descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
External Job Ad Text

Main Responsibilites 主要职责：
Understand and implement both strategic and tactical plan to realize market opportunities
Maintain good engagement with KOLs, and target regional key customers
Participate in brand strategy and action plan development and communication with the brand team and cross-functional team
Drive execution excellence in innovative disease management campaigns
Develop Speaker management system and maintain operation excellence on speaker management
Seamlessly collaborate within the marketing team, advocate continuous improvement and best practice sharing
Provide support to department projects and take initiative in creative ideas of execution excellence
Communicate and collaborate effectively with other brand relevant department

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验

Education/
• Qualifications教育程度/所获资格证书
Bachelor above
Medical, pharmacy or biology background preferred

Job Required Competencies岗位所需胜任力
MNC background
Minimum 3-5 years’ experience of Marketing/Sales
2-3 years Pharmaceutical Marketing experience as must
Good communication and presentation skills in Chinese and English (oral and writing)
Strong Project Management capabilities, self-motivated and results-driven
Strong execution capability, strong cross-functional communication

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
客户管理
• 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道 , 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（ HCP ）观念、学术需求 传递专业化医学 / 疾病 / 产品信息
• 传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案
• 传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈
• 传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设
• 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生 / 科室教育 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理
• 规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。
• 组织和支持区域专家会议
• 了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈
• 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理
• 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作
• 成为产品和疾病领域的专家 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持
• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力

你需要具备哪些条件才能加大申请这个岗位的竞争力呢？
岗位所需胜任力
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识
• 良好学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• 正确的思维和行为 ( 使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维 )

工作年限
• 3 年以上医药行业工作经验
• 既往有学术推广 / 市场 / 医学经验
• 跨职能工作经验为佳

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
您是谁
您负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

您的机会:
A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Position Summary: The Senior Product Managerfor New Product Launch acts as the "strategic architect" and "commercial driver" for upcoming innovative drugs, new indications, or core medical devices in the pipeline. This role is responsible for defining the product’s core value proposition, developing the cross-functional Go-to-Market strategy, building strong scientific advocacy among Top KOLs, and empowering the field force. The ultimate goal is to ensure a compliant, high-impact, and commercially successful market entry and accelerated post-launch uptake.

1. Pre-Launch Market Insight & Strategic Positioning

• Clinical & Unmet Need Assessment: Conduct deep dives into medical literature, clinical trial data, and treatment guidelines to identify target patient profiles and critical unmet medical needs.

• Core Value Proposition : Translate complex clinical and evidence-based medical data into compelling, differentiated, and compliant brand stories and product positioning.

• Competitive Intelligence: Monitor competitors’ clinical pipelines, pricing structures, and marketing activities to develop effective defense and counter-attack strategies.
2. Go-to-Market & Access Strategy Development

• Brand Plan Ownership: Design and execute the 1-to-3-year strategic and tactical Brand Plans for the product launch, effectively allocating the Marketing Budget to maximize ROI.

• Cross-Functional Synergy: * Partner with the Medical Affairs team to align on post-launch evidence generation, Investigator-Initiated Trials, or Real-World Studies.Collaborate with the Market Access team to provide pharmacoeconomic data supporting National Reimbursement Drug List (NRDL) negotiation and provincial bidding.

• Omnichannel Marketing (OCM): Develop and implement a digital/omnichannel engagement strategy tailored to Healthcare Professionals to expand brand share-of-voice .
3. KOL Engagement & Academic Advocacy

• KOL Network Building: Establish and maintain robust academic relationships with national and regional Key Opinion Leaders , medical associations, and guideline committee members.

• High-Impact Academic Events: Plan and lead nationwide launch events, standalone symposia, advisory boards, and satellite meetings to establish scientific credibility.

• Compliance Management: Ensure all marketing materials (Detailing Aids, Slides, Patient brochures) and events strictly adhere to industry compliance standards (e.g., RDPAC guidelines), local Advertising Laws, and internal policies.
4. Sales Enablement & Launch Performance Tracking

• Launch Toolkits Generation: Create high-quality, scientifically sound marketing toolkits, detailing flows, objection handling guides, and FAQs for the field force.

• Field Force Training: Lead product strategy and message training for the sales team (VFE, Regional Managers, Medical Representatives) to ensure message consistency and executional excellence.

• KPI Tracking & Course Correction: Track and analyze key launch metrics (e.g., hospital listing rate, target physician penetration, prescription conversion, and market share). Dynamically adjust tactics based on market feedback.
【Job Requirements】

• Education background: * Bachelor’s degree or above in Clinical Medicine, Pharmacy, Biology, Life Sciences, or a related field (Master’s, Ph.D., or MBA is highly preferred). A strong scientific background is critical to understanding clinical data.

• Work Experience: Minimum of 5 years of marketing experience in the pharmaceutical/biote

The Position On en Roche Looking to launch your career in healthcare and make a real impact from day one? Join a global leader in diagnostics and be part of shaping the future of healthcare operations, finance, and supply chain at scale. What is it?
• ON en Roche is a 2-year rotational graduate program within Finance & Operations designed for high-potential early-career professionals.
• From day one, you will take ownership of real business challenges that directly impact operations, customer experience, and Roche’s end-to-end value chain.
• You will rotate across different areas within Finance & Operations, gaining hands-on experience and a holistic understanding of how a global healthcare organization operates.
• The program is designed to accelerate your development through structured rotations, cross-functional exposure, and continuous learning. Why join?
• Real ownership from day one on business-critical challenges
• Exposure to an end-to-end healthcare value chain at global scale
• Rotations across Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations
• High-impact projects with international and cross-functional teams
• Structured development, mentoring, and continuous feedback
• Clear fast-track career progression within Roche The Opportunity Drive business performance through financial insight, strategic sourcing, and data-driven decision-making. Rotations may include:
• Customer Finance
• Controlling & Reporting
• Procurement & Strategic Sourcing The Position
• Analyze financial and operational performance to identify risks and opportunities
• Support pricing, cost, and margin optimization initiatives
• Contribute to procurement and sourcing strategies
• Participate in forecasting, business planning, and performance management
• Monitor customer profitability and performance
• Support cross-functional transformation initiative Who you are We are looking for high-potential early-career professionals with a strong analytical mindset and motivation to build a career in healthcare and operations.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Fluent Spanish and English (written and spoken)
• Interest in healthcare, operations, and data-driven environments
• Full availability for a 24-month program Timelines & further information

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Role Purpose Roche Diagnostics provides integrated solutions for diagnostics testing in commercial and hospital labs, medical centers and laboratory networks. Our products and solutions support healthcare professionals in clinical decision making in a wide field of indications . Within the Healthcare Transformation and Access Department, we are seeking a Medical Affairs Advisor Advisor to provide medical and scientific support for our solutions with an initial core focus on Oncology diseases. The Medical Affairs Partner is a field-based medical expert in one or more therapeutic areas, responsible for developing and maintaining relationships with healthcare professionals (HCPs) in order to create a better understanding of products and increase disease/product awareness, providing clinical and scientific support for HCPs, and providing medical information for our products to patients, caregivers, and the general public. Role scope: Key responsibilities
• Drives business-aligned medical strategy by leading annual and ongoing medical planning, including inputs on situational analyses and strategies
• Plan and implement medical tactics and activities for assigned therapeutic areas
• Plan and handle medical budgets
• Communicate, drive, and handle clinical research/study for medical evidence generation that helps practitioners, patients and payers make good health care decisions
• Establish and maintain relationships with healthcare professionals (HCPs) to create a better understanding of the company’s products and increase disease/product awareness
• Provide clinical and scientific support for HCPs, including answering questions about products and other related issues
• Prepare and deliver presentations on the therapeutic areas and company products, and participate in panel discussions
• Keep up to date on scientific and clinical developments in the therapeutic areas, and provide medical information to internal and external customers
• Review of non-, and promotional materials
• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and Roche Safety, Security, Health, and Environmental Protection policies, while demonstrating a solid understanding of compliance requirements and upholding the high standard of integrity. Additional task, duties and responsibilities:
• Responsible for acting in line with legal, regulatory and company standards and codes of practice (such as Roche Code of Conduct and any other Roche directives and guidelines)
• Work in a cross functional setup applying agile working methodology
• Ensure compliance with HCP interaction guidelines (e.g. iHCP) , and other guidelines from Roche quality and compliance groups Requirements: Education and experience
• Master’s degree or higher in science or related fields
• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in the life sciences industry (diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, or biotechnology).
• Hands-on experience in medical affairs, clinical development, scientific communication, or product strategy .
• Prior experience in Oncology diseases is highly preferred.
• Good Compliance track record. No material Compliance violation is identified in the past 5 years Required skills and qualifications
• Good knowledge of Compliance requirements and clear understanding of high standards of Integrity
• Scientific and commercial understanding of diagnostic products, knowledge of product development and tri

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we believe every patient deserves the best diagnostic outcome. As a Technical Service Manager, you will be the driving force behind the reliability of Roche diagnostic instruments in Indonesia — leading a team of Field Service Engineers and ensuring that every laboratory we serve can trust their equipment, every day. If you are a hands-on technical leader who thrives in the field, takes ownership of outcomes, and genuinely cares about the people you lead and the customers you serve, we want to hear from you. The Opportunity You will lead the Field Service Engineer (FSE) team for Roche Diagnostics Indonesia, owning the full lifecycle of instrument service — from installation and preventive maintenance through to troubleshooting and customer escalation management. Reporting to the Head of Customer Support, you will be accountable for team performance, customer satisfaction, and the operational discipline that keeps our instruments — and our customers' laboratories — running at their best. In this role, you will:
• Lead, develop, and manage a team of Field Service Engineers — setting clear targets, monitoring performance, and building their technical and professional capability
• Own instrument reliability across your territory: plan and execute preventive maintenance, manage escalations, and ensure all service activities are documented and traceable in line with Roche SOPs
• Drive customer satisfaction by resolving hardware and software issues with urgency, following up within 24 hours on all raised problems, and handling customer complaints with accountability
• Ensure operational compliance across all service activities — including case management in Rexis, service bulletin implementation, and trunk stock and spare parts management
• Report on team performance and operational metrics to the Head of Customer Support, providing clear monthly reviews and contributing to continuous service improvement Who You Are You bring:
• A Bachelor's degree in Electro Medical Engineering or Electrical Engineering from a reputable university
• Minimum 5 years of technical service experience in the medical device, diagnostics, or healthcare industry — with direct people management experience
• Proven ability to lead and develop field-based teams, with a track record of driving accountability, performance, and team capability
• Strong technical grounding in instrument troubleshooting, installation, and preventive maintenance, with the judgment to know when to escalate
• A customer-first mindset: you take ownership of issues, communicate proactively, and are not satisfied until the customer is
• Comfort working independently in a field-intensive environment — including travel across Indonesia and flexibility for weekend responsibilities when required
• Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken, for reporting and cross-functional communication Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Introduction The ERP Solution Architect designs business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready E2E solutions that involve, but go beyond ERP. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements and evolving the architecture throughout the product life cycle . By solving complex technical problems, defining reference architectures, and aligning with the broader architecture community for governance, you will ensure robust implementations that deliver enhanced value to the organization. The Opportunity:
• Design E2E Solutions: Serve as the primary point of contact for mediation and digital product provisioning, designing robust solutions that align product requirements with enterprise architecture and RDT governance standards .
• Drive Technical Roadmap & Strategy: Own, develop, and maintain the product's technology roadmap while assessing impacts, managing technical debt, and piloting new technologies to maximize business value .
• Manage Commercial Backoffice Standards: Own all technical matters related to usage mediation and provisioning of digital products, driving discussions with digital product teams to ensure full adoption of commercial backoffice standards .
• Architectural Governance & Documentation: Document and continuously evolve the architecture throughout the product lifecycle, managing Non-Functional Requirements (NFR), fitness functions, and reference patterns .
• Lead Stakeholder Collaboration: Explain complex or sensitive technical information to diverse audiences, working collaboratively to build consensus among product teams, business stakeholders, and technical peers .
• Bridge Business & Technology: Bring together deep technical expertise with a strong business understanding to seamlessly integrate digital product teams with commercial backoffice ecosystems .
• Provide Technical Oversight: Deliver high-level technical guidance, mentorship, and consultation for digital product teams, identifying clear opportunities to improve existing applications .
• Support Global Operations: Drive operational excellence by analyzing end-to-end production issues and ensuring accurate, timely corrective actions across the integrated application landscape . Who you are:
• Education: Possess a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related technical field (Required) .
• Architectural & ERP Experience: Demonstrated extensive experience designing, documenting, and implementing business-driven, standards-based solutions within an ERP landscape (SAP ECC and SAP S/4 environments preferred) .
• Integration & Mediation Expertise: Proven track record with System Integration Technologies, common Integration Design Patterns (MuleSoft, CPI, Solace, Event mesh preferred), and knowledge of Convergent mediation via DigitalRoute .
• API & Development Skills: Proficient in using API tools like Postman/Bruno, combined with developer experience in languages such as JavaScript and Python .
• Agile Frameworks: Experienced working in Agile methodologies (like SAFe and Scrum) with a proven ability to collaborate seamlessly with local, nearshore, and offshore cross-functional teams .
• Analytical Problem Solver: Strong analytical skills with the ability to take a new perspective on existing solutions, owning complex technical issues end-to-end to ensure permanent resolution . PDF (Google Drive)

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. Diagnostics are an integral part of decision-making along every step of a person’s health, wellness and disease journey. A diagnostic test alone can help clinicians change the course of someone’s healthcare experience – and their life. We are a healthcare pioneer and the industry’s global leader in in-vitro diagnostics, our Diagnostics Division pushes boundaries and challenges the status quo to redefine what’s possible. Our commitment to research and development means we can bring to the market integrated solutions in diagnostic testing, laboratory efficiency, healthcare digitalisation and decision support tools and software. Our products deliver increasingly precise information to help save lives, prevent or control the risk of infection and monitor treatment effectiveness. The Opportunity This position is primarily responsible for initiating, directing, and executing scientific research, development, and manufacturing process strategies to support both new and existing products. A central pillar of this role involves creating and scaling a comprehensive digital pathology workflow, bridging the gap between traditional histology and high-throughput data analysis. You will investigate the feasibility of applying a wide variety of scientific principles to potential inventions and products, with a specific emphasis on integrating state-of-the-art imaging tools and automated analysis platforms into the laboratory ecosystem. As a subject matter expert, you will maintain a broad knowledge of cutting-edge theories, serving as an in-house and outside consultant while making meaningful contributions to scientific literature and international conferences. You may act as a primary spokesperson for corporate scientific affairs and provide strategic advice to top management regarding the evolution of digital pathology and assay innovation. Furthermore, you will participate in and promote the professional growth of junior scientists. Utilizing advanced professional concepts, you will contribute to the development of product and process principles, achieving complex objectives through creative and effective methodologies.
• Digital Pathology & CDx Development: Participate in the creation and implementation of digital pathology workflows for Companion Diagnostics (CDx) projects, ensuring all methods and processes are optimized for clinical-grade imaging and data integrity.
• Research & Experimental Design: Plan and execute complex R&D projects using advanced scientific knowledge and DOE (Design of Experiments) to define new components, identify technical challenges, and develop potentially patentable reagents or systems.
• Data Analysis & Process Improvement: Analyze experimental data to form technical conclusions and implement improvements in work processes or documentation, consistently promoting a "Quality First Time" approach to all deliverables.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with cross functional teams to share expertise, contribute to project planning, and deliver presentations of results to internal and external stakeholders to advance corporate scientific goals. Who You Are:
• Bachelor's Degree in a relevant discipline plus 8 or more years of progressive work experienc

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Developing enzymes for Roche internally as well as externally means for us the development of tailor-made biocatalysts and biological targets for creating the best-in-class molecules for Roche and our clients. Combining several biotechnological methods such as expression profiling, cell cultivation, enzyme purification portfolio, enzyme engineering and biochemical investigations, we always try to improve, to maintain or to design new enzymes. Mandatory, the complete value chain as a platform thought of Roche is given. We are working cross-functional for both the diagnostic and pharma division of Roche worldwide. Being an R&D function we always try to keep close contacts with our clients as with our production for ensuring a fast, but qualitatively high development which should result in functional Roche products finally.

As a Post-Doc Position in Novel Enzymes (m/f/d) , you actively shape the development of new enzymes using biotechnological and bioinformatic methods. Become part of an innovative research team that consolidates a platform from dry-lab to wet-lab to develop customized enzymes for our diagnostics. We offer you a unique opportunity to translate your scientific ideas into practice and thus contribute to the improvement of patient health.

The opportunity

• You ensure the development of new enzymes using a combination of biotechnological and bioinformatic methods

• You are responsible for the independent production of tailored proteins/enzymes using molecular biological methods or the establishment of new production and screening methods for protein variants

• You support the consolidation of a platform from dry-lab to wet-lab, suitable for the protein engineering of novel enzymes

• You implement new biochemical and biophysical readouts suitable for the screening and development of tailored enzymes

• You pursue scientific and technical education by continuously following and reading the relevant scientific literature

Who you are

• You possess a university degree (Dr. / Ph.D.) in a relevant field

• You have specialized knowledge in the areas of protein engineering, bioinformatics, and molecular biology

• Experience in microbiology, downstream and upstream processing, as well as chemistry, is an advantage

• You demonstrate knowledge and expertise in recombinant protein expression, protein purification, and the development of protein analytical methods for protein characterization

• You are willing to provide consultation and troubleshooting regarding enzyme challenges in Research & Development and Production

This position is limited to 2 years.

Application documents
To make the application process as convenient as possible for you please add only a motivation letter and your updated CV . References and certificates are not required at this stage.

We look forward to receiving your application!

As a Post-Doc Position in Novel Enzymes (m/f/d) , you actively shape the development of new enzymes using biotechnological and bioinformatic methods. Become part of an innovative research team that consolidates a platform from dry-lab to wet-lab to develop customized enzymes for our diagnostics. We offer you a unique opportunity to translate your scientific ideas into practice and thus contribute to the improvement of patient health.

The opportunity

• You ensure the development of new enzymes using a combination of biotechnological and bioinformatic methods

• You are responsible for the independent production of tailored proteins/enzymes using molecular biological methods or the establishment of new production and screening methods for protein variants

• You support the consolidation of a platform from dry-lab to wet-lab, suitable for the protein engineering of novel enzymes

• You implement new biochemical and biophysical readouts suitable for the screening and development of tailored enzymes

• You pursue scientific and technical education by continuously following and reading the relevant scientific literature

Who you are

• You possess a university degree (Dr. / Ph.D.) in a relevant field

• You have specialized knowledge in the areas of protein engineering, bioinformatics, and molecular biology

• Experience in microbiology, downstream and upstream processing, as well as chemistry, is an advantage

• You demonstrate knowledge and expertise in recombinant protein expression, protein purification, and the development of protein analytical methods for protein characterization

• You are willing to provide consultation and troubleshooting regarding enzyme challenges in Research & Development and Production

This position is limited to 2 years.

Application documents
To make the application process as convenient as possible for you please add only a motivation letter and your updated CV . References and certificates are not required at this stage.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Lead project progress control, resource coordination, and cross-functional communication to ensure on-time and high-quality delivery.
• Project Implementation: Collaborate with Product Managers to develop effective promotion tools; ensure product strategies and marketing activities are efficiently executed and implemented at the sales terminal.
• AI Technology Empowerment: Act as the department's AI application expert; guide and assist product groups in building AI-based product management tools and intelligent workflows to drive digital transformation. The Position At Roche , we believe that access to reliable diagnostics plays a critical role in improving patient outcomes. As a Field Service Engineer, you will be at the forefront of ensuring our instruments operate at their best—supporting healthcare professionals with timely, high-quality technical service. This role offers the opportunity to work directly with cutting-edge diagnostic technologies while building strong partnerships with customers across your territory. Your Opportunity As a Field Service Engineer, you will:
• Deliver installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of diagnostic instruments at customer sites
• Perform preventive maintenance and ensure all service activities are completed accurately and on time
• Provide technical training and support to customers to ensure optimal product usage
• Document service activities, product issues, and maintenance reports in internal systems
• Manage spare parts, service logs, and administrative responsibilities in a timely manner
• Travel within assigned territory to support hospitals, labs, and healthcare facilities
• Support continuous improvement by contributing to preventive maintenance procedures
• Build trusted relationships with customers, becoming a reliable technical partner in their operations Who you are You are a technically capable and customer-focused professional who thrives in a hands-on environment, with a structured approach to problem-solving and a strong sense of accountability in delivering service excellence.
• Diploma (D3) or Bachelor’s degree (S1) in Electrical, Electronic, Electro-Medical (ATEM), Instrumentation, or Physics Engineering
• Fresh graduates are welcome; 2+ years of experience as a Service Engineer in diagnostics or medical devices is an advantage
• Able to read and understand wiring diagrams, block diagrams, and system functions
• Familiar with measurement tools (e.g., multimeter, voltmeter)
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail and the ability to manage time effectively while working under pressure
• Effective communication skills, including basic English proficiency Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Ecco cosa ci rende Roche.
• Azienda globale stimabile | Opportunità di crescita Carriera
• Posizione permanente a tempo pieno | Bonus annuale e Auto Consentimento
• stipendio base tra $100,000-$120,000
• Team di supporto e dinamico | Modi di lavoro Agile Roche Diagnostics Nuova Zelanda (RDNZ) ha appena aperto un'opportunità emozionante per la posizione di Field Service Engineer di essere basato a Wellington. Lo scopo principale di questa posizione è quello di svolgere la funzione di servizio di ingegneria per la squadra assegnata, ma le responsabilità possono flettersi tra le altre squadre secondo i requisiti aziendali. C'è un requisito di formazione e formazione continua sul portafoglio, strumento e risoluzione dei problemi di prodotto, installazione degli strumenti e messa in servizio, procedure di manutenzione degli strumenti e tutte le modifiche del produttore, e altre questioni dei servizi di postvendita dello strumento per la soddisfazione della base clienti RDNZ e in linea con i nostri SOP organizzativi e politiche. Sfruttando la vostra esperienza di ingegneria diagnostica del laboratorio, le responsabilità di questo ruolo includono ma non sono limitate a;
• Assicurarsi che la base clienti esistente e nuova sia supportata da un servizio post-vendita di qualità.

• Adaptability and Resilience: Dimostrare uno stile di lavoro accurato e la capacità di eseguire efficacemente sotto pressione e in tempi stretti, accoppiato con un atteggiamento aperto e flessibile.
• Forte comunicazione e competenze linguistiche: Esibizione eccellente comando dell'inglese, che consente una comunicazione chiara ed efficace all'interno di un ambiente globale.
• High Motivation e Continuous Learning Mindset: mostrare una motivazione eccezionale e una forte volontà di imparare e sviluppare continuamente, riflettendo un autentico interesse per la finanza.
• Approccio proattivo e orientato al miglioramento: una mentalità di crescita con la passione per il miglioramento dello status quo è altamente apprezzata, così come le competenze IT per l'introduzione dell'automazione. Processo di applicazione:

La position L'équipe fournit des renseignements opportuns, exacts et pertinents pour appuyer le chef du groupe Contrôle et comptabilité, le chef des finances stratégiques, le DPF Pharma et, en bout de ligne, le chef de la direction, le comité de direction et le conseil d'administration en matière de création de valeur et de gestion du rendement financier. En outre, il fournit des renseignements opportuns, exacts et pertinents en matière de décision et analyse le rendement financier réel et prévu des unités de gestion de la Division des produits pharmaceutiques. L'opportunité Le Centre d'excellence de l'entreprise (eCoE) se concentre sur trois domaines : fournir une expertise financière de haut niveau, des idées novatrices et un esprit d'entreprise qui permet l'agilité et la flexibilité aux parties prenantes. Ce rôle consiste à préparer des présentations pour l'équipe de leadership Pharma et l'équipe de leadership Pharma Finance, en plus d'appuyer la compilation de rapports de gestion critiques pour le Comité de direction de l'entreprise, le conseil d'administration et d'autres décideurs clés. Vous contribuerez également à l'analyse du rendement de la Division Roche Pharma, à la production de précieux renseignements et à la contribution à divers projets financiers ponctuels, en veillant à ce que tous les rapports soient mis à jour et continuellement améliorés. De plus, vous aiderez à la préparation de preuves et de documents à l'appui des résultats financiers déclarés. Qui vous êtes :
• Vous êtes actuellement inscrit à l'université de finance / économie ou un diplôme similaire, ou vous avez terminé votre diplôme dans les 12 derniers mois avant la date de début.
• Vous êtes quelqu'un qui veut influencer votre propre développement et vous êtes un joueur d'équipe enthousiaste qui aime travailler dans un environnement global et dynamique.
• Vous êtes à la recherche d'une entreprise où vous avez la possibilité de poursuivre vos intérêts dans toutes les fonctions.
• Compétences analytiques et techniques exceptionnelles : possède de solides compétences analytiques, une perception rapide et un degré élevé de précision et d'attention aux détails. Cela inclut la compétence avancée dans Microsoft Excel (VBA est un plus) et PowerPoint, ainsi que Google Sheets et Google Slides.
• Adaptabilité et résilience: Démontrer un style de travail précis et la capacité de fonctionner efficacement sous pression et dans des délais serrés, avec une attitude ouverte et flexible.
• Compétences en communication et en langue fortes : montrer une excellente maîtrise de l'anglais, permettant une communication claire et efficace dans un environnement mondial.
• Motivation élevée et apprentissage continu : Montrez une motivation exceptionnelle et une forte volonté d'apprendre et de se développer en continu, reflétant un véritable intérêt pour les finances.
• Approche proactive et orientée vers l'amélioration: une mentalité de croissance avec une passion pour l'amélioration du statu quo est très appréciée, tout comme les compétences informatiques pour introduire l'automatisation. Processus de demande :
• Veuillez télécharger votre CV actuel et une lettre de motivation, où vous indiquez votre date de début préférée du stage. Renseignements supplémentaires :
• Veuillez noter qu'en raison de la réglementation, les citoyens non membres de l'UE/AELE doivent fournir un certificat de l'université indiquant qu'un stage est obligatoire dans le cadre des documents de candidature et doivent être inscrits en permanence dans leur université pendant toute la durée de ce stage.
• L'emploi à temps partiel n'est pas possible.
• Date de début la plus proche: 1er août 2026 ou dès disponibilité
• Durée: 12 mois, temps plein (40 heures/semaine)
• Lieu: Bâle Si vous êtes fier de contribuer et de sentir que vous avez le dévouement au travail d'équipe et à l'innovation que nous

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Job Purpose This role acts as a "T-shaped" Value Orchestrator. The primary mission is to break down traditional silos between procurement and finance by autonomously leading procurement strategies and end-to-end (E2E) processes. Crucially, this role ensures that the "savings" and "cash flow optimizations" generated from procurement activities are directly reflected in the affiliate's financial planning and budgeting (P&L), thereby maximizing enterprise business value. Key Responsibilities 1. Procurement Strategy & Vendor Management
• Develop and implement procurement strategies and savings plans to support business objectives and financial targets.
• Execute comprehensive Vendor Management, which includes coordinating supplier selection, onboarding, regular performance evaluations, and maintaining strong, strategic vendor relationships.
• Lead supplier negotiations to secure favorable commercial terms.
• Optimize payment terms to significantly reduce deposit/advance invoices and improve company cash flows. 2. Budgeting & Financial Planning
• Integrate procurement savings and cost optimization plans directly into the affiliate's planning events, including Business Plan (BP), T0, T3, Baseline, as well as Period cost, and M&D budgets.
• Ensure procurement savings initiatives are tightly aligned with and realized in the company’s financial targets and P&L. 3. E2E Process, Governance & SOPs
• Create, maintain, and regularly update Procurement Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and formalized purchasing policies to ensure operational efficiency and compliance across all departments.
• Establish and maintain governance frameworks for the full procurement lifecycle and internal controls.
• Continuously evaluate and enhance procurement processes and controls to ensure scalability and effectiveness. 4. Collaboration & Network Orchestration
• Act as the bridge between Finance and Procurement, and collaborate closely with the Supply Chain team to align procurement processes with operational needs.
• Work with the Roche network (other affiliates and global) to find better solutions and share best practices. 5. Compliance & Risk Management
• Perform risk management on supply contracts, proactively identifying and resolving supply or quality issues.
• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and external regulations. Key Requirements
• Education: Bachelor’s Degree or above, preferably in Business Administration, Finance, or related.
• Experience: 5+ years of experience in procurement, supply chain management, or financial planning in Multinational Companies (MNCs).
• Professional Skills: Strong negotiation, analytical, and financial acumen (understanding of budgeting and P&L). Expertise in vendor management, procurement governance, SOP creation, and E2E processes. Familiarity with financial systems (e.g., SAP) is required.
• Attributes & Languages: Proven ability to solve problems, influence cross-functional teams, and build stakeholder relationships. Fluent in both oral and written English and Mandarin. Good compliance track record. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicin

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position This posting is for Talent Pool purposes and may not correspond to a current vacancy with an active recruitment process. However, it reflects a role for which we regularly recruit or anticipate having openings in the near future for permanent or fixed term opportunities. The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity. The Opportunity As a Senior Financial Accountant you will perform day-to-day and closing activities in cooperation with cross-functional departments, according to predefined deadlines with full ownership of their tasks and in compliance with the Process Documentations of the respective business sub-process. In this position in close collaboration with the Country Chief Accountant, you will focus on:
• Leased assets, fixed asset and CAPEX accounting activities
• Taxes, GL journals and accruals/ provisions, reconciling BS accounts
• Clearing customer accounts and bank suspense accounts, collecting direct debit, daily bank posting, posting and reconciling treasury transactions
• Calculating and issuing AR manual invoices
• Defining and calculating cost and revenue allocation in controlling
• Conducting product closing in the Material Management module of SAP
• Performing Month-end Closing and Reporting for Consolidation and for Divisions
• Preparing audit documentation and participating in internal and external audits Who you are We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have: University degree, preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline
• 2-4 years of experience in a relevant position
• Excellent communication and analytical skills
• Outstanding customer orientation and service focus
• Strong interpersonal skills and team player attitude
• Proficiency in English In exchange we provide you with:
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.
• Excellent benefits : Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.
• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.
• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Esterni International (EAi), parte dell'Ufficio CEO di Roche Pharma, assicura che l'azienda possa modellare le politiche, le decisioni di finanziamento e le condizioni di mercato che determinano come l'innovazione sanitaria sia valutata e premiata. Influenziamo a livello globale dove vengono definite le priorità strategiche e consentiamo a livello locale dove l'impatto aziendale viene consegnato. Attraverso l’advocacy focalizzata e una rete globale collegata, EAi costruisce relazioni di fiducia con governi, istituzioni multilaterali e partner globali, sviluppa sostenitori di terze parti, e forgia alleanze che proteggono e crescono gli affari di Roche, migliorando l’accesso dei pazienti all’innovazione. L'opportunità La politica globale Lead, Malattia Area Policy è un esperto strategico ad alto impatto responsabile della progettazione e della guida delle strategie politiche di Roche attraverso aree terapeutiche prioritarie (TA). Segnalando al Global Disease Area Policy Team Lead, sei l'esperto di politica definitiva, assicurando che l'ambiente di politica esterna e i sistemi sanitari garantiscano un accesso rapido e sostenibile all'innovazione. Questo ruolo richiede una miscela unica di padronanza della politica tecnica, acume commerciale e diplomazia strategica per navigare ambienti sovranazionali complessi, influenzare gli stakeholder senior e orchestrare l'allineamento della politica globale-locale delle malattie senza la necessità di autorità gerarchiche dirette. Principali responsabilità
• Guidare lo sviluppo e l'attuazione del portafoglio di strategia di politica globale e metriche di performance attraverso TA prioritari, garantendo il pieno allineamento con le funzioni globali, regionali e affiliate.
• Definire la visione, la strategia, gli obiettivi e la realizzazione di progetti politici sofisticati, prove, strumenti e posizionamento a lungo termine che rispondono alle esigenze dei pazienti, dei medici e del business.
• Agire come catalizzatore primario per la modellazione degli ambienti politici attraverso l'archiviazione di schemi di impegno e di advocacy esterni per una vasta sezione trasversale delle parti interessate della politica della malattia e del sistema sanitario, identificando e mitigando le barriere all'accesso tra governi e ONG.
• Servire come punto di contatto principale globale per la politica dell'area delle malattie, fornendo una direzione tempestiva ed esperta al business
• Partner strategicamente nelle regioni e nelle affiliate di Roche per garantire un'applicazione coerente delle competenze in materia di politica sanitaria, consentendo l'implementazione locale delle strategie di politica delle malattie e di guidare la missione Affari Esteri attraverso l'organizzazione.
• Condurre lo sviluppo di contenuti a livello di portafoglio, strumenti analitici e strategie politiche di area malattia che traducono complesse sfide di politica esterna e di assistenza sanitaria in insight aziendali e tattiche attuabili.
• Gestire iniziative di politica strategica globale ad alto impatto e flussi di lavoro di progetto, garantendo trasparenza delle risorse e raccomandazioni basate su prove per consentire un processo decisionale di alto livello.
• Sostenere la crescita organizzativa condividendo le competenze della politica sanitaria globale e istruire i coetanei interfunzionali per promuovere una cultura di eccellenza funzionale e innovazione. Chi sei
• Hai un master, MBA, o equivalente in Scienze Politiche, Politica Pubblica, Salute Pubblica, Gestione della Sanità, o un campo relativo.
• 8+ anni di esperienza nella politica sanitaria o negli affari pubblici nel settore delle scienze della vita o del governo, con una profonda padronanza e conoscenza della politica della zona delle malattie, del sistema sanitario e degli ambienti di accesso.
• Un leader riconosciuto con una capacità dimostrata di influenzare dirigenti e politici senior
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position External Affairs International (EAi), part of the Roche Pharma CEO Office, ensures the company can shape the policies, funding decisions, and market conditions that determine how healthcare innovation is valued and rewarded. We influence globally where strategic priorities are defined and enable locally where business impact is delivered. Through focused advocacy and a connected global network, EAi builds trusted relationships with governments, multilateral institutions, and global partners, develops third-party advocates, and forges alliances that protect and grow Roche’s business while improving patient access to innovation. The Opportunity The Global Policy Lead, Disease Area Policy is a high-impact strategic expert responsible for designing and driving Roche’s policy strategies across priority Therapeutic Areas (TAs). Reporting to the Global Disease Area Policy Team Lead, you serve as the definitive policy expert, ensuring that the external policy environment and healthcare systems deliver rapid and sustainable access to innovation. This role requires a unique blend of technical policy mastery, commercial acumen and strategic diplomacy to navigate complex supra-national environments, influence senior stakeholders, and orchestrate global-to-local disease area policy alignment without the need for direct hierarchical authority. Key Responsibilities
• Drive the development and implementation of the global policy strategy portfolio and performance metrics across priority TAs, ensuring full alignment with global, regional, and affiliate functions.
• Define the long-term global disease area policy vision, strategy, objectives and crafting sophisticated policy projects, evidence, tools and positioning that addresses the needs of patients, medical professionals, and the business.
• Act as a primary catalyst for shaping policy environments by architecting external engagement and advocacy frameworks for a broad cross-section of disease area policy and health system stakeholders, while identifying and mitigating barriers to access among governments and NGOs.
• Serve as the primary global point-of-contact for disease area policy, providing timely and expert direction to the business
• Partner strategically across Roche regions and affiliates to ensure consistent application of health policy expertise, enabling local implementation of disease area policy strategies, and to drive the External Affairs mission through the organization.
• Lead the development of portfolio-wide content, analytical tools, and disease area policy strategies that translate complex external policy and healthcare challenges into actionable business insights and tactics.
• Manage high-impact global strategic policy initiatives and project workstreams, ensuring resource transparency and evidence-based recommendations to enable high-level business decision-making.
• Support organizational growth by sharing global health policy expertise and educating cross-functional peers to foster a culture of functional excellence and innovation. Who You Are
• You hold a Master’s degree, MBA, or equivalent in Political Science, Public Policy, Public Health, Healthcare Management, or a related field.
• 8+ years of experience in health policy or public affairs within the life sciences sector or government,with a deep mastery and knowledge of disease area policy, health system and access environments.
• A recognized leader with a demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and policymakers

• Unterstützung des organisatorischen Wachstums durch den Austausch globaler gesundheitspolitischer Expertise und Ausbildung von funktionsübergreifenden Peers, um eine Kultur funktionaler Exzellenz und Innovation zu fördern. Wer bist du?
• Sie halten einen Master-Abschluss, MBA oder gleichwertig in Politikwissenschaft, Public Policy, Public Health, Healthcare Management oder einem verwandten Bereich.
• 8+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Gesundheitspolitik oder öffentlichen Angelegenheiten im Bereich der Lebenswissenschaften oder der Regierung, mit einer tiefen Beherrschung und Kenntnisse der Krankheitsgebietspolitik, des Gesundheitssystems und der Zugangsumgebungen.
• Ein anerkannter Führer mit einer nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, Führungskräfte und Politiker zu beeinflussen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position External Affairs International (EAi), qui fait partie du bureau du PDG de Roche Pharma, veille à ce que l'entreprise puisse façonner les politiques, les décisions de financement et les conditions du marché qui déterminent la valeur et la récompense de l'innovation en matière de soins de santé. Nous influons à l'échelle mondiale là où les priorités stratégiques sont définies et nous permettons à l'échelle locale d'avoir un impact sur les entreprises. Grâce à un plaidoyer ciblé et à un réseau mondial connecté, EAi établit des relations de confiance avec les gouvernements, les institutions multilatérales et les partenaires mondiaux, développe des défenseurs tiers et forge des alliances qui protègent et développent les affaires de Roches tout en améliorant l'accès des patients à l'innovation. L'opportunité Le responsable de la politique mondiale, Politique sur les zones de maladies, est un expert stratégique à fort impact chargé de concevoir et d'orienter les stratégies stratégiques de Roche dans les zones thérapeutiques prioritaires. Rendre compte au responsable de l'équipe de la politique mondiale sur les maladies, vous êtes l'expert en politiques définitives, vous assurant que l'environnement politique externe et les systèmes de soins de santé offrent un accès rapide et durable à l'innovation. Ce rôle exige un mélange unique de maîtrise des politiques techniques, de sens commercial et de diplomatie stratégique afin de naviguer dans des environnements supranationaux complexes, d'influencer les principaux intervenants et d'orchestrer l'alignement des politiques mondiales sur les zones de maladies locales sans avoir besoin d'une autorité hiérarchique directe. Principales responsabilités
• Diriger l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre du portefeuille de stratégies politiques mondiales et des indicateurs de performance dans les AT prioritaires, en assurant une alignement complet avec les fonctions mondiales, régionales et affiliées.
• Définir la vision politique, la stratégie, les objectifs et l'élaboration de projets politiques sophistiqués, de données probantes, d'outils et de positionnement qui répondent aux besoins des patients, des professionnels de la santé et des entreprises.
• Agir en tant que principal catalyseur de la mise en place d'un environnement politique en élaborant des cadres d'engagement et de plaidoyer extérieurs pour un large éventail d'acteurs de la politique et du système de santé, tout en identifiant et en atténuant les obstacles à l'accès entre les gouvernements et les ONG.
• Servir de principal point de contact mondial pour la politique en matière de maladies, fournissant une orientation opportune et experte aux entreprises
• Établir des partenariats stratégiques dans les régions de Roche et les filiales afin d'assurer une application cohérente de l'expertise en matière de politique de santé, de permettre la mise en œuvre locale des stratégies de lutte contre la maladie et de conduire la mission Affaires extérieures à travers l'organisation.
• Diriger l'élaboration de contenus à l'échelle du portefeuille, d'outils d'analyse et de stratégies politiques dans le domaine des maladies qui traduisent des politiques extérieures complexes et des défis en matière de soins de santé en idées et tactiques opérationnelles réalisables.
• Gérer les initiatives stratégiques mondiales à haut impact et les axes de travail des projets, en assurant la transparence des ressources et en formulant des recommandations fondées sur des données factuelles pour permettre une prise de décisions de haut niveau.
• Soutenir la croissance organisationnelle en partageant l'expertise mondiale en matière de politique de santé et en éduquant les pairs interfonctionnels pour favoriser une culture d'excellence fonctionnelle et d'innovation. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un Master, d'un MBA ou d'un équivalent en sciences politiques, politiques publiques, santé publique, gestion des soins de santé ou un domaine connexe.
• 8 ans et plus d'expérience en matière de politique de santé ou d'affaires publiques dans le secteur des sciences de la vie ou au sein du gouvernement, avec une maîtrise et une connaissance approfondies de la politique en matière de maladies, du système de santé et des environnements d'accès.
• Un dirigeant reconnu ayant une capacité démontrée d'influencer les cadres supérieurs et les décideurs

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. As an IT Workplace Services Professional you continuously evaluate and improve the employee experience through subject matter expertise in the digital workplace, focusing on efficiency, employee satisfaction, and ensuring business continuity. This is a varied role and can give you a springboard into other careers in Informatics and beyond. The Opportunity
• You will act as a digital enabler for our business colleagues & functions
• You act as the owner of the digital employee experience for the respective site
• You drive employee productivity through consultancy, provide intimacy and site proximity at the sites, and ensure a personalized Roche employee experience.
• You leverage available data (e.g.: Nexthink, SNOW) for proactive support
• You support and manage the Incident/ Request management processes to ensure SLAs are met and drive continuous improvement through trend analysis.
• You manage IT hardware lifecycle management & deskside support processes/managed services for the site
• You provide support & guidance for onsite services (e.g. events and meetings) by leveraging from internal and external providers. Drive the user experience and promote best practices.
• You drive and enable standard workplace infrastructure, global/local projects, and deployments in collaboration with product teams.
• You proactively address and follow through on process-improvement ideas
• You support & drive budgeting process related to the respective site
• You support local audit, inspection and certification requirements
• You support local Business Continuity and IT Disaster Recovery planning activities Who you are:
• Exhibits a Lean-Agile Mindset
• Manages risks progressively and in a way that leads to opportunity
• Enterprise mindset that can break down silos. Focus on delivery through collaboration, and bringing people together to work towards the same purpose across organizational boundaries.
• Exhibits intellectual curiosity and integrity and has a strong passion for innovation
• Understanding of Roche-supported operating systems, devices and applications, including the Google Suite of Applications, MS Office, etc.
• Experience with ticketing systems and troubleshooting hardware, software and mobile devices.
• Excellent working knowledge of the ITIL v3 processes in an IT service delivery
• Solid written and oral communication skills in German and English. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Learning Intern , you will join our Global Learning Services (GLS) team within the People Support Solutions (PSS) organization in Roche. In this role, you will assist with executing routine administrative and system data maintenance activities in our Learning Management System ( Cornerstone ). You will gain hands-on learning experience in a shared service environment, supporting learning processes and ensuring high-quality, customer-focused support for our global learning community. Your Key Responsibilities
• System Administration : Execute routine data maintenance and system administrative tasks within Cornerstone and other relevant learning systems in a timely and accurate manner.
• Process Support : Assist with the administrative coordination of various training events, including new employee orientation, leadership training, professional training, and other training requests.
• Customer Support : Help provide customer service and troubleshooting support regarding training records, learning processes, and system inquiries to internal HR experts and business partners.
• Documentation : Assist in keeping team knowledge up to date by contributing to and updating Standard Work Instructions (SWIs) and local Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
• Continuous Improvement : Actively participate in team meetings, workshops, and work-related events to help identify process improvements and support new ways of learning.
• Compliance & Integrity : Perform daily duties with high integrity, adhering to global and local guidelines, including strict data privacy rules and safety, security, and environmental (SHE) regulations. Who You Are We are looking for an analytical, proactive and collaborative university students who bring the following skills and competencies:
• Education : Currently enrolled in a university program with active/passive full-time student status in Hungary (studies in HR, Business, or Social Sciences are preferred).
• Able to work 25-30 hrs/week .
• Languages: Fluent English (C1) is required. German (B2-C1) also required.
• System & IT Skills : Experience with standard IT applications (Google Suite or Microsoft) and an eagerness to learn cloud-based learning management software (like Cornerstone).
• Growth Mindset : An agile learner who is open to seeking and giving feedback, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, and capable of navigating complex data.
• Customer Centricity : Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a focus on delivering reliable support and managing customer expectations.
• Collaboration : A supportive team player who enjoys working in a multicultural, cross-border matrix environment. What We Offer
• Hands-on experience operating Cornerstone and various other tools.
• Deep exposure to a global Shared Service Center environment.
• Competitive salary.
• A collaborative and supportive team environment that values your development and continuous learning.
• Flexible working hours according to your studies. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changi

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position On en Roche Looking to launch your career in healthcare and make a real impact from day one? Join a global leader in diagnostics and be part of shaping the future of healthcare operations, finance, and supply chain at scale. What is it?
• ON en Roche is a 2-year rotational graduate program within Finance & Operations designed for high-potential early-career professionals.
• From day one, you will take ownership of real business challenges that directly impact operations, customer experience, and Roche’s end-to-end value chain.
• You will rotate across different areas within Finance & Operations, gaining hands-on experience and a holistic understanding of how a global healthcare organization operates.
• The program is designed to accelerate your development through structured rotations, cross-functional exposure, and continuous learning. Why join?
• Real ownership from day one on business-critical challenges
• Exposure to an end-to-end healthcare value chain at global scale
• Rotations across Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations
• High-impact projects with international and cross-functional teams
• Structured development, mentoring, and continuous feedback
• Clear fast-track career progression within Roche The Opportunity Optimize real-world operations by improving efficiency, scalability, and digital transformation in industrial environments. Rotations may include:
• Site Operations
• Warehouse operations & material flow
• Customer Fulfillment & Service Operations
• Direct Procurement The Position
• Support site capacity planning and growth readiness
• Improve warehouse layout, material flow, and productivity
• Analyze operational flows to identify improvement opportunities
• Contribute to automation, analytics, and process redesign projects
• Translate operational data into actionable insights Who you are We are looking for high-potential early-career professionals with a strong analytical mindset and motivation to build a career in healthcare and operations.
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations - focused profiles , or related fields
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Fluent Spanish and English (written and spoken)
• Interest in healthcare, operations, and data-driven environments
• Full availability for a 24-month program Timelines & further information
• Full-time 24-month graduate contract (not a university internship agreement)
• Based in Sant Cugat (Barcelona)
• Start date: September 2026
• Assessment Center: July 7th
• Applications reviewed on a rolling basis Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity: As a R2R Period-End Close Senior Analyst based in San José, Costa Rica, you will be an integral part of our Global Shared Services organization. This role serves as a subject matter expert, delivering advanced accounting support and complex financial analysis while driving process improvements and automation initiatives. You will act as a key point of contact for accounting and reporting matters, serving as a trusted advisor for our supported affiliates. Your key responsibilities will include:
• Accounting Expertise & Audit Leadership: Lead complex accounting analyses and audit activities for assigned areas. You will serve as a subject matter expert for affiliates and internal stakeholders, ensuring technical accounting excellence.
• Financial Reporting & Close Activities: Prepare and review complex financial statements and reports. You will manage month-end close activities, including journal entries, cost allocations, and reconciliations, while maintaining a proper audit trail and compliance with standards.
• Analysis, Commentary & Advisory: Analyze financial results to investigate variances and provide clear, actionable insights to management. You will interpret and communicate financial data effectively to both internal and external stakeholders.
• Compliance & Governance: Ensure strict compliance with company policies, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements.
• Team Development: Support the growth of the team through coaching, reviewing work, and contributing to cross-functional initiatives and global projects.
• Continuous Improvement: Drive process improvements and support automation initiatives to increase the efficiency of the Record-to-Report flow. Who you are: You are a highly analytical finance professional with a strong attention to detail, capable of working independently in a fast-paced environment to meet tight deadlines. Requirements and Qualifications:
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance , or a related field. A professional certification ( CPA, ACCA , or equivalent) is preferred.
• Experience: Minimum of 4+ years of experience in accounting or finance. Prior experience in a Finance Shared Services environment is preferred. Experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry is a plus.
• Technical Skills: * Strong knowledge of US GAAP and/or IFRS .
• Experience with ERP systems, specifically SAP (FI, CO/PA, MM, FA, FCC) and BlackLine is highly desirable.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Workspace.
• Languages: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; fluent in English and Spanish . Portuguese and or French is preferred.
• Core Competencies: * Strong stakeholder management and collaboration abilities.
• Problem-solving mindset with a focus on process automation and continuous improvement.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision. Relocation benefits are not available for this posting. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
