The Position As a Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist in the Global Digital Hub, you will ensure the successful delivery of digital campaigns content creation projects within the Digital Campaigns Chapter. This role plays a crucial part in coordinating and completing timely, high-quality digital campaigns while maintaining our delivery standards. You'll collaborate closely with affiliate business teams, brand teams, third-party vendors, campaign coordinators, and global campaign coordinators to bring digital initiatives to life. The Opportunity In this pivotal role, you will:
• Manage Campaign Delivery : Oversee the end-to-end digital campaigns content creation and delivery process, from initiation through final implementation, ensuring all projects meet established quality and timeline standards.
• Coordinate Stakeholder Feedback : Incorporate insights and feedback from diverse stakeholders, revising digital campaign content requests to align with expectations and project objectives.
• Drive Process Improvement : Coach stakeholders on new processes and requirements that enhance efficiency and optimize our ways of working in digital campaign delivery.
• Support Campaign Leadership : Collaborate with Campaign Coordinators and Global Campaign Coordinators on client communications, change management initiatives, and service offering updates.
• Establish Best Practices : Adopt and maintain existing processes, establish governance principles, and ensure proper documentation and implementation across your area of responsibility—contributing to our Center of Excellence. Who You Are You are a detail-oriented professional with a strong passion for project coordination and a solid understanding of digital marketing principles and content creation processes. Your exceptional organizational and communication skills allow you to juggle multiple projects with ease, consistently delivering high-quality results on time. You thrive in collaborative environments, building strong relationships with diverse stakeholders and gracefully adapting to feedback to exceed expectations. Required Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field
• Minimum 1+ years of proven project management experience, preferably in digital marketing or content creation
• Strong understanding of digital marketing principles and campaign management
• Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities with a demonstrated track record of managing multiple simultaneous projects
• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with proven ability to collaborate effectively across diverse stakeholder groups
• Experience coordinating cross-functional teams including designers, copywriters, marketers, and clients/stakeholders
• Strong time management skills to prioritize competing priorities
• Openness to learning new project management tools and software
• Demonstrated ability to thrive in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments Ready to make an impact? If you're excited about driving digital campaign success and leading seamless project delivery, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now to join Roche's Global Digital Hub and help shape the future of our digital campaigns. Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Senior Software Verification & Validation Engineer (Test Automation) Roche Sequencing is not only changing science, but we are changing lives. Our software teams are laying the groundwork for the future by developing powerful bioinformatics algorithms, data analysis tools, and software/systems infrastructures so researchers and clinicians can make better health decisions faster. As a Senior Verification & Validation Engineer, you will design/develop verification tests, develop test framework and infrastructure, plan test strategies and document design history for Roche Sequencing products. Your work will help us create cutting-edge laboratory workflow software for our non-invasive prenatal testing (NIPT) and Oncology test offerings. Do you want to develop software products that scientists and others in the life sciences will use to diagnose, find treatments, and eventually beat diseases like cancer or help with early prenatal diagnoses of genetic conditions? Our team builds highly scalable, reliable software and secure systems for better diagnostics. Y ou will have meaningful work developing an innovative technology that saves and improves lives around the world. This is an opportunity to work in a highly collaborative team, working with some of the best engineers in the industry. The Opportunity
• You will collaborate with a cross-functional team of lab personnel, assay developers, algorithm scientists, and technical leadership developing cutting edge clinical laboratory products.
• You will author and confirm correctness of requirements-driven tests, covering aspects including testing approaches (exploratory, white box, black box, etc.), testing level, (end-to-end, system, integration, unit, etc.), and testing types (functional, performance, scalability, etc.).
• You will automate and execute front-end and back-end tests, covering instrument software and web applications.
• You will participate in requirements, architecture, and design specification reviews
• You will collate and report quality metrics and enhancing quality dashboards.
• You will perform root cause analysis of defects for products under development and supporting on-market issue investigation.
• You will document design history as required by the standard operating procedures and ensuring regulatory compliance of verification and validation deliverables.
• You will partner with developers and other V&V personnel on engineering excellence and continuous improvement initiatives.
• You will support audits by providing test evidence and documentation. This position is based in Santa Clara, CA. This is a hybrid role requiring 3 - 4 days on site. Relocation benefits are not being provided. Who You Are:
• You have a Bachelor's in Science in Computer Science (or equivalent field); or a Masters in Computer Science or equivalent field
• You have 5+ years of experience in software development or software verification or validation
• You have demonstrated experience using Agile SW development and accompanying tools
• You have demonstrated experience authoring design history and software release documentation
• You have demonstrated experience working with global teams.
• You demonstrate excellent communication skills, both written and oral.
• You are familiar with modern automated test technologies (Selenium, GitHub, etc.) across a variety of platforms.
• Familiarity with SQL and basic database operations is a desirable skill. Preferred:
• You have experience working in a reg

As a Senior Verification & Validation Engineer, you will design/develop verification tests, develop test framework and infrastructure, plan test strategies and document design history for Roche Sequencing products. Your work will help us create cutting-edge laboratory workflow software for our non-invasive prenatal testing (NIPT) and Oncology test offerings. Do you want to develop software products that scientists and others in the life sciences will use to diagnose, find treatments, and eventually beat diseases like cancer or help with early prenatal diagnoses of genetic conditions? Our team builds highly scalable, reliable software and secure systems for better diagnostics. Y ou will have meaningful work developing an innovative technology that saves and improves lives around the world. This is an opportunity to work in a highly collaborative team, working with some of the best engineers in the industry. The Opportunity
• You will collaborate with a cross-functional team of lab personnel, assay developers, algorithm scientists, and technical leadership developing cutting edge clinical laboratory products.
• You will author and confirm correctness of requirements-driven tests, covering aspects including testing approaches (exploratory, white box, black box, etc.), testing level, (end-to-end, system, integration, unit, etc.), and testing types (functional, performance, scalability, etc.).
• You will automate and execute front-end and back-end tests, covering instrument software and web applications.
• You will participate in requirements, architecture, and design specification reviews
• You will collate and report quality metrics and enhancing quality dashboards.
• You will perform root cause analysis of defects for products under development and supporting on-market issue investigation.
• You will document design history as required by the standard operating procedures and ensuring regulatory compliance of verification and validation deliverables.
• You will partner with developers and other V&V personnel on engineering excellence and continuous improvement initiatives.
• You will support audits by providing test evidence and documentation. This position is based in Santa Clara, CA. This is a hybrid role requiring 3 - 4 days on site. Relocation benefits are not being provided. Who You Are:
• You have a Bachelor's in Science in Computer Science (or equivalent field); or a Masters in Computer Science or equivalent field
• You have 5+ years of experience in software development or software verification or validation
• You have demonstrated experience using Agile SW development and accompanying tools
• You have demonstrated experience authoring design history and software release documentation
• You have demonstrated experience working with global teams.
• You demonstrate excellent communication skills, both written and oral.
• You are familiar with modern automated test technologies (Selenium, GitHub, etc.) across a variety of platforms.
• Familiarity with SQL and basic database operations is a desirable skill. Preferred:
• You have experience working in a reg

The Position Esta posición tiene una duración de 6 meses con posibilidad de extensión de hasta 18 meses. OBJETIVO DEL PUESTO: Facilitar el camino de transformación de nuestras personas y organización entregando soporte de People & Culture (P&C) a OneRoche a través de la ejecución de diferentes iniciativas de desarrollo, training, performance, comunicaciones, y operaciones que apoyan la agilidad, efectividad y transformación organizacional. ROLES Y RESPONSABILIDADES: P&C Operations:
• Simplificar procesos y proponer áreas de mejora y eficiencia para facilitar la transformación organizacional.
• Guiar y prestar apoyo a los People Managers y colaboradores en procesos de Workday, facilitar Workday training on-demand.
• Seguimiento con P&C PSS local y regional, y Workday cuando sea necesario.
• Coordinar nuevos ingresos con equipos locales, IT, y SHE en cuanto a documentación y equipos requeridos.
• Apoyar en actividades de onboarding con la finalidad de que las personas cuenten con todo lo necesario para su efectividad laboral e integración a la organización. People & Culture Communications:
• Coordinar las comunicaciones de People & Culture de nuevos ingresos, desarrollo de Carrera, transformación, cambios organizacionales, y salidas de OneRoche trabajando en conjunto de la agencia de comunicaciones y stakeholders relevantes. Training & Development:
• Analizar, identificar, y coordinar soluciones de training enfocadas en las necesidades del business on-demand.
• Preparar, co-facilitar workshops, y dar seguimiento a las acciones de las actividades de training & development.
• Actualizar y administrar participación y coordinación de trainings con proveedores, facilitadores, colaboradores y stakeholders relevantes.
• Apoyar, actualizar, y a dar seguimiento a los procesos de talent (succession plans, talent pools) performance, y development via check-ins y reuniones con people managers y colaboradores, utilizando y actualizando la herramienta de Talent en Workday.
• Participar y trabajar en equipo con el equipo de Calidad en las necesidades de training y auditoria. REQUERIMIENTOS: Conocimientos:
• Título Universitario Ingeniería Comercial, Administración de Empresas, Recursos Humanos o carrera afín.
• Experiencia laboral de al menos 2 a 3 años en áreas de Recursos Humanos, Consultoría, o Gestión de Proyectos.
• Nivel de Inglés Avanzado. Conocimientos específicos (deseable):
• Workday
• Metodologías Ágiles
• Gestión de Proyectos
• Técnicas de facilitación
• Habilidades digitales
• Habilidades de presentación
• Metodologías/técnicas de coaching
• Metodologías/técnicas de feedback Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Location: Kentucky, Ohio, Indiana and West Virginia (Ideal candidate to live in Lexington, KY) Travel: 100% in assigned territory. This is an exciting time to join the Roche Support Network. If you are passionate about problem solving then this is the position for you! As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche discovers, develops and provides innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products and services that deliver significant benefits to patients and healthcare professionals - from early detection and prevention of diseases to diagnostics, treatment and treatment monitoring. Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success, and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience. The Opportunity The Roche Support Network group is committed to providing industry-defining support to its customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will have the opportunity to travel and demonstrate your expertise as a technical repair and/or installation specialist for Roche assigned product lines and provide valued service to your laboratory customers in an assigned territory. This position serves as a technical repair or installation specialist for Roche products for assigned product lines and geographies. Product Responsibility: Clinical chemistry, Immunoassay and lab automation.
• Provides routine technical support to customers on operational and maintenance aspects of system equipment.
• Performs on-site service, repair and/or installation of company product(s). This may include any aspect of field support and is not limited to mechanical/system hardware and software, networking/wireless networking.
• Serves as customer contact on routine technical and service-related problems. Receives training and delivers service within the normal scope of the position. Follows documented practices, policies and procedures in providing repair and installation support.
• Diagnoses mechanical, hardware, software and system failure, using established procedures. Determines the most cost-effective repair/resolution to minimize customer downtime.
• Provides analysis, feedback and recommendations on product failure trends and serviceability issues. Documents all activity in a manner compliant with the company's quality procedures. Specialized knowledge generally of a particular area, system or equipment. Requires specific training and certification.
• Applies some advanced skills to the position or specialization. May adapt procedures, processes, tools, equipment and techniques to meet the more complex requirements of the position. Duties are generally routine, but may include non-routine tasks.
• Resolves most questions and problems and refers only the most complex issues to higher levels.
• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions. This is a field based role. Who You Are
• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or work experience are required.
• 5 years of progressive experience in repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking is necessary. Alternatively, a Bachelor's degree in a relevant fiel

• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions. This is a field based role. Who You Are

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'assistenza sanitaria si sta evolvendo e Global Procurement risponde continuando ad impegnarsi per le più alte prestazioni possibili, adottando approcci innovativi e strategici per le partnership tra imprese e fornitori. Global Procurement gestisce proattivamente l'intero ecosistema dei fornitori, fornendo un contributo vitale per migliorare i risultati della salute, riducendo i costi per i pazienti e i sistemi sanitari globali, e assicurando che Roche continui a fare ora ciò che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. Questo programma e soluzioni Lead - il ruolo digitale e tecnologico si trova all'interno del capitolo Strategia e Soluzioni, dove la nostra missione è di orchestrare le priorità strategiche, catalizzare la consegna del valore per l'azienda, e amplificare l'eccellenza del Procurement. Non gestiamo solo i processi; guidiamo un miglioramento continuo per rafforzare l’impatto del Global Procurement sull’intera organizzazione Roche. Come Leader di programmi e soluzioni, guiderai un team agile e performante focalizzato su Digital e Tech . Il vostro mandato è quello di guidare l'accusa di portare soluzioni innovative alla vita e accelerare l'impatto degli appalti. In questo ruolo, si porterà il team a fornire contro un portafoglio ad alto impatto che comprende:
• Mercato e Fornitore-Driven Innovation: Co-creazione di soluzioni prima di mercato per risolvere complesse sfide aziendali. Sarete tenuti a sfidare lo status quo e ridefinire i modi di lavorare, guardando oltre la catena del valore tradizionale per fornire impatto oltre metriche standard di approvvigionamento.
• Programmi e progetti strategici complessi: accelerazione e amplificazione dei risultati per iniziative di approvvigionamento ad alto livello, quali programmi su larga scala (ad esempio trasformazioni dei costi) e progetti critici (ad esempio trattative complesse e sourcing). Queste iniziative sono selezionate per il loro peso strategico, impatto e fattibilità. Condurrai un team che si aspetta di fissare lo standard oro per la qualità e il ritmo, richiedendo una mentalità di "sviluppo continuo" per rimanere al passo con le tendenze del mercato. Questa è l’occasione per dare un impatto misurabile durante la formazione di una cultura di squadra che riflette l’impegno di Roche verso persone e pazienti. Oltre alla consegna del progetto, sarai un costruttore di comunità, che promuove una cultura della curiosità, della sicurezza psicologica e della collaborazione radicale in cui le persone si sentono in grado di sperimentare e crescere. Potrai allenare un team medio-grande, guidando l'allocazione delle risorse al lavoro di impatto più alto e la pianificazione per trasformare gli obiettivi di alto livello in realtà. L'opportunità:
• Portfolio & Program Leadership: Guida il tuo team in un ambiente globale veloce per gestire un portafoglio diversificato di soluzioni e programmi (tra cui le trasformazioni dei costi e i negoziati critici) che offrono un valore enorme per gli stakeholder digitali e tecnologici.
• Cultura & Community Building: coltivare un ambiente inclusivo e ad alta fiducia. Sarete un driver chiave nella costruzione di una comunità in cui i membri del team si sentono al sicuro per condividere i fallimenti come apprendimento, celebrare i successi insieme e collaborare attraverso i confini per scintillare nuove idee.
• Resource Orchestration: bilanciare dinamicamente le risorse per massimizzare l'impatto; si lavorerà attraverso reti e squadre per garantire il giusto talento è nel posto giusto al momento giusto.
• Innovazione Strategica & Problem Solving: Diagnosi delle complesse esigenze di business all'interno dello spazio digitale e tecnologico, selezionando l'approccio giusto (ad esempio Soluzione rispetto al programma) alla ricerca di viali per accelerare la realizzazione del valore

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next. This Programs and Solutions Lead - Digital and Tech role sits within the Strategy and Solutions Chapter, where our mission is to orchestrate strategic priorities, catalyse value delivery for the business, and amplify Procurement Excellence. We don’t just manage processes; we drive continuous improvement to strengthen Global Procurement’s impact on the entire Roche organisation. As a Programs and Solutions Lead , you will guide a high-performing, agile team focused on Digital and Tech . Your mandate is to lead the charge in bringing innovative solutions to life and accelerating procurement impact. In this role, you will lead the team to deliver against a high-impact portfolio encompassing:
• Market and Supplier-Driven Innovation: Co-creation of market-first solutions to solve complex business challenges. You will be expected to challenge the status quo and redefine ways of working, looking beyond the traditional value chain to deliver impact beyond standard procurement metrics.
• Complex Strategic Programs and projects: Acceleration and amplification of outcomes for high-stakes procurement initiatives, such as large-scale programs (e.g. cost transformations ) and critical projects (e.g. complex negotiations and sourcing ). These initiatives are selected for their strategic weight, impact, and feasibility. You will lead a team expected to set the gold standard for quality and pace, requiring a "continuous development" mindset to stay ahead of market trends. This is a chance to deliver measurable impact while shaping a team culture that reflects Roche’s commitment to people and patients. Beyond project delivery, you will be a community-builder, fostering a culture of curiosity, psychological safety, and radical collaboration where people feel empowered to experiment and grow. You will coach a medium-to-large team, guiding resource allocation to the highest impact work and planning to turn high-level objectives into reality. The Opportunity:
• Portfolio & Program Leadership: Lead your team in a fast-paced global environment to manage a diverse portfolio of solutions and programs (including cost transformations and critical negotiations) that deliver massive value for Digital and Tech stakeholders.
• Culture & Community Building: Cultivate a high-trust, inclusive environment. You will be a key driver in building a community where team members feel safe to share failures as learnings, celebrate successes together, and collaborate across boundaries to spark new ideas.
• Resource Orchestration: Dynamically balance resources to maximize impact; you will work across networks and squads to ensure the right talent is in the right place at the right time.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Healthcare entwickelt sich und Global Procurement reagiert kontinuierlich auf die bestmögliche Leistungsfähigkeit und setzt innovative und strategische Ansätze für Geschäfts- und Lieferantenpartnerschaften ein. Global Procurement verwaltet proaktiv das gesamte Lieferanten-Ökosystem und leistet einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Verbesserung der gesundheitlichen Ergebnisse, zur Senkung der Kosten für Patienten und globale Gesundheitssysteme und stellt sicher, dass Roche jetzt weiter tut, was Patienten als nächstes brauchen. Diese Programme und Lösungen führen - Digitale und Tech-Rolle sitzt im Kapitel Strategie und Lösungen, wo unsere Mission ist, strategische Prioritäten zu orchestrieren, die Wertschöpfung für das Unternehmen zu katalysieren und die Beschaffungs-Exzellenz zu verstärken. Wir verwalten nicht nur Prozesse, wir treiben eine kontinuierliche Verbesserung ein, um die Auswirkungen der Global Procurement auf die gesamte Roche-Organisation zu stärken. Als Programs and Solutions Lead führen Sie ein leistungsfähiges, agiles Team, das sich auf Digital und Tech konzentriert. Ihr Auftrag ist es, die Verantwortung bei der Bereitstellung innovativer Lösungen für das Leben und die Beschleunigung der Beschaffungsauswirkungen zu übernehmen. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Présentation de l’équipe: Au cœur de l’équipe Medical Evidence & Data science, tu auras pour missions de travailler
• sur la génération d'un protocole de recherche pour la constitution de la plus grande base de données onco-génomique en France (50% du temps),
• sur l’utilisation d’une IA agentic afin de générer/valider des tables statistiques (50% du temps). Quel sera ton impact ? Constitution de la plus grande base de données onco-génomique en France : ● Prendre en charge les réunions et les aspects contractuels entre les différentes parties prenantes internes et externes. ● Évaluer le niveau d'interopérabilité des différentes sources de données ● Programmer sous R les alignements syntaxiques et sémantiques des données permettant de mettre en œuvre cette interopérabilité. ● Générer et soumettre un protocole de recherche, à partir d’un synopsis déjà rédigé ● Étudier la faisabilité de certains objectifs exploratoire, tels que: ● Participer au projet FALCON (réseau mondial de bases onco-génomiques utilisant une approche fédérée) ● link avec la base de données nationale du SNDS ● collecter des données supplémentaires en cas de besoin (imagerie, données non structurées) pour répondre à d'autres objectifs de recherche ultérieurs. ● Pour répondre à ces objectifs, la première étape sera de se former à la pathologie et aux outils/templates déjà disponibles en interne pour la génération d’un protocole et d’effectuer une revue de littérature ciblée. Ton travail sera crucial pour aider l’équipe dans la mise en place de cette étude. L’utilisation d’une IA agentic : ● Mise en place de l’infrastructure permettant d’utiliser l’IA . ● Évaluation des étapes (et prompts associés) pour la génération/validation des tables ● Identification des avantages/incovénients, risques/biais de l’utilisation de l’IA aux différentes étapes identifiées. Ton ADN ● Tu es autonome dans la gestion de ton planning avec des réunions hebdomadaires programmées entre toi et ton tuteur. ● Tu es curieux(se), rigoureux(se) et pragmatique. ● Tu aimes programmer, notamment avec le logiciel R. ● Une appétence marquée pour l'IA et la capacité à en faire un usage efficace et stratégique sont essentielles. ● Tu as un bon niveau d’anglais car tu auras beaucoup de contacts avec des anglophones; ● Tu es motivé(e) et proactif(ve) et tu souhaites t’immerger dans le monde de l’entreprise ! Stage conventionné de 6 mois à pourvoir à partir de septembre 2026 Basé à Paris, Boulogne-Billancourt (92) Pourquoi nous rejoindre? ● Cette stage va te permettre d'apprendre et maîtriser des découvrir tous les aspects du Medical Evidence & Data science dans le milieu de la santé. ● Notre entreprise dispose d'un environnement collaboratif et stimulant, où tu pourras travailler aux côtés de professionnels expérimentés et passionnés, ce qui facilitera ton apprentissage et ton développement professionnel. ● Tu auras la possibilité de contribuer à des activités qui ont un impact direct sur la compréhension et le traitement des maladies, ce qui ajoutera une dimension enrichissante à ton travail ● Nous considérons les stagiaires comme de véritables partenaires qui pourront être amenés à évoluer à nos côtés. Ta contribution, tes propositions seront écoutées et valorisées par les équipes. ● Conformément à la réglementation, tous nos postes sont ouverts au recrutement de travailleurs handicapés. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. The Position Security Analyst - Penetration Testing Exp- 4 to 7 yers Location- Pune Position Overview We are seeking an experienced Security Analyst to join our cybersecurity team. In this role, you will conduct comprehensive penetration testing and vulnerability assessments across our diverse technology landscape, identifying and documenting security risks to strengthen our overall security posture. Primary Responsibilities
• Conduct thorough penetration testing of web applications, mobile applications, and AI/LLM system using industry-standard tools and methodologies
• Perform hands-on security assessments and identify vulnerabilities in web-based systems and APIs
• Execute practical penetration tests against target systems, documenting real-world findings and exploitation methods
• Develop and execute custom exploitation payloads and attack scenarios
• Analyze application logic, authentication mechanisms, and access control implementations
• Collaborate with development and infrastructure teams to define scope, validate findings and track remediation efforts
• Maintain detailed testing documentation, evidence of assessments, and proof of concept demonstrations
• Participate in security reviews and contribute to threat modeling exercises
• Stay current with emerging web application security threats and attack vectors
• Quickly adapt to new tools, technologies, and emerging security challenges in the threat landscape Required Qualifications Certifications (Mandatory - at least one of the following)
• OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional) or
• CPTS (Certified Penetration Testing Specialist) or
• OSCE (Offensive Security Certified Expert) or
• Equivalent recognized penetration testing certification Experience & Technical Skills Primary Expertise (Web Application and LLM - Hands-On Required):
• 3+ years of demonstrated hands-on experience in web application penetration testing
• Proven ability to identify and exploit real-world vulnerabilities in production and pre-production environments
• Practical expertise with OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, including SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF, authentication bypass, and API security flaws
• Proficiency with web security testing tools (Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Postman, etc.)
• Experience bypassing security controls and WAF implementations
• Hands-on experience with API penetration testing (REST, GraphQL, SOAP)
• Practical expertise with LLM security assessments, including prompt injection, model manipulation, and output validation weaknesses.
• Understanding of LLM vulnerabilities including prompt injection, jailbreaking, data leakage, and model poisoning attacks
• Experience evaluating guardrails, content filters, and safety mechanisms in AI systems
• Proficiency with LLM security testing frameworks (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications)
• Familiarity with LLM penetration testing tools (e.g., Claud CLI, PRFU, Garak, promptfoo, etc.) Required Secondary Skills (Hands-On Demonstrated):
• Mobile Penetration Testing: Practical hands-on experience testing iOS and Android applications, including runtime analysis, reverse engineering, and security assessment of mobile APIs
• Cloud Security: Hands-on experience conducting security assessments on public cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including services like EC2, S3, Lambda, IAM, RDS, and cloud misconfiguration identification. Core Competencies:

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Security Analyst - Penetration Testing Exp- 4 to 7 yers Location- Pune Position Overview We are seeking an experienced Security Analyst to join our cybersecurity team. In this role, you will conduct comprehensive penetration testing and vulnerability assessments across our diverse technology landscape, identifying and documenting security risks to strengthen our overall security posture. Primary Responsibilities
• Conduct thorough penetration testing of web applications, mobile applications, and AI/LLM system using industry-standard tools and methodologies
• Perform hands-on security assessments and identify vulnerabilities in web-based systems and APIs
• Execute practical penetration tests against target systems, documenting real-world findings and exploitation methods
• Develop and execute custom exploitation payloads and attack scenarios
• Analyze application logic, authentication mechanisms, and access control implementations
• Collaborate with development and infrastructure teams to define scope, validate findings and track remediation efforts
• Maintain detailed testing documentation, evidence of assessments, and proof of concept demonstrations
• Participate in security reviews and contribute to threat modeling exercises
• Stay current with emerging web application security threats and attack vectors
• Quickly adapt to new tools, technologies, and emerging security challenges in the threat landscape Required Qualifications Certifications (Mandatory - at least one of the following)
• OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional) or
• CPTS (Certified Penetration Testing Specialist) or
• OSCE (Offensive Security Certified Expert) or
• Equivalent recognized penetration testing certification Experience & Technical Skills Primary Expertise (Web Application and LLM - Hands-On Required):
• 3+ years of demonstrated hands-on experience in web application penetration testing
• Proven ability to identify and exploit real-world vulnerabilities in production and pre-production environments
• Practical expertise with OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, including SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF, authentication bypass, and API security flaws
• Proficiency with web security testing tools (Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Postman, etc.)
• Experience bypassing security controls and WAF implementations
• Hands-on experience with API penetration testing (REST, GraphQL, SOAP)
• Practical expertise with LLM security assessments, including prompt injection, model manipulation, and output validation weaknesses.
• Understanding of LLM vulnerabilities including prompt injection, jailbreaking, data leakage, and model poisoning attacks
• Experience evaluating guardrails, content filters, and safety mechanisms in AI systems
• Proficiency with LLM security testing frameworks (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications)
• Familiarity with LLM penetration testing tools (e.g., Claud CLI, PRFU, Garak, promptfoo, etc.) Required Secondary Skills (Hands-On Demonstrated):
• Mobile Penetration Testing: Practical hands-on experience testing iOS and Android applications, including runtime analysis, reverse engineering, and security assessment of mobile APIs
• Cloud Security: Hands-on experience conducting security assessments on public cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including services like EC2, S3, Lambda, IAM, RDS, and cloud misconfiguration identification. Core Competencies:
• Strong understanding of networking, encryption, authentication, and authorization mechanisms

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Diagnostics Operation Penzberg ist das Herzstück der weltweiten Produktion diagnostischer Einsatzstoffe innerhalb des Roche-Konzerns. Als Weltmarktführer im Bereich der In-Vitro-Diagnostik verbinden wir höchste GMP-Qualitätsstandards mit technologischem Fortschritt. Hier arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle zwischen klassischer Qualitätskontrolle und der digitalen Transformation der Gesundheitsbranche. Als Praktikant:in (m/w/d) geben wir dir nicht nur Einblick in das „Daily Business“ der Qualitätskontrolle, sondern lassen dich aktiv an der Schnittstelle zwischen klassischer Laborarbeit und moderner IT-Infrastruktur mitwirken. Du lernst hautnah, was es bedeutet, in einem hochregulierten GMP-Umfeld beim weltweit größten Hersteller von In-Vitro-Diagnostik-Produkten zu arbeiten. Deine Aufgaben In diesem Praktikum bist du der Treiber unserer nächsten digitalen Evolutionsstufe. Wir arbeiten bereits digital – mit der Implementierung und Optimierung eines Labor-Informations-Management-Systems (LIMS) heben wir unsere Prozesse nun auf das nächste Level an Vernetzung und Effizienz. Als Content Creator überarbeitest du die bisherigen Dokumente und hilfst uns beim Erstellen neuer Stammdaten.
• Methoden-Check & Optimierung: Du hinterfragst Methodentexte kritisch, prüfst sie auf Aktualität und Logik und hilfst dabei, diese für die digitale Nutzung aufzubereiten
• Recherche & Dokumentation: Du führst eigenständige Recherchearbeiten durch und unterstützt bei der Erstellung technischer Dokumente
• Projektarbeit: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für kleinere, eigenständige Projekte im Bereich der QC Dein Profil
• Hintergrund: Du studierst Naturwissenschaften (Chemie, Biologie, Pharmazie), Bioinformatik, Medizintechnik oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang
• Mindset: Du bist motiviert, neugierig und hast eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe. Du liebst es, Dingen auf den Grund zu gehen und Texte kritisch zu hinterfragen
• IT-Affinität: Du bist sicher im Umgang mit MS Office und hast ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an digitalen Systemen (LIMS)
• Sprache: Du beherrschst die deutsche Sprache fließend in Wort und Schrift
• Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest gewissenhaft, strukturiert und hast Freude an der Dokumentation Deine Vorteile
• Flexible Zeiteinteilung für eine gute Work-Life-Balance
• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum
• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden (online/offline)
• Ermäßigte Preise (-50 %) in unserer Kantine
• Fitnessstudio auf dem Roche Campus
• Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und spannende Gastvorträge
• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boardinghaus
• Gut organisierte Verkehrsanbindung nach München mit unserem Roche-Shuttle
• Standort-Power: Lerne Diagnostics Operation Penzberg als weltweit größten Roche-internen Hersteller von diagnostischen Einsatzstoffen kennen
• Networking: Erhalte spannende Einblicke in globale Prozesse und knüpfe Kontakte in einem führenden Healthcare-Unternehmen Deine Bewerbung Wir machen es dir einfach: Bitte lade nur deinen Lebenslauf online hoch. Ein Anschreiben ist nicht erforderlich. Denke daran, dass sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation während des gesamten Zeitraums des Praktikums richtet oder alternativ an Personen in einem maximal einjährigen Gap-Year (zwischen Bachelor- und Masterstudium), bei dem schriftlich nachgewiesen werden kann, auf welcher Universität/Hochschule und genau wann (Monat/Jahr) innerhalb eines Jahres die Studien fortgesetzt werden. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Pharmaceuticals

Main Responsibilities

• Acting as an Enterprise Partner along the entire patient disease journey to drive better outcomes for patients faster, functioning as a catalyst in the newly customer-oriented implementation model.

• Guiding the business squads/teams as a strategic partner to drive patient and customer centric ambitions, driving outcome-based planning with end-to-end perspective , including fit-for-purpose planning, next level of business analytics and insightful decision-making with focus on short, mid and long-term.

• Drive P&L management to ensure rigorous execution and fast responses to the business needs and adjusted priorities.

• Effective resource allocation on sustainable investment , facilitating constructive discussions about difficult trade-off decisions with business partners within and across business areas and recognizing potential for new growth opportunities.

• Performing core financial management tasks , including Event Driven Planning and financial modeling seeking for continuous learning and improvement.

• Continuously examining and interpreting data , such as financial statements, price developments, market dynamics, productivity measures, investment opportunities to inform decision making.

• To strive for consistency and efficiency across business areas, by continuously finding opportunities to harmonize, pool and simplify finance processes while sustaining or improving the stakeholder experience .

• Seeking and building opportunities to partner and collaborate with local and global networks of experts .

• Squad/Team squad members peer coaching on financial and specific expertise , fostering collaboration and a constructive environment.

• Ability to articulate themes related to Procurement, Supply Chain, Accounting as well as RSS (Shared Service Center) , connecting the dots and harmonizing processes.

• Serving as guardians to enable new business opportunities, to safeguard our assets , and to provide transparency and uphold compliance.

• Owning their development to ensure they are continually growing skills , capabilities, mindset and behaviors in line with their passion and the needs of the ecosystem to perform at their best and deliver state of the art finance services.

• Collaborating with other key players in Roche, including Roche Global RSS (Shared Services) , ERP Analytics and Centers of Expertise (e.g., eCoE, and Global Networks), to ensure requirements for new solutions and enhancements are managed and delivered effectively.

Expected Skills and Capabilities

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Project Manager – Deliver Impact, Drive Innovation

At Roche, we’re not just delivering solutions—we’re transforming lives. We’re seeking a Project Manager with the drive and vision to lead medium to high-complexity projects across Roche solutions and third-party collaborations. From pre-sales to full implementation, you’ll be at the heart of delivering meaningful innovation to our customers.

Location: UK (Field-based)

The Mission: To orchestrate the delivery of world-class diagnostic solutions that empower laboratories and improve patient lives across the UK.

Are you a strategic leader with a background in structured project delivery? Do you thrive on transforming complex technical requirements into seamless, operational healthcare solutions?

The Opportunity

As a Project Manager for Roche Solutions, you will be the bridge between commercial strategy and technical reality. You will drive medium to high-complexity projects, ensuring an enhanced customer experience from initial discovery through to the final transition to "live" status.

Key Responsibilities:

• Project Governance: Deliver projects in full alignment with the Roche Design and Implementation Framework (RDIF). You will utilize PRINCE2 principles to manage costs, aggressive timelines, and multidisciplinary resources.

• Commercial Strategy & Partnering: Collaborate with Commercial Teams and Consultants during the "Discover & Develop" phase. You ensure that proposed solutions are not only innovative but technically viable and accurately costed.

• Technical Implementation: Lead the coordination of technical milestones. From overseeing floor plan sign-offs to producing detailed Gantt charts and managing project phasing, you ensure precision at every step.

• Site Leadership: Act as the face of Roche on-site. You will lead customer meetings across UK to mobilize resources for our most complex system tracks, such as the CCM (cobas Connection Modules) and cobas 8100.

• Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary escalation point for implementations. You will maintain robust communication plans to keep both internal leadership and external customers informed and aligned.

• Risk & Quality Assurance: Proactively identify risks and dependencies. You will lead "lessons learned" reviews to ensure that every project at Roche is better than the last.

Who You Are

You are a disciplined professional who understands that in the world of diagnostics, precision in planning is as important as precision in testing.

Your Experience & Qualifications:

• Education: Educated to degree standard (or equivalent experience) with PRINCE2 Practitioner status strongly preferred.

• Methodology: A proven expert in Waterfall project management, capable of managing the rigid dependencies of laboratory installations.

• Industry Background: A track record of managing medium to high-complexity projects, ideally within a laboratory, clinical, or diagnostic environment.

• Technical Savvy: Comfortable leading spatial planning workshops, interpreting floor plans, and contributing to technical tender responses.

• Must have proven project management experience with a focus on product delivery.

• Regional Expertise: Ability to navigate the specific multi-stakeholder landscape of the English healthcare system.

• Mobility: As this is a field-based role, you must have the ability to travel across UK for site visits and customer engagement as required.

The successful candidate must possess a valid UK driving

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Siamo affari medici. Stiamo trasformando insieme la pratica medica. Siamo responsabili per la prospettiva medica esterna a Roche e per garantire che la scienza dietro i nostri prodotti sia comunicata e compresa tra gli HCP rilevanti a livello globale, per i quali siamo un partner affidabile. Collaboriamo in un ambiente di lavoro integrato con le affiliate, lo sviluppo globale e la strategia globale. Aiutiamo a guidare lo sviluppo, l'introduzione, l'assunzione e l'uso informato dei nostri farmaci e servizi innovativi nella pratica clinica e nella cura dei pazienti in tutto il mondo. Creiamo ed evolviamo competenze, capacità e opportunità per la nostra rete medica globale. Pensiamo in anticipo e facciamo leva digitale ogni volta che possibile. L'opportunità
• Fornire competenze mediche per il cancro al seno e contribuire a componenti di strategia medica come la generazione di prove, la diffusione e le intuizioni mediche come parte di una strategia integrata.
• Contribuisci a o guidare la pianificazione e l'esecuzione di strategie di generazione di prove rilevanti nell'area del cancro al seno, in base a lacune di accesso medico e di mercato, tra cui studi clinici, studi iniziati da Investigator (IIS), dati del mondo reale e collaborazioni di ricerca scientifica costruendo reti mirate con stakeholder sanitari in più culture e paesi.
• Generi informazioni mediche integrate per informare strategie e piani e fornisci competenze mediche e funzionali alle strategie di accesso al mercato e ai relativi piani operativi.
• Condurre la collaborazione con specialisti accademici e clinici chiave in tutto il mondo per garantire un input scientifico e strategico ai nostri programmi di sviluppo clinico e per risparmiare con loro sull'interpretazione dei nostri risultati di prova clinica in modo che questi possano potenzialmente creare valore per HCP e beneficio pazienti. Chi sei Hai un grado di MD che è un grado di vita altamente preferito o avanzato (ad esempio PhD o PharmD). Un grado di specializzazione o esperienza nel settore del cancro al seno è un must. Inoltre, si dispone di robusti affari medici e / o medicina farmaceutica esperienza. Più lontano, si porta:
• High Ethical Standards: Lei dimostra l'integrità e la conformità in tutte le attività professionali.
• Agility strategica: Hai la capacità di prendere decisioni consapevoli e strategiche in modo efficace.
• Approccio paziente-critico: priorità ai pazienti nelle attività di sviluppo clinico e di pratica medica.
• Esperienza di lancio: la tua esperienza con il lancio di prodotti medici o indicazioni guiderà l'introduzione di prodotti di successo. La vostra esperienza nel cancro al seno può guidare il cambiamento. Fai il passo successivo e aiutaci a fornire farmaci innovativi ai pazienti in tutto il mondo. Applichi subito. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We are Medical Affairs. We are transforming Medical practice together. We are accountable for the medical outside-in perspective at Roche and for ensuring that the science behind our products is communicated and understood amongst relevant HCPs at global scale, for whom we are a trusted partner. We collaborate across and strive in an integrated work environment with the affiliates, global development and global strategy. We help in driving the development, introduction, uptake and informed use of our innovative medicines and services in clinical practice and patient care worldwide. We create and evolve competencies, capabilities, and opportunities for our global Medical Network. We think ahead and leverage digital whenever possible. The Opportunity
• You provide medical expertise to Breast Cancer and contribute to medical strategy components such as evidence generation, dissemination and medical insights as part of an integrated strategy.
• You contribute to or lead the planning and execution of evidence generation strategies relevant in the Breast Cancer area, based on medical and market access gaps, including clinical studies, Investigator-Initiated Studies (IIS), real-world data, and scientific research collaborations by building purposeful networks with healthcare stakeholders across multiple cultures and countries.
• You generate integrated medical insights to inform strategies and plans and you provide medical and functional expertise to market access strategies and related operational plans.
• You lead the collaboration with key academic and clinical specialists worldwide to secure scientific and strategic input to our clinical development programs and to spar with them on the interpretation of our clinical trial results so that these can potentially create value for HCPs and benefit patients. Who You Are You hold an MD degree which is a highly preferred or advanced life-science degree (e.g. PhD or PharmD). A specialization degree or industry experience in Breast Cancer is a must. In addition, you have robust medical affairs and/or pharmaceutical medicine experience. Further, you bring:
• High Ethical Standards: You demonstrate integrity and compliance in all professional activities.
• Strategic Agility: You have the ability to make informed, strategic decisions effectively.
• Patient-Centric Approach: You prioritize patients in clinical development and medical practice activities.
• Launch Experience: Your experience with the launch of medical products or indications will drive successful product introduction. Your expertise in Breast Cancer can drive change. Take the next step and help us deliver innovative medicines to patients worldwide. Apply now. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Wir sind Ärztin. Wir verwandeln die medizinische Praxis zusammen. Wir sind verantwortlich für die medizinische Außenanschauung bei Roche und dafür, dass die Wissenschaft hinter unseren Produkten weltweit unter relevanten HCPs kommuniziert und verstanden wird, für die wir ein vertrauenswürdiger Partner sind. Wir arbeiten zusammen und streben in einem integrierten Arbeitsumfeld mit den Affiliate, der globalen Entwicklung und der globalen Strategie an. Wir helfen bei der Entwicklung, Einführung, Aufnahme und informierten Nutzung unserer innovativen Medikamente und Dienstleistungen in der klinischen Praxis und Patientenversorgung weltweit. Wir schaffen und entwickeln Kompetenzen, Fähigkeiten und Chancen für unser globales Medical Network. Wir denken voraus und nutzen digital, wann immer möglich. Die Chance
• Sie bieten medizinisches Know-how für Brustkrebs und tragen als Teil einer integrierten Strategie zu Komponenten der medizinischen Strategie wie Beweiserzeugung, Verbreitung und medizinische Erkenntnisse bei.
• Sie leisten einen Beitrag zur Planung und Durchführung von im Bereich Brustkrebs relevanten Strategien der Beweiserzeugung, die auf medizinischen und Marktzugangslücken basieren, einschließlich klinischer Studien, Untersuchungs-Initiierten Studien (IIS), Daten der realen Welt und wissenschaftliche Forschungskooperationen, indem Sie gezielte Netzwerke mit Interessengruppen im Gesundheitswesen in verschiedenen Kulturen und Ländern aufbauen.
• Sie generieren integrierte medizinische Erkenntnisse, um Strategien und Pläne zu informieren und bieten medizinische und funktionale Expertise für Marktzugangsstrategien und damit verbundene Betriebspläne.
• Sie führen die Zusammenarbeit mit wichtigen akademischen und klinischen Spezialisten weltweit, um wissenschaftliche und strategische Inputs für unsere klinischen Entwicklungsprogramme zu sichern und mit ihnen über die Interpretation unserer klinischen Studienergebnisse zu spären, so dass diese potenziell einen Mehrwert für HCPs schaffen und Patienten profitieren können. Wer bist du? Sie halten einen MD-Abschluss, der ein sehr bevorzugtes oder fortgeschrittenes Life-Science-Abschluss ist (z.B. PhD oder PharmD). Ein Spezialisierungsgrad oder Branchenerfahrung in Brustkrebs ist ein Muss. Darüber hinaus verfügen Sie über eine robuste medizinische und/oder pharmazeutische Medizin. Weiter bringt ihr:
• Hohe Ethische Standards: Sie zeigen Integrität und Compliance in allen professionellen Aktivitäten.
• Strategische Agilität: Sie haben die Fähigkeit, fundierte, strategische Entscheidungen effektiv zu treffen.
• Patient-Centric Approach: Sie priorisieren Patienten in der klinischen Entwicklung und in der medizinischen Praxis.
• Launch Experience: Ihre Erfahrung mit der Einführung von Medizinprodukten oder Indikationen wird die erfolgreiche Produkteinführung vorantreiben. Ihr Know-how im Brustkrebs kann sich ändern. Nehmen Sie den nächsten Schritt und helfen Sie uns, innovative Medikamente an Patienten weltweit zu liefern. Bewerben Sie sich. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostics-Produkten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die einen globalen Einfluss haben. Wir bauen gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft. Roche ist Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous sommes des affaires médicales. Nous transformons la pratique médicale ensemble. Nous sommes responsables de la perspective médicale externe à Roche et de veiller à ce que la science derrière nos produits soit communiquée et comprise parmi les HCP pertinents à l'échelle mondiale, pour lesquels nous sommes un partenaire de confiance. Nous collaborons dans un environnement de travail intégré avec les affiliés, le développement mondial et la stratégie mondiale. Nous contribuons au développement, à l'introduction, à l'adoption et à l'utilisation éclairée de nos médicaments et services innovants dans la pratique clinique et les soins aux patients dans le monde entier. Nous créons et développons des compétences, des capacités et des opportunités pour notre réseau médical mondial. Nous pensons à l'avenir et puisons dans le numérique chaque fois que possible. L'opportunité
• Vous fournissez une expertise médicale au cancer du sein et contribuez à des composantes de la stratégie médicale telles que la production de preuves, la diffusion et les connaissances médicales dans le cadre d'une stratégie intégrée.
• Vous contribuez ou dirigez la planification et l'exécution de stratégies de production de données pertinentes dans le domaine du cancer du sein, basées sur des lacunes médicales et d'accès au marché, y compris des études cliniques, des études entreprises par des chercheurs (SII), des données réelles et des collaborations de recherche scientifique en créant des réseaux ciblés avec les intervenants des soins de santé dans plusieurs cultures et pays.
• Vous produisez des informations médicales intégrées pour éclairer les stratégies et les plans et vous fournissez une expertise médicale et fonctionnelle aux stratégies d'accès au marché et aux plans opérationnels connexes.
• Vous dirigez la collaboration avec des spécialistes universitaires et cliniques clés du monde entier afin d'obtenir une contribution scientifique et stratégique à nos programmes de développement clinique et de les analyser avec eux sur l'interprétation de nos résultats d'essais cliniques afin que ceux-ci puissent potentiellement créer de la valeur pour les HCP et bénéficier aux patients. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme MD qui est un diplôme hautement préféré ou avancé en sciences de la vie (p. ex. doctorat ou pharmD). Un diplôme de spécialisation ou une expérience de l'industrie dans le cancer du sein est un must. De plus, vous avez une solide expérience médicale et/ou pharmaceutique. En outre, vous apportez:
• Hautes normes éthiques: Vous démontrez l'intégrité et la conformité dans toutes les activités professionnelles.
• Agilité stratégique : Vous avez la capacité de prendre des décisions stratégiques éclairées et efficaces.
• Approche patient-chercheur : Vous priorisez les patients dans les activités de développement clinique et de pratique médicale.
• Expérience de lancement: Votre expérience avec le lancement de produits médicaux ou d'indications conduira à une introduction réussie du produit. Votre expertise en cancer du sein peut conduire au changement. Prenez la prochaine étape et aidez-nous à fournir des médicaments innovants aux patients du monde entier. Demande maintenant. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

titleByLocale.it: Digital Solutions Analytics Lead - Libero professionista

descriptionByLocale.it:
Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality. The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here . Here's what we're looking for: As a Digital Solutions Analytics Lead , you will act as a data analytics leader for product uptake and product usage, driving insights generation that fundamentally shape the development, product improvement and market adoption of our digital health, IVD, and medical device products. This is a high-impact, independent role requiring deep expertise and the ability to influence critical product and business decisions. Your work will involve strategically shaping analyses involving diverse data types (including usage data, market uptake data, app store data, and digital health data) in close alignment with product and business teams . Your upcoming mission:
• Managing the Analytics around user engagement and product uptake
• Analytics for step-by-step in app customer journeys
• Support of communication and reporting: Reporting Template, Presentations, Data Automation, Dashboard generation
• Ad-hoc analytics for app features improvement
• Documentation and tools management
• Regular report updates and business review support
• Consulting the product teams on analytics and insights generation Essential skills:
• 2-3 years of experience in business analytics
• Familiar with SQL and reporting tools Tableau or PowerBI, SQL.
• English fluent in reading, speaking and writing
• Education: Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering or Business Administration (BS, preferentially an advanced degree) Bonus skills:
• Experience with product usage analytics (e.g., Countly, Amplitude, OpenTelemetry). What to expect:
• Ambitious and passionate people building meaningful products for a global audience
• An innovative agile working environment allowing for collaboration with really smart people and knowledge sharing in cross-functional teams
• Loads of benefits (brand new Apple hardware, fitness, public transport, lunch benefit, language classes, professional training budget, chance to join global conferences...)
• Flexible working hours and home office policy, 5 weeks vacation
• An amazing office with a rooftop terrace, fully stocked kitchen and amazing barista coffee machines in the middle of Vienna… oh, and did we mention the best team in the world! Who we are and what we care about? We are committed to providing a healthy, equal and inclusive working environment for our employees to bring true relief to the patient! We care about family friendly career paths, sustainability, a healthy lifestyle and the flexibility of a modern workplace. We maintain a culture of learning and sharing, as well as open and candid feedback. At every level, there are many opportunities to develop and grow - both professionally and personally. As a healthcare pioneer committed to transforming the lives of billions of people around the globe, we push boundaries to redefine what is possible. We know that early, accurate diagnosis is essential to maintain health, prevent disease and help advance new, targeted treatments and potential cures for the world’s most serious health problems. We have a passion for innovation and a profound commitment to make a lasting impact on society by continuing to improve the standard of care for humankind. Our culture inspires us to create healthcare that is sustainable, efficient and financially viable. Healthcare that is built on people’s needs, strong data and clinical insights. Healthcare that save

titleByLocale.fr: Ingénieur principal, Développement de l'algorithme d'imagerie - DGR Biométrie et données cliniques

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'Ingegnere di Piombo Senior porterà il ciclo di vita dell'algoritmo end-to-end - dallo sviluppo attraverso la validazione e l'implementazione di norma-ready - garantendo l'allineamento con GxP, SaMD e Imaging Governance framework. Essendo l'unico punto di responsabilità tra gRED, pRED, PD, RDT e RIS, il ruolo fornirà funzionalità scalabili di piattaforma analitica, promuovere l'automazione e garantire la qualità, la documentazione e gli standard di conformità sono costantemente applicati. Questa posizione guida la visione, la strategia e l'esecuzione dell'ecosistema dell'algoritmo di imaging, consentendo uno sviluppo e una distribuzione più rapidi, riproducibili e conformi tra ricerca e ambiti clinici. Sarete responsabili della definizione dei compiti per gli altri e della guida di iniziative su larga scala su un prodotto. In questo ruolo strategico, istruirai e guiderai altri ingegneri, eccellerai nei negoziati con le parti interessate, e fornirai una direzione per obiettivi a medio e lungo termine. Contribuirai attivamente alla conoscenza tecnica, ispirerai l'innovazione e guiderai la progettazione di soluzioni multi-servizio e multi-modali complesse. Grazie all'esperienza nell'architettura e nell'interoperabilità dei modelli AI/ML, ai framework applicativi avanzati di analisi e alle caratteristiche cloud, promuoverai la consistenza architettonica, guiderai la strategia tecnica per i principali componenti e gli ingegneri senior del mentore per garantire i più elevati standard di qualità ingegneristica in tutta l'organizzazione. Questo ruolo di Senior Lead Engineer richiede l'impegno quotidiano con partner scientifici, normativi, clinici e informatici per allineare la strategia, la priorità e l'esecuzione per rafforzare la collaborazione e la visibilità tra i team globali, fornendo un ponte diretto tra Imaging Governance, Algorithm Development e Platform Operations. L'opportunità:
• Definire ed eseguire la strategia del prodotto e la roadmap per multi-modali (tra cui Radiologia e Patologia Digitale) Imaging Data & Insights all'interno della piattaforma di imaging globale (GIP).
• Priorizzare e fornire iniziative che migliorano la qualità dei dati, l'accessibilità e la riutilizzabilità per R&D, la ricerca traduttiva e lo sviluppo clinico.
• Agire come proprietario principale del prodotto per le applicazioni di analisi delle modalità di imaging, coordinando attraverso gRED, pRED, PD, RDT e RIS.
• Il partner scientifico, clinico e tecnico porta a tradurre i requisiti aziendali in soluzioni tecniche scalabili e conformi.
• Gestire le relazioni degli stakeholder e le collaborazioni esterne per garantire l'interoperabilità, la conformità e l'allineamento strategico.
• supervisionare il ciclo di vita end-to-end di applicazioni di analisi dei dati di imaging multi-modale, visualizzazione e analisi.
• Assicurare la consegna tempestiva dei miglioramenti del prodotto, flussi di lavoro standardizzati e l'integrazione di strumenti abilitati AI/ML.
• Collabora con team di ingegneria, qualità e regolamentazione per garantire l'adesione a standard GxP, FAIR e data-governance.
• Allineamento dell'unità attraverso le funzioni R&D, Diagnostics e Data Science per abilitare i dati condivisi e le pipeline di analisi e processi unificati.
• Gestire dipendenze, rischi e pietre miliari per tutti i materiali di patologia digitale e comunicare i progressi attraverso KPI e report sulle prestazioni.
• Identificare e implementare opportunità per aumentare la scalabilità, l'automazione e l'efficienza attraverso i flussi di lavoro di analisi.
• Monitorare l'industria e le tendenze tecnologiche nella patologia digitale, AI/ML e la salute digitale per guidare l'innovazione dei prodotti in corso.
• Identificare e introdurre il formato comune per la distribuzione, ridurre i costi di conversione e migliorare la velocità di inferenza attraverso l'arros
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Senior Lead Engineer will lead the end-to-end algorithm lifecycle—from development through validation and regulatory-ready deployment—ensuring alignment with GxP, SaMD, and Imaging Governance frameworks. Acting as the single point of accountability across gRED, pRED, PD, RDT, and RIS, the role will deliver scalable analytical platform capabilities, promote automation, and ensure quality, documentation, and compliance standards are consistently applied. This position drives the vision, strategy, and execution of the imaging algorithm ecosystem, enabling faster, reproducible, and compliant development and deployment across research and clinical domains. You will be responsible for defining tasks for others and driving medium to large-scale initiatives across a product. In this strategic role, you will coach and lead other engineers, excel in stakeholder negotiations, and provide direction for mid to long-term goals. You will actively contribute to technical knowledge, inspire innovation, and lead the design of complex multi-service and multi-modal solutions. With expertise in AI/ML models architecture and interoperability, advanced analysis application frameworks and cloud features, you will promote architectural consistency, drive technical strategy for major components, and mentor senior engineers to ensure the highest standards of engineering quality across the organization. This Senior Lead Engineer role requires daily engagement with scientific, regulatory, clinical, and informatics partners to align on strategy, prioritization, and execution to strengthen collaboration and visibility across global teams, providing a direct bridge between Imaging Governance, Algorithm Development, and Platform Operations. The Opportunity:
• Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for multi-modal (including Radiology and Digital Pathology) Imaging Data & Insights within the Global Imaging Platform (GIP).
• Prioritize and deliver initiatives that enhance data quality, accessibility, and reusability for R&D, translational research, and clinical development.
• Act as the primary product owner for the imaging modalities analysis applications, coordinating across gRED, pRED, PD, RDT, and RIS.
• Partner with scientific, clinical, and technical leads to translate business requirements into scalable and compliant technical solutions.
• Manage stakeholder relationships and external collaborations to ensure interoperability, compliance, and strategic alignment.
• Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of multi-modal imaging data analysis applications, visualization, and analytics.
• Ensure timely delivery of product enhancements, standardized workflows, and integration of AI/ML-enabled tools.
• Collaborate with engineering, quality, and regulatory teams to ensure adherence to GxP, FAIR, and data-governance standards.
• Drive alignment across R&D, Diagnostics, and Data Science functions to enable shared data and analysis pipelines and unified processes.
• Manage dependencies, risks, and milestones for all digital pathology deliverables and communicate progress through KPIs and performance reports.
