descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Szukamy zorganizowanej i skrupulatnej osoby, która wesprze nasz zespół w zarządzaniu obiegiem używanego sprzętu medycznego. Będziesz kluczowym ogniwem w procesie procesowania zwrotów – od momentu odebrania paczki, przez jej cyfrową ewidencję, aż po koordynację wysyłki do naszej centrali w Niemczech. Twoja Rola:
• Obsługa przesyłek przychodzących: Odbieranie oraz fizyczne segregowanie paczek reklamacyjnych trafiających do magazynu.
• Ewidencja cyfrowa: Wprowadzanie danych o przesyłkach do systemów operacyjnych ( SAP / Rexis ).
• Wstępna diagnostyka: Klasyfikacja urządzeń pod kątem zgłoszonych usterek i uszkodzeń aparatury medycznej.
• Logistyka międzynarodowa: Identyfikacja i przygotowanie wysyłki paczek o statusie „krytycznym” do centrali w Mannheim w celu dalszej ewidencji.
• Współpraca z zespołem: Bieżąca komunikacja z działem serwisu i logistyki. O Tobie:
• Wykształcenie: Minimum średnie (zapraszamy również studentów w trakcie nauki).
• Dyspozycyjność: Możliwość pracy 2 dni w tygodniu (grafik do ustalenia).
• Zdolności analityczne: Umiejętność trafnej klasyfikacji usterki na podstawie dokumentacji i stanu faktycznego.
• Komunikatywność: Jasne przekazywanie informacji i umiejętność pracy w zespole.
• Doskonała organizacja: Umiejętność priorytetyzacji zadań i dbałość o porządek w dokumentacji systemowej.​ Oferujemy:
• Elastyczność: Idealna praca dla osób łączących naukę z życiem zawodowym.
• Cenne doświadczenie: Możliwość pracy w profesjonalnym środowisku opartym na systemie SAP .
• Wpływ na jakość: Realny udział w procesie zapewniania bezpieczeństwa aparatury medycznej.
• Międzynarodowe standardy: Współpraca z centralą w Niemczech i kontakt z nowoczesnymi technologiami medycznymi. Dodatkowe informacje:
• Miejsce pracy: Magazyn Sprzętu Medycznego (Teresin)
• Typ umowy: Umowa zlecenie (16 godzin tygodniowo) Administratorem danych osobowych jest spółka Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. z siedzibą w Warszawie przy ul. Domaniewskiej 28 (02-672). Dane przetwarzane są w celu prowadzenia rekrutacji. Osobom, które zaaplikują przysługuje prawo dostępu do danych, ich sprostowania, usunięcia, ograniczenia przetwarzania, przenoszenia oraz – w sytuacji, gdy są one przetwarzane na podstawie udzielonej zgody – cofnięcia tejże zgody w dowolnym momencie. Kontakt do Inspektora Ochrony Danych: dia.daneosobowe@roche.com. Więcej informacji o zasadach przetwarzania przez Roche danych osobowych pod linkiem: https://www.roche.pl/klauzula-informacyjna-rekrutacja-dia-pl . Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. działa w pełnej zgodności z przepisami prawa i nie toleruje żadnych naruszeń. W Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. obowiązuje Procedura zgłaszania naruszeń prawa. W przypadku chęci zgłoszenia nieprawidłowości związanych z naszą działalnością, wszelkie niezbędne informacje dotyczące zgłaszania naruszeń znajdują się na naszej stronie internetowej: https://www.roche.pl/kontakt/ochrona-sygnalistow-zglaszanie-naruszen . ​ Compensation & Benefits Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Warsaw. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process. Information about the compensation package for this position will be provided ahead of any interview Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity: As an Accounts Payable Accountant you are responsible for high quality services to Roche suppliers and internal partners. You will be responsible for booking complex invoices in accordance with Roche and local standards so that the supplier receives the funds in time for the goods supplied and the services rendered. You will have the possibility to have full responsibility for the end-to-end AP process and handling both internal and supplier queries received by phone or mail in local language.
• Process and validate PO based and direct invoices and payment requests, manage and run payments
• Manage vendor accounts
• Audit, report and support AP invoice resolution
• Handle affiliate’s internal invoice queries
• Act as a point of contact, promoting strong collaborative relationships between the affiliate’s finance teams and all other internal SSC teams
• Participate in process improvement and ongoing projects, opportunity to take part in knowledge transfer Who you are:
• University degree in Finance or relevant professional experience
• General understanding of finance processes and standards. Broad experience in accounts payable processes (or related field) and using SAP is an advantage
• Strong communication and advisory skills and you are able to deal with complex issues
• Customer centricity through your day-to-day interactions
• End-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations
• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment
• Proficiency in English and Arabic In exchange we provide you with:
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.
• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.
• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.
• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion. Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position La atención sanitaria está evolucionando y Roche Diagnostics responde esforzándose continuamente por alcanzar el mayor rendimiento posible, adoptando enfoques innovadores y estratégicos para las asociaciones comerciales y clínicas. Nuestros equipos de ventas gestionan proactivamente el ecosistema sanitario, contribuyendo de forma vital a mejorar los resultados de salud y garantizando que Roche siga haciendo ahora lo que los pacientes necesitarán después. The Responsabilities: Este puesto se integra dentro de la organización Comercial, centrándose en áreas de alta complejidad que están transformando la medicina moderna. Como Sales Specialist - Specialty , serás un motor clave para el desarrollo de negocio en áreas críticas como Microbiología, Anatomía Patológica, Genética y Secuenciación. Trabajando en el área de Madrid, aportarás una visión de 360° para gestionar relaciones estratégicas en los centros sanitarios. Serás responsable de identificar oportunidades de alto valor y asegurar la rentabilidad y el crecimiento de tu zona asignada. Actuarás como un socio estratégico, utilizando un enfoque de venta consultiva para acortar la distancia entre las necesidades diagnósticas complejas y nuestras soluciones innovadoras. Como Sales Specialist - Specialty , desempeñarás diversas funciones según tu experiencia, conocimientos y requisitos generales del negocio, incluyendo pero no limitado a:
• Actuarás como experto en tu territorio, identificando y desarrollando nuevas oportunidades de mercado en los segmentos de especialidad (Microbiología, Patología, Genética) en alineación con la estrategia comercial de Roche Diagnostics.
• Serás el responsable de la relación con el cliente, fortaleciendo vínculos con los diferentes interlocutores estratégicos para comprender sus desafíos y transmitir propuestas de valor estructuradas que respondan a sus necesidades específicas.
• Liderarás la ejecución de los planes de acción locales, colaborando estrechamente con los equipos de Marketing y Servicio para garantizar la satisfacción del cliente y la sostenibilidad del negocio a largo plazo.
• Adoptarás e impulsarás metodologías comerciales rigurosas y un pensamiento analítico para gestionar tanto los aspectos técnicos como comerciales de tu cartera. Who You Are:
• Posees una titulación universitaria con un sólido trasfondo científico , lo que te permite mantener discusiones técnicas de alto nivel.
• Cuentas con experiencia contrastada en ventas en el sector sanitario , preferiblemente con un conocimiento profundo en Microbiología, Anatomía Patológica, Genética o Secuenciación.
• Tienes un conocimiento sólido en las áreas de Enfermedades Infecciosas y Oncología ; se valorará muy positivamente la experiencia adicional en Genética.
• Eres un experto en venta consultiva , con una mentalidad orientada a resultados y una trayectoria de consecución de objetivos comerciales mediante el uso de metodologías estructuradas.
• Demuestras una visión de negocio de 360° , con capacidad para equilibrar los logros a corto plazo con el crecimiento estratégico a largo plazo.
• Muestras una actitud proactiva hacia la gestión del cambio , con alta capacidad de adaptación, autonomía y toma de decisiones responsable en entornos dinámicos.
• Eres un gran comunicador, capaz de actuar como un asesor de confianza ante decisores clínicos y administrativos.
• Se valorará significativamente el conocimiento en contratación pública y poseer una red de contactos establecida con los principales decisor

Serás responsable de identificar oportunidades de alto valor y asegurar la rentabilidad y el crecimiento de tu zona asignada. Actuarás como un socio estratégico, utilizando un enfoque de venta consultiva para acortar la distancia entre las necesidades diagnósticas complejas y nuestras soluciones innovadoras. Como Sales Specialist - Specialty , desempeñarás diversas funciones según tu experiencia, conocimientos y requisitos generales del negocio, incluyendo pero no limitado a:
• Actuarás como experto en tu territorio, identificando y desarrollando nuevas oportunidades de mercado en los segmentos de especialidad (Microbiología, Patología, Genética) en alineación con la estrategia comercial de Roche Diagnostics.
• Serás el responsable de la relación con el cliente, fortaleciendo vínculos con los diferentes interlocutores estratégicos para comprender sus desafíos y transmitir propuestas de valor estructuradas que respondan a sus necesidades específicas.
• Liderarás la ejecución de los planes de acción locales, colaborando estrechamente con los equipos de Marketing y Servicio para garantizar la satisfacción del cliente y la sostenibilidad del negocio a largo plazo.
• Adoptarás e impulsarás metodologías comerciales rigurosas y un pensamiento analítico para gestionar tanto los aspectos técnicos como comerciales de tu cartera. Who You Are:
• Posees una titulación universitaria con un sólido trasfondo científico , lo que te permite mantener discusiones técnicas de alto nivel.
• Cuentas con experiencia contrastada en ventas en el sector sanitario , preferiblemente con un conocimiento profundo en Microbiología, Anatomía Patológica, Genética o Secuenciación.
• Tienes un conocimiento sólido en las áreas de Enfermedades Infecciosas y Oncología ; se valorará muy positivamente la experiencia adicional en Genética.
• Eres un experto en venta consultiva , con una mentalidad orientada a resultados y una trayectoria de consecución de objetivos comerciales mediante el uso de metodologías estructuradas.
• Demuestras una visión de negocio de 360° , con capacidad para equilibrar los logros a corto plazo con el crecimiento estratégico a largo plazo.
• Muestras una actitud proactiva hacia la gestión del cambio , con alta capacidad de adaptación, autonomía y toma de decisiones responsable en entornos dinámicos.

• Se valorará significativamente el conocimiento en contratación pública y poseer una red de contactos establecida con los principales decisor

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il leader della gente guida un team di Cina partner tecnici (CTPs) e professionisti CMC che sono responsabili per le presentazioni CMC di regolamentazione della Cina, attraverso lo sviluppo e l'implementazione di robuste strategie di archiviazione end-to-end Cina basate sulla stretta collaborazione con i team di sviluppo globale, le priorità aziendali della Cina, i requisiti normativi della Cina e il paesaggio. La portata include il portafoglio completo di Roche, i prodotti globali (piccole molecole, biologiche, nuove modalità). L'obiettivo di questo ruolo è quello di guidare e allenare i membri del team al fine di accelerare l'accesso alla droga e la fornitura continua ai pazienti assicurando le giuste presentazioni di prima volta alle autorità sanitarie cinesi e le interazioni efficaci con l'Autorità sanitaria. L'incombente del ruolo è responsabile di modellare l'ambiente normativo in Cina in stretta collaborazione con PTR Policy e tradurlo in strategie normative innovative. In linea con la strategia cinese di Roche e la prima iniziativa della Cina, questo è un ruolo con un alto impatto commerciale. In questa posizione, il leader delle persone è responsabile per la gestione dei partner tecnici cinesi (CTPs) e dei gestori dei programmi CMC, che include l'impostazione degli obiettivi di performance, il feedback tempestivo e l'allineamento degli obiettivi di sviluppo a breve termine con obiettivi di carriera a lungo termine. Fornisce indicazioni e gestisce attività di lavoro di altri per progetti e/o obiettivi specifici. Dimostra i fondamenti delle competenze di coaching efficaci e di mentoring. Adapts stile di coaching per soddisfare le esigenze dell'individuo. Il leader delle persone guida iniziative e strategie di regolamentazione interfunzionali, definisce i passi critici associati e le risorse necessarie e si assume la responsabilità per l'attuazione di queste iniziative e strategie. Proattivamente comunica con personale normativo e interfunzionale a supporto degli obiettivi di progetto interni e associati ai partner. Collabora con la gestione nelle principali comunicazioni con HA su progetti e iniziative di grande complessità. Prende decisioni basate su priorità interfunzionali piuttosto che su priorità di area funzionale. Leader del progetto
• Fornire leadership a un team di professionisti di regolamentazione.
• Responsabile per la gestione delle prestazioni dei dipendenti.
• Lavorare con rapporti diretti e garantire che il feedback oggettivo e tempestivo sia fornito ai dipendenti, concentrarsi sullo sviluppo del dipendente facilitando le discussioni e i check-in di sviluppo regolari.
• Fornire coaching e mentoring ai colleghi per un'area assegnata di responsabilità tecnica di regolamentazione.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con il Leader Portfolio per coordinare risorse e priorità a livello Portfolio.
• Seguire regolarmente e controllare i progressi di ogni progetto specifico nel team, illuminare il team per elaborare strategie di presentazione per diverse applicazioni e identificare i rischi normativi e sviluppare piani di migrazione.
• Costruire e mantenere un rapporto sano con gli stakeholder chiave interni ed esterni, come NMPA, CDE, NIFDC, Supply Chain, Qualità e conformità, PDR Cina e PTR globale,
• Collaborare con le parti interessate chiave interne per lo sviluppo e l'allineamento della strategia tecnica, massimizzare e bilanciare le esigenze normative e di fornitura in Cina. QUALIFICA Istruzione Laurea magistrale in scienze della vita è preferito; Laurea post è un plus. Esperienza
• 8 o più anni di esperienza lavorativa nel settore farmaceutico, biotecnologico o relativo settore e CMC, qualità, normazione o relativa esperienza.
• Gestione delle persone precedenti
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The people leader leads a team of China Technical Partners (CTPs) and CMC professionals that are accountable for China regulatory CMC submissions, through developing and implementing robust end-to-end China filing strategies based on close collaboration with global development teams, China business priorities, China regulatory requirements and landscape. The scope includes the complete Roche portfolio, the global products (small molecules, biologics, new modalities). The focus of this role is to lead and coach the team members in order to accelerate drug access and continuous supply to the patients by ensuring right first-time submissions to Chinese Health Authorities and effective interactions with the Health Authority. The incumbent of the role is responsible to shape the regulatory environment in China in close collaboration with PTR Policy and translate that into innovative regulatory strategies. In line with Roche’s China strategy and the China First initiative, this is a role with a high business impact. In this position, the people leader is responsible for the management of China Technical Partners (CTPs) and CMC program managers, which includes setting performance objectives, providing timely feedback, and ensuring alignment of short-term development goals with longer-term career goals. Provides guidance and manages work activities of others for specific projects and/or objectives. Demonstrates the fundamentals of effective coaching skills and mentoring. Adapts coaching style to meet the needs of the individual. The people leader leads cross-functional regulatory initiatives and strategies, defines associated critical steps and resources needed and takes responsibility for implementation of these initiatives and strategies. Proactively communicates with regulatory and cross-functional personnel in support of internal and partner-associated project goals. Collaborates with management in leading communications with HA on projects and initiatives of major complexity. Makes decisions based on cross-functional priorities rather than functional area priorities. Project People Leader
• Provide leadership to a team of regulatory professionals.
• Responsible for performance management of employees.
• Work with direct reports and ensure that objective and timely feedback is provided to employees, focus on the development of the employee by facilitating regular development discussions and check-ins.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le chef du personnel dirige une équipe de partenaires techniques chinois (PTC) et de professionnels du CMC qui sont responsables des présentations de CMC réglementaires en Chine, en élaborant et en mettant en oeuvre des stratégies de classement de bout en bout de la Chine fondées sur une collaboration étroite avec les équipes de développement mondial, les priorités commerciales de la Chine, les exigences réglementaires de la Chine et le paysage. La portée comprend le portefeuille complet de Roche, les produits mondiaux (petites molécules, produits biologiques, nouvelles modalités). Ce rôle a pour but de diriger et d'entraîner les membres de l'équipe afin d'accélérer l'accès aux médicaments et l'approvisionnement continu des patients en veillant à ce que les premières présentations appropriées aux autorités sanitaires chinoises et les interactions efficaces avec l'autorité sanitaire. Le titulaire du rôle est responsable de façonner l'environnement réglementaire en Chine en étroite collaboration avec la Politique sur les PTR et de la traduire en stratégies réglementaires novatrices. Conformément à la stratégie de la Chine et à l'initiative China First, il s'agit d'un rôle qui a un impact commercial élevé. Dans ce poste, le chef de file est responsable de la gestion des partenaires techniques de la Chine (PTC) et des gestionnaires de programme du MCC, ce qui comprend l'établissement d'objectifs de rendement, la fourniture de rétroaction en temps opportun et l'harmonisation des objectifs de perfectionnement à court terme avec les objectifs de carrière à plus long terme. Fournit des conseils et gère les activités de travail d'autres personnes pour des projets ou des objectifs précis. Démontre les principes fondamentaux de l'efficacité de l'encadrement et du mentorat. Adapte le style de coaching pour répondre aux besoins de l'individu. Le chef des personnes dirige des initiatives et des stratégies de réglementation interfonctionnelles, définit les étapes et les ressources essentielles qui s'y rattachent et assume la responsabilité de la mise en oeuvre de ces initiatives et stratégies. Communiquer de façon proactive avec le personnel de réglementation et le personnel interfonctionnel à l'appui des objectifs des projets internes et associés aux partenaires. Collabore avec la direction pour diriger les communications avec l'AP sur les projets et les initiatives de grande complexité. Prendre des décisions fondées sur des priorités interfonctionnelles plutôt que sur des priorités fonctionnelles. Chef de projet Personnes
• Diriger une équipe de professionnels de la réglementation.
• Responsable de la gestion de la performance des salariés.
• Collaborer avec des rapports directs et veiller à ce que des commentaires objectifs et opportuns soient fournis aux employés, en mettant l'accent sur le perfectionnement de l'employé en facilitant des discussions régulières sur le perfectionnement et des vérifications.
• Fournir un encadrement et un encadrement aux collègues dans un domaine de responsabilité réglementaire technique assigné.
• Collaborer étroitement avec le chef de portefeuille pour coordonner les ressources et les priorités au niveau du portefeuille.
• Suivre et vérifier régulièrement l'avancement de chaque projet spécifique de l'équipe, éclairer l'équipe pour élaborer des stratégies de soumission pour différentes applications, identifier les risques réglementaires et élaborer des plans de migration.
• Établir et maintenir des relations saines avec les principaux acteurs internes et externes, tels que NMPA, CDE, NIFDC, chaîne d'approvisionnement, qualité et conformité, PDR Chine et PTR mondial,
• Collaborer avec les principales parties prenantes internes à l'élaboration et à l'alignement de la stratégie technique, en maximisant et en équilibrage des besoins en matière de réglementation et d'approvisionnement en Chine. QUALIFICATIONS Éducation Masters Le diplôme en sciences de la vie est préféré; le diplôme d'études supérieures est un plus. Expérience
• 8 ans ou plus d'expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique, la biotechnologie ou l'industrie connexe et le CMC, la qualité, la réglementation ou l'expérience connexe.
• Gestion des personnes précédente

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Country Study Start-up Team Leader (cSTL) Roche Nederland B.V., Woerden The Opportunity At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. In our Global Clinical Operations (PDG) team, we are looking for a Country Study Start-up Team Leader (cSTL) to take on a dual-impact role that is vital to our mission. You will be the driving force behind clinical trial submissions while simultaneously serving as a People Leader (for +- 30% of your time), guiding a dedicated team to success in our country delivery operations. In this pivotal role, you will balance strategic oversight of study start-up with hands-on leadership in regulatory submissions and people management. Your work ensures that we deliver innovative medicines to patients faster and more efficiently by streamlining the bridge between clinical design and site activation. In this role, you will:
• Lead the country strategy for study start-up, driving efficiency and innovation to ensure timely site activation.
• Drive clinical trial submissions and regulatory coordination, managing complex submission packages and responding to Health Authority queries.
• Serve as a People Leader for approximately 30% of your time, providing coaching, support, and professional development to your direct reports.
• Architect and oversee the management of Informed Consent Forms (ICF) and clinical site documentation to ensure global compliance.
• Champion process innovation by identifying opportunities for automation to improve trial initiation timelines.
• Collaborate with global stakeholders, including CROs and Health Authorities, to harmonise systems and influence the local start-up environment.
• Manage clinical site budgets and contracts, ensuring financial and legal alignment through expert negotiation. Who you are You are a proactive, visionary leader who combines deep technical expertise in clinical submissions with a genuine passion for developing others. You thrive in complex, matrixed environments and possess the analytical prowess to turn data into strategic improvements. To be successful in this role, you bring:
• Extensive industry expertise: Proven experience in clinical trial start-up and regulatory submissions, with deep knowledge of ICH-GCP and EU CTR.
• Transformation leadership: A track record in coaching, mentoring, and leading high-performing teams to deliver significant business impact.
• Advanced scientific background: A University degree (MD, PhD, MS, or BS) in life sciences; a postgraduate degree is highly desirable.
• Technical proficiency: Experience navigating complex clinical systems such as Veeva Vault, CTIS, and RIM.
• Exceptional communication: The ability to influence and partner with stakeholders, from local operational teams to global executive leadership.
• Language skills: Mandatory fluency in English and fluency in Dutch is strongly preferred Why Roche? For over 125 years, Roche has been working towards a healthier future with one clear goal: "Doing now what patients need next". We believe that the greatest medical challenges can only be solved through intensive collaboration with healthcare professionals and patients. Our impact goes beyond healthcare; we also take full responsibility for our planet. For instance, since 2025, all our locations have run on 100% sustainable electricity—a major milestone in our ambition to be fully climate neutral (net zero) by 2045. At Roche, you are not just working on the healthcare of tomorrow,

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We believe that meaningful impact starts with how we connect—with patients, healthcare professionals, and each other. If you are passionate about building strong customer relationships and driving business growth in the healthcare space, this opportunity could be for you. The Opportunity As an Account Executive, you will be responsible for managing sales performance, developing strategic customer relationships, and promoting Roche Diagnostics’ product portfolio within your assigned territory. You will play a key role in driving sustainable business growth while ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction and alignment with Roche’s global standards. In this role, you will:
• Achieve or exceed assigned sales targets through effective territory and account planning
• Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers to establish long-term partnerships
• Identify and develop new business opportunities across Roche Diagnostics products and services
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams and external partners to execute commercial activities effectively
• Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and provide insights to support business strategy. Deliver timely and accurate reporting
• Ensure proper management of operational processes including contract documentation and supply coordination
• Contribute to a collaborative team environment with a strong focus on customer satisfaction Who you are You are driven, resilient, and able to navigate a dynamic, customer-facing environment. You take ownership of your territory, are proactive in identifying opportunities, and are committed to delivering results. You bring:
• Bachelor’s degree in any field; Life Sciences background is an advantage, with a minimum of 3 years of sales experience in Diagnostics, Medical Devices, or Pharmaceutical industry
• Understanding of the healthcare ecosystem, including hospital or institutional structures
• Ability to work independently and deliver results with minimal supervision
• Strong communication skills, with the ability to manage stakeholders effectively
• Proficiency in English (written and spoken) and basic digital literacy
• Demonstrated learning agility and willingness to adapt to new products and business areas Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT) team operates in an agile framework to continuously improve the manufacturing of highly integrated sensors and cartridges (S&C). Our work spans from supporting early concept ideas to enabling efficient design transfer into routine manufacturing and ensuring sustainable product care throughout the product lifecycle. Organized into Sub-Networks and Squads supported by Chapters, our agile structure enables rapid adaptation to changing priorities and business needs. We foster collaboration, continuous learning, and mutual mentorship while driving partnerships across and beyond Operations. By combining expertise, data-driven insights, digital solutions, and new technologies, we solve complex challenges and deliver high-quality S&C products that meet customer needs throughout their lifecycle — always guided by our core values: Courage, Transparency, Open-Mindedness, and a Can Do Attitude. The Opportunity:
• Taking responsibility for regular product care activities within the Squad. Like handling of non-conformity notifications, leading investigations and root cause analysis, coordinating corrective actions in the manufacturing process, implementing changes to the process.
• Working according to internal processes defined by GxP-regulated environment
• Monitoring production data and analyzing key production performance indicators
• Driving Continuous Improvement initiations within the sensor production process
• Supporting production operators as an SME on the ramp up of newly established production line
• Plan and execute experiments (DoEs) in laboratory and production environment for investigation and product improvements
• Coordination and collaboration with internal and external partners Who you are:
• University Degree in (Electro-, Analytical- or Technical) Chemistry, (Chemical-, Process- or Manufacturing) Engineering or related field
• First experience in a highly regulated production environment and GxP standards (pharma / medical preferred)
• Strong team player with self-reflection, solution-oriented mindset, and collaboration skills
• Strategic thinking with interest in agile framework (Scrum/Kanban) and project management
• Ability to apply a programming language (e.g., python or R-Studio) or AI Agents in a practical setting
• Fluent in English, German at least B2 level
• Nice to have: statistical analysis, database handling (SQL, Snowflake) or experience with software projects Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Consegniamo le conoscenze sui profili di sicurezza dei nostri farmaci, definiamo come gestire i rischi ai pazienti e coordinamo le attività del sistema di farmacovigilanza per l'azienda fornendo un viaggio sicuro per ogni singolo paziente, ovunque. L'opportunità:
• Contribuire a modellare il futuro della sanità fornendo un supporto essenziale per la sicurezza clinica e la farmacovigilanza in tutto il portafoglio Roche, influenzando sia le attività di sviluppo precoce che quelle in fase avanzata.
• Servire come membro chiave del team di sicurezza, offrendo un controllo di sicurezza cruciale e l'ingresso in tutti gli aspetti della gestione dello studio dallo sviluppo attraverso il post-mercato.

• Rilevamento e gestione del segnale di guida, contribuire alla revisione strategica delle valutazioni di sicurezza e dei rapporti di sicurezza della droga.
• Influenza la strategia di sicurezza del prodotto e fornire un input di sicurezza vitale nella strategia di sviluppo clinico sovraccarica.
• Contribuire in modo significativo alla gestione del rischio preparando e mantenendo CCDS, etichettando documenti (compreso l'IB), comunicazioni di rischio, RMP e REMS.
• Agire in modo indipendente con una minima supervisione, dimostrare una forte auto-leadership, e identificare e perseguire attivamente aree per lo sviluppo personale e professionale. Chi sei:

• Dimostrare una forte comprensione di GxP, processi regolamentati e il ciclo di vita di prova clinico end-to-end.
• Esibire eccellenti capacità di comunicazione, sia scritte che verbali, in grado di collaborare efficacemente con i partner remoti in un team globale.
• Adept per l'applicazione di complesse analisi dei dati e metodi statistici per valutare, interpretare e presentare dati scientifici con chiarezza.
• Possedere competenze di presentazione forti, efficaci per sintetizzare e presentare considerazioni chiave e punti di decisione a diversi pubblico.
• Prove capacità di agire in modo indipendente e con una minima supervisione, gestione delle responsabilità di sicurezza nei team di studio e supporto alle attività di sicurezza clinica. The Position We deliver knowledge on the safety profiles of our medicines, define how to manage risks to patients and coordinate the pharmacovigilance system activities for the company providing a safe journey for each individual patient, everywhere. The Opportunity:
• Contribute to shaping the future of healthcare by providing essential clinical safety and pharmacovigilance support across the entire Roche portfolio, influencing both early and late-phase development activities.
• Serve as a key member of the safety team, offering crucial safety oversight and input into all aspects of study management from development through post-market.
• Lead critical post-market safety activities, including signal evaluation, benefit-risk assessment, and comprehensive safety risk management.
• Take ownership of individual and aggregate case reporting, encompassing ICSR case management and critical aggregate reporting activities like DSUR and PBRER.
• Drive signal detection and management, contribute to the strategic review of safety assessments and drug safety reports.
• Influence product safety strategy and provide vital safety input into the overarching Clinical Development strategy.
• Contribute significantly to risk management by preparing and maintaining CCDS, labeling documents (including the IB), risk communications, RMP, and REMS.
• Act independently with minimal supervision, demonstrating strong self-leadership, and proactively identifying and pursuing areas for personal and professional development. Who you are:
• Preferred Qualifications: A relevant post graduate qualification PHD/MSc in a Life sciences discipline; Medical qualification; PharmD or other post-graduate health professional qualifications) would be advantageous
• Demonstrate a strong understanding of GxP, regulated processes, and the end-to-end clinical trial lifecycle.
• Exhibit excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, capable of effectively collaborating with remote partners on a global team.
• Adept at applying complex data analysis and statistical methods to evaluate, interpret, and present scientific data with clarity.
• Possess strong presentation skills, effective at summarizing and presenting key considerations and decision points to diverse audiences.
• Proven ability to act independently and with minimal supervision, managing safety responsibilities on study teams and supporting clinical safety activities. Please note the role level will be determined based on experience and demonstrated expertise. This is the role requiring onsite present at our Basel, Switzerland officeas the primary location. descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Wir liefern Wissen über die Sicherheitsprofile unserer Medikamente, definieren, wie wir Risiken für Patienten verwalten und die Aktivitäten des Pharmakovigilanzsystems für das Unternehmen koordinieren, das überall eine sichere Reise für jeden einzelnen Patienten bereitstellt. Die Gelegenheit:
• Um die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens zu gestalten, indem sie im gesamten Roche-Portfolio wesentliche klinische Sicherheits- und Pharmakovigilanz-Unterstützung bietet, die sowohl die frühe als auch die Spätphasenentwicklung beeinflusst.
• Als wichtiges Mitglied des Sicherheitsteams dienen und entscheidende Sicherheitsübersichten bieten und in alle Aspekte des Studienmanagements von der Entwicklung über den Postmarkt einfließen lassen.
• Führen Sie kritische Sicherheitstätigkeiten nach dem Markt, einschließlich Signalauswertung, Nutzen-Risikobewertung und umfassendes Sicherheitsrisikomanagement.
• Besitzen Sie das Eigentum an der individuellen und aggregierten Fallmeldung, einschließlich der ICSR-Fallverwaltung und kritischen Gesamtberichterstattungsaktivitäten wie DSUR und PBRER.
• Signalerkennung und -management antreiben, zur strategischen Überprüfung von Sicherheitsbewertungen und Drogensicherheitsberichten beitragen.
• Einfluss der Produktsicherheitsstrategie und wichtige Sicherheitseingänge in die übergeordnete klinische Entwicklungsstrategie.
• Mit der Vorbereitung und Aufrechterhaltung von CCDS, der Kennzeichnung von Dokumenten (einschließlich der IB), der Risikokommunikation, der RMP und der REMS erheblich auf das Risikomanagement beitragen.
• Handeln Sie unabhängig mit minimaler Aufsicht, zeigen Sie starke Selbstführerschaft, und proaktiv identifizieren und verfolgen Bereiche für persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung. Wer du bist:
• Bevorzugte Qualifikationen: Eine relevante Postgraduiertenqualifikation PHD/MSc in einer Life Sciences-Disziplin; Medizinische Qualifikation; PharmD oder andere postgraduale Gesundheitsfachqualifikationen) wäre vorteilhaft
• Demonstrieren Sie ein starkes Verständnis von GxP, regulierten Prozessen und dem end-to-end klinischen Testlebenszyklus.
• Exhibit ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, sowohl schriftlich als auch verbale, in der Lage, effektiv mit Remote-Partnern an einem globalen Team zusammenzuarbeiten.
• Die Anwendung komplexer Datenanalysen und statistischer Methoden, um wissenschaftliche Daten mit Klarheit auszuwerten, zu interpretieren und darzustellen.
• Ermöglicht starke Präsentationsfähigkeiten, effektiv bei der Zusammenfassung und Präsentation von Schlüsselüberlegungen und Entscheidungspunkten für verschiedene Publikum.

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous fournissons des connaissances sur les profils de sécurité de nos médicaments, définissons comment gérer les risques pour les patients et coordonnons les activités du système de pharmacovigilance pour l'entreprise offrant un voyage sûr pour chaque patient, partout. La possibilité :
• Contribuer à façonner l'avenir des soins de santé en fournissant un soutien essentiel en matière de sécurité clinique et de pharmacovigilance dans l'ensemble du portefeuille Roche, ce qui influe sur les activités de développement en phase précoce et en phase tardive.
• Servir de membre clé de l'équipe de sécurité, offrant une surveillance de sécurité cruciale et une contribution à tous les aspects de la gestion des études, du développement à la post-commercialisation.
• Diriger les activités critiques de sécurité après la mise en marché, y compris l'évaluation des signaux, l'évaluation des avantages et des risques et la gestion globale des risques en matière de sécurité.
• S'approprier les rapports de cas individuels et globaux, y compris la gestion des cas du CISR et les activités critiques de rapports globaux comme le DSUR et le PBRER.

• Influencer la stratégie de sécurité des produits et apporter une contribution essentielle à la stratégie globale de développement clinique.
• Contribuer de façon significative à la gestion des risques en préparant et en tenant à jour les documents d'étiquetage (y compris l'IB), de communication des risques, de PGR et de SGRR.

• Démontrer une bonne compréhension du GxP, des processus réglementés et du cycle de vie des essais cliniques de bout en bout.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Policy and Value Partner (PVP) , you will be a key driver in delivering life-changing healthcare to patients by strategically influencing stakeholder perceptions and decision-making. You will engage with both internal and external stakeholders to shape the broader policy ecosystem and demonstrate the immense value of our innovative medicines. By providing sound strategic advice and developing evidence-based materials, you will help Roche Australia navigate the socio-political environment to achieve its long-term goals. What you will be working on includes: In this dynamic role, you will be responsible for a variety of strategic and advocacy activities, including:
• Policy Strategy: Developing and implementing public policy projects designed to shape the socio-political environment in favor of patient access.
• Evidence Development: Conducting research and analysis to create evidence-based policy materials, strategies, and advocacy plans relating to Roche’s pipeline and reimbursement systems.
• Environmental Scanning: Monitoring government communications and actions to identify potential opportunities and threats within the socio-political landscape.
• Stakeholder Engagement: Designing and executing overarching engagement plans for political and health stakeholders to support corporate and portfolio goals.
• Global Collaboration: Engaging with Roche’s global public policy and market access teams to leverage globally-generated positioning and resources.
• Strategic Advice: Providing and acting upon sound strategic counsel to the Enabling Team and other internal cross-functional groups.
• Reputation Management: Developing a strategic plan to build Roche Australia’s reputation as a creative and forward-thinking policy partner.
• Communication Design: Crafting clear, tailored, and timely communications and narratives for both internal and external audiences.
• Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborating with Therapeutic Area Squads and the Value and Access Chapter to ensure policy positions are shared and aligned across the organization.
• External Advocacy: Leading engagement with key external political stakeholders, including MPs, Senators, and health advocacy organizations. Who you are: You are a strategic communicator with high interpersonal intelligence and a deep understanding of the Australian political landscape. You bring:
• Educational Background: A tertiary qualification in communications, public relations, health policy, or business/commerce.
• Industry Expertise: Proven experience in public policy or government engagement within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, or a relevant government department.
• Political Acumen: A strong awareness of the policy process and the ability to navigate complex political environments with composure and resilience.
• Analytical Thinking: The ability to synthesize complex information into clear policy positions and meaningful environmental insights.
• Relationship Building: A track record of building strong, credible, and supportive relationships with external stakeholders, such as political advisors and industry bodies.
• Collaborative Spirit: A high level of interpersonal intelligence and the ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams and global networks.
• Compliance Focus: Completion of (or the ability to complete) the Medicines Australia Code of Conduct training. This role is only open to candidates that have full eligibility to live and work in Australia. May require

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Global Learning Services teams focus on executing system data maintenance and administrative activities in Cornerstone and all relevant Learning management systems as well as providing all necessary non-systems related Learning process support. Global Learning Services provides customer service and advisory support to the Learning Community and business partners on global Learning systems and processes and ensuring end-to-end process completion in line with customer focused principles to ensure the Roche People Practices work for the business. As a Learning Specialist, you are responsible for executing Learning system data maintenance and administrative activities in a timely and accurate manner in support of Learning business processes. You are also contributing to the continuous improvement of the People Support Solutions delivery through analysis of the interactions and collaboration with other HR functions within and outside of People Support Solutions. You need a broad understanding across global Learning processes and tools, as well as local and global downstream impacts on compliance, audits and right-to-operate, as well as finance, IT, etc. This is coupled with strong customer focus, communication skills and solution orientation. You will be :
• SERVICE DELIVERY: Execute system data maintenance and administrative activities in Cornerstone and all relevant Learning management systems as well as providing all necessary non-systems related Learning process support. Provide customer service on Learning related activities, such as inquiry resolution, request management, and trouble-shooting.
• Supports the Global Learning Center of Excellence and our business customers with system maintenance and project activities. Cooperate effectively with team members with daily work and projects. Advise the Learning community and business partners on global Learning systems and processes, and support the embedding of the new ways of learning.
• Actively participate in the development and implementation of Roche Learning continuous improvement initiatives. Actively participate in workshops, meetings and work-related team events. Provide guidance and advisory to the learning community at all levels. Be up to date on processes, own the knowledge development on processes, and contribute to the update of relevant documentations (SWIs, SOP, GWIs). Update SWIs and local SOP documentation. Participating in project activities as required
• Display high integrity on the job and comply with the Roche guidelines, including data privacy rules and regulations. Ensure consistent and reliable service delivery for customers serviced. Implement processes and initiatives to ensure continuous improvement as well as service enhancement. Align service delivery and quality with overarching objectives of the global People Support Solutions organization. Manage service quality expectations and address customer concerns . Ensure end to end ownership of resolution . Ensure operations according to defined KPIs and SLAs. Ensure regulatory compliance in line with the countries, customers, and regulations. Develop and manage key stakeholder relationships and communications to partner in a proactive and customer outcomes focused way.
• CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION: Build relationships with HR colleagues within the People Support Solutions organization as well as with customers to ensure ongoing service delivery effectiveness. Collaborate with peers within region and globally to ensure t

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a team member of RSS, you execute the day-to-day activities according to the agreed service level requirements, in compliance with the SOPs of the respective business sub-process. It is also key to follow the instructions of the Team Lead regarding the daily work coordination. You are responsible for managing incoming and outgoing phone calls based on the predefined SLAs and processes and incoming Service Now tickets. With your dedicated work, you contribute continuously to the improvement of the performance of Roche. You will be :
• Service Delivery : Your key responsibilities will be providing support on 1st level questions, system related questions, role management, consultancy services on existing procurement functionalities of the system/platform for end users. Providing support primarily by phone and ticketing tool for above mentioned system related queries coming from Indirect Procurement End Users . Creating/maintaining and following up cases/tickets in the adequate quality and in timely manner – within 24 hours if possible- in order to achieve the best response and end-to-end resolution time. Proceed with role ownership tickets in timely manner according to the guidelines
• Responsible for first level issue resolution and being able to make decision on further actions for completing and resolving the upcoming requests and issues. Being a bridge between other resolver groups and the business, by reviewing feedback related incidents and sharing the knowledge and instructions with the Requestor on the adequate level. Work on scheduled and ad-hoc reporting activities, pro-actively practice the available and required tool sets. Work on the regular and ad-hoc monitoring activity and apply fixes as needed. Being responsible and contribute to a proper availability planning within the Team by discussing planned holiday/training schedule in advance
• Cross-Functional Collaboration : Contribute continuously to the implementation of new tasks and responsibilities coming to the RSS
• Outputs & Deliverables : Maintaining SOPs, Annexes and training materials for 1st level support. Prepare and share knowledge base documents in timely manner or for the requested deadline.
• Employees are responsible for performing their duties in line with the SHE (Safety, Security, Health and Environmental Protection) Guidelines and the applicable law. It is required to complete the mandatory training courses and follow procedures and instructions accordingly. Your skills:
• You bring the following skills and competencies: Experience in supplier relationship management. Basic understanding of procurement support. Familiar with ticketing tools
• Good numerical and analytical skills. React to problems in an appropriate manner. Able to work in a fast paced environment. Good at time management. Open to working in afternoon schedule until 6:00 pm. Excellent troubleshooting and problem solving skills. Outstanding customer service and interpersonal skills
• Highly accountable, agile, and results oriented. Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, both verbally and written. Excellent organizational skills and ability to prioritize tasks. Strong communication skills in English and Mandarin are essential. Additional languages will be an advantage.
• We are seeking an individual with 1-3 years of experience in Procurement operational or support. Experience and knowledge of SAP/ SAP SRM. Proficiency in Mandarin and English (read, write, understand) i

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Mission As a GPC Compliance Assurance Specialist, you will be responsible for safeguarding the Global Patient Care (GPC) Organization by ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements, internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and safety protocols. Your mission is to move beyond service quality to a rigorous model of Compliance Monitoring across all customer channels. You will act as a primary point of contact of GPC’s "Inspection Ready" status. By managing audit schedules, maintaining critical documentation, and liaising with Global Post Market Quality and Local Safety Officers, you will ensure that customer interactions and processes meet the highest legal and medical regulatory standards. You will identify systemic risks and implement corrective actions to maintain the integrity of our patient care operations. Key Accountabilities
• Compliance Monitoring: Conduct regular, systematic compliance audits across all supported channels to ensure adherence to safety reporting and regulatory guidelines.
• Documentation Management: Author, update, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and relevant compliance documentation to reflect current global and local requirements.
• Audit Management: Lead the preparation and management of the GPC audit schedule; coordinate all "pre-work" to ensure the organization is prepared for internal and external inspections.
• Stakeholder Liaison: Act as the key point of contact for affiliate Local Safety Officers (LSOs) and Global Post Market Quality teams to align on safety reporting and quality standards.
• Audit Participation: Actively participate in GPC-relevant audits, providing evidence, responding to inquiries, and managing the documentation trail.
• Corrective & Preventive Actions (CAPA): Identify compliance gaps and collaborate with leadership to design and implement corrective measures and process improvements.
• Risk Mitigation: Communicate significant regulatory risks or compliance deviations to local and global management in a timely and transparent manner.
• Regulatory Alignment: Ensure that all GPC activities remain in full alignment with medical device regulations, pharmacovigilance standards, and data privacy laws. Key Skills and Experience
• Language: A fluent command of English is required; additional languages are a distinct advantage.
• Experience: Minimum 4 years of experience in Quality Management, Regulatory Compliance, or Auditing, preferably within a medical device, pharmaceutical, or highly regulated environment.
• Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of Post Market Surveillance, Pharmacovigilance reporting, and relevant ISO standards.
• Attention to Detail: Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to spot minute deviations in documentation or agent workflows.
• Communication: Ability to communicate complex regulatory requirements to non-compliance stakeholders clearly and persuasively.
• Organizing skills: Proven ability to manage audit schedules, meet strict deadlines, and coordinate multi-departmental preparation efforts.
• Systems Literacy: Proficient in IT navigation and Quality Management Systems (QMS); ability to quickly learn new compliance tracking technologies.
• Mindset: Highly ethical, detail-oriented, and resilient. You must be comfortable working with autonomy while maintaining a collaborative approach with global safety teams. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED) , facciamo medicinali trasformativi per i pazienti per affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie non soddisfatte del mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in medicina. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. Il gruppo Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) di pRED consente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci a dosi ottimali nelle popolazioni rilevanti con una visione di potere traduzione, migliorare continuamente l'accuratezza delle nostre previsioni e accelerare lo sviluppo dei farmaci di domani. PS supporta la scoperta e lo sviluppo di tutta la catena del valore dalla valutazione dell'obiettivo al mercato e oltre. L'opportunità Come parte del capitolo Traduzionale DMPK-PD e Farmacologia Clinica, vi concentrerete sulla fornitura del farmaco giusto alla dose giusta per i pazienti in modo sicuro con un vantaggio efficace. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con le aree terapeutiche per convertire le ipotesi in farmaci innovativi, guidando strategie noncliniche per portare avanti i migliori candidati clinici per specifiche indicazioni. I vostri impatti e responsabilità:
• Strategia & Design: strategie di progettazione e ottimizzazione dei farmaci di piombo e profilazione dei composti per tutti gli aspetti del metabolismo e della farmacocinetica (DMPK), con un forte focus sui concetti di convalida della biologia di destinazione e di convalida traduttiva PK/Pharmacodinamica (PD).
• Valutazione traduttiva: fornire supporto ai team di scoperta precoce nello sviluppo di strategie di traduzione per la valutazione clinica della modulazione di destinazione attraverso l'applicazione di considerazioni biochimiche e farmacologiche.
• Modeling & Simulation (M&S): Eseguire attività M&S fondamentali, tra cui PKPD, Pharmacokinetics (PBPK), Drug-Drug Interaction (DDI), e predizione dose/regimen umano, per fornire un supporto essenziale per progetti che spaziano dall'ottimizzazione del piombo (LO) all'ingresso nell'uomo (EIH).
• Supporto normativo: Preparare e fornire valutazioni scientifiche di alta qualità di informazioni DMPK non cliniche per le recensioni dei programmi interni e le sottomissioni normative esterne (ad esempio, Investigational New Drug (IND), Brochure dell'investigatore (IB), Applicazione clinica di prova (CTA), Nuova applicazione della droga (NDA), Applicazione della licenza di Biologics (BLA)).
• Attuazione: implementazione di biomarcatori e strategie bioanalitiche in stretta collaborazione con partner chiave per garantire la sicurezza dei pazienti e il raggiungimento di un significativo beneficio terapeutico.
• Collaborazione: Facilitare processi decisionali trasparenti e basati sui dati all'interno di team e team di progetto, coltivando e mantenendo relazioni professionali affidabili con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni. Si prega di notare che questa posizione è un contratto temporaneo di 2 anni. Chi sei
• Hai un PharmD o un PhD in Scienze Farmaceutiche, Farmacologia o Bioingegneria, abbinato a oltre 5 anni di esperienza nel settore farmaceutico.
• Possiedi profonda esperienza nella scoperta, caratterizzazione precoce PK, distribuzione e PKPD attraverso varie modalità, sostenuta da una solida base in farmacologia e fisiologia.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED) , we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicine. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed. pRED's Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) group enables discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. PS supports discovery and development across the whole value chain from target assessment to on-market and beyond. The Opportunity As part of the Translational DMPK-PD and Clinical Pharmacology chapter, you will focus on providing the right drug at the right dose to patients safely with an efficacious benefit. You will collaborate closely with therapeutic areas to convert hypotheses into innovative medicines, driving nonclinical strategies to bring forward the best clinical candidates for specific indications. Your Impact & Responsibilities:
• Strategy & Design: Lead drug design and optimization strategies and compound profiling for all Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics (DMPK) aspects, with a strong focus on target biology validation and translational PK/Pharmacodynamics (PD) concepts.
• Translational Evaluation: Provide support to early discovery teams in the development of translational strategies for the clinical evaluation of target modulation through the application of biochemical and pharmacological considerations.
• Modeling & Simulation (M&S): Execute fundamental M&S activities, including PKPD, Physiologically-Based Pharmacokinetics (PBPK), Drug-Drug Interaction (DDI), and human dose/regimen prediction, to provide essential support for projects spanning from Lead Optimization (LO) through Entry into Human (EIH).
• Regulatory Support: Prepare and deliver high-quality scientific assessments of non-clinical DMPK information for internal program reviews and external regulatory submissions (e.g., Investigational New Drug (IND), Investigator's Brochure (IB), Clinical Trial Application (CTA), New Drug Application (NDA), Biologics License Application (BLA)).
• Implementation: Implement biomarker and bioanalytical strategies in close collaboration with key partners to ensure both patient safety and the achievement of meaningful therapeutic benefit.
• Collaboration: Facilitate transparent, data-driven decision-making processes within project teams and squads while cultivating and maintaining trustful professional relationships with both internal and external stakeholders. Please note that this position is a 2-year temporary contract. Who you are
• You hold a PharmD or PhD in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmacology, or Bioengineering, paired with over 5 years of industry experience in a pharmacokinetic-related field.
• You possess deep expertise in discovery, early PK characterization, distribution, and PKPD across various modalities, backed by a solid foundation in pharmacology and physiology.
• You demonstrate hands-on experience with modeling and simulation, proficiency in applying Artificial Intelligence (AI) Machine Learning (ML) to DMPK strategy, and a strong drive to master tools like Phoenix, Ber

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans Roches Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (PRED) , nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Chez PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médecine. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement l'innovation qui change la vie. Le groupe des Sciences Pharmaceutiques (PS) de pRED permet de découvrir et de développer des traitements sûrs et efficaces à des doses optimales dans les populations concernées, avec une vision pour la traduction de puissance, d'améliorer continuellement la précision de nos prédictions et d'accélérer le développement des médicaments de demain. SP appuie la découverte et le développement dans l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur, depuis l'évaluation des cibles jusqu'au marché et au-delà. L'opportunité Dans le cadre du chapitre sur la DMPK-PD et la pharmacologie clinique, vous vous concentrerez sur la fourniture du bon médicament à la bonne dose aux patients en toute sécurité avec un bénéfice efficace. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les domaines thérapeutiques pour convertir les hypothèses en médicaments innovants, en conduisant des stratégies non cliniques pour présenter les meilleurs candidats cliniques pour des indications spécifiques. Votre impact et vos responsabilités :
• Stratégie et conception : Les stratégies de conception et d'optimisation des médicaments et le profilage des composés pour tous les aspects du métabolisme et de la pharmacocinétique des médicaments (DMPK), l'accent étant mis sur la validation de la biologie cible et les concepts de PK/Pharmacodynamique translationnelle (PD).
• Évaluation translationnelle: fournir un soutien aux équipes de découverte précoce dans l'élaboration de stratégies translationnelles pour l'évaluation clinique de la modulation cible par l'application de considérations biochimiques et pharmacologiques.
• Modélisation et simulation (M&S): Exécuter des activités fondamentales de M&S, y compris la PKPD, la Pharmacocinétique physiologique (PBPK), l'interaction médicament-drogue (DDI) et la prédiction de la dose humaine/régime, afin de fournir un soutien essentiel aux projets allant de l'optimisation du plomb (OL) à l'entrée dans l'humain (EIH).
• Soutien réglementaire : Préparer et fournir des évaluations scientifiques de haute qualité de l'information DMPK non clinique pour les examens internes des programmes et les présentations de règlements externes (p. ex., les nouveaux médicaments expérimentaux (IND), la brochure de l'enquêteur (IB), la demande d'essai clinique (CTA), la demande de drogue nouvelle (NDA), la demande de licence de produits biologiques (BLA).
• Mise en oeuvre : Mettre en œuvre des stratégies de biomarqueur et de bioanalyse en étroite collaboration avec des partenaires clés afin d'assurer à la fois la sécurité des patients et l'obtention d'avantages thérapeutiques significatifs.
• Collaboration : Faciliter des processus décisionnels transparents et axés sur les données au sein des équipes et des équipes de projet tout en cultivant et en maintenant des relations professionnelles de confiance avec les parties prenantes internes et externes. Veuillez noter que ce poste est un contrat temporaire de 2 ans. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un PharmD ou d'un doctorat en sciences pharmaceutiques, pharmacologie ou bioingénierie, jumelé à plus de 5 ans d'expérience industrielle dans un domaine lié à la pharmacocinétique.
• Vous disposez d'une expertise approfondie en découverte, caractérisation précoce de la PK, distribution et PKPD sur différentes modalités, soutenue par une base solide en pharmacologie et en physiologie.
• Vous démontrez l'expérience pratique de la modélisation et de la simulation, la compétence dans l'application de l'intelligence artificielle (AI) Machine Learning (ML) à la stratégie DMPK, et une forte volonté de maîtriser des outils comme Phoenix, Ber

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Die Customer Area Near Patient Care (NPC) vereint die Portfolios Point of Care und Diabetes Care von Roche. Mit unserer Leidenschaft bringen wir Tests näher an Patienten und befähigen Menschen, ihre eigene Gesundheit besser zu überwachen. Innerhalb von NPC Operations sind wir global für die End-to-End-Produktion von Lösungen für die kontinuierliche Glukose-Überwachung (CGM), die Blutzuckermessung (BGM) und Insulin Delivery (IDS) sowie für Point-of-Care (POC)-Produkte verantwortlich. Unsere wichtigsten internen Produktionsstätten sind Mannheim in Deutschland und Indianapolis in den USA. Das Umfeld Als CxM Finished Goods sind wir mit rund 25 Kolleg:innen in Mannheim und Rotkreuz Teil von Manufacturing Science and Technology im Bereich NPC Operations. Für unser CGM Accu-Check SmartGuide verantworten wir den globalen Auf- und Ausbau sowie das Betreiben der externen Fertigungsstufe. Zusammen mit unseren strategischen Equipment- und Produktionspartnern entwickeln wir robuste Prozesse und Anlagen. Durch eine hohe Standardisierung sichern wir wettbewerbsfähige Herstellungskosten und eine zuverlässige Produktion. Wir stellen damit die Versorgung mit konformen Produkten in Qualität, Zeit und Kosten für die aktuellen und zukünftigen Produktgenerationen sicher und pflegen das Produkt über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus. Die Position Als Head of CxM Finished Goods - Projects leiten Sie ein globales Team von technischen Projektleiter:innen. Ihr Team verantwortet die Industrialisierung von R&D-Konzepten in standardisierte und robust skalierbare Anlagendesigns, die für die globale Massenproduktion geeignet sind und gewährleisten herstellbares Produktdesign (Design for Manufacturability). Dabei agieren Sie an den Schnittstelle zwischen Equipmentherstellern, externen Betreiber (Contract Manufacturer) und internen Fachbereichen (z.B. R&D, Einkauf, Quality, interne Produktion) und verantworten Kapazitätserweiterungsprojekte speziell für Spritzgussteile und die finale Assemblierung unserer CGM-Produkte. Sie sind massgeblich am Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung des Lieferantenökosystems beteiligt, pflegen aktiv ein externes Netzwerk aus Technologiepartnern und sind mit den relevanten industriellen Standards und Trends bestens vertraut. Zudem setzt Ihr Team Product Care Projekte in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Produktteam zur Proudukt-, Prozess und Kostenoptimierungen. Sie definieren effiziente Ablaufprozesse und entwickeln diese kontinuierlich weiter, um zuverlässig und effizient Projektinhalte abzuliefern und die Fähigkeiten der Zulieferindustrie optimal zu nutzen. Deine Aufgabe
• Teamführung und lokale Ansprechperson: Du leitest das Teams „CxM Finished Goods - Projects“ diziplinarisch und fachlich. Durch eine vorausschauende Bedarfsplanung formst du eine leistungsstarke Einheit, identifizierst und förderst Talente gezielt und stellst durch eine kontinuierliche Qualifizierung der Mitarbeitenden sicher, dass die Kompetenzen im Team stetig mit den technologischen Anforderungen wachsen. Als lokale Ansprechperson in Mannheim schaffst du ein vertrauensvolles und motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld und pflegst ein Netzwerk mit den lokalen Schnittstellen.
• Exzellenz in der Projektabwicklung: Du verantwortest die professionelle Steuerung des gesamten Projektportfolios von CxM Finished Goods. Dabei stellst du eine transparente Planung und zuverlässige Einhaltung der Qualität der Inhalte und Timelines sicher. Durch effizientes Risiko- und Ressourcenmanagement stellst du die Kosteneffizienz üb
