descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Job description The IT Infrastructure Engineer is a highly skilled expert responsible for solving complex business problems using advanced technologies within their specialized infrastructure area. In this role, you will technically lead challenging projects, make critical technical decisions, and architect resilient solutions across multiple domains. This position requires excellent problem-solving capabilities, strategic stakeholder management, and the ability to influence technical strategy, vendor relationships, and inter-organizational initiatives. Description of the area Job Responsibilities
• Scope / (Content Leadership): Highly skilled in a specific infrastructure solution area, adept at solving a variety of complex business problems through the practical and ingenious application of technologies. Contributes to and technically leads challenging projects requiring deep technical knowledge. Architect (acting as a solution architect), design, build, test, and implement integrated, resilient, and reliable first-time deployments in multiple solution areas. Accountable for decision-making in technical design, build, and testing.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Exercises sound judgment, balanced with effective consultative engagement of key stakeholders, to resolve complex problems. Works on complex issues where analysis requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors, including inter-organizational impact. Leads the end-to-end design of infrastructure solutions and maintains component standards. Evaluates promising solutions via Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and feasibility studies across multiple areas, and provides internal escalation support for major incidents.
• Stakeholder Management: Communicates and presents complex information and potential solutions to cross-functional teams and the business in non-technical terms. Represents the organization as a prime contact on initiatives and interacts with senior internal and external personnel. Uses depth of knowledge to influence IT Infrastructure vendor product evaluations and collaborates with multiple IT partners (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Solution Owners) to integrate feedback.
• Impact/Strategy: Leads small-to-medium sized technical teams to achieve objectives in medium-sized initiatives (projects, lifecycle work, PoCs). Ensures solutions comply with Quality/Regulatory standards and that designs adhere to the organization’s Technical Architecture Framework (TAF) policies and directions. Assists in planning technology projects, estimating engineering resources, dependencies, risks, and timelines for successful delivery.
• Complexity / (Product Size): Manages complex issues and variable factors spanning across different organizational boundaries. Coordinates multiple moving parts, dependencies, and inter-organizational impacts to deliver reliable infrastructure on medium-to-large initiatives.
• Business / Technical ability: Applies extensive technical expertise, providing depth and breadth across many areas while acting as a recognized expert in one specific area. Maintains in-depth knowledge in at least two technology areas (e.g., Platform, Compute and Storage, Network Management, ERP Technology Management, High Performance Computing, Datacenter Management, or Database Management). Demonstrates a detailed understanding of how IT infrastructure impacts respective Roche business processes. Qualifications Education / Experience
• Demonstrated experience in technically leading challenging proje

The Position Affiliate: Roche Pharma Korea Cluster: Access & Policy Work Location: Hanam City, Gyeonggi-do Worker Type: Regular Your key responsibilities
• Advanced QC Testing: Perform QC testing for biological/chemical drug products utilizing various compendial and in-house validated methods (e.g., ID/Purity by CE, HPLC & UPLC, Content by UV/Vis, Cell-based Assays), ensuring strict adherence to SOPs and test protocols.
• QC Material & Cell Bank Management: Manage and maintain critical QC materials including QC/retention samples, critical reagents, and cell banking.
• Method Transfer (SME): Lead or support internal/external analytical method transfer activities, providing technical expertise on key analytical methods as a Subject Matter Expert.
• Investigation & Quality Management: Handling of deviations, OOS/OOT investigations, change controls, CAPA, and risk assessments, identifying root causes and implementing effective actions.
• Audit & QMR Leadership: Act as an internal or external GxP auditor/co-auditor and represent the QC function as a member of the local QMR (Quality Management Review) Meeting.
• Data Integrity & Review: Conduct technical review of QC raw data and analytical results, adhering strictly to the current GxP good documentation practices and data integrity requirements.
• Equipment Lifecycle Management: Execute and coordinate qualification, calibration, and preventive maintenance of QC equipment ensuring intended use.
• Documentation & Regulatory Collaboration: Draft, review, and revise various QC SOPs, work instructions, protocols, and reports. Collaborate closely with RA for the preparation of specifications and test methods for drug product registration. Who you are
• Basic qualification: Bachelor of Science majoring in biotechnology or related science.
• A minimum of 4 years experience in developing and executing quality control operation, and laboratory experience in pharmaceutical company.
• A strong background and in-depth knowledge in Instrumental analysis (HPLC, UV, CE, Spectrophotometer, Plate Reader, etc.) and cell-based assays.
• Good English written and communication skill. Submission 자유 양식의 국/영문 이력서 및 국/영문 자기소개서 (하나의 MS Word 혹은 PDF 파일로 제출) ※ 이력서 상단에 반드시 현재 연봉과 희망 연봉을 표기하시기 바랍니다. 누락 시 이력서가 검토되지 않습니다. ※ 이력서 내 이메일 주소와 서류전형 지원 사이트의 입력하시는 이메일 주소를 반드시 동일하게 작성해주시기 바랍니다. ※ 국가보훈대상 및 장애인은 관련 서류 제출시 관련 법규에 의거 우대합니다. ※ 이력서에 개인민감정보 (신체적 조건, 출신 지역, 혼인 여부, 가족관계 등)는 기재하지 말아주십시오. ※ 입사 지원 서류에 허위 사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후 라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다. Process 서류 전형▶ 면접 전형 ▶ 종합 심사 ▶ 최종 합격 통지 ※ 면접은 서류전형 합격자에 한해 개별 통보합니다. ※ 면접 일정 안내 및 조율을 위해 해외 번호(중국)로 연락이 갈 수 있는 점 미리 안내드립니다. ※채용이 유력한 후보자에 대해서 이력 검증 및 평판 조회, 건강검진 등의 종합심사를 진행하여 최종 합격자를 선정합니다. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Advanced QC Testing: Perform QC testing for biological/chemical drug products utilizing various compendial and in-house validated methods (e.g., ID/Purity by CE, HPLC & UPLC, Content by UV/Vis, Cell-based Assays), ensuring strict adherence to SOPs and test protocols.
• QC Material & Cell Bank Management: Manage and maintain critical QC materials including QC/retention samples, critical reagents, and cell banking.
• Method Transfer (SME): Lead or support internal/external analytical method transfer activities, providing technical expertise on key analytical methods as a Subject Matter Expert.
• Investigation & Quality Management: Handling of deviations, OOS/OOT investigations, change controls, CAPA, and risk assessments, identifying root causes and implementing effective actions.
• Audit & QMR Leadership: Act as an internal or external GxP auditor/co-auditor and represent the QC function as a member of the local QMR (Quality Management Review) Meeting.
• Data Integrity & Review: Conduct technical review of QC raw data and analytical results, adhering strictly to the current GxP good documentation practices and data integrity requirements.
• Equipment Lifecycle Management: Execute and coordinate qualification, calibration, and preventive maintenance of QC equipment ensuring intended use.
• Documentation & Regulatory Collaboration: Draft, review, and revise various QC SOPs, work instructions, protocols, and reports. Collaborate closely with RA for the preparation of specifications and test methods for drug product registration. Who you are
• Basic qualification: Bachelor of Science majoring in biotechnology or related science.
• A minimum of 4 years experience in developing and executing quality control operation, and laboratory experience in pharmaceutical company.
• A strong background and in-depth knowledge in Instrumental analysis (HPLC, UV, CE, Spectrophotometer, Plate Reader, etc.) and cell-based assays.
• Good English written and communication skill. The Position Lass uns gemeinsam an einer gesünderen Zukunft arbeiten. Bei Roche ist Dein Einsatz als Betriebsingenieur:in weit mehr als nur technische Instandhaltung; Du bist der Herzschlag unserer Anlagen am Standort Penzberg – einem der größten Biotech-Zentren Europas. Stell Dir vor, Deine Arbeit ist das Fundament, auf dem lebensverändernde medizinische Durchbrüche entstehen, weil Du für die technische Verfügbarkeit und Effizienz unserer hochkomplexen Systeme sorgst. In einem Umfeld, das technologische Innovation und menschliches Wohlergehen vereint, trägst Du direkt dazu bei, die Lebensqualität von Patient:innen weltweit zu verbessern. Dein neues Team Du wirst Teil der Abteilung Operational Solutions & Services (OSS R&D) . Wir sind ein Team aus Expert:innen, das mit Leidenschaft daran arbeitet, die Infrastruktur für unsere Spitzenforschung und Produktion auf Top-Niveau zu halten. In Penzberg triffst Du auf eine Kultur des Vertrauens und der Zusammenarbeit, in der Deine Ideen zur Optimierung von Gebäuden und Anlagen nicht nur gehört, sondern aktiv gefördert werden. Gemeinsam sorgen wir dafür, dass unser Standort ein Ort bleibt, an dem Innovation fließen kann. Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich Als Betriebsingenieur:in bist Du die treibende Kraft hinter der Zuverlässigkeit unserer prozess- und gebäudetechnischen Anlagen. Du agierst wie ein Dirigent, der die verschiedenen technischen Gewerke zu einem harmonischen und effizienten Gesamtbild zusammenführt. Dabei übernimmst Du folgende spannende Aufgaben:
• Anlagenverfügbarkeit: Du stellst die Funktionstüchtigkeit und technische Verfügbarkeit sicher und steuerst effiziente Instandhaltungsmaßnahmen unter wirtschaftlichen Aspekten.
• Verantwortung: Du übernimmst die Anlagenverantwortung für Gebäude sowie prozesstechnische Nebenanlagen und stellst deren Betrieb unter Einhaltung aller Sicherheits- und Qualitätsstandards (GMP, GEP) sicher.
• Projektleitung: Du planst und steuerst technische Maßnahmen sowie Projekte – von der ersten Idee bis zur fachgerechten Realisierung nach dem Stand der Technik.
• Optimierung: Du verbesserst unsere Prozesse durch Zuverlässigkeitsstudien und Energiemonitoring, um einen nachhaltigen und kosteneffizienten Betrieb zu gewährleisten.
• Schnittstellenmanagement: Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit mit internen Fachabteilungen sowie externen Partnern und stellst eine lückenlose technische Dokumentation im SAP-System sicher. Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit Du verstehst Technik als Enabler für Fortschritt und bringst die nötige Expertise mit, um komplexe Systeme am Laufen zu halten.
• Ausbildung: Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Dipl.-Ing. FH / Bachelor / Master) im Bereich Maschinenbau, Verfahrenstechnik, Versorgungstechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
• Erfahrung: Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Anlagenbau, in der Betreuung technischer Anlagen oder im Gebäudebetrieb mit.
• Know-how: Du besitzt fundierte Kenntnisse in der Instandhaltung technischer Anlagen sowie Wissen in den Bereichen GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) und GEP (Good Engineering Practice).
• Skills: Du bist sicher im Umgang mit EDV-Systemen (idealerweise SAP) und verfügst über verfahrenstechnisches Verständnis sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.
• Persönlichkeit: Du zeichnest Dich durch eine eigenständige Arbeitsweise, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und die Fähigkeit aus, komplexe Projekte sicher zu steuern. Dauer: Diese Stelle ist unbefristet zu besetzen. Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser

The Position The Purpose The Disease Level Partner (DLP) is at the centre of implementation of the strategy and objectives within our therapy areas balanced with truly focusing on patient outcomes. The DLP understands their business as if it were their own. Through deep understanding of patient pathways, our medicines across the portfolio and customer needs, the DLP aligns their objectives to both the disease area strategy and regional objectives across their local health economy. By effective utilisation of all available resources, they will be successful in securing appropriate access to key customers to deliver better outcomes for more patients, faster. As an expert of the region, the DLP will enjoy developing deep customer knowledge and generating insights that support our strategies and bring new customer partnerships to Roche. Your Opportunity
• Have strong communication skills where you listen, partner and educate
• Gather actionable insights and elicit partnering opportunities that improve patient outcomes.
• Construct, present and agree with the Therapy Area Team and Disease Community Leads the objectives, strategy and goals for the region.
• Be fully accountable for the delivery of the goals within the Roche portfolio of products through effective engagement with customers, driving positive customer experience.
• Leverage support for products, ideas and projects across a local health economy and to contribute to the development and mobilisation of local and national brand advocates
• Maintain a detailed knowledge of national policy objectives and drivers and apply this to identify opportunities for growing the business at a National and Regional level in collaboration with the cross functional extended Roche Teams
• Use agile methodology (e.g. sprint methodology, MVP and iterative approach) to deliver disease level projects and non-disease level projects with internal/external expertise
• Ensure that all knowledge management and CRM systems are maintained in accordance with Roche standards, possess a thorough understanding of the provisions of the ABPI Code of Practice, remaining compliant with Roche SOPs and policies.
• Act as a guardian for high standards of compliance, ethics and safety; putting patients at the center of all actions by consistent business behaviour that complies with applicable laws, industry codes and Roche’s Code of Conduct.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position This role is initially for a fixed-term contract 12 months. The employment contract will be concluded by our vendor/third party for outsourcing services. We have a fantastic and challenging opportunity to fully combine your recruiting and consulting skills to seek, attract, and bring in the very best talent into Roche. This is with a focus on supporting the demand for talent within our Roche EMEA region. As a Talent Acquisition Partner you will play a pivotal role in ensuring we are hiring the best talent to meet our business ambitions. Make Your Mark. Improve Lives. You will be part of the Roche EMEA Recruiting team, a group of highly skilled professionals in our Integrated Workforce Strategies organization. The geographic focus will be Extended Eastern Europe (EEE) & CIS countries, however you will also be collaborating closely within the Region EMEA where we swarm our capacities to achieve our region’s goals as one team, and also within our global network. This position reports to the Recruiting Lead EEE & CIS countries. Your Impact
• Be a professional and consultative partner for our business leaders regarding all talent acquisition aspects
• Expertly drive end-to-end recruiting processes and provide customized talent acquisition strategies and solutions, including active candidate sourcing & pipelining, talent marketing, talent selection, candidate experience, and Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
• Manage the offer process with all necessary stakeholders (create an offer proposal following our Roche compensation and benefits framework and pay equity considerations, obtain approvals, extend offers, and negotiate with the candidate if required)
• Closely collaborate with the other People and Culture colleagues in-country, particularly the Business Partners to have insight about the coming business priorities, and the People Relations Partners to ensure a high confidentiality of recruitment-related topics
• May lead recruitment transformation projects across functions/countries Who You Are
• University degree in Human Resources Management, Business Management, Economics, Marketing, Finance is preferred
• You are fluent in English but also having additional language skills are an advantage
• You are preferably working in the Life Science/Tech industry and have a high passion for People and Culture, particularly for Talent Acquisition with proven success as a recruiter or head-hunter
• You are well-versed in talent attraction, sourcing, and assessing across multiple geographies and varied levels of complexity and expert in applicant tracking and sourcing tools such as Workday, Phenom People, LinkedIn
• You excel at building and maintaining relationships with stakeholders across all levels, both within our business and the People and Culture team, leveraging excellent communication, interpersonal, and influencing skills to collaborate, negotiate, and innovate effectively
• You have excellent coaching and advising skills, and thus are a trusted partner to your business clients and enable them in their hiring decisions
• You can work in a multinational matrix organization with the dexterity to participate in or lead recruiting squads across regions or globally Salary starts from 2000 EUR gross/month. Final salary will depend on the level of experience and skills. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Dein neues Team Im Standort Management Mannheim/Penzberg, sind wir gut 1'300 Spezialisten für verschiedenste Infrastruktur- und Professional-Services, die diese für die Standorte Mannheim und Penzberg zur Verfügung stellen. In einem dynamischen Umfeld fördern wir die nahtlose Zusammenarbeit über Geschäftsbereiche und Funktionen hinweg, bieten innovative Lösungen und verbessern die Arbeitsumgebung der Mitarbeitenden an den Standorten Mannheim und Penzberg. In dieser Funktion bist du Teil der Roche Diagnostics GmbH Risk Management & SHE Compliance, explizit des Teams Environmental Safety. Wir handeln stets mit dem Bewusstsein für unsere große Verantwortung gegenüber der Umwelt und der Gesellschaft und verwalten daher nicht nur, sondern gestalten aktiv eine zukunftsorientierte umweltrechtliche Compliance. Werde jetzt Teil eines Teams werden, dass sich wie folgt auszeichnet:
• Zwei Standorte, ein Team: Trotz der räumlichen Distanz verbindet uns ein engmaschiger, standortübergreifender Austausch und ein starker Teamgeist.
• Gesetzliche Fachexpertise: Wir übernehmen die zentralen Rollen der gesetzlichen Betriebsbeauftragten für Umweltschutz und sorgen dafür, dass unsere Innovationen & Assets stets auf einem rechtssicheren Fundament stehen.
• Vom Berater zum Gestalter: Wir verstehen uns nicht als „Bedenkenträger“, sondern als lösungsorientierte Gestalter. Wir handeln business-orientiert und unterstützen die operativen Einheiten dabei, Nachhaltigkeit und Effizienz in Einklang zu bringen. Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich In dieser Rolle unterstützt Du die Geschäftsführung und die operativen Einheiten bei der Sicherstellung der technischen Anlagen- und Verfahrenssicherheit. Mit Deiner Expertise im Boden- und Gewässerschutz agierst Du am Standort Mannheim als zentrale Instanz für die Überwachung und fachliche Beratung zur Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen. Du stellst sicher, dass die Betreiberverantwortung durch fundierte Expertise und proaktive Begutachtung gestärkt wird, und übernimmst darüber hinaus folgende spannende Aufgaben:
• Du überprüfst sicherheitstechnische Konzepte und stellst sicher, dass diese den gesetzlichen sowie internen Anforderungen im Bereich Gewässerschutz entsprechen.
• Du übernimmst die fachliche Überprüfung und auditierst die Umsetzung von Umwelt- und Sicherheitsvorgaben für Gewässer- und Bodenschutz, um die Einhaltung der Standards nachhaltig zu sichern.
• Durch die Bestellung zum Gewässerschutzbeauftragten und die fachliche Beratung der Verantwortlichen minimierst du proaktiv Risiken und sicherst die Compliance ab.
• Bei umweltrelevanten Vorfällen führst du fundierte Ursachenanalysen durch und verantwortest das Reporting gemäß gesetzlichen und Roche-internen Standards in Deinem Fachgebiet. Bei Bedarf unterstützt du intern im Rahmen der Gefahrenabwehr und im Notfallmanagement.
• Du agierst als kompetente:r Berater:in für die Fachbereiche, indem du Du komplexe Vorschriften wie das WHG oder die AwSV analysierst und in klare, praxisnahe Handlungsanweisungen für unsere Business Units übersetzt.
• Du agierst als Schnittstelle zu Genehmigungs- und Aufsichtsbehörden in Deinem Fachgebiet und begleitest die Fachbereiche proaktiv bei externen Audits und Inspektionen.
• Du beteiligst dich aktiv in internen (z.B. Communities of Practice) und externen (z.B. VCI) Gremien und und trägst mit Deinem Fachwissen zu pragmatischen und wirtschaftlichen Lösungsfindungen bei. Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED) , facciamo medicinali trasformativi per i pazienti per affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie non soddisfatte del mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in medicina. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. Il gruppo Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) di pRED consente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci a dosi ottimali nelle popolazioni rilevanti con una visione di potere traduzione, migliorare continuamente l'accuratezza delle nostre previsioni e accelerare lo sviluppo dei farmaci di domani. PS supporta la scoperta e lo sviluppo di tutta la catena del valore dalla valutazione dell'obiettivo al mercato e oltre. L'opportunità Come leader di progetto DMPK-PD esperto all'interno del gruppo DMPK-PD Traduzionale, sarete fondamentali per garantire che il farmaco giusto sia consegnato alla dose giusta, in modo sicuro ed efficace, ai pazienti. Condurrai strategie non cliniche e traduttive, collaborando in aree terapeutiche per trasformare le ipotesi scientifiche in candidati clinici innovativi. I vostri impatti e responsabilità:
• Leadership strategica: Definire e condurre la progettazione avanzata della droga, strategie di ottimizzazione e profilazione completa dei composti, integrando i principi DMPK all'avanguardia con la convalida della biologia di destinazione e concetti di PK/PD traduttivi complessi.
• Competenza traduttiva: Servire come esperto di materia tematica, guidare i team di scoperta precoce nello sviluppo di sofisticate strategie di traduzione per la valutazione clinica della modulazione target, sfruttando la conoscenza biochimica e farmacologica profonda.
• Advanced Modelling & Simulation (M&S): attività M&S avanzate dirette (comprese PKPD complessi, PBPK, DDI e sofisticate predizioni di dose/regimen) per informare criticamente e de-rischiare i progetti da Lead Optimisation (LO) attraverso lo sviluppo clinico precoce (EIH).
• Mastery di regolamentazione: Autore e presente valutazioni scientifiche definitive e di alta qualità dei dati DMPK non clinici per le revisioni critiche dei programmi interni e tutte le principali sottomissioni normative esterne (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), garantendo la conformità globale e tempi accelerati.
• Attuazione e innovazione: pioniere e supervisionare l'implementazione di robuste strategie biomarcatrici e bioanalitiche in stretta collaborazione con gli stakeholder chiave per massimizzare la sicurezza dei pazienti e il beneficio terapeutico.
• Influenza trasversale: il processo decisionale trasparente, basato sui dati, funge da consulente affidabile e coltiva relazioni professionali di alta fiducia tra team di progetto globali, enti di governance e partnership esterne. Chi sei
• Ha un PharmD o PhD in Scienze Farmaceutiche, Farmacologia, Bioingegneria o simili, accoppiato con oltre 10 anni di esperienza nel settore progressivo in un ruolo legato alla farmacocinetica senior.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED) , we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicine. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed. pRED's Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) group enables discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. PS supports discovery and development across the whole value chain from target assessment to on-market and beyond. The Opportunity As an experienced DMPK-PD Project Leader within the Translational DMPK-PD Group, you will be pivotal in ensuring the right drug is delivered at the right dose, safely and efficaciously, to patients. You will lead nonclinical and translational strategies, collaborating across therapeutic areas to transform scientific hypotheses into groundbreaking clinical candidates. Your Impact & Responsibilities:
• Strategic Leadership: Define and lead advanced drug design, optimisation strategies, and comprehensive compound profiling, integrating cutting-edge DMPK principles with target biology validation and complex translational PK/PD concepts.
• Translational Expertise: Serve as the subject matter expert, guiding early discovery teams in developing sophisticated translational strategies for clinical evaluation of target modulation, leveraging deep biochemical and pharmacological knowledge.
• Advanced Modelling & Simulation (M&S): Direct advanced M&S activities (including complex PKPD, PBPK, DDI, and sophisticated human dose/regimen prediction) to critically inform and de-risk projects from Lead Optimisation (LO) through early clinical development (EIH).
• Regulatory Mastery: Author and present definitive, high-quality scientific assessments of nonclinical DMPK data for critical internal program reviews and all major external regulatory submissions (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), ensuring global compliance and accelerated timelines.
• Implementation & Innovation: Pioneer and oversee the implementation of robust biomarker and bioanalytical strategies in close partnership with key stakeholders to maximise patient safety and therapeutic benefit.
• Cross-Functional Influence: Champion transparent, data-driven decision-making, acting as a trusted advisor and cultivating high-trust professional relationships across global project teams, governance bodies, and external partnerships. Who You Are
• You hold a PharmD or PhD in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmacology, Bioengineering or similar, coupled with over 10 years of progressive industry experience in a senior pharmacokinetic-related role.
• You possess deep, comprehensive expertise across the entire discovery, nonclinical and development spectrum, covering PK characterisation, distribution, and PKPD for diverse modalities (small molecules, biologics, novel therapeutics), grounded in authoritative knowledge of pharmacology and physiology.
• You demonstrate mastery of advanced modelling and simulation platforms (e.g., Phoenix, Berkeley Madonna, GastroPlus, SimCyp) and possess practical experience or a strong drive to apply Artificial Intelligence (AI

Bei pRED sind wir vereint von unserer Mission, Wissenschaft in die Medizin zu verwandeln. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine von Neugier, Verantwortung und Demut definierte Kultur, in der unsere talentierten Menschen befähigt und inspiriert sind, außergewöhnliche lebensverändernde Innovation mit Geschwindigkeit voranzubringen. PS unterstützt Entdeckung und Entwicklung in der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette von der Zielbewertung bis zum Markt und darüber hinaus. Die Chance Als erfahrener DMPK-PD Projektleiter innerhalb der Translational DMPK-PD Gruppe, werden Sie entscheidend dafür sein, dass das richtige Medikament in der richtigen Dosis, sicher und effektiv, an Patienten geliefert wird. • Fortgeschrittene Modellierung und Simulation (M&S): Direkte Fortgeschrittene M&S-Aktivitäten (einschließlich komplexer PKPD-, PBPK-, DDI- und ausgeklügelter menschlicher Dosis/Regimen-Prädiktion) zur kritischen Information und De-Risiko-Projekte von Lead Optimization (LO) durch frühe klinische Entwicklung (EIH).
• Regulatory Mastery: Autor und präsentieren endgültige, qualitativ hochwertige wissenschaftliche Bewertungen von nicht-klinischen DMPK-Daten für kritische interne Programmrezensionen und alle wichtigen externen regulatorischen Einreichungen (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), die globale Compliance und beschleunigte Timelines gewährleisten.
• Implementierung & Innovation: Pioneer und beaufsichtigen die Umsetzung von robusten Biomarker- und bioanalytischen Strategien in enger Partnerschaft mit den wichtigsten Akteuren, um die Patientensicherheit und den therapeutischen Nutzen zu maximieren.
• Cross-Functional Influence: Champion transparent, datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung, fungiert als vertrauenswürdiger Berater und kultiviert hoch vertrauensvolle Berufsbeziehungen über globale Projektteams, Governance-Einrichtungen und externe Partnerschaften. Wer bist du?
• Sie halten einen Doktortitel oder Doktortitel in der Pharmakologie, Pharmakologie, Bioengineering oder dergleichen, verbunden mit über 10 Jahren fortschrittlicher Branchenerfahrung in einer hochrangigen pharmakokinetischen Rolle.
• Sie verfügen über fundiertes, umfassendes Know-how über das gesamte Entdeckungs-, Nicht-Klinik- und Entwicklungsspektrum, das PK-Charakterisierung, Verteilung und PKPD für vielfältige Modalitäten (kleine Moleküle, Biologik, neuartige Therapeutika) abdeckt, die in maßgeblichem Wissen über Pharmakologie und Physiologie begründet sind.
• Sie demonstrieren Meisterschaft von fortschrittlichen Modellierungs- und Simulationsplattformen (z.B. Phoenix, Berkeley Madonna, GastroPlus, SimCyp) und verfügen über praktische Erfahrungen oder einen starken Antrieb zur Anwendung von künstlicher Intelligenz (KI)

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans Roches Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (PRED) , nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Chez PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médecine. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement l'innovation qui change la vie. Le groupe des Sciences Pharmaceutiques (PS) de pRED permet de découvrir et de développer des traitements sûrs et efficaces à des doses optimales dans les populations concernées, avec une vision pour la traduction de puissance, d'améliorer continuellement la précision de nos prédictions et d'accélérer le développement des médicaments de demain. SP appuie la découverte et le développement dans l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur, depuis l'évaluation des cibles jusqu'au marché et au-delà. L'opportunité En tant que chef de projet expérimenté de DMPK-PD au sein du Groupe DMPK-PD, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel pour vous assurer que le bon médicament est livré à la bonne dose, de façon sûre et efficace, aux patients. Vous dirigerez des stratégies non cliniques et translationnelles, en collaborant dans des domaines thérapeutiques pour transformer des hypothèses scientifiques en candidats cliniques révolutionnaires. Votre impact et vos responsabilités :
• Leadership stratégique: Définir et diriger la conception avancée des médicaments, les stratégies d'optimisation et le profilage complet des composés, en intégrant les principes de pointe de DMPK avec la validation de la biologie cible et les concepts de PK/PD translationnels complexes.
• Expertise translationnelle: servir d'expert en matière, guidant les équipes de découverte précoce dans le développement de stratégies translationnelles sophistiquées pour l'évaluation clinique de la modulation cible, en tirant parti de connaissances biochimiques et pharmacologiques profondes.
• Modélisation et simulation avancées (M&S): Diriger les activités de M&S avancées (y compris la PKPD complexe, la PBPK, la DDI et la prédiction sophistiquée des doses/régimes humains) afin d'informer et de dérisquer les projets de l'optimisation du plomb (OL) jusqu'au développement clinique précoce.
• Maîtrise de la réglementation : Auteur et présentation d'évaluations scientifiques définitives de haute qualité des données DMPK non cliniques pour les examens internes critiques des programmes et toutes les principales présentations de réglementation externe (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), assurant la conformité mondiale et l'accélération des délais.
• Mise en œuvre et innovation: pionnier et supervision de la mise en œuvre de stratégies biomarqueurs et bioanalytiques robustes en partenariat étroit avec les principales parties prenantes afin de maximiser la sécurité des patients et les avantages thérapeutiques.
• Influence interfonctionnelle : Championne, prise de décisions transparente et axée sur les données, en tant que conseillère de confiance et en cultivant des relations professionnelles de haute confiance entre les équipes de projet mondiales, les organes de gouvernance et les partenariats externes. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un PharmD ou d'un doctorat en sciences pharmaceutiques, pharmacologie, bioingénierie ou similaire, associé à plus de 10 ans d'expérience industrielle progressive dans un rôle pharmacocinétique senior.
• Vous possédez une expertise approfondie et complète sur l'ensemble du spectre de découverte, non clinique et de développement, couvrant la caractérisation, la distribution et la PKPD de PKPD pour diverses modalités (petites molécules, produits biologiques, nouveaux traitements), fondées sur une connaissance autorisée de la pharmacologie et de la physiologie.
• Vous démontrez la maîtrise de plates-formes de modélisation et de simulation avancées (p. ex. Phoenix, Berkeley Madonna, GastroPlus, SimCyp) et vous possédez une expérience pratique ou un puissant effort pour appliquer l'intelligence artificielle (AI)

The Position Position: Manager/Senior Manager - Central Market Access Strategy, I2 您将有机会： 疾病领域产品准入策略
• 产品准入策略及规划： 根据公司整体品牌策略，制定并整合疾病领域新产品及在研产品的整体准入策略，包含医保报销（Reimbursement）、商保创新目录准入（C-list）及基药目录准入等的策略开发。
• 价值建议开发： 与医学、市场部协作，开发具有竞争力的产品价值建议（Value Proposition）及定制化的准入沟通材料及资料（如 DA、Value Deck等） 。 疾病领域产品准入落地执行
• 准入全流程管理： 负责统筹该 TA 在中央层面准入、地方准入互动及动态调整机制下的医保和卫生准入及具体落地工作，协助处理相关异议并确保准入结果交付 。
• 重点项目运营： 策划并执行部门疾病领域重点策略项目，确保项目目标与产品准入需求高度切合 。
• 工具与培训： 支持中央及地方团队的客户沟通，提供沟通工具包使用培训及政策异议处理支持 。
• 区域协同： 与区域准入团队配合，推动落地及本地政策项目的执行 。 疾病领域政策倡导
• 政策洞察与框架构建： 研究并监测国家及地方医药政策趋势（如 DRG/DIP、动态准入等），构建并优化疾病领域的准入政策影响框架 。
• 准入环境塑造： 统筹该疾病领域的政策倡导规划，通过与高层利益相关者（政府机构、智库、学术团体）的合作，推动有利于创新药准入的政策环境和疾病规范化管理 。 疾病领域准入 BP
• 业务战略协同： 作为 NMA 部门与业务部门（CE）、及其他准入团队沟通的桥梁，参与核心讨论及准入建议，确保准入视角融入产品全生命周期策略 。
• 跨团队资源整合： 协调跨部门资源（医学、市场、VEP等），支持疾病领域关键产品在国家/地方准入一体化策略中的执行，提升组织效能 。
• 客户需求洞察： 动态维护内疾病领域内核心政策及影响客户图谱，基于区域需求进行客户的协同拜访等，并针对疾病领域提供差异化的解决方案，提升准入工作的客户导向。 我们期待您：
• 需具备 5 年以上（经理）或8 年以上（高级经理）医疗行业工作经验，其中至少包含 3 年或5年以上市场准入相关经验；
• 教育背景：拥有相关领域的学位（医学、卫生政策、经济学、管理学等），硕士学位优先。
• 专业技能：具备项目管理与执行方面的专业知识者优先。
• 语言能力：具备优秀的英语口语及书面表达能力。
• 演讲技巧：具备良好的演示与汇报技巧。

• 极强的独立分析及解决问题的能力.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary) ● A field-based medical expertise for field medical strategy development and execution on the assigned disease area and related biomarker under the leadership of Medical Science Manager Leader. ● Be responsible for data generation activities for assigned disease area and related biomarker. ● Establish long-term, peer-to-peer relationships with TAEs and investigators，including biomarker area experts, in a given therapeutic field and deliver quality interactions and services that bring value to HCPs, and that are aligned with medical strategies. ● Lead implementation of the tactical / field medical plans in collaboration with Country Medical Manager. ● Identify opportunities for collaborations between the company and the TAEs and investigators. ● Ensures strict adherence to the company’s corporate policies, SOP and local regulations for all medical science initiatives for assigned disease area. Principle Roles &
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities (Major functions of the position) 1) A field-based medical expertise for medical science in assigned disease area and related biomarker ● Drive development, implementation and monitoring field medical plan under coaching of MSM Leader and align with country medical strategy. ● Define and execute field medical short term to long term vision includes scientific communications and strategic partnerships through interaction with TAEs. ● Collect field TAE insights and determine TAE interest in ongoing research and educational events; Develop and regularly update TAE profile to better understand TAE’s clinical practices, needs, preferences and views of new data. ● Provide scientific support for cross functional partners in medical training, scientific query handling, speaker material preparation. ● Lead the local innovative business model developing, implementation and further optimization, such as the establishment of regional pathology referral center with synergy from Roche diagnostic company and other external diagnostic related company or medical society. ● Contribute to the execution of advisory boards. 2) Data Generation ● Translate insights on local stakeholder needs and value decision drivers into an effective medical strategy, prioritize gaps and hurdles related to the local patient journey. ● Ensure excellence in access evidence planning and generation as part of the medical strategy, incorporating RWE, clinical studies and data inputs for local economic models etc. ● Receive IISs request, work with country medical manager to review of IISs within the company, and following-up with investigators, in accordance to all local laws and regulations. ● Support site feasibility assessments, site development plan, patients enrollment in trials and investigator engagementof Phase I-IIIa clinical studies under the direction of PDof Phase IIIb-IV Medical Affairs clinical studies in collaboration with clinical operations 3) Knowledge exchange ● Translate clinical/scientific evidence into local value messages and communicate those in cross functional collaboration to relevant stakeholders in a tailored manner. ● Exchange scientific data with HCPs; facilitate their needs of up to date scientific data, including but not limited to publications of clinical trials, guidelines, by ensuring they have the best quality available information they require. ● Develop and deliver medical training and education program to the target audience. ● Provide inputs to country medical manager on the aff

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Position At Roche, we are building a harmonized, scalable, and compliant omnichannel engagement ecosystem that enables personalized and data-driven interactions across channels. As the PI Omnichannel Technical Product Owner, you will play a key role within Roche Digital Technologies (RDT), partnering closely with the Pharma International (PI), Marketing Technologies Solution Owner, and Business Product Owner for Marketing Automation to drive the execution and operational delivery of omnichannel orchestration and activation capabilities. This role is focused on the technical delivery, orchestration, and operationalization of omnichannel engagement use cases across digital activation channels. You will work across business and technology teams to ensure campaigns, journeys, integrations, and activation capabilities are delivered efficiently, compliantly, and at scale. You will operate within an Agile Release Train (ART) environment and work closely with internal teams, external vendors, and implementation partners to drive execution across sprint ceremonies, planning cycles, and delivery governance activities. This position will report to the Lead for Omnichannel Orchestration for Pharma International The Opportunity Own Omnichannel Activation Delivery : Own the end-to-end technical delivery and operational execution of omnichannel activation capabilities across digital engagement channels. Drive Channel Orchestration : Support the orchestration and execution of customer journeys, triggers, segmentation, personalization, and campaign activation use cases across the omnichannel ecosystem. Enable Business Activation : Partner closely with business stakeholders and Product Owners to translate business priorities into executable delivery plans and activation outcomes. Coordinate Cross-Functional Workstreams : Drive alignment and execution across multiple workstreams including Integrations, segmentation, journeys and activation, reporting and insights, and vendor coordination Support Agile Delivery Execution : Actively participate in Agile Release Train ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily standups, release planning, delivery tracking Market Onboarding & Campaign Enablement: Support affiliate onboarding activities, campaign execution readiness, and operational rollout of omnichannel capabilities across markets. Operational Excellence & Governance: Help establish scalable operational processes, delivery governance, documentation standards, and execution best practices across omnichannel activation activities. Who You Are You are a delivery-oriented and collaborative leader who is comfortable operating across business and technology domains within large-scale enterprise transformation programs. Experience
• 7+ years of experience in Marketing Technology, CRM, Marketing Automation, or Omnichannel engagement domains
• Experience working in large-scale enterprise transformation or digital engagement programs
• Experience operating within Agile delivery environments
• Strong understanding of omnichannel campaign execution and activation workflows
• Hands-on experience or strong familiarity with: Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), CRM and Marketing Automation ecosystems, Customer journeys and campaign orchestration, Segmentation and activation concepts, Email and digital engagement channels
• Experience coordinating cross-functional delivery teams and external vendors
• Ability to manage dependenc

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position This role is part of the Legal and Compliance department in Diagnostics Division with matrix reporting lines. Your direct report is to Head of Legal and Compliance with dotted line managers Head of Marketing and Head of Professional Services also with direct access to executive directors (as legally required). The Cybersecurity and Digital Solutions Lead is responsible for developing and implementing cybersecurity policies and protocols to protect Roche's products, information systems and technologies and managing the roadmap, governance, and value realization of key digital initiatives across the Czech Affiliate and its Diagnostics and Pharma businesses. Using your expertise in Roche's products and environment, you will ensure systems comply with all security and regulatory standards. You will also apply your technical skills to manage and mitigate cyber threats. The Opportunity
• Develop and oversee cybersecurity framework, strategy, policies and procedures (eg. ISO 27001 implementation, NIS2 local implementation) to safeguard digital systems and sensitive information.
• Manage the cybersecurity responsibilities across different teams in Roche Diagnostics and Pharma divisions and ensure cooperation throughout the organization and overall alignment with Roche's security objectives.
• Ensure Regulatory Compliance with cybersecurity and data protection requirements.
• Manage the Risk Framework and monitor risk management activities.
• Perform risk assessments to identify potential cyber threats and establish and coordinate a risk management plan in the context of the organisation as well as individual installation cases.
• Assess system vulnerabilities and implement security measures.
• Monitor network and information security systems for potential breaches and intrusions.
• Coordinate potential cyber security incidents.
• Cooperate and coordinate the process of cybersecurity asset management.
• Conduct regular security audits and compliance checks across all systems and applications and elaborate regular reports on cybersecurity risks and mitigation steps.
• Liaise and communicate directly with the regulatory Authorities and relevant Bodies on topics of cybersecurity.
• Communicate directly and regularly with the management on the topics of cybersecurity, support Executive Management in cybersecurity-related decisions
• Prepare Security Assessments and Reports for Leadership.
• Maintain updated knowledge of cybersecurity trends, emerging threats, and technologies.
• Collaborate with external IT and external business units (e.g. hospitals and laboratories, etc.) to ensure effective cybersecurity strategies are integrated into business processes.
• Provide training and awareness programs on cybersecurity best practices for all staff.
• Manage cybersecurity training and awareness programs across business functions.
• Oversee third-party risk management and vendor cybersecurity compliance.
• Define and maintain the digital portfolio roadmap for diagnostics, including connected devices, remote monitoring tools, and AI-driven decision support systems.
• Work cross-functionally with Product Management, IT, and Legal, Compliance and Regulatory teams to ensure timely and compliant delivery.
• Collaborate with all stakeholders (internal/ external) on development and implementation of Digital Products and Solutions strategy. Who You Are
• Master’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
• Certifications su

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione La divisione “Pharma Site Services” di Roche Pharma presso la sede di Basilea/Kaiseraugst è responsabile della pianificazione e dell'attuazione di progetti di investimento innovativi, convenienti e conformi alle GMP. Con la logistica del sito ci occupiamo anche delle merci e delle spedizioni che arrivano al sito, vengono immagazzinate e distribuite qui o lasciano il sito. Inoltre, il dipartimento svolge attività di ingegneria edile e operativa, gestione della qualità tecnica ed è responsabile della risoluzione dei problemi e della manutenzione affidabili, compreso il funzionamento dell'infrastruttura necessaria. Supportiamo il nostro management e i nostri clienti con impianti di produzione biotecnologici, chimici e farmaceutici, edifici di laboratorio ed edifici amministrativi. Il reparto “Energie & Utilities” è responsabile dell'approvvigionamento energetico e dei media, della gestione dell'edificio e dei servizi di manutenzione nelle sedi di Basilea e Kaiseraugst. Il circolo "Energie e servizi pubblici - Operazione E2E" garantisce il funzionamento affidabile, conforme alle autorità e attento ai costi dei mezzi di riscaldamento, raffreddamento e processo, compresa la fornitura e lo smaltimento. In questa posizione garantirai la disponibilità, la conformità ufficiale e il funzionamento economico dei sistemi e manterrai i sistemi per conto dei nostri clienti. Sei responsabile del funzionamento dei sistemi, della risoluzione dei problemi, della manutenzione, dell'ottimizzazione continua (energia, costi) e del supporto dell'azienda esterna. Dovresti anche essere pronto a svolgere compiti di guardia e lavorare su progetti. La possibilità:
• Sistemi di generazione di aria compressa e di processo + reti di gas (N2, Co2, Arg) ecc. Conformi a GMP e GEP, ottimizzati e gestiti nell'area di ispezione
• Manutenzione, gestione aziendale esterna, miglioramenti e ulteriore sviluppo di sistemi e sistemi
• Tenuta di registri e gestione di SOP
• Avvio di modernizzazioni e assistenza nella pianificazione dei costi
• Implementazione della gestione della continuità operativa per sistemi e sistemi
• Gestione dei pezzi di ricambio
• Interpretazione del consumo di energia e misure derivate
• Fornitura di servizi di guardia nella fornitura di energia per l'area di Basilea (aria compressa e di processo, produzione di acqua fredda e salata e vari sistemi termici (40°C, acqua di fabbrica, raffreddamento delle acque reflue, idranti, rete a 95°C) Chi siete:
• Almeno tre anni di esperienza professionale nell'esercizio e nella manutenzione di sistemi di processo in un ambiente GMP
• L'esperienza pratica nella fornitura di energia è un vantaggio
• Avete esperienza nell'utilizzo dei sistemi di controllo dei processi dei sistemi menzionati.
• Hai completato la formazione professionale tecnica e preferibilmente una formazione continua come specialista della manutenzione.
• Metodi di lavoro indipendenti e auto-organizzati; Comprensione e buona capacità di orientamento all'interno di un'organizzazione a matrice
• Ottima conoscenza della lingua tedesca scritta e parlata, idealmente inglese, completano il tuo profilo Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo si impegnano a far progredire la scienza, garantendo a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi hanno portato a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e a oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Ci diamo la forza reciproca di esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alte le nostre ambizioni, in modo da poter offrire la vita

Nous soutenons notre direction et nos clients avec des installations de production biotechnologiques, chimiques et pharmaceutiques, des bâtiments de laboratoire et des bâtiments administratifs. Le département « Energies & Utilities » est chargé d'assurer l'approvisionnement en énergie et en médias, d'assurer l'exploitation des bâtiments et de fournir des services de maintenance sur les sites de Bâle et de Kaiseraugst. Le cercle « Energies & Utilities - Operation E2E » garantit l'exploitation fiable, conforme aux réglementations et économique des fluides de chauffage, de refroidissement et de processus, y compris l'approvisionnement et l'élimination. À ce poste, vous assurerez la disponibilité, la conformité officielle et le fonctionnement économique des systèmes et assurerez la maintenance des systèmes pour le compte de nos clients. Vous êtes responsable de l'exploitation des systèmes, du dépannage, de la maintenance, de l'optimisation continue (énergie, coûts) et du support externe de l'entreprise. Vous devez également être prêt à effectuer des tâches de garde et à travailler sur des projets. La possibilité :
• Systèmes de génération d'air comprimé et de traitement + réseaux de gaz (N2, Co2, Arg), etc. Conformes aux BPF et aux BPE, optimisés et exploités dans la zone d'inspection
• Maintenance, gestion externe de l'entreprise, améliorations et développement ultérieur des systèmes et des systèmes
• Tenir des journaux de bord et gérer les SOP
• Initier des modernisations et aider à la planification des coûts
• Mettre en œuvre une gestion de la continuité d'activité des systèmes et des systèmes
• Gestion des pièces de rechange
• Interprétation de la consommation d'énergie et détermination des mesures
• Fournir un service de garde pour l'approvisionnement en énergie pour la région de Bâle (air comprimé et de procédé, génération d'eau froide et de saumure et divers systèmes thermiques (40°C, eau d'usine, eaux usées de refroidissement, bouches d'incendie, réseau 95°C) Qui vous êtes :
• Au moins trois ans d'expérience professionnelle dans l'exploitation et la maintenance de systèmes de procédés dans un environnement GMP.
• Une expérience pratique dans l'approvisionnement en énergie est un avantage.
• Vous avez de l'expérience dans l'exploitation des systèmes de contrôle de procédés des systèmes mentionnés.
• Vous avez suivi une formation professionnelle technique et idéalement une formation continue en tant que spécialiste de la maintenance.
• Méthodes de travail indépendantes et auto-organisées ; Compréhension et bonne capacité d'orientation au sein d'une organisation matricielle
• Allemand courant écrit et parlé, idéalement anglais complètent votre profil Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent au progrès de la science, garantissant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts ont permis de traiter plus de 26 millions de personnes avec nos médicaments et de réaliser plus de 30 milliards de tests à l'aide de nos produits de diagnostic. Nous nous donnons les moyens d'explorer de nouvelles possibilités, de favoriser la créativité et de maintenir nos ambitions élevées, afin de pouvoir offrir la vie.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Are you someone who finds satisfaction in the details? Do you enjoy the process of systematically checking software to ensure it works perfectly with physical hardware? In our cross functional and cross Site team, we are looking for a Test Technician with a strong interest in Instrument testing focusing on Software Testing to join our team in Sant Cugat. While you will be working with physical medical instruments, your primary focus will be on the software that drives them—executing test cases, documenting defects, and ensuring the system is reliable for patient use. Your Role In this position, you aren't just "clicking buttons"—you are the guardian of software quality. You will be responsible for the consistent execution of test protocols that bridge the gap between digital code and mechanical movement. Key Responsibilities:
• Software-Centric medical device testing:
• Execute manual test cases focusing on software functionality, with a customer mindset on a medical device.
• Lifecycle Maintenance:
• Create, refine, and update software test cases over the entire life cycle of the medical device.
• Methodical Execution:
• Perform repetitive test cycles with high consistency to ensure software stability across different versions.
• Technical Documentation:
• Document every step of your process. You will record defects and test results with high precision to meet medical regulatory standards. Your Profile We are looking for a practical, detail-oriented professional with a genuine passion for technology. If you love troubleshooting, have a high affinity for software, and prefer hands-on execution over theoretical concepts, this is the role for you. Formación Profesional (Grado Medio/Superior), no university degree is required—we value your practical skills, technical curiosity, and drive to learn Background: Completed apprenticeship or solid job experience in a technical environment, laboratory, or IT-support setting. E.g. Técnico/a de Pruebas, Tester de Software y Hardware, Técnico de Verificación y Validación (V&V), Desarrollo de Aplicaciones Multiplataforma, Grado en Ingeniería Informática or similar The "Tester" Mindset: You are naturally conscientious and thorough. You enjoy a routine-oriented environment and take pride in performing repetitive tasks with 100% accuracy every time. Software Affinity: You have a keen interest in how software operates and a desire to build a career in instrument/system testing (no programming skills needed). Quality First: You understand that documenting a test is just as important as performing it. Soft skills: Ability to actively contribute to team collaboration, inclusion, sharing ideas and good team spirit, as well as mutual trust and respect (project team and sub chapter level) Languages skills: Expert Spanish (C1 or better) and expert English (C1 or better) language skills. The project language is English. Local team language is Spanish Bonus skills:
• Basic understanding of customer workflows in the area of diagnostic instruments (e.g. in coagulation or serum work area)
• Basic skills with testing tools e.g. Retina
• Initial experience with software testing on instrument level What you can expect from us: Teamwork with ambitious and passionate people building high-quality products meeting customer’s needs An agile working environment allowing for collaboration and knowledge sharing in cross-functional teams Fostered collaboration within the project and chapter to build and maintain a tr

titleByLocale.it: SW Technical Lead - Piattaforme di dati

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione SW Technical Lead - Piattaforme di dati Come sviluppatore di software personalizzato, si agirà come leader strategico e innovatore. Definirai i compiti per gli altri, guiderai iniziative su larga scala e i colleghi di mentore per promuovere la crescita. Questo ruolo consiste nel fornire supporto a livello globale per iniziative tecniche, condividere conoscenze a livello internazionale, e modellare la direzione tecnica dell'organizzazione. Possiederai una profonda esperienza in più aree tecnologiche, stabilirai standard elevati per la qualità del codice e la sicurezza, e rimuoverai gli ostacoli per le squadre, migliorando continuamente la produttività degli sviluppatori e il ciclo di vita globale dello sviluppo del software. L'opportunità:
• Ambito: fornire una guida tecnica strategica e impostare la direzione per lo sviluppo di prodotti digitali in linea con gli obiettivi e le priorità aziendali.
• Evoluzione architettonica: guidare la transizione strategica da un monolite modulare a microservizi, assicurando che i confini del dominio siano rispettati e le prestazioni rimangono elevate. Partecipa allo sviluppo di nuovi componenti e idee collaborando con un team multidisciplinare per offrire esperienze end-to-end agli utenti finali.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Definire i compiti per gli altri e guidare le iniziative di successo Medium to Large (M/L) a livello Product Line. Sfidare gli altri in un modo di crescita, sfruttare i punti di forza del team in modo efficace, e agire come allenatore e / o guidare per gli altri.
• Gestione degli stakeholder: Possedere una forte comprensione degli ecosistemi delle parti interessate e delle loro esigenze, eccellendo nei negoziati e nelle partnership per i benefici reciproci. Fornire la direzione per obiettivi e obiettivi a medio-lungo termine.
• Impatto/Strategia: fornire supporto a livello globale per iniziative innovative e tecnologiche. Fai discorsi e condividi la conoscenza in eventi locali/internazionali e iniziative di condivisione delle conoscenze, e impegnarsi attivamente in attività correlate a RDT Data Domain/Site.
• Complessità/ (dimensione del prodotto): Operare a livello del prodotto / dominio / sito.
• Capacità aziendale/tecnica: contribuire attivamente all'avanzamento della conoscenza tecnica all'interno del campo attraverso pubblicazioni, presentazioni e mentorship (ad esempio, servendo come proprietario di capacità). Ispirare l'innovazione, guidare soluzioni innovative in linea con le tendenze tecnologiche, e concentrarsi sulla progettazione di nuovi approcci ai problemi esistenti. Chi sei:
• 10+ anni di esperienza collaudata che guida la collaborazione interfunzionale per risolvere i problemi tecnici a livello organizzativo e allineare gli sforzi di ingegneria disparati verso obiettivi comuni.
• Possiede una profonda comprensione dei principi del trattamento dei dati e delle esigenze di protezione dell'intelligenza artificiale. Tenere esperienza nella costruzione di soluzioni per gli esperti di dati (ad esempio, Data Owners, Data Consumers, Data Product Owners e Digital Asset Management).
• Esprimi una profonda esperienza in più aree tecnologiche e la capacità di selezionare e applicare tecnologie adeguate per risolvere problemi complessi.
• Mantenere la competenza in Java, Spring Boot, Angular, AWS, ECS, Docker, PostgreSQL, GitOps, Architettura basata su eventi o tecnologie simili.
• Dimostrare una forte comprensione delle pratiche del ciclo di vita dello sviluppo del software, compresa la messa a punto delle prestazioni e la scalabilità.
• Levare la conoscenza eccellente dello sviluppo software disponibile sul mercato strumenti per suggerire l'adozione nell'attuale strumenti Roche, migliorando continuamente la produttività degli sviluppatori e l'esperienza Roche-wide.
• Applicare competenze nelle best practice di sicurezza informatica, assicurando che le soluzioni software conformi agli standard di sicurezza in coordinamento con l'esperto Roche appropriato
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position SW Technical Lead - Data Platforms As a Custom Software Developer, you will act as a strategic leader and innovator. You will define tasks for others, drive large-scale initiatives, and mentor colleagues to foster growth. This role involves providing global-level support for technical initiatives, sharing knowledge internationally, and shaping the organization's technical direction. You will possess deep expertise across multiple technology areas, set high standards for code quality and security, and remove obstacles for teams, continuously improving developer productivity and the overall software development lifecycle. The Opportunity:
• Scope: Provide strategic technical guidance and set the direction for digital product development in alignment with business goals and priorities.
• Architectural Evolution: Lead the strategic transition from a modular monolith to microservices, ensuring domain boundaries are respected and performance remains high. Take ownership of the development of new components and ideas as you cooperate with a multidisciplinary team to deliver end-to-end experiences to the End Users.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Define tasks for others and drive successful Medium to Large (M/L) initiatives at the Product or Product Line level. Challenge others in a growth-enabling way, leverage team strengths effectively, and act as a coach and/or lead for others.
• Stakeholder Management: Possess a strong grasp of stakeholder ecosystems and their needs, excelling in negotiations and partnerships for mutual benefits. Provide direction for mid- to long-term goals and objectives.
• Impact/Strategy: Provide global-level support for innovative and technological initiatives. Give speeches and share knowledge in local/international events and knowledge-sharing initiatives, and actively engage in RDT Data Domain/Site-related activities.
• Complexity/ (Product Size): Operate at the Product / Domain / Site level.
• Business/Technical ability: Actively contribute to the advancement of technical knowledge within the field through publications, presentations, and mentorship (for example, by serving as a capability owner). Inspire innovation, drive innovative solutions in line with technology trends, and focus on designing new approaches to existing problems. Who you are:
• 10+ years proven experience driving cross-functional collaboration to solve organization-wide technical problems and aligning disparate engineering efforts toward common goals.
• Possess a deep understanding of data processing principles and AI-readiness data needs. Hold experience in building solutions for data experts (e.g., Data Owners, Data Consumers, Data Product Owners, and Digital Asset Management).
• Exhibit deep expertise in multiple technology areas and the ability to select and apply appropriate technologies to solve complex problems.
• Maintain proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, Angular, AWS, ECS, Docker, PostgreSQL, GitOps, Event-driven architecture, or similar technologies.
• Demonstrate a strong understanding of software development lifecycle practices, including performance tuning and scalability.
• Leverage excellent knowledge of market-available software development tooling to suggest adoption into the current Roche toolset, continuously improving developer productivity and experience Roche-wide.
• Apply expertise in cybersecurity best practices, ensuring that software solutions comply with security standards in coordination with appropriate Roche expert
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position SW Technical Lead - Datenplattformen Als Custom Software Developer fungieren Sie als strategischer Führer und Innovator. Sie werden Aufgaben für andere definieren, Großinitiativen und Mentorkollegen zur Förderung des Wachstums antreiben. Diese Rolle beinhaltet die Bereitstellung globaler Unterstützung für technische Initiativen, das Teilen von Wissen international und die Gestaltung der technischen Richtung der Organisation. Sie verfügen über fundiertes Know-how in mehreren Technologiebereichen, setzen hohe Standards für die Codequalität und Sicherheit, und entfernen Hindernisse für Teams, kontinuierlich die Produktivität der Entwickler und den gesamten Lebenszyklus der Softwareentwicklung. Die Gelegenheit:
• Anwendungsbereich: Strategische technische Beratung bereitstellen und die Richtung für die digitale Produktentwicklung in Abstimmung mit Geschäftszielen und Prioritäten festlegen.
• Architektonische Evolution: Führen Sie den strategischen Übergang von einem modularen Monolith zu Mikroservices, um sicherzustellen, dass Domaingrenzen eingehalten werden und die Leistung bleibt hoch. Nehmen Sie das Eigentum an der Entwicklung neuer Komponenten und Ideen, während Sie mit einem multidisziplinären Team zusammenarbeiten, um End-to-End-Erfahrungen an die Endbenutzer zu liefern.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Aufgaben für andere definieren und auf der Ebene der Produkt- oder Produktlinie erfolgreiche Initiativen mit mittlerer bis großer (M/L) vorantreiben. Fordern Sie andere auf wachstumssteigernde Weise heraus, hebeln Sie Teamstärken effektiv und fungieren als Trainer und/oder führen Sie für andere.
• Stakeholder Management: Besteht ein starkes Verständnis der Stakeholder-Ökosysteme und deren Bedürfnisse, die sich in Verhandlungen und Partnerschaften für gegenseitige Vorteile auszeichnen. Richten Sie Richtung für mittel- bis langfristige Ziele und Ziele.
• Impact/Strategy: Globale Unterstützung für innovative und technologische Initiativen. Sprechen Sie an lokalen/internationalen Veranstaltungen und Wissensaustauschinitiativen und beteiligen Sie sich aktiv an RDT Data Domain/Site-bezogenen Aktivitäten.
• Komplexität/ (Produktgröße): Betrieb auf der Produkt-/Domain-/Site-Ebene.
• Business/Technische Fähigkeit: Aktiver Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung des technischen Wissens im Feld durch Veröffentlichungen, Präsentationen und Mentorship (z.B. als Leistungsinhaber). Inspirieren Sie Innovation, treiben Sie innovative Lösungen im Einklang mit Technologietrends und setzen Sie auf die Entwicklung neuer Ansätze für bestehende Probleme. Wer du bist:
• 10+ Jahre bewährte Erfahrung, die funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit vorantreibt, um organisatorische technische Probleme zu lösen und unterschiedliche technische Anstrengungen zu gemeinsamen Zielen auszurichten.
• Ein tiefes Verständnis der Datenverarbeitungsprinzipien und des Bedarfs an AI-Readiness-Daten. Erfahrung in Gebäudelösungen für Datenexperten halten (z.B. Data Owners, Data Consumers, Data Product Owners und Digital Asset Management).
• Erwarten Sie tiefes Know-how in mehreren Technologiebereichen und die Fähigkeit, geeignete Technologien zur Lösung komplexer Probleme auszuwählen und anzuwenden.
• Erhalten Sie Kenntnisse in Java, Spring Boot, Angular, AWS, ECS, Docker, PostgreSQL, GitOps, Event-getriebene Architektur oder ähnliche Technologien.
• Demonstrieren Sie ein starkes Verständnis von Software-Entwicklungs-Lebenszyklus-Praktiken, einschließlich Leistungsabstimmung und Skalierbarkeit.
• Vermitteln Sie hervorragende Kenntnisse über marktübliche Software-Entwicklungstools, um die Einführung in den aktuellen Roche-Toolset vorzuschlagen, die Entwicklerproduktivität und Erfahrung Roche-weit kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
