Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Lead technique SW - Plateformes de données En tant que développeur de logiciel personnalisé, vous agirez comme leader stratégique et innovateur. Vous définirez des tâches pour les autres, stimulerez des initiatives à grande échelle et mentorez vos collègues pour favoriser la croissance. Ce rôle consiste à fournir un appui mondial aux initiatives techniques, à partager les connaissances à l'échelle internationale et à façonner l'orientation technique de l'organisation. Vous posséderez une expertise approfondie dans plusieurs domaines technologiques, établirez des normes élevées pour la qualité et la sécurité des codes, et supprimerez les obstacles pour les équipes, améliorant continuellement la productivité des développeurs et le cycle de vie global du développement logiciel. La possibilité :
• Portée: Fournir des orientations techniques stratégiques et définir l'orientation pour le développement de produits numériques en conformité avec les objectifs et les priorités des entreprises.
• Evolution architecturale: Diriger la transition stratégique d'un monolithe modulaire à un microservices, en assurant le respect des limites du domaine et le maintien des performances. Prenez en charge le développement de nouveaux composants et idées alors que vous coopérez avec une équipe multidisciplinaire pour fournir des expériences de bout en bout aux utilisateurs finaux.
• Responsabilisation/Résoudre les problèmes : Définir les tâches pour les autres et mener à bien les initiatives moyennes à grandes (M/L) au niveau du produit ou de la gamme de produits. Définer les autres de façon à favoriser la croissance, tirer parti des forces de l'équipe et agir comme entraîneur et/ou chef de file pour les autres.
• Gestion des parties prenantes: posséder une bonne compréhension des écosystèmes des parties prenantes et de leurs besoins, excellant dans les négociations et les partenariats pour des avantages mutuels. Fournir une orientation pour les buts et objectifs à moyen et à long terme.
• Impact/Stratégie: fournir un appui au niveau mondial pour les initiatives innovantes et technologiques. Donner des discours et partager des connaissances sur les événements locaux et internationaux et les initiatives de partage des connaissances, et participer activement aux activités liées au domaine de données et au site de RDT.
• Complexité/ (Taille du produit): Fonctionnez au niveau du produit/domaine/site.
• Capacités commerciales/techniques: contribuer activement à l'avancement des connaissances techniques sur le terrain au moyen de publications, de présentations et de mentorat (par exemple, en servant de propriétaire de capacités). Inspirer l'innovation, proposer des solutions innovantes en fonction des tendances technologiques et se concentrer sur la conception de nouvelles approches des problèmes existants. Qui vous êtes :
• Plus de 10 ans d'expérience prouvée conduisant à une collaboration interfonctionnelle pour résoudre des problèmes techniques à l'échelle de l'organisation et aligner les efforts d'ingénierie disparates sur des objectifs communs.
• Posséder une compréhension approfondie des principes de traitement des données et des besoins en données de préparation à l'IA. Avoir de l'expérience dans la construction de solutions pour les experts en données (p. ex., les propriétaires de données, les consommateurs de données, les propriétaires de produits de données et la gestion numérique d'actifs).
• Exposer une expertise approfondie dans plusieurs domaines technologiques et la capacité de sélectionner et d'appliquer des technologies appropriées pour résoudre des problèmes complexes.
• Maintenir la compétence en Java, Spring Boot, Angular, AWS, ECS, Docker, PostgreSQL, GitOps, l'architecture d'événements ou des technologies similaires.
• Démontrer une bonne compréhension des pratiques de développement du cycle de vie des logiciels, y compris le réglage des performances et l'évolutivité.
• Tirer parti d'une excellente connaissance des outils de développement de logiciels disponibles sur le marché pour suggérer l'adoption dans l'outil Roche actuel, améliorant en permanence la productivité du développeur et l'expérience à l'échelle de Roche.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Roche Diagnostics International AG in Rotkreuz is one of the world's leading providers of diagnostic system solutions for hospitals, laboratories, and physician offices. With over 2,200 employees, Rotkreuz is one of Roche Diagnostics' main sites. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity, and diversity. The Team Lead QC Reagents role at the Roche Rotkreuz S&C (Sensor & Cartridge Manufacturing) site is a central leadership position responsible for the quality control of reagents, ensuring product quality and compliance with regulatory requirements. This includes assuming technical responsibility for compounding in reagent production, and supporting all production processes to drive improvement in collaboration with the respective Team Leaders (Peers) The Opportunity
• Lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 8 specialists, fostering talent and managing the team’s training matrix and status using adult learning methods.
• Take responsibility for all Safety, Health, and Environment (SHE) roles within the team, implementing risk reduction measures and ensuring full compliance with GMP, GSP, and mQMS.
• Translate S&C Operations Strategy into measurable team objectives and KPIs, while optimizing manufacturing and personnel costs through performance analysis.
• Ensure supply according to long-term resource planning (12 months) and optimize the production plan in collaboration with the supply chain.
• Assume technical responsibility for compounding in reagent production and lead the Continuous Improvement Process (CIP) to increase quality and efficiency standards.
• Act as the central interface to departments like Supply Chain, R&D, and MSAT to ensure cross-functional order coordination and planning optimization.
• Monitor Quality-KPIs such as Right-First-Time (RFT) and Statistical-Process-Control (SPC), and contribute to department-wide improvements as a member of the S&C Manufacturing Rotkreuz Leadership Team. Who You Are
• You hold a higher natural science education (BSc, MSc, PhD), ideally as a Chemist, Biochemist, Process Engineer, or Materials Scientist.
• You have proven experience in employee leadership with an empathetic style and a genuine passion for coaching and empowering a diverse team in a production environment.
• You possess profound experience with GMP in highly regulated environments, a strong quality awareness, and a very good command of written and spoken German and English.
• You have strong analytical thinking skills, an understanding of complex contexts, and an interest in Shopfloor Management and data-based decision-making.
• You demonstrate excellent communication skills, high self-reflection, and the ability to represent the department’s interests effectively. Have we sparked your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your complete application documents (cover letter, CV, references, diplomas, etc.). Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity

The Team Lead QC Reagents role at the Roche Rotkreuz S&C (Sensor & Cartridge Manufacturing) site is a central leadership position responsible for the quality control of reagents, ensuring product quality and compliance with regulatory requirements. This includes assuming technical responsibility for compounding in reagent production, and supporting all production processes to drive improvement in collaboration with the respective Team Leaders (Peers) The Opportunity
• Lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 8 specialists, fostering talent and managing the team’s training matrix and status using adult learning methods.
• Take responsibility for all Safety, Health, and Environment (SHE) roles within the team, implementing risk reduction measures and ensuring full compliance with GMP, GSP, and mQMS.
• Translate S&C Operations Strategy into measurable team objectives and KPIs, while optimizing manufacturing and personnel costs through performance analysis.
• Ensure supply according to long-term resource planning (12 months) and optimize the production plan in collaboration with the supply chain.
• Assume technical responsibility for compounding in reagent production and lead the Continuous Improvement Process (CIP) to increase quality and efficiency standards.
• Act as the central interface to departments like Supply Chain, R&D, and MSAT to ensure cross-functional order coordination and planning optimization.
• Monitor Quality-KPIs such as Right-First-Time (RFT) and Statistical-Process-Control (SPC), and contribute to department-wide improvements as a member of the S&C Manufacturing Rotkreuz Leadership Team. Who You Are
• You hold a higher natural science education (BSc, MSc, PhD), ideally as a Chemist, Biochemist, Process Engineer, or Materials Scientist.
• You have proven experience in employee leadership with an empathetic style and a genuine passion for coaching and empowering a diverse team in a production environment.
• You possess profound experience with GMP in highly regulated environments, a strong quality awareness, and a very good command of written and spoken German and English.
• You have strong analytical thinking skills, an understanding of complex contexts, and an interest in Shopfloor Management and data-based decision-making.
• You demonstrate excellent communication skills, high self-reflection, and the ability to represent the department’s interests effectively. Have we sparked your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your complete application documents (cover letter, CV, references, diplomas, etc.). Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Immerse yourself in the fascinating everyday working life at Roche Diagnostics surrounded by beautiful mountains, not far from the scenic Lake Zug and yet close to the cities of Zug, Zurich and Lucerne. Here, where we have been rooted for over 50 years, we develop and produce diagnostic solutions and help to find answers to health questions. The Rotkreuz site, where a wide variety of disciplines work hand in hand, is a meeting place for over 2,700 talented employees from 70 different nations. Our campus invites people to work together, be creative and realise their full potential. We believe that a positive work environment, employee satisfaction, inclusion and sustainability are key to growing together and improving the lives of patients around the world. Welcome to Roche in Rotkreuz. Embark on a transformative learning experience with Roche Diagnostics in Rotkreuz. Designed to nurture emerging talent, this program offers a dynamic and immersive opportunity to gain hands-on experience in the field of diagnostics, fostering personal and professional growth. The Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) team within Sensor and Cartridge Operations ensures the efficient and high-quality production of electrochemical sensors and cartridges, reagents and fluid packs by bridging the gap between product development and full-scale manufacturing. The Opportunity
• You transform raw manufacturing data into actionable intelligence to ensure high-quality product consumable assemblies.
• Your role involves evaluating and deploying a microscopy-based optical stage to inspect and analyze product components.
• You apply Machine Learning algorithms for automated feature extraction and classification to establish accept/reject criteria before final assembly.
• Data analysis guides your work as you leverage classical statistics and predictive modeling to correlate imaging features with process parameters and quality.
• Collaboration and presentation are key as you present analytical findings to multidisciplinary teams (Operations, R&D) to drive data-backed mitigations for in-field quality issues.
• Your work focuses on a critical, high-priority product care project, solving real-life issues that occur at the customer site to bring solutions to the market.
• The position offers a supportive culture with professional growth, mentorship, and a modern work-life balance including on-site perks and work-from-home options. Who You Are
• You have completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree within the last 12 months, or are currently enrolled in a Master’s program, specializing in Biomedical, Mechanical, or Process Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field.
• You are a tech-enthusiast who loves to see code come to life in physical products and has a genuine interest in how cutting-edge technology meets modern manufacturing
• You possess a strong analytical and troubleshooter mindset, acting as an independent worker who is also a dedicated team player.
• Technical expertise in Python and its ecosystem is a strength you bring to the role, alongside your proficiency in image analysis tools.
• You can leverage any additional knowledge in optics and spectroscopy, which is considered a plus for this position.
• A strong foundation in statistical data analysis ensures that you remain highly data-analysis driven in all your tasks.
• You are fluent in English, while German is a plus as it facilitates a collaborative environment within the team. Application Process •

Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. As a Territory Manager based in Coimbatore , you will play a crucial role in driving sales, Doctor Promotion, retail promotion, managing distribution networks, and executing sales promotion plans for your territory. You will ensure our products penetration in the assigned market effectively by supporting distributors, gathering market insights, and partnering with the Area Sales Manager (ASM) to achieve our business goals. The Opportunity
• Promote pharmaceutical products to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) through scientific communication, relationship building, product detailing, and ethical marketing to increase product awareness and prescriptions.
• You assist the ASM in planning for the territory by providing market environment insights to estimate yearly demand, submitting distributor-level inventory requirements, and monitoring the stock availability of promotional materials.
• You prepare and execute monthly sales promotion plans—including field activation and merchandising activities—and meticulously record expenses and sales generated to evaluate program efficacy.
• You ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the market.
• You manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones.
• You motivate distributors and dealers through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes.
• You organize distributor and dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies, and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups.
• You act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your customer visits. Who You Are
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field.
• You have proven practical experience in field sales, distribution management, or a territory management role.
• You have a strong interest in driving market growth, with a focus on relationship building, demand generation, and executing marketing strategies.
• You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Doctors, Chemist & dealer interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings.
• You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/Weekly/Monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections.
• You are comfortable with field travel within the Coimbatore territory and thrive in a structured environment where you collaborate closely with the Area Sales Manager. title: Network Analyst - Global Supply Chain Planning

titleByLocale.it: Network Analista - Global Supply Chain Planning
titleByLocale.en: Network Analyst - Global Supply Chain Planning
titleByLocale.fr: Network Analyste - Global Chaîne d'approvisionnement Planning

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche Diagnostics, our mission is clear: we deliver answers to patients. We ensure our complex portfolio of life-saving diagnostic products is delivered to customers efficiently, on time, and complete. Achieving this requires a world-class, resilient global supply chain. As a Network Analyst , you won't just maintain a system—you will be the architect of its optimization. This is a unique, high-impact fixed-term opportunity running through December 2028 , designed for a forward-thinking supply chain professional looking to lead massive digital transformations on a global stage. The Opportunity Operating within our global 3-hub matrix network, you will drive the continuous evolution of a flexible and resilient end-to-end supply chain. You will wear two critical hats: serving as the Technical Expert managing complex, cloud-based network optimizers, and acting as the Agile Product Owner for a cross-functional data product team. If you want to spend the next few years working with absolute state-of-the-art technology to build a resume-defining portfolio, this is your sandbox. Your Impact
• Network Optimization: Drive the end-to-end configuration of our multi-hub global network. You’ll manage and fine-tune complex, parameter-heavy cloud solvers (OMP) to make data-driven decisions on shipping routes, transport modes, replenishment quantities, and global safety stocks.
• Agile Product Ownership: Lead a global, cross-functional data product team as Product Owner. Utilizing agile methodologies and Data Mesh principles, you will design and deliver complex analytics solutions that provide real value to the business.
• Data Automation & Governance: Build an unshakeable master data foundation. You will pioneer automation solutions across systems, driving data quality and implementing robust data governance frameworks.
• Technological Innovation: Stay at the absolute cutting edge. You will integrate mathematical and heuristic optimization logics, advanced solvers, and modern data tech into our daily operations.
• Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as a core consultant and Subject Matter Expert (SME). You will bridge the gap between technical data teams and senior leadership, leading global initiatives that align with Roche’s strategic priorities. Who You Are
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Analytics, Operations Research, or a related field.
• You bring 3+ years of experience in supply chain planning, network optimization, or data analytics with a distinct international focus.
• You possess strong, data-driven decision-making capabilities and thrive when turning complex, chaotic data into elegant supply chain solutions. Preferred Technical Toolkit
• Planning Suites: Deep proficiency with integrated planning suites like OMP (including its data and optimization modules) and a strong working knowledge of SAP ERP.
• Data Quality & Automation: Experience with master data automation tools (e.g., OMP Data Genie, ADM rules) and data quality platforms like Ataccama.
• Analytics & ETL: Solid know-how in data preparation, ETL, and visualization using platforms like Snowflake, Alteryx, and Tableau, alongside SAP analytics environments (SAC, BoA, BW). Relocation benefits are not available for this posting The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Indianapolis, IN is $78,900 - $146,500. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location,

• The capability to multitask and handle complex cases

descriptionByLocale.it:
La posizione Chi siamo Global Product Strategy (GPS) guida la strategia di Roche e il portafoglio di prodotti - dalla ricerca e sviluppo fino ai pazienti. Come membro del GPS, sarete parte di un gruppo veramente internazionale che collabora con funzioni e affiliati in tutto il mondo, attraverso l'impresa Roche, per plasmare il futuro della medicina. In qualità di Responsabile Area Terapeutica Globale (TAH), Neurologia, Immunologia e Malattie Infettive, guiderai team multidisciplinari su larga scala, composti da rapporti diretti e indiretti, con notevole influenza sulle prestazioni strategiche, finanziarie e operative dell’azienda. Potrai dirigere direttamente un team di leader senior che sono responsabili per il coordinamento e la gestione della pipeline precoce e del ciclo di vita dei prodotti in fase avanzata e sul mercato; fornire leadership globale, interfunzionale per tutte le attività di sviluppo, tecnico e commerciale per tutte le molecole / prodotti in Neurologia, Immunologia e Malattie Infettive. Sarete un membro in piedi del GPS Leadership Team e dare contributi significativi alla visione a lungo raggio, strategia e piani per GPS e Roche Pharma generale. Sarete una co-presidente per i comitati di governance dell'Area Terapeutica (TA) pertinenti (commissioni di business e sviluppo / riunioni TAH) e un membro in piedi di vari comitati decisionali globali, come il Comitato Portfolio di Late-Stage (LSPC). Chi sei
• Stiamo cercando un leader con attributi VACC (Visionaire, Architetto, Coach, Catalyst) che si impegna per i nostri nuovi modi di lavorare. Sei autentico e consapevole di te stesso, appassionato del grande quadro, della scienza all'avanguardia e del raggiungimento dei risultati, creando un ambiente diversificato e inclusivo che esalta il meglio della gente. Principali responsabilità In questa posizione, sarai principalmente responsabile per in modo efficace: - Definire, impostare, allineare e supervisionare l'implementazione/adozione della visione a lungo raggio e della strategia globale per le diverse aree terapeutiche della neurologia e dell'immunologia. - Sviluppo e realizzazione di una visione robusta, integrata e coesa e Piano Strategico Area terapeutica, che comprende singole strategie globali di pipeline, area malattia e ciclo di vita (comprese le soluzioni integrate, se del caso), per tutte le aree di attività/indicazioni/disease in Neurologia, Immunologia e Malattie Infettive. - Ottimizzazione dell'allocazione delle risorse per garantire il portafoglio strategico e i risultati finanziari sono raggiunti, sia all'interno di Neurologia e Immunologia che attraverso GPS. - Garantire rigorose valutazioni commerciali dei risultati della Fase I – III e fornire approfondimenti di esperti, opzioni strategiche e raccomandazioni ai comitati executive e Portfolio Strategici relativi alle attività terapeutiche e al loro potenziale di mercato. - Catalyzing Lifecycle Teams (LCT), Disease Area Strategy Teams (DAT), Commercialization Leadership Teams (CLT), e Integrated Development and Commercialization Planning (IDCP) Teams, per coordinare le attività attraverso Roche per assicurare l'allineamento globale e affiliato. - Assicurare che i team di Neurologia e Immunologia forniscano una guida di asset leadership, approfondimenti commerciali rilevanti e un rigoroso supporto analitico per le licenze e altre attività di sviluppo aziendale. - Contabile per collaborare con i leader del team Portfolio di Immunology Pharma (IPPT) e del team di neurologia Pharma (NPPT) per garantire la realizzazione delle nostre strategie TA e DA, tra cui sostenere considerazioni strategiche di portafoglio, valutazioni di opportunità e trade-off, promuovendo la collaborazione e la comunità TA end-to-end. - Co-chair Business and Development Boards e TAH meeting per garantire un asset e un processo decisionale a livello di programma robusto e rigoroso. In qualità di co-presidente attraverso i Bordi di Sviluppo e Business, il TAH svolge un ruolo vitale nel sterzare le attività attraverso il loro ciclo di vita end-to-end attraverso il collegamento di esecuzione tecnica con la strategia commerciale. Nella scheda di sviluppo, si assicura che i programmi soddisfino i criteri "Bar". A
descriptionByLocale.en:
The Position Who We Are Global Product Strategy (GPS) drives Roche’s strategy and portfolio of products - from research and development through to patients. As a member of GPS, you will be part of a truly international group that collaborates with functions and affiliates worldwide, across the Roche enterprise, to shape the future of medicine. As the Global Therapeutic Area Head (TAH), Neurology, Immunology and Infectious Diseases, you will lead large-scale, multidisciplinary teams, composed of direct and indirect reports, with considerable influence on the company’s overall strategic, financial and operational performance. You will directly lead a team of senior leaders who are accountable for coordinating and managing the early pipeline and the lifecycle of late-stage and on-market products; providing global, cross-functional leadership for all development, technical, and commercial activities for all molecules/products across Neurology, Immunology and Infectious Diseases. You will be a standing member of the GPS Leadership Team and make significant contributions to the long-range vision, strategy and plans for GPS and Roche Pharma overall. You will be a co-chair for relevant Therapeutic Area (TA) governance boards (business and development boards / TAH meetings) and a standing member of various global decision-making committees, such as the Late-Stage Portfolio Committee (LSPC). Who You Are We're looking for a leader with VACC attributes (Visionaire, Architect, Coach, Catalyst) who is committed to our new ways of working. You're authentic and self-aware, passionate about the big picture, cutting-edge science and achieving results while creating a diverse and inclusive environment that brings out the best in the people. Key Responsibilities In this position, you will be primarily accountable for effectively:
• Defining, setting, aligning and overseeing implementation/adoption of the long-range vision and global strategy for the diverse therapeutic areas of Neurology and Immunology.
• Leading development and execution of a robust, integrated and cohesive vision and Therapeutic Area Strategic Plan, which includes individual global pipeline, disease area and lifecycle strategies and plans (including integrated solutions, if appropriate), for all assets/indications/disease areas across Neurology, Immunology and Infectious Diseases.
• Optimizing resource allocation to ensure strategic portfolio and financial outcomes are achieved, both within Neurology and Immunology and across GPS.
• Ensuring rigorous commercial assessments of Phase I – III results and provision of expert insights, strategic options and recommendations to executives and Strategic Portfolio Committees regarding therapeutic area assets and their market potential.
• Catalyzing Lifecycle Teams (LCTs), Disease Area Strategy Teams (DATs), Commercialization Leadership Teams (CLTs), and Integrated Development and Commercialization Planning (IDCP) Teams, to coordinate activities across Roche to assure global and affiliate alignment.
• Ensuring Neurology and Immunology teams provide asset leadership guidance, relevant commercial insights and rigorous analytical support for licensing and other business development activities.
• Accountable for partnering with the Immunology Pharma Portfolio Team (IPPT) and Neurology Pharma Portfolio Team (NPPT) leaders to ensure the realisation of our TA and DA strategies including supporting strategic portfolio considerations, opportunity assessments, and trade-offs, while fostering end-to-end TA collaboration and community.
• Co-chair Business and Development Boards and TAH meetings to ensure robust and rigorous asset and program level decision making. As a co-chair across the Development and Business Boards, the TAH plays a vital role in steering assets through their end-to-end lifecycle by bridging technical execution with commercial strategy. At the development board, you ensure programs meet the "Bar" criteria. A
descriptionByLocale.de: Die Position Wer wir sind Die globale Produktstrategie (GPS) treibt die Strategie und das Produktportfolio von Roche – von Forschung und Entwicklung bis hin zu Patienten. Als Mitglied von GPS, Sie werden Teil einer wirklich internationalen Gruppe, die mit Funktionen und Tochtergesellschaften weltweit, über das Roche-Unternehmen zusammenarbeiten, um die Zukunft der Medizin zu gestalten. Als Global Therapeutic Area Head (TAH), Neurologie, Immunologie und Infektionskrankheiten führen Sie groß angelegte, multidisziplinäre Teams, die aus direkten und indirekten Berichten bestehen, mit erheblichem Einfluss auf die allgemeine strategische, finanzielle und operative Leistung des Unternehmens. Sie leiten direkt ein Team von führenden Führungskräften, die für die Koordination und Verwaltung der frühen Pipeline und den Lebenszyklus von latenten und auf dem Markt verantwortlich sind; bieten globale, funktionsübergreifende Führung für alle Entwicklung, technische und kommerzielle Aktivitäten für alle Moleküle/Produkte in der Neurologie, Immunologie und Infektionskrankheiten. Sie werden ein stehendes Mitglied des GPS Leadership Teams sein und maßgebliche Beiträge zur Weitsicht, Strategie und Pläne für GPS und Roche Pharma insgesamt leisten. Sie sind Co-Vorsitzender für relevante Therapeutic Area (TA) Governance Boards (Geschäfts- und Entwicklungsboards / TAH-Meetings) und ein ständiges Mitglied verschiedener globaler Entscheidungsgremien wie dem Late-Stage Portfolio Committee (LSPC). Wer bist du? Wir suchen einen Führer mit VACC-Attributen (Visionaire, Architekt, Coach, Catalyst), die sich unserer neuen Arbeitsweise verpflichtet. Sie sind authentisch und selbstbewusst, leidenschaftlich über das große Bild, innovative Wissenschaft und Ergebnisse zu erzielen, während eine vielfältige und integrative Umgebung zu schaffen, die das Beste in den Menschen bringt. Hauptverantwortlichkeiten In dieser Position sind Sie in erster Linie für effektiv verantwortlich: - Definieren, Einstellen, Ausrichten und Übersehen der Umsetzung/Annahme der langfristigen Vision und der globalen Strategie für die vielfältigen therapeutischen Bereiche der Neurologie und Immunologie. - Führende Entwicklung und Durchführung einer robusten, integrierten und zusammenhängenden Vision und Therapeutic Area Strategic Plan, die individuelle globale Pipeline-, Krankheits- und Lebenszyklusstrategien und -pläne (einschließlich integrierter Lösungen, gegebenenfalls) für alle Assets/Indications/Disease-Bereiche in der Neurologie, Immunologie und Infektionskrankheiten umfasst. - Optimierung der Ressourcenzuweisung, um ein strategisches Portfolio und finanzielle Ergebnisse zu gewährleisten, sowohl innerhalb der Neurologie als auch im Bereich der Immunologie und des GPS. - Sicherstellung strenger kommerzieller Bewertungen der Phase I – III Ergebnisse und Bereitstellung von fachkundigen Erkenntnissen, strategischen Optionen und Empfehlungen an Führungskräfte und Strategische Portfolio-Komitees in Bezug auf therapeutische Flächenaktiva und ihr Marktpotenzial. - Catalyzing Lifecycle Teams (LCTs), Disease Area Strategy Teams (DATs), Commercialization Leadership Teams (CLTs) und Integrated Development and Commercialization Planning (IDCP) Teams, um Aktivitäten über Roche zu koordinieren, um eine globale und assoziierte Ausrichtung zu gewährleisten. - Die Teams für Neurologie und Immunologie sorgen für Asset-Führung, relevante kommerzielle Erkenntnisse und strenge analytische Unterstützung für Lizenzierung und andere Geschäftsentwicklungsaktivitäten. - Verantwortlich für die Zusammenarbeit mit dem Immunology Pharma Portfolio Team (IPPT) und dem Neurology Pharma Portfolio Team (NPPT) Führungskräften, um die Umsetzung unserer TA- und DA-Strategien zu gewährleisten, einschließlich der Unterstützung strategischer Portfoliobetrachtungen, Gelegenheitsbeurteilungen und Trade-offs, und gleichzeitig die Förderung einer end-to-end TA-Kollaboration und -Community. - Co-Vorsitzende Geschäfts- und Entwicklungsräte und TAH-Meetings, um eine robuste und strenge Entscheidungsfindung im Bereich Asset und Programmebene zu gewährleisten. Als Co-Vorsitzender in den Entwicklungs- und Wirtschaftsräten spielt die TAH eine wichtige Rolle bei der Steuerung von Vermögenswerten durch ihren End-to-End-Lebenszyklus, indem sie technische Ausführung mit kommerzieller Strategie überbrücken. Im Entwicklungsboard stellen Sie sicher, dass Programme die Kriterien "Bar" erfüllen. A
descriptionByLocale.fr: La position Qui nous sommes La stratégie mondiale des produits (GPS) stimule la stratégie Roches et son portefeuille de produits - de la recherche et du développement jusqu'aux patients. En tant que membre du GPS, vous ferez partie d'un groupe véritablement international qui collabore avec des fonctions et des affiliés dans le monde entier, à travers l'entreprise Roche, pour façonner l'avenir de la médecine. En tant que Responsable du Secteur Thérapeutique Mondial (TAH), Neurologie, Immunologie et Maladies Infectieuses, vous dirigerez des équipes multidisciplinaires à grande échelle, composées de rapports directs et indirects, avec une influence considérable sur la performance globale stratégique, financière et opérationnelle de l'entreprise. Vous dirigerez directement une équipe de cadres supérieurs responsables de la coordination et de la gestion du pipeline précoce et du cycle de vie des produits en retard et sur le marché; fournirez un leadership mondial et interfonctionnel pour toutes les activités de développement, techniques et commerciales de toutes les molécules/produits de la neurologie, de l'immunologie et des maladies infectieuses. Vous serez un membre permanent de l'équipe de leadership du GPS et apporterez une contribution importante à la vision, à la stratégie et aux plans à long terme du GPS et de Roche Pharma. Vous serez coprésident des conseils de gouvernance des domaines thérapeutiques pertinents (conseils d'affaires et de développement/réunions des TAH) et membre permanent de divers comités décisionnels mondiaux, comme le Comité du portefeuille en fin d'étape. Qui vous êtes Nous sommes à la recherche d'un leader avec des attributs VACC (Visionaire, Architecte, Coach, Catalyst) qui est engagé dans nos nouvelles façons de travailler. Vous êtes authentique et conscient de vous-même, passionné par la vision d'ensemble, la science de pointe et l'obtention de résultats tout en créant un environnement diversifié et inclusif qui fait ressortir le meilleur des gens. Principales responsabilités Dans ce poste, vous serez principalement responsable : - Définir, mettre en place, aligner et superviser la mise en œuvre/l'adoption de la vision à long terme et de la stratégie globale dans les divers domaines thérapeutiques de la neurologie et de l'immunologie. - Diriger l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre d'une vision solide, intégrée et cohérente et d'un plan stratégique sur les domaines thérapeutiques, qui comprend des stratégies et des plans globaux individuels sur les domaines de la maladie et du cycle de vie (y compris des solutions intégrées, s'il y a lieu) pour tous les biens, les indicateurs et les maladies de la neurologie, de l'immunologie et des maladies infectieuses. - Optimiser l'allocation des ressources pour s'assurer que le portefeuille stratégique et les résultats financiers sont atteints, tant au sein de la neurologie et de l'immunologie que dans l'ensemble du GPS. - Assurer des évaluations commerciales rigoureuses des résultats de la Phase I – III et fournir aux cadres supérieurs et aux comités du portefeuille stratégique des connaissances spécialisées, des options stratégiques et des recommandations concernant les actifs thérapeutiques et leur potentiel commercial. - Catalyser les équipes de cycle de vie (ELD), les équipes de stratégie des régions de maladies (EAD), les équipes de leadership en commercialisation (ELD) et les équipes de planification intégrée du développement et de la commercialisation (PDIC) afin de coordonner les activités dans l'ensemble de Roche afin d'assurer l'alignement des activités à l'échelle mondiale et des filiales. - Veiller à ce que les équipes de neurologie et d'immunologie fournissent des conseils sur le leadership des actifs, des renseignements commerciaux pertinents et un soutien analytique rigoureux pour les licences et autres activités de développement des entreprises. - Responsable du partenariat avec l'équipe de portefeuille d'Immunology Pharma (IPPT) et les chefs de file de l'équipe de portefeuille de Neurology Pharma (NPPT) pour assurer la réalisation de nos stratégies d'AT et d'AD, y compris l'appui à des considérations stratégiques de portefeuille, des évaluations des possibilités et des compromis, tout en favorisant la collaboration et la communauté d'AT de bout en bout. - Coprésider les conseils d'affaires et de développement et les réunions du TAH pour assurer une prise de décision solide et rigoureuse au niveau des biens et des programmes. En tant que coprésident des Conseils de développement et d'affaires, le TAH joue un rôle essentiel dans la direction des actifs tout au long de leur cycle de vie en reliant l'exécution technique à la stratégie commerciale. Au conseil de développement, vous assurez que les programmes répondent aux critères « Bar ». A

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Location: Ohio, Kentucky, Indiana and West Virginia (Ideal candidate to live south west of Cincinnati around the 71/75 corridor) Travel: 100% in assigned territory. This is an exciting time to join the Roche Support Network. If you are passionate about problem solving then this is the position for you! As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche discovers, develops and provides innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products and services that deliver significant benefits to patients and healthcare professionals - from early detection and prevention of diseases to diagnostics, treatment and treatment monitoring. Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success, and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience. The Opportunity The Roche Support Network group is committed to providing industry-defining support to its customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will have the opportunity to travel and demonstrate your expertise as a technical repair and/or installation specialist for Roche assigned product lines and provide valued service to your laboratory customers in an assigned territory. This position serves as a technical repair or installation specialist for Roche products for assigned product lines and geographies. Product Responsibility: Clinical chemistry, Immunoassay and lab automation.
• Provides routine technical support to customers on operational and maintenance aspects of system equipment.
• Performs on-site service, repair and/or installation of company product(s). This may include any aspect of field support and is not limited to mechanical/system hardware and software, networking/wireless networking.
• Serves as customer contact on routine technical and service-related problems. Receives training and delivers service within the normal scope of the position. Follows documented practices, policies and procedures in providing repair and installation support.
• Diagnoses mechanical, hardware, software and system failure, using established procedures. Determines the most cost-effective repair/resolution to minimize customer downtime.
• Provides analysis, feedback and recommendations on product failure trends and serviceability issues. Documents all activity in a manner compliant with the company's quality procedures. Specialized knowledge generally of a particular area, system or equipment. Requires specific training and certification.
• Applies some advanced skills to the position or specialization. May adapt procedures, processes, tools, equipment and techniques to meet the more complex requirements of the position. Duties are generally routine, but may include non-routine tasks.
• Resolves most questions and problems and refers only the most complex issues to higher levels.
• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions. This is a field based role. Who You Are
• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or work experience are required.
• 5 years of progressive experience in repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking is necessary. Alternatively, a Ba

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As an EHS Technician, you support the Manufacturing and R&D functions of GenMark Diagnostics across all Safety, Health, and Environmental (SHE) matters. Under general supervision, you perform technical duties including hazardous waste disposal, office ergonomics, and the maintenance of site SHE documentation. You serve as a key resource, providing safety expertise and guidance to site leadership The Opportunity
• Assisting in maintaining corporate safety standards and policies, adapting to changes, and ensuring compliance with state and federal regulations by creating and maintaining safety records, data, and files.
• Supporting the safety supervisor in implementing policies, procedures, and training, including ergonomic assessments, industrial hygiene surveys, evacuation drills, facility inspections, and handling and disposal of hazardous chemicals and medical waste.
• Coordinating, conducting, and participating in regular safety meetings, such as Emergency Response Team meetings, while managing and maintaining required documentation.
• Utilizing and updating company-specific SHE Data Management Software, Work Order systems, and Preventive Maintenance software to support safety operations efficiently.
• Assisting with incident investigations, follow-up on corrective actions, and thorough documentation of safety/environmental/equipment-related incidents.
• Developing metrics, creating data summaries, and preparing communications for leadership reporting to facilitate informed decision-making.
• Performing additional tasks as assigned, contributing to a wide range of safety and environmental health responsibilities essential to the position. Who You Are
• You bring a minimum of 1 year of experience in an EHS-specific role.
• If you have two years of college courses completed in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, Science, or another technical degree, that's preferred
• CPR, AED and First Aid Instructor Certification are preferred Behaviors, competencies, and qualities of the ideal applicant.
• Knowledge of Emergency Action and Emergency Response Plans, including recurring training and drills
• Self-directed and demonstrated ability to successfully manage multiple projects and prioritize. You are a trusted partner and can influence within a complex and collaborative organization.
• You bring technical skills with the ability to explain complex issues and requirements verbally and in writing in an easily understood manner. Proficient in computer skills.
• Interpersonal and cross-cultural skills; willingness to work flexible hours Relocation Benefits are not offered for this job posting. The expected salary range for this position, based on California is 40,200.00.- 74,600.00 USD annually. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below. Benefits Who we are GenMark is now a proud member of the Roche Group, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. As a global leader in healthcare, Roche Diagnostics offers a broad portfolio of products, tools and services that help in the prevention, diagnosis and management of diseases like HPV, HIV, hepatitis and diabetes as well as other medical conditions, such as fertility and blood coagulation.

Under general supervision, you perform technical duties including hazardous waste disposal, office ergonomics, and the maintenance of site SHE documentation. You serve as a key resource, providing safety expertise and guidance to site leadership The Opportunity
• Assisting in maintaining corporate safety standards and policies, adapting to changes, and ensuring compliance with state and federal regulations by creating and maintaining safety records, data, and files.
• Supporting the safety supervisor in implementing policies, procedures, and training, including ergonomic assessments, industrial hygiene surveys, evacuation drills, facility inspections, and handling and disposal of hazardous chemicals and medical waste.
• Coordinating, conducting, and participating in regular safety meetings, such as Emergency Response Team meetings, while managing and maintaining required documentation.
• Utilizing and updating company-specific SHE Data Management Software, Work Order systems, and Preventive Maintenance software to support safety operations efficiently.
• Assisting with incident investigations, follow-up on corrective actions, and thorough documentation of safety/environmental/equipment-related incidents.
• Developing metrics, creating data summaries, and preparing communications for leadership reporting to facilitate informed decision-making.
• Performing additional tasks as assigned, contributing to a wide range of safety and environmental health responsibilities essential to the position. Who You Are
• You bring a minimum of 1 year of experience in an EHS-specific role.
• If you have two years of college courses completed in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, Science, or another technical degree, that's preferred
• CPR, AED and First Aid Instructor Certification are preferred Behaviors, competencies, and qualities of the ideal applicant.
• Knowledge of Emergency Action and Emergency Response Plans, including recurring training and drills
• Self-directed and demonstrated ability to successfully manage multiple projects and prioritize. You are a trusted partner and can influence within a complex and collaborative organization.
• You bring technical skills with the ability to explain complex issues and requirements verbally and in writing in an easily understood manner. Proficient in computer skills.
• Interpersonal and cross-cultural skills; willingness to work flexible hours Relocation Benefits are not offered for this job posting. The expected salary range for this position, based on California is 40,200.00.- 74,600.00 USD annually. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below. Benefits Who we are GenMark is now a proud member of the Roche Group, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. As a global leader in healthcare, Roche Diagnostics offers a broad portfolio of products, tools and services that help in the prevention, diagnosis and management of diseases like HPV, HIV, hepatitis and diabetes as well as other medical conditions, such as fertility and blood coagulation.

• Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und mit Datenauswertungen ist von Vorteil

# Roche - Job Description ## Mansioni - Impacto sostenible: Contribuire a soluzioni che rispondono ai desafíos più urgenti della salute riducendo l'impatto sul pianeta. - Liderare la strategia di accesso e politiche pubbliche per il portafolio di Roche Diagnóstica nella regione di Ecuador e Perú-PEC. - Responsabilità: - Strategia di Accesso e Valor: Disegnare ed eseguire il Piano di Accesso per prodotti di alto valore medico, anticipando le tendenze del mercato per definire proposte di valore innovative che accelerino la loro adozione. - Relazione di Alto Livello e Influenza: Costruire relazioni strategiche con Leader di Opinione (KOLs), società scientifiche e autorità governative per guidare la partecipazione dell'azienda nella modifica delle politiche pubbliche e dei quadri normativi. - Mappatura degli Stakeholder e Percorso del Paziente: Sviluppare la mappatura degli attori chiave e delle istituzioni obiettivo, analizzando il percorso del paziente per identificare le priorità cliniche e le nuove opportunità di crescita. - Economia della Salute (HECON): Implementare gli strumenti di economia della salute e i modelli di costo-beneficio per posizionare strategicamente il portafolio nelle entità di salute della regione Perú e Ecuador. - Liderazgo Científico y de Opinión: Agire come il principale esperto scientifico del portafolio, diffondendo l'evidenza clinica attraverso le pubblicazioni, i pannelli di esperti e traducendo le esigenze dei pazienti e dei professionisti in strategie di business. - Collaborazione Transversale: Lavorare in sinergia con i team commerciali, di strategia e finanza per agevolare i processi di accesso e massimizzare le opportunità commerciali del portafolio. ##
• Requisiti - Professionista in Scienze della Salute, Amministrazione delle Imprese o corsi affini, con dominio avanzato del linguaggio inglese (parlato e scritto). - Più di 3 anni nell'industria farmaceutica o dell'assistenza sanitaria, guidando i ruoli di Accesso al Mercato e Politica Pubblica. - Profonda comprensione del sistema di salute peruviano-ecuadoriano, nonché la sua normativa e gli stakeholder rilevanti per l'ecosistema della salute. - Visione strategica e sistemica, con capacità dimostrate di influire e ispirare attraverso il leadership collaborativo. - Desiderabile: - Studi aggiuntivi o specializzazione in Economia della Salute e Politiche Pubbliche. - Trayectoria comprovada in metodologías ágiles y colaboración en equipos multidisciplinarios. ## Contatto I dettagli sulla trasparenza della retribuzione sono forniti sulla base della posizione di pubblicazione principale. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Quito. Se sei interessato ad altre posizioni in cui il ruolo potrebbe essere disponibile, forniamo i dettagli sulla retribuzione rilevanti durante il processo di assunzione. ## Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati a far avanzare la scienza, garantendo che tutti abbiano accesso alle cure sanitarie oggi e per le generazioni future.

Roche - Job Description Shipments - Sustenible impact: Contribute to solutions that respond to the most urgent health desafíos by reducing the impact on the planet. - Liderate the access strategy and public policies for the Roche Diagnóstica portfolio in Ecuador and Perú-PEC. - Liability: - Access strategy and Valor: Draw and execute the Access Plan for high medical value products, anticipating market trends to define innovative value proposals that accelerate their adoption. - High Level and Influence Report: Building strategic relations with Leader of Opinions (KOLs), scientific societies and government authorities to lead the company's participation in changing public policies and regulatory frameworks. - Stakeholder mapping and Patient Path: Develop key players and target institutions mapping, analyzing the patient's path to identify clinical priorities and new growth opportunities. - Health Economy (HECON): Implement health economic instruments and cost-benefit models to strategically position the oil carrier in the health entities of the Peru and Ecuador region. - Liderazgo Científico y de Opinión: Act as the leading scientific expert of the portfolio, spreading clinical evidence through publications, expert panels and translating the needs of patients and professionals into business strategies. - Transversal collaboration: Work in synergy with business teams, strategy and finance to facilitate access processes and maximize the business opportunities of the portfolio.
• Requirements - Professional in Health Sciences, Business Administration or related courses, with advanced English language domain (speaking and written). - More than 3 years in the pharmaceutical industry or healthcare industry, leading the roles of Market Access and Public Policy. - Deep understanding of the Peruvian- Ecuadorian health system as well as its legislation and stakeholders relevant to the health ecosystem. - Strategic and systemic vision, with proven ability to influence and inspire through collaborative leadership. - Undesirable: - Additional studies or specialization in Economics of Health and Public Policies. - Trayectoria compromise in methodlogías ágiles y colaboración en equipos multidisciplinaryrios. Contact Details on the transparency of pay are provided on the basis of the main publication position. For this role, the main position is Quito. descriptionByLocale.de:
Roche - Job Beschreibung Sendungen - Sustenible Auswirkungen: Tragen Sie auf Lösungen, die auf die dringendsten gesundheitlichen Desafíos reagieren, indem Sie die Auswirkungen auf den Planeten reduzieren. - Legen Sie die Zugangsstrategie und die öffentlichen Richtlinien für das Portfolio von Roche Diagnóstica in Ecuador und Perú-PEC fest. - Haftung: - Access-Strategie und Valor: Zeichnen und führen Sie den Access Plan für hochwertige Medizinprodukte aus, wobei die Markttrends vorweggenommen werden, um innovative Wertschöpfungsvorschläge zu definieren, die ihre Annahme beschleunigen. - Hochrangiger und einflussreicher Bericht: Aufbau strategischer Beziehungen mit dem Führer der Meinungen (KOL), wissenschaftlichen Gesellschaften und Behörden des Staates, um die Beteiligung des Unternehmens an den sich ändernden öffentlichen Politiken und regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen zu leiten. - Stakeholder Mapping und Patient Path: Entwickeln Sie Schlüsselakteure und Zieleinrichtungen Mapping, analysieren Sie den Weg des Patienten, um klinische Prioritäten und neue Wachstumsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren. - Health Economy (HECON): Umsetzung von gesundheitsökonomischen Instrumenten und Kosten-Nutzen-Modellen, um den Ölträger in den Gesundheitseinrichtungen der Region Peru und Ecuador strategisch zu positionieren. - Liderazgo Científico y de Opinión: Act als führender wissenschaftlicher Experte des Portfolios, Verbreitung von klinischen Beweisen durch Veröffentlichungen, Expertenpanels und Übersetzen der Bedürfnisse von Patienten und Profis in Geschäftsstrategien. - Transversale Zusammenarbeit: Arbeiten Sie in Synergie mit Geschäftsteams, Strategie und Finanzen, um Zugriffsprozesse zu erleichtern und die Geschäftsmöglichkeiten des Portfolios zu maximieren.
• Anforderungen - Professur für Gesundheitswissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder verwandte Kurse, mit fortgeschrittener englischer Sprache (sprechend und geschrieben). - Mehr als 3 Jahre in der pharmazeutischen Industrie oder im Gesundheitswesen, was die Rollen des Marktzugangs und der öffentlichen Politik anführt. - Ein tiefes Verständnis des peruanischen und ecuadorianischen Gesundheitssystems sowie seiner für das Gesundheitsökosystem relevanten Rechtsvorschriften und Interessenvertreter. - Strategische und systemische Vision, mit bewährter Fähigkeit, durch kollaborative Führung zu beeinflussen und zu inspirieren. - Unerwünscht: - Zusätzliche Studien oder Spezialisierung in der Wirtschaft der Gesundheit und der öffentlichen Politik. - Trayectoria Kompromiss in methodlogías ágiles y colaboración en stattos multidisziplinaryrios. Kontakt Einzelheiten über die Transparenz des Entgelts werden auf der Grundlage der wichtigsten Veröffentlichungsposition angegeben. Für diese Rolle ist die Hauptposition Quito. Wenn Sie an anderen Stellen interessiert sind, in denen die Rolle zur Verfügung stehen könnte, geben wir Ihnen während des Rekrutierungsprozesses Angaben über die entsprechende Bezahlung. Wer sind wir? Eine gesündere Zukunft führt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft und stellen sicher, dass jeder heute und für zukünftige Generationen Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Data Steward Lead Roche India - Roche Services & Solutions Hyderabad A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement (GP) is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next. The Opportunity This role sits within the Enablement Chapter, in Global Procurement Analytics & Insights, where we drive operational and financial effectiveness by delivering trusted data, actionable insights, stronger performance management, and robust decision support for GP leadership and chapters. As Data Steward Lead , you will play a senior role in shaping how Global Procurement defines, governs, documents, validates, and uses its critical data products. You will act as the data stewardship lead for priority procurement data products, ensuring that business definitions, metadata, lineage, data quality expectations, ownership, access requirements, and usage guidance are clear, trusted, and consistently applied. You will work closely with procurement, finance, governance, informatics, data engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders to improve trust in critical metrics such as spend, savings, supplier, category, contract, and sustainability data. This is a senior stewardship and data product governance role. You will connect business meaning with technical implementation, helping ensure that data products are not only built, but also understandable, reusable, well-governed, and fit for decision-making. Responsibilities include
• Leading data stewardship for priority Global Procurement data products, including business definitions, metric logic, ownership, metadata, lineage, data quality expectations, and approved usage.
• Defining and maintaining data product standards and data product contracts, including product purpose, data grain, source dependencies, business rules, ownership, service expectations, and release-readiness criteria.
• Partnering with business owners and domain experts to resolve conflicting metric definitions and align on certified business logic for critical procurement data products.
• Working with data engineering teams to translate business rules into governed data products using modern data platforms and tools such as Snowflake, dbt, GitLab, and related data engineering practices.
• Ensuring that production-grade data products are properly documented and registered in enterprise cataloging tools such as Collibra, including technical metadata, business glossary terms, ownership, stewardship, and lineage.
• Supporting data access and policy alignment in partnership with governance, informatics, and security teams, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Immuta-enabled policy controls, masking requirements, and Personally Identifiable Information (PII) handling where applicable.
• Leading data quality issue triage for critical data products by identifying root causes, coordinating resolution, tracking open risks, and esca

The Opportunity: This role sits within the Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution. The Delivery group comprises many communities grouping categories of the same value chain or having commonality. The communities are key enablers of strong category expertise while allowing flexibility in the procurement delivery response to the evolving needs of our customers. As a Procurement Specialist in Direct Materials, you will bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Applying both general procurement and specialized knowledge or expertise in a specific commodity or spend area, you will ensure effective and efficient delivery of core procurement services and continuous improvement of automation and content availability. You will collaborate closely with internal procurement (i.e. Chapters and capability areas such as customer relationship management, contracting, solutions, analytics, etc.) and business stakeholders to translate business needs into sourcing and spend management activities and content enhancement. You will work closely with other team members to support customer demand, improve the customer buying experience, deliver on day-to day operational activities, and provide capacity and expertise to deliver productivity and other customer oriented projects/solutions. As a Delivery Specialist, you will play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and general business requirements, including but not limited to:
• You are a Category and sourcing subject matter specialist in Direct Materials, conducting market and internal analysis to develop strategies and tactical plans for how Roche should source and negotiate for third party goods and services in order to satisfy stakeholder requirements.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position This role is based in Roche Services Americas, one of our worldwide Shared Services Centers providing Finance and Procurement services to various countries in the Americas region. As the Record to Report (R2R) CRM SME , you will be based in San José, Costa Rica, reporting to the Cluster Section Lead CRM NALA. The Opportunity: In this specialized role, you will be responsible for executing high-level AR operational activities and serving as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for our systems and processes. Your focus will be on maintaining technical excellence and driving regional process harmonization. Your responsibilities include:
• SME Leadership: Maintain deep knowledge of accounts receivable processes, flows, and systems. Serve as the technical expert for "AS IS" processes during global project implementations.
• Operational Execution: Coordinate and perform complete, stringent, and timely financial tasks including bank reconciliation, cash application, and clearing of AR/bank suspense accounts.
• Process Improvement: Propose and coordinate system enhancements, sharing best practices from global organizations and following through on implementations.
• Credit & Data Management: Execute Customer Credit Analysis, manage dispute resolutions, and maintain customer credit master data.
• Project Coordination: Support the resolution of gaps found during project rollouts, coordinating testing and documentation to ensure seamless transitions.
• Training & Mentorship: Maintain a training network to ensure knowledge flows across the organization, providing functional guidance to team members.
• Stakeholder Communication: Handle incoming inquiries via calls and emails with a focus on customer service, and facilitate cross-functional communication to resolve complex issues. Who you are:
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Project Management or Engineering.
• You bring 5+ years of finance and accounting experience, with a deep understanding of R2R and AR process flows.
• You are characterized by a high level of social competence and are fluent in both English and Spanish ; Portuguese is a plus.
• You possess strong technical expertise in Finance Shared Services systems such as SAP, BlackLine, and SNOW . SAP FS-CM and Power BI a plus.
• You are an expert at organizing tasks with limited direction and managing multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
• You are well known for your independent, yet collaborative working style and your ability to act as a technical bridge between local teams and global projects. Preferred:
• Advanced knowledge of computerized environments (Excel, G-Suite, PowerPoint, Power BI) for data analysis.
• Demonstrated experience in project testing and documentation (UAT) within a Shared Service Center environment. Relocation benefits are not available for this posting. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer

The Position Technical Manager - Regional Customer Support Centre Are you looking for an exciting challenge? Are you ready to lead a specialist team in delivering world-class diagnostic support across the UK, Ireland and Northern Europe? Roche Diagnostics is looking for a Technical Manager to lead our SWA/Core Lab Hardware remote support team. Based within our Regional Customer Support Centre (RCSC) in Burgess Hill, you will be the strategic lead for a team of 16 specialists providing critical technical and systems support for the Roche Core Laboratory portfolio. The Role As Technical Manager, you will lead a team of 16 specialists who provide remote technical and systems support for the Roche Core Laboratory portfolio, alongside customer and staff training. You will be the driving force behind the team’s operational and strategic success, ensuring we deliver a "best-in-class" customer experience. You will be accountable for the successful delivery of service requirements across the UK, Ireland, Nordics and the wider EMEA-LATAM region. Key Responsibilities:
• Leadership & Coaching: Use your skills to empower your team, remove obstacles and foster high performance.
• Line Management: Drive recruitment of ideal skill sets, manage performance and take ownership of the team's professional development.
• Strategic Collaboration: Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Regional Service Managers to ensure the technical service offering aligns with broader business goals.
• Operational Excellence: Oversee the delivery of high-value remote support and the implementation of Roche Global standards. Location & Flexibility This is an office based role with an expectation of a minimum of 2 days a week in our office in Burgess Hill, Sussex. Who you are You are a resilient leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment. You don’t just manage tasks; you inspire innovation and possess a "questioning" approach that challenges the status quo to exceed customer expectations. Essential Requirements:
• Education: A degree in a relevant field OR a proven track record of technical mastery and leadership in an engineering environment.
• Experience: A minimum of 3 years experience of leading technical teams
• Technical Background: A proven track record of supporting complex healthcare instrumentation and/or deep experience within a Blood Sciences laboratory.
• Leadership: Proven experience in line management or a clear ability to demonstrate the leadership competencies required to coach and develop a high-performing team.
• Technical Proficiency: Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office, Google Suite, and CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce).
• Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders in a matrix environment.
• IT Literacy: Strong digital skills, including Microsoft/Google Suite and CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce). Investing in you Roche is a company that invests as much in its people as it does in R&D (over £6.5 billion worldwide). descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. The Position Como Process Owner - Administrative Engagement Services , serás responsable de gestionar y optimizar los procesos administrativos de la célula de Engagement, la cual centraliza el soporte para las interacciones de Roche con actores clave del sector salud (profesionales, organizaciones, programas de pacientes y donaciones). En este rol, actuarás como guardián del cumplimiento normativo y líder de mejora continua, asegurando que cada contrato, pago o colaboración se ejecute con excelencia operativa y bajo los más altos estándares éticos. The Opportunity
• Liderar proyectos de optimización, simplificación y automatización de procesos para mejorar los tiempos de respuesta y la eficiencia operativa.
• Actuar como experto (SME) orientando a los stakeholders internos y externos en la ejecución correcta de interacciones con actores del sector salud.
• Negociar y monitorear los Acuerdos de Nivel de Servicio (SLAs) con los clientes internos para alinear expectativas y capacidad de respuesta.
• Gestionar el equipo de soporte transaccional y personal externo en el procesamiento de contratos, órdenes de compra y documentos de estudios clínicos o donaciones.
• Definir y mantener actualizadas las políticas y procedimientos del área buscando la estandarización de los servicios bajo estándares de cumplimiento.
• Implementar métricas y KPIs para evaluar la capacidad del equipo y realizar análisis de datos que apoyen la toma de decisiones estratégicas.
• Aplicar principios de metodologías ágiles (Scrum y Lean Management) para gestionar el backlog de solicitudes y facilitar reuniones de seguimiento. Who you are
• Profesional en Ingeniería Industrial (preferiblemente), Ingeniería Química, Química Farmacéutica o Administración de Empresas.
• Experiencia mínima de 2 a 4 años en gestión de procesos administrativos, centros de servicios compartidos (SSC), optimización de procesos o gestión de proyectos.
• Experiencia previa en la industria farmacéutica o sector salud (preferible).
• Dominio del idioma inglés a nivel avanzado (B2-C1) para interactuar en un entorno multinacional.
