descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position En Roche Bolivia nos encontramos en búsqueda de un/a Patient Journey Partner (PJP) para el área terapéutica de Oncología idealmente basado en Santa Cruz, Bolivia , quien es un líder empoderado y referente de contacto local con Roche, que se vincula con todos los actores del ecosistema de salud involucrados directamente a la jornada del paciente (en determinadas áreas de enfermedades o terapéuticas), de manera de co-crear soluciones significativas para su mejora, conectando con las capacidades que todo Roche puede disponer para ello. La oportunidad:
• Siendo un aliado confiable y punto de contacto primario (pero no exclusivo), se conecta con todos los actores involucrados en la jornada del paciente, buscando identificar las oportunidades para mejorarla lo más efectiva y rápidamente posible. Para lograrlo, además conecta y pone a disposición del ecosistema toda la capacidad, la ciencia y el conocimiento del que Roche dispone.
• Al velar por la jornada del paciente en su totalidad, el/la PJP actúa como un pensador sistémico, con la capacidad de identificar un propósito compartido entre las partes interesadas y para co-crear soluciones en el ecosistema.
• En alianza con todos los actores que participan en la jornada del paciente (incluidos los pacientes), busca remover barreras y desbloquear oportunidades para ofrecer soluciones valiosas a los pacientes y a la comunidad.
• Comparte internamente las necesidades de los pacientes y los actores directamente vinculados, prioriza, asegura recursos y desarrolla soluciones que busquen mejorar los resultados lo más pronto posible.
• Vela por el uso apropiado de los productos de Roche a lo largo de todo su ciclo de vida, lo que incluye entre otros, compartir información al respecto con profesionales de la salud en una forma veraz y balanceada.
• Está facultado para disponer de recursos a nivel local y de la red según sea necesario, incluida la colaboración con otros PJP y HSP.
• Busca garantizar una excelente experiencia, cada vez que las partes interesadas se relacionen con los empleados, los productos y los servicios de Roche.
• Como empleado de Roche, comprende y respeta todas las políticas, programas, procedimientos e instrucciones relacionados a SHE, farmacovigilancia y compliance (esto incluye reportar incidentes e informar a quien sea apropiado en cada situación). Quién eres
• Grado universitario (ciencias, economía o negocios) es altamente deseable. Un grado avanzado en ciencias de la vida y / o MBA es valorado.
• Experiencia y conocimiento en el mercado de enfermedades raras, hematología y/o neurología del país.
• Experiencia comercial, representación y/o visita médica, líder de cuentas claves entre otras.
• Profundo conocimiento de la jornada del paciente y procedimientos médicos relacionados en determinada área de enfermedad, que permita el relacionamiento con especialistas en el tema.
• Robusto conocimiento de estrategias y tácticas de asuntos médicos, incluyendo investigación clínica.
• Se requiere excelentes habilidades de relacionamiento con las partes interesadas, incluidos expertos del área terapéutica de oftalmología y organizaciones relacionadas. Es altamente deseable experiencia en trabajo conjunto con agrupaciones de pacientes. Sólida base y visión de negocio, con conocimientos en asuntos médicos, asuntos comerciales y experiencia del cliente.
• Se requiere experiencia en el liderazgo de equipos multifuncionales. Es muy deseable tener experiencia tanto en la formulación de estrategias mu

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow. Roche is strongly committed to an inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing inclusion and belonging enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients. The Strategic Quality Partner acts as a single point of contact within project teams (New product development / Product Change) for a portfolio of products assigned to them. The SQP leads and drives for decisions for strategic topics from a compliance and product quality perspective. The SQP partners with internal and external stakeholders across the value chain to accelerate the development process and incorporate learnings. Stakeholders include, but are not limited to Development Leads, Project Leaders, Regulatory Affairs, Operations, Global Customer Support, and Post-Market Quality. The Opportunity
• Ensure consistent interpretation & implementation of global requirements across Customer Areas (CAs)
• Incorporate lessons learned from all areas of quality across Customer Areas (CA) into project support and ensure PostMarket Quality feedback is built into the requirements
• Ensure development project plans contain the right deliverables according to the Design & Development module to deliver safe and compliant solutions
• Support internal and external audits
• Lead and facilitate constructive discussions e.g. at project team meetings
• Drive awareness and adoption of the Risk Enabler inside and outside of Global Quality & Regulatory decision making; prepare and enable risk-based decisions
• Partner to ensure effective resolution of issues (e.g. CAPA, NC)
• Ensure effective feedback loops and information flow for milestone review. Who You Are
• Bachelor's degree in science, engineering, business administration or a related field. MBA or advanced degree is considered an advantage.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Let’s build a healthier future, together. By combining our unique strengths, we’re redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. Discover what it’s like to work at Roche. The Opportunity The Security and Cybersecurity Expert provides expert-level leadership and strategic guidance across the organization's critical security programs and initiatives. This role manages a team of analysts, establishes team objectives and processes, and develops enterprise-wide security best practices that ensure consistency and alignment with organizational standards. The position combines hands-on oversight of high-impact projects with mentorship of less experienced team members, while maintaining quality assurance and strategic alignment across all security initiatives. Responsibilities Accountability/Problem Solving
• Leads comprehensive analysis of complex, strategic business problems across organizational boundaries, conducting root cause analysis and eliciting stakeholder needs to influence sound decision-making and drive consensus through persuasive communication
• Demonstrates mastery in requirements and domain knowledge, providing thought leadership on unusually complex problems with innovative solutions; mentors colleagues, leads large-scale process improvement initiatives, and guides strategic change adaptation while ensuring deliverables align with strategic objectives Stakeholder Management
• Identifies and analyzes complex stakeholder networks across organizational boundaries and global teams, developing comprehensive engagement and communication plans that drive consensus on strategic vision while building and maintaining strong relationships across the organization
• Acts as a master negotiator and trusted advisor to leadership, navigating complex conflicts to achieve alignment, empowering teams in stakeholder management, and serving as a role model in collaboration and organizational trust-building Impact/Strategy
• Drives significant, consistent impact across major products and domains by ensuring delivery of high-value solutions aligned with business strategy, embedding best practices, and leveraging industry trends to influence organizational strategy and foster continuous improvement
• Leads evaluation and implementation of optimal strategic solutions and transitions across large, complex projects spanning multiple domains; manages highly ambiguous requirements holistically while ensuring traceability and alignment with broader organizational goals Who you are
• Advanced technical proficiency in Java, JavaScript, AWS (Amazon Web Services), and SAP Customer Data Cloud (SAPCDC), with comprehensive knowledge of cybersecurity technologies and enterprise systems
• In-depth understanding of business domain, organizational strategy, and Business Analysis Advisory/Consultancy concepts; ability to apply systems thinking for holistic, enterprise-wide security consulting
• Demonstrated expertise in complex root cause analysis, requirements elicitation, strategic solution evaluation, and traceability principles across organizational boundaries
• Proven leadership and mentoring capabilities with ability to manage technical teams, build consensus among senior stakeholders, and establish trusted advisory relationships that influence strategic decisions
• Track record of driving significant impact through large-scale process improvements, change management initiatives, and thought leadership in emerging security trends and industry best pract

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. Our Clinical Safety organisation is dedicated to delivering meaningful improvements to patients through medically-differentiated therapies. In this role, you will provide essential safety science and pharmacovigilance support to molecules across the Roche portfolio, ensuring the highest standards of participant safety and data reliability. As a Safety Director, you will provide vital safety science and pharmacovigilance support across our diverse portfolio, ensuring the safety of our participants and the integrity of our clinical data from early development through to marketed products. In this pivotal role, you will act as a recognized expert in drug safety, applying strong self-leadership to manage complex safety profiles. The Opportunity: Working under the matrix leadership of the Safety Strategy Leader (SSL):
• Develop and maintain an expert understanding of product safety profiles and drive the overarching safety strategy for assigned molecules.
• Drive signal detection and management activities, ensuring proactive identification and evaluation of safety issues.
• Take independent responsibility for risk management activities, including the preparation and maintenance of Risk Management Plans, Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategies, and labelling documents.
• Review clinical protocols, Investigator’s Brochures (IB), and informed consent forms to ensure alignment with safety strategies.
• Lead safety science contributions for global regulatory filings, including INDs, NDAs, and MAAs.
• In partnership with the SSL, you will support the presentation of important safety issues to internal and external review and governance committees, as needed.
• Work cross-functionally in a global matrix environment, mentoring colleagues and coordinating with external vendors to ensure excellence in safety science.
• Act as a functional business process owner or subject matter expert to improve our safety science practices.
• You may be expected to support non-molecule projects, due diligence evaluations and other projects as needed.
• Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with functions including Clinical Science, Regulatory, Data Science and Clinical Operations and Surveillance teams to ensure seamless execution of business initiatives.
• Mentor & Lead: Act as a subject matter expert within the function, coaching junior scientists Who You Are: You are a proactive, structured thinker who thrives in a global matrix environment that is passionate about patient safety and possesses the analytical rigour to interpret complex data, ensuring that every decision we make is backed by sound scientific evidence. At Roche, you will find a culture that values your expertise and offers you the space to grow as a leader in safety science.
• A qualified healthcare professional or a Life Sciences graduate (a PhD, MSc, or PharmD is a distinct advantage) and bring 7+ years of experience.
• Bring extensive experience in clinical drug development within the biopharmaceutical industry, ideally with a focus on clinical safety.
• You possess a broad understanding of PV and clinical risk management, including GVP, GCP, and CTR requirements.
• Proven track record of leading and influencing in a global matrix environment, even without formal authority.
• Skilled at applying complex data analysis and statistical methods to evaluate and present scientific data with clarity

• Develop and maintain an expert understanding of product safety profiles and drive the overarching safety strategy for assigned molecules.
• Drive signal detection and management activities, ensuring proactive identification and evaluation of safety issues.
• Take independent responsibility for risk management activities, including the preparation and maintenance of Risk Management Plans, Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategies, and labelling documents.
• Review clinical protocols, Investigator’s Brochures (IB), and informed consent forms to ensure alignment with safety strategies.
• Lead safety science contributions for global regulatory filings, including INDs, NDAs, and MAAs.
• In partnership with the SSL, you will support the presentation of important safety issues to internal and external review and governance committees, as needed.
• Work cross-functionally in a global matrix environment, mentoring colleagues and coordinating with external vendors to ensure excellence in safety science.
• Act as a functional business process owner or subject matter expert to improve our safety science practices.
• You may be expected to support non-molecule projects, due diligence evaluations and other projects as needed.

You will play a key role in delivering clinical trials to patients by enabling innovative trial execution and ensuring a seamless experience for investigators and clinical site staff in the UK The Opportunity You will be responsible for leading the country's study start-up strategy, focusing on efficiency, innovation, and collaboration with external partners. Your work will have a direct impact on the speed and quality of our clinical trials. This role is internally known as the Country Study Start-Up Team Leader (cSTL). Your key responsibilities will include:
• Overseeing start-up operations to ensure timely and efficient site activation and regulatory compliance.
• Serve as a key member of the Country Leadership Team, contributing actionable insights and leadership influence to advance clinical study start-up environments.
• Build and maintain collaborative relationships with regional and global counterparts to standardise systems, improve study timelines, and implement innovations across study processes.
• Leading the development and oversight of clinical trial submissions and amendments, managing packages, and ensuring document maintenance.
• Identifying and driving opportunities for process automation, standardisation, and innovation at the country and site level.
• Providing strategic oversight for all aspects of budgeting and contract management, including developing budget strategies and negotiating contracts.
• Engaging with government and institutional bodies, such as Ethics Boards and Health Authorities, to align on and influence evolving clinical trial policies and practices.
• Driving department-wide engagement by fostering a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and high performance while championing inclusion and belonging. • Leading by example in demonstrating and championing inclusive behaviours in your team, PDG, PD, and the Roche Enterprise. Provide opportunities for growth and development for all team members and address any barriers that may exist.
• People management-related administration (e.g. Workday People & Culture Management system tasks) and contact for employment-related matters. You will also provide coaching, support, and leadership to a team of direct reports. You will champion inclusive behaviours and provide opportunities for growth and development for all team members. • You bring proven experience and hold a degree in life sciences (MD, PhD, MA/MS, BA/BS) or equivalent; a postgraduate or master’s degree is highly desirable.
• You have extensive experience in clinical trial start-up processes, including regulatory submissions, site activations, and amendments.
• Proven leadership or line management experience, with a track record of coaching, motivating, and driving teams toward shared goals.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We deliver knowledge on the safety profiles of our medicines, define how to manage risks to patients and coordinate the pharmacovigilance system activities for the company providing a safe journey for each individual patient, everywhere. The Opportunity:
• Contribute to shaping the future of healthcare by providing essential safety science and pharmacovigilance support across the entire Roche portfolio, influencing both early and late-phase development activities.
• Serve as a key member of the safety team, offering crucial safety oversight and input into all aspects of study management from development through post-market.
• Lead critical post-market safety activities, including signal evaluation, benefit-risk assessment, and comprehensive safety risk management.
• Take ownership of individual and aggregate case reporting, encompassing ICSR case management and critical aggregate reporting activities like DSUR and PBRER.
• Drive signal detection and management, and contributing to the strategic review of safety assessments and drug safety reports.
• Influence product safety strategy and provide vital drug safety input into the overarching Clinical Development strategy.
• Contribute significantly to risk management by preparing and maintaining CCDS, labeling documents (including the IB), risk communications, RMP, and REMS.
• Act independently with minimal supervision, demonstrating strong self-leadership, and proactively identifying and pursuing areas for personal and professional development. Who you are:
• Preferred Qualifications: A relevant postgraduate qualification (e.g. PHD/MSc in a Life sciences discipline; Medical qualification; PharmD or other post-graduate health professional qualifications) would be advantageous
• Demonstrate a strong understanding of GxP, regulated processes, and the end-to-end clinical trial lifecycle.
• Exhibit excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, capable of effectively collaborating with remote partners on a global team.
• Adept at applying complex data analysis and statistical methods to evaluate, interpret, and present scientific data with clarity.
• Possess strong presentation skills, effective at summarizing and presenting key considerations and decision points to diverse audiences.
• Proven ability to act independently and with minimal supervision, managing safety responsibilities on study teams and supporting safety science activities. Please note the role level will be determined based on experience and demonstrated expertise. This role is based onsite at our Welwyn, United Kingdom office. Our team follows a hybrid work structure, requiring a fixed number of onsite days per week. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In qualità di Data & AI Engineering Intern, lavorerai a stretto contatto con ingegneri e scienziati di dati esperti per costruire, sperimentare e imparare in diverse aree tecniche. Questo ruolo è progettato per fornire l'esposizione al ciclo di vita completo dei dati - dall'ingestione dei dati e dalla trasformazione al modello di sviluppo e distribuzione delle applicazioni. Potrai ruotare attraverso o contribuire a progetti di ingegneria dei dati, flussi di lavoro ML e applicazioni full-stack, a seconda delle priorità del team e dei tuoi interessi. L'opportunità
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con ingegneri e scienziati di dati esperti per costruire e imparare attraverso il ciclo di vita completo dei dati al prodotto.
• Ruotare tra i progetti che comprendono l'ingegneria dei dati, i flussi di lavoro ML e le applicazioni full-stack in base ai tuoi interessi.
• Assistere nella costruzione di datadotti scalabili e nell'elaborazione di dataset strutturati/non strutturati utilizzando SQL e Python.
• Collaborare su progetti ML & AI, tra cui la preparazione di dataset, modelli di test e la sperimentazione di strumenti moderni come LLM.
• Contribuire allo sviluppo a pieno ritmo costruendo dashboard, API e servizi backend.
• Ottieni esperienza pratica con piattaforme cloud (AWS) , containerizzazione (Docker), e orchestrazione moderna del flusso di lavoro. Chi sei
• Uno studente attualmente iscritto (Bachelor’s o Masters) in Informatica, Data Science, Ingegneria o un campo correlato, o si è laureato negli ultimi 12 mesi prima della data di inizio.
• Possedere una solida conoscenza di base della programmazione , con una forte preferenza per Python .
• Familiare con SQL e confortevole lavorare con varie strutture dati.
• Altamente curioso e motivato ad imparare e sperimentare continuamente nuovi domini tecnici.
• Idealmente avere qualche esposizione ai concetti ETL, ai fondamenti ML o allo sviluppo web (frontend o backend).
• Interessato all'intersezione dell'intelligenza artificiale e delle scienze della vita, con un approccio proattivo alla collaborazione del team. Informazioni aggiuntive
• Mentorship: ricevere una guida dedicata e una mentorship da esperti ingegneri e scienziati di dati.
• Real-world Impact: Opportunità di lavorare su casi di utilizzo reali in assistenza sanitaria e farmaceutica.
• Crescita della carriera: costruire una solida base per crescere in ruoli futuri come Data, ML o Software Engineer.

Il nous permet de fournir des produits de haute qualité aux patients, de garantir notre droit de fonctionner et de nous aider à créer de la valeur grâce à l'excellence des processus et à des efforts d'amélioration continue. La qualité, c'est le bien de chaque patient et la responsabilité de chaque employé. En tant que gestionnaire principal des processus opérationnels, vous assumerez la propriété conceptuelle des processus et façonnerez l'avenir numérique des processus opérationnels de service à Roche. Ce rôle principal est axé sur l'amélioration de l'efficacité opérationnelle tout en maintenant la satisfaction de la clientèle et en veillant au respect des normes élevées de l'industrie. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les intervenants mondiaux, régionaux et locaux pour promouvoir une culture d'amélioration continue alignée sur les objectifs stratégiques de l'organisation, tout en collaborant avec les équipes de propriétaires de produits d'affaires pour s'assurer que les processus sont effectivement mis en œuvre dans l'écosystème mondial de Roche IT. PRINCIPAUX COMPTES Gestion des processus opérationnels
• Diriger la saisie, l'analyse et la documentation des processus de bout en bout en utilisant les normes BPMN 2.0
• Mettre au point et améliorer en permanence des procédures ciblées harmonisées qui concilient les normes mondiales et les exigences locales;
• Construire et maintenir le dépôt central de processus (Roche ADONIS) comme source unique de vérité
• Effectuer des analyses des lacunes et établir des plans d'action prioritaires pour améliorer les processus; AI-First – Automatisation des processus et activation de l'IA
• Évaluer systématiquement les processus opérationnels de service pour le potentiel d'automatisation et la préparation à l'IA
• Définir des cas d'utilisation pour l'automatisation des processus assistés par l'IA (classification des billets, routage intelligent, documentation automatisée, diagnostic prédictif)
• Veiller à ce que les processus nouvellement définis soient fondés sur les données, mesurables et normalisés;
• Développer la connaissance de l'IA au sein du réseau des intervenants grâce à des programmes de formation et de champions Gestion des intervenants et gouvernance
• Mettre en place et maintenir un réseau mondial d'intervenants dans les PME nationales, les chefs de file de services régionaux et mondiaux, les BPO et les TI;
• Faciliter le Conseil du Processus mondial et organiser des ateliers avec des équipes internationales;
• Gérer la résistance et les intérêts concurrents dans une culture axée sur le consensus Gestion de l'interface et leadership de projet
• Collaborer avec les propriétaires de produits d'affaires pour transmettre les exigences harmonisées de processus pour le développement de produits
• Participer aux cycles de développement de produits agiles en tant qu'expert en processus
• Diriger ou participer à des projets de transformation stratégique à grande échelle ayant un impact organisationnel important
• Gérer les budgets et exécuter les projets en fonction du calendrier, du budget et du succès des ICR We@Roche Diagnostics Culture
• Démontrer les dimensions We@RD (passionner sur les clients, simplifier radicalement, faire confiance et collaborer, tous les lead, expérimenter et apprendre)
• Optimiser en permanence les processus pour améliorer les normes de qualité et d'efficacité Votre historique Éducation et expérience (requis)
• Diplômé en administration des affaires, informatique des affaires, génie ou équivalent (maîtrise préférée)
• Au moins 7 ans d'expérience professionnelle, avec au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans la gestion des processus opérationnels
• Expérience démontrée dans la modélisation de processus (BPMN 2.0), l'analyse et l'optimisation

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Senior Security Engineer Impact Our Secure Access team protects the organization’s global workforce by delivering and operating the technologies that enable secure, reliable, and compliant access to corporate resources. We work at the intersection of network security, identity, and cloud — supporting users and business-critical systems in a regulated industry environment. Do you want to make a meaningful impact as a Security Engineer focused on secure access and network security? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, self-directed environment? If so, we’d love to hear from you! What You Will Do As a Security Engineer on the Secure Access team, you will design, implement, and operate the technologies that underpin our organization’s remote access, web security, and network protection capabilities. You will be a hands-on contributor who brings both deep technical expertise and the energy to drive improvements independently. Purpose The Secure Access team engineers, delivers, and supports the solutions used to provide secure network access across the corporate environment — spanning on-premises, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure. The team provides hands-on engineering, configuration management, and automation support to keep access controls robust, auditable, and scalable in a regulated industry context. Key Activities and Deliverables
• Design, implement, and operate Cloudflare-based web security and Zero Trust access solutions.
• Administer and support GlobalProtect VPN infrastructure, including policy management, troubleshooting, and lifecycle operations.
• Build and maintain automation pipelines to reduce manual toil and improve consistency across security configurations.
• Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and maintain version-controlled configurations in GitHub.
• Own configuration management processes in ServiceNow, ensuring accurate CMDB records and change management compliance.
• Ensure security solutions meet regulatory requirements and support audit and compliance activities.
• Proactively identify gaps in access controls and propose improvements with a self-driven, solution-oriented mindset.
• Collaborate with cross-functional partners including network, identity, and cloud teams to deliver integrated secure access capabilities.
• Mentors more junior team members and contributes to the development of security best practices Job Skills Required
• High energy, self-motivated, and capable of owning work end-to-end with minimal direction.
• Accountability/Problem Solving : Independently leads the analysis of moderately complex cybersecurity incidents and technical problems, clearly defining the security problem scope and driving root cause analysis for security breaches or vulnerabilities
• Identifies a diverse range of security stakeholders across functional areas and effectively manages relationships to build reliance through deep business and technical understanding, acting as a trusted advisor
• Strong customer focus with a highly responsive service delivery and support ethic.
• Collaborative and communicative — comfortable working across distributed, cross-functional teams.
• Detail-oriented with a commitment to quality, documentation, and operational excellence.
• Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Qualifications and Experience Required
• 5-7 years of hands-on technical experience in security engineering, with a focus on network security and secure access technologies.
• Demonstrated hands-on experie

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Experience Required- 6+ years The Accounts Payables ERP Solution Architect designs business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready enterprise resource planning (ERP) solutions within the Accounts Payables context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements and evolving the architecture throughout the product life cycle. By solving complex technical problems, defining reference architectures, and aligning with the broader architecture community for governance, you will ensure robust ERP implementations that deliver enhanced value to the organization. Description of the area Our landscape in the Accounts Payables area integrates SAP ECC and S/4HANA with diverse procurement platforms to support the Invoice-to-Pay lifecycle. We ensure seamless processing from invoice receipt and compliant financial approval workflows through to the successful delivery of payment instructions to the Treasury solution. You will play a key role in navigating the transition from legacy environments to modern ERP standards, ensuring integration resilience and scalability as we re-engineer our global ERP landscape through the ASPIRE program. You will serve as the critical interface for translating business requirements into technical/ IT language. Your primary mission is to deeply explore and define the functional "why" behind business requests, ensuring that every technological solution is built upon a foundation of clearly mapped processes and validated organizational needs. Job Responsibilities
• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs ERP solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within a specific solution context. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle, and aligns with the architecture community for proper governance.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves complex problems, taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for the assigned ERP solution. Assesses and consults on impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates conceptual and logical data models, taxonomies, and ontologies for the solution and the related interfaces. Defines and drives reference architectures, needed NFRs, and ensures Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are recorded. Drives external technology trends and assesses feasibility for the solution, including vendor assessments.
• Stakeholder Management: Explains difficult or sensitive technical information and works collaboratively to build consensus among product teams, business stakeholders, and technical peers.
• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap within the solution context. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific ERP technologies for product teams. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes, improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies.
• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates primarily within the Accounts Payable product scope, managing the architectural complexities of specific ERP applications or components. In ad

The Position
ntroduction The Delivery Management Professional (SE6) leads moderately complex deliveries, proactively identifies improvements, manages diverse stakeholders, and contributes to strategic implementation. In this role, you will independently define and control the scope of medium to large initiatives, utilizing effective facilitation and analytical skills to drive value delivery. While navigating intricate stakeholder environments, you will connect team development with broader business objectives. Depending on the organization's needs, you may operate within role archetypes such as Project Manager, Service (Delivery) Manager, ITSM Process SME, Scrum Master, RTE, or Agile Coach.
The Opportunity:

• You will independently define, manage, and control the scope of medium to large initiatives, aligning them with strategic objectives and stakeholder expectations.

• Lead the analysis of complex delivery problems by driving root cause investigations and eliciting critical stakeholder needs.

• Develop and execute comprehensive stakeholder communication plans, acting as a trusted advisor across diverse functional areas.

• Shape team processes and contribute to the implementation of strategic objectives for Informatics, the Chapter, and specific Domains.

• Manage the delivery of complex features and projects, such as service transitions, product releases, or Agile Release Train (ART) increments.

• Select and tailor delivery methodologies—ranging from Waterfall to Agile—to optimize results and manage dependencies effectively.

• Utilize advanced delivery tools and techniques to address business challenges and contribute to high-level planning and forecasting.

• Foster a culture of accountability and team spirit by mentoring colleagues and using facilitation techniques to guide teams through ambiguity.

Who you are:

• You possess a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, IT, or a related field, combined with significant professional experience in delivery management.

• Have a proven track record (typically 7+ years) operating as a Project Manager, Scrum Master, RTE, or Service Manager for large-scale initiatives.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Procurement Specialist - Research & Development (Clinical Laboratories) Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions Hyderabad A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next. The Opportunity This role sits within the Indirect Procurement Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution. The Indirect Procurement Delivery group comprises many communities grouping categories of the same value chain or having commonality, including Research & Development, Commercial and Corporate Services, Digital & Technology, and Facilities. The communities are key enablers of strong category expertise while allowing flexibility in the procurement delivery response to the evolving needs of our customers. As a Procurement Specialist in Clinical Laboratories, you will bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Applying both general procurement and specialized knowledge or expertise in a specific commodity or spend area, you will ensure effective and efficient delivery of core procurement services and continuous improvement of automation and content availability. You will collaborate closely with internal procurement (i.e. Chapters and capability areas such as customer relationship management, contracting, solutions, analytics, etc.) and business stakeholders to translate business needs into sourcing and spend management activities and content enhancement. You will work closely with other team members to support customer demand, improve the customer buying experience, deliver on day-to day operational activities, and provide capacity and expertise to deliver productivity and other customer oriented projects/solutions. As a Procurement Specialist in Clinical Laboratories, you will play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and general business requirements, including but not limited to:
• You are a Category and sourcing subject matter specialist in Clinical Laboratories conducting market and internal analysis to develop strategies and tactical plans for how Roche should source and negotiate for third party goods and services in order to satisfy stakeholder requirements.
• You are a Procurement delivery practitioner delivering and executing sourcing strategies by leveraging spend, category know-how, robust sourcing, negotiation, contracting, supplier management methodologies and frameworks and project management skills.
• You develop content and automation, translating sourcing outcomes and opportunities into content and automated buying channels that improve business adoption, satisfaction, and overall efficiency. Who you are:
• You hold a university degre

titleByLocale.fr: Données de l'équipe responsable du processus

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il Team Lead e Product Manager è responsabile per l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto, dall'ideazione iniziale e dalla pianificazione strategica fino al lancio, scaling e all'eventuale pensionamento. Questo ruolo è fondamentale per trasformare le esigenze scientifiche e aziendali in soluzioni tecnologiche tangibili e ad alto valore. Sarete responsabili di definire la visione del prodotto, la strategia e la roadmap, assicurando che si allinea con gli obiettivi di overarching della nostra organizzazione e, infine, accelera la consegna di diagnostica e medicine che cambiano la vita ai pazienti. Questo ruolo richiede una combinazione distintiva di inquisitività scientifica, competenza tecnica e business insight per navigare con successo nel paesaggio. Il vostro obiettivo primario è quello di guidare team di ingegneria e servizi che costruiscono prodotti desiderabili, fattibili, fattibili e sostenibili che soddisfano le esigenze in evoluzione dei nostri utenti interni pur mantenendo una stretta conformità con gli standard del settore. Descrizione della zona All'interno di RDT Pharma Technical Operations e in particolare nel contesto di Manufacturing Technologies, il Team Lead Process Data supervisiona un portafoglio strategico di team e soluzioni focalizzate sul ciclo di vita dei dati farmaceutici. Questo settore fa parte della spina dorsale digitale del nostro ambiente di produzione, assicurando che i processi scientifici complessi siano tradotti in formati digitali affidabili, eseguibili e reportabili. Il nostro scopo include:

Data Historian Solutions: Gestione dei flussi di dati ad alta frequenza e in tempo reale dal piano del negozio per consentire analisi approfondite, risoluzione dei problemi e miglioramento continuo del processo. Tu sarai:
• Strategia & Visione: Contabile per impostare la direzione di un prodotto e garantire che raggiunga i risultati definiti e gli obiettivi finanziari. Integrare attivamente le capacità AI rilevanti nella roadmap del prodotto. Definire e monitorare le metriche chiave relative alla soddisfazione dell'utente, all'impegno e alla consegna del valore, e utilizzare questi dati per informare le iterazioni del prodotto.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Team Lead and Product Manager is accountable for the entire product lifecycle, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to launch, scaling, and eventual retirement. This role is pivotal in transforming scientific and business needs into tangible, high-value technology solutions. You will be responsible for defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, ensuring it aligns with the overarching goals of our organization and ultimately accelerates the delivery of life-changing diagnostics and medicines to patients. This role demands a distinctive combination of scientific inquisitiveness, technical proficiency, and business insight to successfully navigate the landscape. Your primary objective is to lead engineering and service teams building desirable, feasible, viable, and sustainable products that meet the evolving needs of our internal users while maintaining strict compliance with relevant industry standards. Description of the area Within RDT Pharma Technical Operations and specifically in the context of Manufacturing Technologies , the Team Lead Process Data oversees a strategic portfolio of teams and solutions focused on the lifecycle of pharmaceutical manufacturing data. This area is part of the digital backbone of our production environment, ensuring that complex scientific processes are translated into reliable, executable, and reportable digital formats. Our scope includes:
• Process Parameter Definition & Tracking: Ensuring the precision and integrity of data that defines our manufacturing steps. . Enterprise Recipe Management: Orchestrating the "blueprints" for our medicines across different sites to ensure consistency and scalability. Data Historian Solutions: Managing the high-frequency, real-time data streams from the shop floor to enable deep analysis, troubleshooting, and continuous process improvement. Shop-Floor Data Accessibility : Streamlining the extraction and availability of raw manufacturing data to ensure it is readily accessible for higher-level systems, analytics, and operational decision-making. You will be:
• Strategy & Vision : Accountable for setting the direction for a product and ensuring that it achieves defined outcomes and financial objectives. Defines product strategy, roadmap, and features aligned with business goals, user needs and organisational policies. Proactively integrate relevant AI capabilities into the product roadmap. Define, track, and communicate relevant KPIs for the product to measure its performance and contribution to business goals and strategy.
• Customer-Centricity : Actively collect, understand, and prioritize the needs of internal users. Act as the primary owner of the “customer's” problem and be responsible for defining and delivering a solution that provides tangible value. Define and track key metrics related to user satisfaction, engagement, and value delivery, and use this data to inform product iterations.
• Product Lifecycle Mgmt. Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, guide its development, and manage its growth and eventual decline based on market research, customer feedback, and business goals. Manage the product in compliance with emerging regulations.
• Stakeholder Collaboration : Expand collaboration to a broader set of cross-functional teams and be responsible for aligning these teams around the product roadmap. Clearly communicate the product roadmap, timelines, and potential trade-offs to various stakeholders to manage their expectations effectively.

Definieren und verfolgen Sie wichtige Metriken im Zusammenhang mit der Benutzerzufriedenheit, dem Engagement und der Wertschöpfung und nutzen Sie diese Daten, um die Produkt iterationen zu informieren.
• Product Lifecycle Mgmt. Eigener End-to-End-Produktlebenszyklus, führen seine Entwicklung und verwalten ihr Wachstum und seinen eventuellen Rückgang basierend auf Marktforschung, Kundenfeedback und Geschäftszielen. Verwalten Sie das Produkt in Übereinstimmung mit den aufstrebenden Vorschriften.
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Erweitern Sie die Zusammenarbeit zu einem breiteren Satz von funktionsübergreifenden Teams und sind für die Ausrichtung dieser Teams auf die Produkt-Roadmap verantwortlich. Deutlich kommunizieren Sie die Produkt-Roadmap, Timelines und potenzielle Trade-offs an verschiedene Stakeholder, um ihre Erwartungen effektiv zu verwalten.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le chef d'équipe et le gestionnaire des produits sont responsables de tout le cycle de vie du produit, depuis l'idée initiale et la planification stratégique jusqu'au lancement, à l'échelle et à la retraite. Ce rôle est essentiel pour transformer les besoins scientifiques et commerciaux en solutions technologiques tangibles et de grande valeur. Vous serez responsable de la définition de la vision, de la stratégie et de la feuille de route du produit, en s'assurant qu'elle s'harmonise avec les objectifs généraux de notre organisation et, en fin de compte, accélère la prestation de diagnostics et de médicaments qui changent la vie aux patients. Ce rôle exige une combinaison distinctive d'enquête scientifique, de compétence technique et de perspicacité commerciale pour naviguer avec succès dans le paysage. Votre objectif principal est de diriger les équipes d'ingénierie et de service en construisant des produits souhaitables, réalisables, viables et durables qui répondent aux besoins changeants de nos utilisateurs internes tout en maintenant le strict respect des normes pertinentes de l'industrie. Description de la zone Dans le cadre des opérations techniques de RDT Pharma et plus particulièrement dans le contexte des technologies de fabrication , les données de processus de l'équipe supervisent un portefeuille stratégique d'équipes et de solutions axées sur le cycle de vie des données de fabrication pharmaceutique. Cette zone fait partie de l'épine dorsale numérique de notre environnement de production, assurant que les processus scientifiques complexes sont traduits en formats numériques fiables, exécutables et à déclaration. Notre portée comprend :
• Définition et suivi du paramètre process : assurer la précision et l'intégrité des données qui définissent nos étapes de fabrication. . Gestion de la recette d'entreprise : orchestrer les "empreintes bleues" pour nos médicaments sur différents sites afin d'assurer la cohérence et l'évolutivité. Data Historian Solutions: Gestion des flux de données en temps réel à haute fréquence depuis l'atelier pour permettre une analyse approfondie, le dépannage et l'amélioration continue des processus. Accessibility Shop-Floor Data : Simplification de l'extraction et de la disponibilité des données brutes de fabrication pour s'assurer qu'elles sont facilement accessibles pour les systèmes de niveau supérieur, les analyses et la prise de décisions opérationnelles. Vous serez :
• Stratégie & Vision : Responsable de définir l'orientation d'un produit et de veiller à ce qu'il atteigne des résultats définis et des objectifs financiers. Définit la stratégie, la feuille de route et les caractéristiques des produits en fonction des objectifs opérationnels, des besoins des utilisateurs et des politiques organisationnelles. Intégrer de manière proactive les capacités d'IA pertinentes dans la feuille de route des produits. Définir, suivre et communiquer les ICR pertinents pour le produit afin de mesurer son rendement et sa contribution aux objectifs et à la stratégie de l'entreprise.
• Client-Centricité : Recueillir, comprendre et prioriser activement les besoins des utilisateurs internes. Agir en tant que propriétaire principal du problème du client et être responsable de définir et de fournir une solution qui fournit une valeur tangible. Définir et suivre les mesures clés liées à la satisfaction des utilisateurs, à l'engagement et à la livraison de valeur, et utiliser ces données pour éclairer les itérations de produits.
• Cycle de vie du produit Mgmt. Posséder le cycle de vie des produits de bout en bout, orienter son développement et gérer sa croissance et éventuellement son déclin en fonction de l'étude de marché, de la rétroaction des clients et des objectifs commerciaux. Gérer le produit conformément aux nouveaux règlements.
• Collaboration avec les parties prenantes : étendre la collaboration à un ensemble plus large d'équipes interfonctionnelles et être responsable de l'alignement de ces équipes sur la feuille de route des produits. Communiquer clairement la feuille de route du produit, les échéanciers et les compromis possibles à divers intervenants pour gérer efficacement leurs attentes.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity As a Cluster Section Lead in the Global Finance Support organization, you will be responsible for establishing and leading day-to-day Finance Technical support, working with the respective Global Cluster Lead. The role has a strong focus on people management, compliance and operational excellence. In this position you will drive operational excellence to achieve the objectives of the Global Product Line, leading a team of Finance Business and System Analysts. As a people manager you will inspire and help to shape the future of our organization. You will actively coach and foster the development of the team members, help remove siloes and support your team to evolve with the organic development of the business. You will lead the collaboration across clusters, as well as, across Global Product Lines, and Global teams.
• Strategic Talent Management: Lead the full employee lifecycle by managing recruitment with P&C, overseeing onboarding/integration, and ensuring comprehensive training through various learning channels.
• Performance & Development: Motivate and develop team members by setting clear goals, documenting performance, and providing proactive coaching and feedback.
• Operational Excellence: Drive service quality in Finance Business Support by meeting KPI targets, ensuring high end-user satisfaction, and maintaining a deep understanding of end-to-end finance processes.
• Collaboration & Communication: Foster a culture of teamwork and transparency by proactively sharing information, project roadmaps, and business knowledge across global and functional boundaries.
• Continuous Improvement: Partner with enabling functions to implement best practices and identify system/process enhancements that drive automation, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.
• Stakeholder & Risk Management: Manage key business relationships and collaborate with leadership to set performance targets, manage team workloads, and mitigate operational risks.
• Values-Driven Leadership: Serve as a role model by embodying Roche values and Leadership Commitments while promoting Agile, LEAN, and ITIL methodologies. Who you are
• Strategic Leadership & Change Management: Proven ability to lead projects in complex matrix organizations, drive organizational change, and mentor/coach team members to success.
• Operational Excellence & Metrics: Extensive experience in customer support (preferably Finance) with a focus on meeting department KPIs, managing escalations, and utilizing reporting tools for data-driven decisions.
• Stakeholder & Account Management: Expert in demand and relationship management, possessing exceptional negotiation, facilitation, and communication skills to navigate a dynamic international environment.
• Agile & Structured Methodologies: Proficient in implementing support processes through modern ways of working, such as Agile, ITIL, and LEAN, while maintaining a strong sense of urgency.
• Results-Oriented Professionalism: Highly accountable and resourceful problem-solver with a university degree and the ability to manage multiple priorities with composure and integrity. In exchange we provide you with
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.
• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private

The Position Como Estagiário(a) de Supply Chain, você fará parte de uma equipe colaborativa focada em otimizar nossos processos de Planejamento de Demanda . Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para aplicar suas habilidades analíticas na prática . Venha se desenvolver profissionalmente em uma cultura que valoriza a inovação e a melhoria contínua . A Oportunidade
• Você apoia o time de Planejamento de Demanda nas rotinas analíticas e no ciclo de S&OP .
• Você trabalha com um grande volume de dados, realizando o tratamento, a consolidação e a análise constante de informações .
• Você desenvolve dashboards, relatórios e indicadores de performance essenciais para a área .
• Você identifica oportunidades de melhoria contínua nos processos e contribui ativamente para a padronização e otimização de fluxos .
• Você apoia a estruturação e o acompanhamento de projetos estratégicos, expandindo seu impacto na organização . Quem você é
• Você cursa graduação em Engenharia, Administração, Economia, Estatística, Matemática, Supply Chain ou áreas correlatas, com previsão de conclusão a partir de 2027 e vínculo ativo com a instituição de ensino .
• Você tem disponibilidade para estagiar de 1 a 2 anos, com uma carga horária de 6 horas diárias .
• Você possui Excel avançado e grande facilidade para trabalhar com análise e tratamento de dados .
• Você demonstra forte capacidade analítica, raciocínio lógico e mantém um perfil estruturado, organizado e com visão processual .
• Você se comunica muito bem e tem a habilidade de transformar dados complexos em informações claras e assertivas . Preferencial
• Você tem conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau ou similares) e noções de S&OP / Planejamento de Demanda .
• Você conhece metodologias de projetos (PMBOK, Agile, Scrum ou similares) .
• Você possui alguma experiência prévia com análise de dados ou iniciativas de melhoria contínua . *Benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para esta vaga. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose
Join a global pharmaceutical company and work on real-world evidence (RWE) generation projects
using robust, large-scale real-world databases. This internship offers a unique opportunity to gain
hands-on experience in RWE research, contribute to impactful healthcare insights, and collaborate
with experts in epidemiology and data science.

Role scope:
You will:
● Partner with RWD Scientists to support end-to-end RWE projects, including study design,
statistical analysis planning, data analysis, and scientific report writing
● Conduct research using international and domestic real-world databases
● Assist in writing pharmacoepidemiology study protocols
● Support the development of RWE training materials
Key Responsibilities
1. Analyze and interpret data from multinational real-world databases
2. Explore the use of domestic healthcare databases for RWE studies
3. Assist in writing research protocols for pharmacoepidemiology studies
4. Prepare training materials for RWE capacity building

Requirements:
Qualifications

• Currently enrolled in a graduate program in medicine, pharmacy, public health, epidemiology, biostatistics, or related fields

• Undergraduate students with hands-on RWD research experience are also welcome

• Basic understanding of epidemiology and pharmacoepidemiology

• Experience with or strong interest in real-world data analysis

Skills & Knowledge

• Proficient in statistical analysis and data interpretation

• Basic programming skills in R or SAS

• Familiar with literature review and scientific data synthesis

• Understanding of healthcare databases, both domestic and international

• Ability to contribute to the development of study protocols and scientific reports

Core Competencies

• Strong logical thinking and analytical skills

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team setting

• Effective communication and presentation skills

• Proactive, responsible, and eager to ask questions and learn

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience using large healthcare databases (e.g., NHIRD, TriNetx, or Flatiron)

• Involvement in epidemiology or pharmacoepidemiology research projects

• Passion for reading medical literature and analyzing clinical data

• Interest in emerging trends and innovations in real-world evidence and drug development

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
羅氏大藥廠-真實世界數據研究實習課程

課程目標
• 以真實世界證據專案（real-world evidence project）為主軸，讓實習生在 6 週內 (2025/7/6-
• 8/14) 完成從「研究問題形成 → 研究設計 → 數據分析 → 結果解讀 → 報告→ 教材輸出」的閉環
• 訓練，並實際參與跨國藥廠的研究協作模式。
• 課程大綱
• 本課程旨在引領實習生深度參與真實世界證據的完整產製流程。學員將從文獻回顧與法規研析
• 出發，學習如何從真實世界數據中挖掘洞見，並歷經研究問題定義、研究設計至統計分析的實
• 戰演練，進而掌握 RWE 在藥業的核心價值。
• 課程內容
• 實習生於六周實習結束後完成:
• 1 份可執行的研究設計文件（研究問題、族群定義、暴露/結局、偏差或敏感度分析規劃）
• 1 套可重現的分析程式（R 或 SAS）＋ 資料處理與描述性分析輸出
• 1 份結果簡報（含主要結果、限制、建議下一步）
• 1 份內/外部 RWE 教學材料（例如：演講投影片）
• 預期收穫
• ● 實際接觸國內外大型真實世界數據資料庫
• ● 參與藥廠真實世界數據研究案
• ● 了解藥業文化與工作方式，幫助職涯探索
• ● 學以致用，將學校所學技能應用至藥業
• 實習規劃及名額
• ● 實習單位: 羅氏大藥廠/醫藥事務部 (115臺北市南港區經貿一路170號10樓)
• ● 實習規劃: 6周，週數可依照專案進度，於取得主管與學生共同同意後彈性增加。
• ● 實習期間: 2025/7/6-8/14
• ● 實習名額: 2-3名
• ● 授課對象: 藥學系5-6年級學生且有RWE相關經驗者尤佳或臨藥所碩博班學生
• ● 甄選方式: 請於4/13下午五點前用email方式寄送個人書面履歷 (格式不拘，信件主旨: [
• 暑期實習申請] 姓名) 到進行shih-chieh.shao@roche.com初審，4/17將用email通知初
• 審結果及複審口試細節。甄選評估項目包含是否具備運用R或SAS進行數據分析能力及
• 基本藥物流行病學知識，以及相關個人特質 (例如: 具備發掘、分析與解決問題，善於
• 溝通與表達，並能參與團隊合作)
• 其他注意事項
• ● 羅氏大藥廠保有最終修改及解釋本實習計畫書內容之權利

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
羅氏大藥廠-真實世界數據研究實習課程

課程目標
• 以真實世界證據專案（real-world evidence project）為主軸，讓實習生在 6 週內 (2025/7/6-
• 8/14) 完成從「研究問題形成 → 研究設計 → 數據分析 → 結果解讀 → 報告→ 教材輸出」的閉環
• 訓練，並實際參與跨國藥廠的研究協作模式。
• 課程大綱
• 本課程旨在引領實習生深度參與真實世界證據的完整產製流程。學員將從文獻回顧與法規研析
• 出發，學習如何從真實世界數據中挖掘洞見，並歷經研究問題定義、研究設計至統計分析的實
• 戰演練，進而掌握 RWE 在藥業的核心價值。
• 課程內容
• 實習生於六周實習結束後完成:
• 1 份可執行的研究設計文件（研究問題、族群定義、暴露/結局、偏差或敏感度分析規劃）
• 1 套可重現的分析程式（R 或 SAS）＋ 資料處理與描述性分析輸出
• 1 份結果簡報（含主要結果、限制、建議下一步）
• 1 份內/外部 RWE 教學材料（例如：演講投影片）
• 預期收穫
• ● 實際接觸國內外大型真實世界數據資料庫
• ● 參與藥廠真實世界數據研究案
• ● 了解藥業文化與工作方式，幫助職涯探索
• ● 學以致用，將學校所學技能應用至藥業
• 實習規劃及名額
• ● 實習單位: 羅氏大藥廠/醫藥事務部 (115臺北市南港區經貿一路170號10樓)
• ● 實習規劃: 6周，週數可依照專案進度，於取得主管與學生共同同意後彈性增加。
• ● 實習期間: 2025/7/6-8/14
• ● 實習名額: 2-3名
• ● 授課對象: 藥學系5-6年級學生且有RWE相關經驗者尤佳或臨藥所碩博班學生
• ● 甄選方式: 請於4/13下午五點前用email方式寄送個人書面履歷 (格式不拘，信件主旨: [
• 暑期實習申請] 姓名) 到進行shih-chieh.shao@roche.com初審，4/17將用email通知初
• 審結果及複審口試細節。甄選評估項目包含是否具備運用R或SAS進行數據分析能力及
• 基本藥物流行病學知識，以及相關個人特質 (例如: 具備發掘、分析與解決問題，善於
• 溝通與表達，並能參與團隊合作)
• 其他注意事項
• ● 羅氏大藥廠保有最終修改及解釋本實習計畫書內容之權利

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design. The Opportunity: We are looking for an upbeat, dynamic, innovative and creative individual who is highly involved and very passionate about Digital Marketing and Project Management. As a Digital Campaign Intern you will be responsible for supporting our Delivery Managers to deliver on campaign objectives for various affiliates globally. You will be at the forefront of our project deliveries and the work you'll do will directly impact the way affiliates will interact with our teams. In this position you will be focusing on :
• Assisting in project managing various digital campaigns to enhance customer satisfaction during asset delivery operations through the DIA Content Lab
• Managing updates of marketing materials in a timely manner in close collaboration with relevant stakeholders depending on the updates incl. communication/coordination with requestors (from the affiliates)
• Managing tickets within our project manager system, coordinating the organization of source files and asset managements for seamless identification and reuse within our global network.
• Staying curious, open-minded, and always willing to do more. Who you are:
• You have ongoing studies at any Hungarian University /college in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.
• You are available at least 20-25 hours per week
• You are passionate about project management
• You're organized, detail-oriented, self-motivated, with the ability to easily transition between multiple tasks and problem solve thoughtfully
• You have highly developed interpersonal and communication skills
• You are a quick learner, proactive, flexible and curious with an an innovative mind
• You are a strong team player with ability to work in a virtual team environment
• English proficiency is a must. Any other language is a big plus. In exchange we provide you with: Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career. A global community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion. Explore what the Global Digital Hub is about. Discover the Roche Services & Solutions Center and how we work together as a truly global team! descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Purpose of the role Roche is the world’s largest biotech company, with truly differentiated medicines in oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, ophthalmology and diseases of the central nervous system. Roche is also the world leader in-vitro diagnostics and tissue-based cancer diagnostics, and a frontrunner in diabetes management. The Diagnostics Insights Solution Management Team is part of Roche Diagnostics . We focus on developing and commercialising solutions with multiple components (digital, physical, and service offerings) to create value beyond individual products by comprehensively addressing customer needs. As Business Solution Management Associate , you will support us in addressing the challenges in commercializing these integrated solutions. One of our key initiatives in commercializing integrated solutions with country organizations is the multi-year Stronger Solution Selling (S3) program . You will support the S3 core team in delivering strategic workshops with country organizations and optimizing essential solution-selling assets to help cross-functional affiliate teams better navigate Roche Diagnostic’s physical, digital, and service portfolios. This role offers a blend of project management and process refinement, providing a unique platform to shape how the organization delivers tailored value to its customers worldwide. • Project Management & Delivery : Take ownership of assigned tasks with a focus on structuring complexity and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality assets.
• Affiliate Support & Collaboration : Directly assist the S3 Core Team in driving activities with country organizations and country clusters.
• Asset & Tool Optimization : Refine existing and develop new solution-selling tools to help teams better navigate Roche’s physical and digital offerings.
• Change Management : Support ongoing activities aimed at sustaining the organizational shift toward effective solution selling.
• Process Improvement : Potentially step up into a process improvement project to refine workflows, systems, or insights that improve the effectiveness of solution selling. How would your day to day look like? As Business Solution Management Associate , you'll work closely with team members in the S3 core team, as well as subregional and country teams. This role offers a great opportunity to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders for driving improvements in solution commercialization. Your day-to-day will be dynamic and diverse, and could begin by coordinating with the S3 Core Team to support global affiliates and manage project deliverables. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The role ​ You’ll work alongside a dynamic team in a fast paced environment shaping how AI can enhance the strategic capabilities of Business Development. This is an opportunity to blend business insight, creativity, and technical curiosity to help build a next-generation partnership and insights platform within Roche. Responsibilities
• Collaborate closely with stakeholders across multiple departments to clearly define project requirements, implement use cases, and validate AI-driven applications.
• Design and build lightweight, no-code/medium-code generative AI tools and assistants to automate or enhance internal workflows and processes.
• Develop and refine AI-enhanced solutions that support diverse corporate use cases, enhancing efficiency and strategic decision-making.
• Provide comprehensive training and ongoing support to users and teams to ensure successful adoption and effective use of AI-based applications.
• Troubleshoot and optimize solutions based on continuous user feedback and emerging business requirements.
• Continue to maintain and update AI capabilities within corporate business development applications, maintaining awareness of emerging trends and best practices
• Develop and update documentation and knowledge bases for corporate business development AI tools Who You Are
• Recent graduate in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field
• Experience using GenAI tools like ChatGPT (Custom GPTs), Gemini (Gems), or other AI assistants, and building data visualizations, such as Tableau dashboards
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially for documenting AI use cases and translating between technical tools and business needs
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with exceptional attention to detail
• Collaborative mindset with experience working effectively across multiple teams in a fast-paced, dynamic corporate environment
• Familiarity with Salesforce Sales Cloud (preferred) Who We Are At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients. At Roche, we believe diversity and inclusion are essential values for our success. We have a special interest in integrating people with disabilities into our teams. Are you ready to apply? We are looking for someone who thinks beyond the task at hand—a learner who sees this as a unique opportunity to shape the future of Diagnostics. If that is you, apply now! Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
