descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position You will join the Customer Experience, Research & Strategy team at Roche Diagnostics in Sant Cugat. This team sits at the heart of how Roche understands and designs for the people who rely on diagnostic solutions — from lab professionals to clinicians and patients. The team combines rigorous research with strategic design to shape services and experiences across digital and physical touchpoints. About the role As a Service Design intern you will contribute to real research and design projects from day one. Working alongside senior designers and researchers, you will help map the end-to-end experiences of Roche's customers, conduct user research, and explore how conversational interfaces — chatbots, voice assistants, and AI-powered agents — can better serve the needs of healthcare professionals. Over the course of a full year you will move through the entire design cycle — from discovery and research through to prototyping and delivery — building a rich, evidence-based portfolio in one of the most complex and meaningful design contexts there is. What you'll do Research support
• Assist in planning and facilitating user interviews, contextual enquiries, and usability sessions with healthcare professionals
• Help synthesise qualitative findings through affinity mapping and insight frameworks
• Contribute to personas, journey maps, and mental model documentation
• Support the team in maintaining research repositories and knowledge assets Service design
• Contribute to service blueprints and experience maps that reveal systemic friction
• Participate in co-design workshops with internal teams and external stakeholders
• Help build and iterate on prototypes for concept testing
• Document design decisions and produce artefacts that communicate intent clearly Conversational design
• Support the design of dialogue flows and conversation scripts for chat and voice interfaces
• Help define tone of voice guidelines for automated interactions in a healthcare context
• Assist in evaluating conversational prototypes with real users and documenting findings
• Research best practices in NLP, intent design, and accessible conversational UX Collaboration
• Work in cross-functional squads alongside product managers, engineers, and clinical experts
• Present work-in-progress in team reviews and design critiques
• Contribute to team rituals: stand-ups, retrospectives, and design community sessions
• Bring fresh perspective and curiosity to a team that values diverse viewpoints Who we're looking for
• Currently enrolled in a degree in Service Design, Interaction Design, HCI, UX, or a related field
• Genuine interest in human-centred research — you are curious about people and why they behave as they do
• Exposure to conversational design, dialogue writing, or NLP through coursework or personal projects
• Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to ask good questions in complex environments
• Clear communication in English (working language of the team); Spanish is a plus
• A portfolio or project work demonstrating research and/or design thinking Nice to have
• Familiarity with tools such as Figma, FigJam, Miro, or Dovetail
• Interest in healthcare, diagnostics, or life sciences
• Exposure to systems thinking, service blueprinting, or design research methods
• Any experience with chatbot platforms or voice assistant design
• Strong visual communication skills — the ability to make complexity legible What we offer: The internship experience
• A full

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Purpose of the role This position aims at offering the opportunity to develop competences in the area of testing, integration and validation of Software solutions in the field of Laboratory connectivity components in Roche Laboratories. Our team is responsible for developing connectivity solutions which are enabling interoperability of all components part of the Diagnostics of our clients (instruments, Network integrators, IT solutions, LIS…). The position will support this ambition by covering activities related to gain understanding of requirements at business and technical level so that they can support on the component, E2E and field validation of functionality, testing activities and integration with other solutions. The role will also provide technical requirements to development teams when appropriate. How would your day to day look like? You will be part of a development team based in Sant Cugat and as part of it, you will join their Agile ceremonies (SAFE Framework). You will work in some activities from your team backlog related to your role. You will be in the office an average of 1 to 2 days per week together with the rest of the team for specific testing needs. In addition, you will need to travel 3-4 times per year to Switzerland or other client locations. Who are you? You are a recent graduate (max 3 years after graduation) in the fields of Informatics, Telecommunications and Biotech. You are a person with high curiosity and willingness to learn from other domains. You try to find autonomy in your work and are able to ask for help or advice in order to ensure you are doing valuable work. You are authentic, tell the truth and explain the why, strive for excellence and continuously improve and live our values of Integrity, Courage and Passion. What do we offer? We offer a learning environment and opportunities to develop quickly yourself both on our domains and on your personal growth and leadership.
• We offer you a mature organization with Innovative and passionate people, very customer centric and open to change and continuously improving and delivering value fast. You also will be trained on the basic competencies you need to work with us and will feel safe for failing and learning as the essence to growing with us. This opportunity is part of the START TECH program, you can find more information about the program in the following link . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Position At the heart of this internship, you will collaborate with our Simulation Teams to architect the future of System & Solution Design. As a key contributor, you will help build and validate ‘Digital Twins’ for our next-generation core lab solutions. Your work won’t just be theoretical, it will directly shape the physical architecture and the logical “brain” of cutting-edge, end-to-end laboratory systems. Your Key Responsibilities
• Model & Maintain: Create and maintain complex scenarios for software and hardware simulations.
• Execute & Analyze: Run simulations and perform deep-dive analyses of the results to identify system behaviors.
• Evolutionary Support: Provide status updates and issue notifications to support the continuous evolution of our simulators.
• Collaborate: Work alongside multidisciplinary teams to improve departmental operations and project delivery. What You Will Learn & Develop
• Advanced Simulation: Gain hands-on experience with Discrete Event Simulation (DES) using tools like Simio or AnyLogic.
• Systems Engineering: Understand the "big picture" of how hardware, software, and logistics integrate into massive diagnostic solutions.
• Algorithmic Thinking: Design and implement efficient heuristics for real-time decision-making in robotics.
• Data Science: Use Python to transform raw simulation outputs into powerful, data-driven visual stories.
• Software Development: Level up your OOP (C# or Java ) skills by extending simulation logic.
• Global Collaboration: Experience working across borders with engineers and product owners in an international environment. Who You Are You are a methodical, responsible team player who is eager to take ownership of technical challenges.
• Education: Mechanical Engineering, SW Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or Industrial Engineering.
• Programming: Solid foundation in Object-Oriented Programming (C# or Java).
• Data Tools: Knowledge of SQL, Python, and Pandas for data management.
• Simulation: Familiarity with Discrete Event Simulations and statistical modeling.
• Communication: Fluent in English; able to present complex data with clarity.
• Mindset: You are a methodical, responsible team player who is eager to take ownership of technical challenges.A strong willingness to learn and a proactive approach to problem-solving. The Position Purpose of the role At Diagnostics Insights Software, we are collaborating in digitalizing diagnostics and revolutionizing how data is accessed and utilized in Laboratories and Point of Care settings. Building software products is great, but working on software with a purpose is even better! As a Software Engineer in Test, you’ll work on a product that helps people with the most precious thing they have — their health. In collaborative teams of engineers, designers, product owners, and UX experts, you’ll experience best-in-class software engineering practices daily and contribute to software that meets the highest expectations — we do not put our users’ lives at risk! Main responsibilities:
• Confirm the correctness of requirements-driven tests, utilizing diverse testing approaches such as exploratory, white box, and black box testing.
• Execute tests across multiple testing levels , including end-to-end, system, integration, and unit testing.
• Perform various testing types , such as functional, performance, resiliency, and scalability testing, to ensure robust product quality.
• Automate and execute front-end and back-end tests for platforms and web applications .
• Develop and automate deployment and testing pipelines, supporting multiple project branches and stages.
• Track and report quality metrics , contributing to the maintenance and improvement of quality dashboards .
• Conduct root cause analyses of defects and newly discovered issues to continuously improve testing practices.
• Design and implement automation frameworks and validate toolchains to support testing processes.
• Ensure compliance with regulatory standards for all quality engineering deliverables.
• Collaborate closely with Test Architects, Test Leads, Test Managers, as well as designers, architects, and developers.
• Share, coach, and train the built-in quality mindset throughout the organization. How would your day to day look like? You will work closely with developers, product owners, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality software in a fast-paced, iterative environment. You will deep dive on ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products by performing thorough testing activities throughout the development lifecycle. We are committed to quality, dedicating time to design reviews, thorough test coverage, focused quality days and CI/CD principles. If this resonates with you, we would love to hear from you Who are you?
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
• You are familiar with integration of automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline to ensure continuous testing.
• You are familiar with the testing processes: design, plan, execution and reporting.
• Great written and verbal communication in English.
• Technologies & Tools: Kubernetes-based applications, AWS, Java, Cucumber (Behavior-Driven Development), Typescript, Javascript, Playwright, Cypress, Jira, GitHub/GitLab, Confluence, Google Suite, macOS/Linux. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Department Summary We are seeking a highly motivated professional with experience in Security and Privacy to join our dynamic team. As a Junior Penetration Tester, your main responsibilities will include supporting and assisting in penetration testing activities to ensure the security of Roche products and solutions. This role involves collaborating with Product Teams, executing predefined test strategies, and documenting the results. You will play a crucial role in identifying vulnerabilities and aiding in the reporting process. The Opportunity
• Work closely with Product Teams to understand and determine testing requirements and assist in the development, planning, scoping and execution of testing activities (both in physical and cloud products).
• Conduct cybersecurity penetration testing activities across various technology layers, assessing the criticality of vulnerabilities for adequate prioritization, and providing suitable remediation recommendations to product teams.
• Maintain and utilize the repository of penetration testing methods and tools to ensure consistency and standardization in testing practices.
• Create detailed reports and present findings, associated risks, and recommendations to product teams and management.
• Participate in planning and managing red team exercises to assess the cyber resilience of products and solutions.
• Support the Incident Response team during incidents.
• Contribute to initiatives aimed at integrating defense capabilities into products in collaboration with other PSPO colleagues.
• Develop, maintain, and continuously optimize processes, playbooks, and tools to enhance penetration testing efficiency and effectiveness. Program Highlights
• Intensive 1 year intern graduate program (Contrato en prácticas).
• Competitive salary and benefits package.
• Location in Sant Cugat del Valles, On Site.
• Access to training and development opportunities.
• Work with some of the most talented people in the biotechnology industry. Who You Are (Required)
• Must have graduated from a University degree program.
• Must have attained a Bachelor's degree.
• Experience or familiarity with cloud computing technologies, vulnerability assessment, and penetration testing.
• Knowledge of automating security controls through scripting languages such as shell scripting and Python.
• Understanding of information security and privacy risks.
• Problem solving abilities, communication, teamwork, flexibility and adaptability.
• Team player, proactive, self-driven, solution-oriented, and hands-on. Required Majors: Information Systems, Computer Science or a related relevant area of study. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives through innovation in diagnostics. As part of our Start Tech Program , we are looking for a motivated recent graduate to join our team in Sant Cugat and contribute to cutting-edge diagnostic development. This internship offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a dynamic laboratory environment while working alongside experienced professionals in the field. Your Responsibilities As a Start Tech Graduate Intern, you will support the development of diagnostic solutions and contribute to laboratory operations. Your key responsibilities will include:
• Participating in the development of diagnostic assays, including clotting, enzymatic, and immunological methods
• Independently supporting the execution of analytical experiments, including data analysis, interpretation, and presentation of results
• Assisting in the planning, implementation, evaluation, and documentation of development activities, including literature research
• Contributing to general laboratory tasks to ensure smooth day-to-day operations
• Taking responsibility for the proper use and maintenance of assigned laboratory equipment What We Are Looking For
• Recent graduate in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or a related field
• Strong interest in diagnostics and laboratory-based research
• Analytical mindset with attention to detail and problem-solving skills
• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment
• Good communication skills and willingness to learn What We Offer
• Hands-on experience in a leading global healthcare company
• Exposure to innovative diagnostic technologies and methodologies
• A collaborative and international work environment
• Opportunities for learning, growth, and future career development within Roche If you are eager to start your career in diagnostics and want to make a meaningful impact, we would love to hear from you. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position Présentation de l’équipe: sous la responsabilité de l’Ingénieur Réseau Terrain et du Responsable Régional Equipe Service, tu seras Rattaché(e) à l’équipe Service Excellence. En lien étroit avec les équipes supports et commerciales, tu seras amené(e) à travailler sur des missions liées à l’installation et aux maintiens des réseaux instruments Roche dans les laboratoires d’analyses médicales privés et hospitaliers. Quel sera ton impact? ● Assurer la conception des schémas réseau et déploiement . ● Installer et maintenir le réseau IT Roche toutes gammes en collaboration avec les équipes Ingénieur Service et Ingénieur ITWF. ● Garantir les plans d’actions en lien avec la cybersécurité. ● Effectuer les retrofits hardware / software IT réseau roche, la maintenance des réseaux instruments et les mises à jour des solutions en place chez nos clients. ● Installer et tester les solutions de télémaintenance Roche. ● Assurer la traçabilité et le reporting des interventions et upgrades réalisés. Ton ADN: ● Tu recherches une alternance pour ton Bac+4 ou 5 de 12/24 mois à compter de septembre 2026 ● De formation école d’ingénieurs spécialisé en informatique et réseau et cyber résilience, tu possède également une appétence dans le domaine de la santé. ● Tu as le sens de l’écoute et le sens des responsabilités . ● Autonomie et rigueur te caractérisent, tu aimes travailler en équipe. ● Tu possèdes un bon niveau d’anglais (B2). ● Tu aimes te déplacer et tu es titulaire du permis B depuis plus de 2 ans. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? - Cette alternance va te permettre de développer des compétences concrètes et solides en sécurités et architectures informatique et de découvrir le monde de la santé à travers les laboratoires d’analyses médicales. - Nous considérons les alternants et les stagiaires comme de véritables partenaires qui pourront être amenés à évoluer à nos côtés. Ta contribution, tes propositions seront écoutées et valorisées par les équipes. - Conformément à la réglementation, tous nos postes sont ouverts au recrutement de travailleurs handicapés. Si tu as besoin d’un aménagement spécifique en vue de l’entretien de recrutement, n’hésite pas à nous le signaler. - Tu cherches un sens à ce que tu fais ? Rejoins un groupe qui œuvre pour des projets à fort impact pour la santé de tous. Si tu es prêt(e) à faire partie de notre écosystème novateur et à propulser ta carrière avec Roche, envoie dès maintenant ta candidature! Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche ́s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organizzazione (pRED), facciamo farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti al fine di affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie non soddisfatte al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. Questa posizione si trova in Chimica Preclinica, Manifattura e Controlli (pCMC), un dipartimento all'interno della piccola organizzazione di ricerca molecola in modalità terapeutiche pRED, dove pave, in un ambiente diverso, ambizioso e innovativo, il percorso per portare droga candidati dalla prima ricerca allo sviluppo. L'opportunità Come Interno nel nostro team i vostri compiti principali includono:
• Eseguire e supportare l'ottimizzazione dei saggi di screening utilizzando sistemi di gestione liquida per accelerare il processo di pre-formulazione.
• Eseguire saggi manuali "head-to-head" in panchina per confrontare, convalidare e risolvere i risultati contro processi automatizzati, garantendo coerenza e precisione.
• Interpretare i set di dati complessi per fornire raccomandazioni sui miglioramenti del processo e sulla fattibilità della formulazione. Chi sei
• Sei uno sperimentatore meticoloso e indipendente che gode della risoluzione dei problemi
• Hai una laurea magistrale in chimica, scienze farmaceutiche, ingegneria chimica, o automazione con esperienza di laboratorio, laurea completata non più di 12 mesi prima della data di inizio stage
• Hai dimostrato esperienza di gestione dei liquidi (di solito Tecan/Fluent/Freedom EVO).
• Buone capacità di comunicazione scritte e verbali in inglese. Informazioni aggiuntive
• Data di inizio desiderata: 1 ottobre 2026 (negoziabile)
• Carico di lavoro: 100%
• Durata: 12 mesi
• Nota: Questo stage non è adatto per una tesi di laurea o dottorato. Processo di applicazione Per essere considerato per questa posizione, si prega di caricare i seguenti documenti:
• CV attuale
• Lettera di copertina
• Copia dei diplomi Requisiti per i cittadini non UE/EFTA: a causa della normativa svizzera, i seguenti documenti sono obbligatori per la vostra richiesta:
• Prova di iscrizione: devi rimanere ufficialmente iscritto alla tua università per tutta la durata dello stage.
• Mandatory Internship Letter: Un documento ufficiale della tua università conferma che lo stage è una parte richiesta del tuo curriculum. Ti interessa? Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere i tuoi documenti di applicazione completi! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position In Roche´s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed. This position is located in Preclinical Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (pCMC), a department within the small molecule research organization in pRED Therapeutic Modalities, where we pave, in a diverse, ambitious and innovative environment, the path to bring drug candidates from early research into development. The Opportunity As an Intern in our team your main tasks will include:
• Execute and support the optimization of screening assays using liquid handling systems to accelerate the pre-formulation pipeline.
• Perform "head-to-head" manual assays at the bench to compare, validate, and troubleshoot results against automated processes, ensuring consistency and accuracy.
• Interpret complex datasets to provide recommendations on process improvements and formulation viability. Who You Are
• You are a meticulous and independent experimentalist who enjoys troubleshooting
• You hold a Master’s degree in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemical Engineering, or Automation with lab experience, degree completed no more than 12 months prior to the internship start date
• You have proven experience operating liquid handlers (ideally Tecan/Fluent/Freedom EVO).
• Good written and verbal communication skills in English. Additional Information
• Desired Start Date: October 1, 2026 (Negotiable)
• Workload: 100%
• Duration: 12 months
• Note: This internship is not suitable for a Master’s or PhD thesis. Application Process To be considered for this position, please upload the following documents:
• Current CV
• Cover Letter
• Copy of Diplomas Requirements for Non-EU/EFTA Citizens: due to Swiss regulations, the following documents are mandatory for your application:
• Proof of Enrollment: You must remain officially enrolled at your university for the entire duration of the internship.
• Mandatory Internship Letter: An official document from your university confirming that the internship is a required part of your curriculum. Have we piqued your interest? We look forward to receiving your complete application documents! Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce de Roche (PRED), nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement l'innovation qui change la vie. Ce poste est situé dans la chimie préclinique, la fabrication et les contrôles (pCMC), un département au sein de l'organisme de recherche sur les petites molécules dans les Modalités thérapeutiques pRED, où nous posons, dans un environnement diversifié, ambitieux et innovateur, la voie pour apporter des médicaments les candidats des premières recherches au développement. L'opportunité En tant que stagiaire de notre équipe, vos tâches principales seront les suivantes :
• Exécuter et soutenir l'optimisation des tests de dépistage à l'aide de systèmes de manipulation des liquides pour accélérer le pipeline de préformulation.
• Effectuer des essais manuels « tête à tête » au banc pour comparer, valider et dépanner les résultats par rapport aux processus automatisés, en assurant la cohérence et la précision.
• Interpréter des ensembles de données complexes pour formuler des recommandations sur l'amélioration des processus et la viabilité de la formulation. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes un expérimental méticuleux et indépendant qui aime le dépannage
• Vous êtes titulaire d'une maîtrise en chimie, sciences pharmaceutiques, génie chimique ou automatisation avec expérience de laboratoire, diplôme complété au plus 12 mois avant la date de début du stage
• Vous avez prouvé l'expérience d'utilisation de gestionnaires de liquides (idéalement Tecan/Fluent/Freedom EVO).
• Bonnes compétences en communication écrite et verbale en anglais. Informations complémentaires
• Date de début souhaitée : 1er octobre 2026 (négociable)
• Charge de travail: 100%
• Durée: 12 mois
• Note: Ce stage n'est pas adapté pour une maîtrise ou une thèse de doctorat. Processus de demande Pour être considéré pour ce poste, veuillez télécharger les documents suivants :
• CV actuel
• Lettre de couverture
• Copie des diplômes Exigences pour les citoyens non membres de l'UE/AELE: en raison de la réglementation suisse, les documents suivants sont obligatoires pour votre demande:
• Preuve d'inscription: Vous devez rester officiellement inscrit à votre université pendant toute la durée du stage.
• Lettre de stage obligatoire : Document officiel de votre université confirmant que le stage fait partie intégrante de votre programme d'études. Avons-nous pincé votre intérêt ? Nous avons hâte de recevoir tous vos documents de candidature! Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche we believe it’s critical to deliver medical solutions now — even as we develop innovations for the future. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives and creating a healthier future for all. The IT Data Transfer and Migration Lead plays a critical role in supporting Roche’s Mergers & Acquisitions initiatives by leading enterprise-scale data migration and transfer strategies across complex systems and environments. This role partners closely with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure scalable, compliant, and efficient data migration solutions that support business continuity and operational excellence. Your Opportunity As a Data Transfer & Migration Lead, you will lead the design and execution of migration strategies for acquired and partnering organizations, ensuring data transfer activities are delivered efficiently, securely, and in compliance with enterprise and regulatory standards. In this role, you will:
• Lead the design, execution, and lifecycle management of enterprise-scale data transfer and migration strategies for Mergers & Acquisitions initiatives
• Design and implement scalable data architectures, advanced ETL/ELT frameworks, and automation tools to improve migration efficiency and reliability
• Drive technical excellence by mentoring engineering teams, setting architectural standards, and guiding complex technical decision-making
• Collaborate with business stakeholders, data owners, and technical teams to define migration rules aligned with Roche’s enterprise architecture and compliance requirements
• Ensure data infrastructure and migration platforms remain secure, resilient, scalable, and compliant with applicable standards including GxP where required
• Oversee system ownership and lifecycle management of data migration platforms, tools, and related operational processes
• Partner with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to align migration strategies with organizational priorities and business objectives Who you are You are a strategic and technically strong data engineering leader who thrives in complex, enterprise environments. You bring strong stakeholder management capabilities, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to lead high-impact transformation initiatives across global teams. To be successful in this role, you have:
• 10+ years of experience in data engineering, data migration, or enterprise data architecture within complex global environments
• Deep expertise in distributed systems, cloud data platforms, and advanced ETL/ELT patterns, with the ability to architect scalable data warehouses and data lakes
• Strong understanding of enterprise system interoperability, including platforms such as Veeva, SAP, ServiceNow, and related ecosystems
• Proven experience leading high-impact data migration or transformation projects with strong focus on governance, security, and operational resilience
• Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams, mentor engineers, and influence architectural decisions across cross-functional stakeholders
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience partnering with senior leadership on data strategy and execution
• Experience with event-driven architectures, streaming technologies, or AI-enabled data capabilities is considered an advantage Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today

Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Die Gelegenheit: Wir suchen derzeit nach zwei Prozesstechnikern, die sich an unserem Process Engineering-Team in einem 12-Monats-Vertrag mit der Möglichkeit der Erweiterung beteiligen. Beide Positionen werden die gleichen Tages-zu-Tage-Aufgaben beinhalten, die unten skizziert werden; aber eine der Rollen wird auch an unserem Standort Dumyat arbeiten müssen. Als Prozesstechniker arbeiten Sie eng mit den Sensorherstellern und Verpackungsteams zusammen und werden in allen Bereichen der Fertigung hochqualifiziert und kompetent (z.B. Linienbetrieb & Verpackung, Prozesse und Verfahren). Mit einem logischen Ansatz können Produkt- und Prozessprobleme schnell und effektiv diagnostiziert werden. Unterstützung und Förderung kontinuierlicher Verbesserungsinitiativen bei gleichzeitiger Sicherstellung der höchsten Qualität und Produktivität. Analyse von Fertigungsdaten und Durchführung von Produkt- / Prozesstests, um sicherzustellen, dass CTQs erfüllt sind. Aktualisieren von Dokumentationen wie Standard-Betriebsverfahren, Arbeitsanleitungen und Materialrechnungen. Dies ist eine Vor-Ort-Rolle, die an unserem Standort Athena Motherwell basiert. Bitte beachten Sie, dass Sie ca. 70% Ihrer Zeit aus unserer Bathgate-Website verbringen werden, aber eine der Rollen wird auch an unserer Dumyat-Standort arbeiten müssen. Aufgaben: Technische Daten:
• Arbeiten Sie in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Fertigungstechnikern und Ingenieuren, um in der Sensorfertigungsleitung Betrieb, Prozesse und Verfahren hoch kompetent zu werden
• Unterstützung der Überwachung von Produkt- und Prozessdaten durch statistische Analysetechniken
• Schnelle und effektive Diagnose und Fehlerbehebung von Problemen mit einem methodischen Ansatz und Bericht Fortschritte auf strukturierte Weise
• Durchführung von CTQ-Tests und Materialanalysen
• Untersuchung und Lösung von Nichtkonformitäten und Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung robuster OCAP- und Präventionsmaßnahmen
• Unterstützung von NPD-Projekten durch Übertragung von Pilotarbeiten auf Hochvolumenfertigung
• Unterstützung von Validierungsaktivitäten und Abschluss der Validierungsdokumentation im Einklang mit den Geschäftsanforderungen
• Unterstützung der kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen durch das Engagement des Produktionsteams bei Schichtarbeit
• Vergewissern Sie sich, dass höchste Qualität und Compliance eingehalten werden
• Änderung der Steuerungsaktualisierung von Blei/Unterstützung in der Fertigungsdokumentation.

• Process Excellence Yellow oder Green Gürtel zusätzlichen Vorteil.
• Vorzugsweise Grad qualifizierte oder relevante Erfahrung.
• Erfahrung in der Drehumwandlung und / oder Rolle zum Rollendruck (Rotationssieb / Flexografik etc.) zusätzlichen Vorteil

• GMP-Erfahrung
• Ein Hand-on-Prozesstechniker mit einem guten Niveau der relevanten Branchenerfahrung (vorzugsweise medizinische Geräte)
• Erfahrung der Optimierung von Produkt und Prozessen
• Hohes Niveau der Computerkompetenz
• Teamplayer und Berücksichtigung aller Fertigungsaufgaben
• Analyse von Produktionsdaten und Durchführung von Prozessen / Produktanalysen, um sicherzustellen, dass CTQs erfüllt werden
• Starke Problemlösungsfähigkeiten und Dringlichkeitsgefühl
• Detailorientiert und garantiert höchste Qualität und Produktivität werden täglich gepflegt

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position La possibilité : Nous sommes actuellement à la recherche de deux techniciens de process pour rejoindre notre équipe de Process Engineering sur un contrat de 12 mois, avec la possibilité de prolongation. Les deux postes comprendront les mêmes responsabilités quotidiennes décrites ci-dessous; toutefois, l'un des rôles devra aussi travailler à notre emplacement de Dumyat. En tant que technicien en process, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de fabrication et d'emballage des capteurs et vous deviendrez hautement qualifié et compétent dans tous les aspects de la fabrication (p. ex. fonctionnement et emballage en ligne, processus et procédures). Être en mesure de diagnostiquer les problèmes de produit et de processus rapidement et efficacement en utilisant une approche logique. Appuyer et diriger les initiatives d'amélioration continue tout en assurant le maintien des plus hauts niveaux de qualité et de productivité. Analyser les données de fabrication et effectuer des essais de produits et de procédés pour s'assurer que les CTQ sont respectés. Mettre à jour les documents tels que les procédures opérationnelles normalisées, les instructions de travail et les factures de matériel. C'est un rôle sur place basé sur notre site Athena Motherwell. Veuillez noter que vous passerez environ 70 % de votre temps à partir de notre site de Bathgate, mais que l'un des rôles devra aussi être celui de notre site de Dumyat. Responsabilités : Technique:
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les techniciens de fabrication et les ingénieurs pour devenir très compétents dans le fonctionnement de la ligne de fabrication de capteurs, les processus et les procédures
• Soutenir la surveillance des données sur les produits et les procédés au moyen de techniques d'analyse statistique
• Diagnostic rapide et efficace et dépannage des problèmes en utilisant une approche méthodique et rapporter les progrès de manière structurée
• Effectuer des essais CTQ et des techniques d'analyse des matériaux/produits
• Étudier et résoudre les non-conformités et aider à développer des OCAP et des mesures préventives robustes
• Soutenir les projets de la NPD par le transfert des travaux pilotes à la fabrication à haut volume
• Soutenir les activités de validation et compléter la documentation de validation en fonction des besoins opérationnels
• Aider à mener des initiatives d'amélioration continue par l'engagement de l'équipe de production en équipe
• Assurer le maintien des niveaux de qualité et de conformité les plus élevés
• Mise à jour du contrôle du changement de plomb/support à la documentation de fabrication.
• Assurer le maintien des niveaux de qualité et de conformité les plus élevés Qui vous êtes : Études essentielles / Qualifications :
• Processus Excellence Ceinture jaune ou verte avantage supplémentaire.
• De préférence Expérience qualifiée ou pertinente.
• Expérience en conversion rotative et / ou bobine à l'impression de bobines (écran rotatif / flexographique etc.) avantage supplémentaire
• Connaissance des méthodes et techniques d'analyse statistique Exigences (y compris les compétences clés):
• Expérience BPF
• Un technicien pratique en procédés possédant un bon niveau d'expérience dans l'industrie (de préférence lié à un appareil médical)
• Expérience d'optimisation des produits et des procédés
• Niveau élevé de connaissances en informatique
• Joueur d'équipe et prend la responsabilité de tout défi de fabrication
• Analyser les données de production et effectuer l'analyse des procédés/produits pour s'assurer que les CTQ sont respectés
• Compétences fortes en résolution de problèmes et sentiment d'urgence
• Des détails orientés et assure le maintien quotidien des niveaux les plus élevés de qualité et de productivité
• Connaissance des méthodes et techniques d'analyse statistique Processus de recrutement Phase I :
• Présentation de la lettre de présentation et du CV : évaluation des compétences techniques et de la motivation. Phase II:
• Entretien en personne à Athena Motherwell (avec les candidats présélectionnés plus tard) Objectif - notre objectif

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As our Communications & Corporate Affairs Partner , you will spearhead initiatives to engage stakeholders, influence policy, and articulate the organization's dedication to advancing health in line with Roche Philippines’ priorities. You will develop and implement strategic communication advocacy and campaigns that resonate with diverse audiences, driving our narrative with focused intent and clarity. This is a unique opportunity to lead critical initiatives, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and make a tangible difference in the healthcare landscape. What you will be working on: In this role, you will lead company advocacy and corporate reputation management by delivering purpose-driven communications. You will ensure a consistent narrative across internal and external stakeholders, markets, and cultures, collaborating cross-functionally to align communication strategies with healthcare and social sector priorities. Key responsibilities include but are not limited to.
• Strategic Communication & Brand Ambassadorship: Develops, enhances, and executes communication strategies for assigned therapeutic areas and corporate branding. Ensures Roche is flawlessly represented in all internal and external messaging, upholding a consistent commitment to excellence.
• Influence & Ecosystem Engagement: Manages interactions and builds strategic relationships with external media, patient groups, policymakers, and academics to advance advocacy goals and increase the company’s share of voice.
• Crisis Leadership & Reputation Management: Owns the communications strategy and execution during crisis situations, acting as the primary guardian of corporate reputation to mitigate risk and protect the brand.
• Championing Best Practices & Standards: Leads the development, implementation, and management of best-in-class communication policies, procedures, and templates to drive consistency, operational efficiency, and high-quality standards.
• Omnichannel Reach & Media Management: Manages and leverages Roche Philippines’ media channels to their fullest potential, expanding reach and impact through both traditional and digital platforms.
• Employee Engagement & Internal Culture: Leads internal communications and employee engagement initiatives, utilizing local and network resources to foster an inclusive, purpose-driven culture.
• Measuring Success & Continuous Improvement: Develops metrics and mechanisms to measure the results of communication plans and tactics, sharing best practices and identifying opportunities for ongoing optimization across the network.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Acts as a high-agility partner, collaborating with cross-functional teams (locally and globally) and external partners to ensure communication activities directly support the achievement of business objectives. Who you are: You are a Corporate Communications expert who demonstrates:
• Healthcare Passion: A strong understanding of health and pharmaceutical concepts, universal healthcare, access to medicines, and the building blocks of health, with proven experience in driving related advocacy initiatives
• Strategic Agility: Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, multi-tasking environment. You're a strategic thinker with a knack for systems-level organization
• Business Acumen: Strong understanding of market dynamics, organizational drivers, and financial indicators to make informed decisions that align with broader business goals. •

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione di Roche, siamo convinti che sia fondamentale fornire immediatamente soluzioni mediche, anche se sviluppiamo innovazioni per il futuro. Siamo appassionati di cambiare la vita dei pazienti e siamo coraggiosi nelle nostre decisioni e azioni. Crediamo che la buona azione significhi un mondo migliore. E' per questo che lavoriamo ogni giorno. Ci impegniamo alla precisione scientifica, all'etica indiscutibile e all'accesso alle innovazioni mediche per tutti. Lo facciamo oggi per creare una mattina migliore. L’organizzazione “Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst”, che fa parte della strategia aziendale globale, della sostenibilità e dei siti, fornisce l’infrastruttura per l’intero sito e lo sviluppa continuamente. Lavoriamo con tutti gli stakeholder: lungo tutta la catena del valore, dalla ricerca precoce alla cura dei pazienti. Qui, un modello di organizzazione moderna ti aspetta, in cui puoi portare i tuoi talenti in un'attività significativa indipendentemente. Garantiamo spazio per la creatività e la libertà di scelta nella nostra organizzazione. Non puoi trovare i superiori classici con noi. Nei vostri ruoli come esperto di servizi digitali e ingegnere digitale per ServiceNow nel gruppo Roche, siete la forza trainante dietro la digitalizzazione coerente e l'automazione dei nostri processi. L'attenzione è rivolta al massiccio supporto tecnico e allo sviluppo strategico del Portale dei Servizi del Sito basato su ServiceNow. Non si è soddisfatti dei processi manuali esistenti, ma si analizzano processi aziendali complessi per trasformarli in flussi di lavoro automatizzati e digitali. In questo modo, sfruttate pienamente le capacità della piattaforma ServiceNow per creare soluzioni intelligenti che eliminano le interruzioni dei media e aumentano significativamente l'efficienza. Sei responsabile dell'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità di questi processi automatizzati nel portale e assicurati che l'applicazione funzioni in modo intuitivo e senza intoppi per gli utenti. La vostra competenza amministrativa garantisce anche la stabilità e la scalabilità del sistema, monitora le prestazioni e adatta i processi digitali a nuove esigenze. Il vostro obiettivo è quello di espandere il Portale di Servizio del Sito in una piattaforma di self-service scalabile che consente di risparmiare tempo prezioso attraverso l'automazione e stabilisce uno standard digitale moderno per l'intera azienda. La tua opzione
• In collaborazione con il team, gestisci il funzionamento quotidiano del Portale Servizio Sito e garantisci la stabilità, l'efficienza e la scalabilità della piattaforma ServiceNow. Sviluppi nuovi processi digitali, fai errori proattivi e implementa continuamente miglioramenti per mantenere i nostri processi digitali in movimento con le esigenze dinamiche dell'azienda.
• Stai collegando le nostre soluzioni digitali integrando nuovi servizi e flussi di lavoro automatizzati nel portale. In stretto coordinamento con il nostro ServiceNow Expert: interni, reparti e business, garantirai una connettività senza soluzione di continuità e un flusso regolare di dati tra i processi di backend e l'applicazione finale nel portale. Il vostro ruolo è fondamentale per mantenere il percorso dalla richiesta di soluzione automatizzata il più breve possibile.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The position At Roche, we are convinced that it is essential to provide medical solutions immediately – even if we develop innovations for the future. We are passionate about changing the lives of patients and are courageous in our decisions and actions. We believe that good action is a better world. That's why we get to work every day. We work with all stakeholders: along the entire value chain, from early research to patient care. Here, a modern organization model awaits you, in which you can bring your talents into a meaningful activity independently. We guarantee space for creativity and freedom of choice in our organization. You can't find classic superiors with us. In your roles as Digital Service Expert and Digital Engineer for ServiceNow in Roche's Digital Services group, you are the driving force behind the consistent digitization and automation of our processes. The focus is on the massive technical support and strategic development of the Site Service Portal based on ServiceNow. You are not satisfied with existing manual processes, but you analyze complex business processes to transform them into automated, digital workflows. In doing so, you fully exploit the capabilities of the ServiceNow platform to create intelligent solutions that eliminate media breaks and significantly increase efficiency. You are responsible for seamless integration of these automated processes into the portal and make sure that the application works intuitively and smoothly for users. Your administrative expertise also ensures the stability and scalability of the system, monitors the performance and adapts the digital processes to new requirements. Your goal is to expand the Site Service Portal into a scalable self-service platform that saves valuable time through automation and sets a modern, digital standard for the entire company. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Mission As a GPC Global Compliance Assurance Lead, you will play a key role in ensuring the GPC - Global Patient Care Organization has the highest quality standards and remains compliant at all times. You will lead and manage a team of GPC Compliance Assurance Leads, Compliance Assurance Specialists and PRI & Case Monitoring Specialists. You will ensure Roche and partners' products and solutions meet global regulations, corporate standards, and expectations by overseeing the monitoring, reviewing, and timely reporting on the quality of interactions. You will help maintain an effective quality management system and governance, globally, and continually improve the governance to meet evolving business and compliance needs. Together with your team, you will implement a common quality framework across the GPC Hubs. You will analyze results regularly, conceive corrective and preventive measures in case of findings, and collaborate in the design of training concepts to overcome identified knowledge gaps. You will ensure the GPC Organization complies with regulatory requirements and corporate standards. You will communicate significant quality, or regulatory issues and risks that may impact operations or regulatory compliance to local, regional or global management. In addition, you will be accountable for the preparation, coordination, and conduct of audits, ensuring the GPC Organization operates in an “inspection ready” manner and that audit measures are strictly implemented. Key Accountabilities
• Effectively lead and develop a team of GPC Compliance Assurance Leads, Specialists and PRI & Case Monitoring Specialists.
• Design, implement, and continuously improve the Global Compliance Governance Model and related monitoring standards.
• Accountable for the end-to-end audit process, including preparation work, managing the audit schedule, and ensuring the timely implementation of audit-related measures.
• Implement and follow up on measures to continuously maintain or optimize the overall compliance of GPC in the processing and documentation of customer concerns.
• Act as a contact person and expert with the different interfaces for all quality and compliance topics, proactively and in an advisory manner.
• Main responsible for auditing and analyzing the compliance levels of the cases handled by GPC Advisors.
• Close collaboration with global safety and post-market quality teams to ensure end-to-end compliance in the complaint handling process.
• Foster a culture of excellence, inclusivity, and collaboration while driving team and individual performance.
• Cultivate an inspiring team environment that promotes diversity, overcoming the challenges of a multi-location setup.
• Ensure the team delivers exceptional service while optimizing efficiency and effectiveness through continuous improvement.
• Drive the talent acquisition and hiring process, focusing on retaining top talent and maintaining a positive work environment.
• Provide proactive feedback and coaching to team members, managing performance and contributing to succession planning and talent management. Key skills and Experience
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
• A fluent command of English is a must; any other language is a plus.
• Proven leadership experience, preferably in an international setting in a medical regulated environment.
• Knowledge of Roche products, solutions, and systems is recommended.
• Minimum 4 years of experience in Quality Assurance, Comp

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Come scienziato nello sviluppo farmaceutico, fai parte del Dipartimento “Sviluppo farmaceutico” di Pharma Technical Development (PTD) di Basilea, Svizzera. Il dipartimento di sviluppo farmaceutico è responsabile per lo sviluppo di prodotti farmaceutici parenterali ( molecole sintetiche e biologiche) dalla fase 1 al lancio. Le attività comprendono la formulazione e lo sviluppo del processo di produzione per i prodotti farmaceutici parenterali per tutte le fasi cliniche e il lancio del mercato, il trasferimento del prodotto e del processo ai siti di produzione commerciale, il supporto commerciale del prodotto e lo sviluppo dell'estensione della linea. L'opportunità
• Sviluppo leader: sviluppo farmaceutico delle formulazioni parenterali per lo sviluppo e il mercato clinico (comprese le estensioni di linea). Comprendere il comportamento della stabilità (ad esempio biofisica, degradazione chimica)
• Gestione dei dati: garantire l'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità dei dati strutturati e non strutturati in tutto il dipartimento.
• Data Mining & Pattern Discovery: Utilizzare tecniche di statistica e machine learning avanzate per eseguire l'estrazione di dati in profondità. Identificare le tendenze e le correlazioni associate ai dati scientifici.
• Competenze funzionali come project management: Rappresentanza dello Sviluppo Farmaceutico come responsabile del progetto farmaceutico nei team CMC globali, rappresentante funzionale in team interfunzionali e comitati globali all'interno di Roche.
• Inserimenti normativi: autorizzare sezioni di prodotti farmaceutici per IND/IMPDs clinici e MAAs. Chi sei Come candidato di successo si possiede un dottorato di ricerca in ingegneria chimica/processo/bioprocesso o campi correlati O si possiede un master in ingegneria chimica/processo/bioprocesso o campi correlati con un minimo di 3 anni di esperienza professionale (industria) in un'azienda farmaceutica.
• Provata esperienza di stabilire e gestire grandi set di dati, compresa l'esposizione a script associati all'analisi dei dati.
• Profonda comprensione della modellazione statistica, tra cui regressione lineare/logistica, analisi dei cluster, previsione delle serie temporali, analisi dei dati di studio longitudinale e test multivariato.
• Conoscenza dello sviluppo dei prodotti farmaceutici e dei requisiti associati.
• Comprensione dei requisiti normativi per diverse fasi cliniche e commerciali di sviluppo.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e comportamenti collaborativi, con il pensiero end-to-end e globale, nonché eccellenti capacità di gestione degli stakeholder Sei pronto a fare la differenza per i nostri pazienti? Non vediamo l'ora della tua applicazione – unisciti a noi ora e diventi parte del nostro viaggio! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Scientist in Pharmaceutical Development, you are part of the Department “Pharmaceutical Development” in Pharma Technical Development (PTD) in Basel, Switzerland. The department Pharmaceutical Development is responsible for the development of parenteral drug products (Synthetic molecules and Biologics) from Phase 1 through Launch. Activities encompass formulation and manufacturing process development for parenteral drug products for all clinical stages and the market launch, the transfer of product and process to commercial manufacturing sites, commercial product support and line extension development. The opportunity
• Leading development: Pharmaceutical development of parenteral formulations for clinical development and market (including line extensions). Understanding stability behavior (e.g. biophysics, chemical degradation)
• Management of Data: Ensure seamless integration of structured and unstructured data across the department.
• Data Mining & Pattern Discovery: Utilize advanced statistical and machine learning techniques to perform deep-dive Data Mining. Identify trends and correlations associated with scientific data.
• Functional expertise as project management: Representation of Pharmaceutical Development as pharmaceutical project leader in global CMC teams, functional representative in cross-functional teams and global committees within Roche.
• Regulatory submissions: Authoring drug product sections for clinical IND/IMPDs and MAAs. Who you are As the successful candidate you hold a Ph.D. degree in chemical/process/bioprocess engineering or related fields Or you hold a masters degree in chemical/process/bioprocess engineering or related fields with a minimum of 3 years of professional (industry) experience in a pharmaceutical company.
• Proven experience of establishing and managing large data sets, including exposure to scripting associated with data analysis.
• Deep understanding of statistical modeling including linear/logistic regression, cluster analysis, time-series forecasting, longitudinal study data analysis, and multivariate testing.
• Knowledge of pharmaceutical product development and associated requirements.
• Understanding of regulatory requirements for different clinical and commercial stages of development.
• Excellent communication skills and collaborative behaviors, with end-to-end and global thinking, as well as excellent stakeholder management skills Are you ready to make a difference for our patients? We are looking forward to your application – join us now and become part of our journey! Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Die Abteilung Pharma Development ist verantwortlich für die Entwicklung von parenteralen Arzneimitteln (Synthetische Moleküle und Biologik) von Phase 1 bis Launch. Aktivitäten umfassen die Entwicklung von Formulierungen und Herstellungsprozessen für parenterale Arzneimittel für alle klinischen Stadien und die Markteinführung, die Übertragung von Produkt und Prozess auf kommerzielle Produktionsstätten, kommerzielle Produktunterstützung und Linienerweiterung Entwicklung. Die Gelegenheit
• Führende Entwicklung: Pharmazeutische Entwicklung von parenteralen Formulierungen für die klinische Entwicklung und den Markt (einschließlich Linienerweiterungen). Verstehen von Stabilitätsverhalten (z.B. Biophysik, chemischer Abbau)
• Datenmanagement: Gewährleistung einer nahtlosen Integration strukturierter und unstrukturierter Daten in der gesamten Abteilung.
• Data Mining & Pattern Discovery: Verwenden Sie fortschrittliche statistische und maschinelle Lerntechniken, um Deep-Dive Data Mining durchzuführen. Identifizieren Sie Trends und Korrelationen, die mit wissenschaftlichen Daten verbunden sind.
• Funktionskompetenz als Projektmanagement: Vertretung der Pharma-Entwicklung als Pharma-Projektleiter in globalen CMC-Teams, funktioneller Vertreter in funktionsübergreifenden Teams und globalen Gremien in Roche.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que Scientifique en Développement Pharmaceutique, vous faites partie du département Développement Pharmaceutique (PTD) à Bâle, Suisse. Le ministère du Développement pharmaceutique est responsable de la mise au point de produits pharmaceutiques parentéraux (molécules de synthèse et produits biologiques) de la phase 1 jusqu'au lancement. Les activités comprennent la formulation et l'élaboration de procédés de fabrication pour les produits pharmaceutiques parentéraux pour toutes les étapes cliniques et le lancement du marché, le transfert de produits et de procédés vers des sites de fabrication commerciale, le soutien des produits commerciaux et le développement d'extensions de gamme. L'opportunité
• Développement avancé: Développement pharmaceutique de formulations parentérales pour le développement clinique et le marché (y compris les extensions de lignées). Comprendre le comportement de stabilité (par exemple biophysique, dégradation chimique)
• Gestion des données : assurer une intégration transparente des données structurées et non structurées dans l'ensemble du département.
• Data Mining & Pattern Discovery: Utilisez des techniques avancées de statistique et d'apprentissage automatique pour effectuer l'extraction de données en profondeur. Déterminer les tendances et les corrélations associées aux données scientifiques.
• Expertise fonctionnelle en tant que gestion de projet : Représentation du développement pharmaceutique en tant que chef de projet pharmaceutique dans les équipes mondiales du CMC, représentant fonctionnel dans les équipes interfonctionnelles et les comités mondiaux au sein de Roche.
• Présentations réglementaires : Autoriser les sections des produits pharmaceutiques pour les ID/IMPD cliniques et les AAM. Qui vous êtes En tant que candidat retenu, vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat en génie chimique/procédé/bioprocédé ou dans des domaines connexes. Ou vous êtes titulaire d'une maîtrise en génie chimique/procédé/bioprocédé ou dans des domaines connexes avec un minimum de 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle (industrie) dans une entreprise pharmaceutique.
• Expérience éprouvée de l'établissement et de la gestion de grands ensembles de données, y compris l'exposition à des scripts associés à l'analyse des données.
• Compréhension approfondie de la modélisation statistique, y compris la régression linéaire/logistique, l'analyse en grappes, la prévision de séries chronologiques, l'analyse longitudinale des données des études et les essais multivariés.
• Connaissance du développement des produits pharmaceutiques et des exigences connexes.
• Compréhension des exigences réglementaires pour les différents stades cliniques et commerciaux du développement.
• Excellentes compétences en communication et comportement collaboratif, avec une réflexion de bout en bout et globale, ainsi que d'excellentes compétences en gestion des parties prenantes Êtes-vous prêt à faire la différence pour nos patients ? Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Procurement Manager – Research & Lab Materials Roche India - Roche Services & Solutions Hyderabad A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next. The Opportunity This role sits within the Materials, Manufacturing & CAPEX Procurement Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution. The Materials, Manufacturing & CAPEX Procurement Delivery group comprises many communities grouping categories of the same value chain or having commonality, including Raw Materials, External Manufacturing Services, Logistics, Research & Laboratory Materials, and Engineering (CAPEX). Within Research & Laboratory Materials, we cover two categories:
• Lab Chemicals & Consumables (LCC)
• Lab Equipment & Maintenance (LEM) This structure enables strong category expertise while allowing flexibility in the procurement delivery response to the evolving needs of our customers. As a Procurement Manager, you will bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Using your specialized knowledge and in-depth expertise in project management and procurement overall, you will proactively identify and drive strategies and approaches for managing and sourcing third-party spend requirements. You can also play the role of Category Strategy Owner in charge of driving, coordinating, and signing the category strategy. You will collaborate with internal procurement functions (such as Business Partners, Solutions, Analytics, Contracting, etc.) and business stakeholders to build and implement comprehensive LEM/LCC sourcing and spend management strategies that are aligned to business needs and functional objectives. You will work closely with other team members, as a peer coach, project, or workstream lead to identify opportunities to aggregate customer demand, drive buying channel automation, deliver on day-to-day activities, and provide capacity, expertise, and oversight to productivity and other customer-oriented projects/solutions. As a Procurement Manager, you will play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and business requirements, including but not limited to:
• You are a category and sourcing subject matter expert, conducting market and internal analysis to develop strategies, best practices, and guidance on tactical plans for how Roche should source, negotiate, and manage suppliers in this space to maximize value for Roche.
• You are a procurement delivery practitioner delivering and executing sourcing strategies and major initiatives by leveraging spend, category know-how, robust sourcing, negotiation, contracting, supplier management methodologies, and project management s

• Precedente esperienza in società di consulenza che lavorano con tempi di risposta rapidi.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Responsibilities:
• The HSP partners with healthcare system stakeholders to drive healthcare system innovation and unlock possibilities to deliver value for the ecosystem and society
• As part of this, the HSP contributes to identifying, mapping, engaging and managing ecosystem stakeholders.
• The HSP acts as trusted partner and the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche. She or he shares the stakeholder community vision and value internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster.
• The Healthcare System Partner lives the Visionary, Architect, Coach, Catalyst (VACC) model, acts as catalyst and coach externally and internally.
• The role is empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally and from the network as needed, including in collaboration with other Healthcare System Partners and Patient Journey Partners.
• The HSP looks across the individual ecosystem and catalyzes our ability to see broader trends and patterns in healthcare systems. They need to bring outside insights into Roche to influence strategy AND to bring our expertise, science and knowledge out to the ecosystem Experiences, Knowledge and Qualifications: Skills & Experience:
• Deep understanding of healthcare system, processes and governance
• Excellent customer engagement and management skills
• Experience leading cross functional teams is required. Cross-functional leadership experience in both formulating cross-functional strategies and orchestrating cross-functional teams is desirable.
• System thinker and deep listener
• A sensitive leader who senses, reflects and responds
• Strong business acumen with desired expertise in commercialization and customer experience excellence
• Ability to understand and leverage digital means and tools for the benefit of all stakeholders is highly desirable.
• Able to manage complex projects Knowledge
• Broad understanding of Roche’s present portfolio and future pipeline, such that they can work on future-based solutions Capabilities:
• Fluent in local language. Proficient in English to collaborate internally across the broader Roche enterprise is highly desirable. Preferred Qualifications:
• University degree (scientific, economic, or business degree). An advanced degree in Life science and/or MBA is a plus.
• Practical understanding of digital innovation methodologies
• Education in health policy
• CCXA Academy (desirable) Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come.
