We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Purpose of the role Roche is the world’s largest biotech company, with truly differentiated medicines in oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, ophthalmology and diseases of the central nervous system. Roche is also the world leader in-vitro diagnostics and tissue-based cancer diagnostics, and a frontrunner in diabetes management. The Diagnostics Insights Solutions Team is part of Roche Diagnostics . We focus on developing and commercialising larger solutions with multiple components (digital products, physical products, and service offerings) to create value beyond individual products by comprehensively addressing customer needs. As a Technical Solution Management Associate you will act as a bridge between business needs and technical implementation of our solutions portfolio. You will work hand in hand with our team and different Solution Teams in the organization to support them with the automation of processes, contributing to the alignment with organizational objectives. Your main area of responsibility will be the application of Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence technologies to design and develop tailored tools to bring the end-to-end management of digital solutions to the next level. Main responsibilities As a Technical Solution Management Associate, your core responsibilities will include:
• Contribution to Ideation and Design: Actively participate in the ideation, analysis, and evaluation of solutions within the team's scope with the objective of optimizing processes and augmenting transparency and traceability with data.
• Process Optimization Tool Development: Identify opportunities for improvement and enhance solution management by leveraging data analytics and AI tools for diverse stakeholder groups (e.g., solution teams, affiliate members, or the broader organization). Additionally, identify inefficient processes and create tools to automate or streamline them.
• Team management (e.g. lean portfolio management, Aha! Automation, etc.)
• Technical solution management (e.g. requirements, version control,...)
• End-to-End solution management (e.g. coordination of solutions portfolio, traceability,...)
• Solution Lifecycle Management Support: Assisting with the administrative and documentation tasks related to the different stages of the lifecycle of complex software solutions.
• Reporting and Metrics Creation: Supporting the creation of data-driven tools to track the performance and adoption of key organizational solutions.
• Sustainable Development: Define the necessary maintenance and sustainability tasks to ensure the continued relevance and accuracy of the developed tools by e.g. enabling seamless retraining with new or updated training data. How would your day to day look like? As Technical Solution Management Associate in the Diagnostics Insights Solutions team, you'll work closely with our team members (Business Solution Managers and Technical Solution Managers) as well as cross-functional partners from across the organization. This role offers a great opportunity to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders, including product managers, marketing leads, definition teams, engineering teams and subject matter experts. The successful candidate will play a dual role, handling management and administrative support tasks related to organizational solutions, while also developing and implementing tools to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of our internal processes. • Good knowledge and experience in pathology/molecular solutions - an advantage.
• Fluent in English (oral and written).
• Technical vocabulary & terminology.
• Advanced computer skills (Windows and Microsoft Office).
• Experience in laboratory practice and/or experience in the use of automated laboratory equipment (Roche instruments preferably).
• Experience in laboratory manual practice and chemicals handling.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione A Roche, siamo guidati da un'ambizione condivisa: creare un futuro più sano attraverso l'innovazione continua, avanzando la scienza e espandendo l'accesso alla sanità per le persone in tutto il mondo. Il nostro scopo è quello di aiutare a costruire un mondo in cui le persone possono trascorrere più tempo con coloro che importano di più. Man mano che l'assistenza sanitaria continua a evolversi, Global Procurement si sta trasformando per offrire un maggior valore strategico: migliorare le partnership dei fornitori, guidare l'innovazione e migliorare i risultati per i pazienti e i sistemi sanitari a livello globale. Gestire attivamente un ecosistema di fornitori complesso, ci assicuriamo di soddisfare le esigenze di oggi, anticipando quelle di domani. L'opportunità In qualità di Lead di partner commerciali di analisi e informazioni, guiderai la direzione strategica di Analytics all'interno del capitolo Procurement Enablement. Questa funzione è centrale per la costruzione di un'organizzazione di appalti di classe migliore attraverso intuizioni basate sui dati, governance, sviluppo delle capacità e innovazione digitale. Potrai modellare come i dati vengono sfruttati attraverso Global Procurement, sbloccando il suo pieno potenziale per informare il processo decisionale, le prestazioni di guida e creare impatto commerciale tangibile. Operando in un ambiente altamente dinamico e globale, guiderai i team ad applicare il pensiero strutturato, l'analisi avanzata e le intuizioni attuabili a complesse sfide aziendali. Il tuo impatto In questo ruolo di leadership, si agirà come consulente strategico e costruttore di capacità, lavorando tra i team di Procurement, Finance e Analytics cross-functional. Potrai guidare, allenare e ispirare gli altri offrendo soluzioni di analisi ad alto impatto e promuovere una forte cultura basata sui dati. Le principali aree di responsabilità includono:
• Impostare la visione e la strategia per l'analisi e le intuizioni all'interno del business partnering, allineando con gli obiettivi di Global Procurement più ampi
• Agire come esperto di materia senior, guidando le migliori pratiche nella strategia dei dati, analisi, visualizzazione e generazione di informazioni
• Condurre lo sviluppo e il miglioramento continuo dei prodotti, dei framework e delle soluzioni scalabili di Analytics
• influenzare gli stakeholder senior per incorporare il processo decisionale basato sui dati e migliorare la qualità dei dati in tutta l'organizzazione
• Costruire e sviluppare team altamente performanti, contribuendo a iniziative, team e programmi multifunzionali
• Campione dell'innovazione individuando opportunità di sfruttare nuove tecnologie, metodologie e modi di lavoro Chi sei Sei un leader esperto con un forte record di traccia in Analytics, Procurement e gestione account all'interno di organizzazioni complesse e matrici. Porti sia la visione strategica che l'esperienza pratica, insieme alla capacità di influenzare ai massimi livelli. tipicamente porterà:
• Preferito un diploma universitario (business, analisi o scienze della vita)
• 10+ anni di esperienza nella consulenza per appalti, analisi, analisi aziendale o gestione
• Esperienza comprovata che traduce complesse sfide aziendali in soluzioni analitiche scalabili
• Forte capacità di comunicazione esecutiva, con la capacità di influenzare e guidare l'adozione di nuove strategie e tecnologie
• Profonda esperienza nella generazione dei dati, della visualizzazione e dell'intuizione, unita a team e iniziative leader di esperienza
• L'esperienza di gestione della categoria è altamente vantaggiosa
• Esperienza di gestione account precedente anche auspicabile
• Fluenza in inglese
• Mindset Leadership Incorpori una mentalità aziendale, pensando oltre i confini funzionali per creare solu integrato, customer-centric

The Position At Roche, we are driven by a shared ambition: to create a healthier future through continuous innovation, advancing science, and expanding access to healthcare for people worldwide. Our purpose is to help build a world where people can spend more time with those who matter most. As healthcare continues to evolve, Global Procurement is transforming to deliver greater strategic value—enhancing supplier partnerships, driving innovation, and improving outcomes for patients and healthcare systems globally. By actively managing a complex supplier ecosystem, we ensure we meet today’s needs while anticipating those of tomorrow. The Opportunity As Analytics & Insights Business Partnering Lead , you will lead the strategic direction of Analytics within the Procurement Enablement chapter. This function is central to building a best-in-class Procurement organization through data-driven insights, governance, capability development, and digital innovation. You will shape how data is leveraged across Global Procurement, unlocking its full potential to inform decision-making, drive performance, and create tangible business impact. Operating in a highly dynamic, global environment, you will guide teams to apply structured thinking, advanced Analytics, and actionable insights to complex business challenges. Your Impact In this leadership role, you will act as a strategic advisor and capability builder, working across Procurement, Finance, and cross-functional Analytics teams. You will lead, coach, and inspire others while delivering high-impact Analytics solutions and fostering a strong data-driven culture. Key areas of accountability include:
• Setting the vision and strategy for Analytics and insights within business partnering, aligning with broader Global Procurement objectives
• Acting as a senior subject matter expert, guiding best practices in data strategy, Analytics, visualization, and insight generation
• Leading the development and continuous improvement of Analytics products, frameworks, and scalable solutions
• Influencing senior stakeholders to embed data-driven decision-making and improve data quality across the organization
• Building and developing high-performing teams, while contributing to cross-functional initiatives, squads, and enterprise-wide programs

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Bei Roche sind wir von einem gemeinsamen Ehrgeiz angetrieben: eine gesündere Zukunft durch kontinuierliche Innovation zu schaffen, Wissenschaft voranzutreiben und den Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung für Menschen weltweit zu erweitern. Da sich die Gesundheitsversorgung weiter entwickelt, verwandelt sich Global Procurement um einen größeren strategischen Wert – die Förderung von Lieferantenpartnerschaften, das Fahren von Innovation und die Verbesserung der Ergebnisse für Patienten und Gesundheitssysteme weltweit. Durch die aktive Verwaltung eines komplexen Lieferanten-Ökosystems stellen wir sicher, dass wir die heutigen Bedürfnisse erfüllen und die von morgen erwarten. • Als hochrangiger Fachexperte handeln, Best Practices in der Datenstrategie, Analytics, Visualisierung und Wissensgenerierung leiten
• Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Analytics Produkten, Frameworks und skalierbaren Lösungen

• Aufbau und Entwicklung leistungsfähiger Teams, während sie zu funktionsübergreifenden Initiativen, Teams und unternehmensweiten Programmen beitragen
• Innovationsmeisterschaft durch die Identifizierung von Möglichkeiten, neue Technologien, Methoden und Arbeitsweisen zu nutzen Wer bist du? • Erprobte Erfahrung, die komplexe geschäftliche Herausforderungen in skalierbare analytische Lösungen überträgt

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chez Roche, nous sommes animés par une ambition commune : créer un avenir plus sain grâce à l'innovation continue, faire progresser la science et élargir l'accès aux soins de santé pour les gens du monde entier. Notre but est d'aider à construire un monde où les gens peuvent passer plus de temps avec ceux qui comptent le plus. À mesure que les soins de santé continuent d'évoluer, l'approvisionnement mondial se transforme pour offrir une plus grande valeur stratégique – améliorer les partenariats avec les fournisseurs, stimuler l'innovation et améliorer les résultats pour les patients et les systèmes de santé à l'échelle mondiale. En gérant activement un écosystème de fournisseurs complexe, nous nous assurons de répondre aux besoins d'aujourd'hui tout en anticipant ceux de demain. L'opportunité En tant que responsable des partenariats d'affaires, vous dirigerez l'orientation stratégique de l'analyse dans le chapitre sur l'activation des achats. Cette fonction est essentielle à la mise sur pied d'une organisation d'approvisionnement de qualité grâce à des données, à la gouvernance, au développement des capacités et à l'innovation numérique. Vous façonnerez la façon dont les données sont exploitées dans l'ensemble de l'approvisionnement mondial, en débloquant tout son potentiel pour éclairer la prise de décisions, stimuler les performances et créer un impact commercial tangible. Fonctionnant dans un environnement mondial très dynamique, vous guiderez les équipes pour appliquer la pensée structurée, l'analytique avancée et des idées pragmatiques aux défis opérationnels complexes. Votre impact Dans ce rôle de leadership, vous jouerez le rôle de conseiller stratégique et de bâtisseur de capacités, travaillant dans les équipes d'Approvisionnement, de Finances et d'Analyse interfonctionnelle. Vous dirigerez, coacherez et inspirerez d'autres personnes tout en fournissant des solutions d'analyse à impact élevé et en favorisant une culture fortement axée sur les données. Les principaux domaines de responsabilité sont les suivants :
• Définir la vision et la stratégie pour l'analyse et les idées au sein des partenaires commerciaux, en s'harmonisant avec les objectifs plus généraux d'approvisionnement mondial
• En tant qu'expert principal en la matière, guider les meilleures pratiques en matière de stratégie de données, d'analyse, de visualisation et de production de connaissances
• Diriger le développement et l'amélioration continue des produits, cadres et solutions d'analyse évolutives
• Influencer les hauts responsables sur la prise de décisions fondées sur les données et améliorer la qualité des données dans l'ensemble de l'organisation
• Créer et développer des équipes performantes, tout en contribuant à des initiatives, des équipes et des programmes interfonctionnels
• Promouvoir l'innovation en identifiant les possibilités de tirer parti des nouvelles technologies, méthodologies et méthodes de travail Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un leader expérimenté avec une solide expérience dans l'analyse, l'approvisionnement et la gestion de comptes au sein d'organisations complexes et matricielles. Vous apportez une vision stratégique et une expertise pratique, ainsi que la capacité d'influencer au plus haut niveau. Vous apporterez généralement:
• Diplôme universitaire (business, Analytics ou sciences de la vie préférée)
• 10 ans et plus d'expérience en achats, en analyse, en analyse d'entreprise ou en conseil en gestion
• Expérience éprouvée transformant des défis complexes en solutions analytiques évolutives
• Fortes compétences en communication avec les cadres, avec la capacité d'influencer et de stimuler l'adoption de nouvelles stratégies et technologies
• Une expertise approfondie en matière de données, de visualisation et de production de connaissances, associée à l'expérience d'équipes et d'initiatives de premier plan
• L'expérience de gestion de catégorie est très avantageuse
• Une expérience antérieure de la gestion des comptes est également souhaitable
• Connaissance de l'anglais
• L'esprit de leadership Vous incarnez un état d'esprit d'entreprise, en pensant au-delà des frontières fonctionnelles pour créer un solu intégré et axé sur le client

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED ) , facciamo medicinali trasformativi per i pazienti al fine di affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. Il Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza (CoE) è un'organizzazione globale che consente alle unità di ricerca e sviluppo precoce di Roche (pRED e gRED) di diventare più basate sui dati, più digitalmente adept, e meglio preparate per le sfide del futuro. All'interno del CoE, la Medicina Computazionale si concentra sullo sviluppo e l'applicazione di soluzioni di analisi dei dati innovative per supportare lo sviluppo clinico, migliorando la nostra comprensione della malattia, della progressione della malattia e della risposta individuale del paziente al trattamento. In collaborazione con i nostri scienziati attraverso pRED e gRED, creiamo farmaci migliori aumentando ogni parte della R&D attraverso la nostra cultura data-driven. Come Digital Measures Lead , si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nell'integrazione di tecnologie di salute digitale basate sui sensori nel cuore dei nostri programmi di sviluppo di droga pRED e gRED. Nelle aree di malattia come il morbo di Alzheimer e la Sclerosi Multipla, sarete responsabili di modellare ed eseguire strategie che ci permettono di aumentare la produttività R&D utilizzando le valutazioni dei risultati clinici digitali, i biomarcatori digitali e le misure digitali esplorative raccolte da wearables, smartphone e altre tecnologie di salute digitale basate sui sensori (DHT). Sarete parte di un team di esperti che si trova a Basilea e nel sud di San Francisco e riferirete al gruppo Sensor Data Insights leader nel reparto Biologia e Medicina Computazionale. L'opportunità:
• Collaborare con i team di sviluppo della droga per creare opportunità ad alto impatto che favoriscano i miglioramenti della produttività di trial clinici con DHT basati sui sensori; integrarli in aree di malattia, sviluppo clinico e strategie di biomarcatore.

Pharma Technical Development (PTD) fait partie intégrante de la mission de Roches visant à développer des médicaments innovants et transformatifs significatifs pour les patients en appliquant une expertise technique de premier plan pour concevoir, développer, fournir et enregistrer des produits de stade clinique à l'échelle mondiale. L'opportunité En tant que TDL, vous dirigerez des équipes de développement technique (TDT) pour élaborer et piloter des stratégies de chimie, de fabrication et de contrôle (CMC) pour les candidats aux médicaments cliniques, depuis les premiers essais humains jusqu'au lancement du produit, en assurant l'intégrité technique et l'atténuation proactive des risques.
• Leadership: Diriger les équipes techniques tout au long du cycle de vie du produit, du développement préclinique au lancement du produit, en assurant l'intégrité scientifique de la stratégie CMC.
• Stratégie et exécution : Concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies techniques multiformes - englobant les processus de fabrication, les configurations de produits et d'appareils pharmaceutiques et les chaînes d'approvisionnement mondiales - pour assurer une approbation réglementaire et un succès commercial sans faille.
• Alignement et gouvernance de l'entreprise : offre des perspectives à l'échelle de l'entreprise pour s'assurer que les produits livrables restent axés sur le patient et le client; sert de liaison principale avec les équipes d'actifs, les cadres supérieurs et les comités de gouvernance, fournissant des mises à jour transparentes qui facilitent la prise de décisions éclairées.
• Excellence opérationnelle : Supervise le développement de bout en bout du MCC, y compris la gérance financière, la prévision des ressources et le suivi des étapes pour assurer une exécution parfaite.
• Gestion des risques et des décisions : favorise la prise de décisions éclairées pour les investissements et l'atténuation des risques du MCC, l'élaboration de plans d'urgence robustes et la communication proactive des impacts potentiels aux organismes de leadership et de gouvernance pertinents. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes un chef de file reconnu dans le développement de CMC/produit avec une capacité éprouvée de diriger des projets pharmaceutiques complexes et à fort débit.
• Éducation: B.S./M.S./Ph.D. en chimie, pharmacie, génie chimique, ou un domaine technique connexe.
• Expertise technique : vaste expérience de l'industrie pharmaceutique, y compris une solide expérience dans le développement de procédés biologiques et le leadership de l'équipe du CMC.
• Pensée stratégique et critique: compréhension avancée du processus complet de développement des médicaments avec une histoire d'innovation réussie. Le sens des affaires est un plus
• Gestion des programmes : Capacité démontrée de gérer des programmes interfonctionnels complexes tout en pensant de façon stratégique et proactive.
• Communication et influence: compétences exceptionnelles en négociation et en communication verbale/écrite, avec une expérience d'influence sur la haute direction et les tiers. . Êtes-vous prêt à faire la différence pour nos patients ? Nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature – rejoignez-nous maintenant et faites partie de notre voyage! Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'endroit principal est Bâle. Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le rôle peut être disponible, nous fournirons les détails pertinents de la rémunération plus tard dans le processus d'embauche. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés

title: Internship in Innovation & Sustainability - Mission Eco-Possible

titleByLocale.it: Stage in Innovazione & Sostenibilità - Mission Eco-Possible
titleByLocale.en: Internship in Innovation & Sustainability - Mission Eco-Possible
titleByLocale.de: Internship in Innovation & Sustainability - Mission Eco-Possible
titleByLocale.fr: Internship in Innovation & Sustainability - Mission Eco-Possible

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Our Global Internship Programme in Innovation & Sustainability (#IP2TIS) offers a unique opportunity for passionate individuals to gain hands-on experience in the pharmaceutical industry while making a positive impact on the world. Are you ready to join a global network spanning 20+ countries, where bright minds collaborate to tackle real-world challenges in Innovation & Sustainability? Do you want to work on impactful projects, shape the future, and drive change from within? As an intern, you will contribute to Mission Eco-Possible, an active initiative designed to align CAC DIA operations with Roche’s global sustainability strategy and support a 25% reduction in greenhouse gas emissions by 2030. The project focuses on turning the affiliate’s emissions baseline into a practical roadmap for action, with particular attention to Scope 1 and Scope 3 emissions in the Central America and Caribbean context. Within your first months, you are expected to help design and implement an internal environmental sustainability campaign, support the definition of a feasible action plan and investment needs for emissions reduction, and develop an emissions reporting tool aligned with Roche Group guidelines. Your work will help translate global sustainability commitments into local action, strengthen reporting transparency, and mobilize the organization around a shared environmental mission. This internship offers a valuable opportunity to combine sustainability strategy, analytics, and culture change in a high-impact regional setting. The Opportunity
• Design and implement an internal cultural campaign focused on environmental sustainability and the 2030 Eco-Mission
• Support the definition of a feasible action plan to reduce Scope 1 and Scope 3 emissions in the CAC regional context
• Assess investment needs and support feasibility analysis for proposed sustainability initiatives
• Develop an emissions reporting tool for the affiliate aligned with Roche Group guidelines
• Analyze current emissions drivers, including fleet operations, refrigerants, business travel, and e-waste
• Translate sustainability data into clear dashboards, reports, and visual materials for internal use
• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to support implementation and engagement across the organization
• Help connect local actions to Roche’s broader net-zero and SBTi-aligned commitments Who You Are You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program at a university in your final years , preferably in the field of Environmental Engineering or related and are interested in applying your knowledge in a modern working environment as part of an internship of 6 months. Furthermore you are
• Proficient in advanced Excel, Power BI, or Tableau and able to create strong reporting and visualization tools
• Knowledgeable in ESG principles and greenhouse gas accounting frameworks such as the GHG Protocol
• Able to conduct technical and financial feasibility analyses for sustainability projects and investment decisions
• A strong communicator who can turn complex data into compelling stories and work effectively with different stakeholders
• Fluent in Spanish and English.
• Proactive, adaptable, and comfortable driving initiatives in a dynamic regional environment If you meet most but not all qualifications, we still encourage you to apply. Additional information
• The internship is expected to start between 1 and 16 July 2026 and will last 6 months.
• Work term: full

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position International Product Manager – Personalized Healthcare Solutions (PHCS) A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. Who We Are: Advancing precision medicine through diagnostics for over 25 years. In collaboration with leading pharmaceutical companies, Roche Personalised Healthcare Solutions (PHCS) identify and develop innovative precision diagnostics to help radically improve the lives of patients. As the global diagnostic partner of choice, we deliver diagnostic confidence through a broad menu of high medical value assays across Immunohistochemistry (IHC) and In Situ hybridization (ISH), PCR and NGS. We are a global partner of choice in Oncology, including tissue diagnostics, as well as Neurology & Cardiology. Roche PHCS brings unmatched value as a collaborative partner to pharmaceutical organizations developing treatments across critical areas of highest unmet medical need. The Opportunity: As an International Product Manager (IPM) within the PHCS Lifecycle Team, you are the primary driver of our mission. You sit at the critical intersection of diagnostics and therapeutics, transforming complex technology into clinical reality. Your primary responsibility is to drive the global commercialization of our Companion Diagnostics (CDx) portfolio related to Tissue Diagnostics in direct partnership with pharmaceutical customers. Beyond the core product management of the Tissue Diagnostic portfolio, you will act as a strategic leader, driving initiatives that grow the PHCS organization and innovative pipeline, and support the broader Roche Diagnostics network. Key Roles & Responsibilities:
• External Pharmaceutical Partnering: Act as the dedicated commercial lead for pharmaceutical partners. Co-create and align CDx launch plans with drug therapy timelines to ensure seamless "day-one" testing readiness.
• Country & Regional Collaboration: Partner with Roche Diagnostics regional and country stakeholders to drive successful CDx pull-through. You will help markets overcome barriers to adoption, deliver pharmaceutical partner objectives and ultimately drive precision medicine innovation.
• Commercial Strategy Leader: Drive the commercial strategy for IHC-based companion diagnostics, ensuring our value proposition resonates with pathologists, laboratory managers, and pharma stakeholders.
• End-to-End Product Lifecycle Management: Provide technical and strategic guidance throughout early assay development and lead commercial product delivery from concept to commercialization. Responsible for on-market product strategy, supply topics, quality issues, incorporating global regulatory updates, label expansion and end-of-life product management.
• PHCS Strategy Leadership: Lead design and execution of our overarching strategy in collaboration with PHCS leadership and senior stakeholders. Analyze global market trends, customer needs, and competitive landscapes to define long-term strategies.
• Cross-functional Collaboration: Drive high-impact growth projects that define how Roche Diagnostics delivers value beyond the individual test, collaborating closely with lifecycle teams and stakeholders across the organization. Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:
• Liderar la ejecución de proyectos de IT relacionados con instalación, integración y mejoras de sistemas (hardware y software), asegurando cumplimiento en alcance, tiempos, calidad y coordinación con áreas internas y clientes.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Account Executive - Tissue Diagnostics The Opportunity: This role supports our Tissue Diagnostics franchise and will be responsible for meeting and exceeding sales objectives in targeted accounts across specified territories. Typically responsible for medium to large accounts or have a medium to large quota/territory. Must develop customer prospects and create and maintain relationships with decision makers. Contacts/visits existing and potential customers. Works to build and maintain network of colleagues, partners, and customers to share information and obtain prospects. Additionally, position requires value quantification presentations to potential customers. Must demonstrate in-depth knowledge of product line and have a more in-depth knowledge of other products or services. A seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of area of specialization. Resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. This job is the fully qualified, career-oriented position. Has a complete knowledge of company products and services. Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Networks with senior internal and external personnel in own area of expertise. Responsible for selling the company's products or services, developing new accounts and/or expanding existing accounts. Normally receives little instruction on day-to-day work, general instructions on new assignments. This is a field based role: the territory includes North and Central Illinois (Chicago down to Springfield) and the state of Iowa. Relocation benefits are not provided for this role. You must live within 50 miles of the territory border. We prefer the candidate to reside in the greater Chicago area. Key Roles & Responsibilities:
• Contacts new and existing customers to meet and exceed sales objectives in targeted accounts, by developing new business, growing existing business, maintaining customer relationships and troubleshooting customer problems. This includes identifying and developing strategic account plans, developing and delivering the differentiating message and quantifiable economic value for products and services, selling the primary differentiation of Roche products, overcoming and managing objections, and negotiating to obtain sales.
• Generates demand and maximizes product awareness by working with and providing education and information to customers.
• Implements strategic initiatives and plans to facilitate sales process and productivity.
• Works with others, as needed or required, to prepare proposals for assigned accounts. Presents all contract proposals to customers to maximize overall business and profitability, which may require some negotiation.
• Conducts and organizes necessary territory planning and routing for efficiency. Conducts business analysis and planning.
• Communicates competitive market information internally.
• Networks and interfaces with internal colleagues to share information and best practices while remaining actively involved in industry/customer organizations that impact business.
• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions. Who you are:
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
• You hold 3 years relevant sales or equivalent experience
• Participation in an approved accelerated development, fellows

titleByLocale.en: Diagnostics Strategy - Divisional Strategy Lead for M&A Integration & Operating Model Design
titleByLocale.de: Diagnostics Strategy - Divisional Strategy Lead für M&A Integration & Operating Model Design
titleByLocale.fr: Stratégie diagnostique - Stratégie divisionnaire Responsable de l'intégration des M et A et de la conception du modèle opérationnel

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Sei parte di un team di alto livello e ad alto impatto che co-crea e implementa la strategia Roche Diagnostics per realizzare la nostra visione “innovare la diagnostica, plasmare la salute, cambiare la vita”. Si gioca un ruolo fondamentale nella massimizzazione del valore complessivo di consegna della strategia Diagnostica per i nostri clienti e pazienti e nello sblocco della potenza dell'organizzazione per i nostri clienti e pazienti. Nell'ambito del team Diagnostics Strategy, guiderai iniziative strategiche chiave, come le integrazioni M&A o i cambiamenti del Modello Operativo che consentono la realizzazione della Strategia Divisionale. Hai l'opportunità di plasmare e guidare attività di strategia, metodologie e best practice al fine di raggiungere una comprensione e competenze strategiche critiche in tutta l'organizzazione. Quando un M&A è deciso, guiderà o parte del team di integrazione M&A che sta definendo l'approccio di integrazione e svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel rendere l'integrazione un successo raggiungendo gli obiettivi definiti dello stato finale. Potrai collaborare a stretto contatto con una varietà di stakeholder senior provenienti da diverse parti dell'organizzazione Diagnostics e riferire in un Team Lead Strategy. Le aree di responsabilità previste includono la guida e l'attuazione di iniziative strategiche tra le funzioni, ma non sono necessariamente limitate a quelle descritte di seguito: L'opportunità
• Ampia comprensione del business Diagnostics come prerequisito per progettare la vestibilità per il modello operativo, la progettazione organizzativa e gli approcci di integrazione
• Conoscenza di più aree e aspetti di integrazione M&A (come: fasi di integrazione M&A, Org.Design, Integrazione di sistema o considerazioni legali e fiscali)
• Utilizzare la conoscenza delle conoscenze di business e integrazione, metriche, competenze e principi decisionali per diagnosticare efficacemente gli argomenti di integrazione con una vasta gamma di complessità.
• Proattivamente costruisce la conoscenza dell'ambiente esterno per diagnosticare e implementare efficacemente le strategie per aiutare a guidare le decisioni di integrazione.
• Conduce e/o supervisiona e coordina il lavoro di progettazione o integrazione del Modello Operativo dalla pianificazione all'implementazione, tra cui l'individuazione di opportunità e rischi, sviluppando e supervisionando piani d'azione per affrontarli. Sviluppa e conduce/coordina il programma/progetto
• comprovata capacità di influenzare i leader aziendali e i decisori per raggiungere i risultati necessari.
• Sviluppare e perfezionare ulteriormente gli aspetti del nostro overarching design organizzativo e modello operativo (ad esempio, strutture, ruoli, interfacce, ecc.), eseguire controlli sanitari dell'organizzazione
• Guidare la comprensione delle scelte di progettazione organizzativa In un ambiente altamente interfunzionale, fornirete anche la leadership di progetto e matrice coerente con i valori Roche, le capacità di leadership e la mentalità. L'incumbent cercherà di ispirare e accendere la passione in altri per creare un cambiamento sostenibile e sfruttare gli sforzi di una vasta gamma di persone e team. Chi sei
• Laurea di livello universitario in una disciplina rilevante, tipicamente con 5-7 anni di esperienza, preferibilmente in diagnostica di matrice di grandi dimensioni o società di dispositivi mediciIndustria
• Esperienza in una società di consulenza o sviluppo strategico e attuazione in un ruolo di strategia aziendale o globale &
• Esperienza comprovata con integrazioni post-merger all'interno o supporto in/con società di diagnostica
• pensiero strutturato, comprovate capacità di problem solving e record rack di successo progetto e gestione dei programmi
• Altamente sviluppato
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position You are part of a high-performing and high-impact team that co-creates and implements the Roche Diagnostics strategy in order to realize our vision “innovating diagnostics, shaping healthcare, changing lives”. You play a pivotal role in maximizing the overall value delivery of the Diagnostics strategy for our customers and patients and in unlocking the power of the organization for our customers and patients. As part of the Diagnostics Strategy team, you will lead key strategic initiatives, like M&A Integrations or Operating Model changes that enable the realization of the Divisional Strategy. You have the opportunity to shape and drive strategy activities, methodologies, and best practices with a view to reaching a critical strategy understanding and expertise throughout the organization. When an M&A is decided you will lead or be part of the M&A integration team that is defining the integration approach and will play a key role in making the integration a success by reaching the defined end state objectives. You will collaborate closely with a variety of senior stakeholders from different parts of the Diagnostics organization and report into a Strategy Team Lead. Expected areas of accountability would include driving and implementing strategic initiatives across functions, but are not necessarily limited to those outlined below: The Opportunity
• Broad understanding of the Diagnostics business as a prerequisite to design the fit for purpose operating model, Organisational Design and integration approaches
• Knowledge of multiple M&A Integration areas and aspects (like: M&A Integration phases, Org.Design, System Integration or legal and tax considerations)
• Use of knowledge of business and integration insights, metrics, expertise, and decision principles to effectively diagnose integration topics with a wide range of complexity.
• Proactively builds knowledge of the external environment to effectively diagnose and implement strategies to help drive integration decisions.
• Leads and/or oversees and coordinates the Operating Model design or integration work from planning to implementation including identifying opportunities and risks while developing/overseeing action plans to address them. Develops and leads/coordinates program / project planning
• Proven ability to influence business leaders and decision makers to achieve required outcomes.
• Further develop and refine aspects of our overarching organisational design and operating model (e.g., structures, roles, interfaces, etc.), run health checks of the organization
• Drive the understanding of the organisational design choices In a highly cross-functional environment,you will also provide project and matrix leadership consistent with the Roche values, leadership capabilities and mindset. The incumbent will seek to inspire and ignite passion in others to create sustainable change and to leverage the efforts of a diverse range of people and teams. Who you are
• University degree level qualification in a relevant discipline, typically with 5-7+ years of experience, preferably in large matrix Diagnostics or Medical Device CompaniesIndustry
• Experience in a consultancy company or strategy development and implementation in a corporate or global strategy role &
• Proven experience with post-merger integrations inside or supporting in/with diagnostics companies
• Structured thinking, proven problem-solving skills & t rack record of successful project & program management-
• Highly developed
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Sie sind Teil eines leistungsstarken und wirkungsstarken Teams, das die Roche Diagnostics Strategie gemeinsam entwickelt und implementiert, um unsere Vision „Innovation von Diagnostik, Formgebung von Gesundheitsversorgung, Veränderung von Leben“ zu verwirklichen. Sie spielen eine zentrale Rolle bei der Maximierung der gesamten Wertschöpfung der Diagnostikstrategie für unsere Kunden und Patienten und bei der Entriegelung der Organisationskraft für unsere Kunden und Patienten. Im Rahmen des Diagnostics Strategy Teams führen Sie wichtige strategische Initiativen wie M&A-Integrationen oder Operating Model-Änderungen, die die Umsetzung der Divisionsstrategie ermöglichen. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, Strategieaktivitäten, Methoden und bewährte Praktiken zu gestalten und zu treiben, um ein kritisches Strategieverständnis und Fachwissen in der gesamten Organisation zu erreichen. Wenn eine M&A beschlossen wird, werden Sie das M&A-Integrationsteam leiten oder einbinden, das den Integrationsansatz festlegt und eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Realisierung der Integration spielen wird, indem Sie die definierten Endstaatsziele erreichen. Sie werden eng mit einer Vielzahl von hochrangigen Stakeholdern aus verschiedenen Teilen der Diagnostik-Organisation zusammenarbeiten und in einem Strategieteam Lead melden. Zu den erwarteten Rechenschaftspflichtbereichen gehören die Umsetzung und Umsetzung strategischer Initiativen über Funktionen hinweg, sind aber nicht unbedingt auf die nachstehend aufgeführten beschränkt: Die Chance
• Ein umfassendes Verständnis des Diagnostics-Geschäfts als Voraussetzung für die Gestaltung der Passform für zielorientiertes Betriebsmodell, Organisationsdesign und Integrationsansätze
• Kenntnisse mehrerer M&A-Integrationsbereiche und -aspekte (wie: M&A-Integrationsphasen, Org.Design, Systemintegration oder rechtliche und steuerliche Erwägungen)
• Einsatz von Kenntnissen über Unternehmens- und Integrations-Einsichten, Metriken, Know-how und Entscheidungsprinzipien, um Integrationsthemen mit einer Vielzahl von Komplexität effektiv zu diagnostizieren.
• Proaktiv baut Wissen über das externe Umfeld auf, um Strategien effektiv zu diagnostizieren und umzusetzen, um Integrationsentscheidungen anzutreiben.
• Führen und/oder beaufsichtigen und koordinieren die Planungs- oder Integrationsarbeit von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung, einschließlich der Identifizierung von Chancen und Risiken bei der Entwicklung/Übersicht von Aktionsplänen, um sie zu behandeln. Entwickelt und führt/Koordinaten Programm / Projektplanung
• Bewährte Fähigkeit, Führungskräfte und Entscheidungsträger zu beeinflussen, um notwendige Ergebnisse zu erzielen.
• Weiterentwicklung und Verfeinerung von Aspekten unseres übergeordneten Organisations- und Betriebsmodells (z.B. Strukturen, Rollen, Schnittstellen usw.)
• Führen Sie das Verständnis der organisatorischen Gestaltungsoptionen aus In einer hoch funktionsübergreifenden Umgebung bieten Sie auch Projekt- und Matrixführerschaft im Einklang mit den Roche-Werten, Führungsfähigkeiten und Denkweisen. Der Incumbent wird versuchen, Leidenschaft in anderen zu inspirieren und zu entzünden, um nachhaltige Veränderungen zu schaffen und die Bemühungen einer Vielzahl von Menschen und Teams zu nutzen. Wer bist du?
• Hochschulabschluss-Qualifikation in einer relevanten Disziplin, typischerweise mit 5-7+ Jahren Erfahrung, vorzugsweise in der großen Matrix Diagnostics oder MedizinprodukteunternehmenIndustrie
• Erfahrung in einem Beratungsunternehmen oder Strategieentwicklung und Umsetzung in einer Corporate oder Global Strategie Rolle &
• Erprobte Erfahrung mit Post-Merger-Integrationen innerhalb oder Unterstützung in/mit Diagnostik-Unternehmen
• Strukturiertes Denken, bewährte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten & t Rack Rekord von erfolgreichem Projekt- & Programmmanagement-
• Hochentwickelt
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Vous faites partie d'une équipe à haut rendement et à fort impact qui co-crée et met en œuvre la stratégie de diagnostic Roche afin de réaliser notre vision, d'innover le diagnostic, de façonner les soins de santé, de changer les vies. Vous jouez un rôle central en maximisant la valeur globale de la stratégie Diagnostics pour nos clients et patients et en débloquant la puissance de l'organisation pour nos clients et patients. Dans le cadre de l'équipe de la Stratégie diagnostique, vous dirigerez des initiatives stratégiques clés, comme les intégrations de M et A ou les changements du modèle opérationnel qui permettent la réalisation de la Stratégie divisionnaire. Vous avez l'occasion de concevoir et de diriger des activités stratégiques, des méthodologies et des pratiques exemplaires en vue d'atteindre une compréhension et une expertise stratégiques essentielles dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Lorsqu'une M&A est décidée, vous dirigerez ou participerez à l'équipe d'intégration des M&A qui définit l'approche d'intégration et jouera un rôle clé pour faire de l'intégration un succès en atteignant les objectifs définis de l'état final. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec divers intervenants chevronnés de différentes parties de l'organisation Diagnostics et vous ferez rapport en chef d'équipe stratégique. Les domaines de responsabilisation prévus comprendraient la conduite et la mise en oeuvre d'initiatives stratégiques dans toutes les fonctions, mais ne se limitent pas nécessairement à ceux décrits ci-dessous : L'opportunité
• Une compréhension large de l'activité Diagnostic comme préalable à la conception de l'ajustement à des fins de modèle opérationnel, conception organisationnelle et approches d'intégration
• Connaissance de multiples domaines et aspects d'intégration des fusions et acquisitions (comme les phases d'intégration des fusions et acquisitions, la conception, l'intégration des systèmes ou des considérations juridiques et fiscales)
• Utilisation des connaissances sur les perspectives d'affaires et d'intégration, les paramètres, l'expertise et les principes de décision pour diagnostiquer efficacement les sujets d'intégration avec un large éventail de complexité.
• Développer activement les connaissances sur l'environnement extérieur afin de diagnostiquer et de mettre en œuvre efficacement des stratégies permettant d'orienter les décisions d'intégration.
• Dirige et/ou supervise et coordonne les travaux de conception ou d'intégration du modèle d'exploitation, de la planification à la mise en oeuvre, y compris la détermination des possibilités et des risques tout en élaborant ou supervisant des plans d'action pour y remédier. Élaborer et diriger/coordonner la planification des programmes et des projets
• Capacité éprouvée d'influencer les chefs d'entreprise et les décideurs pour obtenir les résultats requis.
• Développer et affiner les aspects de notre conception organisationnelle globale et de notre modèle opérationnel (par exemple, structures, rôles, interfaces, etc.), effectuer des contrôles de santé de l'organisation
• Favoriser la compréhension des choix de conception organisationnelle Dans un environnement hautement interfonctionnel, vous assurerez également un leadership de projet et de matrice conforme aux valeurs de Roche, aux capacités de leadership et à l'état d'esprit. Le titulaire cherchera à inspirer et à susciter la passion chez d'autres pour créer un changement durable et pour tirer parti des efforts d'un éventail varié de personnes et d'équipes. Qui vous êtes
• Diplôme universitaire dans une discipline pertinente, généralement avec 5-7 ans d'expérience, de préférence dans une grande matrice Diagnostics ou entreprises d'instruments médicaux
• Expérience d'une société de conseil ou d'une stratégie de développement et de mise en œuvre dans un rôle de stratégie d'entreprise ou globale &
• Expérience éprouvée des intégrations post-fusion à l'intérieur ou en support dans/avec des entreprises de diagnostic
• La pensée structurée, les compétences éprouvées de résolution de problèmes et l'enregistrement de la réussite de projet et de gestion de programme-
• Hautement développés

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Introduction The Digital Integration Engineer takes ownership of ambiguous tasks and skillfully navigates group dynamics, fostering strong collaboration and acting as a technical mentor. In this role, you will lead small to medium (S/M) initiatives, effectively prioritize with stakeholders, and maintain a "bigger picture" view of how various components align with the overall strategic goals. You will leverage extensive experience to design, develop, and implement complex, end-to-end integrations primarily leveraging ServiceNow platform capabilities (e.g., IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, REST/SOAP APIs) with various external enterprise systems. The Opportunity:
• Drive ownership of ambiguous tasks and "grey zone" topics, successfully leading small to medium (S/M) initiatives at the project, squad, or product level.
• Engineer end-to-end integrations by leveraging ServiceNow capabilities including IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, and REST/SOAP APIs with external systems.
• Foster collaboration and knowledge sharing by navigating group dynamics in diversified settings and acting as a technical mentor for the team.
• Lead feasibility studies and technical evaluations to ensure all integration solutions are scalable, reliable, and performant.
• Manage stakeholders effectively by prioritizing demands and maintaining a "bigger picture" view of how components fit the overall product strategy.
• Influence platform governance through enterprise-level technical decision-making and the formulation of global integration strategies.
• Champion technical excellence by sharing knowledge at internal events such as DevOps Days, Tech Talks, and Tech Live sessions.
• Ensure documentation integrity by developing comprehensive data maps, API specifications, and ServiceNow Update Set best practices. Who you are:
• Proven Integrator: You have extensive experience in designing, developing, and implementing ServiceNow integrations and complex platform solutions.
• Educated & Experienced: You are educated to a degree level in a relevant field and bring a strong track record of driving technical initiatives.
• ServiceNow Specialist: You possess deep expertise in ServiceNow technical architecture and multiple modules, including ITSM, HRSD, and CSM.
• Technical Leader: You are a recognized mentor capable of aligning development plans with global strategies and fostering a collaborative team environment.
• Strategic Thinker: You possess the ability to challenge the status quo and navigate complex group dynamics to achieve engineering quality.
• Integration Expert: You have deep proficiency in IntegrationHub, MID Servers, and scripted integrations, with a focus on security and performance.
• Communication Pro: You are a skilled communicator who can simplify complex technical strategies and manage senior stakeholder expectations effectively. #RDT2026 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportun

• Realizas mantenimientos preventivos y correctivos bajo la supervisión del responsable del taller .
• Colaboras con los Ingenieros de Servicio de Campo (FSE) en la instalación y puesta a punto de analizadores Roche (Cobas y Sysmex) .
• Desarrollas aplicaciones para la mejora y automatización de proyectos y actividades internas del taller .
• Gestionas el soporte documentario para los procesos de importación de repuestos y materiales operativos .
• Aseguras el cumplimiento de procedimientos administrativos técnicos, incluyendo la preparación de reportes y manejo de software CRM .
• Participas activamente en los entrenamientos técnicos y sesiones de capacitación impartidas en el taller .
• Contribuyes a la organización de materiales, reactivos y periféricos necesarios para la continuidad del servicio al cliente . Quien eres
• Eres egresado/a de las carreras de Ingeniería Electrónica, Mecatrónica, Biomédica o afines .
• Cuentas con un nivel de inglés intermedio que te permite comprender manuales técnicos .
• Posees un manejo intermedio de MS Office, con énfasis en el uso de Excel para gestión de datos .

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position El Medical Ecosystem Partner (MEP) está en el centro de la nueva organización en Roche, desafiando el papel que jugamos en la sociedad para pasar de ofrecer medicamentos de clase mundial a construir alianzas, co-crear, innovar y liderar la atención médica. Es directamente responsable de entregar los mejores resultados para los pacientes, su comunidad, el ecosistema y la organización de una manera más rápida. El objetivo de esta función es también colaborar con la comunidad científica y médica externa para proporcionar información clara, científicamente sólida, coherente y oportuna sobre nuestros productos, servicios y áreas de enfermedad, y recopilar información externa relevante para la estrategia general. La Oportunidad
• El MEP es un rol clave dentro de la afiliada, que tiene las habilidades para identificar y superar barreras de acceso con el fin de tener un mayor impacto en el viaje del paciente.
• El MEP se enfoca en la importancia de traer y compartir insights trabajando de cerca con nuestros clientes para descubrir las oportunidades potenciales para transformar los resultados en salud para los pacientes, de forma más rápida. Comparte la experiencia, la ciencia y el conocimiento de Roche a los diferentes ecosistemas de salud.
• Participa y promueve el trabajo en red (Network) para agilizar, colaborar e innovar, así como atraer experiencia y recursos a nivel local.
• Procesa , analiza y proporciona información médica valiosa, tanto interna como externamente, de forma proactiva o basada en solicitudes.
• Trabajar de cerca con todos los actores que intervienen directamente en el manejo de la enfermedad (en un área terapéutica determinada), compartiendo con los Expertos de Áreas Terapéuticas (TAEs) un profundo y actualizado conocimiento sobre el manejo de la patología, información relacionada con los productos con FOCO EN PIPELINE acorde a los estándares de Roche y de las regulaciones locales, así como asociaciones de pacientes y otras partes interesadas.
• Comunica propuestas de valor a los diferentes grupos de interés para acelerar soluciones de acceso “One Roche”
• Brinda apoyo como experto en los ecosistemas locales, fomentando el trabajo multidisciplinario y el desarrollo de iniciativas OneRoche que apoyen el desarrollo de la estrategia de una Medicina Integral y Personalizada.
• Asegura de que las consultas de información médica cumplan con los estándares de calidad, las políticas y los SOP de Roche, y satisfagan las necesidades del cliente.
• Asegura de que los departamentos de Farmacovigilancia y Calidad tengan información oportuna sobre los informes de eventos adversos y quejas de calidad, y realizar las conciliaciones requeridas por estos departamentos.
• Participa de forma significativa con las comunidades globales y regionales pertinentes, participando activamente (compartiendo experiencias y participando en grupos de trabajo) y defendiendo el valor de las redes y la colaboración.
• Trabaja en conjunto con el Squad y el área de RWE en la identificación de Gaps de evidencia local para co-crear con los actores de los ecosistemas soluciones que puedan cubrir los gaps para mejorar el acceso y la atención personalizada de los pacientes y lograr que se generen publicaciones
• Cuenta con entendimiento profundo del ecosistema médico (médico tratante, tomadores de decisión en instituciones públicas y privadas, asociaciones médicas y de pacientes) para encontrar oportunidades y moldearlo, facilitando que más pacientes reciban mejores solucion

OBJETIVOS DEL CARGO: Asegurar la excelencia en el servicio técnico a través de la gestión de acciones proactivas, de mantenimientos y soporte especializado. Apoyar la puesta en marcha de equipos y asesorar a los clientes en el uso óptimo de la tecnología para cumplir con los estándares globales de calidad de la compañía. Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:
• Ejecutar mantenimientos preventivos y correctivos, asegurando el registro, documentación y cierre oportuno de casos en Rexis, así como la correcta trazabilidad de la información técnica.
• Realizar la instalación y puesta en marcha de equipos bajo estándares de calidad del fabricante, coordinando con las áreas de Aplicaciones e IT.
• Brindar soporte técnico a clientes, resolviendo consultas, reclamos y problemas de funcionamiento, además de asesorar en el uso adecuado de los equipos.
• Asegurar el cumplimiento de normativas y políticas corporativas, incluyendo la gestión de notificaciones, entrega de evidencias documentales, control de sustancias y residuos peligrosos, y coordinación con logística para su disposición.
• Impulsar el desarrollo técnico continuo, aprobando entrenamientos, transfiriendo conocimiento al equipo y brindando apoyo en actividades de taller según se requiera. Tu Perfil:
• Título universitario o técnico en Electrónica, Mecánica o áreas afines.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we are working to make next-generation sequencing simple and accessible enough for routine use. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. Our Systems Technology Group, a part of Roche Sequencing Solutions, is focused on creating and advancing technologies to significantly enhance DNA sequencing workflows. We are seeking a hands-on Chemistry & Fluidic Systems Integration Scientist/Engineer to serve as a key contributor in chemistry and biology. Joining our current team of talented scientists and engineers, you will help bridge the gap between complex molecular biology, physical chemistry and cutting-edge microfluidic instrumentation and consumables. The ideal candidate will thrive at this intersection, actively porting and translating complex workflows onto novel systems during the earliest stages of research and development. You will be responsible for rigorously testing new concepts, performing complex assays, troubleshooting integrated subsystems, and optimizing overall performance based on first principles. Your Role and Responsibilities:
• You will contribute to efforts to translate, test, and optimize complex, multi-step chemical and molecular biology workflows (e.g., purification, synthesis, library prep, target enrichment, amplification, and sequencing) on early-stage microfluidic systems.
• You will support the selection, formulation, and optimization of buffers, surfactants, coatings and critical additives. You will leverage your understanding of the distinct purpose of each reagent to maintain efficiency and optimize chemical and enzymatic reactions within microfluidic or closed-system environments.
• You will design and execute rigorous experiments using statistical methods to characterize system performance, solving potentially complex problems by analyzing possible solutions using experience, judgment, and precedents.
• You will conduct early-stage troubleshooting for complex performance issues on novel systems. You will connect systemic failures such as leaks, null results, or surface fouling back to first-principles root causes, whether molecular, chemical, material, or physical.
• You will act as a technical resource for colleagues with less experience, serving as a go-to person for explaining complex molecular biology and sequencing chemistry concepts to a team of talented engineers.
• You will analyze complex, multi-modal data sets and serve as a key technical partner to both assay development scientists and hardware design engineers. You will provide data-driven feedback to guide the co-development of reagents, consumables, and instrument hardware. A cover letter is required for this application. Please outline your relevant experience and explain why you are interested in this role and our company. This is an on-site position based in Santa Clara, CA. Relocation benefits are not being offered for this role. Who You Are (Required):
• You have a PhD in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biophysics, Molecular Biology, Bioengineering, Biomedical Engineering (or a closely related discipline) with 3+ years of relevant industry experience; OR a Master's degree in one of the above disciplines with 5+ years of relevant industry experience; OR a Bachelor's degree with 7+ years of relevant industry experience.
• You possess a strong understanding of the fundamental principles of chemistry and molecular biolog

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position ***12 Month Opportunity*** Roche is a global healthcare leader at the forefront of innovation, dedicated to improving the lives of patients through the development of groundbreaking medicines and diagnostic tools. With a heritage spanning over 125 years, we are committed to sustainable healthcare and delivering medical solutions that address some of the world’s most complex health challenges. Our Global Clinical Supply Chain Organization is the backbone of our clinical research, ensuring that no patient goes without treatment and no clinical trial is delayed. By joining our newly expanded team in Mississauga, Canada, you will be part of a strategically significant hub that fosters agility, cross-functional collaboration, and the delivery of life-saving biopharmaceuticals to more than 100 molecules across 600+ clinical trials globally. The Opportunity
• You will take ownership of the clinical study supply chain for Investigational Medicinal Products (IMP), ensuring effective and cost-conscious delivery across diverse disease areas.
• You will execute end-to-end demand and supply planning within ERP systems, such as SAP, to maintain robust aggregate and long-range program oversight.
• You will lead the alignment of key activities and timelines across cross-functional teams to ensure every clinical trial is supplied in strict accordance with agreed scopes.
• You will strategically forecast, plan, and initiate the procurement of comparator drugs and other study materials required for complex clinical protocols.
• You will integrate all relevant regulatory and quality requirements into the supply plan to ensure compliance with international standards and GMP environments.
• You will drive business excellence by owning and optimizing Clinical Supply Chain processes, influencing change, and ensuring global system integration.
• You will collaborate with Technical Development Teams and Clinical Operations to bridge the gap between drug development and patient-centric delivery. Who you are
• You possess a minimum of five years of experience in Clinical Supply Chain, Planning, or Manufacturing, ideally within the Biotechnology or Pharmaceutical industry.
• You hold an academic degree in Life Sciences, Business, or Engineering, complemented by a solid understanding of clinical trial design and drug technical development.
• You are skilled at navigating ERP systems and IRT functionalities to manage complex inventory and supply chain optimization simulations.
• You demonstrate a high level of proficiency in GMP environments, with a keen eye for quality assurance, regulatory affairs, and budget planning.
• You are a confident stakeholder manager who excels at building customer focus and earning respect through impactful, needs-driven actions.
• You possess an agile mindset, showing a willingness to experiment with new ideas and lead process improvement activities in a self-directed team environment.
• You are an action-oriented professional with the ability to influence others, make decisive choices, and travel internationally to support global operations. *** Relocation not available for this position*** The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 115,328.00 and 151,368.00 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors as determined by the company. We use artificial intelligence to screen, assess or select applicants for this role. This

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Business Analyst , you will independently manage end-to-end workstreams, tackling complex business problems with emerging ambiguity to drive Quote Management initiatives and Diagnostics commercial launches . You will act as a trusted advisor to leadership and Diagnostics affiliate commercial teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives and translating requirements into strategic implementation plans . Join us to lead the design of effective solutions and shape best practices within our global digital landscape . Description of the area The Quote Management team is part of DIA Commercial Operations, a strategic global function within Roche Digital Technology (RDT) and is at the heart of our Diagnostics digital landscape. We are responsible for developing, globally rolling out, and continuously evolving technology solutions that enhance the experience of healthcare providers and patients. Serving as a link between global business units - such as Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), Roche Information Solutions (RIS), and Commercial Enablement - and their operational goals, we design the digital architecture that enables Roche to scale its impact across APAC, EMEA/LATAM, and NAM. The Opportunity:
• Drive Strategic Delivery : Act as the RDT delivery lead for Quote Management initiatives and enable high-impact commercial product launches across global markets .
• Orchestrate End-to-End Workstreams : Autonomously manage complex BA workstreams from discovery to implementation while navigating high-ambiguity environments .
• Translate Business Needs : Gather complex requirements and translate them into clear, actionable user stories and robust technical solution designs in partnership with Architects .
• Execute System Rollouts : Take ownership of system functional definitions and execute complex configurations to drive successful regional rollouts .
• Serve as a Trusted Advisor : Facilitate high-level workshops to shape strategy and resolve complex stakeholder conflicts, aligning regional expectations with global roadmaps .
• Optimize Solution Value : Contribute to long-term solution roadmaps and ensure every initiative delivers demonstrable business value and technical scalability .
• Bridge Technical Gaps : Act as the direct technical liaison between affiliate business stakeholders and offshore managed services to ensure seamless execution .
• Ensure Quality Excellence : Define clear acceptance criteria and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate that solutions meet rigorous business standards . Who you are:
• Experienced Professional : Proven track record of managing complex BA workstreams independently, driving regional rollouts in the APAC region, and making localization system configurations. You bring 7+ years of Business Analysis experience managing end-to-end IT workstreams, including 4+ years in MedTech or Healthcare Life Sciences .
• Domain Expert : You possess deep functional and technical knowledge of the Quote-to-Contract (Q2C) and Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) commercial sales domains .
• Technically Proficient : You have hands-on experience with Conga CPQ and Salesforce (SFDC) , with familiarity in Jira and SAP S/4HANA (ASPIRE) .
• Academic Background : You hold a Bachelor’s or Advanced Degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field .
• Agile Practitioner : You have practical knowledge of Agile frameworks (Scrum/SAFe); professional certifications like CBAP or IIBA AAC are highly preferre

Serving as a link between global business units - such as Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), Roche Information Solutions (RIS), and Commercial Enablement - and their operational goals, we design the digital architecture that enables Roche to scale its impact across APAC, EMEA/LATAM, and NAM. The Opportunity:
• Drive Strategic Delivery : Act as the RDT delivery lead for Quote Management initiatives and enable high-impact commercial product launches across global markets .
• Orchestrate End-to-End Workstreams : Autonomously manage complex BA workstreams from discovery to implementation while navigating high-ambiguity environments .
• Translate Business Needs : Gather complex requirements and translate them into clear, actionable user stories and robust technical solution designs in partnership with Architects .
• Execute System Rollouts : Take ownership of system functional definitions and execute complex configurations to drive successful regional rollouts .
• Serve as a Trusted Advisor : Facilitate high-level workshops to shape strategy and resolve complex stakeholder conflicts, aligning regional expectations with global roadmaps .
• Optimize Solution Value : Contribute to long-term solution roadmaps and ensure every initiative delivers demonstrable business value and technical scalability .
• Bridge Technical Gaps : Act as the direct technical liaison between affiliate business stakeholders and offshore managed services to ensure seamless execution .
• Ensure Quality Excellence : Define clear acceptance criteria and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate that solutions meet rigorous business standards . Who you are:
• Experienced Professional : Proven track record of managing complex BA workstreams independently, driving regional rollouts in the APAC region, and making localization system configurations. You bring 7+ years of Business Analysis experience managing end-to-end IT workstreams, including 4+ years in MedTech or Healthcare Life Sciences .
• Domain Expert : You possess deep functional and technical knowledge of the Quote-to-Contract (Q2C) and Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) commercial sales domains .
• Technically Proficient : You have hands-on experience with Conga CPQ and Salesforce (SFDC) , with familiarity in Jira and SAP S/4HANA (ASPIRE) .
• Academic Background : You hold a Bachelor’s or Advanced Degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field .
• Agile Practitioner : You have practical knowledge of Agile frameworks (Scrum/SAFe); professional certifications like CBAP or IIBA AAC are highly preferre
