• Process Account receivable, treasury and inter-company task as per Service level Agreement. Process all cash application and remittance reconciliation for assigned countries accurately and within specific timescales. Prepare and follow up unidentified open items in clearing account when execute daily/monthly bank reconciliation.
• Liaise with the stakeholder for preparation and transaction posting of Inter-company non trade related debit and credit notes. Preparation of monthly reconciliation, highlight and rectify anomalies encountered. Generate statement of accounts to the customers. Track and resolve disputes and route to local affiliates as and when required
• Attend to all matters requested for accounts receivable when required. Initiate the dunning process and generate reminders for overdue accounts. Prepare regularly the details of unallocated and unidentified receipts for stakeholder further actions. Execute month end, quarter end and year end closing activities for countries assigned. Manage Cash pool account reconciliation
• Prepare preliminary and final Inter-company Account Receivable balances to reconcile against counterparty balances. Ensure timely and accurate deal settlement and posting of treasury related transactions including Inter-company foreign exchange, loan, accrual and actual interest, bank charges and etc.Creation and maintenance of the customer master data records in system. Credit management – Perform and responsible for credit analysis on customer according to company credit policy and procedures. Reviewing credit risk for new and existing customers by carry out credit worthless checks and make credit limit recommendation.
• Collection management – Ensure customers pay within agreed payment terms, contacting sales team and customer on collection activities if necessary as per company’s debt collection procedure.. Demonstrated good customer service skills while initiating outbound calls and received inbound calls with customer. Handling of AR bad debt allowance and write off management. First point of contact for operational support and issue solving Liaise with customer for balance confirmation and monitoring of daily sales order status. Who you are
• Ensure all work documentation and work processes are updated and meet with Internal Control Financial Reporting (ICFR), group policies and guidelines, local statutory and legal requirements within agreed service timelines.
• Perform back up function and other duties, including job rotation to other functional teams as and when required. Participate in internal and external compliance audit queries
• Transformation/ Continuous Improvement Implementations : Work collaboratively with Country Chief Accountant and stakeholders. Engage and support the teams in the implementation of continuous improvement project
• Proactively to identify, recommend and implement solutions in consultation with the management for continuous improvement opportunities in the areas of operation
• Assist to ensure effective knowledge transfer as for sustainable development knowledge and sharing of best practices within the team ​ Thank you for your application. Please take note that only shortlisted candidates will be notified. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Professional Technical Services team (Field Service Engineering) in Hungary is a dedicated group of experts committed to delivering high-quality engineering and technical solutions in the field of in vitro diagnostics (IVD) . As part of Roche Diagnostics, the team focuses on creating long-lasting partnerships with healthcare providers by ensuring our diagnostic systems are installed and maintained to the highest standards, ultimately supporting reliable patient results across the country. The Opportunity As a Technical Services Project Manager and Team Lead, you will play a dual role that balances high-level project execution with people leadership. You will be responsible for ensuring compliant, professional services for our customers while developing a high-performing team of Field Service Engineers. In this role, you will split your focus between driving complex technical implementations (60-70%) and mentoring your team (30-40%). You will be the bridge between technical excellence and strategic growth, ensuring our laboratory solutions are delivered seamlessly while fostering a culture of continuous improvement. As a Technical Project Manager (60-70%):
• You will manage the full project lifecycle for laboratory implementations, from initial tender to handover.
• You will conduct on-site technical assessments, develop and execute detailed project plans to meet stakeholder expectations, identify and mitigate risks.
• You will oversee the installation of systems, testing, and reagent applications, ensuring all deliverables are met on time and within scope. As a Team Lead (30-40%):
• You will lead, coach, and develop a customer-focused, future-ready and high-performing Field Service Engineering team, attract and retain top talent, and foster a continuous learning culture.
• You will manage resource planning and workload, oversee the business portfolio (SWA, NPC, M&TD), monitor team KPIs and service data to ensure high-quality technical support for Hungarian customers. Who you are
• Experienced Leader: You have a proven track record in leading and developing teams, with the ability to motivate others and facilitate professional growth.
• Technical Expert: You hold a BSc/MSc in Engineering (e.g. Electrical, Mechatronical, Mechanical, Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, etc) and have 3-5 years of experience in laboratory technology or medical devices.
• Project Specialist: You are proficient in project management methodologies and tools, with a focus on delivering outcomes in complex, changing environments.
• Strategic Thinker: You possess a growth mindset and the ability to think at an enterprise level, identifying business development opportunities within the healthcare system.

Entra a far parte di DS Clinical & Commercial Supply, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione:

• In qualità di collegamento di progetto, sei la persona di contatto principale per i progetti di ricerca e sviluppo (RED), per le licenze nonché per i ruoli e i comitati di pianificazione locale e globale. In collaborazione con stakeholder interni ed esterni come lo sviluppo tecnico della molecola sintetica, la galenica, la regolamentazione e la qualità, ti assicuri che i rispettivi obiettivi del progetto siano coordinati.
• Prenderai la guida della pianificazione strategica e della fattibilità del progetto e quindi effettuerai una pianificazione strategica a lungo termine, in particolare una prospettiva quinquennale per le strutture operative e il personale, oltre a svolgere studi di fattibilità e valutazioni di capacità.

Condurrai indagini complesse, identificherai le cause profonde e implementerai misure correttive e preventive efficaci.
• In qualità di mentore e coach, sostieni i nostri dipendenti nello sviluppo continuo delle loro capacità e conoscenze professionali.
• Agire come forza trainante per il miglioramento continuo identificando soluzioni innovative per ottimizzare i processi e aumentare la produttività, sfruttando e implementando principi snelli e soluzioni digitali per migliorare le operazioni.

• Hai una laurea in chimica o ingegneria chimica e almeno 10 anni di esperienza nella chimica di processo per molecole di sintesi.
• Hai una conoscenza approfondita della sintesi chimica, delle tecnologie dei processi chimici e della produzione in un ambiente cGMP.
• In qualità di esperto tecnico, capisci come motivare i team in un'organizzazione a matrice e creare una forte coesione per avere successo insieme.
• I tuoi punti di forza risiedono nella collaborazione: mantieni ottimi rapporti con le parti interessate e gestisci abilmente trattative e progetti interfunzionali.
• Sei un motore attivo del cambiamento, creando una cultura flessibile e aperta a nuove opportunità.

• Comunichi fluentemente in tedesco
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche you can be who you are – with all the unique qualities you bring with you. Our culture promotes personal development, open dialogue and sincere relationships. Here you will be valued, accepted and respected for who you are, so that you can develop personally and professionally. We want to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure that every person has access to healthcare today and for future generations. Become part of DS Clinical & Commercial Supply, where every voice counts. The position:
• Aligning the project portfolio with the capacities and capabilities of DS Clinical & Commercial Supply is the core task
• As a project liaison, you are the primary contact person for research and development projects (REDs), in-licensing as well as for local and global planning roles and committees. In collaboration with internal and external stakeholders such as Synthetic Molecule Technical Development, Galenics, Regulatory and Quality, you ensure that the respective project goals are coordinated.
• You will take the lead on strategic project planning & feasibility and therefore carry out long-term strategic planning, in particular a 5-year outlook for operational facilities and personnel, as well as carrying out feasibility studies and capacity assessments.
• In the role of Resource Coordinator, you will coordinate resources in collaboration with the sections within DS Clinical & Commercial Supply and oversee planning within the department.
• You will act as a subject matter expert and consultant for manufacturing processes and/or equipment, providing your expertise to solve complex technical problems and strategic issues. You will lead complex investigations, identify root causes, and implement effective corrective and preventative measures.
• As a mentor and coach, you support our employees in the continuous development of their professional skills and knowledge.
• Act as a driving force for continuous improvement by identifying innovative solutions to optimize processes and increase productivity, leveraging and implementing lean principles and digital solutions to improve operations.
• Act as a matrix lead that shapes the department's strategic planning and goal setting and promotes a strong team spirit and culture of collaboration, urgency and high motivation to achieve these goals. Who you are:
• You have a degree in chemistry or chemical engineering and at least 10 years of experience in process chemistry for synthetic molecules.
• You have in-depth knowledge of chemical synthesis, chemical process technologies and production in a cGMP environment.
• As a technical expert, you understand how to motivate teams in a matrix organization and create strong cohesion in order to be successful together.
• Your strengths lie in collaboration: You maintain excellent relationships with stakeholders and skillfully navigate negotiations and cross-functional projects.
• You are an active driver of change, creating a flexible and open culture for new opportunities.
• You are a driving force for continuous improvement and tackle new challenges with passion.
• You communicate fluently in German

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. As an Inte rn – Access and Policy based in Dhaka , you will play a vital role in supporting Roche Bangladesh Limited’s mission to shape the healthcare ecosystem. You will assist in building strategic partnerships and navigating policy frameworks to ensure our innovative solutions reac h the patients who need them most—helping to unlock possibilities that deliver value for both the healthcare system and society. The Opportunity
• You assist in coordinating partnerships and engagements with Development Organizations, Patient Advocacy Groups (PAGs), Societies, and Foundations to support access and policy initiatives.
• You support the team in developing and maintaining strategic partnerships within government and industry to effectively communicate Roche’s positions.
• You contribute to identifying, mapping, and managing key ecosystem stakeholders to ensure alignment with our corporate strategies.
• You act as a facilitator for collaboration between external stakeholders and internal Roche teams, helping the department serve as a trusted partner.
• You assist in broadening the company's corporate and non-governmental network through market analysis, stakeholder mapping, and outreach support.
• You execute day-to-day departmental operations and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to build trusted internal and external partnerships.
• You commit to a minimum 6-month internship duration, allowing you to gain deep, hands-on experience and make a meaningful impact within the Access and Policy functions. Who You Are
• You are a fresh graduate , or a current student pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Public Health, Public Policy, Business Administration, Pharmacy, or a related field.
• You are a proactive individual with a genuine passion for pursuing a career in Healthcare Policy, Access, or Public Affairs.
• You possess excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and are confident in engaging with diverse stakeholders.
• You have basic IT skills and a strong proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
• You demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a high level of attention to detail.
• You are available to work fully on-site at the office every day and are comfortable working in a structured, fast-paced environment.
• You uphold high ethical standards, maintain confidentiality, and thrive in a collaborative teamwork setting. Why Join Us? At Roche, we endeavor to provide a meaningful and enriching experience that ensures our interns gain valuable industry insights, hands-on knowledge, and the opportunity to build a solid foundation for a career in Access and Policy. What we offer Roche offers rewarding growth opportunities, a competitive remuneration package and a collaborative culture where people are united in purpose and will stretch you to be brave, speak up and think differently. Feel empowered to deliver meaningful outcomes, supported by accessible and inspiring leaders. Roche encourages a high-performance culture where you are empowered and trusted to make decisions. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Das Arbeitsumfeld Die Einheit Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) stellt die technische und strategische Kompetenz für die Bereitstellung der klinischen Pipeline sowie Einführung und die Unterstützung der kommerziellen pharmazeutischen Produktion für unsere Patienten sicher. Die Abteilung MSAT Process Automation bietet für die Herstellung, Bewertung und Freigabe hochwertiger Produkte im GMP-Bereich den technischen Support, Engineering, Daten und Dokumente. Dabei sind produktionslinienbezogene Gruppen für die Konfiguration und den Support der Produktions-Automationssysteme verantwortlich; technische Chapter stellen die standardisierte Nutzung der Systeme sicher und tragen zu effizienten Produktionsprozesstransfers bei. Kernthemen, mit denen wir uns in MSAT Process Automation befassen:
• Umsetzung von Herstellvorgaben in Checkpläne, Batch- und MES-Rezepte
• End-to-End Direct Support und Configuration Management für Automationssysteme der Produktion
• Herstellprozessbezogene Datenbereitstellung & Analyse
• Anwendertraining
• Anforderungsmanagement für alle Produktions-Automationssysteme und Datenreports
• PLS (PCS7) Umsetzung und Support
• Application Administration für prozessnahe Automation
• Business Process Oversight, Data Oversight und Configuration Oversight für alle automatisierten Herstellprozesse von Transfer, Make, Assess und Release Dein zukünftiges Team Wir sind ein gut eingespieltes, selbstständig agierendes Team und fühlen uns überwiegend im Manufacturing Produktionsumfeld als Rezeptersteller und 1st Level Support für die Produktionssysteme zu Hause. In diesem agilen Umfeld ist es für uns eine Selbstverständlichkeit, kunden- und lösungsorientiert zu arbeiten und dabei viele Schnittstellen zu bedienen. Deine Aufgaben
• Rezepterstellung für pharmazeutische Entwicklungs- und Marktprodukte: Planung und Umsetzung von beschriebenen Herstellprozessen in automatisierte Produktionsabläufe auf MES- und Batchebene
• Konfiguration von Prozess- und Stammdaten
• 1st Level Support und Fehleranalyse (24/7) für automatisierte Produktionssysteme
• Analyse und Bereitstellung von Prozessdaten
• Standardisierung von Prozessen, Rezepten, PLS-Phasen und Konfigurationen
• Anforderungensmanagement für Produktionssysteme
• GMP-gerechte Dokumentation sämtlicher Arbeitsaktivitäten Dein Profil passt gut zu uns, wenn
• Du Dein naturwissenschaftliches Studium (Bachelor oder Master) erfolgreich abgeschlossen hast oder alternativ tiefgreifende Erfahrung aus der pharmazeutischen Produktion vorweisen kannst,
• Du über fundierte verfahrenstechnische oder biotechnologische Kenntnisse verfügst und es Dir Spaß macht, diese in die Sprache der Prozessautomation zu übersetzen,
• Du GMP-Dokumentation als wichtig empfindest und bereit bist, Deine Expertise jederzeit in der sicheren Bedienung des Sematic Batch Client sowie in Routine-GMP-Prozessen (z.B. Abweichungen und Changes) sowie in Audits und Inspektionen einzubringen,
• Du praktische Erfahrung im GMP-Bereich von Labor oder Produktion mitbringst,
• Du bereits erste Erfahrungen im Projektmanagement gesammelt hast,
• You are fluent in German and English, both written and spoken and you are able to influence at all levels,
• Du idealerweise eine Affinität zu Lean Methoden besitzt,
• Du gerne Dein Wissen erweiterst (z.B. durch externe Seminar- und Kongressbesuche) und dieses mit Deinen Kollegen und den Anwendern in den Produktionsbetrieben teilst,
• Du ein wahrer Teamplayer bist, über Durchsetzungsvermöge

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As Global Business Process Specialist - Capital Investment Finance , you are part of the Business Process Management Finance team at Roche Services & Solutions. This position actively pursues the implementation of the E2E BPM strategy and is responsible for global, cross-divisional, state-of-the-art process design related to financial processes in the domains of asset accounting, CAPEX & Lease accounting. The person in this role is the empowered decision-maker for their area across divisions and in line with the E2E Business Process Management guardrails from the Global Business Process Managers. This position works closely with various stakeholders in the Business Process Management organization & beyond, with the goal to ensure fit-for-purpose solutions and contributes as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in an ongoing large scale global SAP S4 deployment across our Pharmaceutical and Diagnostics Division. Disclosure Note: The position is open on a fixed-term basis until 31/12/2029. The Opportunity
• Project Management and Contribution: Drive deployment of large scale SAP S4 project, responsible for areas in and around Asset Accounting, CAPEX & Lease Accounting
• Business Process Strategy: Actively pursues the implementation of the E2E BPM strategy, delivers solutions including processes, technology, and analytics, and supports global business acceptance for their dedicated area.
• Business Process Design: Responsible for global, cross-divisional, state-of-the-art process design and redesign, ensuring processes are fit for purpose, lean, and standardized.
• Business Process Governance: Manages the prioritization and implementation of change requests, ensures robust process execution, documents process requirements, and drives automation and improvements.
• Strong Business and IT Knowledge: Requires strong knowledge in both business and IT to effectively discuss and justify business requirements and assess the feasibility of technical solutions.
• Strong Stakeholder Management Skills: Needs strong skills in communication, change management, and negotiation to discuss complex topics with various stakeholders across the organization.
• Overarching Impact: Has a significant global impact on both business and IT through the design, governance, and implementation of standardized processes.
• Agile Leadership and Coaching: Has a good understanding of SAFe principles, contributes to advancing agile ways of working, assumes agile roles (e.g., product owner, scrum master), and provides guidance and coaching to other specialists and colleagues. Who you are We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:
• Education and Experience: A bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Informatics, Engineering, or a comparable field is required, along with 5-7 years of professional experience in business process management, finance, accounting, or an equivalent function.
• Technical and Process Expertise: The role demands a strong understanding of end-to-end business processes, deep process knowledge, and technical expertise in areas like IFRS Accounting, SAP FI/CO, ICFR, Procurement, and various laws and regulations. Past experience as functional consultant and/or end user in asset & lease accounting i

Die Roche Pharma AG an ihrem Standort in Grenzach-Wyhlen steuert zentrale Elemente der technischen Qualitätssicherung für den gesamten europäischen Raum sowie die klinische Forschung, das Marketing und die Vertriebsaktivitäten für den deutschen Markt. Das Kundenerlebnis in den Mittelpunkt zu stellen, Digital-First zu denken und Omnichannel-Marketing zu leben entspricht Deinem Mindset? Wir wollen jeden Touchpoint unserer Kunden mit Roche mit einer besonders positiven Customer Experience belegen. Passt das zu Dir? Dann bist Du bei Roche und in unserem Team genau richtig. Ein umfangreicher Einarbeitungsplan hilft Dir gemeinsam mit dem Team, alle Teilbereiche von Digital Customer Excellence kennen- und verstehen zu lernen. Und dann heißt es mit Unterstützung deines Buddys aus dem Team „Learning by doing“. Deine Aufgaben:
• Superior Customer Experience mitgestalten
• Unterstützung und Auswertung digitaler Kampagnen und Omnichannel-Kommunikation für strategische, abteilungsübergreifende Produkte
• Wissenstransfer digitaler Konzepte in die Kundeninteraktion und standortweite Implementierung
• Omnichannel-Kommunikation (Fokus Digital) erlebbar machen
• Analyse & Bewertung nutzerfreundlicher digitaler Plattformen und Kanäle
• Erarbeitung und Mitwirkung bei digitalen Kampagnen und Konzepten
• Maßnahmen mitgestalten, die einen WOW-Effekt bei unseren Kunden erzeugen und ein nachhaltiges CX-Mindset fördern
• Recherche und interne Kommunikation von Best-Practice-Beispielen zu Customer Centricity
• Content-Erstellung für deutschsprachige Kanäle; Workshop-Moderation und Ergebnisdokumentation in deutscher Sprache Wer Du bist: Für Dein Praktikum im Team von Digital Customer Excellence (Bezeichnung der Abteilung) bringst Du folgende Voraussetzungen mit:
• Generelle Voraussetzung zur Beschäftigung als Praktikant/in ist die ordentliche Immatrikulation während des gesamten Praktikums oder aber das Praktikum wird innerhalb eines Gap Years absolviert, also nach dem Bachelorabschluss in Vorbereitung auf ein Masterstudium oder auf die Promotion.
• Du bist Student (m/w/d) mit den Schwerpunkten Wirtschafts- oder Naturwissenschaften, Digitales Management und/oder Gesundheitsmanagement.
• Du bist ein "Early Adopter" von neuen, digitalen Tools/Plattformen und zeichnest Dich aus durch Deine Neugierde in Bezug auf die Entwicklung und Implementierung digitaler Kommunikationsformen.
• Du verfügst über eine gute digitale Affinität sowie eine analytische Herangehensweise.
• Interesse an Marketing in der Pharmabranche und allgemeinen Fragestellungen im gesundheitspolitischen Umfeld.
• Idealerweise praktische Erfahrungen im Vertrieb oder Gesundheitsmanagement.
• Interesse an CX/UX & Content Management wünschenswert.
• Du überzeugst durch Deine kommunikative Persönlichkeit und Dein Ideenreichtum.
• Deine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Dein analytisches Denken hast Du in Projekten eingesetzt und diese selbstständig vorangetrieben.
• Du bist ein Teamplayer, gibst und erhältst gerne Feedback und agierst immer mit dem Ziel, das Portfolio des Teams zu verbessern.
• Sichere Kommunikation in Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse runden D

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a member of the Global Digital Hub Team, you will work to ensure fulfillment of the Global Digital Hub long term outcomes and strategy as well as excellent delivery of priorities related to content. You are responsible for supporting Roche disease area teams in translating their brand strategy into content. In addition, you work with relevant stakeholders to ensure the effective deployment of resources and tools to support and ensure that all content related activities are conducted efficiently, cost-effectively, and in accordance with the business needs. This position has a global scope. Your Opportunity In the position of Digital Content Strategist in the area of Immunology/CVRM you will be focusing on:
• Aligning content strategy across disease area teams to ensure business objectives flow seamlessly through the full content supply chain
• Developing customer engagement goals and driving customer-centric content planning that solves identified business problem
• Building integrated omnichannel plans by collaborating with strategy leads, insights teams, and data analytics experts to ensure content reaches customers effectively
• Auditing and optimizing content by identifying gaps, repurposing existing assets across new channels and formats, and maximizing content value
• Fostering cross-functional collaboration across commercial, medical, corporate communications, and global teams to co-create innovative content strategies
• Measuring content performance through KPIs and A/B testing, while building a repository of best practices tailored to customer segments
• Driving continuous improvement by establishing governance principles, encouraging experimentation, and recommending enhancements to service and responsiveness for business partners Who you are You are an upbeat, dynamic individual who is highly involved and passionate about planning, creating and executing content strategies. As a Digital Content Strategist you are an accomplished expert, with a deep knowledge of digital content and demonstrated success executing content strategies and providing high quality enablement of customer engagement. You are a proactive, innovative problem-solver with a focus on sustainable and scalable solutions. You are passionate about personal growth and learning, constantly focusing on improvement of our customer's experience. You have:
• Degree in Life sciences or healthcare experience (considered as a plus) with 3–5 years digital marketing experience
• Content Development experience: Create resonant digital content across multiple channels (email, paid media, congresses)
• Rapid Learning: Quickly master disease areas, competitive landscapes, and brand-specific marketing challenges
• Strong planning, influencing, and cross-functional facilitation skill
• Fluent English; excellent presentation, customer service, and team alignment abilities
• Detail-oriented, organized, independent problem-solver; adaptable to pressure and international schedules; tech-savvy quick learner In exchange we provide you with
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.
• Excellent benefits & flexibility: Roche Annual Bonus, Monthly transportation allowance, Home Office set - up equipment, Health Insurance, Life/Accident insurance, Full salary when on sick leave f

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist in the Global Digital Hub, you ensure the successful delivery of digital campaigns content creation projects within the Digital Campaigns Chapter. The role plays a crucial role in ensuring timely and high-quality digital campaigns content creation coordination and completion. Your Opportunity The Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist may collaborate closely with affiliate business teams or brand teams, third-party-vendors, campaign and global campaign coordinators in the organization, related to project requirements, objectives, and timelines. In the position you will be focusing on: ● Managing the affiliate or global digital campaigns content creation and delivery process, ensuring timely and successful completion of any projects from initiation to final implementation, while ensuring delivery standards are met. ● Incorporating feedback from stakeholders and revise digital campaigns content requests accordingly to ensure alignment with their expectations. ● Instructing stakeholders on new process or requirements that would increase efficiency in the ways of working in subject matter area ● Supporting Campaign Coordinators and Global Campaign Coordinators in client communications in the area of service offering, change management or communication ● Adoption and Center of Excellence: follow existing processes, establish process governance principles and maintain proper documentation and implementation within the scope of responsibility Who you are You are a person with high interest and ability in project coordination with a keen understanding of digital marketing principles and content creation processes. Your excellent organizational and communication skills enable you to manage multiple projects efficiently, ensuring timely and high- quality delivery. You excel at collaborating with diverse stakeholders and adapting to their feedback to meet their needs and expectations. You have: ● Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field. ● Min 1+ years of proven experience in project management, preferably in digital marketing or content creation. ● Strong understanding of digital marketing principles and campaign management. ● Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities, with a track record of managing multiple projects simultaneously. ● Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders. ● Experience in coordinating and collaborating with cross-functional teams, including designers, copywriters, marketers, and clients/stakeholders, strong organizational and time management skills to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously. ● Openness to learn project management tools and software, experience working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. In exchange we provide you with
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.
• Excellent benefits & flexibility: Roche Annual Bonus, Monthly transportation allowance, Home Office set - up equipment, Health Insurance, Life/Accident insurance, Full salary when on sick leave for the first 9 days, Eyeglasses settlement, One-time payment options for various events in the life e.g. wedding, childbirth, Service Awards: We value loyalty with additio

Your Opportunity The Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist may collaborate closely with affiliate business teams or brand teams, third-party-vendors, campaign and global campaign coordinators in the organization, related to project requirements, objectives, and timelines. In the position you will be focusing on: ● Managing the affiliate or global digital campaigns content creation and delivery process, ensuring timely and successful completion of any projects from initiation to final implementation, while ensuring delivery standards are met. ● Incorporating feedback from stakeholders and revise digital campaigns content requests accordingly to ensure alignment with their expectations. ● Instructing stakeholders on new process or requirements that would increase efficiency in the ways of working in subject matter area ● Supporting Campaign Coordinators and Global Campaign Coordinators in client communications in the area of service offering, change management or communication ● Adoption and Center of Excellence: follow existing processes, establish process governance principles and maintain proper documentation and implementation within the scope of responsibility Who you are You are a person with high interest and ability in project coordination with a keen understanding of digital marketing principles and content creation processes. Your excellent organizational and communication skills enable you to manage multiple projects efficiently, ensuring timely and high- quality delivery. You excel at collaborating with diverse stakeholders and adapting to their feedback to meet their needs and expectations. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. The Position As a Design Project Coordinator (DPC), you are the end-to-end owner of design tickets. You act as a central point of contact from ticket intake to delivery, handling all project management, Workfront administration, designer allocation, stakeholder communication. Your mission is to protect creative time for designers and ensure smooth, timely execution across all project types. Your Opportunity: This role demands a proactive approach to project management, including the screening and delegation of incoming tasks, constant communication to optimize project delivery, and the maintenance of a balanced and productive team environment. In this position you will be focusing on:
• Oversee the full lifecycle of assigned Workfront tickets, from intake to closure.
• Review ticket briefs, clarify missing or unclear information with stakeholders.
• Assign designers based on availability and expertise.
• Manage Workfront administration, including metadata, timelines, task transitions, and documentation.
• Act as the single point of contact between stakeholders and designers.
• Coordinate kick-off calls for complex or high-priority projects, and route feedback to designers.
• Ensure timely deliveries, update stakeholders, close tickets, escalate blockers, and track team progress. Who you are:
• 2+ years of professional experience in project management or workflow management, preferably in a design area or similar fast-paced business.
• Exceptional time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.
• Demonstrated ability to organize and manage time efficiently, prioritizing tasks to handle multiple projects concurrently.
• Skilled in fostering client relationships through initial project discussions, ongoing updates, and setting realistic expectations, ensuring smooth project execution. In exchange we provide you with:
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.
• Excellent benefits & flexibility: Roche Annual Bonus, Monthly transportation allowance, Home Office set - up equipment, Health Insurance, Life/Accident insurance, Full salary when on sick leave for the first 9 days, Eyeglasses settlement, One-time payment options for various events in the life e.g. wedding, childbirth, Service Awards: We value loyalty with additional holidays and bonus payment, Work in a hybrid model (2 days/week from the office)
• A global diverse community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity The Executive Business Coordinator & Biosafety Specialist serves as a strategic collaborator to the Country Manager and the Leadership Team. This role combines high-level executive support and organizational management with the specialized responsibility of serving as the site Biosafety Officer (BSO). The position ensures operational excellence, seamless leadership coordination, and full compliance with biological safety standards. Main
• Responsibilities Executive Support & Leadership Management - Executive Assistant to the CM: Act as the primary point of contact and gatekeeper for the Country Manager; managing complex calendars, travel, and high-priority communications. - Leadership Team Coordination: Support the leadership team’s administrative activities, including preparing agendas, documenting meeting minutes (when applicable), and tracking action items to ensure organizational alignment. - Strategic Liaison: Facilitate communication between the CM and internal/external stakeholders, ensuring the CM is briefed and prepared for all engagements. Organizational Business Management & Events - Event Management: Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of organizational events, including town halls, leadership retreats, and corporate functions. - Operational Oversight: Manage administrative workflows and special projects as assigned by the CM to improve organizational efficiency. - Collaboration with finance and procurement team for purchase requisition creation - Establish a good relations with service providers and negotiate to maintain expenses within the defined budget - Ensure good record management of all contracts, according to the record management SOP - Ensure contracts are executed until service delivery and partners payment Biosafety Management (Biosafety Officer Duties) - Policy Development: Create, develop, and revise local biosafety policies and procedures, ensuring alignment with local laws, Roche Group requirements (K17), and industry standards like the WHO Laboratory Biosafety Manual. - Risk Management: Partner with line management to ensure risk assessments for potentially infectious materials are performed and periodically revised. - Compliance & Inspections: Conduct regular inspections and surveillance of workplaces handling contaminated instruments to ensure compliance with biosafety levels and legal requirements. - Safety Programs: Organize health programs for employees, specifically managing Hepatitis B vaccinations and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). - Training & Reporting: Support line management in delivering documented biosafety training and maintaining procedures for reporting incidents or accidents involving infectious materials. - Waste & Vendor Management: Ensure procedures are in place for the legal disposal of biological waste and assist in qualifying outsourced vendors according to K15 and K17 standards. - Regulatory Liaison: Coordinate interactions between the site, local biosafety authorities, and Group SHE, ensuring all notifications and permits are fulfilled. - Self-Assessment: Perform regular self-assessments to verify program compliance and report biosafety metrics, risks, or gaps to site leadership. In the capacity of Biosafety Officer, this role holds the following specific authorities: - Work Stoppage: Authority to stop any activity immediately in the event of imminent danger related to biological exposure. - Regulatory Issuance: Authority to issue detailed biosafety regulations specific to

The Position L’ Opportunite Dans le cadre du cycle client (Ventes, Déploiement et Suivi) et de la stratégie de maintenance de la filiale, Le Technical Service Engineer installe et maintient les équipements chez les clients afin de garantir le niveau de satisfaction des clients et le bon fonctionnement des systèmes. Missions Princiaples Garantir la réalisation des actions techniques du SAV, leur traçabilité et le niveau de satisfaction des clients sur son secteur - Réalise l’installation technique des systèmes sur les sites clients, l’exécution des maintenances préventives et curatives ainsi que les mises à jour des systèmes installés. - Réalise également les désinstallations et réinstallations des systèmes sur site. - Porte une attention particulière à la qualité des actions techniques et administratives réalisées, en respectant le cadre défini par le groupe et la (Valeurs, Contrat, Normes ISO, recommandations Constructeur, cadre réglementaire…) pour parvenir à l’obtention des objectifs fixés. - Contribue aux plans d’action « Satisfaction Client » de son secteur et est responsable de l’exécution de ceux qu’il initie. - Contribue activement aux différents processus ou méthodes mis en place pour conquérir de nouveaux clients, fidéliser et développer nos clients existants. - Renseigne, quantitativement et qualitativement en temps réel, l’ensemble des interventions dans les outils mis à sa disposition et les qualifie selon les règles en cours. Assurer la mise en œuvre d’actions d’amélioration et de fiabilisation des systèmes installés - Remonte les informations techniques à son responsable et alerte celui-ci en cas de difficulté particulière. - S’informe sur les informations diffusées par les supports techniques et les applique dans son activité. - Conçoit ses actions en intégrant systématiquement l’amélioration de la Satisfaction Clients. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Unser Global Internship Programme in Innovation & Sustainability (#IP2TIS) bietet engagierten Talenten eine besondere Gelegenheit, praktische Erfahrungen in der Pharmaindustrie zu sammeln und gleichzeitig einen positiven Beitrag für die Welt zu leisten. Bist Du bereit, Teil eines globalen Netzwerks in mehr als 20 Ländern zu werden, in dem kluge Köpfe gemeinsam an realen Herausforderungen in Innovation & Sustainability arbeiten? Möchtest Du an wirkungsvollen Projekten mitarbeiten, die Zukunft mitgestalten und Veränderung von innen heraus vorantreiben? In diesem Praktikum arbeitest Du an der datenbasierten Optimierung von HVACR-Systemen, um Energieverschwendung in Gebäudebetrieben sichtbar zu machen und gezielt zu reduzieren. Du analysierst bestehende Facility-Daten von mehr als 100 Assets, identifizierst ineffiziente Betriebsweisen wie gleichzeitiges Heizen und Kühlen oder unnötige Laufzeiten und leitest konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab. Innerhalb der ersten drei Monate erstellst Du ein Mapping der zehn energieintensivsten Assets, entwickelst standardisierte Regeln zur Erkennung von Ineffizienzen und erarbeitest einen priorisierten Optimierungsplan für das lokale Facility Management. Damit trägst Du direkt zur Priorität Environment in Roche’s Nachhaltigkeitsstrategie bei, insbesondere zu Climate Change und Sustainable Operations. Die Rolle bietet Dir die Möglichkeit, mit Daten sofort messbare Umweltwirkung und Kosteneinsparungen in einer komplexen Infrastruktur zu erzielen. Deine Aufgaben
• Du analysierst historische Facility-Daten, um Muster von Energieverschwendung und ineffizientem Anlagenbetrieb zu identifizieren
• Du erstellst ein Mapping und Inventar der zehn energieintensivsten Assets auf Basis von Datenmustern
• Du entwickelst standardisierte Regeln zur Erkennung betrieblicher Ineffizienzen, zum Beispiel für HVACR-Unstimmigkeiten oder Abweichungen von Produktionsplänen
• Du bewertest bestehende Daten nach definierten Kriterien und leitest daraus Optimierungspotenziale ab
• Du schlägst Anpassungen von Produktionszeiten und HVACR-Betriebszeiten vor, um unnötigen Energieverbrauch zu vermeiden
• Du quantifizierst das Einsparpotenzial jeder Maßnahme in Bezug auf Energieverbrauch, Kosten und CO₂-Fußabdruck
• Du erarbeitest einen umsetzbaren Optimierungsplan mit einer priorisierten Liste technischer Anpassungen für das lokale Facility Management
• Du bereitest Ergebnisse verständlich auf und stimmst Dich mit relevanten Stakeholdern ab Wer Du bist Du bist aktuell an einer Universität in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudium eingeschrieben, vorzugsweise in den Fachrichtungen Energiemanagement, Energietechnik, Maschinenbau mit Schwerpunkt HLK/Gebäudetechnik, Data Science, Data Analytics, Umwelttechnik oder Facility Management, und möchtest Dein Wissen in einem modernen Arbeitsumfeld im Rahmen eines mindestens 3-monatigen Praktikums einbringen. Außerdem bringst Du Folgendes mit:
• Du hast Erfahrung in der Datenanalyse und kannst mit größeren Datensätzen sicher arbeiten
• Du verfügst über ein grundlegendes technisches Verständnis von HVACR-Systemen und deren Zusammenspiel in industriellen oder großtechnischen Gebäuden
• Du hast ein Basisverständnis von Gebäudeautomationssystemen und davon, wie Facility-Daten erfasst und gesteuert werden
• Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und lösungsorientiert
• Du kommunizierst sicher mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und verfügst über gute Englisch- oder Deutschkenntnisse Auch wenn Du nicht alle Qualifika

The Position Unser Global Internship Programme in Innovation & Sustainability (#IP2TIS) bietet engagierten Talenten eine besondere Gelegenheit, praktische Erfahrungen in der Pharmaindustrie zu sammeln und gleichzeitig einen positiven Beitrag für die Welt zu leisten. Bist Du bereit, Teil eines globalen Netzwerks in mehr als 20 Ländern zu werden, in dem kluge Köpfe gemeinsam an realen Herausforderungen in Innovation & Sustainability arbeiten? Möchtest Du an wirkungsvollen Projekten mitarbeiten, die Zukunft mitgestalten und Veränderung von innen heraus vorantreiben? In diesem Praktikum arbeitest Du an der datenbasierten Optimierung von HVACR-Systemen, um Energieverschwendung in Gebäudebetrieben sichtbar zu machen und gezielt zu reduzieren. Du analysierst bestehende Facility-Daten von mehr als 100 Assets, identifizierst ineffiziente Betriebsweisen wie gleichzeitiges Heizen und Kühlen oder unnötige Laufzeiten und leitest konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab. Innerhalb der ersten drei Monate erstellst Du ein Mapping der zehn energieintensivsten Assets, entwickelst standardisierte Regeln zur Erkennung von Ineffizienzen und erarbeitest einen priorisierten Optimierungsplan für das lokale Facility Management. Damit trägst Du direkt zur Priorität Environment in Roche’s Nachhaltigkeitsstrategie bei, insbesondere zu Climate Change und Sustainable Operations. Die Rolle bietet Dir die Möglichkeit, mit Daten sofort messbare Umweltwirkung und Kosteneinsparungen in einer komplexen Infrastruktur zu erzielen. Deine Aufgaben
• Du analysierst historische Facility-Daten, um Muster von Energieverschwendung und ineffizientem Anlagenbetrieb zu identifizieren
• Du erstellst ein Mapping und Inventar der zehn energieintensivsten Assets auf Basis von Datenmustern
• Du entwickelst standardisierte Regeln zur Erkennung betrieblicher Ineffizienzen, zum Beispiel für HVACR-Unstimmigkeiten oder Abweichungen von Produktionsplänen
• Du bewertest bestehende Daten nach definierten Kriterien und leitest daraus Optimierungspotenziale ab
• Du schlägst Anpassungen von Produktionszeiten und HVACR-Betriebszeiten vor, um unnötigen Energieverbrauch zu vermeiden
• Du quantifizierst das Einsparpotenzial jeder Maßnahme in Bezug auf Energieverbrauch, Kosten und CO₂-Fußabdruck
• Du erarbeitest einen umsetzbaren Optimierungsplan mit einer priorisierten Liste technischer Anpassungen für das lokale Facility Management
• Du bereitest Ergebnisse verständlich auf und stimmst Dich mit relevanten Stakeholdern ab Wer Du bist Du bist aktuell an einer Universität in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudium eingeschrieben, vorzugsweise in den Fachrichtungen Energiemanagement, Energietechnik, Maschinenbau mit Schwerpunkt HLK/Gebäudetechnik, Data Science, Data Analytics, Umwelttechnik oder Facility Management, und möchtest Dein Wissen in einem modernen Arbeitsumfeld im Rahmen eines mindestens 3-monatigen Praktikums einbringen. Außerdem bringst Du Folgendes mit:
• Du hast Erfahrung in der Datenanalyse und kannst mit größeren Datensätzen sicher arbeiten
• Du verfügst über ein grundlegendes technisches Verständnis von HVACR-Systemen und deren Zusammenspiel in industriellen oder großtechnischen Gebäuden
• Du hast ein Basisverständnis von Gebäudeautomationssystemen und davon, wie Facility-Daten erfasst und gesteuert werden
• Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und lösungsorientiert
• Du kommunizierst sicher mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und verfügst über gute Englisch- oder Deutschkenntnisse Auch wenn Du nicht alle Qualifika

title: AI and Automation Engineer-Information Security Governance

titleByLocale.it: AI and Automation Ingegnere-Information Security Governance
titleByLocale.en: AI and Automation Engineer-Information Security Governance
titleByLocale.de: AI and Automation Ingenieur-Information Security Governance
titleByLocale.fr: AI and Automation Ingénieur-Information Security Governance

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Information Security & Privacy By Design team is the engine behind Roche’s security governance. We design, deliver, and support the digital frameworks that protect our organization, including IRAAM (Information Risk Assessment And Mitigation), PETRA (Policy Exceptions Tool for Risk Assessment ), OIA (Outsourcing Impact Assessment), and our cutting-edge GenAI security agents . As an AI & Automation Engineer , you are the vital architect bridging the gap between high-level security expertise and scalable, self-service execution. Your mission is to democratize security and privacy knowledge by building intelligent agents and low-code tools that empower Roche employees. You don’t just manage risk; you build the "digital brains" that make risk management proactive, intuitive, and frictionless. You are an "implementer" who thrives on turning strategic advice into functional code. You believe that security governance is most effective when it is invisible, automated, and powered by data. Description of the Area The Information Security & Privacy By Design team makes Roche’s information security governance accessible through actionable processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate information risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee third-party and personal data processing risks. Our processes are primarily instantiated in the ServiceNow IRM Platform . We work closely with Information Security, Privacy, Risk & Compliance, and IT teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s information risk posture. You’ll be working within the Information Security Governance (ISG) area. ISG is responsible for defining the strategic agenda for information security and privacy topics at the Roche Group level. This is realized within the global Information Security Management System (ISMS) which aligns business and IT strategies, business and technical projects, policies, standards, directives, procedures, governance, legal / regulatory, compliance, and other requirements at a global level. The Information Security & Privacy by Design area is accountable for co-developing, in collaboration with key stakeholders, and stewardship of the strategic direction of the Information Risk Assessment processes based on organizational objectives, industry practices and legal / regulatory requirements - e.g IRAAM, PETRA, OIA. This includes oversight, awareness, direction and continuous improvement to the end-to-end processes and their relevant risk modules in alignment with the global ISMS, corporate directives and Roche management systems (e.g. privacy, quality, risk). Job Responsibilities 1. AI Solution Development & Knowledge Engineering
• Security AI Stewardship: Own the development and roadmap of internal AI-based advisory tools. You will transform static security policies and KB articles into interactive, intelligent agents.
• Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG): Build and optimize data pipelines to ingest diverse sources—including Google Docs, ServiceNow KB articles, and slide decks—into AI models to ensure accurate, grounded advisory.
• Prompt Engineering & Tuning: Continuously refine LLM performance to ensure security and privacy advice is technically sound, brand-aligned, and user-friendly. 2. Low-Code & Automation Engineering
• Self-Service Platforms: Leverage Roche’s low-code platforms( e.g. LEAP Outsystems or similar) to build front-end interfaces that provide employees with 24/7 security guidance

Vos principales responsabilités:
• Vous validez les installations techniques simples et gérez les déménagements
• Vous gérer les pré-installations et installations techniques
• Vous assurez les maintenances préventives et curatives
• Vous effectuez les désinstallations

• De formation technique en électronique ou électricité et/ou licence biomédicale
• Bonne maitrise technique (électricité, hydraulique, mécanique, robotique, électronique…)
• Vous disposez d'une expérience significative dans le domaine du diagnostic dans l'idéal, ou vous possédez une forte appétence pour ce domaine.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Deine Entwicklung Bist Du auf der Suche nach einem Praktikum, das Dir die Möglichkeit bietet, sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich zu wachsen? Möchtest Du Deine theoretischen Kenntnisse in einem praxisorientierten Umfeld anwenden und in einem spannenden Bereich mit deutschlandweiter Bedeutung tätig werden? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig! Werde Teil unseres engagierten Teams und profitiere von individueller Betreuung und regelmäßigem Feedback, um Dein Potenzial voll auszuschöpfen. In deinem Praktikum wirst du direkt an den Head of Mobility Management berichten. Über uns Mobility - nachhaltig, rentabel und attraktiv. Als Mobility Management-Gruppe sind wir verantwortlich für die Mobilität unserer ca. 20.000 Roche Mitarbeiter. Digitale Mobilitätsplattformen, Flugreisen, Deutsche Bahn, ÖPNV, Fahrräder, Elektroautos und zukünftig auch Transporter fürs Beamen? Mit unseren drei Fachbereichen: Travel Management Roche Deutschland, Fleet Management für Mannheim, Penzberg und Ludwigsburg sowie Mobility Site Services in Mannheim und Penzberg gestalten wir die Zukunft der Mobilität. Wir suchen motivierte Talente wie dich, die mit uns auf diese aufregende Reise gehen. Deine Aufgaben: Vielfältig und spannend!
• Du übernimmst die Durchführung von (Teil-)Projekten, darunter die Optimierung von Prozessen mit Tools wie bspw. Lucid Charts
• Du interviewst verschiedene Stakeholder um stets den Ist-Zustand des Prozesses adäquat darzustellen
• Du führst Prozessmappings in Tools wie bspw. Lucid Chart aus
• Du stellst Business Cases auf und bewertest verschiedene Optionen um strategische Entscheidungen zu unterstützen

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Localisation idéale : Touraine. Missions Vous serez en charge de la réalisation des installations (& désinstallation) , des maintenances préventives, curatives et correctives sur l’ensemble du portefeuille de nos systèmes analytiques et pré-post analytiques pour la filiale Roche Diagnostics France. Vos principales responsabilités:
• Vous validez les installations techniques simples et gérez les déménagements
• Vous gérer les pré-installations et installations techniques
• Vous assurez les maintenances préventives et curatives
• Vous effectuez les désinstallations
• Vous réalisez les rétrofits hardware/software des systèmes
• Vous assurez un reporting exact de votre activité, maitrisez les règles et procédures QSE qui impactent votre activité et êtes responsable de la mise à niveau de vos connaissances. Qui vous êtes:
• De formation technique en électronique ou électricité et/ou licence biomédicale
• Bonne maitrise technique (électricité, hydraulique, mécanique, robotique, électronique…)
• Vous disposez d'une expérience significative dans le domaine du diagnostic dans l'idéal, ou vous possédez une forte appétence pour ce domaine.
• Vous avez une bonne aisance relationnelle, une attitude positive, l’esprit d'équipe et un très bon sens du service client
• Vous faites preuve de rigueur et de ponctualité
• Bon niveau d’anglais technique requis Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.it: Regional Field Service Ingegnere - Implementation Team Europe (Poland)
titleByLocale.en: Regional Field Service Engineer - Implementation Team Europe (Poland)
titleByLocale.de: Regional Field Service Ingenieur - Implementation Team Europe (Poland)
titleByLocale.fr: Regional Field Service Ingénieur - Implementation Team Europe (Poland)

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Regional Field Service Engineer - Implementation Team Europe Location: Poland Join our high-performing Field Service team and directly contribute to healthcare excellence across Europe. This critical role offers the unique opportunity to leverage your technical expertise and problem-solving skills to install complex analytical laboratory systems and act as a knowledge expert for the entire region. We are seeking someone eager to learn in a diverse environment, committed to co-creation, and focused on delivering exceptional service to our customers and, ultimately, patients. The Opportunity As a Regional Field Service Engineer, you are accountable for achieving service excellence across the Europe region. You will act as the knowledge expert, ensuring the successful setup and operation of our CoreLab analytical platforms.
• Lead Complex Installations: Successfully install and technically release CoreLab analytical laboratory instrument platforms for customer use.
• Act as Knowledge Expert: Contribute to large customer projects and serve as a technical resource, transferring knowledge and supporting other Field Service Engineers across borders.
• Ensure Compliance: Document all regional service activities accurately and timely in the CRM system, ensuring full compliance with company quality procedures.
• Drive Service Excellence: Independently analyze and resolve most technical questions and problems, only referring the most complex issues to senior levels.
• Monitor and Optimize: Develop and monitor local reports to ensure the efficient and productive delivery of services and actively monitor costs for your own service activities. Actively gather information in preparation for meetings, delivering and sharing the outcome with others.
• Manage Project Lifecycle: Focus on installations for large projects that require special attention based on continuous Roche affiliates and customer demands and specifications.
• Stay Current: Remain aware of new service bulletins and Global Customer Support (GCS) updates, implementing new ways of working and promoting teamwork. Who You Are We are looking for you to bring dedication, technical depth, and a commitment to service to our team.
• Technical Background: You have full technical higher education (precision mechanics, electronic, Information Technology, Medical Technology, or related specialties).
• Experience Level: We welcome applications from recent university graduates and those with 1–3 years of experience who are eager to grow their professional footprint and build a long-term career within Roche.
• Core Technical Skills: You possess basic knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, and Information Technology (IT) and Networking concepts.
• Soft Skills: As an excellent communicator, you possess the analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills necessary to bridge complex challenges with clear solutions autonomously. With a mastery of organization and prioritization, you consistently deliver high-quality customer service while demonstrating the ability and willingness to collaborate seamlessly within a multi-cultural environment.
• Language skills: You are fluent in English (verbal and written).
• Mobility & Operational Requirement: You hold a valid driver’s license and are prepared for frequent travel throughout Europe. To support this high level of mobility, you reside close to an international airport, ensuring efficient travel and seamless connectivity for our European operation

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we believe that data-driven decisions are the heartbeat of innovation. As a Decision Analytics Consultant , you won’t just be analyzing requirements; you will be a trusted advisor and a strategic bridge between complex technical landscapes and business outcomes. You will lead end-to-end business analysis workstreams, leveraging advanced analytics and statistical modeling to tackle ambiguity and transform complex clinical or operational data into actionable insights. Your mission is to ensure that every solution we build provides demonstrable value to our patients and our organization. Your Impact & Responsibilities
• Strategic Advisory & Leadership: Independently manage end-to-end BA workstreams. You will act as a consultant to cross-functional teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives and aligning project goals with long-term solution roadmaps.
• Data-Driven Decision Making: Ability to gather, analyze, and interpret complex datasets (quantitative and qualitative) to inform product and UX decisions; Experience translating user behavior, metrics, and feedback into actionable insight; Proficiency in tools such as SQL, Excel, or Tableau
• Solution Design & Product Development: Translate complex business requirements into strategic implementation plans. You will design data products (datasets, KPI frameworks) and evaluate vendor solutions to ensure they meet our technical and business standards.
• User Behavior & Experience Analysis: Strong capability to analyze user journeys, pain points, and interaction patterns; Experience with usability testing, A/B testing, and heuristic evaluations; Familiarity with UX research tools such as Google Analytics, Hotjar, or Mixpanel
• Requirements Elicitation & Problem Structuring: Expertise in breaking down ambiguous business problems into structured requirements and hypotheses; Ability to synthesize stakeholder needs, technical constraints, and user expectations into clear functional and non-functional requirements; Skilled in creating user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows
• Process Excellence & Mentorship: As a senior member of our Community of Practice, you will mentor junior and intermediate BAs, proactively shaping our methodologies and driving continuous improvement in our operational workflows.
• Technical Integrity: Drive the analysis and ensure comprehensive requirements traceability, maintaining a focus on data governance and change management. Who You Are You are someone who thrives in dynamic environments, loves tackling "gray areas," and is passionate about the intersection of technology and human health. You bring structure to chaos and are a natural communicator. Qualifications & Experience:
• Experience: 5+ years of experience in Business Analysis or Consultancy, with at least 3+ years within the Life Sciences/Pharma industry.
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in one of the following fields - Information Systems / Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration (with a focus on IT, Analytics, or Operations), Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) or UX-related discipline, Data Analytics / Data Science. Master’s degree (or equivalent experience) in - MBA (Information Systems or Product Management focus), Human-Computer Interaction (HCI),Data Analytics / Business Analytics is highly desirable.
• Analytical Mastery: SQL, BI tools (Tableau/Power BI), UX analytics platforms (Google Analytics, Mixpanel), and collaboration tools (Jira, Confluence). Familiarity

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición. OBJETIVOS DEL CARGO: Asegurar la excelencia en el servicio técnico a través de la gestión de acciones proactivas, de mantenimientos y soporte especializado. Apoyar la puesta en marcha de equipos y asesorar a los clientes en el uso óptimo de la tecnología para cumplir con los estándares globales de calidad de la compañía. Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:
• Ejecutar mantenimientos preventivos y correctivos, asegurando el registro, documentación y cierre oportuno de casos en Rexis, así como la correcta trazabilidad de la información técnica.
• Realizar la instalación y puesta en marcha de equipos bajo estándares de calidad del fabricante, coordinando con las áreas de Aplicaciones e IT.
• Brindar soporte técnico a clientes, resolviendo consultas, reclamos y problemas de funcionamiento, además de asesorar en el uso adecuado de los equipos.
• Asegurar el cumplimiento de normativas y políticas corporativas, incluyendo la gestión de notificaciones, entrega de evidencias documentales, control de sustancias y residuos peligrosos, y coordinación con logística para su disposición.
• Impulsar el desarrollo técnico continuo, aprobando entrenamientos, transfiriendo conocimiento al equipo y brindando apoyo en actividades de taller según se requiera. Tu Perfil:
• Título universitario o técnico en Electrónica, Mecánica o áreas afines.
• Experiencia de al menos 3 años en funciones similares o 2 años en manejo de plataformas Roche.
• Nivel de inglés intermedio.
• Manejo de herramientas Office a nivel intermedio. #LI-DC1 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición. OBJETIVOS DEL CARGO: Asegurar la excelencia en el servicio técnico a través de la gestión de acciones proactivas, de mantenimientos y soporte especializado. Apoyar la puesta en marcha de equipos y asesorar a los clientes en el uso óptimo de la tecnología para cumplir con los estándares globales de calidad de la compañía. Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:
• Ejecutar mantenimientos preventivos y correctivos, asegurando el registro, documentación y cierre oportuno de casos en Rexis, así como la correcta trazabilidad de la información técnica.
• Realizar la instalación y puesta en marcha de equipos bajo estándares de calidad del fabricante, coordinando con las áreas de Aplicaciones e IT.
• Brindar soporte técnico a clientes, resolviendo consultas, reclamos y problemas de funcionamiento, además de asesorar en el uso adecuado de los equipos.
• Asegurar el cumplimiento de normativas y políticas corporativas, incluyendo la gestión de notificaciones, entrega de evidencias documentales, control de sustancias y residuos peligrosos, y coordinación con logística para su disposición.
• Impulsar el desarrollo técnico continuo, aprobando entrenamientos, transfiriendo conocimiento al equipo y brindando apoyo en actividades de taller según se requiera. Tu Perfil:
• Título universitario o técnico en Electrónica, Mecánica o áreas afines.
• Experiencia de al menos 3 años en funciones similares o 2 años en manejo de plataformas Roche.
• Nivel de inglés intermedio.
• Manejo de herramientas Office a nivel intermedio. #LI-DC1 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
