descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next. The Procurement Manager - Clinical Laboratories role sits within the Indirect Procurement Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution. The Indirect Procurement Delivery group comprises many communities grouping categories of the same value chain or having commonality, including Research & Development, Commercial and Corporate Services, Digital & Technology, and Facilities. The communities are key enablers of strong category expertise while allowing flexibility in the procurement delivery response to the evolving needs of our customers. The Opportunity:
• You will bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Applying both general procurement and specialized knowledge or expertise in a specific commodity or spend area, you will ensure effective and efficient delivery of core procurement services and continuous improvement of automation and content availability.
• You will collaborate closely with internal procurement (i.e. Chapters and capability areas such as customer relationship management, contracting, solutions, analytics, etc.) and business stakeholders to translate business needs into sourcing and spend management activities and content enhancement.
• You will work closely with other team members to support customer demand, improve the customer buying experience, deliver on day-to day operational activities, and provide capacity and expertise to deliver productivity and other customer oriented projects/solutions.
• You are a Category and sourcing subject matter specialist in Clinical Laboratories conducting market and internal analysis to develop strategies and tactical plans for how Roche should source and negotiate for third party goods and services in order to satisfy stakeholder requirements.
• You are a Procurement delivery practitioner delivering and executing sourcing strategies by leveraging spend, category know-how, robust sourcing, negotiation, contracting, supplier management methodologies and frameworks and project management skills.
• You develop content and automation, translating sourcing outcomes and opportunities into content and automated buying channels that improve business adoption, satisfaction, and overall efficiency. Who you are:
• You hold a university degree, preferably in business or a scientific related discipline like Biological/Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biochemistry or related field.
• You have proven procurement experience in strategic sourcing, category strategy building and strategic project execution with general contracting understanding and proficiency or relevant related commodity experience, preferably in the Pharmaceutical industry.
• You have experience in procurement systems, processes and skills in project management.
• You possess knowledge and experience in the Clinical Laboratories commodity area (Genomics and Genetics, Bio

Principais Responsabilidades
• Gestão de Contratos: Elaboração de instrumentos de baixa complexidade baseados em minutas pré-aprovadas e gestão do fluxo de assinaturas via DocuSign . Apoio na revisão de cláusulas contratuais operacionais e rotineiras.
• Apoio ao Contencioso: Interface direta com as áreas internas (P&C/RH, Comercial e Finanças) para obtenção de subsídios e documentos necessários para a defesa em processos trabalhistas, de consumo e crédito e cobrança, apoiando nossos escritórios parceiros. Organização e envio e recebimento de relatórios mensais junto aos escritórios parceiros. Gestão do controle de contencioso da área.
• Administrativo: Gestão financeira da área (suporte a pagamentos e controle com abertura de requisições de pagamento e gestão de notas fiscais), organização de planilhas de controle financeiro.
• Comunicação e Atendimento: Gestão da caixa de e-mail institucional do jurídico e triagem de demandas. Suporte inicial de atendimento às áreas para esclarecimento de dúvidas jurídicas gerais. Atualização constante da Intranet jurídica e gestão de procurações da companhia.

• Formação: Cursando Direito (preferencialmente a partir do 5º/6º semestre / 3º ano).

• Organização: Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas e prazos com atenção aos detalhes.
• Comunicação: Boa escrita e facilidade de interlocução com diferentes áreas da empresa.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Sobre a Roche: Um futuro mais saudável. Éso que nos impulsiona a inovar. Avançar aggiunto na ciência e garantir que todos tenham acesso à saúde - hoje e nas gerações futures. Criando um mundo onde todos nós teremos mais tempo com as pessoas que amamos. É isso que nos faz Roche. A Oportunidade: Você busca uma experiência prática onde a teoria da faculdade encontra o mundo real? Como Estagiário de Suporte de Campo em Recife , você será o braço direito dos nossos Especialistas. Seu papel será fondamentale para garantir a disponibilitàdade dos ativos e a excelência no atendimento ao nosso clientela. Aqui você terá voz ativa e aprenderá a gerir uma operação de campo de ponta a ponta, vivenciando desde a execução técnica até até a rappresentaação estratégica de resultados. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem:
• Apoio Técnico: Auxiliar em manutenções preventivas e corretivas diretamente no campo.
• Monitoramento e Gestão: Acompanhar e atualizar indicadores de performance (KPIs) da operação.
• Comunicação Estratégica: Redigir comunicados técnicos e informativos para o clientela final sobre o status das atividades.
• Documentação: Organizar relatórios de visitas, checklists de manutenção e o planejamento de atividades.
• Melhoria Contínua: Participar ativamente de análises de causa raiz para evitar a reincidência de falhas. Requerimenti:
• Formação: Cursando Engenharia (Mecânica, Elétrica, Produção), Tecnologia em Manutenção ou áreas correlatas.
• Localidade: Recife
• Ferramentas: Domínio do Pacote Office e ferramentas Google.
• Tecnologia: Habilidade no uso de Inteligência Artificial para otimização de tarefas.
• Comunicação: Excelente capacidade de escrita (essencial para o contato com o clientela).

Nos esforzamos por formar equipos que representen una variedad de antecedentes, perspectivas y habilidades. Abrazar la diversidad nos permite crear un excelente lugar para trabajar e innovar para los pacientes. Resumen de la posición: Como Pasante de Marketing, serás un motor de transformación en nuestra organización. Acompañarás iniciativas y procesos que fortalecen las estrategias de mercadotecnia y de negocio de cada área terapéutica. Tu rol será clave para que los procesos de marketing soporten la ejecución de nuestros planes táctico en el sistema de salud. • ● Proveer el soporte para implementar las estrategias del portafolio: apoyo en ejecución de los eventos locales del Área Terapeútica (AT) y ejecución de campañas omnicanal.
• ● Reusar, crear y desarrollar materiales promocionales y no promocionales utilizando la herramienta de sometimiento correspondiente (Veeva Promomats)
• ● Colaborar con él/la Therapeutic Area Support Partner en el proceso de creación, ejecución y cierre de eventos comerciales relacionados con el AT.
• ● Colaborar y coordinar procesos con Agencias creativas y/o audiovisuales

• ● Conocimientos específicos: Inglés B2/ Upper Intermediate
• Mindset y Skills esperados:
• ● Adoptar los valores de Roche: integridad, coraje y pasión
• ● Interés genuino en la gente.
• ● Iniciativa.
• ● Comunicación efectiva.
• ● Inglés intermedio - avanzado.
• Adicionalmente, se espera que el/la Disease Area Marketing Intern demuestre los Principios Operativos de Roche y contribuya al Grupo Roche.

• ● Poner a los pacientes primero.
• ● Seguir la ciencia.
• ● Actuar como un solo equipo.
• ● Abrazar las diferencias.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La posizione Rari disturbi del sangue Account & Community Manager – DC/Baltimore Ecosystem Fin dall'inizio, Genentech è stato un team di individui altamente dedicati e appassionati. Siamo un luogo in cui le persone sono unite intorno a un unico scopo e una visione ambiziosa. Insieme, aspiriamo a fornire risultati di salute sempre migliori per i pazienti, riducendo al contempo i costi complessivi di assistenza sanitaria. Il nostro obiettivo è quello di costringere il cliente ad agire per conto dei loro pazienti, mostrando grande impegno per la comunità delle malattie rare, il cui sostegno è fondamentale. Utilizzando metodi innovativi per identificare i pazienti che possono beneficiare del trattamento, dobbiamo adottare un approccio altamente strategico all'accesso dei pazienti, aiutando i pazienti e i loro assistenti a navigare nel sistema sanitario. L'opportunità: Il RBD-ACM è un ruolo chiave che si concentra sulla comprensione e sull'affrontare le esigenze dei fornitori di servizi sanitari, delle farmacie speciali, dei pazienti/caregiver e dei gruppi di advocacy dei pazienti. Essi mirano a migliorare i risultati del paziente, ridurre i costi e migliorare la qualità della cura. Prendendo la proprietà del loro Area Terapeutica, collaborano con gli stakeholder per massimizzare l'impatto e migliorare l'esperienza del cliente e del paziente. Essi forniscono informazioni sui prodotti, influenzano la strategia aziendale e rappresentano tutti i prodotti rilevanti all'interno della loro area. Essi guidano la domanda clinica all'interno delle linee guida, assicurano scelte farmacologiche appropriate e aumentano la domanda paziente e caregiver di informazioni. Essi raccolgono intuizioni, sostengono la strategia nazionale a livello locale, e rappresentano prodotti Genentech eticamente e professionalmente.
• Servire come punto di contatto primario e identificare le opportunità per l'attuazione di strategie di ecosistema e TA nell'area terapeutica, impegnandosi con fornitori di servizi sanitari, farmacie speciali, pazienti/caregiver e membri del team di advocacy paziente
• Mobilitare esperti di ecosistema e organizzazione per collaborare con i clienti e affrontare i loro obiettivi clinici, educativi e aziendali, mirando a migliorare i risultati dei pazienti, ridurre i costi e migliorare la qualità della cura
• Identificare e sviluppare in modo proattivo soluzioni per conti complessi all'interno e all'interno di ecosistemi, tra cui la rete accademica, messa a fuoco e TA account speciali
• Fornire istruzione ai fornitori di assistenza sanitaria sulle informazioni sui prodotti, uso appropriato, dosaggio e amministrazione, in base alle linee guida approvate dalla FDA. Collabora con farmacie speciali per rafforzare la proposizione di valore dell'Area Terapeutica, condurre recensioni aziendali e identificare le opportunità. Fornire ai membri del gruppo di advocacy pazienti/caregivers e pazienti risorse e informazioni per potenziare le loro discussioni con i fornitori di assistenza sanitaria e la partecipazione attiva alle decisioni sanitarie Si tratta di un ruolo basato sul campo, il territorio coprirà la maggiore area DC/Baltimore tra cui Northern VA. È preferito che i candidati vivono nel territorio per considerazione Chi sei: Qualifiche
• Laurea in economia, scientifica o clinica, livello di laurea al minimo
• È necessaria una precedente esperienza di settore interfunzionale nelle scienze della vita commerciale (farmaco o biotecnologia) o nell'industria in relazione con i principali operatori dell'ecosistema sanitario (ad es. finanziatori, sistemi sanitari).
• 6 o più anni di esperienza che lavorano in un ruolo di vendita con HCP, rappresentando idealmente più prodotti e lavorando in un ambiente di sistema sanitario complesso
• Competenze dimostrate nell'addestramento, nella formazione e nella mentoring degli altri per aiutarli a raggiungere i loro obiettivi e responsabilità, superando obiettivi e aspettative
• Forte capacità di cercare e applicare in modo proattivo informazioni pertinenti per risolvere problemi complessi, assimilare e comunicare efficacemente le informazioni cliniche e di prodotto, e affrontare le questioni operative nella consegna dei prodotti sanitari, compreso il rimborso e la fornitura. Comprensione di leggi, codici e politiche aziendali applicabili nel settore sanitario Preferiti:
• Precedente 4-6 anni di competenze di gestione del conto o patien
descriptionByLocale.en:
The Position Rare Blood Disorders Account & Community Manager – DC/Baltimore Ecosystem From the beginning, Genentech has been a team of highly dedicated, passionate individuals. We are a place where people are united around a single purpose and an ambitious vision. Together, we aspire to deliver ever better health outcomes for patients while lowering overall healthcare costs. Our goal is to compel the customer to act on behalf of their patients while showing great commitment to the rare disease community, whose support is key. Utilizing innovative methods to identify patients who may benefit from treatment, we must take a highly strategic approach to patient access while assisting patients and their caregivers to navigate the healthcare system. The Opportunity: The RBD-ACM is a key role that focuses on understanding and addressing the needs of healthcare providers, specialty pharmacies, patients/caregivers, and patient advocacy groups. They aim to improve patient outcomes, lower costs, and enhance the quality of care. By taking ownership of their Therapeutic Area, they collaborate with stakeholders to maximize impact and improve the customer and patient experience. They provide information about products, influence the business strategy, and represent all relevant products within their area. They drive clinical demand within guidelines, ensure appropriate medication choices, and increase patient and caregiver demand for information. They gather insights, support the national strategy at a local level, and represent Genentech products ethically and professionally.
• Serve as the primary point of contact and identify opportunities for implementing ecosystem and TA squad strategies in the therapeutic area, engaging with healthcare providers, specialty pharmacies, patients/caregivers, and patient advocacy team members
• Mobilize ecosystem and organization experts to partner with customers and address their clinical, educational, and business goals, aiming for improved patient outcomes, lower costs, and enhanced quality of care
• Proactively identify and develop solutions for complex accounts within and across ecosystems, including academic, delivery network focused, and TA specialty accounts
• Deliver education to healthcare providers on product information, appropriate use, dosing and administration, based on FDA approved guidelines. Collaborate with specialty pharmacies to reinforce the value proposition of the Therapeutic Area, conduct business reviews, and identify opportunities. Provide patients/caregivers and patient advocacy group members with resources and information to empower their discussions with healthcare providers and active participation in healthcare decisions This is a field based role, the territory will cover the Greater DC/Baltimore area including Northern VA. It is preferred that candidates live in the territory for consideration Who you are: Qualifications
• Business, Scientific or Clinical degree, Bachelor’s degree level at minimum
• Previous cross-functional industry experience in commercial life sciences (pharma or biotechnology) or related industry engaging with key healthcare ecosystem players (e.g., payers, health systems), is required
• 6 or more years of experience working in a sales role with HCPs, ideally representing multiple products and working across a complex healthcare system environment
• Demonstrated expertise in coaching, training, and mentoring others to help them achieve their goals and responsibilities, exceeding targets and expectations
• Strong ability to proactively seek and apply relevant information to solve complex problems, assimilate and effectively communicate clinical and product information, and address operational issues in healthcare product delivery, including reimbursement and supply. Understanding of applicable laws, codes, and company policies in the healthcare industry Preferred Qualifications:
• Previous 4-6 years of account management skills or patien
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Position Rare Blood Disorders Account & Community Manager – DC/Baltimore Ecosystem Von Anfang an war Genentech ein Team von hoch engagierten, leidenschaftlichen Individuen. Wir sind ein Ort, an dem Menschen um einen einzigen Zweck und eine ehrgeizige Vision vereint sind. Gemeinsam wollen wir immer bessere Gesundheitsergebnisse für Patienten liefern und gleichzeitig die Gesamtkosten für die Gesundheitsversorgung senken. Unser Ziel ist es, den Kunden dazu zu zwingen, im Namen ihrer Patienten zu handeln, während er großes Engagement für die seltene Krankheitsgemeinschaft zeigt, deren Unterstützung entscheidend ist. Durch die Verwendung innovativer Methoden zur Identifizierung von Patienten, die von der Behandlung profitieren können, müssen wir einen hochgradig strategischen Ansatz für den Patientenzugriff bei gleichzeitiger Unterstützung von Patienten und deren Pflegepersonen zur Navigation des Gesundheitssystems ergreifen. Die Gelegenheit: Der RBD-ACM ist eine zentrale Rolle, die sich auf das Verständnis und die Bewältigung der Bedürfnisse von Gesundheitsdienstleistern, Spezialapotheken, Patienten/Betreuern und Patienten-Werbungsgruppen konzentriert. • Mobilisieren Sie Ökosystem- und Organisationsexperten, um mit Kunden zusammenzuarbeiten und ihre klinischen, pädagogischen und betriebswirtschaftlichen Ziele anzusprechen, um verbesserte Patientenergebnisse, geringere Kosten und verbesserte Pflegequalität zu erreichen
• Proaktiv zu identifizieren und zu entwickeln Lösungen für komplexe Konten innerhalb und außerhalb von Ökosystemen, einschließlich akademischer, konzentrierter Liefernetzwerke und TA-Spezialkonten

Es ist bevorzugt, dass Kandidaten in dem Gebiet leben, um zu berücksichtigen Wer du bist: Qualifikationen
• Business, Wissenschaftlicher oder klinischer Abschluss, Bachelor-Abschluss mindestens
• Vorherige funktionsübergreifende Branchenerfahrungen in der gewerblichen Lebenswissenschaften (Apothek oder Biotechnologie) oder in der damit verbundenen Industrie, die sich mit wichtigen Akteuren des Gesundheitswesens (z.B. Zahler, Gesundheitssysteme) befasst, sind erforderlich
• 6 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung in einer Vertriebsrolle bei HCPs, die sich ideal für mehrere Produkte auszeichnet und über eine komplexe Gesundheitssystemumgebung arbeitet
• Gezeigtes Know-how in Coaching, Training und Mentoring anderer, um ihnen dabei zu helfen, ihre Ziele und Aufgaben zu erreichen, Ziele und Erwartungen zu übertreffen
• Starke Fähigkeit, relevante Informationen proaktiv zu suchen und anzuwenden, um komplexe Probleme zu lösen, klinische und Produktinformationen zu assimilieren und effektiv zu kommunizieren und operative Probleme in der Gesundheitsproduktlieferung, einschließlich Erstattung und Versorgung zu lösen. Verständnis der geltenden Gesetze, Codes und Unternehmenspolitiken in der Gesundheitsbranche Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:
• Vorherige 4-6 Jahre Account Management Fähigkeiten oder Terrasse
descriptionByLocale.fr:
La position Compte sur les troubles sanguins rares et gestionnaire communautaire – écosystème DC/Baltimore Dès le début, Genentech a été une équipe de personnes très dévouées et passionnées. Nous sommes un endroit où les gens sont unis autour d'un but unique et d'une vision ambitieuse. Ensemble, nous aspirons à obtenir des résultats de santé toujours meilleurs pour les patients tout en réduisant les coûts globaux des soins de santé. Notre objectif est d'obliger le client à agir au nom de ses patients tout en montrant un grand engagement envers la communauté des maladies rares, dont le soutien est essentiel. En utilisant des méthodes novatrices pour identifier les patients susceptibles de bénéficier d'un traitement, nous devons adopter une approche hautement stratégique de l'accès des patients tout en aidant les patients et leurs soignants à naviguer dans le système de santé. La possibilité : Le RBD-ACM est un rôle clé qui vise à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des fournisseurs de soins de santé, des pharmacies spécialisées, des patients/soins et des groupes de défense des droits des patients. Ils visent à améliorer les résultats des patients, à réduire les coûts et à améliorer la qualité des soins. En s'approprier leur domaine thérapeutique, ils collaborent avec les intervenants pour maximiser l'impact et améliorer l'expérience des clients et des patients. Ils fournissent des informations sur les produits, influencent la stratégie commerciale et représentent tous les produits pertinents dans leur région. Ils conduisent la demande clinique à l'intérieur des lignes directrices, assurent des choix de médicaments appropriés et augmentent la demande d'information des patients et des soignants. Ils recueillent des idées, soutiennent la stratégie nationale au niveau local et représentent les produits Genentech de manière éthique et professionnelle.
• Servir de point de contact principal et identifier les possibilités de mettre en oeuvre des stratégies d'équipes d'écosystèmes et d'AT dans le domaine thérapeutique, en collaboration avec les fournisseurs de soins de santé, les pharmacies spécialisées, les patients/soins et les membres de l'équipe de défense des patients
• Mobiliser les experts de l'écosystème et de l'organisation pour qu'ils s'associent à leurs clients et s'attaquent à leurs objectifs cliniques, éducatifs et commerciaux, en vue d'améliorer les résultats des patients, de réduire les coûts et d'améliorer la qualité des soins
• Identifier et développer de manière proactive des solutions pour des comptes complexes à l'intérieur et à l'intérieur des écosystèmes, y compris des comptes spécialisés universitaires, axés sur les réseaux de prestation et des comptes spécialisés d'AT
• Offrir aux fournisseurs de soins de santé des informations sur les produits, leur utilisation, leur dosage et leur administration, sur la base des directives approuvées par la FDA. Collaborer avec les pharmacies spécialisées pour renforcer la proposition de valeur du secteur thérapeutique, effectuer des examens commerciaux et cerner les possibilités. Fournir aux patients/soins et aux membres du groupe de défense des droits des patients des ressources et des informations leur permettant de discuter avec les fournisseurs de soins de santé et de participer activement aux décisions en matière de soins de santé C'est un rôle sur le terrain, le territoire couvrira la région du Grand DC/Baltimore, y compris l'AV du Nord. Il est préférable que les candidats vivent sur le territoire pour considération Qui vous êtes : Compétences
• Diplôme d'entreprise, scientifique ou clinique, niveau de baccalauréat au minimum
• Une expérience antérieure interfonctionnelle de l'industrie des sciences de la vie commerciales (pharmacie ou biotechnologie) ou de l'industrie connexe, en collaboration avec les principaux acteurs de l'écosystème de la santé (p. ex. payeurs, systèmes de santé), est requise
• 6 ans ou plus d'expérience dans un rôle de vente avec des HCP, représentant idéalement plusieurs produits et travaillant dans un environnement complexe du système de santé
• Expertise démontrée dans le coaching, la formation et le mentorat d'autres personnes pour les aider à atteindre leurs buts et leurs responsabilités, dépassant les objectifs et les attentes
• Forte capacité de rechercher et d'appliquer de façon proactive des informations pertinentes pour résoudre des problèmes complexes, assimiler et communiquer efficacement des informations cliniques et des informations sur les produits, et aborder les problèmes opérationnels liés à la livraison des produits de santé, y compris le remboursement et l'approvisionnement. Compréhension des lois, codes et politiques d'entreprise applicables dans le secteur de la santé Qualifications préférées :
• 4-6 ans de compétences en gestion de compte ou patien

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Are you organized, detail-oriented, and energized by keeping complex operations running smoothly? Roche is seeking a Facilities Specialist to serve as a key contributor to our facilities management team. You'll coordinate maintenance, manage SAP systems, supervise contractors, and be the trusted liaison between our internal customers and facilities services. If you have SAP Plant Maintenance expertise, strong customer service skills, and thrive in regulated environments, this role offers the perfect blend of technical and interpersonal challenge. The Opportunity Essential Job Functions & Major Contributions
• Coordinates facility repair and maintenance frequently involving the supervision of contractors. Inspects completed work for quality, compliance with local procedures and documentation for final approval. Primary liaison between internal customers and facilities management for unscheduled maintenance and projects, local personnel and equipment relocations, and small projects.
• Coordinates and supervises various contracted maintenance services that includes but is not limited to mechanical, plumbing and electrical equipment and systems. Assesses service provider performance at least annually.
• Primary or back-up SAP Plant Maintenance coordinator, adding equipment master records, functional locations, setting up maintenance plans and general equipment task lists, generating and tracking PM and maintenance orders, documenting order completion, and auditing of maintenance records and reports to ensure regulatory compliance of the maintenance program. Generates CMMS reports based on gathered metrics.
• Assist with delegating repair/service tickets to the Facilities Team
• Assists with handles invoices for review, approval, payment, and filing. Acts as the primary liaison GenMark Facilities group, service providers and Accounts Payable.
• Responsible for collection and prompt reporting of any customer service-related issues directly to the Facilities Manager or Director. Responsibilities may include preparing, tabulating, and analyzing customer satisfaction surveys related to any or all of the wide array of service provided by the group through ServiceNow.
• Support O&M technical leads, which may include periodically performing daily rounds and on-call services
• Maintains GMP SOPs and non-GMP Facilities documents
• Trained to input SOP Change Requests
• Other tasks delegated to by the Manager Who You Are Education & Experience
• Bachelors Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Business Administration, etc.
• Minimum 2 years working experience with SAP Plant Maintenance Module software and knowledge of Archibus
• Minimum 4 years’ experience working in a customer service intensive role and /or facilities maintenance planning
• Exceptional customer service skills
• Experience working in an ISO and FDA regulated environment.
• Advanced computer skills - e.g., MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), Google Workspace Preferred:
• Technical/trade school specializing in electrical, plumbing or mechanical systems.
• Thorough expertise using SAP Plant Maintenance Module software, Archibus, and ServiceNow
• 6 or more years’ experience working in a relevant Facilities Management and Planning position
• Experience working with Monday.com This position is not eligible for relocation. The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $66,900 - $124,200 USD Annual. Act

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. As a Territory Manager (Individual Contributor) based in Kottayam , you will play a crucial role in driving sales, Doctor Promotion, retail promotion, managing distribution networks, and executing sales promotion plans for your territory. You will ensure our products penetration in the assigned market effectively by supporting distributors, gathering market insights, and partnering with the Area Sales Manager (ASM) to achieve our business goals. The Opportunity
• Promote pharmaceutical products to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) through scientific communication, relationship building, product detailing, and ethical marketing to increase product awareness and prescriptions.
• You assist the ASM in planning for the territory by providing market environment insights to estimate yearly demand, submitting distributor-level inventory requirements, and monitoring the stock availability of promotional materials.
• You prepare and execute monthly sales promotion plans—including field activation and merchandising activities—and meticulously record expenses and sales generated to evaluate program efficacy.
• You ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the market.
• You manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones.
• You motivate distributors and dealers through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes.
• You organize distributor and dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies, and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups.
• You act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your customer visits. Who You Are
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field.
• You have proven practical experience in field sales, distribution management, or a territory management role.
• You have a strong interest in driving market growth, with a focus on relationship building, demand generation, and executing marketing strategies.
• You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Doctors, Chemist & dealer interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings.
• You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/Weekly/Monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections.
• You are comfortable with field travel within the Kottayam territory and thrive in a structured environment where you collaborate closely with the Area Sales Manager. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Business Operations Lead

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche .

As a Business Operations Lead , you serve as a strategic and tactical partner to the Functional Leadership team, driving strategy and goals in alignment with Site and Network objectives. You are a multi-discipline professional representing the Site Business Support group, working collaboratively to drive excellence in project portfolio management, change leadership, and operational excellence. You play a key role in deploying site-wide business processes and leading strategic projects, such as product technical transfers and business programs. You push boundaries to enable a continuous improvement mindset and implement lean practices that result in quick and efficient innovation.

Your Opportunity

• Functional Partnership & Excellence: You drive business results by facilitating functional goal development using lean strategy tools. You manage the functional project portfolio process, leading prioritization to ensure alignment with resource management and business timelines.

• Operational Excellence (OE) Deployment: You act as a strong advocacy and change agent for Lean/OE to build a strong continuous improvement culture. You lead process improvement activities to realize productivity outcomes and coach improvement projects to achieve functional goals.

• Organizational Change Management (OCM): You develop and implement effective change management programs to drive execution excellence. You lead site-wide initiatives to build OCM business processes and change leadership capabilities at both leadership and individual levels.

• Program & Project Management: You provide leadership for site-wide initiatives, including CAPEX and Product Technical Transfers. You ensure due diligence is performed to mitigate risks to safety, quality, compliance, and delivery.

• Coaching & Capability Building: You act as a coach for colleagues, helping them develop skills in project management and change leadership methodologies. You serve as a subject matter expert on continuous improvement methods and tools.

• Communication & Safety: You manage functional communications in line with the site plan, ensuring impactful content and timing. You ensure a safe working environment by complying with all Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) requirements and site security measures.

Who You Are

• Education: You hold a degree in Engineering, Project Management, Business Administration, Life Sciences, or an equivalent discipline.

• Experienced Professional: You have a minimum of 8 years of related working experience, preferably within a biotech or pharmaceutical operating environment.

• Project Expert: You possess a proven track record of at least 5 years managing small to medium-scale projects of varying complexity. PMP certification is preferred.

• Technical Specialist : You have essential competencies in Project Portfolio and Program Management, and you are a certified Black Belt in continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean or Six Sigma.

• Change Leader: You have experience leading change initiatives on local, regional, or global levels and are familiar with industry change management standards such as PROSCI .

• Strategic Influencer: You possess excellent verbal and written

• Responsibilities / Accountabilities Strategic planning ● Shape and influence strategy for complex evidence generation deliveries and cross-functional projects ● Lead and/or support evidence generation strategy/plan setting up as critical component of local integrated evidence plan for multiple portfolio and pipeline products across therapeutic areas ● Provide epidemiological inputs with solid understanding of strategic business context in the medical planning process across therapeutic areas Implementation ● Lead the RWD project/studies design, analyses and interpretation. ● Map / license RWD sources and build research collaborations to increase the availability of fit - for - purpose RWD. ● Implement the RWE plan and execute RWE projects timely in close collaboration with cross - functional partners. ● Identify and implement scientifically innovative RWE programs that can support to address business needs and overcome key challenges in drug development using RWD or enable to provide meaningful RWE in support of regulatory decision making (e.g. label changes, new indications), payer decision making and clinical practice. Communication ● Build strong partnerships and opportunities to collaborate and innovate with varying internal and external stakeholders in support of Roche products, programs, processes, systems, and/or compliance ● Communicate scientifically and develop/maintain KOL network in medical/clinical community to ensure appropriate academic consultation/support and address the varying evidence requirements of stakeholders ● Lead the development of new and innovative partnerships with external stakeholders across healthcare ecosystems to co - design and execute innovative study designs and implementation science that address pre identified evidence needs. Development ● Act as a coach, mentor or consult to provide technical expertise on the RWE/epidemiology basics and internal/external trainings. ● Serve as franchise / division level RWE lead to ensure a broad understanding of the value of RWE to the product value demonstration both locally and globally. ● Maintain process standards across the therapeutic areas according to Roche SOPs, China CDE requirements and GPP guidelines with regard to pharmacoepidemiology Qualification and Experience ● Education/
• Qualifications - Master degree or above in the epidemiology, biostatistics, public health or equivalent combination of education and experience - Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in designing, implementation and report of epidemiology/observational studies - Working experiences as real world data scientist/epidemiologist in multinational pharmaceutical company or Clinical Research Organization, experience in oncology studies will be plus ● Leadership Competencies Ability to work effectively in a matrix team ● Job Required Competencies - Expert knowledge of epidemiology/observational methodologies and applications - Previous experience as a key RWD scientist or lead epidemiologist - Good knowledge of statistical programming skill (including SAS programming) - Strong communication skills and ability to work both, independently and collaboratively, as required - Demonstrated project management skills is strongly preferred - Business acumen - Be able to handle technical discussion in fluent English Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to health

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Would you like to start your professional career in the healthcare industry with a biotech leading company? We are looking for "early-in-career" colleague to join our team. The role is based in Kaunas, Lithuania and up to 12-months assignment. If you are a recent graduate from University Degree or you are enrolled in a Master/Postgraduate degree in business discipline, this could be a great opportunity for you. What you can learn? You would provide support directly to the Head of Customer Support and Service, who is leading the Roche Customer service and support and will share with you best practices, tools and build your skills for succeeding in a career. Kick-start your career with Roche! You'll gain hands-on experience in using cutting-edge digital tools. You'll also learn valuable project management skills in a dynamic international setting, working alongside diverse stakeholders and using agile methodologies like SCRUM and SAFe. Based in Kaunas, Lithuania, you'll be part of a multidisciplinary and multicultural team and receive mentorship from the Head of Service and Customer support, who will share insights and help you build a successful career. Main projects and tasks: Office Support & Facilities Coordinator
• Office equipment and premises maintenance coordination
• Workshop hygiene, cleaning coordination
• Office food, coffee and supplies coordination Returns, replacements and decontamination of near patient care devices
• Manage device return from patients
• Manage device replacements to patients and closely collaborate with Supply Chain team
• Manage device decontamination and preparations for a return to centralized location
• Document all returns, replacements and decontamination activities in the system Indirect Procurement Invoices management
• Upload invoices to the system in a timely manner
• Proactively follow up and communicate with colleagues to approve invoices on time
• Proactively collaborate with accounting team on resolving invoices management issues Support Service team
• Implementation and coordination of service team projects & events
• Coordinate products transfer from/to workshop
• Coordinate shipments deliveries to workshop
• Prepare, collect signatures and archive instruments handover acts
• Coordinate and manage various activities for asset monitoring (physical checking at customer site, signatures collection, documents archiving, but not limited)
• Proactively follow up service team certifications training matrix, collect signatures and archive certificates
• Proactively coordinate service tools certification and closely collaborate with the team for tools calibration
• Support the service team with customer contact, instrument and asset management in the data management system. Who You Are:
• Recent graduate from a university degree or master's program
• Prior project management exposure, with the ability to manage multiple timelines and priorities
• Strong collaboration and communication skills
• Ability to prioritize and problem-solve in a fast-paced environment while maintaining strong attention to detail
• Fluency in English and Lithuanian language Salary: 1200-1500 EUR gross/month. Final salary will depend on the level of skills and experience. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result i

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Please note this is a fixed-term role until the end of 2028. The Opportunity: As an Accounts Payable Accountant you are responsible for high quality services to Roche suppliers and internal partners. You will be responsible for booking complex invoices in accordance with Roche and local standards so that the supplier receives the funds in time for the goods supplied and the services rendered. You will have the possibility to have full responsibility for the end-to-end AP process and handling both internal and supplier queries received by phone or mail in local language.
• Process and validate PO based and direct invoices and payment requests, manage and run payments
• Manage vendor accounts
• Audit, report and support AP invoice resolution
• Handle affiliate’s internal invoice queries
• Act as a point of contact, promoting strong collaborative relationships between the affiliate’s finance teams and all other internal SSC teams
• Participate in process improvement and ongoing projects, opportunity to take part in knowledge transfer Who you are:
• University degree in Finance or relevant professional experience
• General understanding of finance processes and standards. Broad experience in accounts payable processes (or related field) and using SAP is an advantage
• Strong communication and advisory skills and you are able to deal with complex issues
• Customer centricity through your day-to-day interactions
• End-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations
• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment
• Proficiency in English and German In exchange we provide you with:
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.
• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.
• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.
• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion. Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Praktikum im Project Portfolio Management mit Schwerpunkt IT-Architektur & KI-Anwendungen (m/w/d) Möchten Sie die Zukunft des Project Portfolio Managements mitgestalten und innovative KI-Lösungen entwickeln? Dann sind Sie bei uns genau richtig! Wer wir sind: Diagnostics Operations Penzberg (DOZ) ist der zweitgrößte Produktionsstandort innerhalb Roche Global Operations und Rohstofflieferant für die gesamte Diagnostics Division. Als führender Hersteller für biologische und chemische Einsatzstoffe ist DOZ ein wichtiger Knotenpunkt im weltweiten Roche Netzwerk. Wir suchen eine/n engagierte/n und motivierte/n Praktikanten/in, die/der unser Team im Bereich Project Portfolio Management (PPM) verstärkt. In dieser spannenden Rolle arbeiten Sie an der Schnittstelle zwischen IT-Architektur und der Implementierung von Künstlicher Intelligenz, um unsere Projektmanagementprozesse zu optimieren und zukunftsfähig zu gestalten. Wenn Sie begeistert vom Projektmanagement und der Steuerung eines großen Projektportfolios sind, dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen! Ihre Aufgaben:
• Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung einer zukunftsweisenden IT-Architektur für das Project Portfolio Management: Sie helfen uns dabei, eine skalierbare und effiziente Architektur zu konzipieren, die den Anforderungen unserer wachsenden Projektlandschaft gerecht wird.
• Identifizierung und Evaluierung von Potenzialen für den Einsatz von KI-Anwendungen im PPM: Sie recherchieren und bewerten innovative KI-Lösungen, die zur Verbesserung von Prognosen, Ressourcenplanung, Risikomanagement und Entscheidungsfindung im Projektportfolio eingesetzt werden können.
• Mitarbeit bei der Konzeption und Implementierung von Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs) für ausgewählte KI-Anwendungen: Sie sind aktiv an der Umsetzung erster Prototypen beteiligt, um die Machbarkeit und den Mehrwert von KI-basierten Lösungen zu demonstrieren.
• Analyse von Projektmanagement-Daten zur Ableitung von Optimierungspotenzialen: Sie unterstützen uns bei der Datenanalyse, um Engpässe und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten in unseren bestehenden PPM-Prozessen zu identifizieren.
• Dokumentation von Prozessen, Architekturen und Best Practices: Sie tragen zur Erstellung und Pflege relevanter Dokumentationen bei, um Wissenstransfer und Nachhaltigkeit zu gewährleisten.
• Unterstützung des Teams im Tagesgeschäft des Project Portfolio Managements: Sie erhalten Einblicke in die täglichen Abläufe und unterstützen bei administrativen und organisatorischen Aufgaben. Ihr Profil:
• Immatrikulierte/r Student/in der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaft oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs.
• Hohe Motivation, Lernbereitschaft und Leidenschaft für Prozessoptimierung .
• Begeisterung für Projektmanagement oder erste Berührungspunkte mit Projekt- oder Portfoliomanagement.
• Interesse an IT-Architektur und Faszination für KI sowie Bereitschaft, sich in neue Technologien
• Analytische, problemlösungsorientierte Denkweise und der Wunsch, Herausforderungen aktiv anzunehmen .
• Selbstständige Arbeitsweise, gute Kommunikation und Teamgeist.
• Fließende Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse. Was wir Ihnen bieten:
• Flexible Zeiteinteilung
• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum > 3 Monate
• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine
• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus
• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden
• Einblicke in die spannende Welt des Project Portfolio Managements und der KI-Entwicklung in einem d

title: Team Lead, RDT Onsite Services Rotkreuz

titleByLocale.it: Capo Team, RDT Onsite Services Rotkreuz
titleByLocale.en: Team Lead, RDT Onsite Services Rotkreuz
titleByLocale.fr: Chef d'équipe, RDT Onsite Services Rotkreuz

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Workforce Enablement (WE) is the home for employee-facing products, services, and experiences within RDT, delivering digital tools and support to empower our workforce globally. Within WE, the Onsite Enablement organization acts as the heartbeat of our physical presence, serving as the bridge between digital strategy and local execution. We ensure that every site—from R&D labs to corporate hubs—operates with seamless, cutting-edge technology services. Our ultimate mission is to provide a frictionless workplace where technology empowers our people to focus on what matters most: improving patient lives. As the Team Lead for RDT Onsite Services in Rotkreuz (Engineering Manager), a role requiring your presence five days a week on-site, you will be accountable for the people, budget, and services required to deliver a high-quality offering for our employees. You will focus on developing your team members' capabilities, encouraging them to self-define their career journeys while supporting them by removing roadblocks and setting clear performance goals. By fostering healthy dynamics, a sustainable pace, and the right skill sets, you will oversee a team of individual contributors to lead software and service delivery, manage stakeholders, and create efficiencies in collaboration to ensure onsite service excellence, infrastructure stability, and an optimal user experience. The Opportunity
• Team Development & Culture: Proactively identify future-focused capabilities, oversee technical and soft skill development (including emotional intelligence), and mentor team members on their career paths while fostering a culture of radical candor, accountability, and psychological safety.
• Health, Sustainability & Change Leadership: Establish team health metrics, design initiatives to improve collaboration, resolve complex systemic impediments, and guide distributed, multi-time-zone teams through organizational shifts, site transitions, or critical system failures while maintaining morale and operational consistency.
• Product Vision & Service Delivery: Co-create the long-term technical vision for the product portfolio, ensure successful delivery and feature shipment, manage technical priorities and dependencies, and ensure deliverables align with both local business needs and global standards.
• Performance & Process Optimization: Define success metrics, lead significant process re-engineering efforts spanning multiple development teams to create step-change improvements, and present technical insights and optimization strategies to senior leadership.
• Financial & Resource Management: Manage the team's budget, headcount planning, operational costs (OPEX), infrastructure upgrades (CAPEX), and vendor contracts to ensure maximum ROI, while supporting business cases for large initiatives and optimizing resource allocation across projects.
• Stakeholder Management & Influence: Manage relationships with senior-level stakeholders, translate complex IT requirements into business value for site heads, negotiate priorities, and tactically shield the team from scope creep while breaking down organizational silos.
• Cross-Functional Enablement: Empower teams to act autonomously, drive initiatives to improve engineering processes, manage the talent pipeline for future needs, and resolve cross-functional roadblocks blocking agile release trains or program teams. Who You Are
• Experienced Leader: You bring 10+ years of experience in people leadership, product/service management,

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Solution Architect for ERP Application Lifecycle (ALM) Processes, Framework and Tools is the primary technical authority responsible for architecting the transition from legacy SAP Solution Manager to a modern, future-proof ALM ecosystem. In this role, you will lead the strategic design and operational excellence of the global "Requirements to Deploy" process, ensuring that our delivery pipeline remains robust during a period of significant technological shift. Your core mission is to navigate the complexities of SAP’s Cloud ALM offering while maintaining the flexibility to custom-build proprietary solutions when standard tools lack the necessary influence on design or functional depth. As part of your daily remit, you will: Architect the Pivot: Actively evaluate the functional gaps within SAP Cloud ALM and decide where the organization must "Build" rather than "Buy." You will be responsible for the high-level design of custom ALM modules (potentially on SAP BTP or other cloud-native platforms) to ensure our specific business requirements are met. Design the "Requirements to Deploy" Lifecycle and Lead Technical Decisioning: You will orchestrate the end-to-end framework including Business Process Modelling, Requirements, Change, Transport, Release, Test, Defect and System Documentation Management. You are not just a tool user; you are the designer of the framework that enables these processes. Govern Hybrid Landscapes: You will define the integration patterns required to link SAP-specific ALM components with the broader enterprise DevOps toolchain, ensuring a "clean core" strategy while managing the decommissioning of legacy SolMan/ChaRM environments. Qualifications
• Mastery of ALM Transition & Toolsets: Expert-level knowledge of legacy ALM (SolMan, Focused Build, ChaRM, Worksoft, Adonis) paired with the ability to architect migrations to SAP Cloud ALM.
• 8+ years of Custom Build & Extensibility Expertise: Proven experience in designing custom-built enterprise software or side-by-side extensions. You must demonstrate an "architectural mindset" capable of building bespoke tools when SaaS products offer limited design influence.
• SDLC & DevOps Proficiency: Deep understanding of ERP change management and transport layers, with a modern approach to API-first design, CI/CD pipelines, and automated release orchestration.
• Advanced competency in using AI-augmented engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, SAP Joule, or equivalent) to improve code quality, automate documentation, and design intelligent extensions that bridge functional gaps in standard SaaS offerings
• Lifecycle Management: Proven track record of managing at least 2–3 full-scale ERP implementation or upgrade lifecycles, specifically focusing on the architectural trade-offs between "Standard" and "Custom" solutions.
• Strategic Compliance: Solid background in IT Service Management / ITIL, alongside experience in Computerized System Validation (CSV) and ICFR, ensuring custom-built ALM tools meet global regulatory standards.
• Global Architectural Leadership: Experience working in a large global company, demonstrating the ability to build consensus among diverse stakeholders
• English Communication: Superior command of the English language (both written and verbal) is essential for collaborating with global stakeholders and presenting complex ALM strategies to leadership.
• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equ

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'opportunità Il nostro team di sviluppo clinico ha una fantastica opportunità per un (Lead) Direttore Clinico di aderire al franchise neurologico per sostenere studi clinici di fine fase. Questa posizione offre un'opportunità unica per svolgere un ruolo cardine nel promuovere lo sviluppo clinico di Trontinemab , il primo anticorpo anti-amiloide nelle prove per utilizzare la tecnologia del cervello per trattare la malattia di Alzheimer. In questo ruolo sarete:
• Supporta la strategia di sviluppo clinico per uno o più test di fine stadio (Phase II–III) nella malattia di Alzheimer
• Guidare la progettazione e l'esecuzione di studi clinici, assicurando rigore scientifico, integrità etica e allineamento normativo chiaro
• Fornire un monitoraggio medico per gli studi in corso e garantire la sicurezza e la qualità dei dati dei pazienti
• Collaborare con team interfunzionali tra cui le operazioni normative, cliniche, sicurezza, biomarcatori, biostat e ricerca precoce
• Mentore e allenatore Scienziati Clinici all'interno del team
• Impegnarsi con parti interessate esterne come consiglieri, investigatori chiave e autorità sanitarie
• Contribuire alle pubblicazioni scientifiche e condurre la presenza di Roche in neurologia attraverso conferenze chiave e impegno comunitario
• Fornire input clinici ai programmi precedenti per rafforzare la pipeline di neuroscienze di Roche Chi sei Sei un leader medico guidato dalla missione che combina competenze scientifiche con il pensiero strategico. Tu porti:
• Un MD o MD/PhD , con formazione clinica in neurologia o demenza, preferibilmente con profonda esperienza nella malattia di Alzheimer
• Solida esperienza di ricerca clinica, compresa la leadership nella progettazione e nell'esecuzione di prove (preferibilmente nell'industria farmaceutica)
• Una solida comprensione del ciclo di vita dello sviluppo del farmaco, dagli studi di prima fase al post-marketing
• Un comprovato record di impatto scientifico, dimostrato attraverso pubblicazioni, presentazioni o contributi consultivi
• Eccezionale capacità di comunicazione e la capacità di influenzare in un ambiente matrixed e cross-functional
• Una passione per l'innovazione e la risoluzione dei problemi collaborativi, sempre con il paziente al centro Se sei emozionato dall'opportunità di contribuire alla scienza pionieristica con un impatto diretto sui pazienti, applica ora e aiutaci a fare ora ciò che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo! Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Welwyn. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Le dichiarazioni di cui sopra sono destinate a descrivere la natura generale e il livello di lavoro che vengono eseguiti dai dipendenti, e non devono essere interpretate come un elenco esaustivo di responsabilità, doveri e competenze richieste dal personale così classificato. Inoltre, essi non stabiliscono un contratto di lavoro e sono soggetti a modifiche a discrezione di Roche Products Lt
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity Our Clinical Development team has a fantastic opportunity for a (Lead) Clinical Director to join the neurology franchise to support late-stage clinical studies. This position offers a unique opportunity to play a pivotal role in advancing the clinical development of Trontinemab , the first anti-amyloid antibody in trials to use brain-shuttle technology to treat Alzheimer’s disease. In this role you will:
• Supports the clinical development strategy for one or more late-stage (Phase II–III) trials in Alzheimer’s disease
• Drive clinical trial design and execution, ensuring scientific rigor, ethical integrity, and clear regulatory alignment
• Provide medical monitoring for ongoing studies and ensure patient safety and data quality
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including regulatory, clinical operations, safety, biomarkers, biostats, and early research
• Mentor and coach Clinical Scientists within the team
• Engage with external stakeholders such as advisory boards, key investigators, and health authorities
• Contribute to scientific publications and lead Roche’s presence in neurology through key conferences and community engagement
• Provide clinical input to earlier-stage programs to strengthen Roche’s neuroscience pipeline Who You Are You are a mission-driven medical leader who combines scientific expertise with strategic thinking. You bring:
• An MD or MD/PhD , with clinical training in neurology or dementia, preferably with deep expertise in Alzheimer’s disease
• Solid clinical research experience , including leadership in trial design and execution (preferably in the pharmaceutical industry)
• A solid understanding of the drug development lifecycle , from early-phase studies to post-marketing
• A proven track record of scientific impact , demonstrated through publications, presentations, or advisory contributions
• Exceptional communication skills and the ability to influence across a matrixed, cross-functional environment
• A passion for innovation and collaborative problem-solving , always with the patient at the centre If you're excited by the opportunity to contribute to pioneering science with a direct impact on patients, apply now and help us to do now what patients need next! Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Welwyn. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Die Chance Unser Klinisches Entwicklungsteam hat eine fantastische Gelegenheit für einen (Lead-)Klinischen Direktor, sich der Neurologie-Franchise anzuschließen, um klinische Studien in der Spätphase zu unterstützen. Diese Position bietet eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, eine zentrale Rolle bei der Förderung der klinischen Entwicklung von Trontinemab zu spielen, der erste Anti-Amyloid-Antikörper in Versuchen, um Gehirn-Shuttle-Technologie zur Behandlung der Alzheimer-Krankheit zu verwenden. In dieser Rolle wirst du:
• Unterstützt die klinische Entwicklungsstrategie für eine oder mehrere Spätstadien (Phase II–III)-Studien bei der Alzheimer-Krankheit
• Führen Sie die klinische Studienplanung und -durchführung aus, um wissenschaftliche Strenge, ethische Integrität und klare regulatorische Ausrichtung zu gewährleisten
• Bereitstellung einer medizinischen Überwachung für laufende Studien und Sicherstellung der Patientensicherheit und Datenqualität
• Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams, einschließlich regulatorischer, klinischer Operationen, Sicherheit, Biomarker, Biostaten und Frühforschung
• Mentor und Coach Klinische Wissenschaftler im Team
• Mit externen Akteuren wie Beratungsräten, zentralen Ermittlern und Gesundheitsbehörden vertraut zu machen
• Beitrag zu wissenschaftlichen Publikationen und führender Roche-Präsenz in der Neurologie durch wichtige Konferenzen und Gemeinschaftsengagements
• Bereitstellung von klinischen Input für frühere Programme zur Stärkung der Neurowissenschaften-Pipeline von Roche Wer bist du? Sie sind ein missionsgetriebener medizinischer Leiter, der wissenschaftliche Expertise mit strategischem Denken verbindet. Sie bringen:
• Ein MD oder MD/PhD mit klinischer Ausbildung in der Neurologie oder Demenz, vorzugsweise mit tiefem Know-how in der Alzheimer-Krankheit
• Solide klinische Forschungserfahrung, einschließlich Führung in der Versuchsplanung und -durchführung (vorzugsweise in der Pharmaindustrie)
• Ein solides Verständnis des Lebenszyklus für die Drogenentwicklung, von Studien in der Frühphase bis zur Nachvermarktung
• Erprobter Überblick über wissenschaftliche Auswirkungen, der durch Veröffentlichungen, Präsentationen oder beratende Beiträge nachgewiesen wird
• Außergewöhnliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, in einer Matrix zu beeinflussen, funktionsübergreifende Umgebung
• Leidenschaft für Innovation und kollaborative Problemlösung, immer mit dem Patienten im Zentrum Wenn Sie von der Möglichkeit begeistert sind, mit direktem Einfluss auf die Patienten zur Pionier-Wissenschaft beizutragen, wenden Sie sich jetzt an und helfen uns, jetzt zu tun, was Patienten als nächstes brauchen! Bei Anwendung der Bezahlungstransparenz werden auf der Basis des primären Buchungsorts Angaben gemacht. Für diese Rolle ist der primäre Standort Welwyn. Wenn Sie an weiteren Standorten interessiert sind, an denen die Rolle zur Verfügung stehen kann, stellen wir die entsprechenden Vergütungsdetails später im Einstellungsprozess zur Verfügung. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostics-Produkten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die einen globalen Einfluss haben. Wir bauen gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft. Die hier dargelegten Aussagen sollen die allgemeine Art und das Ausmaß der Arbeit beschreiben, die von den Arbeitnehmern geleistet wird, und sind nicht als eine vollständige Liste von Verantwortlichkeiten, Pflichten und Fähigkeiten zu verstehen, die von den so klassifizierten Mitarbeitern benötigt werden. Darüber hinaus stellen sie keinen Arbeitsvertrag fest und können sich nach Ermessen von Roche Products Lt ändern

• Une expérience prouvée de l'impact scientifique, démontrée par des publications, des présentations ou des contributions consultatives
• Compétences exceptionnelles en communication et capacité d'influencer un environnement matriciel et interfonctionnel
• Une passion pour l'innovation et la résolution collaborative de problèmes , toujours avec le patient au centre Si vous êtes excité par l'occasion de contribuer à la science pionnière avec un impact direct sur les patients, postulez maintenant et aidez-nous à faire maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin! descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Senior Data Center Network Engineer (d/f/m) Introduction At Roche, we believe that every voice matters, and we invite you to bring your unique perspective to our team. As a Senior Data Center Network Engineer, you will join a culture of technical excellence, architecting resilient, high-performance infrastructures that empower our global mission. You will act as a technical expert, leveraging advanced automation to solve critical business challenges and drive our digital evolution. The Opportunity:
• Architect Scalable Networks: Lead the end-to-end design and deployment of "first-time-right" network solutions, specifically focusing on Spine-Leaf topologies and L2/L3 fabrics.
• Drive Technical Leadership: Act as a Solution Architect for large initiatives, managing resource estimation, dependencies, and risk mitigation across technical teams.
• Implement Network as Code: Modernize operations by developing and maintaining Arista AVD, Ansible, and CI/CD pipelines to ensure scalable, repeatable deployments.
• Master Complex Problem Solving: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to diagnose complex network incidents, performing deep root-cause analysis to prevent recurrence.
• Maximize System Reliability: Define and maintain Service Level Objectives (SLOs) through advanced telemetry and streaming analytics to ensure "five-nines" availability.
• Influence Strategic Roadmaps: Translate technical roadmaps into business value for stakeholders and steer vendor product evaluations to align with long-term strategy.
• Lead Seamless Migrations: Oversee high-stakes brownfield-to-greenfield migrations with a focus on hitless cutovers and zero-downtime execution.
• Foster Innovation and Growth: Proactively refine fabric performance and mentor junior engineers, contributing to a workplace culture of continuous learning. Who you are:
• Experienced Architect: You bring deep mastery of Arista EOS and EVPN-VXLAN architectures, with a proven track record of designing large-scale fabrics.
• Educated Professional: You hold a Bachelor’s degree in a technical field and bring years of relevant industry experience; CCIE-level expertise is highly desirable.
• Automation Expert: You are proficient in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), specifically using Arista AVD, Ansible, and CI/CD pipelines for network automation.
• Strategic Thinker: You possess the ability to translate complex system concepts into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Resilient Problem Solver: You demonstrate expert-level troubleshooting skills and remain decisive in high-pressure, complex technical scenarios.
• Project Leader: You have significant experience leading technical teams through complex project dependencies and risk management.
• Visionary Engineer: You are a proactive learner who stays ahead of industry trends to maintain architectural excellence in modern fabric environments.
