Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position About the role Are you a tech enthusiast eager to bridge the gap between traditional Software Engineering and Artificial Intelligence? Our Instrumentation Development chapter in Sant Cugat (Barcelona) is looking for a Software Engineer Intern to join our development squads. In this role, you will be part of the team designing cutting-edge solutions for the future Core Laboratory. Your mission will be to help the department explore and implement AI use cases, directly contributing to projects that impact patient lives while developing your skills in a professional, high-tech environment. Main responsibilities
• AI Integration: Participate in initiatives to explore, prototype, and implement AI-driven features within our software ecosystem.
• Development: Support the squad in developing software components using C# and .NET , while leveraging Python for AI-specific implementations.
• Modern Tooling: Work with cutting-edge developer tools like GitHub Copilot and contribute to integrations with MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers .
• Collaboration: Work within an Agile squad, participating in ceremonies (Daily, Sprint Planning) and contributing to the team's goals.
• Quality: Produce clean, maintainable code and participate in testing activities to ensure the reliability of our medical instrumentation software. How would your day-to-day look like? You will start your day synced with your squad, discussing progress and tackling challenges. Under the guidance of an assigned mentor , you will transition from your initial onboarding to making real contributions to our codebase. You will spend part of your time investigating how AI can optimize our projects and the other part implementing those solutions within our C#/.NET architecture. It is a balance of autonomous learning, creative exploration of AI, and structured teamwork. This opportunity is part of the START TECH program, you can find more information about the program in the following link. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione ESPERIENZA E QUALIFICA:
• Academic/Scientific/Clinical:
• • M.D. richiesto
• Conoscenze terapeutiche all’interno del metabolismo, dell’obesità e del diabete con un’esperienza clinica, scientifica e clinica di sperimentazione/sviluppo necessaria
• Lo sfondo accademico/insegnante è un plus
• Esperienza di lavoro con i principi e le tecniche di analisi, interpretazione e rilevanza clinica
• Esperienza risultati editoriali di uno studio scientifico in una rivista peer-reviewed è preferito
• Normativa: La conoscenza degli aspetti medici di GCP (buona pratica clinica), ICH (Conferenza internazionale sull'armonizzazione dei requisiti tecnici per la registrazione dei farmaci per uso umano), FDA, EMA e altre linee guida e regolamenti pertinenti è preferito
• Durata dell'esperienza: 2 o più anni di esperienza accademica o clinica post-laurea
• Fino al 30% di viaggio globale Abilità e comportamenti chiave
• Etica: ha un'etica impeccabile. Dimostra, o comprovata capacità di dimostrare, Valori Roche
• Attenzione ai dettagli: eccezionale attenzione ai dettagli
• Business Acumen: Ha la conoscenza del settore farmaceutico/biotecnico, le molteplici funzioni e ruoli coinvolti nel processo di sviluppo della droga. Regolarmente conduce lo sviluppo di strategie e piani di malattia
• Organizzazione: Può dare priorità a più compiti e obiettivi nel tempo, sul bersaglio e nel budget
• Competenze interpersonali: buona comunicazione interpersonale, verbale e capacità di influenza: può influenzare senza autorità
• Scrittura: Forte capacità di comunicazione scritta
• Capacità di presentazione: Buone capacità di presentazione aziendale; è comodo ed efficace quando si presenta ad altri, internamente o esternamente. Confidente e competente quando interagisce con gli altri internamente ed esternamente: rimane concentrato e on-point, è in grado di sollevare problemi o sfide in modo produttivo e maturo
• Competenze di negoziazione: Buone competenze di negoziazione: sa come completare i materiali di consegna lavorando efficacemente con altri internamente ed esternamente
• Decision Making: Sa come prendere decisioni di compromesso, bilanciando etica ed efficacia
• Lavoro di squadra: forte orientamento al lavoro di squadra DUTI SPECIFICHE E RESPONSABILITÀ: Strategia e pianificazione CDP
• Partecipa allo sviluppo del piano CD per molecola/indicazioni assegnate
• Raccoglie e analizza i dati e le informazioni necessarie per creare il piano CD
• Funziona con altri membri del CST e sub-team rilevanti per sviluppare componenti del piano CD (ad esempio, strategia di analisi/dati, sviluppo di KOL, strategia di pubblicazioni, ecc.)
• Funziona con CST e altri team rilevanti per sviluppare e fornire informazioni e input per i requisiti di budget/risorse necessari per implementare ed eseguire il piano CD
• Rimangono al di fuori degli sviluppi interni ed esterni, delle tendenze e di altre dinamiche pertinenti al lavoro del CD per mantenere, in ogni momento, una visione e una prospettiva completamente attuali di influenze interne/esterne e/o implicazioni per l'area terapeutica e malattia assegnata(i)
• Come opportuno, partecipa a attività e progetti di valutazione e/o di intelligence competitiva e/o di altri mercati/industria
• Mantiene i più elevati standard e livelli di conoscenza scientifica e clinica nella specifica area terapeutica e malattia di assegnazione
• Collabora con una varietà di partner e stakeholder interni ed esterni, come investigatori clinici, clinici, scienziati e leader di opinione chiave (KOL), nonché gruppi interni multidisciplinari, tra cui altri gruppi in PD, ricerca, sviluppo aziendale, commerciale

Forniamo servizi che rendono la nostra sede vivace e attraente e dimostriamo che siamo l'azienda più stimolante in Svizzera. Progettiamo soluzioni su misura, gestiamo edifici, infrastrutture, sistemi e ne facciamo la manutenzione. Abbiamo organizzato questi servizi in circoli. Il circolo “Asset Lifecycle Management - Concepts & Strategies” crea nelle sedi di Basilea e Kaiseraugst l'ambiente per la massima creazione di valore dagli investimenti con l'obiettivo di generare il massimo “ritorno sugli investimenti” possibile. In qualità di pianificatore della manutenzione, sviluppi strategie e concetti di manutenzione insieme all'operatore e all'ingegneria di progetto e li mapperai nei nostri sistemi SAP S/4 Hana. Sei in gran parte responsabile della standardizzazione, del rispetto dei metodi e del mantenimento dei dati anagrafici di manutenzione e calibrazione. Garantisci e promuovi un'elevata qualità dei dati e risolvi i problemi con i dati e le loro fonti. La possibilità:
• Agire come key user e principale responsabile dei dati anagrafici. Mantieni e approvi i dati anagrafici dell'impianto in SAP S/4 Hana (inclusi elenchi di attività e piani di ispezione) e, come ultima istanza, controlli la conformità agli standard concordati e alle convenzioni di denominazione.
• Siete l'interlocutore principale per i processi di manutenzione e calibrazione e utilizzate la vostra competenza tecnica nella manutenzione e nella gestione dei dati per consigliare i diversi gruppi di clienti nella produzione, nella ricerca e nelle infrastrutture nelle sedi di Basilea e Kaiseraugst.
• Controllare la qualità dei dati e risolvere in modo specifico i problemi di integrità o coerenza dei dati nei flussi di lavoro.
• Analizzi i dati provenienti da diverse fonti e ricavi misure di miglioramento continuo per la qualità dei dati. In questo modo, crei la base di dati affidabili per guidare iniziative di gestione del ciclo di vita delle risorse locali e globali.
• Sviluppare strategie di manutenzione, definirle e mapparle nei sistemi.
• Metti in discussione lo status quo in modo obiettivo e critico e intraprendi nuovi percorsi nel mantenimento. Chi sei Sei una personalità dal pensiero positivo, basata sull'integrità e autoriflessiva con forti capacità di squadra. In questo senso, hai un atteggiamento e un modo di pensare aperti e collaborativi, necessari per un lavoro di successo nel tuo team e tra i reparti. Hai fiducia in te stesso e negli altri, ti assumi la responsabilità e vivi una cultura aperta, aperta alla parola e priva di errori. Il tuo atteggiamento orientato alla soluzione e il tuo atteggiamento positivo determinano le tue azioni quotidiane e mettono il cliente al centro. In qualità di pianificatore di manutenzione ed esperto di dati anagrafici, hai già acquisito un'esperienza professionale approfondita nella manutenzione di impianti di ingegneria di processo e unità confezionate, idealmente nel settore farmaceutico (regolamentato GxP) o in un settore altrettanto rigorosamente regolamentato. Comprendi i concetti di modellazione dei dati, sei sicuro nell'utilizzo del data warehouse e hai buone capacità di documentazione tecnica. L'elevata qualità dei dati è il fondamento di robusti processi di manutenzione e calibrazione. Vivi il miglioramento continuo, l'esperienza con SAP S/4 Hana completa il tuo profilo. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Logistics Engineer / Project Manager leads the technical evolution and modernization of our 10,000m2 self-operated distribution center. This role is the strategic architect responsible for transforming a complex, legacy-automated environment into a flexible, next-generation fulfillment hub using AMR and advanced robotics. You will bridge the gap between physical hardware and digital systems, managing the transition from a legacy software stack (WMS/WCS/MFC) to a modern SAP eWM environment. Reporting directly to the Head of Supply Chain, you will own the technical roadmap, from ROI analysis and vendor selection participation to on-site project execution lead, ensuring our automation strategy aligns with future business scalability. Your Main Responsibilities
• Creation of holistic view of warehouse operations in terms of automation technology, system landscape and warehouse operator needs. Full understanding & documentation of current bottlenecks in terms of throughput and storage capacity. Create suitable measurements (KPIs) where needed in order to translate requirements and current capacities.
• Automation Transformation & Strategy: Assess and lead the transition from rigid legacy automation to flexible technologies (AMRs, Humanoids, etc.) where required. Take full stock of existing hardware capabilities and map them against future business requirements and market-leading solutions.
• Systems Architecture & Integration: Fully master the current system landscape (WMS, WCS, MFC). Design the integration strategy to link the physical world with the digital world, acting as the lead for the upcoming SAP eWM implementation.
• Financial Stewardship & ROI: Drive rigorous ROI analysis for all automation projects collaborating with finance and site management. Have clear visibility for throughput, storage density, and FTE optimization.
• Material Flow & Process Optimization: Analyze and redesign internal material flows to eliminate bottlenecks. Use data-driven insights to optimize picking strategies, replenishment cycles, and packing efficiency. Processes are redesigned considering sustainability, quality and safety aspects.
• Project Governance: Act as the on-site Project Lead for major technical and system shifts. Manage the end-to-end lifecycle—from concept and vendor assessment to commissioning and structured handover—ensuring minimal disruption to active operations. Interact with global and local project teams.
• Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Partner with site management to assess new vendors and technologies. Navigate the complex relationship between legacy hardware providers and modern robotics OEMs, ensuring system interoperability.
• Technical Communication: Adapt complex technical concepts for different audiences (“zoom in & out”). Clearly articulate the "why" behind automation shifts to senior leadership while providing granular technical direction to on-site maintenance and IT teams.
• Performance Tracking: Define and monitor KPIs for automated systems, including uptime, cycle times, and error rates. Lead corrective actions when performance gaps occur in the automated flow. Who You Are
• An Analytical Problem Solver: You enjoy the challenge of making legacy systems perform in a modern context. You take ambiguity and uncertainty as an opportunity to bring up proposals.
• A Strategic Executor: You can design a 3-year automation roadmap but are equally willing to be on the warehouse floor during a "Go-Live" to troubleshoot o

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. As a Territory Manager based in Bangalore , you will play a crucial role in driving sales, Doctor Promotion, retail promotion, managing distribution networks, and executing sales promotion plans for your territory. You will ensure our products penetration in the assigned market effectively by supporting distributors, gathering market insights, and partnering with the Area Sales Manager (ASM) to achieve our business goals. The Opportunity
• Promote pharmaceutical products to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) through scientific communication, relationship building, product detailing, and ethical marketing to increase product awareness and prescriptions.
• You assist the ASM in planning for the territory by providing market environment insights to estimate yearly demand, submitting distributor-level inventory requirements, and monitoring the stock availability of promotional materials.
• You prepare and execute monthly sales promotion plans—including field activation and merchandising activities—and meticulously record expenses and sales generated to evaluate program efficacy.
• You ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the market.
• You manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones.
• You motivate distributors and dealers through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes.
• You organize distributor and dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies, and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups.
• You act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your customer visits. Who You Are
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field.
• You have proven practical experience in field sales, distribution management, or a territory management role.
• You have a strong interest in driving market growth, with a focus on relationship building, demand generation, and executing marketing strategies.
• You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Doctors, Chemist & dealer interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings.
• You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/Weekly/Monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections.
• You are comfortable with field travel within the Bangalore territory and thrive in a structured environment where you collaborate closely with the Area Sales Manager. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other

• You assist the ASM in planning for the territory by providing market environment insights to estimate yearly demand, submitting distributor-level inventory requirements, and monitoring the stock availability of promotional materials.
• You prepare and execute monthly sales promotion plans—including field activation and merchandising activities—and meticulously record expenses and sales generated to evaluate program efficacy.
• You ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the market.
• You manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones.
• You motivate distributors and dealers through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes.
• You organize distributor and dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies, and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups.
• You act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your customer visits. Who You Are
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field.
• You have proven practical experience in field sales, distribution management, or a territory management role.
• You have a strong interest in driving market growth, with a focus on relationship building, demand generation, and executing marketing strategies.
• You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Doctors, Chemist & dealer interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings.
• You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/Weekly/Monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections.
• You are comfortable with field travel within the Bangalore territory and thrive in a structured environment where you collaborate closely with the Area Sales Manager. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As Team Lead in Network Security Edge Defense you will focus on capabilities development of your team members that align with the function’s vision. You will encourage your team to self-define their career journey and seek ways to enable development opportunities in the direction of the journey. You will support them in removing roadblocks and by setting focus in their performance management. You make sure to develop your team with the right skills, healthy dynamics and a sustainable pace. You support the software and/or service delivery as a leader setting focus, removing impediments, managing stakeholders and creating efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible. Description of the area The Edge Defense team belongs to the Network Security organization, a cornerstone of Information Security. We provide the technologies and services that protect the entire network against IT Security incidents and digital threats. The core stack of this team includes:
• Perimeter Defense: Network Firewalls and DDoS Mitigation
• Modern Architecture: Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) services
• Cloud Network Security in AWS, Azure, GCP ​ Job Responsibilities
• Strategic Edge Vision & Modern Architecture: Define the digital roadmap for Perimeter Defense (Firewalls, DDoS) and Modern Architecture (Zero Trust) across the most external facing network segments, both on-premise and in multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
• Operational Excellence & Automation: Drive an "Automation First" mindset for external network security, leveraging APIs and scripting to replace manual work with scalable security code ("Shift Left").
• Cloud-Native Security: Lead the security strategy for the complex multi-cloud footprint (AWS, Azure, GCP), focusing on securing the perimeter and network edge in the cloud.
• Lifecycle Management & Compliance: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for Edge Defense technologies, from discovery to global scale, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations (e.g., GDPR, excluding GxP for non-manufacturing focus).
• Business Translation: Connect technical security performance of the external network to broader business outcomes, ensuring security is an accelerator for R&D and other non-manufacturing environments.
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Deeply understand customer and business needs to shape the strategic direction and digital roadmap for the Edge Defense product, focusing on delivering high-value outcomes. Who You Are Experience
• 5+ years of experience in Information Security is an asset
• 3+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry is an asset
• 5+ years of experience in people leadership, product/service management, program management or a similar role, with a proven track record of building high performing teams ​ Education
• Bachelor’s or Advanced degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or a related Engineering field or equivalent experience
• Professional Information Security certifications are a plus (e.g. CISSP, CISM) ​ Technical Skills
• Proven background and solid foundation in Information Security specifically in Network Firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet), NAC (e.g., Cisco ISE), and ZTNA solutions
• Experience in multi-cloud environments is a plus
• Operational Excellence: Strong understanding of ITIL frameworks (Incident, Change, and Problem Management) and Continuous Improvement methodologies
• Automation

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Dein neues Team Als Mitglied des PDG Country Study Start-Up Teams liegt dein Hauptaugenmerk darauf, einen reibungslosen und hocheffizienten Studienstart sicherzustellen, um so die Bereitstellung klinischer Studien für Patient:innen zu unterstützen. Du bringst klinische Studien innovativ auf den Weg: Du deckst den spezifischen Bedarf in der Start-up-Phase über verschiedene Therapiegebiete hinweg und garantierst einen reibungslosen Ablauf für Patient:innen und Prüfzentren. In dieser Schlüsselrolle vernetzt du dich intensiv mit lokalen und globalen Teams sowie unseren CRO Partnern (Auftragsforschungsinstituten). Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich In dieser Rolle konzentrierst du dich auf die effiziente und rechtskonforme Initiierung von Roche-gesponserten klinischen Studien. Du entwickelst effektive Start-up-Strategien, steuerst die operativen Abläufe und treibst Prozessverbesserungen auf Länder- und Zentren-Ebene voran – immer unter Einhaltung aller regulatorischen Vorgaben.Deine Hauptaufgaben umfassen:
• Strategische Leitung: Du leitest Teams bei der strategischen Planung der operativen Durchführung des Studienstarts, wobei Du die Verantwortung für Risikomanagement, regulatorische Compliance sowie die partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit mit externen Stakeholdern trägst.
• Operative Exzellenz: Du managst die Start-up-Aktivitäten und stellst eine termingerechte Aktivierung der Prüfzentren sowie die regulatorische Compliance sicher. Du verantwortest und steuerst den gesamten Budget- und Vertragsprozess – von der Erstellung der Budgets über die Vertragsverhandlung und Versicherungsdokumente bis hin zur systemseitigen Datenpflege, um die finanzielle und rechtliche Konformität sowie eine präzise Planung zu gewährleisten.
• Globale Ausrichtung: Du arbeitest mit dem globalen Studienteam zusammen und stellst sicher, dass die Zeitpläne eingehalten werden und managst Amendments über den gesamten Studienzyklus hinweg.
• Innovation & Standardisierung: Du identifizierst Chancen zur Prozessoptimierung und Automatisierung und arbeitest mit regionalen sowie globalen Partnern zusammen, um Systeme zu harmonisieren und Zeitpläne zu optimieren.
• Behördenkommunikation: Du stehst im Austausch mit Behörden und Institutionen (z. B. Ethikkommissionen und Gesundheitsbehörden), um Richtlinien und Praktiken bei klinischen Studien aufeinander abzustimmen. Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit Für die Rolle als Study Start Up Lead (SSUL) (m/w/d) bringst du ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (MD, PhD, Master oder Bachelor) in den Life Sciences oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit. Ein weiterführender Hochschulabschluss (Postgraduate/Master) ist dabei sehr wünschenswert. Folgende Punkte runden dein Profil ab:
• Berufserfahrung: Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung im Start-up von klinischen Studien, in regulatorischen Einreichungsprozessen sowie in der cross-funktionalen Zusammenarbeit.
• Fachwissen: Du besitzt ein tiefgreifendes Verständnis der ICH-GCP-Leitlinien, der EU-CTR sowie der lokalen regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen und hast bereits Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Dienstleistern und CROs gesammelt.
• Methoden & IT: Du bist sicher im Umgang mit klinischen Systemen (z. B. Veeva Vault, CTIS, RIM) und zeichnest dich durch starke organisatorische, analytische und problemlösungsorientierte Fähigkeiten aus.
• Mindset: Du bringst eine kollaborative und adaptive Denkweise mit. Es gelingt dir, auch in komplexen, matrixorganisierten und globalen Teams den Überblick zu be

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. As a Territory Manager based in Salem , you will play a crucial role in driving sales, Doctor Promotion, retail promotion, managing distribution networks, and executing sales promotion plans for your territory. You will ensure our products penetration in the assigned market effectively by supporting distributors, gathering market insights, and partnering with the Area Sales Manager (ASM) to achieve our business goals. The Opportunity
• Promote pharmaceutical products to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) through scientific communication, relationship building, product detailing, and ethical marketing to increase product awareness and prescriptions.
• You assist the ASM in planning for the territory by providing market environment insights to estimate yearly demand, submitting distributor-level inventory requirements, and monitoring the stock availability of promotional materials.
• You prepare and execute monthly sales promotion plans—including field activation and merchandising activities—and meticulously record expenses and sales generated to evaluate program efficacy.
• You ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the market.
• You manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones.
• You motivate distributors and dealers through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes.
• You organize distributor and dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies, and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups.
• You act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your customer visits. Who You Are
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field.
• You have proven practical experience in field sales, distribution management, or a territory management role.
• You have a strong interest in driving market growth, with a focus on relationship building, demand generation, and executing marketing strategies.
• You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Doctors, Chemist & dealer interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings.
• You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/Weekly/Monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections.
• You are comfortable with field travel within the Salem territory and thrive in a structured environment where you collaborate closely with the Area Sales Manager. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione La divisione “Pharma Site Services” di Roche Pharma è il partner centrale per un'ampia gamma di funzioni presso la sede di Basilea/Kaiseraugst: dalle funzioni di gruppo alla ricerca e sviluppo fino alla produzione e spedizione. Forniamo servizi che rendono la nostra sede vivace e attraente e dimostriamo che siamo l'azienda più stimolante in Svizzera. Progettiamo soluzioni su misura, gestiamo edifici, infrastrutture, sistemi e ne facciamo la manutenzione. Abbiamo organizzato questi servizi in circoli. Il circolo “Asset Lifecycle Management - Concepts & Strategies” crea nelle sedi di Basilea e Kaiseraugst l'ambiente per la massima creazione di valore dagli investimenti con l'obiettivo di generare il massimo “ritorno sugli investimenti” possibile. In qualità di pianificatore della manutenzione, sviluppi strategie e concetti di manutenzione insieme all'operatore e all'ingegneria di progetto e li mapperai nei nostri sistemi SAP S/4 Hana. In qualità di Master Data Quality Steward, la tua responsabilità principale risiede nell'area della calibrazione. Sei in gran parte responsabile della standardizzazione, del rispetto dei metodi e della garanzia della qualità procedurale dei dati anagrafici di calibrazione. Garantite e promuovete un'elevata qualità dei dati, risolvete i problemi con i dati e le loro fonti e assicurate processi efficienti, standardizzati e integrativi per i dati anagrafici rilevanti per la calibrazione (Master Data Management). La possibilità:
• Agire come utente chiave e persona principale responsabile dei dati anagrafici di calibrazione. Mantieni e approvi i dati anagrafici dell'impianto in SAP S/4 Hana (inclusi elenchi di attività di calibrazione e piani di test) e, come ultima istanza, controlli la conformità agli standard concordati e alle convenzioni di denominazione.
• Siete l'interlocutore principale per i processi di calibrazione e utilizzate la vostra competenza specialistica nella calibrazione e nella gestione dei dati per consigliare i diversi gruppi di clienti nella produzione, nella ricerca e nelle infrastrutture nelle sedi di Basilea e Kaiseraugst.
• Garantite la delimitazione tecnica del sistema nell'area di calibrazione, identificate le fonti dei dati, verificate la qualità dei dati e risolvete in modo specifico i problemi di integrità o coerenza dei dati nei flussi di lavoro di calibrazione.
• Documentare le fonti dei dati, collegare le informazioni, gestire report di qualità dedicati per l'area di calibrazione e mantenere KPI pertinenti.
• Analizzi i dati provenienti da diverse fonti e ricavi misure di miglioramento continuo per la qualità dei dati. In questo modo, crei la base di dati affidabili per guidare iniziative di gestione del ciclo di vita delle risorse locali e globali.
• Sviluppi strategie di calibrazione, le definisci e le mappe nei sistemi.
• Metti in discussione lo status quo in modo obiettivo e critico e intraprendi nuovi percorsi di calibrazione. Chi sei Sei una personalità dal pensiero positivo, basata sull'integrità e autoriflessiva con forti capacità di squadra. In questo senso, hai un atteggiamento e un modo di pensare aperti e collaborativi, necessari per un lavoro di successo nel tuo team e tra i reparti. Hai fiducia in te stesso e negli altri, ti assumi la responsabilità e vivi una cultura aperta, aperta alla parola e priva di errori. Il tuo atteggiamento orientato alla soluzione e il tuo atteggiamento positivo determinano le tue azioni quotidiane e mettono il cliente al centro. In qualità di pianificatore di manutenzione ed esperto di dati anagrafici hai già un'esperienza professionale approfondita nella manutenzione e calibrazione di sistemi di ingegneria di processo e università confezionate

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position La division des Services du site du Pharma est le partenaire central du site de Bâle/Kaiseraugst pour un large éventail de fonctions : des fonctions de groupe à la recherche, développement, production et expédition. Nous fournissons des services qui rendent notre emplacement pulsant et attrayant, qui montrent que nous sommes l'entreprise la plus inspirante en Suisse. Nous concevons des solutions sur mesure et exploitons des bâtiments, des infrastructures, des installations et nous gardons cela à l'esprit. Nous avons organisé ces services en Cercles. Le cercle «Asset Lifecycle Management - Concepts & Strategies» sur le site de Bâle et Kaiseraugst façonne l'environnement pour la création de valeur maximale des plantes dans le but d'atteindre le plus haut rendement possible des plantes. Développé comme planificateur de maintenance Avec l'opérateur et le projet d'ingénierie, vous développerez des stratégies de maintenance, des concepts et les cartographiez dans nos systèmes SAP S/4 Hana. En tant que maître de la qualité des données, votre principale responsabilité est dans le domaine de l'étalonnage. Vous êtes responsable de la normalisation, de la conformité avec les méthodes et de l'assurance de la qualité du processus des données-cadres d'étalonnage. Assurer et promouvoir la haute qualité des données, éliminer les données et les sources et assurer des processus efficaces, normalisés et inclusifs pour l'étalonnage de la gestion des données maîtresses. La possibilité:
• Vous agissez en tant qu'utilisateur clé et contrôleur principal pour les fichiers principaux d'étalonnage. Vous emportez et approuvez les données de base de l'usine dans le SAP S/4 Hana (y compris les listes de tâches d'étalonnage et les plans d'essai) et vérifiez le respect des normes convenues et des conventions de désignation en dernier ressort.
• Vous êtes la personne de contact principale pour les processus d'étalonnage et, avec votre expertise pour l'étalonnage et la gestion des données, conseille les différents groupes de clients dans la production, la recherche et l'infrastructure sur le site de Bâle et Kaiseraugst.
• Vous assurez la délimitation technique du système dans la zone d'étalonnage, identifiez les sources de données, vérifiez la qualité des données et corrigez spécifiquement les problèmes d'intégrité ou de cohérence des données dans les processus d'étalonnage.

Votre attitude de base orientée vers la solution et l'attitude de can-do détermine votre action quotidienne et se concentre sur le client. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We are seeking a Marketing Lead who will report to the Marketing and Customer Engagement Head and be responsible for the Lung portfolio. As a Marketing Lead, your mission is to create value through meaningful benefits for patients, the business, external stakeholders, and health systems. By working with patient journey partners (PJPs) and healthcare system partners (HSPs), and other cross-functional enablers, value can be added in various ways, such as product innovation, treatment pathway design, a new patient service, technologies/capabilities that improve operational efficiency, global knowledge sharing, or external collaboration. Responsibilities:
• Develop specific marketing strategies for therapeutic areas within the organization, working together cross-functionally with Medical and Access Leads.
• Build and implement an effective plan for Omnichannel engagement via leveraging different channels and tools. Focus on building Omnichannel capabilities internally and externally to provide meaningful customer experiences that add value to patients, collaborating closely with the Digital team.
• Manage P&L to ensure resources are utilized effectively and in accordance with the business outcomes
• Ensure continuous sales and logistics forecasting, working closely with the PJPs and Finance team.
• Interpret and translate scientific data into commercial implications, analyze data, and make strategic recommendations.
• In case of new launches, build and propose a suitable Go-to-Market Strategy via defining pricing, distribution channels, and sales strategies, working with Access and Launch Excellence Leads.
• Provide marketing insight and direction to optimize new product launches and monitor budget and expenditures.
• Participate in national and international congresses, scientific meetings, and global implementation/update meetings to keep the knowledge updated for commercialization strategies.
• By overseeing the patient journey in its entirety, act as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and contribute to creating value to the patient journey through supporting and enabling the PJPs in implementing successful projects for the ecosystem in line with Roche Code of Conduct and principles.
• Working beyond the local organization, align and collaborate with broader networks, provide support to global networks and other affiliates, and be accountable for ensuring collaboration with the networks and local leads to identify new opportunities, initiatives, and solutions to answer stakeholder needs and to drive value for the patients.
• Prepare and update the training materials and provide internal education and training programs to the customer engagement teams and other lead roles in the affiliate when necessary.
• Generate mar-com strategies working together with the communication department. Support the PJPs in setting the Therapeutic Area or other communication strategy and creation/adaptation of local Therapeutic Area messages, materials, and communication content for digital platforms. Mindset and Behaviours:
• We Before Me Mindset: Strong entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding partnering capabilities (coaching, consulting, ability to deeply listen, question, and understand)
• Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, take risks and experiment, and contribute to the learning cycle by sharing knowledge with others inside and outside Roche
• System thinker, self-managed and self-directed - altru

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Con i suoi circa 1.500 dipendenti (PTM), il centro di produzione Kaiseraugst garantisce una cura completa dei pazienti al massimo livello qualitativo. Come il più grande e moderno centro di confezionamento di Roche, Kaiseraugst serve più di 120 paesi e si trova in tutto il mondo per standard eccellenti nella produzione farmaceutica. La possibilità
• Leader leader e responsabilità complessiva per circa 40 dipendenti (compreso il contraente) nonché coaching e sviluppo dei dipendenti
• Responsabilità per il Facility Excellence Team con Asset Excellence Manager, Facility Excellence Manager e il ruolo di Partnering Systems Change Specialist; lo Swisslog Maintenance Team e il MRP per il Manufacturing Support Head
• Garantire la pianificazione e il controllo delle risorse predittive secondo SQDEC (Safety / Quality / Delivery / Engagement / Cost) come parte del team di gestione dei Servizi di Logistica Centrale
• Applicazione dei metodi LEAN per il miglioramento continuo e l'utilizzo della gestione visiva per il controllo dei processi tramite KPI;
• Responsabilità per la pianificazione degli investimenti logistici per CLS, coordinamento della roadmap logistica e configurazione logistica per nuovi prodotti farmaceutici presso il sito Kaiseraugst
• Garantire e privilegiare gli adeguamenti del sistema in coordinamento con gli obiettivi locali e globali e garantire tutti i requisiti GMP, sicurezza operativa, ambiente e processo
• PMI per progetti di logistica di siti e di rete, con la massima responsabilità per l'attuazione di progetti CAPEX e altri investimenti per sviluppare ulteriormente l'infrastruttura logistica
• Automation Business Owner of Logistics Plants in Three Different Buildings in Kaiseraugst and Responsibility for the Implementation of Infrastructure and Improvement Projects Considerando i requisiti logistici delle unità di produzione e dell'organizzazione globale della catena di approvvigionamento Chi sei
• Il pensiero positivo, la personalità integree e auto-riflettente con passione per la leadership e una pronunciata impostazione “Can-Do”
• Capacità di rafforzare la fiducia nel team attraverso la trasparenza, il trasferimento di responsabilità e l'apertura Speak-up e la cultura degli errori
• Il pensiero imprenditoriale in vista del processo complessivo (fine alla fine), così come la capacità di fornire prestazioni costantemente elevate in un ambiente in continua evoluzione
• Formazione professionale superiore, studio o master
• Esperienza di leadership pluriennale, idealmente nell'ambiente farmaceutico e/o logistico
• Esperienza con audit GMP e ispezioni da parte delle autorità sanitarie
• Conveniente uso della tecnologia, alta affinità di numero e ottime capacità di comunicazione in tedesco e inglese in parola e scrittura Pronti per il prossimo passo? Non vediamo l'ora di sentirti. Iscriviti ora per scoprire questa entusiasmante opportunità! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere il nostro alto ambizioso, in modo da poter offrire una soluzione sanitaria che cambi la vita

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. En tant que centre d'emballage le plus grand et le plus moderne de Roche, Kaiseraugst dessert plus de 120 pays et est synonyme d'excellentes normes dans la production pharmaceutique. La possibilité
• Leader principal et responsabilité globale pour une quarantaine d'employés (y compris l'entrepreneur) ainsi que coaching et perfectionnement des employés
• Responsabilité de l'équipe d'excellence de l'installation avec les gestionnaires d'excellence de l'actif, les gestionnaires d'excellence de l'installation et le rôle de spécialiste du changement des systèmes de partenariat; l'équipe de maintenance de Swisslog et le MRP au responsable du soutien à la fabrication
• Assurer la planification et le contrôle prédictifs des ressources selon SQDEC (Sécurité / Qualité / Livraison / Engagement / Coût) dans le cadre de l'équipe de gestion des Services centraux de logistique
• Application de méthodes LEAN pour l'amélioration continue et l'utilisation de la gestion visuelle pour le contrôle des processus à l'aide des KPI;
• Responsable de la planification des investissements logistiques pour le CLS, de la coordination de la feuille de route logistique et de la configuration logistique des nouveaux produits pharmaceutiques sur le site de Kaiseraugst
• Assurer et hiérarchiser les ajustements des systèmes en coordination avec les objectifs locaux et mondiaux et garantir toutes les exigences en matière de BPF, de sécurité opérationnelle, d'environnement et de processus;
• PME pour les projets de logistique de site et de réseau dont la responsabilité principale est la mise en œuvre des projets CAPEX et d'autres investissements visant à développer l'infrastructure logistique
• Automatisation Propriétaire d'usines de logistique dans trois bâtiments différents à Kaiseraugst et responsabilité de la mise en œuvre des projets d'infrastructure et d'amélioration compte tenu des exigences logistiques des unités manufacturières et de l'Organisation mondiale de la chaîne d'approvisionnement Qui vous êtes

• Capacité à renforcer la confiance dans l'équipe par la transparence, le transfert de responsabilité et la culture ouverte de la parole et de l'erreur
• La réflexion entrepreneuriale en vue du processus global (fin à fin), ainsi que la capacité à fournir des performances constamment élevées dans un environnement en constante évolution
• Formation professionnelle supérieure, études ou maîtrise
• Expérience de leadership pluriannuelle, idéalement dans l'environnement pharmaceutique et/ou logistique
• Expérience des audits et inspections des BPF par les autorités sanitaires
• Utilisation pratique de la technologie, affinité élevée et très bonnes compétences en communication en allemand et en anglais en paroles et en écriture Prêt pour la prochaine étape ? You will help drive security best practices, contribute to complex security programs, and support the continuous evolution of Roche’s cybersecurity capabilities. In this role, you will:
• Lead and contribute to cybersecurity initiatives and strategic programs across global and cross-functional environments
• Provide expert guidance and advisory support on complex cybersecurity challenges, incident response activities, and security-related risk considerations
• Partner with stakeholders across Informatics and business teams to align cybersecurity priorities with organizational objectives
• Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of security processes, standards, and best practices
• Analyze complex problems, identify root causes, and recommend effective and scalable security solutions
• Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders to drive alignment, decision-making, and execution across initiatives
• Mentor and support team members while contributing to a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and operational excellence
• Stay informed on industry trends, emerging threats, and evolving cybersecurity practices to help strengthen Roche’s overall security posture Who you are You are a strategic and collaborative cybersecurity professional who is comfortable navigating complex environments, influencing stakeholders, and balancing technical depth with business impact. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a member of the Safety Development & Processes (SDP) team within Product Development Safety, you will lead the evolution of global processes that enable world-class safety and vigilance activities across Roche’s drug and device development portfolio.. In this influential role, you will operate as a Global Process Owner or senior subject-matter expert, shaping the frameworks that underpin our safety activities for medicines, devices, and digital health solutions. You will drive strategic innovation and process excellence to ensure Roche remains at the forefront of patient safety and regulatory compliance. The Opportunity As the Safety Process Director / Senior Director, you will design and govern the global operating models that translate complex safety requirements into scalable, high-impact clinical and post-marketing practices. This role is internally known as Safety Process Director/Senior Director.
• Lead the design and continuous improvement of global safety processes, ensuring they remain robust, agile, and aligned with industry-leading standards.
• Act as a Global Process Owner or senior expert for complex safety and vigilance activities, providing strategic direction across the organization.
• Partner with key stakeholders , including Safety Science Leaders, the QPPV/PRRC offices, and cross-functional global teams to harmonize safety initiatives.
• Drive process innovation by identifying opportunities to strengthen Roche’s safety capabilities and participating in external industry collaborations.
• Translate scientific and regulatory foundations of Signal Management and Risk Management into effective global safety practices.
• Influence internal governance discussions to ensure safety and vigilance practices support the safe development of innovative medicines and digital health solutions. Who you are You are a strategic leader who thrives in a global matrix environment, combining deep technical expertise in Safety Science with the ability to coach and catalyze change across organizational boundaries.
• You hold a degree in Medicine, Life Sciences, Healthcare, Engineering, or a related discipline.
• You bring extensive experience in Pharmacovigilance and Safety Science, with deep expertise in Signal Management and Risk Management.
• You possess a strong command of global pharmacovigilance and safety regulations (such as FDA, EMA, and MHRA).
• You have a proven track record of leading complex initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders to drive strategic improvement. We look forward to your application. This role is based onsite at our Welwyn, United Kingdom office. Our team follows a hybrid work structure, requiring a fixed number of onsite days per week. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. The statements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees, and are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and ski

Gemeinsam mit den Kolleg:innen aus dem Verkauf und anderen Vertriebseinheiten verfolgen wir das Ziel, eine langfristige Kundenbindung sicherzustellen und den Verkauf unserer Roche-Systeme aktiv zu unterstützen. Dabei verantworten wir den technischen und applikativen Kundenservice unter anderem für Analysensysteme und Reagenzien der Molekularen/Gewebediagnostik und IT-Lösungen. Deine Aufgaben erledigst du sowohl im direkten Kundenkontakt als auch in enger Abstimmung mit deinem Team:
• Du führst fachgerechte technische Fehlerdiagnosen durch und reparierst Roche-Standardgeräte – meist vor Ort beim Kunden, teilweise auch per Remote-Support. Dabei übernimmst du auch die sorgfältige Dokumentation im CRM-System, um nachhaltige Problemlösungen sicherzustellen und die Fakturierung.
• Du bist verantwortlich für die Installation neuer Systeme, führst Testläufe durch und übergibst die Geräte betriebsbereit an den Kunden.
• Du erledigst Wartungen und Modifikationen termingerecht und unter Berücksichtigung wirtschaftlicher Aspekte, basierend auf Serviceverträgen oder Einzelaufträgen.
• Als technischer Ansprechpartner vor Ort erkennst du die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden frühzeitig. • Du organisierst deine Einsätze in der Region effizient und eigenverantwortlich. FH) in Elektrotechnik, Elektronik, Mechatronik oder einer ähnlichen Fachrichtung bringst Du idealerweise erste praktische Berufserfahrung (z.B. durch Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeit oder eine technische Ausbildung) im Umgang mit komplexen technischen Systemen mit. Folgende Punkte runden Dein Profil ab:
• Aufgrund der regionalen Einsatzplanung und der Fahrzeiten lebst Du im idealerweise in der Region Augsburg/Landsberg a. Lech. Zudem besitzt du einen gültigen Führerschein und bringst eine hohe Reisebereitschaft mit, um unsere Kund:innen in der Region zu betreuen.
• Du bringst Erfahrung im Umgang mit technischen Systemen mit, insbesondere in den Bereichen Hydraulik, Elektronik und Messtechnik.
• Du besitzt Kenntnisse in der Anwendung von Steuerungs- und Betriebssoftware, verstehst die IT-Anbindung moderner IT-Anbindungen und hast idealerweise chemisches Basiswissen.
• Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und besitzt gute fach- und allgemeinsprachliche Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mindestens Niveau B1/B2).
• Du arbeitest eigenständig, ergebnisorientiert nach Zielvorgaben und bringst eine hohe Kundenorientierung mit. Als Teil eines deutschlandweiten Teams schätzt du den kollegialen Austausch und bist bereit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione SUMMARIO DI POSIZIONE GENERALE E PURPOSE: L’organizzazione di sviluppo clinico di Roche è strutturata dall’area terapeutica ed è responsabile dello sviluppo e dell’esecuzione delle strategie cliniche di sviluppo tardivo (Phase II – III) e dei piani che forniscono terapie medicalmente differenziate che forniscono un significativo miglioramento ai pazienti. Il Direttore Medico di Piombo conduce o apporta importanti contributi allo sviluppo della strategia e del piano di sviluppo clinico (CD) ed è responsabile dell'esecuzione efficace ed efficiente per le molecole/indicazioni assegnate. I direttori medici di piombo sono tenuti a svolgere le loro responsabilità con più indipendenza rispetto ai direttori medici. ESPERIENZA E QUALIFICA:
• Academic/Scientific/Clinical:
• M.D. richiesto
• Esperienza di sperimentazione/sviluppo clinico, scientifico o clinico rilevante nella stessa area terapeutica
• Lo sfondo accademico/insegnante è un plus
• Esperienza significativa che funziona con i principi e le tecniche di analisi, interpretazione e rilevanza clinica
• Esperienza risultati editoriali di uno studio scientifico in una rivista peer-reviewed è preferito
• Significativa esperienza nell'industria farmaceutica/biotecnica O è un esperto riconosciuto nel settore
• Esperienza significativa progettazione e conduzione di studi clinici (cioè uno o più studi)
• L'esperienza che autorizza un piano di sviluppo globale è preferita
• Comprensione della fase II – III sviluppo della droga
• La conoscenza e la comprensione dello sviluppo della fase I & IV della droga è un plus
• Comprensione dei profili di prodotto e di sicurezza
• Normativa: conoscenza degli aspetti medici del GCP (buona pratica clinica), ICH (conferenza internazionale sull'armonizzazione dei requisiti tecnici per la registrazione dei farmaci per uso umano), FDA, EMA e altre linee guida e regolamenti pertinenti è richiesto
• 4 o più anni di esperienza nell'industria farmaceutica/biotecnica O è un esperto locale riconosciuto nel settore (ad esempio Professore aggiunto o equivalente)
• Fino al 30% di viaggio globale Abilità e comportamenti chiave
• Etica: ha un'etica impeccabile. Dimostra, o comprovata capacità di dimostrare, Valori Roche
• Attenzione ai dettagli: eccezionale attenzione ai dettagli
• È considerato conoscibile nel suo campo, è rispettato da altri, può contribuire efficacemente allo sviluppo di farmaci a più lungo raggio, e può condurre squadre interfunzionali a risultati di successo
• Business Acumen: ha una solida conoscenza dell'industria farmaceutica/biotecnica, delle molteplici funzioni e ruoli coinvolti nel processo di sviluppo della droga.
• Organizzazione: Può dare priorità a più compiti e obiettivi nel tempo, sul bersaglio e nel budget
• Competenze interpersonali: forte comunicazione interpersonale, verbale e capacità di influenza: può influenzare senza autorità e ha dimostrato esperienza costruendo e coltivando relazioni con partner chiave e stakeholder, sia internamente che esternamente
• Scrittura: eccezionali capacità di comunicazione scritte
• Capacità di presentazione: Forte capacità di presentazione aziendale: efficace nel riassumere e presentare le considerazioni chiave e i punti di decisione. Confidente e competente quando interagisce con gli altri internamente ed esternamente: rimane concentrato e on-point, è in grado di sollevare problemi o sfide in modo produttivo e maturo
• Competenze di negoziazione: forti capacità di negoziazione: in grado di guidare efficacemente discussioni e decisioni verso i risultati finali desiderati
• Decision Making: Prende buone decisioni aziendali ed esercita un giudizio positivo. Saldo decisioni con imperativi per l'etica e l'efficacia. Able a mak

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position GENERAL POSITION SUMMARY AND PURPOSE: Roche’s Clinical Development organization is structured by therapeutic area and is responsible for developing and executing the late development (Phase II – III) clinical strategies and plans that deliver medically-differentiated therapies that provide meaningful improvement to patients. The Lead Medical Director leads or makes major contributions to development of the Clinical Development (CD) strategy and plan and is responsible for effective and efficient execution for the assigned molecule(s)/indication(s). Lead Medical Directors are expected to perform their responsibilities with more independence by comparison to Medical Directors. EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:
• Academic/Scientific/Clinical:
• M.D. Required
• Relevant clinical, scientific, or clinical trial/development experience in same/similar therapeutic area required
• Academic/teaching background is a plus
• Significant experience working with the principles and techniques of data analysis, interpretation, and clinical relevance
• Experience publishing results of a scientific study in a peer-reviewed journal is preferred
• Significant pharma/biotech industry experience OR is a recognized expert in the field
• Significant experience designing and conducting clinical trials (i.e. one or more trials)
• Experience authoring a global development plan is preferred
• Understanding of Phase II – III drug development
• Knowledge and understanding of Phase I & IV drug development is a plus
• Understanding of product and safety profiles
• Regulatory: Knowledge of medical aspects of GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA, and other relevant guidelines and regulations is required
• 4 or more years pharma/biotech industry experience OR is a recognized local expert in the field (e.g Assistant Professor or equivalent)
• Up to 30% global travel Key Skills and Behaviours
• Ethics: Has impeccable ethics. Demonstrates, or proven ability to demonstrate, Roche Values
• Attention to detail: Outstanding attention to detail
• Is regarded as knowledgeable in his/her field, is respected by others, can effectively contribute to longer-range drug development, and can lead cross-functional teams to successful results
• Business Acumen: Has sound knowledge of the pharma/biotech industry, the multiple functions and roles involved in the drug development process.
• Organization: Can prioritize multiple tasks and goals on time, on target, and within budget
• Interpersonal skills: Strong interpersonal, verbal communication and influencing skills: can influence without authority and has proven experience building and cultivating relationships with key partners and stakeholders, both internally and externally
• Writing: Outstanding written communication skills
• Presentation skills: Strong business presentation skills: effective at summarizing and presenting the key considerations and decision-points.Confident and competent when interacting with others internally and externally: stays focused and on-point, is able to raise problems or challenges in a productive and mature manner
• Negotiation Skills: Strong negotiation skills: can effectively drive discussions and decisions toward desired end-results
• Decision Making: Makes good business decisions and exercises sound judgment. Balances decisions with imperatives for ethics and efficacy. Able to mak

titleByLocale.en: People & Culture Business Partner - Roche Pharma
titleByLocale.de: People & Culture Business Partner - Roche Pharma
titleByLocale.fr: People & Culture Business Partner - Roche Pharma

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Roche Pharma India is a fully fledged Roche Country Organization headed by a General Manager, operating across India in a unique cluster-based operating model. This fit-for-purpose model is aligned to realize the huge potential in India that is waiting to be unlocked. Roche India envisions a future role to truly serve patients in India and help uplift and transform the health system. Roche prides itself on bringing first-in-class/ best-in-class products to the market, and India is one of the most important markets to bring its gold-standard portfolio to. Roche India is an organization with just over 300 employees and has yearly sales of approximately CHF 160 million with an aspiration to serve 10x the number of patients by 2035. Every employee at Roche India strives to achieve a triple win (for patients, for the health system, and for Roche) and truly lives up to the ethos of “Doing Now What Patients Need Next”. Roche India is part of Roche Group with more than 100,000 employees across the globe dedicated to advanced science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products globally. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. As the People & Culture (P&C) Business Partner for Roche Pharma India, you will: Act as the vital catalyst, rallying all other P&C chapters around the business priorities and P&C strategy. While this is an individual contributor role, it requires the mindset of a strong and highly influential business leader and entrepreneur. You will thrive by accomplishing things through others and living agility in all its facets. Key Responsibilities
• Influence & Trust: You must have the ability to influence with courageous authenticity, build trust with individuals at all levels, and challenge the status quo when appropriate without relying on formal reporting lines.
• Coaching: You will act as a trusted strategic partner, a credible activist, and a coach to creative leadership and the country leadership team. You will engage in honest, authentic, and open dialogue at all levels to unlock the greatness in our people and organization.
• Strategic Alignment: You will translate business strategy into P&C strategies for the leadership areas and drive fit-for-purpose implementation and pull-through.
• Organizational Transformation: You will be a key enabler of organizational transformation, advancing organizational design and effectiveness, including driving shifts in mindset, behaviors, and ways of working.
• Data-Driven Culture: You will focus on data-driven insights to inform your actions and the overall P&C strategy, aiming to create a high-performance, integrity-driven culture where employees can thrive. Who You Are
• Experienced Professional: You bring 10+ years of broad, progressive HR management or consulting experience in international business environments, recognized for best-in-class HR practices.
• Handles complexity well, can handle multiple tasks and initiatives at the same time - can prioritise and organise your own and the P&C team's time and energy into the most important topics in service of our outcomes. You are someone who can stay calm in chaos and approach charged topics with maturity and objectivity, and propose

title: Business Partnership Leader 医院拓展渠道负责人

titleByLocale.fr: Business Partnership Leader 医院拓展渠道负责人

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责/责任 (Major functions of the position) （职位的首要职能） 1、 销售策略与业务计划制定执行 根据公司整体品牌策略，制定并落地非目标医院、基层医疗等广阔市场的年度销售策略计划、区域分解与行动方案。 规划渠道销售模式，因地制宜，探索并制定适合不同市场类型的商业化模式 结合各地基药、医保、集采等政策，制定针对性销售策略，保障销售稳定增长。 2、 渠道与外部合作伙伴管理 负责CSO及合作商业客户的筛选、评估、签约与日常管理和赋能，建立长期稳定和共赢的合作关系。 搭建外部合作团队的管理、考核与激励机制，提升合作方执行力、覆盖能力与推广效率。 定期走访关键渠道客户与合作伙伴，解决市场问题，推动终端覆盖与销量持续提升。 3、 销售团队（BPM）管理与赋能 负责拓展渠道销售团队（BPM）的日常管理、目标拆解、过程追踪与绩效评估。 定期协访一线市场，指导区域销售拓展、客户开发与上量动作，提升团队实战能力。 联合市场、培训部门搭建销售能力体系，开展产品知识、学术推广、渠道开发等专项培训。 4、 客户开发与学术销售联动 推动非核心医院、基层医疗机构等关键客户开发与关系维护。 联动市场部落地学术推广活动，将医学内容转化为销售动作，提升客户认可与处方转化。 根据一线市场信息、竞品动态与客户需求，制定策略并优化执行。 5、销售项目管理与业绩达成 策划、落地各类销售提升项目，针对不同省份特点设计差异化上量方案。 监控销售数据、渠道库存、终端覆盖与投入产出，及时调整动作确保目标达成。 跨部门协同市场、医学、商务、供应链等部门，打通流程、解决障碍，保障业务高效运转。 Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
• 教育背景 Education/Qualifications 教育程度 / 资格证书 ・ 大学本科及以上学历 ・ 医学、药学、市场营销及相关专业优先
• Leadership Competencies 领导者胜任力 ・ 聚焦结果交付，高效驱动团队达成核心目标 ・ 具备较强的人际敏锐度和学习敏锐度，拥抱不确定性，具备创新能力 ・ 极强的目标感、结果导向、执行力与抗压能力 ・优秀的团队辅导、跨部门协同及人际沟通能力
• Job Required Competencies 岗位核心胜任力 ・ 10年以上医药行业销售管理/渠道拓展经验，有基层医疗、广阔市场、院外渠道经验 ・ 具备商业政策设计与规划能力，尤其是0到1的落地经验； 经销商 / CSO 管理、商业渠道运作、基药 / 非公医疗开发经验者优先 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity Are you a visionary leader passionate about shaping the future of Patient Safety? In this pivotal role, you will lead and manage the PV Regional Center, ensuring the delivery of high-quality pharmacovigilance (PV) and Device Vigilance activities across the Europe, Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EEMEA) region. You will be at the forefront of driving operational excellence, upholding regulatory compliance, and integrating regional clinical safety activities in a complex, global environment. Working in partnership with Affiliate Patient Safety and Global Leadership, you will contribute to the broader Patient Safety Operations (PSO) strategy. Your leadership will ensure that our safety processes are not only compliant but also innovative, leveraging data-driven insights and digital transformation to protect patients worldwide.
• Lead and inspire a multi-site regional team , acting as a catalyst for a quality- and customer-centric culture.
• Oversee the operationalization of safety processes to ensure full compliance with global Roche standards and local regulations.
• Drive continuous improvement and innovation by embedding technological advances like AI and digital analytics into safety operations.
• Ensure inspection and audit readiness for all regional activities, maintaining a robust business continuity plan.
• Collaborate with cross-functional partners to integrate regionalized clinical safety activities and achieve shared global objectives.
• Foster a culture of growth and empowerment , adopting the VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach) leadership style to develop future talent.
• Represent the PV function with external parties, including regulators, ensuring Roche’s reputation for excellence remains unmatched. Who You Are You are a strategic thinker and a servant leader who thrives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. You possess a deep understanding of the pharmaceutical landscape and are motivated by the opportunity to lead large-scale operational changes that have a real impact on patient lives.
• You hold a Health Care Professional Degree (Medical, Pharmacy, or equivalent professional experience).
• You bring 10+ years of pharmaceutical experience , with at least 5 years in significant PV leadership roles.
• You have a proven track record in managing multi-country or regional operations within a large, complex organization.
• You are a VACC leader , committed to inclusive behaviors and developing high-performing, diverse teams.
• You possess deep technical expertise in GVP, ICH-GCP, and global regulatory requirements (FDA/EMA).
• You are an exceptional communicator , able to influence stakeholders and convey complex information clearly in English.
• You have a growth mindset , eager to experiment with new technologies and take smart risks to improve operational efficiency. Location: This position is based in Budapest.
