Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Das RiSE-Programm (Roche Internships for Scientific Exchange) ist ein hochkonkurrenzfähiges Studentenforschungsprogramm bei Roche. Es bietet den talentiertesten Absolventen und Medizinstudenten die Möglichkeit, vollständig in unsere interdisziplinäre und internationale Industrie R&D-Umgebung integriert werden. Als RiSE-Studierende werden Sie Ihre Kompetenzen verbessern, wertvolle Arbeitserfahrung bei uns gewinnen und schließlich Teil eines weltweiten Netzwerks von RiSE Alumni werden. Die Neurowissenschaften und Seltene Krankheiten Discovery and Translational Area (NRD DTA) entwickelt Arzneimittel für eine Reihe von schweren neurologischen Erkrankungen, einschließlich Multipler Sklerose, Alzheimer-Krankheit, Parkinson-Krankheit, Autismus, Rückenmuskel-Atrophie und Huntington-Krankheit. Als RiSE-Studierende in der NRD DTA werden Sie im Roche Innovation Center Basel, Schweiz, der Brain Delivery Group beitreten, um Omics-Datenanalysen und experimentelle In-vitro-Arbeiten durchzuführen, um die regulatorische Landschaft der Alzheimer-Krankheitsziele abzubilden. Sie werden von einem Roche-Wissenschaftler gehostet und betreut, der Sie durch Ihre Forschung leitet und Ihnen die notwendige Arbeitsinfrastruktur und ein Kooperationsnetzwerk zur Verfügung stellt. Die Chance
• enge Zusammenarbeit mit rechnerischen Wissenschaftlern, um Sequenzierungsdatensätze zu analysieren, um biologische Erkenntnisse zu fördern.

• Sie haben im letzten Jahr ein Masterstudium absolviert
• Oder Sie sind in einem PhD- oder Medizinstudium an einer Universität eingeschrieben
• Sie wollen Ihre Erfahrung mit einem Industriepraktikum erweitern
• Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Erzeugung und Analyse von scRNAseq-Daten
• Hands-on-Erfahrung mit iPSC-basierten Modellen von Gehirnzellentypen für funktionelle genomische Ansätze (z.B. CRISPR)
• Ein breites Geschick mit Zell- und Molekularbiologie-Assays Weitere Informationen Das bevorzugte Startdatum des Praktikums beträgt 11/2026 oder nach Verfügbarkeit. Anwendungsprozess Bewerbungen müssen einen Lebenslauf und einen Brief umfassen, sowie einen Brief von Ihrem aktuellen oder ehemaligen akademischen Betreuer, der Ihre Bewerbung an das RiSE-Programm unterstützt. Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le programme RiSE (Roche Stages for Scientific Exchange) est un programme de recherche étudiant hautement compétitif à Roche. Il offre aux étudiants diplômés et aux étudiants en médecine les plus talentueux la possibilité d'être pleinement intégrés dans notre environnement de R-D interdisciplinaire et international. En tant qu'étudiant RiSE, vous améliorerez vos compétences, gagnerez une expérience de travail précieuse avec nous et finirez par faire partie d'un réseau mondial d'anciens RiSE. La zone de découverte et de traduction des neurosciences et des maladies rares (DNT) met au point des médicaments pour diverses maladies neurologiques graves, dont la sclérose en plaques, la maladie d'Alzheimer, la maladie de Parkinson, l'autisme, l'atrophie musculaire de la colonne vertébrale et la maladie de Huntington. En tant qu'étudiant RiSE au NRD DTA, vous rejoindrez le groupe Brain Delivery au Roche Innovation Center Basel, en Suisse, pour effectuer des analyses de données omiques et des travaux expérimentaux in vitro pour cartographier le paysage réglementaire des cibles de la maladie d'Alzheimer. Vous serez accueilli et encadré par un scientifique de Roche qui vous guidera dans vos recherches et vous fournira l'infrastructure de travail et le réseau de collaboration nécessaires. L'opportunité
• Collaborer étroitement avec les chercheurs en calcul pour analyser les ensembles de données séquentielles afin de générer des données biologiques.
• Concevoir des expériences in vitro rigoureuses en fonction de votre expertise en interprétation des données transcriptomiques.
• Appliquer un ensemble complet de méthodes de biologie cellulaire moléculaire dans des modèles dérivés de cellules souches pour tester des hypothèses biologiques spécifiques
• Présentez et discutez de votre travail lors de réunions internes.
• Synthétiser les données expérimentales pour la préparation et la soumission de manuscrits à fort impact pour publication par des pairs. Qui vous êtes
• Vous avez obtenu votre diplôme de maîtrise au cours de la dernière année
• Ou vous êtes inscrit à un programme de doctorat ou de diplôme médical dans une université
• Vous cherchez à développer votre expérience avec un stage dans l'industrie
• Expérience approfondie dans la production et l'analyse de données scRNAseq
• Expérience pratique des modèles iPSC d'ingénierie des types de cellules cérébrales pour les approches génomiques fonctionnelles (par exemple CRISPR)
• Un vaste ensemble de compétences avec des tests de biologie cellulaire et moléculaire Informations complémentaires La date de début préférée du stage est 11/2026 ou selon disponibilité. Processus de demande Les demandes doivent comprendre un CV et une lettre d'accompagnement, ainsi qu'une lettre de votre superviseur scolaire actuel ou ancien appuyant votre demande au Programme RiSE. Les lettres de référence sont également les bienvenues. Veuillez noter qu'en raison de la réglementation des citoyens non membres de l'UE ou de l'AELE doivent être inscrits à un programme de doctorat ou de diplôme en médecine dans une université et fournir un certificat de l'université indiquant qu'un stage dans l'industrie est obligatoire dans le cadre de la formation universitaire. Curieux, motivé et prêt à apprendre? Faites votre demande pour notre stage RiSE. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Are you a Finance or Business student looking to gain hands-on experience in a global corporate environment? We are looking for a motivated Intern to join our Global Procurement Finance team. This is a unique opportunity to see the "inner workings" of a global finance function. You will gain exposure to complex stakeholder management and international reporting standards-all while being part of a supportive, expert team. The opportunity In this role, you won’t just be crunching numbers; you’ll be a key part of a team operating across a global scale. You will work directly under the Finance Functional Partner to support global operations and strategic procurement. As our Intern you will:
• Drive Financial Insights: Assist in preparing monthly financial reports
• Master the Tools: Take ownership of our procurement savings tracking tool (SpendHQ) - validating business cases and savings entered by the procurement organization.
• Business Partnering: Collaborate directly with one function/team to provide financial support.
• Support & Innovate: Help Procurement Finance Business Partners with insight generation, SMC planning, and organizational training. Who you are You are enrolled in or have completed your studies within the last 12 months with a degree (Bachelor’s, Master’s) in Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
• Skills: A solid foundation in financial controlling and reporting.
• Communication: Fluent in English; you’re comfortable working in a diverse, international environment.
• Mindset: Proactive, detail-oriented, and ready to take ownership of projects.
• You come with the ability/interest to automate reports and improve processes Additional information Start Date: August 2026 Workload: 100% Duration: 12 months Application process Please submit your complete application, including your CV and a motivation letter. A certificate of enrollment (if you are currently studying) OR recent graduates are also eligible to start an internship with us within 12 months of their graduation date. descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Field Service Engineer – Diagnostica Medica (Stoke-on-Trent to Wrexham) Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci guida. Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare, a avanzare continuamente la scienza, e a garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni future. Insieme, stiamo creando un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Roche Diagnostics offre un'opportunità eccezionale per voi di sfruttare la vostra esperienza tecnica, fornendo un supporto vitale e salvavita ai nostri clienti apprezzati. Come membro integrante del Central Customer-Centric Field Support Team nel Regno Unito, questo ruolo offre la possibilità di assegnazioni basate sul campo attraverso Stoke e aree circostanti o focalizzandosi su una base clienti designata. (North Wales, Shropshire e Staffordshire) Opportunità: Eccellenza tecnica nel campo Posizione ideale: Basato su Stoke o sulle aree circostanti ad ovest, con un ottimo accesso alle reti autostradali. In qualità di Field Service Engineer, il vostro obiettivo è quello di garantire il funzionamento senza soluzione di continuità e il massimo uptime dei sistemi/prodotti innovativi di Roche, che vanno dall'area di lavoro siero, dall'analisi pre/post e dal nostro portafoglio digitale. Utilizzerai una combinazione di supporto in loco e strumenti diagnostici remoti per identificare e risolvere efficacemente i guasti elettromeccanici complessi. Inoltre, eseguire la manutenzione preventiva e generare report approfonditi per migliorare l'efficienza operativa attraverso i siti dei clienti assegnati. Principali responsabilità
• Fornire supporto essenziale: fornire supporto hardware elettromeccanico, tra cui attività proattive e reattive di routine e formazione tecnica.

The Position Field Service Engineer – Medical Diagnostics (Stoke-on-Trent to Wrexham) A Healthier Future. It’s What Drives Us. A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate, to continuously advance science, and to ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Roche Diagnostics presents an exceptional opportunity for you to leverage your technical expertise while providing vital, life-saving support to our valued customers. As an integral member of the Central Customer-Centric Field Support Team in the UK, this role offers the possibility of field-based assignments across Stoke and surrounding areas or focusing on a designated customer base. (North Wales, Shropshire, and Staffordshire) The Opportunity: Technical Excellence in the Field Ideal Location: Based out of Stoke or the surrounding areas to the west, with excellent access to motorway networks. As a Field Service Engineer, your focus is to ensure the seamless operation and maximum uptime of Roche’s innovative Systems/Products, ranging from serum work area, pre/post analytics and our digital portfolio. You will utilise a combination of on-site support and remote diagnostic tools to identify and resolve complex electro-mechanical faults efficiently. Additionally, you will perform preventive maintenance and generate insightful reports to enhance operational efficiency across assigned customer sites. Key Responsibilities
• Deliver Essential Support: Deliver electro-mechanical hardware support, including routine proactive and reactive tasks and technical training.
• Resolve Complex Faults: Perform troubleshooting and fault resolution, conduct preventive maintenance, and generate reports to enhance operational efficiency.
• Customer Training: Provide technical training and guidance to customers, enabling them to excel in the use of Roche diagnostic systems.
• Compliance & Administration: Maintain rigorous administration and regulatory documentation to ensure compliance and efficient service delivery.
• Stakeholder Management: Build productive relationships with peers and key stakeholders to align service and sales objectives seamlessly.
• Service Excellence: Attend internal review meetings to showcase progress, discuss objectives, and ensure service excellence. Who you are We are seeking resilient, adaptable, and customer-focused individuals who thrive on solving technical challenges and exceeding expectations. Ideally, you will bring:
• Educational Qualifications: A degree or equivalent qualification in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering is preferred. Candidates with equivalent experience at the HNC/HND level with a proven track record are also encouraged to apply.
• Experience: Extensive experience within the IVD industry, with a history of delivering exceptional technical support.
• Skills: Excellent analytical ability, self-motivation, advanced troubleshooting expertise, and the ability to work effectively under pressure in a collaborative team environment.
• Attributes: Resilience, tenacity, motivation to exceed customer expectations, and the ability to grow and mentor others through training, coaching, and continuous development. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We are seeking an experienced SAP EWM Specialist who independently leads EWM solution delivery, proactively solves product issues, and contributes to the architecture for the global Roche ASPIRE EWM System. In this role, you will guide product developments, champion accountability, and effectively communicate with all stakeholders. You will solve complex problems, make independent product-level decisions, provide technical oversight, and report at the product level. By bringing advanced EWM knowledge, expertise within GxP environments, and strong analytical skills, you will actively contribute to continuous improvement and the evolution of our warehouse processes across Roche. Description of the area: Job Responsibilities
• Scope: Works and leads independently to deliver solution design with increased complexity (e.g., technical, scope, stakeholders) in the EWM area that meet product requirements and business priorities. Proactively identifies issues at the product level, proposes ideas on how to tackle them, and keeps applying a continuous improvement mindset. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the EWM product life cycle, and leads the development of medium to complex changes. Evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new business processes while providing technical oversight and consultation. Supports larger initiatives as a single point of contact for the EWM system as needed.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Determines methods and procedures on assignments and coordinates or guides the activities of others in the team. Champions accountability by example (such as taking tech lead and/or product owner roles) and helps drive the successful completion of major product milestones. Solves complex problems which require the regular use of ingenuity and creativity, taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information. Independently makes decisions with impact at the product level under limited direction. Analyzes current warehouse processes and recommends SAP EWM enhancements to improve efficiency, accuracy, and compliance. Manages interfaces between SAP EWM and other systems, like e.g. MES and troubleshoot data flow issues.
• Stakeholder Management: Interacts within and across multiple product teams within a domain, working directly with all stakeholders from the business and within IT. Communicates information, issues, and potential solutions to the product team or squad and to external stakeholders. Proactively communicates across work-streams, taking responsibility for fostering teamwork, resolving confusion or miscommunication, and facilitating discussions.
• Impact/Strategy: Makes an impact that is typically limited to the EWM system and its interfaces. Identifies opportunities and improves existing solutions to enhance value and business processes, providing technical oversight and guidance for the product teams. Qualifications Education / Experience
• A minimum of five years of experience is required in independently leading and delivering complex solution designs and products within the Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) domain.
• Background in logistics or supply chain.
• Excellent communication skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams.
• Experience working within a validated environment, including the creation and execution of test scripts and solution documentation. Technical Skills
• SAP EWM certifications.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione AI Full-Stack Engineer - Fusioni e acquisizioni Informazioni sul nostro team: Partnering Digital Solutions Unisciti al nostro team di Partnering Digital Solutions, un gruppo strategico focalizzato sulla massimizzazione dell'impatto del partenariato attraverso ecosistemi digitali e abilitati all'intelligenza artificiale per promuovere il business di Pharma e DIA Partnering. Siamo all'avanguardia nell'innovazione: la costruzione di infrastrutture dati scalabili, l'applicazione di pratiche di ingegneria dei dati avanzate e l'integrazione di capacità esterne all'avanguardia per accelerare il processo decisionale e sbloccare il valore aziendale. Il nostro lavoro si estende su più iniziative ad alto impatto, dallo sviluppo di prodotti di dati intelligenti per consentire flussi di lavoro AI end-to-end. Potrai sviluppare esperienze frontend moderne e integrarli con servizi backend, piattaforme di dati e sistemi AI agentic. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Ingénieur IA - Fusions et acquisitions À propos de notre équipe: Partenaires Solutions numériques Rejoignez notre équipe de Solutions numériques partenaires, un groupe stratégique axé sur la maximisation de l'impact du partenariat grâce aux écosystèmes numériques et à l'IA pour faire progresser les activités de Partenariats Pharma et DIA. Nous sommes à l'avant-garde de l'innovation - construire une infrastructure de données évolutive, appliquer des pratiques avancées en matière d'ingénierie des données et intégrer des capacités externes de pointe pour accélérer la prise de décisions et débloquer la valeur commerciale. Notre travail s'étend à de multiples initiatives à impact élevé, depuis le développement de produits de données intelligents jusqu'aux flux de travail d'IA de bout en bout. Qu'il s'agisse de structurer des écosystèmes de données complexes ou de collaborer avec des institutions de recherche externes, il s'agit d'une occasion unique de contribuer à façonner l'avenir des données et de l'IA à Roche en appuyant directement les décisions stratégiques clés de notre organisation mondiale de partenariat. Responsabilités En tant qu'ingénieur d'IA Full-Stack, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans la conception et la construction d'applications d'IA orientées vers les utilisateurs qui permettent l'analyse en libre-service et la prise de décisions intelligentes. Vous développerez des expériences de frontend modernes et les intégrerez aux services de backend, aux plateformes de données et aux systèmes d'intelligence artificielle. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les ingénieurs des données, les ingénieurs de l'IA/ML et les intervenants commerciaux pour fournir des applications évolutives, sécurisées et intuitives qui apportent des capacités d'IA aux utilisateurs finaux. • Développer des expériences interactives en temps réel, y compris des réponses en streaming et des visualisations dynamiques de données.
• Intégration backend & développement d'API:
• Développer et gérer les services et les API (par exemple FastAPI) pour connecter les applications frontend aux plateformes de données, aux systèmes d'intelligence artificielle et aux services d'entreprise.
• Assurer l'évolutivité, la fiabilité et la performance des intégrations d'applications.
• Intégration AI/Agent:
• Intégrer les applications frontend avec des systèmes d'IA agents alimentés par des cadres tels que LangGraph.
• Permettre une interaction transparente entre les utilisateurs et les agents de l'IA, y compris l'orchestration de flux de travail en plusieurs étapes et des informations basées sur l'IA.
• Intégration de données et de systèmes :
• Connectez les applications aux sources de données internes et externes via les API, permettant l'ingestion de nouvelles données et la visualisation des sorties des modèles d'IA.
• Assurer un traitement efficace des données structurées et non structurées entre les systèmes
• Développement d'applications Cloud-Native :
• Construisez et déployez des applications en utilisant des services AWS comme ECS et Lambda.
• Veiller à ce que les solutions soient évolutives, sécurisées et alignées sur les normes d'architecture d'entreprise
• Intégration des entreprises (sécurité et identité):
• Intégrer les mécanismes d'authentification et d'autorisation des entreprises, y compris la gestion active de l'identité par répertoire et le contrôle d'accès par rôle (RBAC).
• Assurer la mise en œuvre sûre de la SSO et le respect des normes de sécurité Roche.

• Traduire les besoins des entreprises en flux de travail d'application intuitifs et les expériences des utilisateurs. Faites équipe avec les intervenants pour concevoir des solutions qui permettent l'analyse en libre-service et maximisent la convivialité et l'adoption.
• Surveillance et optimisation des performances :
• Mettre en œuvre des pratiques de surveillance, d'enregistrement et d'optimisation des performances pour assurer le respect des règles

• Experiência comprovada em assistência técnica, manutenções e serviços relacionados a equipamentos de análises clínicas ou informática.
• Conhecimento intermediário de Inglês (leitura técnica e comunicação básica).
• Habilidade em organização e autogestão para cumprimento de cronogramas de manutenção e chamados técnicos.
• Facilidade em estabelecer bom relacionamento interpessoal e atuar de forma colaborativa com equipes multidisciplinares.

In questo ruolo, userai la tua esperienza per navigare diversi problemi e prendere decisioni strategiche che spingono il successo. Potrai gestire conti di medie e grandi dimensioni, superando gli obiettivi di vendita durante la costruzione di relazioni durature con i decisori chiave. Il vostro obiettivo sarà quello di espandere la vostra rete, identificare nuove opportunità e presentare proposte di valore convincenti. Con una profonda comprensione della nostra linea di prodotti, servirai come consulente affidabile, migliorando continuamente il nostro sistema di qualità attraverso le tue azioni quotidiane. Come amministratore del conto - Diagnostica molecolare, Lei:
• essere responsabile della promozione di test diagnostici molecolari, tra cui malattia infettiva, respiratoria e trapianto.
• contattare i clienti nuovi e esistenti per soddisfare e superare gli obiettivi di vendita in conti mirati, sviluppando nuovi business, crescendo business esistente, mantenendo le relazioni con i clienti e risolvendo i problemi dei clienti. Ciò include l'individuazione e lo sviluppo di piani di conto strategici, lo sviluppo e la fornitura del messaggio differenziante e del valore economico quantificabile per prodotti e servizi, la vendita della differenziazione primaria dei prodotti Roche, il superamento e la gestione delle obiezioni e la negoziazione per ottenere le vendite.
• generare domanda e massimizzare la consapevolezza del prodotto lavorando e fornendo istruzione e informazioni ai clienti.
• implementa iniziative strategiche e piani per facilitare il processo di vendita e la produttività.
• lavorare con altri, se necessario o richiesto, per preparare proposte per conti assegnati. Presenta tutte le proposte di contratto ai clienti per massimizzare il business complessivo e la redditività, che possono richiedere alcune trattative.
• condurre e organizzare la pianificazione e il routing del territorio necessario per l'efficienza. Conduce l'analisi aziendale e la pianificazione.
• comunica le informazioni sul mercato competitivo internamente.
• reti e interfacce con i colleghi interni per condividere informazioni e migliori pratiche, pur rimanendo attivamente coinvolti in organizzazioni di settore/clienti che influiscono sul business. • L'esperienza nelle vendite diagnostiche è fortemente preferita
• Buone capacità di comunicazione orale e scritta, tra cui fare presentazioni d'impatto
• Prove capacità di leadership

• Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente regolamentato

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Deine Abteilung Du bist auf der Suche nach einem Praktikum, um Einblicke in die pharmazeutische Industrie zu bekommen? Bei uns erhältst Du die spannende Möglichkeit dazu. In Deinem Praktikum lernst Du den Bereich der Qualitätskontrolle umfassend kennen. Es erwartet Dich eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit im Bereich der Analytik von immunologischen Einsatzstoffen. Du erhältst ebenfalls die Möglichkeit, Einblicke in andere Bereiche wie z.B. Biotech Produktion oder Qualitätssicherung zu gewinnen. Während des gesamten Praktikums steht Dir ein kompetenter Ansprechpartner zur Seite. Deine Aufgaben
• Du unterstützt die proteinchemische Analytik und Freigabeanalytik von immunologischen Einsatzstoffen im diagnostischen Umfeld
• Du bearbeitest eigenständig kleinere Projekte zur Optimierung der Qualitätskontrolle, beispielsweise durch Datenrecherche bei Abweichungen oder die Zentralisierung von Analysemethoden
• Du wirkst aktiv an Compliance-Themen mit, indem Du beispielsweise bei der Erstellung und Anpassung von Dokumenten nach internen Vorschriften und geltenden Standards unterstützt
• Du erhältst Einblicke in angrenzende Bereiche wie die Vorbereitung von Audits und Inspektionen sowie in den gesamten Lebenszyklus diagnostischer Tests (Neuentwicklung, Produktion und Verpackung) Dein Profil
• Du bist aktuell in einem naturwissenschaftlichen Studium (z.B. B.Sc . / M.Sc . Chemie, Biochemie, Biotechnologie, Biologie, etc.) immatrikuliert oder Du befindest Dich in Deinem Gap-Year
• Du bringst eine hohe Motivation und Neugierde für die Arbeit in der Qualitätskontrolle mit.
• Idealerweise verfügst Du über Vorkenntnisse in der proteinchemischen Analytik.
• Solide Deutsch-Kenntnisse sind erforderlich Deine Vorteile
• Flexible Zeiteinteilung
• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum > 3 Monate
• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine
• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus
• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden (online/offline)
• Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und spannende Gastvorträge
• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boardinghaus
• Gut organisierte Verkehrsanbindung nach München mit unserem Roche-Shuttle Deine Bewerbung Bitte lade nur Deinen Lebenslauf online hoch. Denke daran, daß sich dieses Praktikum ausschließlich an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation während des gesamten Zeitraums des Praktikums richtet oder alternativ an Personen in einem maximal einjährigen Gap-Year (zwischen Bachelor und Master Studium), wo es schriftlich nachgewiesen werden kann, auf welcher Universität/Hochschule und genau wann (Monat/Jahr) innerhalb eines Jahres die Studien fortgesetzt werden. Beachte bitte, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten, etc.) ausgeschlossen sind. Zeitraum: ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung für die Dauer von 6 Monaten. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Your contact to us! With people. For people. Do you need further support? Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity,

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición. Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:
• Gestionar y expandir la operación comercial de las cuentas asignadas, asegurando el cumplimiento de objetivos de ventas y rentabilidad, alineados con el código de conducta Roche, normativas locales y lineamientos corporativos.
• Liderar negociaciones estratégicas e implementar soluciones integrales adaptadas a las necesidades de los clientes, desarrollando propuestas de valor basadas en un entendimiento profundo de sus operaciones y desafíos.
• Construir y fortalecer relaciones de largo plazo con clientes y stakeholders clave, brindando una experiencia superior de servicio, realizando visitas estratégicas y participando activamente en actividades externas como congresos, talleres y jornadas.
• Identificar nuevas oportunidades de negocio y contribuir al desarrollo de cuentas estratégicas, apoyando procesos de licitación, análisis de mercado, actualización de CRM y colaboración interdisciplinaria enfocada en el paciente y el cliente.
• Impulsar una cultura de trabajo colaborativa y de crecimiento continuo, participando en iniciativas internas, fortaleciendo habilidades comerciales y contribuyendo al desarrollo y capacitación de nuevos integrantes del equipo. Tu Perfil:
• Profesional del área de la salud, idealmente Tecnólogo Médico o Bioquímico, con residencia en Temuco y disponibilidad para viajar dentro de la zona asignada.
• Experiencia mínima de 3 años en el área comercial de soluciones diagnósticas para laboratorio clínico, idealmente en entornos de diagnóstico clínico, equipos médicos o industrias relacionadas.
• Deseable formación en ventas profesionales, manejo de herramientas CRM como Salesforce, y conocimientos comerciales orientados a negociación estratégica y desarrollo de cuentas.
• Nivel de inglés intermedio o avanzado, junto con capacidad de trabajo en equipo, mirada corporativa y pensamiento estratégico orientado a equipos de alto desempeño. #LI-DC1 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione ERP Solution Consultant - SAP EWM Stiamo cercando un esperto senior SAP EWM Specialist & Developer con esperienza MFS per unire il nostro team e prendere la proprietà di una soluzione di gestione del magazzino altamente complessa e validata. Questo magazzino è uno dei più grandi della divisione Roche Pharma con un alto grado di automazione. Guida team di prodotti, responsabilità dei campioni e comunica efficacemente con tutti gli stakeholder. Si risolverà problemi complessi, prendere decisioni indipendenti a livello di prodotto, fornire la supervisione tecnica, e rapporto a livello di prodotto. L'opportunità
• Progettazione e attuazione: sviluppare e implementare miglioramenti complessi alla nostra soluzione SAP EWM, comprese le interfacce utente MFS e WebDynpro
• Indipendente Problem-Solving: analizzare i requisiti aziendali e tradurli in soluzioni tecniche; risolvere i problemi a livello di codice senza richiedere una guida costante
• Deep-Dive tecnico: individuare complesse sfide tecniche, debug code e ottimizzare le prestazioni del sistema
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team aziendali per comprendere i requisiti, gestire le aspettative e comunicare vincoli tecnici e tempistiche
• Gestione dell'ambiente convalidata: Eseguire le modifiche nel rispetto del nostro ambiente regolamentato, inclusi i requisiti di documentazione, casi di test e convalida
• Knowledge Transfer: soluzioni di documenti e competenze con i membri del team per costruire capacità organizzative
• Viaggiare in Svizzera come necessario per il supporto in loco, workshop e impegno dei clienti Qualificazioni richieste
• Ampia esperienza SAP EWM: minimo 5+ anni di lavoro con SAP EWM in ambienti produttivi, comprese configurazioni complesse e personalizzazioni
• Competenza MFS: comprovata esperienza di attuazione e mantenimento di SAP MFS
• ABAP Development Skills: Solid background di programmazione con capacità di debug e ottimizzare il codice ABAP
• Esperienza ambientale convalidata: familiarità dimostrata con ambienti regolamentati, processi di gestione dei cambiamenti e documentazione di conformità
• Conoscenza quadro SAFe: comprensione di lavoro dei principi e delle pratiche di Agile Framework (SAFe)
• Inglese fluente: Forte capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta (essenziale)
• Lingua tedesca (preferita) : La fluenza in tedesco è un vantaggio significativo Chi sei:
• Campo d'insalatura 14.175 - 26.325 PLN lordo basato sul contratto di lavoro.
• Pagamento bonus annuale in base alle tue prestazioni (target 15%).
• Bilancio di formazione dedicato (formazione, certificazioni, conferenze, percorsi di carriera diversificati ecc.).
• Ricarica venerdì (2 venerdì per trimestre disponibile).
• Prendere il programma di tempo (fino a 3 mesi di congedo da utilizzare per qualsiasi scopo).
• Sovvenzione per le vacanze disponibile.
• Flex Location (possibilità di eseguire il nostro lavoro da diversi luoghi del mondo per un certo periodo di tempo).
• Prendere il tempo per la carità ( congedo a pagamento aggiuntivo di massimo 2 settimane per impegnarsi nell'azione di carità di vostra scelta).
• Assistenza sanitaria privata (pacchetti LuxMed), assicurazione vita di gruppo (UNUM) e Multisport.
• Aggiunti di acquisto azionario.
• Vendita annuale di computer portatili aziendali e automobili e molti altri! The Position ERP Solution Consultant - SAP EWM We are seeking an experienced Senior SAP EWM Specialist & Developer with MFS experience to join our team and take ownership of a highly complex, validated warehouse management solution. This warehouse is one of the biggest ones of the Roche Pharma division with a high degree of automation. You guide product teams, champion accountability, and effectively communicate with all stakeholders. You will solve complex problems, make independent product-level decisions, provide technical oversight, and report at the product level. The Opportunity

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche Near Patient Care , we create the tools that help people with diabetes think less about their daily routine and more about their lives. Our Indianapolis site is a global hub for blood glucose strip manufacturing and the future home of our next-generation continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) sensors. The Opportunity As a Controls Engineer , you are the technical backbone of our automated production lines. You won’t just be sitting at a desk; you’ll be hands-on with high-speed equipment, ensuring our manufacturing processes are stable, validated, and constantly improving. What You’ll Do
• Optimize & Innovate: Lead the evolution of our automation and electromechanical processes. You’ll use data and operator feedback to make our lines faster, smarter, and more reliable.
• Launch New Tech: Partner with R&D and Process Development to bridge the gap between design and high-volume manufacturing for new product launches.
• Own the Controls: Program, modify, and troubleshoot the "brains" of our machines, ensuring every sensor, motor, and PLC is performing at peak efficiency.
• Manage Quality & Validation: Lead equipment qualifications (IQ/OQ/PQ) and ensure all process changes meet strict regulatory standards without sacrificing production speed.
• Strategic Leadership: Manage multiple project lifecycles, mentor junior staff, and provide expert on-call support to keep our 24/7 operations running smoothly.
• On-Site: Engineers are dedicated to the Indianapolis site. Travel typically < 10%. What You’ll Bring
• PLC & HMI Proficiency: Deep experience with Allen Bradley (RSLogix/Studio 5000) and FactoryTalk View. You are comfortable modifying code to drive continuous improvement.
• The "Troubleshooter" Mindset: Strong knowledge of electromechanical systems, motion controls (Servos/VFDs), Distributed I/O, sensors, and Cognex/Keyence Vision Systems.
• Validation Expertise: Proven ability to develop and execute equipment qualification protocols and write clear, technical documentation.
• Vendor Management: Experience collaborating with external partners to source specialized solutions or navigate component obsolescence.
• Analytical Drive: A highly logical approach to problem-solving, with the ability to run simulations and use test data to make informed decisions. Who You Are
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or closely related discipline with a minimum of 2 years of related experience; advanced degree may substitute for previous experience or equivalent experience
• Related experience must include troubleshooting, modifying, and/or developing industrial equipment controls systems (PLCs, HMIs, Motion Control, etc.) Preferred:
• Familiar with GMP in a regulated environment (Medical Device or Pharmaceutical).
• Strong electro-mechanical skills that can look at the machine from all engineering aspects: mechanical, electrical, and controls.
• Previous experience troubleshooting controls systems of high volume/speed manufacturing equipment.
• Previous training or experience in Process Improvement Methodologies (e.g. LSS, PDCA, etc.).
• Demonstrates excellent interpersonal, communication, and teamwork skills.
• Strong ability to teach and educate key stakeholders and other colleagues.
• Deep commitment to cross-functional collaboration and breaking down silos to achieve the best results for the organization. This is an onsite role in Indianapolis. Relocation benefits are not available. The expected salary range for the Manufacturing

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche Near Patient Care , we create the tools that help people with diabetes think less about their daily routine and more about their lives. Our Indianapolis site is a global hub for blood glucose strip manufacturing and the future home of our next-generation continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) sensors. The Opportunity As a Controls Engineer , you are the technical backbone of our automated production lines. You won’t just be sitting at a desk; you’ll be hands-on with high-speed equipment, ensuring our manufacturing processes are stable, validated, and constantly improving. What You’ll Do
• Optimize & Innovate: Lead the evolution of our automation and electromechanical processes. You’ll use data and operator feedback to make our lines faster, smarter, and more reliable.
• Launch New Tech: Partner with R&D and Process Development to bridge the gap between design and high-volume manufacturing for new product launches.
• Own the Controls: Program, modify, and troubleshoot the "brains" of our machines, ensuring every sensor, motor, and PLC is performing at peak efficiency.
• Manage Quality & Validation: Lead equipment qualifications (IQ/OQ/PQ) and ensure all process changes meet strict regulatory standards without sacrificing production speed.
• Strategic Leadership: Manage multiple project lifecycles, mentor junior staff, and provide expert on-call support to keep our 24/7 operations running smoothly.
• On-Site: Engineers are dedicated to the Indianapolis site. Travel typically < 10%. What You’ll Bring
• PLC & HMI Proficiency: Deep experience with Allen Bradley (RSLogix/Studio 5000) and FactoryTalk View. You are comfortable modifying code to drive continuous improvement.
• The "Troubleshooter" Mindset: Strong knowledge of electromechanical systems, motion controls (Servos/VFDs), Distributed I/O, sensors, and Cognex/Keyence Vision Systems.
• Validation Expertise: Proven ability to develop and execute equipment qualification protocols and write clear, technical documentation.
• Vendor Management: Experience collaborating with external partners to source specialized solutions or navigate component obsolescence.
• Analytical Drive: A highly logical approach to problem-solving, with the ability to run simulations and use test data to make informed decisions. Who You Are
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or closely related discipline with a minimum of 2 years of related experience; advanced degree may substitute for previous experience or equivalent experience
• Related experience must include troubleshooting, modifying, and/or developing industrial equipment controls systems (PLCs, HMIs, Motion Control, etc.) Preferred:
• Familiar with GMP in a regulated environment (Medical Device or Pharmaceutical).
• Strong electro-mechanical skills that can look at the machine from all engineering aspects: mechanical, electrical, and controls.
• Previous experience troubleshooting controls systems of high volume/speed manufacturing equipment.
• Previous training or experience in Process Improvement Methodologies (e.g. LSS, PDCA, etc.).
• Demonstrates excellent interpersonal, communication, and teamwork skills.
• Strong ability to teach and educate key stakeholders and other colleagues.
• Deep commitment to cross-functional collaboration and breaking down silos to achieve the best results for the organization. This is an onsite role in Indianapolis. Relocation benefits are not available. The expected salary range for the Manufacturing

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. At Roche, we are working to make next-generation sequencing simple and accessible enough for routine use. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. From robust sample isolation and preparation tools to novel sequencing technology and advanced bioinformatics, we are developing differentiated, highly integrated end-to-end solutions for next-generation sequencing, resulting in a sample in, result out workflow. Our Verification and Validation team, a part of Roche Sequencing Solutions, is responsible for ensuring a software product meets its specified requirements and performs as intended by rigorously testing and analyzing the software throughout its development lifecycle. As a Principal Software Developer in Test, you will be responsible for test design, development, automation, deployment, execution, and reporting. Specifically, you will develop an integrated hardware-software framework for end-to-end test automation that leverages a third-party Hardware-in-the-Loop solution. In this role, you will represent quality engineering and verification on behalf of your team in all events and activities related to this effort, working closely with software and hardware engineers across multiple global locations. The Opportunity
• You develop solutions for Hardware-in-the-Loop testing for end-to-end testing of embedded instrument software
• You author and confirm correctness of requirements-driven tests, covering aspects including:
• Testing approaches (exploratory, white box, black box, etc.)
• Testing level (end-to-end, system, integration, unit, etc.)
• Testing types (functional, performance, scalability, etc.)
• You automate and execute front-end and back-end tests, covering for:
• Instrument software
• Web applications
• You automate deployment and testing pipelines across branches and stages
• You report quality metrics and enhancing quality dashboards
• You perform root cause analysis of defects and discoveries
• You develop automation frameworks and validate automation toolchains
• You ensure regulatory compliance of quality engineering deliverables
• You partner with Test Architects, Test Leads, and Verification & Validation Leads on practices
• You collaborate with designers, architects, developers, system engineers and testers on product development
• You participate in all development events, and activities and guide junior testing team members as needed
• Technologies which may be utilized : C++, Java, Cucumber (Behavior-Driven Development), Gherkin, Playwright, Windows, Cypress/JDI/Selenium/WebDriver/TestNG, Typescript/Javascript, Angular, Docker, Jenkins, Groovy, Bash, Jira, Github, Confluence, Google Suite, macOS/Linux, MS SQL, Vector HIL Solutions Who You Are
• You have a Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or related. Advanced degree preferred. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered, with three years of experience for each year of missing education
• You have 10+ years related experience or equivalent combination of education and experience with Jav

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We are seeking a Enterprise Identity Management Engineer to serve as a senior primary architect of our Enterprise Identity Management (IGA) future. This is a high-impact, hands-on role where you will design, build, and deliver next-generation identity solutions operating at global scale. Positioned at the intersection of security engineering and business enablement, you'll create resilient frameworks that protect critical systems while enabling seamless, automated access. As a technical visionary, you'll tackle the most complex identity challenges within our large-scale enterprise ecosystem. The Opportunity In this pivotal role, you will act as a primary architect driving the evolution of our Enterprise Identity Management strategy. You'll own the complete technical lifecycle, from designing scalable solutions to delivering resilient implementations across our global infrastructure. Main Responsibilities
• Lead end-to-end technical design of EIM solutions aligned with enterprise standards and security policies
• Define and standardize architecture patterns, best practices, and reusable frameworks
• Conduct design reviews and provide technical governance for scalable, high-quality implementations
• Translate security and business requirements into actionable technical solutions
• Architect, build, test, and deploy SailPoint-based IAM solutions from the ground up
• Deliver resilient identity solutions across complex, distributed environments
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth implementation and production rollout
• Own delivery lifecycle end-to-end, including planning, estimation, timelines, and risk management
• Act as Tier 3 escalation point, leading root cause analysis and long-term fixes
• Drive innovation through PoCs and adoption of modern EIM Integrations (APIs, cloud integrations) Who You Are Core Expertise & Experience
• Minimum of 8 years of hands-on experience in Identity Management within large-scale, global environments.
• 3+ years experience working in a multinational work environment (Healthcare Industry experience a plus) as an Engineer/Technical team member
• Strong customer engagement and presentation skills with the ability to communicate across all levels (senior and/or small audiences)
• Deep technical expertise in SailPoint, specifically in design, custom development, troubleshooting, and architecture.
• Ability to work effectively with team members and virtual teams from different locations and different cultural background
• Ability to function independently with little supervision
• Advanced programming proficiency in Java for developing custom connectors, rules, and complex workflows.
• Proven experience implementing Integration solutions with Active Directory and cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
• Familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps, and modern architecture (APIs, microservices, cloud)
• Strong understanding of RBAC, Segregation of Duties (SoD), and access governance frameworks. Education
• Bachelor’s or Advanced degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or a related Engineering field.
• Professional Information Security certifications (e.g., CISSP) is a plus. If you're an experienced identity architect with deep SailPoint expertise, a passion for solving complex security challenges, and the drive to own end-to-end technical delivery in a multinational environment, we want to hear from you. Relocation benefits are not available for this job posti

The Position As an Automation Intern, you will be part of our Data Science & Automation (D&A) team within the Business Analytics function. This internship is designed as a hands-on learning experience, where you will explore automation technologies, support ongoing initiatives, and contribute fresh ideas to improve how we work. You will gain exposure to real-world business challenges, automation tools, and emerging AI capabilities, while working alongside experienced Business Analysts, Automation Developers, and Business Partners. This role is ideal for someone who is curious about technology, enjoys simplifying complex ideas, and is eager to learn how automation and data-driven solutions can create business impact. You will be part of RSS Business Analytics - a global team with regional presence in Switzerland, India, Costa Rica, Hungary, Latvia and Malaysia. We operate in an agile organizational set-up without extensive hierarchical structure, where all our employees lead from every seat. Inspirational leadership, service oriented behavior and entrepreneurial customer centric mindset are our core values. As part of your 6-month journey, you will have the chance to dive into one or more of these core areas:
• Hands-on Development: Work on internal automation projects using UiPath, Python, or scripting to streamline our own team's workflows.
• MS migration analysis: Research our upcoming move to Microsoft 365, evaluating the effects on existing automations and proposing best practices for a smooth bot migration.
• Solution Strategy & Showcase: Develop an "Automation Toolkit" (decision trees and tool matrices) to match business problems with the right tech (AI vs. RPA). You’ll then bring this to life by curating a digital "Solution Catalogue" to showcase our team’s capabilities and toolkit.
• Ad-hoc Exploration: Stay agile! You’ll support various team initiatives as they arise, giving you a 360-degree view of Business Analytics. Require:
• Basic understanding of programming or scripting concepts
• Familiarity with any language such as Python, JavaScript, or similar (academic or personal projects is sufficient)
• Strong curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies
• Ability to break down complex ideas into simple, structured formats
• Good communication and presentation skills (written and verbal in English) Nice to have (not mandatory)
• Exposure to automation tools (e.g. UiPath, Power Automate, Google Apps Script)
• Experience creating presentations, documentation, or visual content What we offer:
• Mentorship: Regular 1:1s with experienced Data Scientists and Automation Developers.
• Real Impact: Your projects (like the Tool Matrix or Solution Catalogue) will be used by the team long after your internship ends.
• Global Exposure: Experience how a leading healthcare company uses technology to impact patients' lives.
• Flexible Environment: A culture that values "leading from every seat" and prioritizes your development over a rigid job title. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. An exciting opportunity has arisen to take a Medical Enabler role within the Roche Diagnostics Philippines team. The Medical Enabler is a key strategic role that will help identify and address the relevant medical needs of clinical practice, to successfully support the optimal use of Roche diagnostic solutions. In this role, you will provide technical and clinical expertise and advisory to internal and external customers for all Roche Diagnostics products. This role also develops and executes medical initiatives to support medical strategy/medical plan that will drive the growth of the priority products of the affiliate, develops and cultivates strategic relationships with disease area experts and other external influencers and stakeholders, leads KOL development and engagements in a scientific manner, provides medical support on clinical research, data generation and demonstration projects that will drive strategic growth for the affiliate and participates in health authority interactions. Key responsibilities include Development and management of the medical plan
• Align with Commercial Teams: Marketing, Sales and Near Patient Care teams on focused disease areas and products
• Develop local patient journey map and identify diagnostic gaps to position Roche diagnostic solutions
• Align the local medical plan with global medical plan, under the supervision of Head of Access and Medical Affairs Medical expertise and customer insights
• Inspire high levels of medical expertise and a scientific mindset across the affiliate and instil an enabling mindset throughout the affiliate
• Establish and maintain local medical and scientific independence and assurance of medical compliance, ensuring business integrity and company reputation
• Offer expert opinion on scientific medical information to identify and develop effective peer-to-peer relationships to execute our product strategies, while holding high ethical standards, compliance to Roche SOP and local/ international regulations.
• Research, collate, present, and offer data insights related to the dedicated disease area and product(s)
• Manage the integrity and accuracy of scientific and medical data communication both internally and externally for promotional and non-promotional purposes
• Manage Medical Information activities in accordance with regional/ local model, referencing global standard responses
• Develop a customer centricity culture, making sure promotional/ medical/ scientific communications address HCP needs and optimize patient benefit and safety while keeping a fair balance and compliance with regulations and SOPs
• Provide early insights on new products and indications in close collaboration with the Commercial Team KOL development, engagement plan and execution
• Identify and develop scientific relationship with external KOLs/experts who are qualified sources of insight and advice
• Develop and maintain regular contacts with top tier KOLs
• Develop KOL deck on priority and focused disease area
• Ensure that all activities towards external experts/ KOLs are harmonized across the affiliate
• Planning and execution of relevant scientific advisory board and expert meetings
• Conduct of KOL training, scien

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. Are you ready to take your career to the next level with a dynamic and global role? As a Global Product Planner, you will be at the forefront of supply chain management, driving operational excellence and ensuring product availability across our Indianapolis and Mannheim, Germany hubs. You will develop and manage supply plans utilizing both affiliate and statistical forecasts to create accurate and efficient supply chains. By proactively addressing supply and demand planning issues, you will maintain seamless operations and ensure the accuracy and continuous optimization of MRP master data. Leading bottleneck management, allocation, reserve management, and scrap mitigation across the network will be vital components of your role. In this position, you will be the primary point of contact for product supply-related communications with suppliers, regions, business areas, and affiliates. You will guarantee the timely supply of finished goods to regional and local warehouses, aligning with service level agreements (SLAs), and strive to meet customer service objectives at the lowest possible total costs, including distribution, inventory, and write-offs. We are looking for someone with specialized and comprehensive knowledge in supply chain management or a related business area. Your analytical and problem-solving skills will be engaged in varied and complex duties involving research, analysis, and solution development. You will provide expert guidance to department leadership in setting strategic direction and utilize originality and ingenuity in your daily responsibilities and decision-making processes. Applying a wide range of principles, practices, and procedures to navigate more complex and challenging assignments will be crucial. Additionally, your commitment to maintaining and continuously improving the planning objectives and goals through daily actions will be key. This is your opportunity to make a significant impact in a highly professional and strategic role. Join us and contribute to our mission of delivering exceptional service and operational efficiency. Apply now to be part of a global team committed to excellence! The Opportunity
• Supply Planning: Develops global supply plan based on affiliate forecasts and GSC strategic guidance. Delivers supply plans to Manufacturing and supplier partners. Works with external suppliers to ensure agreed plans are met. In case of exception, works with partners to resolve situations with the least disruption to customers. Monitors cycle time, critical batches and the optimization of planning parameter settings to avoid destruction costs or stock outs. Monitors schedule adherence and discusses if below target during Supply Review meetings (S&OP). Monitors system alerts for potential / actual supply issues throughout the global network. Makes recommendations to provide timely resolution with minimum impact to customers: Works with IBL/IPM to define regional/country product allocations in case of bottleneck; Keeps Regions / Affiliates / BAs informed as to potential and actual product bottlenecks.
• Inventory & Product availability management: Manages inventories at global distribution centers to ensure high service level to customers at low

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Deine Abteilung Unser 18-köpfiges Team, bestehend aus Analytikern, Projektleitern und Gruppenleiter im Bereich der chemischen und biochemischen Analytik, freut sich auf tatkräftige Unterstützung von einem hilfsbereiten und flexiblen neuen Teammitglied. Du solltest Spaß an neuen Herausforderungen haben und Dich in unsere positive Arbeitsatmosphäre einfügen. Wir möchten Dir als Praktikant (m/w/d) einen Einblick in das „ daily business “ in der Abteilung Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT) geben. Dabei wirst Du auch die Möglichkeit haben, Dich selbstständig mit Projektarbeiten zu befassen, um bestehende Prozesse zu optimieren. Deine Aufgaben
• Unterstützung unserer Projektarbeiten im Bereich Design Transfer & Product Care
• Analytik von chemischen, biochemischen und biologischen Einsatzstoffen im diagnostischen Umfeld Dein Profil
• Du bist aktuell in einem naturwissenschaftlichen Studium (Bachelor oder Master in Chemie / Biochemie / Molekularbiologie / Lebensmittelchemie / Life Science oder vergleichbar) immatrikuliert oder Du befindest Dich in Deinem Gap-Year
• Du bringst Kenntnisse in der chemischen und/oder biochemischen Analytik mit
• Du bist motiviert, neugierig und möchtest Deine Ideen einbringen
• solide Deutschkenntnisse sind erforderlich Deine Vorteile
• Flexible Zeiteinteilung
• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum > 3 Monate
• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden (online/offline)
• Ermäßigte Preise (-50 %) in unserer Kantine
• Fitnessstudio auf dem Roche Campus
• Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und spannende Gastvorträge
• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boardinghaus
• Gut organisierte Verkehrsanbindung nach München mit unserem Roche-Shuttle Deine Bewerbung Denke daran, daß sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation während des gesamten Zeitraums des Praktikums richtet oder alternativ an Personen in einem maximal einjährigen Gap-Year (zwischen Bachelor und Master Studium), wo es schriftlich nachgewiesen werden kann, auf welcher Universität/Hochschule und genau wann (Monat/Jahr) innerhalb eines Jahres die Studien fortgesetzt werden. Beachte bitte, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten, etc.) ausgeschlossen sind. Zeitraum : ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung für die Dauer von 6 Monaten Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Your contact to us! With people. For people. Do you need further support? Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Job Description: Join our Innovation Hub to pioneer the next generation of AI-driven pharmaceutical solutions. Unlike a traditional data role, this internship focuses on bridging the gap between cutting-edge LLM (Large Language Model) research and practical healthcare applications. Key Responsibilities:
• Full-Stack AI Development: Architect and build AI-driven applications from the ground up.
• Cloud Architecture & Publishing: Take ownership of the deployment process. You will containerize applications and publish them to Cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) , ensuring they are accessible and scalable.
• Database Management: Design and implement basic data storage architectures to handle application state, session memory, and knowledge retrieval.
• End-to-End Ownership: Monitor the live application, troubleshoot cloud environment issues, and iterate on model performance independently.
• Technical Translation: Work with stakeholders to refine project requirements and ensure the final product meets pharmaceutical industry standards. Required Skills and Qualifications:
• You are a self-starter, independent & highly motivated.
• Internship Duration: Capability to commit to a 6-month full-time internship (highly preferred).
• AI Solution Engineering: Proven ability to build an AI application from scratch (Portfolio/GitHub evidence of independent projects is highly preferred).
• Technical Proficiencies: Strong hands-on experience with Python
• Database Basics: Understanding of how to store and retrieve data from a database (e.g., NoSQL, Vector DBs, or simple Cloud Storage)
• AI Fundamentals: Familiarity with LLM architectures, API integrations, and the basics of Natural Language Processing (NLP).
• Software Engineering Basics: Familiarity with Git for version control and the SDLC.
• Education: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or Software Engineering, or a related field. What We Offer:
• End-to-End Project Ownership: You won’t just be assisting; you will be the lead developer of your assigned project, responsible for its architecture and success.
• Production Experience: A rare opportunity to see your "from-scratch" builds published and running in an enterprise-grade cloud environment.
• Corporate Working Environment @ a leading MNC : You will be part of a qualified and engaged professional team and organization where you will experience corporate culture at the intersection of healthcare industry and digital innovation in a globally leading pharma company Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Team Lead Engineering Dati commerciali A Roche, crediamo che ogni individuo possa fare la differenza. Stiamo cercando un Team Lead Engineering Commercial Data per unire il nostro team in un ruolo che siede all'incrocio di eccellenza ingegneristica e impatto aziendale. In questa posizione, guiderai e cresci team di ingegneria dati e analisi altamente performanti per fornire soluzioni scalabili, affidabili e business-critical che supportano il processo decisionale commerciale attraverso vendite, marketing, prezzi e coinvolgimento dei clienti. L’area Commercial Data, Analytics e AI supporta il Servizio, Marketing, Vendite e Operazioni Commerciali attraverso l’organizzazione globale di Roche Diagnostics, consentendo il processo decisionale e l’eccellenza operativa in scala. L'area abbraccia team globali, regionali e di livello nazionale e copre una vasta gamma di attività commerciali, tra cui l'impegno del cliente, l'efficacia delle vendite, le prestazioni del servizio, i prezzi, la gestione delle basi installate e l'ottimizzazione operativa. Operando in un ambiente globale altamente regolamentato, la funzione Commercial Data & Analytics collabora a stretto contatto con i team di piattaforme aziendali, IT, Digital e Central Data & AI per fornire fondazioni di dati affidabili, analisi e informazioni AI-enabled. Le soluzioni sono progettate per essere scalabili, conformi e riutilizzabili in tutti i mercati, pur rimanendo abbastanza flessibili per soddisfare le esigenze locali. Fornendo prodotti di dati affidabili, funzionalità di analisi e approfondimenti avanzati, l'area svolge un ruolo fondamentale nel migliorare l'efficacia commerciale, la qualità del servizio e l'esperienza del cliente, supportando infine la missione di Roche Diagnostics di fornire soluzioni diagnostiche innovative ai pazienti in tutto il mondo. L'opportunità:
• Guidare e sviluppare team di ingegneria di dati e analisi altamente performanti, favorendo una cultura di eccellenza tecnica, responsabilità e crescita professionale continua.
• Capacità di ingegneria scala per supportare diversi casi di uso commerciale in Servizi, Marketing, Vendite e Operazioni attraverso la modellazione e la trasformazione dei dati moderni.
• Guidare gli standard tecnici, stabilendo e rafforzando le migliori pratiche per lo sviluppo basato su dbt, CI/CD, test automatizzati e documentazione completa.
• Coinvolgere i dati a bordo come servizio per consentire un'ingestione efficiente, standardizzata e scalabile di nuove fonti di dati, mantenendo al contempo una stretta sicurezza e governance.
• Progettazione di robuste condotte che alimentano soluzioni di analisi avanzate e AI/ML, assicurando che tutti i dataset siano di qualità produttiva e "AI-ready" per i team di scienza a valle.
• Collaborare con i team di piattaforma per allineare le soluzioni di dati commerciali con l'architettura aziendale, garantendo il riutilizzo delle funzionalità della piattaforma e evitando duplicazioni degli strumenti .
• Gestire la consegna del team su base giornaliera, traducendo complessi requisiti commerciali in livelli di analisi affidabili e prodotti di analisi ad alto impatto.
• Artigianato di ingegneria campione esaminando i progetti tecnici e guidando il vostro team verso decisioni architettoniche mantenuti, convenienti e scalabili. Chi sei:
• Leader esperto: Possiedi 5+ anni di esperienza nella leadership dell'ingegneria dei dati o nell'architettura, con una comprovata traccia di costruzione di team di alto livello.
• Esperto del settore: Portate 2+ anni di esperienza all'interno del settore farmaceutico, biotecnologico o della tecnologia sanitaria regolamentata per navigare complesse esigenze di conformità.

• Mit Plattformteams zusammenarbeiten, um kommerzielle Datenlösungen mit der Unternehmensarchitektur auszurichten, um die Wiederverwendung von Plattformfunktionen zu gewährleisten und die Werkzeugvervielfältigung zu vermeiden.
