Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chef d'équipe Ingénierie Données commerciales Chez Roche, nous croyons que chaque individu peut faire la différence. Nous cherchons une équipe responsable de l'ingénierie Données commerciales pour rejoindre notre équipe dans un rôle qui se situe à l'intersection de l'excellence en génie et de l'impact commercial. Dans cette position, vous dirigerez et développerez des équipes d'ingénierie de données et d'analyse à haut rendement pour fournir des solutions évolutives, fiables et critiques pour les affaires qui soutiennent la prise de décision commerciale à travers les ventes, le marketing, les prix et l'engagement des clients. Le secteur des données commerciales, de l'analyse et de l'intelligence artificielle soutient l'organisation mondiale des services, du marketing, des ventes et des opérations commerciales dans l'ensemble de Roche Diagnostics. La zone s'étend aux équipes mondiales, régionales et nationales et couvre un large éventail d'activités commerciales, y compris l'engagement des clients, l'efficacité des ventes, la performance des services, les prix, la gestion de base installée et l'optimisation opérationnelle. Opérant dans un environnement mondial hautement réglementé, la fonction Commercial Data & Analytics s'associe étroitement aux équipes de plateformes commerciales, informatiques, numériques et centrales de Data & AI pour fournir des bases de données fiables, des analyses et des informations adaptées à l'IA. Les solutions sont conçues pour être évolutives, conformes et réutilisables sur tous les marchés, tout en restant suffisamment souples pour répondre aux besoins locaux. En fournissant des produits de données fiables, des capacités d'analyse et des informations avancées, la région joue un rôle essentiel dans l'amélioration de l'efficacité commerciale, de la qualité du service et de l'expérience client, soutenant finalement la mission de Roche Diagnostics pour fournir des solutions diagnostiques innovantes aux patients dans le monde entier. La possibilité :
• Diriger et développer des équipes d'ingénierie de données et d'analyse à haut rendement, favorisant une culture d'excellence technique, de responsabilité et de croissance professionnelle continue.
• Capacités d'ingénierie à l'échelle pour soutenir divers cas d'utilisation commerciale dans les services, le marketing, les ventes et les opérations par la modélisation et la transformation de données modernes.
• Conduire les normes techniques en établissant et en appliquant les meilleures pratiques pour le développement basé sur le DBT, le CI/CD, les tests automatisés et la documentation complète.
• Evolver les données à bord en tant que service permettant une ingestion efficace, normalisée et évolutive de nouvelles sources de données tout en maintenant une sécurité et une gouvernance strictes.
• Concevoir des pipelines robustes qui alimentent l'analyse avancée et les solutions AI/ML, en veillant à ce que tous les ensembles de données soient de qualité de production et « prêts à l'AI » pour les équipes scientifiques en aval.
• Collaborer avec les équipes de plate-forme pour aligner les solutions de données commerciales sur l'architecture d'entreprise, en assurant la réutilisation des capacités de la plate-forme et en évitant la duplication des outils.
• Gérer la prestation de l'équipe au quotidien, en traduisant des exigences commerciales complexes en couches d'analyse fiables et en produits à fort impact.
• Métier d'ingénierie champion en examinant les conceptions techniques et en guidant votre équipe vers des décisions architecturales durables, rentables et évolutives. Qui vous êtes :
• Leader expérimenté : vous possédez 5 ans d'expérience dans le leadership ou l'architecture de l'ingénierie des données, avec une expérience éprouvée de la construction d'équipes performantes.
• Expert de l'industrie: Vous apportez 2+ ans d'expérience au sein de l'industrie pharmaceutique, de la biotechnologie, ou de la technologie de santé réglementée pour naviguer les besoins de conformité complexes.
• Formellement formé: vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat ou d'un diplôme avancé en informatique ou d'un diplôme similaire f

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Integration Governance Expert is responsible for defining, implementing, and continuously improving governance frameworks for enterprise integrations, including APIs, event-driven architectures, and AI-driven and A2A integrations. This role ensures that integrations are discoverable, reusable, compliant, high-quality, and AI-ready through effective management of metadata, schemas, and standards. You will drive governance practices across integration platforms, enabling consistent design, implementation, and lifecycle management of integration assets. The Opportunity:
• Lead the evolution of integration governance frameworks across APIs, events, and AI-driven systems to ensure enterprise-wide scalability.
• Drive schema governance by designing, versioning, and validating standards such as OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, and JSON Schema to maintain high-quality assets.
• Shape the integration strategy aligned with global digital, data, and AI goals, promoting metadata-driven approaches for maximum reuse.
• Ensure AI-readiness by implementing semantically structured metadata and schemas that support advanced analytics and automation.
• Collaborate with architects and engineers to align on governance standards, providing the enablement needed for consistent global practices.
• Resolve complex integration challenges by performing root cause analysis and debugging issues to improve overall landscape compliance.
• Maximize discoverability of integration assets, ensuring they are well-documented and easily accessible across multiple platforms and domains.
• Operate as a Subject Matter Expert in metadata management, balancing strategic design with practical implementation across MCP interactions. Who you are:
• Experienced professional with a proven track record in integration engineering, architecture, or governance roles within complex enterprise environments.
• Educated specialist holding a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
• Technical expert with advanced knowledge of API design (REST, SOAP, microservices) and management practices.
• Systems architect with strong experience in event-driven architectures, messaging systems, and metadata management (APIs, events, MCP).
• Standardization advocate with expertise in schema governance, lifecycle management, and quality assessment through validation and observability.
• Tech-savvy collaborator familiar with DevOps, CI/CD, and hands-on experience in Mulesoft, Solace, IBM Sterling, or SAP IS.
• Strategic influencer possessing excellent communication skills to engage stakeholders and drive improvement without direct authority. • Drive schema governance by designing, versioning, and validating standards such as OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, and JSON Schema to maintain high-quality assets.

• Resolve complex integration challenges by performing root cause analysis and debugging issues to improve overall landscape compliance.

• Educated specialist holding a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
• Technical expert with advanced knowledge of API design (REST, SOAP, microservices) and management practices.
• Systems architect with strong experience in event-driven architectures, messaging systems, and metadata management (APIs, events, MCP).
• Standardization advocate with expertise in schema governance, lifecycle management, and quality assessment through validation and observability.
• Tech-savvy collaborator familiar with DevOps, CI/CD, and hands-on experience in Mulesoft, Solace, IBM Sterling, or SAP IS.
• Strategic influencer possessing excellent communication skills to engage stakeholders and drive improvement without direct authority. A Roche Diagnóstica, líder mundial em diagnósticos in vitro, dedica-se a soluções de diagnóstico laboratorial. Atuamos para oferecer produtos e serviços exclusivos, além de testes inovadores para pesquisadores, médicos, paciente s, hospitais e laboratórios. A Oportunidade:
• Suporte local (supervisionado): Atuação em Soluções de Informação na resolução de problemas em clientes, realizando o escalonamento de casos para níveis superiores (Especialistas, Latam/GCS), quando necessário.

• Análise e Investigação: Investigação de problemas através da coleta e análise de dados, além da documentação e compreensão de demandas.
• Comunicação: Elaboração de relatórios, apresentações (PPT) e comunicações orais para o compartilhamento de informações técnicas.
• Compliance: Apoio às iniciativas da afiliada para reforçar nossa cultura de conformidade, atuando de forma ética e respeitando o Código de Conduta. Requerimentos:
• Formação: Cursando graduação em áreas relacionadas à TI (Ciências da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software e correlatos).
• Idiomas: Inglês ou Espanhol em nível intermediário a avançado.
• Autonomia: Capacidade de desenvolver o trabalho sem supervisão constante. Sobre você: Buscamos um perfil analítico, ágil e resolutivo. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Who we are The internal value chain (IVC) for digital solutions team is acting as a linking pin across the organization to support global lifecycle teams and affiliates in the commercialization of digital solutions. The team is working on building the backoffice foundations for a successful digital business, along the customer journey “Subscribe-to-retire” digital products. The team provides the organization with fit-for-digital operational processes, innovative technology, analytics and global services. Responsabilities
• The position is part of the Internal Value Chain for Digital Solutions and integrated into the IVC Services Chapter
• Perform daily operational business services for digital products
• Collaborate with and provide services to lifecycle teams and affiliates
• Improve and standardize service processes for digital products
• Perform quality checks and measure service maturity
• Safeguard best-in-class operational support for our internal customers
• Provide project support focusing on the Services Responsibility of Operational Services for Lifecycle Teams
• Support product lifecycle teams with day-to-day operational back office processes:
• Material master data management: global master data creation and maintenance in DMS for digital products and services; maintenance of material master extension workflows for operations sites; support in the regional affiliates SAP systems
• Digital products access management: maintain unique form and process for affiliates to request access to cloud-based products; create and maintain admin/user accounts for end-customers; reconcile and extend/terminate accounts based on license agreements
• 3rd party management: execute ordering of integration services from 3rd party supplier per product; coordination and tracking of all steps / stakeholders involved in the process
• UDI & labeling: manage the E2E process for UDI and labeling, work with LCTs to gather all relevant information, create templates and submit data packages Responsibility of Operational Services for Affiliates
• Support affiliates with day-to-day operational back office processes
• Customer-related activities: regular monitoring of the process designed for digital products & services; training of the affiliates; execution of centralized services such as equipment creation
• First level support: support process execution in SAP/REXIS and other linked systems; monitoring of generic support mailbox; train selected key users
• Global commercial backoffice: generation of commercial documents in related systems, such as contracts, equipments, scheduling agreements
• Service quality measurement: calculate KPIs and perform quality checks to ensure effective and efficient service according to the agreed SLAs Responsibility of IVC Project Support
• Support the transformation of current operations to a global, centralized service organization
• Adapt new ways of working in an agile project environment
• Document processes and procedures for business services
• Support training and testing phases
• Identify improvement potential for effective & efficient service operations Who you are:
• Bachelor in Business Economics and / or Business Informatics / Information Technology and / or any corresponding study or practical experience
• Master’s degree preferred
• Fluent in English, additional languages beneficial Skills / Experience:
• Min 1-3 years of professional experience in:
• Commercial and/or finance functions
• Business pr

title: Data and Systems Analyst - Product Performance

titleByLocale.it: Data and Systems Analista - Product Performance
titleByLocale.en: Data and Systems Analyst - Product Performance
titleByLocale.de: Data and Systems Analyst - Product Performance
titleByLocale.fr: Data and Systems Analyste - Product Performance

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Doing now what patients need next. Near Patient Care is committed to helping people with diabetes everywhere in the world think less about their daily diabetes routine, so they can get true relief, day and night. We offer a broad portfolio of solutions for both people with diabetes and their professionals - from blood glucose monitoring to information management to continuous glucose monitoring. Our aim is to offer innovative products, services and comprehensive solutions for convenient, efficient and effective diabetes management. The Opportunity As a Data and Systems Analyst, you will be a vital driver of digital excellence within the Near Patient Care Indianapolis Product Performance team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between high-tech manufacturing and IT infrastructure, taking ownership of commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) applications and driving the automation of our production processes. This is an ideal opportunity for a proactive, analytical problem-solver who enjoys working independently to investigate cutting-edge technical solutions, while seamlessly collaborating with cross-functional and global networks to turn complex manufacturing data into actionable business intelligence. What You Do
• Individual will assist the Near Patient Care Indianapolis Manufacturing Product Performance team manage software applications relevant to our manufacturing processes.
• You develop reports and other visualization techniques and analyze and interpret data to provide recommendations for process improvements
• You work independently to learn and investigate solutions; while also capable of collaborating and learning from other team members
• You exchange technical information with employees from other sites and form a network.
• Administer COTS applications to ensure proper execution and performance
• May interact with IT teams regarding technologies such as: Active Directory, Windows Server, SQL, Oracle, VMWare, Cisco switches and firewalls
• Use ServiceNow for incident management and change management
• You will attend, support and/or plan team meetings and workshops to build and maintain an understanding of ongoing activities and projects
• You will investigate and drive further automation and simplification of current processes
• You will support teams to manage complex system structures and interfaces Competencies:
• Experience successfully managing medium to large scale improvement projects and in successfully interacting with all levels of the organization
• Ability to effectively negotiate and influence others
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Ability to effectively communicate complex technical problems to both technical and non-technical audiences
• Ability to multitask, prioritize and be detail-oriented
• Ability to work well in a self-managed or team environment
• Strong analytical thinking and problem solving mindset Who You Are
• Bachelor’s degree in Math, Engineering, IT or related field
• Proficient with SAS or other data analysis and visualization tools (e.g. R, R shiny)
• 3+ years professional experience in a related field; OR 1 year with a Master’s degree Preferred
• Familiarity with ServiceNow
• Knowledge of laboratory data systems and quality analytics
• Strong understanding of networking concepts (VLAN’s, SNMP, subnets, switches, firewalls)
• Proven troubleshooting skills in a manufacturing context This is an onsite role in Indianapolis. Relocation benefits are not available. The expe

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que membre de l'équipe du Réseau mondial des patients (GPN) au sein du département Développement de produits médicaux (PDMA) de Roche, le Patient Insights & Analytics Lead est un rôle central qui sert dans toute la chaîne de valeur Pharma de la R-D à la commercialisation. En tant que membre principal de l'équipe d'activation du réseau au GPN, vous servirez de moteur fondamental pour la gestion des connaissances des patients et la mesure de leur impact sur les principales décisions d'affaires en fournissant les systèmes, les cadres et les principes de gestion des connaissances essentiels nécessaires au GPN pour obtenir des résultats pertinents à l'échelle mondiale. En s'assurant que les connaissances des patients sont FAIR (fichables, accessibles, interopérables, réutilisables), quantifiées, comprises et intégrées aux processus d'affaires de Roche, vous faciliterez des partenariats significatifs et interfonctionnels qui auront un impact tangible pour les patients, tout en permettant le succès de notre entreprise. La position
• KPI Framework & Value Narrative: mettre en œuvre un cadre de mesure de KPI, recueillir des données et développer un récit solide démontrant la valeur tangible et l'impact de l'intégration des connaissances des patients dans les décisions clés de l'entreprise
• Affiliate Metric Alignement: Input et façonner les cadres d'affiliation KPI, connectant avec succès les paramètres mondiaux et locaux, dans la mesure du possible
• Insights & CRM Infrastructure: concevoir, déployer et gérer des outils internes qui permettent une gestion rationalisée des intervenants et des connaissances afin de permettre des gains d'efficacité dans la façon dont les entreprises clés fonctionnent l'accès et d'appliquer les connaissances des patients dans leur travail
• Intégration des outils : intégrer et gérer les outils de collecte et de gestion des connaissances utilisés par le GPN dans les solutions à l'échelle de l'entreprise, en alignant l'approche avec les approches/principes plus larges de l'AGPD
• Benchmarking externe: maintenir le contrôle des initiatives et des plateformes de benchmarking externe pour s'assurer que Roche est bien représentée, en générant des données d'impact qui peuvent être intégrées dans des cadres internes pour raconter une histoire complète de l'impact de Roches sur et de la réputation auprès des patients
• Gestion stratégique des parties prenantes : naviguer dans un environnement complexe et matriciel pour intégrer les outils de gestion des connaissances des patients dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise, en réunissant les infrastructures mondiales et locales pour offrir une approche « One Roche » Qui vous êtes
• 5 ans et plus d'expérience éprouvée dans la fourniture de solutions complexes d'analyse/de connaissances dans une organisation matricielle avec une présence mondiale et régionale (expérience de travail avec des données sur les patients et des informations hautement valorisées)
• Haute compétence dans l'élaboration de mesures et de récits validés qui prouvent la valeur commerciale de l'inclusivité du patient de bout en bout.
• Expertise éprouvée dans la conception, la mise en œuvre et la gestion de plateformes et de solutions sur un réseau mondial.
• Forte capacité d'interagir avec les dirigeants internes et de collaborer efficacement avec les fonctions juridiques, de conformité, de communication, d'analyse de marché et autres fonctions commerciales.
• Capacité de diriger des projets ou des initiatives qui vont au-delà des idées et des analyses pour aider à orienter les priorités de l'équipe, au besoin.
• L'intelligence émotionnelle et l'influence efficace des compétences pour aligner les parties prenantes, renforcer la confiance et promouvoir des solutions mutuellement précieuses.
• Les candidats doivent avoir une maîtrise native ou quasi native en anglais professionnel des affaires (écrit et parlé)
• L'emploi nécessite un minimum de voyage (10-15 %) et une flexibilité d'horaire pour desservir les fuseaux horaires mondiaux Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'endroit principal est Bâle. Si vous êtes intéressé par additio

Darüber hinaus übernimmst du folgende spannende Aufgaben:

Cependant, nous tenons à souligner que les deux sites – Mannheim et Penzberg – sont pris en compte de manière égale. L'objectif est de trouver la personne la plus appropriée pour le rôle, quel que soit le lieu de travail. Nous en EFG Sur le site Management Mannheim/Penzberg, nous sommes bien 1'300 spécialistes pour une large gamme d'infrastructures et de services professionnels qui les fournissent pour les sites Mannheim et Penzberg. Dans un environnement dynamique, nous promouvons une coopération transparente entre les secteurs d'activité et les fonctions, proposons des solutions innovantes et améliorons l'environnement de travail des employés des lieux de Mannheim et de Penzberg, où nous façonnons activement l'avenir. La nouvelle structure organisationnelle Dans cette fonction, vous faites partie des Opérations du Site et appartenez à Team Soft Services. La nouvelle structure organisationnelle se trouve également sur le site GSite . Responsabilités Vous vous attendez Dans le rôle Vous êtes responsable du développement stratégique et de la gestion opérationnelle de notre flotte. Vous conduisez la transformation vers des solutions de mobilité durables, assurant une rentabilité et agissant comme un spécialiste pour les acteurs internes et les partenaires externes. De plus, vous assumerez les tâches passionnantes suivantes :
• Développement stratégique de la flotte: Vous façonnez l'avenir de notre mobilité en conduisant l'électrification de la flotte et en mettant en œuvre des concepts innovants et durables. Vous encouragez activement la communication avec les intervenants et les partenaires afin d'optimiser la gestion de la flotte.
• Gestion du cycle de vie: Vous contrôlez indépendamment l'ensemble du cycle du véhicule – de l'approvisionnement stratégique à la gestion de la location à la fiscalité.
• Analyse des coûts et des données : Vous répondez aux décisions fondées sur les données. Il vous donne le plaisir d'analyser des données complexes (p. ex. TCO, profils d'utilisation), de les traduire en feuilles de route stratégiques et de guider les mesures d'optimisation des coûts.
• Gestion des fournisseurs: Vous agissez comme un contact central pour le leasing et les OEM, négociez les conditions-cadres et fournissez un réseau résilient dans l'industrie de la mobilité électronique.
• Politique et conformité : Vous élaborez la Politique sur les voitures (Politique sur les conditions), vous assurez la conformité aux exigences légales et vous conseillez les intervenants internes sur des questions complexes.
• Gestion de projet: Vous réalisez des projets transfrontaliers pour optimiser l'infrastructure de mobilité et inspirer les parties prenantes pour les processus de changement nécessaires. Qualités Ça t'amène.
• Vous avez obtenu un diplôme universitaire (par exemple BWL, génie économique) ou une formation commerciale/technique pertinente avec de nombreuses années de formation spécialisée en gestion de flotte.
• Vous apportez une vaste expérience professionnelle (Richtwert: 3-5 ans avec Master, 4-6 ans avec Bachelor) en logistique ou en gestion de flotte.
• Vous avez une vaste expertise dans la gestion des processus de location et de flotte et idéalement un réseau profond dans l'industrie de la mobilité électronique.
• Vous êtes caractérisé par une compréhension prononcée des chiffres, une réflexion stratégique et une véritable passion pour la mobilité durable.

L'unità comprende un servizio piquet (se necessario). Il sito richiede disponibilità per il normale orario di lavoro, così come il lavoro a turni in funzionamento a 2 turni, funzionamento a 3 turni (continuo) e funzionamento a 5 turni (completamente continuo nel modello 6/4). • rimediare alle perturbazioni a sistemi altamente automatizzati (supporto di primo livello). Rilevamento, analisi e valutazione dei difetti degli impianti

Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. As part of the Project Management Chapter, the Global Project Manager (GPM) plays a key role in optimized product delivery and is accountable for all project management aspects of various projects from simple to complex in nature. Drives the project/product from the original concept through completion by developing and directing detailed work plans, schedules, project estimates, spending, resource plans, and status reports. As a trusted advisor, the Global Project Manager translates and drives projects into products and enables the organization to use energy and time effectively and efficiently while quickly responding to changing business needs across the portfolio. The Opportunity:
• You will own project/program/product structures for Companion Diagnostics (CDx) product development & product care activities including communication management, timelines, resource and budget plans, progress and cost control, and risk management.
• You will create, coordinate, and maintain integrated project plans including dependencies, resources and budgets, allowing the teams to work efficiently and effectively. You are accountable for quality implementation in projects in the following areas: Project risk management; Critical path analysis; Scenario creation and analysis; Budget; Robust planning.
• You will proactively own and drive integrated project plans including dependencies, resources and budgets allowing the teams to work efficiently and effectively.
• You will execute project management processes including guiding and managing preparation for milestone reviews, capacity reviews (cQCR, SCR & fQCR), etc., as applicable & may lead improvement initiatives. You will follow best practices in project/product teams and foster continuous improvement by sharing best practices and knowledge among peers.
• You will select project methodology and apply agile methods as appropriate, including coaching and guiding teams in project methodology, including agile practices (with Project/Program Leads or PMC management if appropriate). You have expertise in working in a hybrid Agile role, combining Agile methods (usually within the project/product team) with non-Agile techniques (usually needed with partners and some functions).
• You will establish, measure, and report the Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), standard metrics, Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) or Outcome Based Planning (OBPs) key results for projects enabling teams and functions to measure and improve quality, efficiency and effectiveness.
• You will act as a trusted advisor with a 360° view on all levels to advise and support the project/product teams as well as the broader organization in the holistic planning; project risk management; scenario creation as well as critical path analysis with the aim to ensure an optimized value delivery. You will serve as a single point of contact & control for project and program data collected from the functions.
• You will lead project team meetings and foster knowledge sharing between project/product teams and sub-chapters to enhance project effectiveness and optimized delivery.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position This role leads the design and implementation of the supply chain and ordering strategy for some of our most strategic accounts. It operates at the intersection of the customers’ supply chain priorities, internal operational excellence, and technological innovation. You will serve as the bridge between complex technical solutions and our clients' operational realities, transforming customer requirements into proactive, market-leading supply chain solutions. The Opportunity Coordinates, monitors and maintains oversight of material supply for strategic large customer accounts. Defines and recommends initiatives for continuous improvement and best practice implementation focused on creating value added solutions through collaboration with key internal business areas and internal/external program stakeholders. Coordinates and applies the fundamental concepts, practices and procedures of the particular field of specialization. Represents the large customer supply team through external, customer facing opportunities. Does not typically supervise people but may have significant responsibility for process and oversight of day to-day operations. Requires in depth knowledge of various processes and functions. Generally, requires an advanced education or training, plus experience with a minimum of 2 supply chain functions such as supply planning, demand planning, order management, warehousing or transportation. Direct customer facing experience preferred.
• Balances the voice of the customer with supply chain objectives to deliver a market leading customer experience.
• Coordinates with internal and external stakeholders to develop and execute strategies which create value added solutions.
• Builds strong internal and external partnerships to deliver on supply chain objectives, strategy and measures.
• Direct order-to-invoice support including the ability to partner with strategic customers to facilitate solutions that deliver operational excellence from order placement to delivery.
• Leads/Participates in process improvement initiatives including optimizing the customer journey touchpoints. Develops or assists in the creation of departmental protocols. May assist in training and mentoring support staff.
• Ability to translate business processes into strategic value stream opportunities that directly impact the customer experience.
• Executes and manages support functions and databases (Customer by Demand Report, Open Orders, SAP, and others as needed).
• Executes reporting. Supports requests for information regarding customer performance, volume, inventory and other inquiries. This position is based out of the Indianapolis Roche site and onsite presence needed. Who You Are
• You hold a Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of two (2) years of relevant business experience.
• Experience with supply chain functions (e.g., supply planning, demand planning, order management, warehousing, or transportation).
• Direct customer-facing experience in a consulting, advisory, or strategic support role is preferred.
• Hands-on experience or working knowledge of AI, automation, and continuous improvement consulting is highly preferred. Behaviors, competencies, and qualities of the ideal Strategic Customer Support Consultant
• Strong computer and analytical skills with competence in both Microsoft and Google Suites, SAP applications, and Smartsheet.
• Strong communication skills (oral and written), including presentation skills, collaborative problem solving, and analytical

The Position Payroll, Time, Benefits Specialist Position summary The Payroll, Time & Benefits Team focuses on payroll, benefits, absence management, customer service and advisory support to employees, manager and business partners ensuring end-to-end process completion in line with customer focused principles to ensure the Roche People Practices work for the business. As a Payroll, Time & Benefits Specialist, you are responsible for executing HR system data maintenance and administrative activities in a timely and accurate manner, in support of P&C business processes in the area of payroll, tax, social insurance, time, and several local and global benefits. etc. You are also contributing to the continuous improvement of the P&C People Support Solutions delivery through analysis of the interactions and collaboration with other P&C functions within and outside of P&C People Support Solutions. You need a broad understanding across local HR processes and tools, as well as local and global downstream impacts on employee lifecycle management, finance, procurement, IT, etc. This is coupled with strong customer focus, communication skills and solution orientation. Responsibilities ● Service Delivery
• Execute system data maintenance and administrative activities in support of P&C business processes in the area of payroll, tax, social insurance, time, several local and global benefits administration, etc. (details refer to the country service catalog)
• Provide customer service on pay, time and benefits related activities, such as inquiry resolution, request management, and troubleshooting.
• Understand and have working knowledge of local time/absence policies.
• Correspondence with managers and leaders to confirm accuracy of employee time/absence entry.
• Manage, process and reconcile mass upload files for all pay frequencies.
• Monitor data flows to/from Workday to Vendor for accuracy
• Ensure integrations are processed timely and resolve any errors ensuring accurately processed
• Ensure regulatory compliance in line with the countries, customers, and regulations.
• Develop and manage key stakeholder relationships and communications to partner in a proactive and customer outcomes focused way.
• Supports P&C Chapters in system maintenance activities.
• Provide guidance and advisory to first level P&C support teams.
• Be up to date on processes, own the knowledge development on processes, and contribute to the update of relevant documentations (KA, SWIs).
• Participating in project activities as required
• Ensure consistent and reliable service delivery for customers serviced.
• Implement processes and initiatives to ensure continuous improvement as well as service enhancement.
• Ensure end to end ownership of resolution
• Ensure operations according to defined KPIs and ServiceNow OKRs.
• Support country non-PTB activities upon the business needs if applicable. ● Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Build relationships with P&C colleagues as well as with customers to ensure ongoing service delivery effectiveness.

The Position Job description The IT Technical Analyst for ServiceNow IRM focuses on assisting with requirement gathering, supporting project objectives, and performing routine data analysis under the guidance of more experienced analysts. In this entry-level role, you will operate within well-defined, routine tasks, focusing on continuous learning and applying core business analysis principles. By supporting the delivery of clearly documented requirements and assisting with problem definition, you will build foundational skills while contributing to the design of specific IT solution features. Description of the area Job Responsibilities
• Scope / (Content Leadership): Operates within well-defined, routine tasks under close supervision, with a primary focus on continuous learning and adherence to established business analysis principles, frameworks, and standards. Executes work within existing templates and processes, proactively seeking clarification and collaborating effectively with team members to build confidence and capability.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Supports senior Analysts and Solution Architects in analyzing technical problems within a defined scope, contributing to problem definition, and identifying potential root causes under guidance. Elicits and clarifies stakeholder needs, analyzes and maps requirements, and assists in identifying and presenting basic solutions. Accountable for the timely completion and quality of assigned discrete tasks and delivering clearly documented requirements.
• Stakeholder Management: Identifies primary team members and internal stakeholders within a project, interacting closely with agile team members working on IT solutions. Acts as a supportive communicator and information gatherer, assisting in preparing basic project updates, capturing stakeholder feedback, and clarifying basic requirements on small, well-defined engagements.
• Impact/Strategy: Focuses on participation, observation, and learning to understand foundational objectives and their relevance. Makes foundational contributions to project objectives while learning how they align with broader goals.
• Complexity / (Product Size): Works typically on a single solution level, supporting the analysis and documentation of requirements for specific features or functionalities. Demonstrates the ability to analyze individual solution components and understands the basic impacts of changes within this limited scope.
• Business / Technical ability: Exhibits a basic understanding and application of tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis. Possesses a foundational understanding of the relevant business or technical domain and supporting technologies. Qualifications Education / Experience
• Entry-level experience with a focus on assisting with requirement gathering, supporting project objectives, and performing routine data analysis under guidance.
• Demonstrated eagerness for continuous learning and adherence to established business analysis principles, frameworks, and standards.
• Knowledge of Risk Management and IT Security is a plus Technical Skills
• ServiceNow Foundations: Basic understanding of ServiceNow tables, fields, and workflow relationships.
• AI Proficiency is a plus: Ability to use Claude (or similar LLMs) to assist in technical analysis, documentation drafting, and platform troubleshooting.
• Agile Methodologies: Foundational knowledge of Agile/Scrum principles, Understanding

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a ServiceNow IRM Solutions Engineer, you drive the successful delivery and evolution of Roche’s Information Risk Management capabilities on the ServiceNow platform. You combine product ownership, strong ServiceNow expertise, and hands-on delivery capability to ensure scalable and compliant solutions supporting Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC), Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), and Privacy. In this role, you translate business, security, privacy, and regulatory requirements into clear and implementable user stories, enabling engineering teams to deliver efficiently and with clarity. You own the delivery backlog and ensure alignment with the product roadmap, enterprise architecture, and strategic priorities. Beyond backlog ownership, you actively support delivery when needed — contributing to analysis, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and solution validation to ensure successful and high-quality outcomes. Your goal is to ensure that ServiceNow capabilities supporting information risk, third-party risk, and privacy management are delivered in a scalable, reliable, and compliant way, enabling Roche to manage information risks effectively across the enterprise. Description of the area Job Responsibilities
• Strategic Backlog Management : Own and refine the ServiceNow IRM, GRC, TPRM, and Privacy backlogs, ensuring a prioritized pipeline of work that aligns with the product roadmap and business value.
• Architectural Guidance : Interpret solution and process architectures to guide delivery, ensuring all configurations and integrations align with ServiceNow platform best practices.
• Requirements Engineering: Translate complex business, regulatory, and security requirements into clear, actionable user stories with well-defined acceptance criteria .
• Transparent Delivery : Maintain visibility into progress, dependencies, and risks, while balancing team capacity and business urgency
• Cross-Functional Alignment: Bridge the gap between ITIL-based processes , cybersecurity governance, and technical implementation to ensure a cohesive risk management ecosystem. Qualifications Education / Experience
• Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
• 5+ years of experience in technical product ownership, product/service management, technical analysis, or delivery leadership.
• 5+ years of hands-on experience in software delivery and ServiceNow platform implementation.
• Demonstrated experience translating complex business or regulatory requirements into implementable technical work items.
• Experience working in Agile delivery environments with backlog ownership and roadmap alignment.
• Experience working with ServiceNow IRM, GRC, Risk Management, TPRM, or Privacy Management modules.
• Experience working in regulated industries (pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or similar) is a plus. Technical Skills
• Strong knowledge of ServiceNow IRM, GRC, TPRM, and Privacy Management capabilities.
• Understanding of ServiceNow platform architecture, configuration, and integration patterns.
• Familiarity with information risk management, cybersecurity governance, and privacy risk management practices.
• Understanding of ITIL-based processes in enterprise environments.
• Experience supporting regulated IT environments and system validation activities is a plus.
• Strong understanding of software delivery methodologies and backlog management practices.
• Ability to int

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer to join our IVD Data Insights team, with strong expertise in building scalable data pipelines and ETL solutions using Python and modern orchestration tools. This role combines hands-on development with responsibilities such as guiding developers, overseeing design and unit testing, and ensuring well-documented, high-quality solutions. You will work closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver reliable cloud-based data products that support analytics, insights, and data-driven decision-making. The role also requires experience handling sensitive healthcare data and implementing data privacy and protection mechanisms, including data anonymization, masking, and secure data processing practices, ensuring compliance with healthcare and data protection regulations such as HIPAA and GDPR. Success in this role requires proven experience with cloud platforms, the software development lifecycle, data engineering best practices, data modeling, and building secure, privacy-aware data pipelines that enable scalable and compliant data solutions. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE, SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS
• Around 5–8 years of experience working with high-performance data products and large-scale data systems.
• Strong expertise in Python with hands-on experience in building and maintaining ETL pipelines, including data processing/manipulation libraries (e.g., pandas, PySpark, Dask).
• Proficiency in designing and developing scalable data pipelines and ETL processes, using tools such as AWS Glue, PySpark, Spark SQL, and orchestration frameworks like Airflow or AWS Step Functions.
• Expertise with AWS cloud services relevant to data engineering, including Glue, EMR, ECS, Lambda, Lake Formation along with other components for data processing and orchestration.
• Experience with databases across different paradigms (columnar, NoSQL, and MPP), such as Redshift, DynamoDB, Aurora, Postgres, and Snowflake.
• Experience implementing data privacy and protection mechanisms such as anonymization, pseudonymization, data masking, and tokenization in large-scale data pipelines. Familiarity with healthcare data regulations (HIPAA, GDPR) and implementing privacy-by-design principles in cloud data platforms.
• Proficiency in software engineering best practices, including version control (Git), containerization (Docker), unit/integration testing, and CI/CD pipelines.
• Strong data analysis skills with the ability to aggregate, transform, and prepare data for reporting and analytics.
• Knowledge of security, compliance, and design best practices for data solutions.
• Familiarity with API development and working with JSON/XML data formats.
• Proven ability to lead and mentor a team of Data Engineers to design, develop, and deliver data products.
• Excellent interpersonal, analytical, and communication skills for effective collaboration with stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
• Experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Tableau or Apache Superset is a plus. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Build scalable end-to-end data pipelines to integrate and model datasets from diverse sources, ensuring alignment with functional and non-functional requirements.
• Translate business requirements and end-to-end designs into technical implementations that leverage system capabilities.
• Define and champion reusable, extensible, scalable, and maintainable solutions, while considering cost-benefit trade-offs.
• Conduct techn

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione I progressi in AI, dati e scienze computazionali stanno trasformando la scoperta della droga. Il nuovo Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza (CoE) unifica Genentech (gRED) e Pharma (pRED) gli sforzi per sfruttare i dati e l'IA per i farmaci innovativi. All'interno di CoE, il Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) modernizza gli ecosistemi computazionali e dati. Il gruppo Engineering - AI Enablement, all'interno del DDC, guida l'adozione di AI, costruisce e distribuisce soluzioni AI per ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro, scala la formazione e l'inferenza del modello e crea applicazioni per accelerare la scoperta della droga. Essi mirano a rendere AI/ML un'utilità quotidiana per le attività dall'analisi dei dati alla documentazione. Il team di pRED-MLOps all'interno del gruppo AI Enablement consente soluzioni AI/ML affidabili su larga scala in tutto il processo di sviluppo precoce, fornendo una piattaforma all'avanguardia per lo sviluppo, la distribuzione e il monitoraggio di modelli ad alto impatto per accelerare la scoperta della droga. Il team è interfunzionale, guidato da impatto, indipendente e in continua evoluzione per soddisfare le esigenze scientifiche. L'opportunità
• VibeOps Research and Prototyping: Migliori pratiche di ricerca, strumenti e metodologie per l'applicazione dei flussi di lavoro di VibeOps in ambienti MLOps, con un focus sulla produttività, una collaborazione interfunzionale efficiente e un self-service sicuro, nonché un'enfasi sulla comprensione dei rischi, limitazioni e compromessi
• Prototipo di soluzioni su piccola scala, concentrandosi sui concetti di VibeOps e sulle migliori pratiche, strumenti e metodologie, all'interno di contesti MLOps realistici. L'obiettivo è la sperimentazione, non la distribuzione della produzione. Inoltre, sviluppare benchmark per convalidare la correttezza di questi prototipi.
• Proporre misure attuabili per integrare i principi "VibeOps" nelle nostre pratiche MLOps e strumenti come direzioni future, per supportare l'adozione di self-service sicuro e scalabile nel tempo.
• Sviluppo della piattaforma ML: Assistere nello sviluppo e nella documentazione di strumenti, tubazioni e framework che migliorano il ciclo di vita MLOps (ad esempio, integrazione del negozio di inferenza, ganci di monitoraggio automatizzati, meccanismi di rilevamento della deriva) con l'accento sulla abilitazione self-service per gli ingegneri ML e gli scienziati dati.
• Ammodernamento delle infrastrutture AI: contribuire alla progettazione, implementazione e ottimizzazione dei moderni componenti infrastrutturali (ad esempio, containerizzazione, orchestrazione, calcolo distribuito) per migliorare la velocità di formazione/inferenza del modello, affidabilità di distribuzione e efficienza delle risorse, in particolare attraverso una lente self-service.
• Collaborazione: lavorare a stretto contatto con gli ingegneri ML, gli scienziati dei dati e gli specialisti delle infrastrutture IT, traducendo la ricerca all'avanguardia in soluzioni pratiche e scalabili di self-service Chi sei
• Sei uno studente di Master iscritto o ti sei laureato come studente di Bachelor o Master entro 12 mesi in Informatica, Biotecnologia o campo relativo
• Esperienza in Python e esperienza con scripting/automazione (ad esempio Bash).
• Comprensione di base dei concetti LLM e AI Generativi, inclusi i suggerimenti, il contesto, le limitazioni e le modalità di fallimento.
• Forte interesse per le operazioni di apprendimento automatico, i principi DevOps.
• Forte capacità di problem solving e un approccio proattivo e automotivato per affrontare sfide complesse.
• Una certa esperienza con piattaforme/tool MLOps (ad esempio, MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker).
• Una certa familiarità con i gasdotti CI/CD (ad esempio, GitLab CI, GitHub, Jenkins).
• Interessi o esposizione ai concetti di AI Agentic, come la chiamata degli strumenti, l'orchestrazione dell'agente o i modelli di interoperabilità (ad esempio, MCP).
• Alcune conoscenze fondamentali del cloud
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) unifies Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) efforts to leverage data and AI for innovative medicines. Within CoE, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) modernizes computational and data ecosystems. The Engineering - AI Enablement group, within DDC, drives AI adoption, builds and deploys AI solutions to optimize workflows, scales model training and inference, and creates applications to accelerate drug discovery. They aim to make AI/ML an everyday utility for tasks from data analysis to documentation. The pRED-MLOps team within the AI Enablement group enables large-scale, reliable AI/ML solutions across the early development pipeline, providing a state-of-the-art platform for developing, deploying, and monitoring high-impact models to accelerate drug discovery. The team is cross-functional, impact driven, independent, and constantly evolving to meet the scientific needs. The Opportunity
• VibeOps Research and Prototyping: Research best practices, tools, and methodologies for applying VibeOps workflows in MLOps environments, with a focus on productivity, efficient cross-functional collaboration, and secure self-service, as well as an emphasis on understanding risks, limitations, and trade-offs
• Prototype small-scale solutions, focusing on VibeOps concepts and best practices, tools, and methodologies, within realistic MLOps contexts. The goal is experimentation, not production deployment. Additionally, develop benchmarks to validate the correctness of these prototypes.
• Propose actionable steps for integrating "VibeOps" principles into our MLOps practices and tooling as future directions, to support secure, scalable self-service adoption over time.
• ML Platform Development: Assist in developing and documenting tools, pipelines, and frameworks that enhance the MLOps lifecycle (e.g., inference store integration, automated monitoring hooks, drift detection mechanisms) with an emphasis on self-service enablement for ML Engineers and Data Scientists.
• AI Infrastructure Modernization: Contribute to the design, implementation, and optimization of modern infrastructure components (e.g., containerization, orchestration, distributed computing) to improve model training/inference speed, deployment reliability, and resource efficiency, specifically through a self-service lens.
• Collaboration: Work closely with ML Engineers, Data Scientists, and IT infrastructure specialists, translating cutting-edge research into practical, scalable self-service solutions Who You are
• You are an enrolled Master student or you have graduated as a Bachelor- or Master student within 12 months in Computer Science, Biotechnology or related field
• Experience in Python and experience with scripting/automation (e.g. Bash).
• Basic understanding of LLMs and Generative AI concepts, including prompts, context, limitations, and failure modes.
• Strong interest in Machine Learning Operations, DevOps principles.
• Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive, self-motivated approach to tackling complex challenges.
• Some experience with MLOps platforms/tools (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker).
• Some familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, GitHub, Jenkins).
• Interest or exposure to Agentic AI concepts, such as tool calling, agent orchestration, or interoperability patterns (e.g., MCP).
• Some foundational knowledge of cloud

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Fortschritte in der KI, Daten und rechnerischen Wissenschaften transformieren die Drogenentdeckung. Das neue Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) vereint Genentech (gRED) und Pharma (pRED) Bemühungen, Daten und KI für innovative Arzneimittel zu nutzen. Innerhalb von CoE modernisiert der Data und Digital Catalyst (DDC) Computer- und Datenökosysteme. Die Engineering - AI Enablement Gruppe, innerhalb von DDC, treibt AI-Adoption an, baut und implementiert AI-Lösungen zur Optimierung von Workflows, Skalen Modell-Training und Inferenz und schafft Anwendungen zur Beschleunigung der Drogenentdeckung. Sie wollen AI/ML zu einem alltäglichen Nutzen für Aufgaben von der Datenanalyse bis zur Dokumentation machen. Das pRED-MLOps-Team innerhalb der AI Enablement-Gruppe ermöglicht großflächige, zuverlässige AI/ML-Lösungen in der frühen Entwicklungspipeline und bietet eine hochmoderne Plattform für die Entwicklung, Bereitstellung und Überwachung von High-Impact-Modellen zur Beschleunigung der Medikamentenentdeckung. Das Team ist funktionsfähig, schlagzäh, unabhängig und entwickelt sich ständig, um die wissenschaftlichen Bedürfnisse zu erfüllen. Die Chance
• VibeOps Forschung und Prototyping: Forschung Best Practices, Tools und Methoden zur Anwendung von VibeOps-Workflows in MLOps-Umgebungen, mit Fokus auf Produktivität, effiziente funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit und sichere Selbstbedienung, sowie eine Betonung auf Verständnisrisiken, Einschränkungen und Kompromisse
• Prototyp kleine Lösungen, die sich auf VibeOps-Konzepte und bewährte Praktiken, Werkzeuge und Methoden im Rahmen realistischer MLOps-Kontexte konzentrieren. Das Ziel ist Experimentieren, nicht die Produktion. Darüber hinaus entwickeln Benchmarks, um die Richtigkeit dieser Prototypen zu überprüfen.
• Aktive Schritte zur Integration von "VibeOps"-Prinzipien in unsere MLOps-Praktiken und zum Werkzeugen als zukünftige Richtungen, um eine sichere, skalierbare Selbstbedienung im Laufe der Zeit zu unterstützen.
• ML Platform Development: Assist bei der Entwicklung und Dokumentation von Werkzeugen, Pipelines und Frameworks, die den MLOps-Lebenszyklus (z.B. Inferenzspeicherintegration, automatisierte Überwachungshaken, Drifterkennungsmechanismen) verbessern, mit Schwerpunkt auf Selbstbedienung für ML Engineers und Data Scientists.
• KI-Infrastruktur-Modernisierung: Mit dem Design, der Implementierung und der Optimierung moderner Infrastrukturkomponenten (z.B. Containerisierung, Orchestrierung, verteiltes Computing) zur Verbesserung der Modellausbildung/Inferenzgeschwindigkeit, Bereitstellungssicherheit und Ressourceneffizienz, insbesondere durch ein Self-Service-Objektiv.
• Zusammenarbeit: Arbeiten Sie eng mit ML Engineers, Data Scientists und IT-Infrastrukturspezialisten zusammen und übersetzen Sie innovative Forschungen zu praktischen, skalierbaren Self-Service-Lösungen Wer bist du?
• Sie sind ein eingeschriebener Masterstudent oder Sie haben als Bachelor- oder Masterstudent innerhalb von 12 Monaten in Informatik, Biotechnologie oder verwandten Bereich absolviert
• Erfahrung in Python und Erfahrung mit Skripting/Automation (z.B. Bash).
• Grundverständnis von LLMs und Generativen KI-Konzepten, einschließlich Aufforderungen, Kontext, Einschränkungen und Ausfallmodi.
• Starkes Interesse an Machine Learning Operations, DevOps Prinzipien.
• Starke Problemlösungsfähigkeiten und ein proaktiver, selbstmotivierter Ansatz zur Bewältigung komplexer Herausforderungen.
• Einige Erfahrungen mit MLOps Plattformen/Werkzeugen (z.B. MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker).
• Einige Vertrautheit mit CI/CD-Pipelines (z.B. GitLab CI, GitHub, Jenkins).
• Interessierte oder Exposition gegenüber Agentic AI-Konzepten, wie z.B. Werkzeuganruf, Agent Orchestration oder Interoperabilitätsmuster (z.B. MCP).
• Einige Grundkenntnisse der Cloud

Le nouveau Centre d'excellence en sciences computationnelles (CoE) unifie les efforts de Genentech (gred) et de Pharma (PRED) pour exploiter les données et l'IA pour les médicaments innovants. Au sein du Conseil de l'Europe, le catalyseur numérique (DDC) modernise les écosystèmes informatiques et de données. Le groupe Engineering - AI Enablement, au sein de DDC, stimule l'adoption de l'IA, construit et déploie des solutions d'IA pour optimiser les flux de travail, évaluer la formation et l'inférence des modèles, et crée des applications pour accélérer la découverte de médicaments. Ils visent à faire de l'IA/ML une utilité quotidienne pour les tâches, de l'analyse des données à la documentation. L'équipe pRED-MLOps au sein du groupe AI Enablement permet de trouver des solutions d'IA/ML fiables à grande échelle dans les premiers stades de développement, fournissant une plate-forme de pointe pour développer, déployer et surveiller des modèles à fort impact afin d'accélérer la découverte de médicaments. L'équipe est interfonctionnelle, axée sur l'impact, indépendante et en constante évolution pour répondre aux besoins scientifiques. L'occasion
• Recherche et prototypage VibeOps : recherche sur les meilleures pratiques, outils et méthodologies pour appliquer les workflows VibeOps dans les environnements MLOps, en mettant l'accent sur la productivité, la collaboration interfonctionnelle efficace et le libre-service sécurisé, ainsi que sur la compréhension des risques, des limites et des compromis
• Prototype de solutions à petite échelle, en mettant l'accent sur les concepts et les meilleures pratiques, outils et méthodologies VibeOps, dans des contextes MLOps réalistes. L'objectif est l'expérimentation, et non le déploiement de la production. De plus, élaborer des repères pour valider l'exactitude de ces prototypes.
• Proposer des mesures concrètes pour intégrer les principes "VibeOps" dans nos pratiques MLOps et l'outillage comme orientations futures, pour soutenir l'adoption en libre-service sécurisée et évolutive au fil du temps.
• Développement de plates-formes ML : aider à développer et documenter des outils, des pipelines et des cadres qui améliorent le cycle de vie des MLOps (par exemple, intégration de stockage d'inférence, crochets de surveillance automatisés, mécanismes de détection de dérive) en mettant l'accent sur l'habilitation en libre-service pour les ingénieurs ML et les data Scientists.
• Modernisation de l'infrastructure de l'IA : contribuer à la conception, à la mise en œuvre et à l'optimisation des composantes modernes de l'infrastructure (par exemple, conteneurisation, orchestration, calcul distribué) afin d'améliorer la vitesse de formation et d'inférence des modèles, la fiabilité du déploiement et l'efficacité des ressources, en particulier grâce à une lentille en libre-service.
• Collaboration: Travaillez en étroite collaboration avec des ingénieurs de ML, des data scientists et des spécialistes de l'infrastructure informatique, traduisant la recherche de pointe en solutions en libre-service pratiques et évolutives Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes un étudiant de Master inscrit ou vous avez obtenu votre diplôme de Bachelor- ou Master étudiant dans les 12 mois en Informatique, Biotechnologie ou domaine connexe
• Expérience en Python et expérience avec scripting/automation (par exemple Bash).
• Compréhension de base des LLM et des concepts d'IA Generative, y compris les invites, le contexte, les limitations et les modes d'échec.
• Intérêt pour les opérations d'apprentissage automatique, principes DevOps.
• Des compétences solides en résolution de problèmes et une approche proactive et automotivée pour relever les défis complexes.
• Une certaine expérience avec les plateformes/outils MLOps (par exemple MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker).
• Connaissance des pipelines CI/CD (p. ex. GitLab CI, GitHub, Jenkins).
• Intérêt ou exposition aux concepts d'IA Agentique, tels que l'appel d'outils, l'orchestration d'agents ou les modèles d'interopérabilité (p. ex. MCP).
• Une connaissance fondamentale du nuage

title: PMO - Estimating and Benchmarking Lead EU

titleByLocale.en: PMO - Estimating and Benchmarking Lead EU
