titleByLocale.de: PMO - Schätzung und Benchmarking Lead EU
titleByLocale.fr: PMO - Estimation et benchmarking Leader UE

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Global Engineering executes major CAPEX projects in Roche’s Pharma Division with focus mainly on Pharma Technical Operations (PT). The Project Estimating and Benchmarking Lead is a key member of the project management office, and is responsible for keeping relevant business processes up to date for estimating / forecasting the cost, time and resources required to complete a defined scope of work based on different levels of design through a project lifecycle.

You work closely with the project team and prepare estimates to be used to ultimately control a project via a defined work breakdown structure. The estimator should have knowledge from a basic understanding to subject matter expertise (based on experience) in the following : Cost estimating including benchmarking, Cost planning and forecasting, Planning and Scheduling, Risk Management, Value Engineering and Target Value Delivery

You also provide technical leadership in assigned functional areas and accountability for Project Estimating and Benchmarking in the delivery of capital projects and engineering services to support PT, CMO, and Affiliates. This includes projects that are single and multidisciplinary in nature. The Position reports to the Head of Project Management Office.

The Opportunity

You actively monitor the effectiveness and efficiency of the Estimating and Benchmarking business processes and identify areas for operational improvements; develop and deploy updates of the business processes accordingly. Responsibilities include:

• Establish, maintain, and conduct effective training in the business processes

• Work with the global Community of Practice for the areas of expertise; liaise with local/regional engineering organizations to spread knowledge and harmonize practices and represent Roche to consultants, service providers, and industry bodies

• Support initiatives to improve CAPEX Delivery processes and practices and support engaging senior business leaders in the development and continuous improvement of business strategies

• Develop, communicate, and champion the purpose and value of the business processes and engage the engineering community/network in applying the business processes for predictably achieving project objectives

• Support feasibility studies with conceptual cost and schedule estimates, and industry benchmarks, as well as support design and construction projects in the preparation and validation of funding estimates and cost forecasts; ensure estimate data is suitable for project planning and control

• Develop and deploy to the PTT community easy-to-use Estimating and Benchmarking tools

• Collect, analyze, and make available normalized cost and schedule data for future estimating; maintain and expand the CAPEX Benchmarking Database

Who you are

You have more than 10 - 15 years of experience in the controlling and management of CAPEX projects in the range of 50 - 1000m. CHF/USD, preferably in the pharmaceutical, diagnostics, and/or medical devices industry, and / or associated technology industries. In addition you will bring the following skills and experience:

• Experience developing and implementing Estimating and Benchmarking processes, systems, and training in a large cooperation, and have excellent knowledge of modern project management methods, as promoted by - for example – CII, LCI, PMI, AACEi, RICS, or IPA. You also have experience working in a complex global setting

• Very good communication skills to effectively communicate with senior management,
descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Global Engineering realizza importanti progetti CAPEX nella Divisione Farmacia di Roche con particolare attenzione alle operazioni tecniche di Pharma (PT). Il Project Estimating e Benchmarking Lead è un membro chiave dell'ufficio di gestione del progetto, ed è responsabile di mantenere aggiornati i processi aziendali pertinenti per stimare / prevedere i costi, il tempo e le risorse necessarie per completare un campo di lavoro definito basato su diversi livelli di progettazione attraverso un ciclo di vita del progetto.

Lavorate a stretto contatto con il team di progetto e preparate le stime da utilizzare per controllare in ultima analisi un progetto tramite una struttura di ripartizione del lavoro definita. Lo stimatore dovrebbe avere conoscenza da una comprensione di base a soggetti esperti di materia (basata sull'esperienza) nel seguente modo: stima dei costi tra cui benchmarking, pianificazione dei costi e previsioni, pianificazione e Scheduling, gestione del rischio, ingegneria del valore e consegna del valore di destinazione

Fornisci anche la leadership tecnica nelle aree funzionali assegnate e la responsabilità per la stima del progetto e Benchmarking nella fornitura di progetti di capitale e servizi di ingegneria per supportare PT, CMO e Affiliati. Questo include progetti che sono singoli e multidisciplinari in natura. La Posizione riporta al Capo dell'Ufficio Gestione dei Progetti.

L'opportunità

Monitorare attivamente l'efficacia e l'efficienza dei processi aziendali di stima e Benchmarking e identificare le aree per i miglioramenti operativi; sviluppare e distribuire gli aggiornamenti dei processi aziendali di conseguenza. Le responsabilità includono:

• Stabilire, mantenere e condurre una formazione efficace nei processi aziendali

• Lavorare con la Comunità globale di pratica per le aree di competenza; collaborare con le organizzazioni di ingegneria locali/regionali per diffondere le conoscenze e armonizzare le pratiche e rappresentare Roche a consulenti, fornitori di servizi e organismi industriali

• Iniziative di supporto per migliorare i processi e le pratiche di CAPEX Delivery e sostenere l'impegno di leader di business senior nello sviluppo e nel miglioramento continuo delle strategie aziendali

• Sviluppare, comunicare e valorizzare lo scopo e il valore dei processi aziendali e coinvolgere la comunità ingegneristica/rete nell'applicazione dei processi aziendali per raggiungere prevedibilmente gli obiettivi del progetto

• Sostenere gli studi di fattibilità con stime concettuali sui costi e sui tempi, nonché i benchmark del settore, nonché i progetti di progettazione e costruzione di supporto nella preparazione e validazione delle stime di finanziamento e delle previsioni sui costi; assicurarsi che i dati di stima siano adatti alla pianificazione e al controllo del progetto

• Sviluppare e distribuire gli strumenti di analisi e Benchmarking della comunità PTT facili da usare

• Raccogliere, analizzare e rendere disponibili i dati di costo e pianificazione normalizzati per la stima futura; mantenere ed espandere il CAPEX Benchmarking Database

Chi sei

Hai più di 10 - 15 anni di esperienza nel controllo e nella gestione dei progetti CAPEX nella gamma di 50 - 1000m. CHF/USD, preferibilmente nell'industria farmaceutica, diagnostica e/o dispositivi medici, e / o industrie tecnologiche associate. Inoltre porterà le seguenti competenze ed esperienza:

• Esperienza nello sviluppo e nell'attuazione dei processi, dei sistemi e della formazione di Estimating e Benchmarking in una grande collaborazione e conoscenza dei moderni metodi di gestione del progetto, come promosso da - per esempio - CII, LCI, PMI, AACEi, RICS, o IPA. Hai anche esperienza di lavoro in un ambiente globale complesso

• Molto buone capacità di comunicazione per comunicare efficacemente con la gestione senior,
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position
Global Engineering führt wichtige CAPEX-Projekte in der Pharma-Abteilung von Roche mit Schwerpunkt Pharma Technical Operations (PT) durch. Das Projekt Schätzen und Benchmarking Lead ist ein zentrales Mitglied des Projektmanagementbüros und ist dafür verantwortlich, relevante Geschäftsprozesse auf dem neuesten Stand zu halten, um die Kosten, Zeit und Ressourcen zu bewerten, die erforderlich sind, um einen definierten Arbeitsumfang auf unterschiedlichen Designebenen durch einen Projektlebenszyklus abzuschließen.

Sie arbeiten eng mit dem Projektteam zusammen und bereiten Schätzungen vor, die verwendet werden sollen, um letztlich ein Projekt über eine definierte Arbeitsteilungsstruktur zu steuern. Der Schätzwert sollte Kenntnisse aus einem Grundverständnis zu Fachkompetenz (auf Basis der Erfahrung) in folgenden Bereichen haben: Kostenschätzung einschließlich Benchmarking, Kostenplanung und Prognose, Planung und Planung, Risikomanagement, Wertentwicklung und Zielwertlieferung

Sie bieten auch technische Führung in zugewiesenen Funktionsbereichen und Rechenschaftspflicht für Projektschätzungen und Benchmarking bei der Lieferung von Investitionsprojekten und Ingenieurleistungen zur Unterstützung von PT, CMO und Affiliates. Dazu gehören Projekte, die in der Natur ein- und multidisziplinär sind. Die Position berichtet an den Leiter des Projektmanagements.

Die Chance

Sie überwachen die Wirksamkeit und Effizienz der Geschäftsprozesse Schätzung und Benchmarking aktiv und identifizieren Bereiche für operative Verbesserungen; entwickeln und implementieren Updates der Geschäftsprozesse entsprechend. Zu den Aufgaben gehören:

• Etablierung, Aufrechterhaltung und Durchführung effektiver Schulungen in den Geschäftsprozessen

• Arbeiten Sie mit der globalen Praxisgemeinschaft für die Fachbereiche; Kontakte mit lokalen/regionalen Ingenieurorganisationen, um Wissen zu verbreiten und Praktiken zu harmonisieren und Roche für Berater, Dienstleister und Industrieorganisationen zu vertreten

• Unterstützung von Initiativen zur Verbesserung der CAPEX-Lieferprozesse und -praktiken und Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Geschäftsstrategien

• Ziel und Wert der Geschäftsprozesse zu entwickeln, zu kommunizieren und zu forcieren und die Engineering-Community/Netzwerke bei der Anwendung der Geschäftsprozesse zur voraussehbaren Erreichung der Projektziele zu engagieren

• Unterstützung von Machbarkeitsstudien mit konzeptionellen Kosten- und Zeitplanschätzungen sowie Branchen-Benchmarks sowie Unterstützung von Design- und Bauprojekten bei der Erstellung und Validierung von Finanzierungsschätzungen und Kostenprognosen;

• Entwicklung und Bereitstellung von leicht zu bedienenden Tools für die PTT-Gemeinschaft

• Sammeln, Analysieren und zur Verfügung stellen normalisierte Kosten- und Zeitplandaten für zukünftige Schätzungen; Aufrechterhaltung und Erweiterung der CAPEX Benchmarking Datenbank

Wer bist du?

Sie haben mehr als 10 - 15 Jahre Erfahrung in der Steuerung und Verwaltung von CAPEX-Projekten im Bereich von 50 - 1000m. CHF/USD, vorzugsweise in der Pharma-, Diagnostik- und/oder Medizinprodukteindustrie und/oder der damit verbundenen Technologiebranche. Darüber hinaus bringen Sie folgende Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen:

• Erleben Sie die Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Schätz- und Benchmarking-Prozessen, Systemen und Schulungen in einer großen Zusammenarbeit und verfügen über hervorragende Kenntnisse moderner Projektmanagementmethoden, wie sie z.B. von CII, LCI, PMI, AACEi, RICS oder IPA gefördert werden. Sie haben auch Erfahrung in einem komplexen globalen Umfeld

• Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um effektiv mit Senior Management zu kommunizieren,
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Global Engineering exécute d'importants projets CAPEX dans la division Pharma Roches, en mettant l'accent principalement sur les opérations techniques Pharma (PT). Le responsable de l'estimation et de l'évaluation du projet est un membre clé du bureau de gestion du projet et il est chargé de tenir à jour les processus opérationnels pertinents pour estimer et prévoir le coût, le temps et les ressources nécessaires à l'achèvement d'une gamme de travaux définie en fonction des différents niveaux de conception au cours du cycle de vie du projet.

Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe du projet et préparez des estimations qui seront utilisées pour contrôler un projet au moyen d'une structure de répartition des travaux définie. L'estimateur devrait posséder des connaissances de base en matière d'expertise (fondées sur l'expérience) dans les domaines suivants : estimation des coûts, y compris l'analyse comparative, la planification des coûts et les prévisions, la planification et l'établissement des calendriers, la gestion des risques, le génie de la valeur et la prestation des valeurs cibles

Vous assumez également le leadership technique dans les domaines fonctionnels assignés et la responsabilité de l'estimation et de l'analyse comparative des projets dans la prestation de projets d'immobilisations et de services d'ingénierie pour soutenir PT, CMO et Affiliates. Cela comprend des projets uniques et multidisciplinaires. Le poste relève du chef du Bureau de gestion de projet.

L'opportunité

Vous surveillez activement l'efficacité et l'efficience des processus opérationnels d'estimation et d'analyse et identifiez les domaines où des améliorations opérationnelles pourraient être apportées; élaborez et déployez des mises à jour des processus opérationnels en conséquence. Les responsabilités comprennent :

• Mettre en place, maintenir et organiser une formation efficace dans les processus opérationnels;

• Collaborer avec la communauté de pratique mondiale dans les domaines de compétence; assurer la liaison avec les organisations d'ingénierie locales et régionales pour diffuser les connaissances et harmoniser les pratiques et représenter Roche auprès des consultants, des prestataires de services et des organismes industriels

• Appuyer les initiatives visant à améliorer les processus et les pratiques d'exécution de CAPEX et appuyer la participation des chefs d'entreprise à l'élaboration et à l'amélioration continue des stratégies d'entreprise

• Développer, communiquer et défendre le but et la valeur des processus opérationnels et faire participer la communauté/réseaux d'ingénierie à l'application des processus opérationnels pour atteindre les objectifs du projet de façon prévisible

• Appuyer les études de faisabilité comportant des estimations conceptuelles des coûts et des calendriers, ainsi que des critères de référence pour l'industrie, ainsi que des projets de conception et de construction pour la préparation et la validation des estimations de financement et des prévisions de coûts; veiller à ce que les données estimées soient adaptées à la planification et au contrôle des projets;

• Développer et déployer à la communauté PTT des outils d'estimation et d'étalonnage faciles à utiliser

• Recueillir, analyser et rendre disponibles des données normalisées sur les coûts et les calendriers pour l'estimation future; tenir à jour et élargir la base de données d'étalonnage CAPEX

Qui vous êtes

Vous avez plus de 10 à 15 ans d'expérience dans le contrôle et la gestion de projets CAPEX dans la gamme de 50 à 1000m. CHF/USD, de préférence dans l'industrie pharmaceutique, diagnostique et/ou des dispositifs médicaux, et / ou les industries technologiques associées. En outre, vous apporterez les compétences et l'expérience suivantes:

• Expérience de l'élaboration et de la mise en oeuvre de processus, systèmes et formations d'estimation et d'étalonnage dans le cadre d'une large coopération, et excellente connaissance des méthodes modernes de gestion de projets, telles que promues par - par exemple - CII, LCI, PMI, AACEi, RICS ou IPA. Vous avez également de l'expérience dans un contexte mondial complexe

• Très bonnes compétences en communication pour communiquer efficacement avec la haute direction,

The Position
Como Gerente de Estratégia Médica, você atuará como um parceiro estratégico crucial dentro do ecossistema de saúde brasileiro, integrando-se ao time médico-científico de Imunologia. Seu papel será vital no lançamento de uma inovação da Roche nas áreas terapêuticas de Nefrologia e Reumatologia, com foco inicial na jornada do paciente com Lúpus Eritematoso Sistêmico (LES) e suas complicações, especialmente a Nefrite Lúpica (NL). Além disso, você será chamado a participar das discussões estratégicas de outras inovações em Imunologia que estão no pipeline.

Sobre a oportunidade:
Sua principal atuação será focada na interação e engajamento com parceiros externos , incluindo médicos, profissionais de saúde, líderes de opinião e decisores. Você será responsável por:

• Articular a narrativa científica da Roche nessas áreas terapêuticas, mantendo-se constantemente atualizado(a) e fornecendo expertise científica e clínica focada em nossos clientes externos.

• Capturar informações de campo e transformá-las em insights estratégicos e acionáveis, colaborando ativamente na definição e constante refinamento de nossa narrativa científica junto ao time de Imunologia.

• Contribuir ativamente para a definição de planos de educação médica e geração de evidências, identificando, comunicando e discutindo potenciais lacunas e necessidades de evidências para o desenvolvimento de um plano integrado de dados.

• Ter um papel ativo nas atividades de medical-marketing, incluindo o posicionamento de produtos da Roche, a construção de planos de contas e a definição dos imperativos estratégicos da Roche para essas áreas terapêuticas.

• Garantir o mais elevado padrão ético, científico e de qualidade, contribuindo para a segurança dos pacientes e a salvaguarda da reputação da Roche.

• Ativar e alavancar o network global da Roche, conectando-se com colaboradores de todo o mundo para maximizar o potencial da nossa rede em benefício do sistema de saúde do Brasil e dos pacientes brasileiros.

Quem você é:

• Graduação completa em Medicina, Farmácia, Biomedicina ou demais áreas da saúde e desejável pós-graduação em Reumatologia, Imunologia ou Nefrologia

• Vivência acadêmica ou experiência na indústria farmacêutica nas áreas de Reumatologia, Imunologia ou Nefrologia.

• Bom conhecimento dos produtos e dinâmicas de mercado em uma ou mais dessas áreas.

• Vivência prévia comprovada na atuação médico-científica de campo em Medical Affairs na indústria farmacêutica, seja como Medical Science Liaison (MSL), Consultor Científico, Gerente Médico-Científico ou Gerente Médico com interação direta com médicos e profissionais de saúde.

• Compreensão sólida do sistema de saúde do Brasil, incluindo políticas de saúde, ambiente de reembolso e avaliação de tecnologias de saúde.

• Conhecimento aprofundado do desenvolvimento de medicamentos farmacêuticos, estratégias e táticas de assuntos médicos, bem como os principais processos de conformidade médica da indústria.

• Disponibilidade para atuar em campo em aproximadamente 50% do tempo, incluindo viagens fora de São Paulo.

• Desejável conhecimento e/ou vivência prévia em estudos clínicos e em geração de evidências de mundo real (RWE)

• Bom entendimento e interesse nas tendências e inovações em saúde digital.

• Inglês avançado.

Os benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para essa posição.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position
Reporting into the Service Intelligence organization, you will help the Roche Support Network (RSN) progress through the data maturity model by applying advanced analytics to our most critical service challenges. Your mission is to identify high-impact use cases and develop the mathematical frameworks to address them. To achieve this, you will identify needs, lead the design and implementation of analytical solutions, provide advice and consulting support to our key business stakeholders and demonstrate value by executing proof-of-concept initiatives and prototyping analytical solutions to answer business questions.

As a Data Scientist, you will position data science as a key competency within the enterprise and be responsible for creating value from data assets using advanced analytics capabilities including data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence methodologies, to identify critical business risk and opportunities for RSN.

You have an overall understanding of the key challenges in our industry. You have experience in the areas of analytics, data transformation, and data science. You are passionate about applying state-of-the-art analytical methods, as well as cutting edge machine learning algorithms to find solutions to complex business problems.

Role Responsibilities

• Identify high-impact data science use cases, develop and implement innovative solutions to drive business impact and develop state-of-the-art analytical capabilities to address identified needs.

• Evaluate, drive and implement solutions from concept to minimum viable product and final product

• Apply analytical and statistical methods to solve identified use cases in an agile manner using multiple data sources and analytical tools

• Collaborate within cross-functional teams to develop solutions, gain alignment and deliver impactful business insights; engage necessary stakeholders to enable better decision-making

• Interpret and communicate analytics results clearly and concisely to audiences with varying backgrounds and degrees of technical understanding.

• Take an enterprise mindset, linking individual responsibilities with the broader organization; focus on outcomes that provide most business value

• Partner with data science experts around the world within Roche to share best-in-class solutions and drive collaborative approaches towards data science challenges.

Minimum Requirements

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Bioinformatics, Mathematics or equivalent field.

• You have at least 2 years of service/industry experience, working in a hands-on capacity as a Data Scientist.

Preferred Requirements

• Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Bioinformatics, Mathematics or equivalent preferred.

• 4 years experience in the service industry, working in a hands-on capacity as a Data Scientist.

• Experience with AWS environments preferred.

• Experience with Agile development methods including Scrum and Kanban preferred.

• Experience with Statistics, Data Mining, Machine Learning, Data Visualization, Cloud Computing, and Distributed Systems

• Hands-on programming experience (Python, R, etc) along with a solid understanding of statistical and machine learning models. You have experience in implementing statistical learning methods or deep learning frameworks to solve problems.

• Ability to work independently, prioritize within an interdisciplinary environment that includes (data) scientists, analysts, bus

The Position

As a Staining Software Engineer, Associate you will design and develop staining procedures in close collaboration with assay development. You develop software supplements that install staining procedures along with the underlying database elements required to support staining procedure(s) in the software application.

The Opportunity

• Developing moderate-scoped procedures with senior engineering guidance to ensure cross-platform compatibility and optimal instrument performance.

• Executing comprehensive manual and automated test scripts to validate software functionality and system reliability.

• Adhering to company policies, Product Development Processes (PDP), and Work Instructions to ensure all engineering activities remain compliant.

• Authoring and tracking documentation deliverables while identifying the appropriate reviewers and approvers to maintain project flow.

• Managing Design Change Orders (DCOs), Document Changes (DCs), and PDP Document Approvals (DAs) within the Document Control System.

• Maintaining the Software Design History File (DHF) by organizing documentation deliverables according to established best practices.

• Facilitating project review meetings through professional presentations, minute-taking, and active tracking of action items to ensure on-time delivery.

Who You Are

• You hold a BS degree or equivalent in a directly related discipline, or an

• equivalent combination of education and experience

• 2 years of related experience required. Experience in a regulated industry, desired

Behaviors, competencies, and qualities of the ideal applicant.

• Basic organizational skills; ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and to plan project components to effectively report status to stakeholders.

• Understanding or familiarity with project management tools (such as Smart Sheets, MS Project, or Trello).

• Knowledge of creating software documentation for a medical device, software databases and/or scripting languages

• Skilled with the use of word processing, spreadsheets, graphical and presentation software applications

• Proficient in a document control system(s) (such as Agile).

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Information Security and Data Privacy Fundamentals

Relocation benefits are not offered for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Arizona is Primary Location State is 64,400.00 - 119,600.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il Head of Product HI Enterprise Cloud (Senior Product Leader) è responsabile per l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto, dall'ideazione iniziale e dalla pianificazione strategica fino al lancio, scaling e all'eventuale ritiro di un prodotto complesso. Questo ruolo è fondamentale per trasformare le esigenze scientifiche e aziendali in soluzioni tecnologiche tangibili e ad alto valore. Sarete responsabili di definire la visione del prodotto, la strategia e la roadmap, assicurando che si allinea con gli obiettivi di overarching della nostra organizzazione e, infine, accelera la consegna di diagnostica e medicine che cambiano la vita ai pazienti. Questo ruolo richiede una combinazione distintiva di inquisitività scientifica, competenza tecnica e business insight per navigare con successo nel paesaggio. Il vostro obiettivo primario è quello di definire la direzione per i team di ingegneria e di servizio per costruire prodotti desiderabili, fattibili, fattibili e sostenibili che soddisfino le esigenze in evoluzione dei nostri utenti interni, pur mantenendo una stretta conformità con i relativi standard del settore. Le sue principali responsabilità:
• Guidare la Visione del Prodotto: Definire ed eseguire la strategia e la roadmap completa per il portafoglio Enterprise Cloud per accelerare la consegna della diagnostica in continuo cambiamento.
• Gestire il ciclo di vita completo: Prendere la responsabilità per l'intero viaggio del prodotto, dall'ideazione iniziale e dalla pianificazione strategica fino alla scalabilità e al pensionamento di soluzioni cloud complesse.
• Lead Cloud Transformation: la strategia "Cloud-First" di Orchestrate Roche ottimizza la velocità e la cadenza di rilascio per soddisfare le esigenze in evoluzione dei prodotti Enterprise e R&D.
• Foster Strategic Collaboration: Navigare un ampio ecosistema di team interni, fornitori esterni di SaaS e partner accademici per garantire l'integrazione della piattaforma senza soluzione di continuità e la gestione delle API.
• Assicurare Compliance ed Eccellenza: L'innovazione di equilibrio con una rigorosa adesione agli standard del settore, tra cui GxP, integrando al contempo le capacità AI per mantenere un vantaggio competitivo. Chi sei:
• Leader del prodotto esperto: porti 10+ anni nella gestione del prodotto o nell'analisi aziendale con una comprovata storia di lancio e gestione di prodotti tecnologici complessi.
• Esperto del settore: hai 2 anni di esperienza nel settore farmaceutico, biotecnologico o della tecnologia sanitaria regolamentata.
• Proven People Manager: Possiedi 2+ anni di esperienza leader, mentoring e sviluppo di team tecnici altamente performanti e multidisciplinari.
• Tecnicamente Proficiente: Lei possiede una laurea universitaria e ha una profonda conoscenza dell'architettura moderna del software, di Cloud Hyperscalers e di Container come Servizio (CaaS).
• Normativa e Data Savvy: Lei è ben diversificato nei principi di dati GxP, FAIR e nelle normative sulla privacy dei dati come GDPR per garantire fondazioni sicure e conformi. Pronto a portare le vostre qualità uniche a Roche e fare un impatto? Applicare ora e unirsi a noi nella nostra missione per plasmare il futuro della salute. Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Madrid. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con la nostra medicina

The Position The Head of Product HI Enterprise Cloud (Senior Product Leader) is accountable for the entire product lifecycle, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to launch, scaling, and eventual retirement of a complex product. This role is pivotal in transforming scientific and business needs into tangible, high-value technology solutions. You will be responsible for defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, ensuring it aligns with the overarching goals of our organization and ultimately accelerates the delivery of life-changing diagnostics and medicines to patients. This role demands a distinctive combination of scientific inquisitiveness, technical proficiency, and business insight to successfully navigate the landscape. Your primary objective is to define the direction for the engineering and service teams to build desirable, feasible, viable, and sustainable products that meet the evolving needs of our internal users while maintaining strict compliance with relevant industry standards. Your main responsabilities:
• Drive the Product Vision: Define and execute the comprehensive strategy and roadmap for the Enterprise Cloud portfolio to accelerate the delivery of life-changing diagnostics.
• Manage the Full Lifecycle: Take accountability for the entire product journey, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to scaling and retirement of complex cloud solutions.
• Lead Cloud Transformation: Orchestrate Roche’s "Cloud-First" strategy by optimizing for speed and release cadence to meet the evolving demands of Enterprise and R&D products.
• Foster Strategic Collaboration: Navigate a broad ecosystem of internal teams, external SaaS vendors, and academic partners to ensure seamless platform integration and API management.
• Ensure Compliance and Excellence: Balance innovation with strict adherence to industry standards, including GxP, while integrating AI capabilities to maintain a competitive advantage. Who you are:
• Experienced Product Leader: You bring 10+ years in product management or business analysis with a proven history of launching and managing complex technology products.
• Industry Expert: You have 2+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology sector.
• Proven People Manager: You possess 2+ years of experience leading, mentoring, and developing high-performing, multidisciplinary technical teams.
• Technically Proficient: You hold a University Degree and have deep knowledge of modern software architecture, Cloud Hyperscalers, and Container as a Service (CaaS).
• Regulatory and Data Savvy: You are well-versed in GxP, FAIR data principles, and data privacy regulations such as GDPR to ensure secure and compliant foundations. Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Der Head of Product HI Enterprise Cloud (Senior Product Leader) ist verantwortlich für den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus, von der ersten Idee und strategischen Planung bis hin zum Start, Skalieren und eventuellen Rücktritt eines komplexen Produkts. Diese Rolle ist von entscheidender Bedeutung für die Transformation von wissenschaftlichen und geschäftlichen Anforderungen in konkrete, hochwertige Technologielösungen. Sie werden für die Definition der Produktvision, Strategie und Roadmap verantwortlich sein, um sicherzustellen, dass sie mit den übergeordneten Zielen unserer Organisation in Einklang steht und letztendlich die Lieferung von lebensverändernden Diagnostik und Arzneimitteln an Patienten beschleunigt. Diese Rolle erfordert eine unverwechselbare Kombination von wissenschaftlicher Inquisition, technischer Kompetenz und geschäftlicher Einsicht, um die Landschaft erfolgreich zu navigieren. Ihr primäres Ziel ist es, die Richtung für die Engineering- und Service-Teams zu definieren, um wünschenswerte, machbare, lebensfähige und nachhaltige Produkte zu entwickeln, die den sich entwickelnden Bedürfnissen unserer internen Nutzer gerecht werden und dabei strenge Einhaltung der relevanten Branchenstandards gewährleisten. Ihre wichtigsten Aufgaben:
• Fahren Sie die Produktvision: Definieren und führen Sie die umfassende Strategie und Roadmap für das Enterprise Cloud-Portfolio aus, um die Bereitstellung von lebensverändernden Diagnosen zu beschleunigen.
• Verwalten Sie den gesamten Lebenszyklus: Berücksichtigen Sie die gesamte Produktreise, von der ersten Idee und strategischen Planung bis hin zur Skalierung und Aussetzung komplexer Cloud-Lösungen.
• Lead Cloud Transformation: Die "Cloud-First"-Strategie von Roche durch Optimierung der Geschwindigkeit und Freigabe von Kadenz, um den wachsenden Anforderungen von Enterprise- und R&D-Produkten gerecht zu werden.
• Foster Strategische Zusammenarbeit: Navigieren Sie ein breites Ökosystem von internen Teams, externen SaaS-Anbietern und akademischen Partnern, um eine nahtlose Plattformintegration und API-Management zu gewährleisten.
• Gewährleistung von Compliance und Exzellenz: Balance Innovation mit strenger Einhaltung von Industriestandards, einschließlich GxP, und Integration von KI-Fähigkeiten, um einen Wettbewerbsvorteil zu erhalten. Wer du bist:
• Erfahrener Produktführer: Sie bringen 10+ Jahre in der Produktmanagement- oder Unternehmensanalyse mit einer bewährten Geschichte der Einführung und Verwaltung komplexer Technologieprodukte.
• Branchenexperte: Sie haben 2+ Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich der Pharma-, Biotechnologie- oder regulierten Gesundheitstechnologie.
• Proven People Manager: Sie besitzen 2+ Jahre Erfahrung führende, Mentoring und Entwicklung von hochperformierenden, multidisziplinären technischen Teams.
• Technisch kompetent: Sie halten einen Hochschulabschluss und verfügen über tiefe Kenntnisse der modernen Softwarearchitektur, Cloud Hyperscalers und Container als Service (CaaS).
• Regulatory and Data Savvy: Sie sind in GxP, FAIR-Datengrundsätzen und Datenschutzbestimmungen wie DSGVO gut um sichere und konforme Grundlagen zu gewährleisten. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le chef de produit HI Enterprise Cloud (chef de produit principal) est responsable de l'ensemble du cycle de vie du produit, de l'idée initiale et de la planification stratégique jusqu'au lancement, à l'échelle et au retrait éventuel d'un produit complexe. Ce rôle est essentiel pour transformer les besoins scientifiques et commerciaux en solutions technologiques tangibles et de grande valeur. Vous serez responsable de la définition de la vision, de la stratégie et de la feuille de route du produit, en s'assurant qu'elle s'harmonise avec les objectifs généraux de notre organisation et, en fin de compte, accélère la prestation de diagnostics et de médicaments qui changent la vie aux patients. Ce rôle exige une combinaison distinctive d'enquête scientifique, de compétence technique et de perspicacité commerciale pour naviguer avec succès dans le paysage. Votre objectif principal est de définir l'orientation des équipes d'ingénierie et de service pour construire des produits souhaitables, réalisables, viables et durables qui répondent aux besoins changeants de nos utilisateurs internes tout en maintenant le strict respect des normes pertinentes de l'industrie. Vos principales responsabilités :
• Conduire la vision du produit: Définir et exécuter la stratégie et la feuille de route globales pour le portefeuille Enterprise Cloud afin d'accélérer la livraison de diagnostics changeant la vie.
• Gérer le cycle de vie complet : Rendre compte de l'ensemble du parcours du produit, de l'idée initiale et de la planification stratégique jusqu'à la mise à niveau et à la retraite de solutions cloud complexes.
• Lead Cloud Transformation: Orchestre Roches Stratégie «Cloud-First» en optimisant la vitesse et la cadence de sortie pour répondre aux exigences changeantes des produits Enterprise et R&D.
• Favoriser la collaboration stratégique : Naviguez dans un vaste écosystème d'équipes internes, de fournisseurs externes SaaS et de partenaires universitaires afin d'assurer l'intégration des plateformes et la gestion des API.
• Assurer la conformité et l'excellence : équilibrer l'innovation avec le strict respect des normes de l'industrie, y compris GxP, tout en intégrant les capacités d'IA pour maintenir un avantage concurrentiel. Qui vous êtes :
• Chef de produit expérimenté: Vous apportez 10 ans et plus en gestion de produits ou en analyse commerciale avec une histoire éprouvée de lancement et de gestion de produits technologiques complexes.
• Expert de l'industrie: Vous avez plus de 2 ans d'expérience dans le secteur pharmaceutique, de la biotechnologie ou des technologies de santé réglementées.
• Proven People Manager: Vous possédez plus de 2 ans d'expérience en leadership, en mentorat et en développement d'équipes techniques multidisciplinaires à haut rendement.
• Techniquement compétent: Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme universitaire et avez une connaissance approfondie de l'architecture logicielle moderne, Cloud Hyperscalers et Container as a Service (CaaS).
• Regulatory and Data Savvy: Vous êtes bien orienté dans GxP, principes de données FAIR, et les règles de confidentialité des données telles que le RGPD pour assurer des fondations sûres et conformes. Prêt à apporter vos qualités uniques à Roche et faire un impact? Postulez maintenant et rejoignez-nous dans notre mission de façonner l'avenir des soins de santé. Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'endroit principal est Madrid. Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le rôle peut être disponible, nous fournirons les détails pertinents de la rémunération plus tard dans le processus d'embauche. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec notre médicament

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns an, die Wissenschaft durch ein Umfeld zu fördern, in dem Forschende die maximale Zeit für Innovation haben. Als R&D Data Engineer (m/w/d) übernimmst Du hierbei eine zentrale Funktion in unserem Digitalisierungsteam ein, um die Vision eines reibungslosen digitalen Labors technisch umzusetzen. Du gestaltest den Daten-Lebenszyklus von der Extraktion aus Altsystemen über die semantische Strukturierung bis zur visuellen Aufbereitung mit. Durch Deinen Fokus auf automatisierte Datenflüsse leistest Du einen entscheidenden Beitrag, um den Wandel hin zu einer hocheffizienten, datengetriebenen Forschungsumgebung zu vollenden. Das erwartet Dich in der Rolle
• Als Teil des Core Lab Digitalisierungsteams gestaltest du die datengetriebene Vision mit. Durch gezieltes Coaching und „Organizational Storytelling“ begeisterst Du die Organisation für datengetriebene Arbeitsweisen. Durch vorhandenes Domain Wissen idealerweise im Bereich CLD und Diagnostics kannst Du schnell die Anforderungen in Lösungen transferieren.
• Du definierst in Zusammenarbeit mit IT und zentralen Einheiten semantische Standards und Datenmodelle im Sinne der Digitalen Strategie von Roche, um sicherzustellen, dass Laborinformationen präzise, standardisiert und sicher in unsere Cloud-Infrastruktur fließen.
• Du entscheidest bei der funktionalen Weiterentwicklung mit und stellst sicher, dass die Bestandssoftware genau das liefert, was die Forschung für nächste Durchbrüche braucht. Dabei identifizierst und extrahierst Du wertvolle Datenbestände und verknüpfst Rohdaten so mit ihrem wissenschaftlichen Kontext, dass sie die Basis für Simulationen und KI bilden.
• Du konzipierst intuitive Dashboards mit BI Software für Self-Service-Analysen und transformierst Laborprozesse nach Analyse durch konsequente Automatisierung, um Reibungsverluste zu minimieren und technologische Hürden direkt zu lösen dort wo die Daten entstehen.
• Du bereitest komplexe technische Sachverhalte so auf, dass sie für das Management als Entscheidungsgrundlage dienen. Du präsentierst Deine Fortschritte und Konzepte sicher in Fachgremien und treibst Deine Projekte eigenverantwortlich zum Erfolg. Wer du bist
• Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (Master/Diplom) in Bioinformatik, Biotechnologie, Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren technischen/naturwissenschaftlichen Feld.
• Du beherrschst Programmiersprachen wie z.B. Python und Datenbanken wie z.B. SQL sicher, insbesondere für das Parsing komplexer Logfiles und die Automatisierung von Daten-Pipelines.
• Fundierte Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit modernen Datenplattformen (z. B. Snowflake, Data Lakes) und Business-Intelligence-Werkzeugen (z. B. Tableau). Du besitzt ein Verständnis für UX-Design und Datenintegrität; Kenntnisse in Machine Learning oder Generative KI runden dein Profil ab.
• Du bringst Erfahrung in der Analytik oder Systementwicklung mit und hast die Fähigkeit, Dich schnell in komplexe wissenschaftliche Fragestellungen hineinzudenken.
• Du hast Erfahrung in der Leitung technischer Projekte und sicher im Umgang mit agilen Methoden und Werkzeugen (Scrum, Kanban, Jira). Arbeiten nach Best practices ist für Dich selbstverständlich.
• Du bist ein kommunikationsstarkes „Daten-Vorbild“ mit diplomatischem Geschick. Du bist ein Teamplayer mit tiefer Data-Engineering-Expertise und einem breiten Interesse daran, End-to-End Laborprozesse (Value Streams) zu verstehen und zu optimieren. Es motiviert Dich, komplexe Zusatzaufgaben eigenverantwortl

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position About the role Are you a natural communicator with an analytical mind? Do you want to understand how a complex medical product is defined before a single line of code is written? Our Instrumentation Development chapter in Sant Cugat (Barcelona) is looking for a Software Product Owner / Requirement Engineer Intern . In this role, you will support our Product Owners in the vital task of defining "what" we build. You will act as a bridge between high-level business needs and the technical implementation teams, ensuring that every feature is clearly documented and understood. This is a unique opportunity to gain a holistic view of the healthcare business and the lifecycle of medical software. Main responsibilities
• Requirement Definition: Support the creation and maintenance of Feature Files and Product Requirements that guide our software implementation partners.
• Product Risk Management: Identify product risks in defined features and define appropriate risk control measures to mitigate risks that could cause patient harm.
• Operational Agility: Assist Product Owners in the day-to-day operational tasks, ensuring that requirements are ready for development "sprints" and resolving functional doubts.
• Tool Management: Work directly with our official requirement management tool, Retina (Codebeamer) , to keep documentation organized and updated.
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Help gather needs and feedback from different areas, including Business Leaders (IPM), Global Service (GCS), and other cross-functional departments.
• Quality Assurance: Ensure that the defined requirements meet the necessary quality attributes for a regulated medical environment.
• Process optimization: Actively participate in and contribute to the continuous improvement of requirements processes within a SAFe environment. How would your day-to-day look like? Your day will involve a lot of interaction within the internal team and stakeholders from other areas and projects. You will participate in meetings with senior Product Owners to understand the strategic roadmap, and then translate those ideas into detailed documentation. You will spend time in Retina , refining feature descriptions, product risks, product requirements and ensuring the "definition of ready" is met for the developers. Under the guidance of your assigned mentor , you will learn how to balance the needs of different stakeholders while building a strong network across various business areas. It’s a role that combines deep "desk work" (analysis and writing) with constant collaboration and networking. Who are you?
• Education: Recent graduate in Informatics, Telecommunications, or Biomedical Engineering . We value your understanding of the product domain and logic over coding skills.
• Analytical Skills: You have a knack for breaking down complex problems into clear, logical requirements.
• Communication: You are comfortable talking to people from different backgrounds (technical and non-technical) and have excellent writing skills.
• Organization: You are methodical and detail-oriented, especially when managing documentation and deadlines.
• Languages: Professional proficiency in English (B2/C1 level) is essential, as you will interact with international stakeholders. This opportunity is part of the START TECH program, you can find more information about the program in the following link. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees

Our Instrumentation Development chapter in Sant Cugat (Barcelona) is looking for a Software Product Owner / Requirement Engineer Intern . In this role, you will support our Product Owners in the vital task of defining "what" we build. You will act as a bridge between high-level business needs and the technical implementation teams, ensuring that every feature is clearly documented and understood. This is a unique opportunity to gain a holistic view of the healthcare business and the lifecycle of medical software. Main responsibilities
• Requirement Definition: Support the creation and maintenance of Feature Files and Product Requirements that guide our software implementation partners.
• Product Risk Management: Identify product risks in defined features and define appropriate risk control measures to mitigate risks that could cause patient harm.
• Operational Agility: Assist Product Owners in the day-to-day operational tasks, ensuring that requirements are ready for development "sprints" and resolving functional doubts.
• Tool Management: Work directly with our official requirement management tool, Retina (Codebeamer) , to keep documentation organized and updated.
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Help gather needs and feedback from different areas, including Business Leaders (IPM), Global Service (GCS), and other cross-functional departments.
• Quality Assurance: Ensure that the defined requirements meet the necessary quality attributes for a regulated medical environment.
• Process optimization: Actively participate in and contribute to the continuous improvement of requirements processes within a SAFe environment. How would your day-to-day look like? Your day will involve a lot of interaction within the internal team and stakeholders from other areas and projects. You will participate in meetings with senior Product Owners to understand the strategic roadmap, and then translate those ideas into detailed documentation. You will spend time in Retina , refining feature descriptions, product risks, product requirements and ensuring the "definition of ready" is met for the developers. Under the guidance of your assigned mentor , you will learn how to balance the needs of different stakeholders while building a strong network across various business areas. It’s a role that combines deep "desk work" (analysis and writing) with constant collaboration and networking. Who are you?
• Education: Recent graduate in Informatics, Telecommunications, or Biomedical Engineering . We value your understanding of the product domain and logic over coding skills.
• Analytical Skills: You have a knack for breaking down complex problems into clear, logical requirements.
• Communication: You are comfortable talking to people from different backgrounds (technical and non-technical) and have excellent writing skills.
• Organization: You are methodical and detail-oriented, especially when managing documentation and deadlines.
• Languages: Professional proficiency in English (B2/C1 level) is essential, as you will interact with international stakeholders. This opportunity is part of the START TECH program, you can find more information about the program in the following link. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position ABOUT THE ROLE Are you fascinated by how software is deployed, scaled, and maintained in high-stakes environments? Our Instrumentation Development chapter in Sant Cugat (Barcelona) is looking for a Software Engineer Trainee to join our DevOps and Infrastructure operations. In this role, you will be the backbone of our development process. You won't just be writing code; you will be ensuring that our software reaches its destination (testing and production environments) smoothly and reliably. This is a unique opportunity to enter the DevOps world, a discipline built on experience and collaboration rather than traditional textbooks. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
• Environment Maintenance: Support the daily operations of our testing environments, ensuring they are ready for the testing team’s deployments.
• Pipeline Optimization: Collaborate with our implementation partners to maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines, ensuring faster and safer software delivery.
• Infrastructure as Code: Assist in managing containerized environments using Docker, kubernetes and cloud resources within Azure and AWS .
• Daily Support: Provide support to the development squads in their day-to-day DevOps needs, troubleshooting deployment issues and monitoring system health.
• Continuous Improvement: Participate in initiatives to automate manual tasks and modernize our current infrastructure. HOW WOULD YOUR DAY-TO-DAY LOOK LIKE? Your day will start with a sync meeting to identify any bottlenecks in our deployment pipelines or environments. Under the guidance of your assigned mentor , you will learn how to manage the infrastructure and how to orchestrate services with Kubernetes . You will work closely with both the testing team (to provide them with stable environments) and our external implementation partners (to learn and improve how we build software). It is a hands-on journey where you will see the immediate impact of your work on the speed and quality of the entire department. WHO ARE YOU?
• Education: Recent graduate in Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related technical field.
• DevOps Passion: You are naturally curious about cloud technologies, automation, and the "behind the scenes" of software development.
• Tech Interest: While you don't need to be an expert, you have a basic understanding or a strong desire to master Cloud services and Kubernetes .
• Mindset: You are a problem-solver who enjoys technical challenges and thrives in collaborative environments.
• Languages: Professional proficiency in English (B1/B2 or higher). WHAT DO WE OFFER?
• A Real DevOps School: DevOps is learned by doing. We offer you the environment, the tools, and the team to transform your curiosity into a professional career.
• Mentorship: You will have a dedicated mentor to guide your learning path from day one.
• High-Tech Stack: Gain hands-on experience with industry-standard tools (Azure, Docker, CI/CD).
• Flexibility: A flexible working model in our Sant Cugat office with remote work options.
• Program: This position is part of our START TECH program for young digital talent. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Purpose of the role: We are looking for a creative, innovative and open-minded intern to join the Global Regulatory Affairs team. As an Intern in Regulatory Affairs, you have the opportunity to support regulatory and product care activities, and get insights into the IVD/MD industry and the applicable regulations and standards for IVD/MD products. In Global Regulatory Affairs we work on specific challenges as a team within all areas of the diagnostic business around the globe, to grow together to bring the best products to patients while choosing a work environment that fits our life. As AI plays an increasing role in our daily lives we are also looking for colleagues who are keen in taking part in high-impact projects that leverage machine learning (ML), natural language processing (NLP), and large language models (LLMs) to optimize how we navigate the complex landscape of global health regulations. In this intern role, you can clearly demonstrate your creativity and leave a footprint in our products’ lifecycle. You will directly contribute to Roche Diagnostics' vision: innovating diagnostics, shaping healthcare & changing lives. Your key responsibilities: After your onboarding program, you will be assigned to tasks or projects. You’ll be mostly spending your time in:
• Assisting in the worldwide registrations and activities for various IVD/MD products, at various stages of their development and lifecycle
• Supporting the preparation and maintenance of global documentation for our IVD/MD products
• Collaborating with other regulatory affairs teams, including local affiliates, for registrational activities
• Coordinating with global interdisciplinary project teams to provide regulatory input to development, submission planning, and documentation needed
• Supporting the global regulatory affairs team members in their non-registrational activities
• Assisting in the design, development, and testing of AI-powered tools and dashboards for regulatory tracking, document analysis, and automated reporting.
• Participating in the training and fine-tuning of ML and NLP models tailored for regulatory use cases, ensuring high accuracy and compliance with internal standards.
• Keep abreast of emerging AI technologies and changing regulatory guidelines regarding AI in the healthcare and pharmaceutical industries. Who you are:
• You have recently graduated (within the last 3 years) in the field of Biology, Life Sciences, Engineering, or Data Science, Computer Science, Bioinformatics
• You possess facilitation and communications skills and the ability to deal with adversity in a multicultural and international environment
• You are a fast learner, have a proactive attitude to drive solutions, and have a high level of team orientation
• You are curious and attentive to detail with a strong problem-solving capability
• You are fluent in English (written and spoken)
• You have a strong proficiency in Python and its data science ecosystem (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow).
• You have Experience with Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques and frameworks (e.g., Hugging Face, spaCy).
• You have Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs) and prompt engineering.
• Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI, or Matplotlib/Seaborn). What do we offer?
• Become a Regulatory Affairs professional for IVDs/MDs.
• Develop a Regulatory Mindset and understand the most important regulations and industry standards. •

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary) The Medical Science Head, Immunology is the medical expert of immunology disease area, and is accountable for the success of the company in the disease area. The individual in this role will lead a team of Country Medical Managers and Medical Science Managers, and is accountable for the development, delivery and execution of the medical strategy for a given disease area. The individual in this role will maintain a comprehensive and in-depth understanding of the medical strategy and relevant clinical, market and access landscapes for their assigned disease area. In addition, the individual in this role will bridge internal partner functions(including Research, Product Development, GPS/CPS, Commercial and Access) and collaborating across the dynamic health ecosystem to ultimately deliver better patient outcomes
• Accountable for the overall setting and delivery of disease area(DA) medical strategic and medical plan for the responsible DAs
• Enhances and drives effective collaboration with external partners (TAEs, Societies and Collaborative Groups) to identify and fulfill appropriate opportunities to advance science and solutions for patients.
• Actively build up internal cross-functional strategic partnership for assigned DA(s), also including global networking
• Responsible for appropriate resource planning in the teams to guarantee activities take place as planned, and within budget
• Responsible for people management and development, as well as all other line manager responsibilities
• Ensures strict adherence to the company’s corporate policies, SOP and local regulations for all initiatives for assigned DA(s) Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities (Major functions of the position) Medical Strategy and planning
• Accountable for development, delivery and maintenance of DA medical strategy
• Builds deep understanding of the current and future direction of the assigned DA(s)
• Drive the synthesis and translation of complex scientific data/clinical situations into strategy and solutions to optimize care for patients
• Creates and executes long term medical affairs DA strategy
• Ultimately accountable to provide strategic perspective based on a deep understanding of clinical decision-making to inform decisions about unmet medical needs and the impact of clinical data on clinical practice pattern
• Accountable for team development, delivery and maintenance of strategically aligned Medical Plans (on-market & in portfolio) within assigned DA(s)
• Leads Country Medical Managers and Medical Science Manager(MSM) Leaders working on the same product or DA to develop and execute annual medical plan
• Ensure medical plan is to aligned with global medical plan, DA strategy and brand strategy
• Leads Country Medical Managers to periodical update medical plan to reflect the change of the competitive landscape and critical business strategy change if appropriate
• On time, quality and within budget delivery of the medical plan, either directly or through team member(s)
• Supervises team to actively build up internal cross-functional strategic partnership for assigned DA(s), also including global networking
• Acts as point of contact for any strategic discussion on the assigned DA(s)
• Partner effectively across the medical and strategy network, within China cross functions(Access, CPS, PD China, CiCOR) and with global(PD, PDMA & GPS) colleagues to create and deliver options to support short and long-term

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Purpose of the role: Your mission is to support the evolution of our operational landscape. You will focus on converting traditional routine processes into agile, AI-enhanced workflows. Additionally, you will provide essential support to our Document Management team, ensuring key project documents are managed and processed accurately within our Electronic Document Management Systems (EDMS), specifically DiaDoc and SAP. Main responsibilities:
• Process Analysis: Critically evaluate established routine processes to identify specific opportunities for AI-driven optimization and efficiency gains.
• Implementation & Strategy: Support the deployment and maintenance of intelligent solutions while assisting with internal communication strategies to ensure smooth adoption.
• Operational Support: Assist in the daily management of project documentation, ensuring high standards of data integrity and accessibility. How would your day to day look like?
• Immersive Learning: You will start by integrating into our daily routines, gaining a deep understanding of our workflows and the interdependencies that drive our business.
• Collaborative Problem-Solving : You will work closely with cross-functional team members to understand their pain points and translate their ideas into tangible efficiency gains.
• Technical Innovation: You will spend significant time developing and supporting intelligent, AI-based solutions tailored to our specific organizational needs.
• Hands-on Document Management : You will gain practical experience in an international regulatory environment by processing selected project documents within our professional EDMS. Who are you?
• Education: You are a recent Bachelor’s or Master’s graduate looking to launch your career in a high-impact environment.
• Technical Agility: You possess a sophisticated understanding of the current AI landscape and have the technical aptitude to integrate smart solutions into a professional corporate infrastructure.
• Solution-Oriented Mindset: You are a motivated problem-solver who is eager to take digital infrastructure to the next level.
• Global Perspective: You are excited to collaborate with international teams and thrive in a fast-paced, world-class diagnostic organization. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Favoriser l'amélioration continue et l'innovation dans les rapports sur la durabilité des P&C, en tirant parti des possibilités de transformation du numérique, des données et des processus. title: Internship in BGE Sensor Development (Rotkreuz, 6-12 month)

titleByLocale.it: Tirocinio nello sviluppo di sensori BGE (Rotkreuz, 6-12 mesi)
titleByLocale.en: Internship in BGE Sensor Development (Rotkreuz, 6-12 month)
titleByLocale.de: Internship in BGE Sensor Development (Rotkreuz, 6-12 month)
titleByLocale.fr: Internship in BGE Sensor Development (Rotkreuz, 6-12 month)

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Shape the Future of Medical Diagnostics: Internship in Blood Gas & Electrolyte Sensor Development Our team, «BGE Sensors & Reagents,» develops, characterizes, and optimizes various electrochemical sensors for medical devices in the field of IVD diagnostics, focusing on the measurement of blood gases, electrolytes, and metabolites in whole blood. To deliver the desired products, we select electrochemical, optical, or enzymatic measurement principles and develop the corresponding sensors. The opportunity Dive into the world of cutting-edge sensor development with a 6-12 month internship (flexible to fit your schedule). You'll collaborate with our expert team to design, test, and optimize electrochemical sensors used in life-saving medical devices. This is your chance to apply your scientific knowledge to real-world challenges and contribute to groundbreaking advancements in healthcare. In this position, you will
• Collaborate with our technical experts in the development and enhancement of sensors for blood gas analysis.
• Contribute to sensor design investigations by planning and conducting various physical and chemical experiments and tests. You will assist in the synthesis and characterization of different functional sensor components.
• Help improve material stability to extend shelf life and reduce the need for complex storage by optimizing the chemical composition and synthesis processes.
• Support the development team with your scientific expertise and gain a deep understanding of complex electrochemical sensors and processes, including their characterization and optimization.
• Manage assigned work packages, plan and execute experiments, and prepare detailed analyses and documentation. You will have access to various analytical methods and tools for sensor and material analysis, as well as data analysis software to compile technical reports.
• Receive a comprehensive introduction to the intricate and challenging field of sensor development for globally used medical devices. Who you Are We are looking for a motivated and inquisitive student or recent graduate with a background in Engineering/Science (e.g., Master's or PhD degree from a Technical University), ideally in Biomedical, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Physical Chemistry, or a related field. You should have some initial experience in biochemical sensor characterization and sensor simulation development (including Python coding, computational chemistry, sensor testing, and characterization). Your graduation should be within the last 12 months of the start date. Additionally:
• You are eager to gain practical experience in an industrial setting and learn about development processes within a leading medical device company.
• You are interested in developing electrochemical sensors, which you will help produce, measure using chemical and electrochemical methods, analyze the resulting data, and study in silico simulations.
• You have a structured and independent approach to conducting experiments and documenting results.
• You are open, adaptable, and a team player.
• You possess strong written and verbal communication skills in English (and preferably German). ​ Additional information
• Start Date: August 2026
• Workload: 100%
• Duration: Minimum 6 months (with potential for extension to 12 months) Application process Please submit your complete application, including:
• Your CV
• A compelling Motivation Letter
• A certificate of enrollment (if you are currently studying) OR re

• Collaborate with our technical experts in the development and enhancement of sensors for blood gas analysis.
• Contribute to sensor design investigations by planning and conducting various physical and chemical experiments and tests. You will assist in the synthesis and characterization of different functional sensor components.
• Help improve material stability to extend shelf life and reduce the need for complex storage by optimizing the chemical composition and synthesis processes.
• Support the development team with your scientific expertise and gain a deep understanding of complex electrochemical sensors and processes, including their characterization and optimization.
• Manage assigned work packages, plan and execute experiments, and prepare detailed analyses and documentation. You will have access to various analytical methods and tools for sensor and material analysis, as well as data analysis software to compile technical reports.
• Receive a comprehensive introduction to the intricate and challenging field of sensor development for globally used medical devices. You should have some initial experience in biochemical sensor characterization and sensor simulation development (including Python coding, computational chemistry, sensor testing, and characterization). Your graduation should be within the last 12 months of the start date. Additionally:
• You are eager to gain practical experience in an industrial setting and learn about development processes within a leading medical device company.
• You are interested in developing electrochemical sensors, which you will help produce, measure using chemical and electrochemical methods, analyze the resulting data, and study in silico simulations.
• You have a structured and independent approach to conducting experiments and documenting results.
• You are open, adaptable, and a team player.
• You possess strong written and verbal communication skills in English (and preferably German). ​ Additional information
• Start Date: August 2026
• Workload: 100%
• Duration: Minimum 6 months (with potential for extension to 12 months) Application process Please submit your complete application, including:
• Your CV
• A compelling Motivation Letter
• A certificate of enrollment (if you are currently studying) OR re

The Position Head of Product Business Workflow Platform and Services Job description The Senior Product Leader is accountable for the entire product lifecycle, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to launch, scaling, and eventual retirement of a complex product. This role is pivotal in transforming scientific and business needs into tangible, high-value technology solutions. You will be responsible for defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, ensuring it aligns with the overarching goals of our organization and ultimately accelerates the delivery of life-changing diagnostics and medicines to patients. This role demands a distinctive combination of scientific inquisitiveness, technical proficiency, and business insight to successfully navigate the landscape. Your primary objective is to lead engineering and service teams building desirable, feasible, viable, and sustainable products that meet the evolving needs of our internal users while maintaining strict compliance with relevant industry standards. These platforms are consumed by others to create business facing platforms, products and services.The Business Workflow Platform in use is ServiceNow, from which function specific modules are enabled to allow business functions within Roche to build workflows to serve their specific needs. Examples of products and workflows consumed by the platform are ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, SPM, and Risk Management. Job Responsibilities
• Strategy & Vision Accountable for setting the direction for a complex product and ensuring that it achieves business outcomes and financial objectives. Monitor business, market, and technology trends to inform product strategy and proactively propose new solutions. Proactively integrate relevant AI capabilities into the product roadmap. Define, track, and communicate relevant KPIs for the product to measure its performance and contribution to business goals and strategy. Define and maintain a multi-year ServiceNow roadmap aligned with business goals.
• Customer-Centricity Establish a clear and aspirational vision for the end-to-end user experience across all touchpoints and product lines. Proactively identify emerging trends and market shifts to inform the long-term product roadmaps and maintain a competitive advantage. Define and track KPIs and use this data to inform product iterations.

Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for a complex product or products in a portfolio, and influence the long-term product strategies and roadmaps of related products. Identify new opportunities for innovation and growth. Identify and capitalise on emerging market trends and technologies to shape the future of the industry and to create new opportunities for the company.
