At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity: As a Regulatory Specialist , you will be responsible for compiling documents and deliverables to support planned product registration timelines. You will maintain product registration throughout a product’s lifecycle by applying successful regulatory change control and ensuring alignment with local and regional registration requirements. You will work independently within guidelines and policies, acting as a resource for colleagues with less experience and providing functional guidance. Your key responsibilities will include:
• Submission Management: Coordinate and prepare document packages for regulatory submissions, license renewals, and annual registrations for new and mature products.
• Lifecycle Maintenance: Support currently marketed products regarding labeling, manufacturing changes, and technical file maintenance to ensure ongoing compliance with Global Regulatory directives.
• Information Systems: Maintain and create product information and reports within the Regulatory Information Management System and support documentation management workflows.
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Interface with internal stakeholders and external partners (Health Authorities/Notified Bodies) to promote successful registration strategies and answer submission-related inquiries.
• Global Support: Support international regulatory submissions by providing needed data and documents, keeping Affiliates informed of new products, projects, or process changes.
• Compliance & Strategy: Keep abreast of regulatory procedures and changes, recommending strategies for the earliest possible approvals of clinical trials applications and improving tracking/control systems. Who you are: You are a proactive professional with strong communication skills, a resolution-oriented mindset, and the ability to manage complex documentation in a regulated environment. Requirements and Qualifications:
• Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Biology, Chemistry, Pharmacy, or related fields.
• Experience: Proven experience in Regulatory, R&D, Quality, Operations, or Clinical teams, specifically including documentation and country registration tasks. Experience with In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) is a plus.
• Languages: Advanced English proficiency is a requirement.
• Core Competencies: * Proactive with strong self-management capabilities.
• Flexible, adaptable, and a curious "learning enthusiast."
• Process improvement oriented and able to work independently. Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position This role is within Biostatistics, a core function within Product Development Data Science and Analytics (PDD) that provides strategic leadership and scientific rigor across Development at Roche. Biostatistics identifies opportunities to apply the full breadth of data, digital, and design capabilities to deploy innovative methods across PDD, PD and the broader Roche Pharma organization. As trusted analytical partners in end-to-end drug development, Biostatistics leverages data to drive scientifically rigorous programmatic decisions across Roche’s Development portfolio; Biostatistics designs robust trials and analysis plans that increase the probability of technical success, accelerating timelines to advance Roche’s clinical pipeline and promote regulatory success — ultimately bringing medicines to our patients faster. The Opportunity: The Statistician is a key member of the cross-functional study or molecule team, responsible for applying statistical expertise to the design, conduct, analysis, and interpretation of individual clinical trials. This role ensures the scientific rigor and regulatory compliance of the study by contributing to protocol development, authoring statistical analysis plans, performing or overseeing data analyses, and supporting the interpretation and communication of results. The Statistician plays a critical role in ensuring that each study generates robust, meaningful data to support decision-making and regulatory submissions.
• You contribute to trial design under guidance, applying standard statistical methods
• You draft and review protocols, statistical analysis plans (SAPs), and case report forms (CRFs) using templates and precedents
• You perform or support statistical analyses as per statistical analysis plans, escalating issues when needed
• You represent Biostatistics and PDD at the Study Team level, ensuring statistical and scientific rigor of study deliverables under guidance
• You collaborate with study team members to meet deliverables, following existing processes
• You summarize findings clearly with support from senior colleagues
• You contribute to CSR development and regulatory responses using established templates
• You apply judgment to address moderately complex statistical or data issues, balancing scientific rigor with appropriate flexibility, and seek guidance when facing novel or ambiguous situations
• You adhere to functional standards by participating in peer review and mentoring relationships to uphold quality and build methodological and regulatory expertise Who You Are:
• You hold an MSc or PhD in Statistics, Biostatistics, or a closely related quantitative field
• You have 1-3 years of relevant experience in clinical trial statistics within a pharmaceutical, biotech, or CRO setting
• You are familiar with ICH guidelines, GCP, and regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, EMA)
• You have a strong understanding of statistical principles and methodology relevant to clinical trial design and analysis
• You are proficient in SAS and/or R and familiar with CDISC standards
• You demonstrate capacity for independent thinking and ability to make decisions based upon sound principles
• You bring excellent strategic agility including problem-solving and critical thinking skills, and agility that extends beyond the technical domain
• You demonstrate respect for cultural differences when interacting with colleagues in the global workplace
• You have excellent verbal and written communication skills, spec

As trusted analytical partners in end-to-end drug development, Biostatistics leverages data to drive scientifically rigorous programmatic decisions across Roche’s Development portfolio; Biostatistics designs robust trials and analysis plans that increase the probability of technical success, accelerating timelines to advance Roche’s clinical pipeline and promote regulatory success — ultimately bringing medicines to our patients faster. The Opportunity: The Statistician is a key member of the cross-functional study or molecule team, responsible for applying statistical expertise to the design, conduct, analysis, and interpretation of individual clinical trials. This role ensures the scientific rigor and regulatory compliance of the study by contributing to protocol development, authoring statistical analysis plans, performing or overseeing data analyses, and supporting the interpretation and communication of results. The Statistician plays a critical role in ensuring that each study generates robust, meaningful data to support decision-making and regulatory submissions.
• You contribute to trial design under guidance, applying standard statistical methods
• You draft and review protocols, statistical analysis plans (SAPs), and case report forms (CRFs) using templates and precedents
• You perform or support statistical analyses as per statistical analysis plans, escalating issues when needed
• You represent Biostatistics and PDD at the Study Team level, ensuring statistical and scientific rigor of study deliverables under guidance
• You collaborate with study team members to meet deliverables, following existing processes
• You summarize findings clearly with support from senior colleagues
• You contribute to CSR development and regulatory responses using established templates
• You apply judgment to address moderately complex statistical or data issues, balancing scientific rigor with appropriate flexibility, and seek guidance when facing novel or ambiguous situations
• You adhere to functional standards by participating in peer review and mentoring relationships to uphold quality and build methodological and regulatory expertise Who You Are:
• You hold an MSc or PhD in Statistics, Biostatistics, or a closely related quantitative field
• You have 1-3 years of relevant experience in clinical trial statistics within a pharmaceutical, biotech, or CRO setting
• You are familiar with ICH guidelines, GCP, and regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, EMA)
• You have a strong understanding of statistical principles and methodology relevant to clinical trial design and analysis
• You are proficient in SAS and/or R and familiar with CDISC standards
• You demonstrate capacity for independent thinking and ability to make decisions based upon sound principles
• You bring excellent strategic agility including problem-solving and critical thinking skills, and agility that extends beyond the technical domain
• You demonstrate respect for cultural differences when interacting with colleagues in the global workplace
• You have excellent verbal and written communication skills, spec

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Let’s build a healthier future, together. By combining our unique strengths, we’re redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. Discover what it’s like to work at Roche. The Opportunity The Global Security Monitoring and Incident Response (MIR) team at Roche strives to keep our networks and users safe from constantly evolving threats. As a Security Engineer on the Vulnerability and Exposure Management Team, you will help protect sensitive data and defend computer systems and web applications from existing and emerging threats. You will not just be managing scanner output. You will help manage and reduce existing risks, assess and evaluate the weaponization of emerging risks, and act as a core builder of our future capabilities. Responsibilities
• Triage, investigate, and respond to critical vulnerabilities affecting Roche
• Evaluate and prioritize vulnerabilities found through our tools, including our bug-bounty program
• Research emerging vulnerabilities and develop methods to confirm exploitability against our attack surface
• Communicate risk and work with system owners and other stakeholders to mitigate security vulnerabilities
• Assess company systems and web applications using both automated and manual tools
• Maintain, improve, and engineer our scanning, detection, and automation solutions
• Participating in security monitoring for a global environment Who you are
• Associate degree in relevant field or 5+ years in information security and fluent English.
• Programming experience (Python, Node.js, JavaScript) and ability to write custom detection logic, scripts, and templates
• Demonstrated ability to triage, analyze, and escalate vulnerabilities; experience validating vulnerabilities and basic exploit development in large global environments
• Focus on web application, network, and computer security; cloud security experience; familiarity with attack surface management and AI-assisted development tools
• Strong communication skills explaining complex risks to non-technical audiences; comfort balancing operational tasks with research; passion for security
• Industry certifications in offensive security (OSCP, GWAPT, OSWE); open-source security project contributions Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Role Description & Mission Experience Required -7 to 14 years As an IT Quality/Validation Specialist in RDT / Pharma R&D, you will independently manage end-to-end quality and analysis tasks across various capabilities. You will provide expertise, guidance, and coaching as a subject matter expert to relevant stakeholders and RDT colleagues to ensure best practices are practically and pragmatically applied. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will lead the analysis of moderately complex business problems, define problem scopes, drive root cause analysis, and translate requirements into strategic implementation plans that align with overarching business objectives. What You’ll Be Working On (Job Responsibilities)
• Validation & Compliance: Stay up to date on relevant industry guidance & regulations relating to Computer Software Validation and Assurance (such as, but not limited to: AAMI: TIR45 (2012), 21 CFR Part 11, and Annex 11). Support periodic reviews and implementation of CSV policies, ensure inspection readiness, and provide support during audits.
• Scope & Content Leadership: Independently manage end-to-end quality analysis tasks across various capabilities, mentor more junior team members, and contribute to the development of Quality Specialist best practices.
• Risk-Based Quality Assurance: Partner with relevant stakeholders to ensure that control artefacts relating to IT technical product development, maintenance, and deployment processes are "right-sized" based on the risk profile of the system.
• Accountability & Problem Solving: Independently lead the analysis of moderately complex business problems, driving root cause analysis and synthesizing complex stakeholder needs. Apply advanced analytical and logical reasoning to proactively identify discrepancies, evaluate change scope, and drive process improvement initiatives.
• Agile & CSV Validation: As an active part of CSV and Agile validation processes, you will be working on reviews and approvals of documents and changes. Provide advice, guidance, and coaching to squads on the appropriate application of supporting tools (such as JIRA, HP ALM, Retina, Trello, Service Now, etc.) to meet Computer Systems Validation and Assurance needs.
• Stakeholder Management: Identify a diverse range of stakeholders across functional areas, analyzing their influence and impact on project outcomes. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Business Quality to ensure compliance with corporate policies regarding computer software assurance and alignment across the network.
• Impact, Strategy & Complexity: Manage quality analysis activities on more complex projects or across multiple products within a domain. Translate requirements into strategic implementation plans, evaluate solution options (including cost-benefit analysis), and develop comprehensive stakeholder maps. The Ideal Candidate (Qualifications & Experience)
• Experience: Experience independently managing end-to-end quality analysis tasks across various capabilities and driving root cause analysis. Must be passionate about compliance and able to inspire others.
• Validation Expertise: Exhibits the behaviors and understanding of computer system assurance/validation. Enables speed where speed is appropriate and control where control is necessary by applying a deep understanding of risk-based validation/assurance approaches.
• Methodology: Passionate about critical thinking, risk-based problem-solving, and Agile/SCRUM methodology.

As the Product Owner (PO) for Digital Process Automation , you will be a techno-functional leader within the Workflow Automation team at Roche. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex business requirements and technical execution, serving as the primary visionary for our DPA platform. You will take ownership of the product roadmap, navigating ambiguous business needs to deliver high-impact automation solutions. Leveraging your expertise in Pega or similar platforms, you will lead agile squads to build scalable, secure, and efficient workflows that transform Roche’s digital landscape.

• Drive Product Vision: Take full ownership of the DPA product backlog, translating high-level business strategies into well-defined user stories and technical requirements.

• Optimize Digital Journeys: Influence the technical direction of the DPA ecosystem to create seamless integrated workflows that reduce manual effort and maximize organizational value.

Who you are

• Proven Product Leader: You bring 3–5 years of experience leading product teams as a Product Owner within an Agile environment, specifically delivering complex software products.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) is the market leader in the In-Vitro Diagnostics business. Within that ecosystem, Research & Early Development is the home for early research activities and plays an integral role in rapidly delivering innovation in discovery and specific customer area needs. For the business to remain competitive in the future, a dedicated management of innovation is of central importance.

To be successful as an Innovation Manager in our organization, a unique capability to thrive in ambiguity is needed, managing research process design to accelerate discovery while ensuring alignment with long-term business strategy. Beyond technical oversight, the role is defined by strategic diplomacy. An Innovation Manager must excel as a research ambassador, translating complex scientific impact into value propositions for diverse stakeholders.

The Opportunity:
• ● Influencing Without Authority: Using organizational and interpersonal awareness and finesse to drive delivery across levels.
• ● Systems Thinking: Navigating the interface between science, medical, and business sectors to manage dependencies at scale.
• ● Resilient Execution: Combining project management rigor with change management and persistence to ensure critical work reaches completion despite structural obstacles.
• ● Supports enterprise research in creating, funneling and harvesting cutting-edge innovation ideas, acts as a neutral thought partner to practice the idea acceptability
• ● Hosts innovation challenges addressing shared problem statements of global RDS Research
● Sparks and cultivates a cross-divisional innovation mindset, acts as change agent to coach the organization on the global research strategy and vision and advocate for the customer and the business role in innovation
• ● Uses independent evaluation, selection, and substantial adaptation and modification of standard project management and communication techniques, procedures and
• criteria to navigate the complex flexible dynamic nature of research and early
• development projects
• ● Actively builds and cultivates connections into the scientific network and maintains
• expert knowledge of industry trends, competition, and emerging innovations,
• contributes to strategic innovation roadmapping for early research
● Organizes and facilitates interdisciplinary workshops applying innovative and agile methodologies to achieve workshop outcomes in creative and effective ways, in order to contribute to problem discovery and challenge-driven ideation
• ● Plans, manages and monitors research operations to support the activities,
• processes, communication and digital infrastructure of research and early
• development and its innovation framework
• ● Collaborates cross-functionally with experts within Research & Development (R&D),CDMA (Clinical Development and Medical Affairs), Partnering and beyond
• ● Monitors and optimizes processes in order to increase quality and efficiency
• standards, promotes and participates in the professional development of best
• practices and process principles to manage risks, to achieve objectives in creative and effective ways and to increase quality and efficiency standards
• ● Coaches and trains other members of the team on the subject matter exp

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deja Tu Huella - Ophthalmology Medical Affairs and Integrated Portfolio Strategy Intern

What do we offer?

To be part of a new cohort of the Roche-CEU San Pablo postgraduate degree as an expert in the Pharmaceutical Industry. An 11-month internship at Roche where you will participate in challenging projects and benefit from pioneering postgraduate training in the market about the pharmaceutical industry.

You will have the opportunity to receive on-the-job training by working on key projects with your designated department from Monday to Thursday and attending in-person postgraduate classes at the university on Friday.

Our main location is Madrid. We are open to applications from all over Spain, but relocation will be needed as part of the program expectations. Office attendance is expected (with some flexibility) to enjoy connection with colleagues, networking opportunities, and exposure to the organization.

Last but not least, you will receive mentorship from a Roche tutor who will provide continuous feedback to support your professional development. The mentors for the program are Roche’s senior and experienced young talent development professionals.

Main responsibilities as an intern:

Medical

• Collaborate within the iSquad alongside the team’s medical experts on activities related to:

• Medical pipeline plans (including vamikibart, satralizumab, PDP, among others).

• Congress planning and coordination.

• TAE (Thought Leader/Therapy Area Expert) plans.

• Local iEP initiatives.

• Organization and coordination of medical education events and courses.

• Support the coordination of working groups with PJPs and the iSquad team to identify needs and collaborate with regional teams.

• Participate in cross-functional initiatives and contribute to the follow-up of strategic medical projects.

• Support communication and presentation of project updates within the team environment.

Marketing

• Support the preparation and review of promotional materials.

• Collaborate in the organization of events, campaigns, and product launches.

• Assist in monitoring digital activities, including web, social media, and e-mailing initiatives.

• Conduct market research and competitor analysis.

• Support departmental administrative activities, including database management and coordination with agencies.

What are we looking for?

Education

• Graduates in Life Sciences or Health Sciences (preferred).

• Strong scientific background.

• Research experience and/or scientific publications are considered a plus.

• Previous knowledge or exposure to marketing activities is valued.

Skills: Strong teamwork and collaboration skills. Excellent organizational skills and ability to prioritize activities effectively. Strong communication skills, including the ability to present project updates in controlled environments. Advanced digital capabilities and interest in innovation.

Competencies : Scientific mindset with analytical thinking. Proactivity and adaptability. Strong learning agility and curiosity. Innovative mindset with interest in improving existing ways of working.

Technical Knowledge: Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Excel. Knowledge of new technologies, Artificial Intelligence, and advanced design tools.

Mindset: Curious and motivated candidates willing to learn and contribute in a collaborative environment. Passion for innovation and continuous improvement. Interest in developing within Medical, Marketing, or cross-functional pharmaceutical ro

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deja Tu Huella - Ophthalmology Medical Affairs and Integrated Portfolio Strategy Intern

What do we offer?

To be part of a new cohort of the Roche-CEU San Pablo postgraduate degree as an expert in the Pharmaceutical Industry. An 11-month internship at Roche where you will participate in challenging projects and benefit from pioneering postgraduate training in the market about the pharmaceutical industry.

You will have the opportunity to receive on-the-job training by working on key projects with your designated department from Monday to Thursday and attending in-person postgraduate classes at the university on Friday.

Our main location is Madrid. We are open to applications from all over Spain, but relocation will be needed as part of the program expectations. Office attendance is expected (with some flexibility) to enjoy connection with colleagues, networking opportunities, and exposure to the organization.

Last but not least, you will receive mentorship from a Roche tutor who will provide continuous feedback to support your professional development. The mentors for the program are Roche’s senior and experienced young talent development professionals.

Main responsibilities as an intern:

Medical

• Collaborate within the iSquad alongside the team’s medical experts on activities related to:

• Medical pipeline plans (including vamikibart, satralizumab, PDP, among others).

• Congress planning and coordination.

• TAE (Thought Leader/Therapy Area Expert) plans.

• Local iEP initiatives.

• Organization and coordination of medical education events and courses.

• Support the coordination of working groups with PJPs and the iSquad team to identify needs and collaborate with regional teams.

• Participate in cross-functional initiatives and contribute to the follow-up of strategic medical projects.

• Support communication and presentation of project updates within the team environment.

Marketing

• Support the preparation and review of promotional materials.

• Collaborate in the organization of events, campaigns, and product launches.

• Assist in monitoring digital activities, including web, social media, and e-mailing initiatives.

• Conduct market research and competitor analysis.

• Support departmental administrative activities, including database management and coordination with agencies.

What are we looking for?

Education

• Graduates in Life Sciences or Health Sciences (preferred).

• Strong scientific background.

• Research experience and/or scientific publications are considered a plus.

• Previous knowledge or exposure to marketing activities is valued.

Skills: Strong teamwork and collaboration skills. Excellent organizational skills and ability to prioritize activities effectively. Strong communication skills, including the ability to present project updates in controlled environments. Advanced digital capabilities and interest in innovation.

Competencies : Scientific mindset with analytical thinking. Proactivity and adaptability. Strong learning agility and curiosity. Innovative mindset with interest in improving existing ways of working.

Technical Knowledge: Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Excel. Knowledge of new technologies, Artificial Intelligence, and advanced design tools.

Mindset: Curious and motivated candidates willing to learn and contribute in a collaborative environment. Passion for innovation and continuous improvement. Interest in developing within Medical, Marketing, or cross-functional pharmaceutical ro

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deja tu Huella - Finance Enterprise Partner (Intern):

What do we offer?

To be part of a new cohort of the Roche-CEU San Pablo postgraduate degree as an expert in the Pharmaceutical Industry. An 11-month internship at Roche where you will participate in challenging projects and benefit from pioneering postgraduate training in the market about the pharmaceutical industry.

You will have the opportunity to receive on-the-job training by working on key projects with your designated department from Monday to Thursday and attending in-person postgraduate classes at the university on Friday.

Our main location is Madrid. We are open to applications from all over Spain, but relocation will be needed as part of the program expectations. Office attendance is expected (with some flexibility) to encourage collaboration, networking, and exposure to multidisciplinary teams and international stakeholders.

Last but not least, you will receive mentorship from a Roche tutor who will provide continuous feedback to support your professional development. The mentors for the program are Roche’s senior and experienced young talent development professionals.

Main responsibilities as an intern:

Be an active member of our squads and business teams, your work will directly impact our strategy:

• Strategic Investment & Forecasting: Drive decision-making by developing business scenarios, optimizing investments, and delivering precise sales forecasting to maximize financial returns.

• Data-Driven Insights & AI: Utilize Artificial Intelligence and advanced analytics—leveraging both internal and external data—to identify value drivers and set ambitious business goals.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with multidisciplinary squads and various therapeutic areas to update Business Plans and lead resource prioritization initiatives.

• Global Networking & Best Practices: Engage with international teams to foster synergies, attract specialized knowledge, and export local best practices across the global organization.

• Tactical Impact Monitoring: Track the effectiveness of commercial tactics and financial strategies to ensure the business achieves its long-term vision and success in the healthcare sector.

What are we looking for?

• Educational Background: We are seeking candidates with a university degree in Business Administration (ADE) + Data Analytics/Data Science, Finance, Economics, International Business, or Engineering (e.g., IE, Business, Engineering, Analytics).

• Analytical Expertise: Strong analytical skills with proven knowledge of business forecasting, as well as financial and analytical management.

• International Profile: A global mindset with the flexibility and capacity for international mobility.

• Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in SAP, BW, SAC, Tableau, Microsoft Office Suite, and Copilot is highly valued.

• Advanced Tools & Presentation: Expert-level skills in Excel (including macros), the application of AI for analytical purposes, and the ability to deliver high-impact strategic and analytical business presentations.

• Soft Skills & Collaboration: Exceptional teamwork and collaborative skills within high-performance environments, with strong communication and influence capabilities.

• Languages: High level of English required. Spanish proficiency is highly valued.

• Commitment: Full time dedication from September 2026 to August 2027.

And remember, being part of this program offers you:

• Postgraduate University CEU-Roche : "Deja tu Huel

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deja tu Huella - Digital Intern

What do we offer?

To be part of a new cohort of the Roche-CEU San Pablo postgraduate degree as an expert in the Pharmaceutical Industry. 11 months of internships at Roche where you will participate in challenging projects and benefit from pioneering postgraduate training in the market about the pharmaceutical industry.

You will have the opportunity to get on the job training by working on key projects with your designated department from Monday to Thursday and attend in person postgraduate classes at the university on Friday.

Our main location is Madrid , we are open to applications from all over Spain but relocation will be needed as part of the program expectations. Office attendance is expected (with some flexbility) to enjoy the connection to our colleagues, network and get exposure.

Last but not least, you will have mentorship by a Roche tutor who will give you continuous feedback to develop your professional skills. The mentors for the program are Roche's senior and experienced young talent development professionals.

Apply for this offer and follow us at @RocheES to share with your network a unique opportunity in the market to start your professional career in the pharmaceutical sector.

Purpose of this internship?

Opportunity to be actively involved in omnichannel strategy, with a focus on enhancing customer experience, working across digital channels, driving innovation, and exploring the potential of Artificial Intelligence within the pharmaceutical industry.

What would be your main responsibilities as an intern?

Support Digital Experts in the design and implementation of digital strategies across therapeutic areas. Responsibilities include developing email marketing campaigns, managing social media content, extracting actionable insights to improve user experience, and contributing creative ideas to optimize digital engagement. The role also involves collaborating closely with cross-functional teams and leveraging digital tools and platforms to drive innovation and deliver impactful solutions.

What are we looking for in this position?

• Recent graduates or university students who will obtain their degree in the summer, in fields such as: Digital Marketing, Business Administration, Innovation, or any degree with a strong interest in digital transformation, customer experience, consumer behavior or digital marketing.

• Curiosity, proactivity, creativity, strong communication skills, and a passion for innovation and the digital world.

• We want proactive and curious candidates that are willing to learn and grow by challenging the status quo.

• We are looking for flexible talents that adapt to changes and are willing to collaborate with teams in a network organization.

• Advanced level of communication in English and Spanish.

• Desirable to have international experience as a student or working abroad.

• Passion for improving the lives of patients and motivation to give the best of yourself in an innovative and challenging environment.

• Commitment to dedicate yourself full time to the program from September 2026 to August 2027.

• For international students, have a valid NIE or work permit in Spain.

And remember, being part of this program offers you:

• Postgraduate University CEU-Roche: "Deja tu Huella" program with great value in the labor market

• Competitive package: Paid internships with additional benefits

• 11 months of internship in which you will be able to develop relevant project

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deja tu Huella - Commercialization Excellence Analytics Intern

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Formar parte de una nueva promoción del posgrado Roche-CEU San Pablo como experto en la Industria Farmacéutica. Disfrutarás de 11 meses de prácticas en Roche participando en proyectos de alto impacto y accediendo a formación diferencial en el sector.

Tendrás la oportunidad de adquirir experiencia práctica trabajando en proyectos clave con tu equipo de lunes a jueves, mientras que los viernes asistirás a clases presenciales del posgrado en la universidad.

Nuestra ubicación principal es Madrid. Estamos abiertos a candidaturas de toda España, pero será necesario trasladarse como parte del programa. Se espera asistencia a oficina (con cierta flexibilidad) para fomentar la conexión con el equipo y el desarrollo de tu red profesional.

Además, contarás con el acompañamiento de un tutor/a de Roche que te proporcionará feedback continuo para impulsar tu desarrollo profesional.
Aplica a esta oferta y síguenos en @RocheES para compartir una oportunidad única para comenzar tu carrera en la industria farmacéutica.

Principales responsabilidades como intern

COMEX & Analytics:

• Apoyar los procesos clave de segmentación y Core & Common , colaborando en la dimensión técnica (cálculo de matrices, dimensionamiento de ficheros y cargas)

• Dar soporte en Launch Readiness , ayudando a identificar nuevos stakeholders en áreas terapéuticas (ej. Lupus, Nefritis) mediante herramientas como CES y bases de datos como One Key

• Colaborar en la configuración de territorios y profiling en el CRM , contribuyendo a una correcta implementación de la estrategia comercial

• Brindar soporte transversal al equipo COMEX en extracción de datos, análisis y elaboración de presentaciones para la toma de decisiones

• Apoyar la operativa diaria del ecosistema CRM , asegurando la continuidad durante la transición al nuevo sistema ELEVATE

• Contribuir a la adopción de soluciones globales como ExcelencIA, CES o DA Sense dentro del flujo de trabajo del equipo

• Participar en iniciativas de innovación con IA , explorando oportunidades para optimizar procesos de análisis e insights

¿Qué buscamos?

Educación: Grado o Máster en Ingeniería, ADE, Estadística o similares. Muy valorable formación adicional en escuelas de negocio (ej. ISDI).

Skills:

• Pensamiento analítico aplicado y capacidad para trabajar con múltiples fuentes de datos (CRM, ventas, visitas, etc.)

• Conocimiento avanzado de Excel/Google Sheets y nivel medio-alto de SQL

• Capacidad para aprender herramientas de visualización ( Tableau, Power BI )

• Interés en el uso de IA aplicada al análisis de datos

Competencias:

• Comunicación clara y capacidad de síntesis

• Trabajo en equipo en entornos multidisciplinares

• Organización y orientación a resultados

• Perfil híbrido entre negocio y análisis

Mindset: Buscamos perfiles adaptables, con curiosidad intelectual y capacidad de aprendizaje en entornos de cambio, especialmente en procesos de transformación tecnológica.

Idiomas: Nivel alto de inglés y español.

Compromiso: Dedicación full-time durante 11 meses.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

Programa “Deja tu Huella”:
Un posgrado de prestigio Roche-CEU San Pablo diseñado para impulsarte en el mercado farmacéutico.

Paquete económico competitivo: Prácticas remuneradas con beneficios adicionales.

Experiencia profesional inmersiva: Participación directa en un momento clave de transformación del área COMEX

Mentorship personalizado: Acompañamiento continuo por par

descriptionByLocale.fr:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deja tu Huella - Commercialization Excellence Insights Intern

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Formar parte de una nueva promoción del posgrado Roche-CEU San Pablo como experto en la Industria Farmacéutica. Disfrutarás de 11 meses de prácticas en Roche participando en proyectos de alto impacto y accediendo a formación diferencial en el sector.

Tendrás la oportunidad de adquirir experiencia práctica trabajando en proyectos clave con tu equipo de lunes a jueves, mientras que los viernes asistirás a clases presenciales del posgrado en la universidad.

Nuestra ubicación principal es Madrid. Estamos abiertos a candidaturas de toda España, pero será necesario trasladarse como parte del programa. Se espera asistencia a oficina (con cierta flexibilidad) para fomentar la conexión con el equipo y el desarrollo de tu red profesional.

Además, contarás con el acompañamiento de un tutor/a de Roche que te proporcionará feedback continuo para impulsar tu desarrollo profesional.
Aplica a esta oferta y síguenos en @RocheES para compartir una oportunidad única para comenzar tu carrera en la industria farmacéutica.

Principales responsabilidades como intern:
Participar en los procesos clave de un analista de Insights dentro de un área terapéutica, entre las que se encuentran:

• Colaborar en la identificación de necesidades de información (insights plan) y en el diseño de análisis relevantes para la toma de decisiones.

• Analizar e interpretar datos , desarrollando una comprensión del área terapéutica y comunicando conclusiones de forma clara al equipo.

• Participar en todas las fases de los estudios de mercado (cuantitativos y cualitativos): definición de objetivos, diseño metodológico, coordinación con proveedores, seguimiento y análisis de resultados

• Apoyar en actividades de Competitive Intelligence , recopilando y analizando información de fuentes secundarias para la elaboración de informes estratégicos

• Participación y apoyo en proyectos transversales dentro del área de Insights, entre las que se encuentran:

• Apoyo al proceso de segmentación , participando en la coordinación, construcción de matrices y generación de entregables.

• Brindar soporte en la organización interna del equipo , incluyendo coordinación de agendas, seguimiento de proyectos y elaboración de minutas

• Apoyar la comunicación interna del equipo , contribuyendo a newsletters e informes transversales

¿Qué buscamos?

Educación: Grado universitario en Administración y Dirección de Empresas (ADE), Economía, Estadística, Marketing o titulaciones afines.

Skills:

• Pensamiento analítico aplicado y capacidad para trabajar con múltiples fuentes de datos para sacar conclusiones.

• Pensamiento de negocio, con enfoque estratégico y capacidad de enfocar insights a la toma de decisiones.

• Conocimiento avanzado de Excel/Google Sheets , y PowerPoint / Google Slides.

• Interés en el uso de IA aplicada al análisis de datos.

Competencias:

• Capacidad organizativa y de gestión de proyectos

• Comunicación clara y capacidad de síntesis

• Trabajo en equipo y colaboración transversal

• Proactividad e iniciativa

Mindset: Buscamos perfiles curiosos, con interés por entender el “por qué” detrás de los datos, que quieran desarrollar una visión estratégica del negocio y aportar valor a través del análisis.

Idiomas: Nivel alto de inglés y español.

Experiencia (valorable):

• Formación o experiencia en investigación de mercados o business analytics

• Experiencia en proyectos de inteligencia artificial aplicada al análisi

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deja tu Huella: Business Enabling & Capabilities - Intern

What do we offer?

To be part of a new cohort of the Roche-CEU San Pablo postgraduate degree as an expert in the Pharmaceutical Industry. 11 months of internships at Roche where you will participate in challenging projects and benefit from pioneering postgraduate training in the market about the pharmaceutical industry.

You will have the opportunity to get on-the-job training by working on key projects with your designated department from Monday to Thursday and attend in person postgraduate classes at the university on Friday.

Our main location is Madrid, we are open to applications from all over Spain but relocation will be needed as part of the program expectations. Office attendance is expected (with some flexibility) to enjoy the connection to our colleagues, network and get exposure.

Last but not least, you will have mentorship by a Roche tutor who will give you continuous feedback to develop your professional skills. The mentors for the program are Roche’s senior and experienced young talent development professionals.

Apply for this offer and follow us at @RocheES to share with your network a unique opportunity in the market to start your professional career in the pharmaceutical sector.

What are the main responsibilities of the Intern?

This internship is designed to help evolve learning beyond traditional training by contributing to the creation of a modern, digital, and scalable learning ecosystem that prepares Roche talent for the future of healthcare.

The intern will work closely with the Roche Academy Spain team and collaborate cross-functionally with different areas of the organization to help design impactful learning experiences, support capability development initiatives, and contribute to the evolution of Roche’s learning culture.

Main responsibilities include:

Digital Learning Ecosystem & SkillUp

• Supporting the organization and curation of learning content within Roche’s digital learning ecosystem, including SkillUp.

• Contributing to the design of intuitive and engaging digital learning experiences using technology and AI as facilitators of employee growth.

• Assisting in the optimization of content structures and learning journeys to improve the employee learning experience.

• Supporting the exploration and implementation of Generative AI tools and digital learning solutions.

Learning Journeys & Capability Development

• Collaborating in the creation of innovative learning journeys focused on future-relevant capabilities.

• Supporting the adaptation of global learning resources and external EdTech trends into high-value local learning experiences.

• Contributing to the alignment of learning initiatives with Roche’s global Commercialization Capabilities framework, especially for customer-facing teams.

• Helping identify new methodologies and approaches to improve employee engagement and capability development.

Learning Analytics & Business Impact

• Supporting the analysis of learning metrics, KPIs, and impact indicators to help measure the value of learning initiatives.

• Assisting in the unification of learning processes under the Roche Academy Spain identity and philosophy.

• Collaborating in the preparation of reports and presentations to communicate learning impact and business alignment.

• Contributing to the development of a data-driven learning culture focused on continuous improvement.

The Position
Deja tu Huella - Medical & Marketing Lung intern

What do we offer?

To be part of a new cohort of the Roche-CEU San Pablo postgraduate degree as an expert in the Pharmaceutical Industry. An 11-month internship at Roche where you will participate in challenging projects and benefit from pioneering postgraduate training in the market about the pharmaceutical industry.

You will have the opportunity to receive on-the-job training by working on key projects with your designated department from Monday to Thursday and attending in-person postgraduate classes at the university on Friday.

Our main location is Madrid. We are open to applications from all over Spain, but relocation will be needed as part of the program expectations. Office attendance is expected (with some flexibility) to enable collaboration, networking, and exposure across teams and ecosystems.

You will also receive mentorship from a Roche tutor who will provide continuous feedback to support your professional development. The mentors for the program are Roche’s senior and experienced young talent development professionals.

Apply for this offer and follow us at @RocheES to share with your network a unique opportunity in the market to start your professional career in the pharmaceutical sector.

Main responsibilities as an intern

Medical

• Facilitate medical education initiatives within the Pulmonology Squad.

• Monitor key clinical studies within the therapeutic area, including the associated publication plan.

• Manage content and briefing materials for medical education events in collaboration with medical teams.

• Optimize scientific content and enhance the impact and follow-up of medical events, coordinating with MCO, Legal & Compliance, ecosystems, communications, and digital teams.

• Support communication of the medical pipeline, including presentations, materials, and internal meetings.

• Contribute to improving coordination and alignment within the squad and across central and ecosystem teams.

• Support the development and exploration of AI-based tools to improve team coordination and operational efficiency.

Marketing

• Support the planning, execution, and follow-up of events, materials, and marketing actions.

• Assist in Pulmonology segmentation activities.

• Support the implementation of actions derived from segmentation strategies.

• Contribute to the development and execution of an omnichannel marketing plan.

• Assist in monitoring digital actions (web, social media, email campaigns).

• Conduct small-scale market research and competitor analysis.

• Support administrative tasks such as database management and coordination with agencies.

What are we looking for?

Education: Degree in Life Sciences or Health Sciences (preferred). Background in Marketing or Health Sciences considered valuable. Strong scientific understanding to support medical content development.

Skills: Strong communication and influence skills. Ability to work in networks and cross-functional teams. Project management mindset. Digital literacy and understanding of social media ecosystems. Ability to make data-driven decisions.

Competencies : Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize tasks. High level of operational efficiency. Ability to improve cohesion and alignment across teams and ecosystems. Proactivity, curiosity, and adaptability. Strong scientific mindset.

Technical Knowledge

• Advanced user of Microsoft Office tools.

• Familiarity with AI tools and digital platforms.

• Comfo

By joining the 'Deja tu huella' program, you will have the opportunity to take on the PJP (Patient Journey Partner) role within the Northeast ecosystem. This is a unique opportunity, as it is a position exclusive to Roche. It is a hybrid role that bridges the gap between the commercial focus and the MSL (Medical Scientific Liaison) perspective. 11 months of internships at Roche where you will participate in challenging projects and benefit from pioneering postgraduate training in the market about the pharmaceutical industry. You will have the opportunity to get on the job training by working on key projects with your designated department from Monday to Thursday and attend in person postgraduate classes at the university on Friday.

Our main location is Barcelona, Office attendance is expected (with some flexbility) to enjoy the connection to our colleagues, network and get exposure. Last but not least, you will have mentorship by a Roche tutor who will give you continuous feedback to develop your professional skills. The mentors for the program are Roche's senior and experienced young talent development professionals.

Apply for this offer and follow us at @RocheES to share with your network a unique opportunity in the market to start your professional career in the pharmaceutical sector.

What are the main responsibilities of the intern?

The intern will work closely with the PJP (Hybrid commercial role and medical department, being the primary point of contact with the doctor) on a daily basis with the goal of learning and understanding their role. As part of this experience, the intern will have the opportunity to accompany the PJP on visits to healthcare professionals, work hand-in-hand with HSPs (Role responsible for contact with health administrations and health managers in hospitals), collaborate in strategic meetings, and receive training on pathology, among other key learning opportunities

So the purpose of this internship is to work closely with the teams in the field that support our client ecosystem and interact with them in their day to day to serve patients’ needs. This will allow a complete understanding on how the health care system operates and what are the main stakeholders that influence the day to day activities of our commercial and access teams on field. With your support we will create reports and insights to share with cross functional teams and improve our interactions and relationships.

What would be your main responsibilities as an intern?

In this highly regulated and complex industry, the intern gains exposure to real-world challenges and opportunities across areas such as ecosystem, market access, regulatory. By facilitating access to cross-functional teams and relevant projects to develop a 360-degree view of the pharmaceutical ecosystem. Through this guidance, the intern can connect academic knowledge to practical applications, develop a deeper understanding of patient-centric strategies, and recognize the role of innovation and compliance in delivering healthcare solutions.

• Recent graduates or university students who will obtain their degree in the summer, in the areas of life sciences.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deja tu Huella - Communications & Intern

What do we offer?
To be part of a new cohort of the Roche-CEU San Pablo postgraduate degree as an expert in the Pharmaceutical Industry. 11 months of internships at Roche where you will participate in challenging projects and benefit from pioneering postgraduate training in the market about the pharmaceutical industry.

You will have the opportunity to get on the job training by working on key projects with your designated department from Monday to Thursday and attend in person postgraduate classes at the university on Friday.

Our main location is Madrid , we are open to applications from all over Spain but relocation will be needed as part of the program expectations. Office attendance is expected (with some flexbility) to enjoy the connection to our colleagues, network and get exposure.

Last but not least, you will have mentorship by a Roche tutor who will give you continuous feedback to develop your professional skills. The mentors for the program are Roche's senior and experienced young talent development professionals.

Apply for this offer and follow us at @RocheES to share with your network a unique opportunity in the market to start your professional career in the pharmaceutical sector.

What is the main purpose of this internship?
Ideation, development, and implementation of the positioning plan and corporate narrative of Roche Farma España, both nationally and across ecosystems, as well as planning and development of Corporate Social Responsibility actions in collaboration with Internal Communication.

What are the main responsibilities of the intern?

• Assist in the design and execution of communication plans for specific therapeutic areas (e.g., Neuroscience, Ophthalmology).

• Draft, edit, and adapt high-quality content (press releases, internal news, talking points) related to clinical milestones and product launches.

• Create engaging assets for social media and digital platforms, ensuring that scientific data is communicated clearly and creatively.

• Support the management of press conferences, scientific forums, and patient advocacy initiatives.

• Analyze the impact of our therapeutic area communications and stay ahead of healthcare trends in the Spanish market.

What are we looking for in this position?

• Graduate or currently finishing a degree in one of the branches of Information Sciences (communications, journalism, etc).

• Training and/or experience in health communication is desirable

• High capacity for communication and public relations

• Skill and speed in creating and composing texts, ability to obtain and edit videos and images, and deep knowledge of the main social networks.

• We want proactive and curious candidates that are willing to learn and grow by challenging the status quo.

• We are looking for flexible talents that adapt to changes and are willing to collaborate with teams in a network organization.

• Advanced level of communication in English and Spanish.

• Desirable to have international experience as a student or working abroad.

• Passion for improving the lives of patients and motivation to give the best of yourself in an innovative and challenging environment.

• Commitment to dedicate yourself full time to the program from September 2026 to August 2027.

For international students, have a valid NIE or work permit in Spain.

And remember, being part of this program offers you:

• Postgraduate University CEU-Roche: "Deja tu Huella" program with great

The Position
Deja tu Huella - Healthcare Solutions Intern (Centro Ecosystem)

What do we offer?

To be part of a new cohort of the Roche-CEU San Pablo postgraduate degree as an expert in the Pharmaceutical Industry. 11 months of internships at Roche where you will participate in challenging projects and benefit from pioneering postgraduate training in the market about the pharmaceutical industry.

You will have the opportunity to get on-the-job training by working on key projects with your designated department from Monday to Thursday and attend in person postgraduate classes at the university on Friday.

Our main location is Madrid, we are open to applications from all over Spain but relocation will be needed as part of the program expectations. Office attendance is expected (with some flexibility) to enjoy the connection to our colleagues, network and get exposure.

Last but not least, you will have mentorship by a Roche tutor who will give you continuous feedback to develop your professional skills. The mentors for the program are Roche’s senior and experienced young talent development professionals.

Apply for this offer and follow us at @RocheES to share with your network a unique opportunity in the market to start your professional career in the pharmaceutical sector.

Purpose of this internship?

The objective of this internship is to provide strategic and operational support to the Healthcare Solutions team within the Centro Ecosystem, contributing to the efficiency of Patient Journey Partners (PJPs) and supporting the development of future talent within the organization.

The intern will gain hands-on exposure to project management, customer interaction dynamics, and healthcare ecosystem collaboration, while learning directly from experienced PJPs and cross-functional teams.

This role is designed as a career accelerator where the intern will not only support operational activities, but also understand the strategic rationale behind business decisions, contributing with new perspectives, digital agility, and innovative ways of working.

What would be your main responsibilities as an intern?

The intern will be integrated into the Healthcare Solutions team activities, contributing to operational excellence and project coordination within the Centro Ecosystem.

Main responsibilities include:

• Supporting the administrative and operational follow-up of active projects within the area.

• Monitoring project timelines, deliverables, and internal coordination activities.

• Preparing reports and tracking performance metrics to identify opportunities for improvement in stakeholder interaction and project execution.

• Supporting PJPs in cross-functional initiatives and customer engagement activities.

• Contributing with new methodologies and innovative approaches to improve team collaboration and operational efficiency.

• Assisting in the preparation of presentations, reports, and strategic materials for internal and external stakeholders.

• Learning about healthcare ecosystem dynamics, negotiation mechanisms, and customer relationship management within the pharmaceutical industry.

What are we looking for in this position?

Recent graduates or university students who will obtain their degree in the summer, preferably in Healthcare Sciences, Economics, Engineering, or Marketing.

We are looking for proactive, analytical, and curious candidates with strong interpersonal skills and motivation to learn in a dynamic and collaborative environment.

Our main location is Madrid, we are open to applications from all over Spain but relocation will be needed as part of the program expectations. Office attendance is expected (with some flexibility) to enjoy the connection to our colleagues, network and get exposure.

Last but not least, you will have mentorship by a Roche tutor who will give you continuous feedback to develop your professional skills. The mentors for the program are Roche’s senior and experienced young talent development professionals.

Apply for this offer and follow us at @RocheES to share with your network a unique opportunity in the market to start your professional career in the pharmaceutical sector.

Purpose of this internship?

The objective of this internship is to provide strategic and operational support to the Healthcare Solutions team within the Centro Ecosystem, contributing to the efficiency of Patient Journey Partners (PJPs) and supporting the development of future talent within the organization.

The intern will gain hands-on exposure to project management, customer interaction dynamics, and healthcare ecosystem collaboration, while learning directly from experienced PJPs and cross-functional teams.

This role is designed as a career accelerator where the intern will not only support operational activities, but also understand the strategic rationale behind business decisions, contributing with new perspectives, digital agility, and innovative ways of working.

What would be your main responsibilities as an intern?

The intern will be integrated into the Healthcare Solutions team activities, contributing to operational excellence and project coordination within the Centro Ecosystem.

Main responsibilities include:

• Supporting the administrative and operational follow-up of active projects within the area.

• Monitoring project timelines, deliverables, and internal coordination activities.

• Preparing reports and tracking performance metrics to identify opportunities for improvement in stakeholder interaction and project execution.

• Supporting PJPs in cross-functional initiatives and customer engagement activities.

• Contributing with new methodologies and innovative approaches to improve team collaboration and operational efficiency.

• Assisting in the preparation of presentations, reports, and strategic materials for internal and external stakeholders.

• Learning about healthcare ecosystem dynamics, negotiation mechanisms, and customer relationship management within the pharmaceutical industry.

What are we looking for in this position?

Recent graduates or university students who will obtain their degree in the summer, preferably in Healthcare Sciences, Economics, Engineering, or Marketing.

We are looking for proactive, analytical, and curious candidates with strong interpersonal skills and motivation to learn in a dynamic and collaborative environment.

This internship offers a unique opportunity to gain cross-functional exposure within the Rare Diseases area, combining Medical and Marketing perspectives in a highly strategic and competitive environment.

The main objective of the internship is to support the design and implementation of the response plan to the anticipated launch of a new competitor indication in the Rare Diseases ecosystem.

The intern will collaborate closely with both the Medical Manager and Marketing Manager in the execution of the Integrated Commercialization Plan (ICP) 2026/27, contributing to strategic initiatives that support the positioning and competitiveness of Roche therapies.

Main responsibilities include:

• Supporting the development and implementation of strategic response plans related to competitor launches within the Rare Diseases area.

• Collaborating with Medical and Marketing teams in the execution and follow-up of the Integrated Commercialization Plan (ICP) 2026/27.

• Supporting competitive intelligence activities, including monitoring competitor positioning, market dynamics, and emerging trends.

• Assisting in the analysis of scientific, market, and customer insights to support strategic decision-making.

• Collaborating in the preparation of presentations, strategic materials, and internal communication resources.

• Supporting project management activities, timelines, prioritization, and coordination across different stakeholders.

• Participating in cross-functional meetings and initiatives involving Medical, Marketing, and customer-facing teams.

• Contributing to the implementation of tactical initiatives ensuring alignment with business objectives and timelines.

• Supporting the organization and follow-up of key strategic projects within the Rare Diseases ecosystem.

Throughout the internship, the candidate will gain exposure to pharmaceutical strategy, competitive market analysis, project management, and cross-functional collaboration within a highly innovative therapeutic area.

What are we looking for in this position?

Recent graduates or university students who will obtain their degree in the summer, preferably in H

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deja tu Huella- Regional Operational Partner Intern

What do we offer?

To be part of a high-impact internship within the Healthcare Solutions / Customer Operations area, where you will contribute to transforming how mutualist patient processes are managed in Spain through data, innovation, and cross-functional collaboration.

You will join a 11-month internship program combining hands-on experience with strategic project work. From Monday to Thursday, you will be embedded in the Customer Operations / ROP team working on real business challenges, and you will complement your development with structured learning and mentorship from senior professionals.

This role is based in Madrid , with expected office attendance (with some flexibility) to foster collaboration, networking, and exposure to different teams. International mobility could be considered in the future depending on performance and business needs.

You will also receive continuous guidance from an experienced mentor who will support your professional development throughout the program.

Purpose of this internship?

This internship offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the transformation of mutualism healthcare management processes in Spain, focusing on efficiency, data-driven decision-making, and process optimization within the Customer Operations / ROP area.

The project will focus on analyzing and redesigning the end-to-end management of mutualist patients in the context of new financing agreements with the Ministry of Health, ensuring a robust, scalable, and error-free process supported by data analytics and AI tools.

You will work closely with internal teams and external stakeholders to improve operational excellence, explore efficiencies, and enable better coordination across the healthcare ecosystem.

What are the main responsibilities of a Customer Operations (ROP Intern)?

• Support the analysis and redesign of mutualism-related healthcare management processes to improve efficiency and reduce operational errors.

• Contribute to the implementation of an optimized end-to-end process aligned with new financing agreements and regulatory frameworks.

• Use data analytics, Excel, and AI tools to identify inefficiencies, trends, and opportunities for improvement.

• Collaborate with internal squads and external stakeholders including MUFACE , MUGEJU , ISFAS , private healthcare teams, and cross-functional squads.

• Support the development of dashboards, reports, and analytical tools to monitor process performance and financial/operational efficiency.

• Participate in the design of scalable solutions that could potentially be proposed to industry stakeholders such as Farmaindustria for broader adoption.

• Assist in project coordination, prioritization, and follow-up of strategic initiatives within Customer Operations.

• Contribute to discussions around healthcare financing, pricing frameworks, and operational models in collaboration with Ministerio de Sanidad .

What are we looking for in this position?

Recent graduates or university students who will obtain their degree in the summer, in fields such as Business Administration (ADE), Economics, Data Analytics, Data Science, or related disciplines with a strong interest in healthcare systems and operations.

We are looking for proactive, analytical, and collaborative candidates who are motivated by solving complex problems and improving healthcare processes.
Desired skills and qualifications include:

• Strong analytical thinking and prob

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
IT Quality Specialist RDT DIA R&D

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

Working as an IT Quality Specialist, you are part of a global community focused on developing and validating cutting-edge software and COTS systems within Roche’s Diagnostics R&D. In this role, you act as a Computer System Validation (CSV) Subject Matter Expert, bridging regulatory excellence with a lean, innovative approach to digital healthcare solutions.

The opportunity:

• Driving global validation efforts by providing expert guidance and authoring critical CSV documentation, including plans, reports, and risk assessments, across diverse delivery frameworks.

• Ensuring full alignment with GxP, ERES, and internal Roche standards while overseeing periodic system evaluations to uphold continuous audit readiness.

• Partnering with Business and Quality stakeholders as a trusted consultant to facilitate cross-functional collaboration and streamline resolution within product teams.

• Evaluating the impact of changes on validated states to protect data integrity and supporting the growth of scalable digital healthcare solutions in complex environments.

Who you are:

• Possessing a minimum of six years of professional experience in CSV, specifically supporting the lifecycle of COTS and custom software within regulated GxP environments.

• Holding a University degree in Science, Engineering, or Computer Science; equivalent technical backgrounds are also highly valued.

• Demonstrating profound expertise in global regulations, including FDA/EU GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, and the core tenets of Data Integrity.

• Expertly navigating diverse testing methodologies and the end-to-end SDLC within modern Agile frameworks such as Scrum or SAFe.

• A collaborative team player with fluent English skills, comfortable mentoring peers and thriving within international, cross-functional project teams.

• Familiarity with Product Development Processes specific to Medical Devices is considered a distinct advantage.

What you get:

• Salary range 14 175-26 325 PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

IT Quality Specialist RDT DIA R&D

Spécialiste de la qualité des TI

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation répond à des objectifs. En tant qu'équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues d'affaires engagés à aider à façonner demain l'avenir numérique des soins de santé. Notre mission est d'alimenter Roche par des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Poussé par le but et la passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique est une force fondamentale dans toute Roche, permettant des façons plus intelligentes de travailler, débloquant le potentiel humain et conduisant des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde.

Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins des entreprises, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements en collaboration.

En tant que spécialiste de la qualité de l'informatique, vous faites partie d'une communauté mondiale axée sur le développement et la validation de logiciels de pointe et de systèmes COTS au sein de la R-D de diagnostic Roches. L'occasion :
