descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED) , we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

pRED Cardiovascular & Metabolism, Immunology (CMI), located in Basel, Switzerland, focuses on the discovery and early development of innovative treatments for specific diseases that affect the lives of millions. In the cardiovascular and metabolism area, we are developing cutting-edge therapies to treat metabolic diseases.

We are currently hiring four experienced PhD-level Discovery Scientists to join our Cardiovascular & Metabolic Disease Research team :
These opportunities include two in vivo-focused and two in vitro-focused positions , offering the chance to contribute to innovative preclinical research in metabolic diseases. We are looking for candidates with strong expertise in in vitro and/or in vivo pharmacology, a solid industry background, and a proven track record in executing preclinical projects in metabolic diseases and immunology.

The opportunity
In this role, you will design and execute experiments and lead projects to evaluate the efficacy and safety of novel therapeutic candidates.

• Lead research projects in the area of metabolic diseases (insulin resistance, obesity) from target ideation to entry into clinical development for both small- and large-molecule modalities.

• Drive the positioning and prioritization of novel metabolic and immunological targets, integrating disease biology, translational biomarkers, and therapeutic modality selection to align with Roche’s CVM pipeline.

• Collaboratively design, execute, and interpret complex preclinical in vitro and in vivo experimental studies for the validation and characterization of targets or therapeutic agents

• Direct, execute, and benchmark novel experiments, work together hand in hand with associates, and transfer standardized assays to associates

• Act as a resource in project teams, and demonstrate clear and professional verbal and written communication

Who You Are
You’re someone who wants to influence your own development. You are looking for a company where you receive the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies. Working in a multicultural environment motivates you. As a fast learner, you actively drive the quality of the requirements.

• You possess a PhD degree in Life Sciences ; are specialized in Metabolic diseases (insulin resistance, obesity, muscle-/adipose-physiology)

• You have >5 years of research and project leadership experience in the pharmaceutical industry.

• You have demonstrated ability to effectively present scientific data and concepts to colleagues, teams, and management is essential

• Skillfully able to interact effectively with people, both internally and externally

• Vigorous “can do” mentality to succeed in a dynamic and highly collaborative research team

• Depending on your background, this role is embedded in an in vivo–focused or in vitro-focused research team

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity !

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employee
descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED) , realizziamo farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti al fine di affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità.

pRED Cardiovascular & Metabolism, Immunology (CMI), situato a Basilea, Svizzera, si concentra sulla scoperta e lo sviluppo precoce di trattamenti innovativi per malattie specifiche che influiscono sulla vita di milioni di persone. Nella zona cardiovascolare e metabolismo, stiamo sviluppando terapie all'avanguardia per il trattamento delle malattie metaboliche.

Attualmente stiamo assumendo quattro esperti scienziati di ricerca di livello PhD per unirsi al nostro team di ricerca di malattie cardiovascolari e metaboliche:
Queste opportunità includono due posizioni in vivo focalizzate e due in vitro-focused , offrendo la possibilità di contribuire a una ricerca preclinica innovativa nelle malattie metaboliche. Siamo alla ricerca di candidati con una forte esperienza nella farmacologia in vitro e/o in vivo, un solido background del settore, e una comprovata esperienza nell'esecuzione di progetti preclinici in malattie metaboliche e immunologia.

L'opportunità
In questo ruolo, progettare ed eseguire esperimenti e condurre progetti per valutare l'efficacia e la sicurezza dei nuovi candidati terapeutici.

• Progetti di ricerca di piombo nell'area delle malattie metaboliche (resistenza dell'insulina, obesità) dall'ideazione di destinazione all'ingresso nello sviluppo clinico per entrambe le modalità di piccole e grandi molecole.

• Guidare il posizionamento e la priorità di nuovi obiettivi metabolici e immunologici, integrando la biologia delle malattie, biomarcatori traduttivi e la selezione di modalità terapeutiche per allineare con la pipeline di Roche CVM.

• Progettazione, esecuzione e interpretazione di studi sperimentali complessi preclinici in vitro e in vivo per la validazione e caratterizzazione di obiettivi o agenti terapeutici

• Esperimenti di romanzi diretti, esecutivi e benchmark, lavorare insieme a mano in mano con gli associati e trasferire saggi standardizzati agli associati

• Agire come risorsa nei team di progetto e dimostrare una comunicazione verbale e scritta chiara e professionale

Chi sei
Sei qualcuno che vuole influenzare il tuo sviluppo. Stai cercando una società in cui ricevi l'opportunità di perseguire i tuoi interessi attraverso funzioni e geografie. Lavorare in un ambiente multiculturale vi motiva. Come un apprendimento veloce, si guida attivamente la qualità dei requisiti.

• Possiedi un dottorato in Scienze della Vita; sono specializzati in malattie metaboliche (resistenza dell'insulina, obesità, muscolo-/adipose-fisiologia)

• Hai > 5 anni di esperienza nella ricerca e nella leadership del progetto nell'industria farmaceutica.

• Hai dimostrato la capacità di presentare efficacemente dati e concetti scientifici a colleghi, team e gestione è essenziale

• Abilmente in grado di interagire efficacemente con le persone, sia internamente che esternamente

• La mentalità vigorosa “può fare” per avere successo in un team di ricerca dinamico e altamente collaborativo

• A seconda del tuo background, questo ruolo è incorporato in un team di ricerca in vivo o focalizzato in vitro

Pronti a fare il passo successivo? Ci piacerebbe sentirti. Applicare ora per esplorare questa eccitante opportunità!

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position
In der Pharma- und Early Development-Organisation (pRED) von Roche machen wir transformative Medikamente für Patienten, um einige der weltweit härtesten ungenutzten Gesundheitsbedürfnisse zu bewältigen. Bei pRED sind wir vereint von unserer Mission, Wissenschaft in Medikamente zu verwandeln. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine von Neugier, Verantwortung und Demut definierte Kultur, in der unsere talentierten Menschen befähigt und inspiriert sind, außergewöhnliche lebensverändernde Innovation mit Geschwindigkeit voranzubringen.

pRED Cardiovascular & Metabolism, Immunology (CMI), in Basel, Schweiz, konzentriert sich auf die Entdeckung und frühe Entwicklung innovativer Behandlungen für spezifische Krankheiten, die das Leben von Millionen beeinflussen. Im Herz-Kreislauf- und Stoffwechselbereich entwickeln wir modernste Therapien, um Stoffwechselerkrankungen zu behandeln.

Zurzeit stellen wir vier erfahrene Doktoranden an unserem Team für Herz-Kreislauf- und Stoffwechselerkrankungen zur Verfügung:
Diese Möglichkeiten umfassen zwei in vivo-fokussierte und zwei in vitro-fokussierte Positionen, die die Möglichkeit bieten, zur innovativen präklinischen Forschung bei Stoffwechselerkrankungen beizutragen. Wir sind auf der Suche nach Kandidaten mit hoher Expertise in der in-vitro- und/oder in-vivo-pharmakologie, einem soliden Industrie-Hintergrund und einem nachgewiesenen Erfolg bei der Durchführung präklinischer Projekte in Stoffwechsel- und Immunologie.

Die Gelegenheit
In dieser Rolle werden Sie Experimente entwerfen und durchführen und Projekte zur Bewertung der Wirksamkeit und Sicherheit neuartiger therapeutischer Kandidaten führen.

• Führen Sie Forschungsprojekte im Bereich der Stoffwechselerkrankungen (Insulinresistenz, Fettleibigkeit) von der Zielidee bis zum Eintritt in die klinische Entwicklung für sowohl klein- als auch großmolekülige Modalitäten.

• Die Positionierung und Priorisierung neuer metabolischer und immunologischer Ziele, die Integration von Krankheitsbiologie, übersetzenden Biomarkern und die therapeutische Modalitätsauswahl, um sich an die CVM-Pipeline von Roche anzupassen.

• Konzipieren, führen und interpretieren komplexe präklinische in vitro und in vivo experimentelle Studien zur Validierung und Charakterisierung von Zielen oder therapeutischen Mitteln

• Direkte, Durchführung und Benchmark neuartige Experimente, arbeiten Hand in Hand mit Mitarbeitern und übertragen standardisierte Assays an Mitarbeiter

• Aktivieren Sie als Ressource in Projektteams und demonstrieren Sie klare und professionelle mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikation

Wer bist du?
Sie sind jemand, der Ihre eigene Entwicklung beeinflussen will. Sie suchen ein Unternehmen, in dem Sie die Möglichkeit erhalten, Ihre Interessen über Funktionen und Geographien zu verfolgen. Die Arbeit in einer multikulturellen Umgebung motiviert Sie. Als schneller Lernender treiben Sie aktiv die Qualität der Anforderungen.

• Sie besitzen einen Doktorgrad in Life Sciences; sind spezialisiert auf Stoffwechselerkrankungen (Insulinresistenz, Fettleibigkeit, Muskel-/Adamose-Physikologie)

• Sie haben mehr als 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Pharmaindustrie.

• Sie haben die Fähigkeit gezeigt, wissenschaftliche Daten und Konzepte effektiv an Kollegen, Teams und Management zu präsentieren ist unerlässlich

• Geschicklich in der Lage, effektiv mit Menschen zu interagieren, sowohl intern als auch extern

• Vigorous “kann tun” Mentalität zu einem dynamischen und hochkollaborativen Forschungsteam erfolgreich

• Je nach Hintergrund ist diese Rolle in einem in vivo-fokussierten oder in vitro-fokussierten Forschungsteam eingebettet

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir würden gerne von Ihnen hören. Bewerben Sie sich jetzt diese spannende Gelegenheit zu erkunden!

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED) de Roche, nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement l'innovation qui change la vie.

pRED Cardiopathie & Métabolisme, Immunologie (CMI), située à Bâle, Suisse, se concentre sur la découverte et le développement précoce de traitements innovants pour des maladies spécifiques qui affectent la vie de millions de personnes. Dans le domaine cardiovasculaire et métabolique, nous développons des thérapies de pointe pour traiter les maladies métaboliques.

Nous embauchons actuellement quatre chercheurs chevronnés au niveau du doctorat pour rejoindre notre équipe de recherche sur les maladies cardiovasculaires et métaboliques :
Ces possibilités comprennent deux positions in vivo et deux positions in vitro, offrant la possibilité de contribuer à la recherche préclinique innovante sur les maladies métaboliques. Nous recherchons des candidats possédant une solide expertise en pharmacologie in vitro et/ou in vivo, une solide expérience de l'industrie et une expérience éprouvée dans l'exécution de projets précliniques en maladies métaboliques et en immunologie.

L'opportunité
Dans ce rôle, vous concevez et exécutez des expériences et dirigez des projets pour évaluer l'efficacité et l'innocuité des nouveaux candidats thérapeutiques.

• Diriger les projets de recherche dans le domaine des maladies métaboliques (résistance à l'insuline, obésité) depuis l'idée cible jusqu'à l'entrée dans le développement clinique pour les modalités de petites et grandes molécules.

• Favoriser le positionnement et la hiérarchisation de nouvelles cibles métaboliques et immunologiques, intégrant la biologie des maladies, les biomarqueurs translationnels et la sélection des modalités thérapeutiques pour s'aligner sur le pipeline CVM de Roches.

• Concevoir, exécuter et interpréter en collaboration des études expérimentales précliniques in vitro et in vivo complexes pour la validation et la caractérisation de cibles ou d'agents thérapeutiques

• Expérimenter directement, exécuter et comparer de nouvelles expériences, travailler main dans la main avec les associés, et transférer des essais normalisés aux associés

• Agir en tant que ressource dans les équipes de projet et faire preuve de communication verbale et écrite claire et professionnelle

Qui vous êtes
Vous êtes quelqu'un qui veut influencer votre propre développement. Vous êtes à la recherche d'une entreprise où vous aurez l'occasion de poursuivre vos intérêts à travers les fonctions et les géographies. Travailler dans un environnement multiculturel vous motive. En tant qu'apprenant rapide, vous conduisez activement la qualité des exigences.

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat en sciences de la vie ; vous êtes spécialisé dans les maladies métaboliques (résistance à l'insuline, obésité, physiologie musculaire/adiposique)

• Vous avez plus de 5 ans d'expérience en recherche et en leadership de projet dans l'industrie pharmaceutique.

• Vous avez démontré la capacité de présenter efficacement les données et les concepts scientifiques aux collègues, aux équipes et à la gestion est essentielle

• Capacité à interagir efficacement avec les personnes, à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur

• Vigorous peut faire la mentalité de réussir dans une équipe de recherche dynamique et hautement collaborative

• Selon vos antécédents, ce rôle est intégré dans une équipe de recherche in vivo ou in vitro.

Prêt à faire l'étape suivante ? Nous aimerions avoir de tes nouvelles. Postulez maintenant pour explorer cette opportunité passionnante !

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche / GenMark Diagnostics’ mission is to revolutionize patient care by providing high-value, simple-to-perform, and clinically relevant multiplex molecular diagnostics, specifically targeting infectious disease testing. We aim to improve patient outcomes, enhance laboratory efficiency, and reduce total cost-of-care through rapid, sample-to-answer solutions.

Roche/Genmark Diagnostics is seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineer (Sr. Engineer) to join our team. In this role, the Sr. Engineer will be responsible for defining the requirements for new tooling and part designs to deliver high quality plastic injection molded products in a timely and cost-efficient manner. In addition, the Senior Engineer will collaborate with procurement, quality assurance, quality control, operations, document control teams on validation and verification for injection molding tools. This is a highly visible role; allowing the Sr. Engineer to make an immediate impact within the team.

The Opportunity:

• You will create, review, and execute engineering change process for consumable components

• You will complete assembly and part drawings as well as other required documentation from design concept to manufacturing transfer; you will work with production teams to transfer verified designs into full production using principles of DFM/DFA

• You will technically manage projects by identifying, planning, & scheduling technical activities for successful completions.

• You will participate or lead in failure analyses, First Article Inspections, and test method development.

• You will transfer troubleshooting knowledge to Operations, Production, and Contract Manufacturers as new problems arise; you will interact with suppliers and contract manufacturers to ensure parts and assemblies can be reliably produced against material specifications.

• You will perform and document feasibility, design, verification, validation, and risk analysis activities under design controls within the new product development process potentially working alongside outsourced partners.

• You will develop test and development strategies and plans of substantial scope and duration that may include coordinating contributors across teams and outsourced partners..

• You will provide engineering and troubleshooting support to assay integration and development teams.

Who You Are:
(Required)

• You have a B.S. in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, bio-engineering (or equivalent area of study) with 5+ years of industry experience; or a Master’s in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, bio-engineering (or equivalent area of study) with 3+ years of industry experience; or or Ph. D. level in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, bio-engineering, (or equivalent area of study) w/ 1+ years of industry experience.

• You have demonstrated experience with the engineering change control process, including technical report documentation, quality document management, and validation and verification activities.

• You have demonstrated experience with CAD (SolidWorks preferred), including drafting to ASME Y14.5 and GD&T standards.

• You have demonstrated experience in the design, DFM, and production of injection molded plastics, including rapid prototyping, prototype molding, and multi-cavity production molds.

• You are highly skilled at developing and sustaining medical or in-vitro diagnostics consumables and instrumentation working within an ISO 13485/GMP compliant environment.

The Position
Roche / GenMark Diagnostics’ mission is to revolutionize patient care by providing high-value, simple-to-perform, and clinically relevant multiplex molecular diagnostics, specifically targeting infectious disease testing. We aim to improve patient outcomes, enhance laboratory efficiency, and reduce total cost-of-care through rapid, sample-to-answer solutions.

Roche/Genmark Diagnostics is seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineer (Sr. Engineer) to join our team. In this role, the Sr. Engineer will be responsible for defining the requirements for new tooling and part designs to deliver high quality plastic injection molded products in a timely and cost-efficient manner. In addition, the Senior Engineer will collaborate with procurement, quality assurance, quality control, operations, document control teams on validation and verification for injection molding tools. This is a highly visible role; allowing the Sr. Engineer to make an immediate impact within the team.

The Opportunity:

• You will create, review, and execute engineering change process for consumable components

• You will complete assembly and part drawings as well as other required documentation from design concept to manufacturing transfer; you will work with production teams to transfer verified designs into full production using principles of DFM/DFA

• You will technically manage projects by identifying, planning, & scheduling technical activities for successful completions.

• You will participate or lead in failure analyses, First Article Inspections, and test method development.

• You will transfer troubleshooting knowledge to Operations, Production, and Contract Manufacturers as new problems arise; you will interact with suppliers and contract manufacturers to ensure parts and assemblies can be reliably produced against material specifications.

• You will perform and document feasibility, design, verification, validation, and risk analysis activities under design controls within the new product development process potentially working alongside outsourced partners.

• You will develop test and development strategies and plans of substantial scope and duration that may include coordinating contributors across teams and outsourced partners..

• You will provide engineering and troubleshooting support to assay integration and development teams.

Who You Are:
(Required)

• You have a B.S. in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, bio-engineering (or equivalent area of study) with 5+ years of industry experience; or a Master’s in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, bio-engineering (or equivalent area of study) with 3+ years of industry experience; or or Ph. D. level in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, bio-engineering, (or equivalent area of study) w/ 1+ years of industry experience.

• You have demonstrated experience with CAD (SolidWorks preferred), including drafting to ASME Y14.5 and GD&T standards.

• You have demonstrated experience in the design, DFM, and production of injection molded plastics, including rapid prototyping, prototype molding, and multi-cavity production molds.

• You are highly skilled at developing and sustaining medical or in-vitro diagnostics consumables and instrumentation working within an ISO 13485/GMP compliant environment.

The Position
At Roche, 94,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity, and diversity. We believe every employee makes a difference. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives. We are courageous in both decision and action, we believe that good business means a better world.

You will provide strategic leadership and management to the Cell & Gene Therapy Quality Systems organization within PTQC. Accountable for the establishment and Quality oversight of the global tools, processes and procedures specific to Cell & Gene Therapy. Ensure the Quality tools, processes and procedures used in PTC are fit for purpose, GxP compliant and support Clinical development timelines as well as future commercial launch.

The Opportunity:

• You will partner with senior leadership to set the strategic direction and ensure alignment with Roche Quality and business strategies, developing and maintaining strong collaborations with internal and external partners .

• You will provide quality expertise and oversight for IT tools, business processes, and GxP procedures used by the PTC unit, ensuring they are phase-appropriate and fit for purpose for Cell & Gene Therapy production .

• You will liaise with production activities, including Apheresis collection, AAV plasmid production, Drug Substance/Product manufacturing, analytics, and shipment to treatment centers .

• You will coordinate work across systems, functions, and sites to harmonize workflow and optimize cross-functional team member participation .

• You will lead the development, review, and revision of SOPs and procedural documents, and collaborate on updating curricula based on determined training needs .

• You will monitor the implementation and effectiveness of systems, create Quality Management Review metrics, and foster continuous quality improvement and procedural simplification .

• You will support internal and external audits, manage deviations and complaints, provide timely support and author responses for Health Authority interactions, and ensure pragmatic, patient-centered problem solving .

Who you are :

• You will have a Bachelor’s or postgraduate degree in a Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Engineering, or related science discipline.

• You will possess over 10 years of experience in the Pharma/Biopharmaceutical industry, specifically with ATMPs manufacturing, with experience in aseptic operations, Biologics, or analytics being an advantage.

• You will apply strong knowledge of GxP regulations to clinical and commercial products to ensure patient safety and the appropriate level of compliance.

• You will manage ambiguity through effective communication, skillfully removing barriers, and overcoming resistance.

• You will operate autonomously and manage complex situations by successfully coordinating multiple tasks and prioritizing them to deliver optimum results.

• You will demonstrate high integrity and accountability, ensuring your team's actions and decisions are aligned with business objectives.

**Relocation benefits not available for this position**
The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 136,936.00 and 179,728.50 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors as determined by the company.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche, we thrive to deliver more benefits to our patients as part of our 10-year Pharma vision. We serve our patients through external partnerships because access to quality products is every patient’s right. We leverage external partners in order to offer flexibility to our internal capacity at the right cost and quality. We enable our external partners to reliably deliver compliant, quality products to our supply chain customers, so that we can deliver to patients worldwide. We do this through cross-functional collaborations ensuring quality process excellence and continuous improvement.

The Opportunity:

• Provide quality and compliance oversight of CDMOs, CROs/PET centers, and in-licensing partners to ensure compliance with cGMP and quality agreement requirements

• Must have expertise and experience in the clinical product development lifecycle, production oversight, and release of clinical supply

• Execute all required activities to assess and release clinical supply. This includes but is not limited to review and approval of specifications, master batch records, methods, method validation reports, and executed batch records.

• Lead resolution of complex investigations, changes and risk assessments.

• Perform disposition of outsourced investigational medicinal products in SAP, including API and Drug Product of Synthetic Molecules and Biologics ​

• Serve as the Quality Point of Contact for CDMOs, CROs and in-licensing partners, and participate as a key member of cross-functional management teams to enable site selection, qualification and implementation, management, and decommissioning

• Oversee and execute all required quality activities during the lifecycle of these GMP suppliers, especially CDMOs, including but not limited to:

• Develop, negotiate and maintain Quality Agreements and associated documents

• Monitor cGMP compliance and report quality performance. Ensure Key Performance Indicators such as on time closure of records are met.

• Identify and mitigate quality risks. Assess impact to Roche clinical product.

• Support Roche audits, ensuring audit responsiveness and CAPA implementation. For Due Diligence audits, directly manage mitigation of findings prior to site implementation

• Tech transfers and process validation, and Inspection readiness for commercial CDMOs as applicable

• Serve as Quality Point of Contact to the technical development team, and lead the Quality subteam as required. Execute the Product Specification File (PSF), intra-company agreements, approve the control system, review CMC sections of Health Authority submissions and related activities.

Who you are:

• You mush have a B.S., M.Sc. or PhD in life sciences or equivalent.

• At least 8 - 10 years Manufacturing and Quality experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry.

• Must have GMP QA experience in bulk API and Drug Product clinical supply manufacturing operations including release, preferably for Synthetic Molecules as well as Biologics including steriles. Experience with siRNA is a plus.

• Sound knowledge of cGMP, ISO standards and international regulations for pharmaceuticals. Must have the ability to interpret regulatory requirements and quality standards as they relate to clinical GMP product operations.

• Excellent Quality decision making skills in complex environments

• Proven ability to influence across cultures and functional reporting lines, and to drive continuous improvement initiatives

• Ability to operate in a self-managed way of wo

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position
At Roche, we thrive to deliver more benefits to our patients as part of our 10-year Pharma vision. We serve our patients through external partnerships because access to quality products is every patient’s right. We leverage external partners in order to offer flexibility to our internal capacity at the right cost and quality. We enable our external partners to reliably deliver compliant, quality products to our supply chain customers, so that we can deliver to patients worldwide. We do this through cross-functional collaborations ensuring quality process excellence and continuous improvement.

The Network Quality Assurance Manager will be a senior and integral part of the Network QA organization, reporting directly to the Network QA Lead. This role is crucial for maintaining stringent quality assurance standards and ensuring the safety, efficacy, and reliability of our products. As our portfolio and network become increasingly diverse and complex, the role of QA oversight is essential to protect patient safety, minimize risks, and maintain the company’s reputation and operational integrity.

The Opportunity:

• You will lead global cross- chapter initiatives for continuous improvement and standardizes QA decision-making processes globally.

• Foster alignment between Site Quality Assurance Heads in defining and implementing Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs) based on audit findings and quality issues, ensuring timely and effective resolution across all sites.

• Drive the oversight, identification, and assessment of QA-related high-risk issues in all PT manufacturing sites and create risk mitigation strategies and execute corrective actions.

• Be able to support local functions with compliance , technical issues/ counterfeit investigation and ability to effectively communicate with Health Authorities

• Develop strategies to address and mitigate issues effectively, providing comprehensive data and insights, advising the senior decision-makers.

• Collaborate with senior leadership to implement global strategic and operational guidance on quality oversight, executing strategies in alignment with the PT strategy.

• Take an active role in conducting comprehensive risk assessments for manufacturing processes, proactively identify potential quality risks, and devise strategic mitigation plans in close collaboration with senior leadership.

• Act as liaison between global and local QA team to ensure teamwork in aligning on issues.

​
Who You Are:

• Strategic Foundation: Possess an advanced degree (BA/BS/MS or equivalent) in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Engineering, or Chemistry, serving as a critical base for complex decision-making.

• Extensive Industry Impact: Over 12-15 years of progressive, high-impact experience across the pharmaceutical/biotechnology industry, specifically integrating manufacturing, quality, and supply chain functions to drive holistic business outcomes.

• Operational Excellence & Influence: Demonstrated mastery in quality assurance, quality control, and manufacturing operations, evidenced by a verifiable track record of architecting and implementing system-wide efficiency and compliance improvements.

• Global Matrix Leadership: Exceptional and proven matrix leadership capabilities, adept at navigating complex, multicultural, and virtual environments to effectively lead people and business units through significant change and transformation initiatives.

• Risk and Regulatory Authority: Deep and authoritative understanding of global qu

The successful candidate must be someone who thoughtfully challenges ideas, prioritizes impactful work, and can be relied upon to operate in the best interest of the team, thriving in a dynamic work environment.

• You will standardize and optimize the systems and technology powering Quality operations and data insights.

• You will translate complex business use cases and project requirements into standardized technology solutions.

• You will serve as the Global Product Owner or sub-product owner for applicable technologies used in Pharma Technical Operations (PT).

• You will lead the lifecycle management for multiple products and systems, including upgrades, replacement, and retirement of computerized systems.

• You will manage system enhancement features, act as the Business Data Steward for data governance, and drive continuous improvement opportunities.

• You will drive the product vision, roadmap, and development lifecycle.

• You will provide in-depth global subject matter expertise and support the implementation of fit-for-purpose innovative solutions while ensuring GxP

This position requires a collaborative and open-minded individual who is capable of maintaining and transforming integral technologies while valuing continuous learning. The successful candidate must be someone who thoughtfully challenges ideas, prioritizes impactful work, and can be relied upon to operate in the best interest of the team, thriving in a dynamic work environment.

The Opportunity:

• You will standardize and optimize the systems and technology powering Quality operations and data insights.

• You will translate complex business use cases and project requirements into standardized technology solutions.

• You will serve as the Global Product Owner or sub-product owner for applicable technologies used in Pharma Technical Operations (PT).

• You will lead the lifecycle management for multiple products and systems, including upgrades, replacement, and retirement of computerized systems.

• You will manage system enhancement features, act as the Business Data Steward for data governance, and drive continuous improvement opportunities.

• You will drive the product vision, roadmap, and development lifecycle.

• You will provide in-depth global subject matter expertise and support the implementation of fit-for-purpose innovative solutions while ensuring GxP

​

• Candidates must have 7+ years of experience in technology, systems, and platforms management within the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry.

• Experience with validated or controlled environments is a requirement. Experience with Veeva Quality Vault (QMS, Quality Docs) and A/I are preferred.

• Demonstrated proficiency in the Software Development Lifecycle is essential.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Strategic Account Executive - Pathology Lab

The Opportunity:
This role supports our Tissue Diagnostics franchise and will be responsible for meeting and exceeding sales objectives in targeted accounts across specified territories.

Responsible for meeting and exceeding sales objectives (capital instruments & reagents) in targeted Anatomic Pathology labs within the Mid Atlantic Region. Geography is focused on the region’s largest customers, large strategic scenarios, massive consolidations and/or largest competitive opportunities. Must maintain & grow existing accounts & develop new accounts in the assigned geography. Develop partnerships with all levels of Buying Influences to include: C-Suite, Lab Directors, Lab Managers, Histotechnologist, Safety Officers, Materials Management, etc. Additionally, position requires value quantification presentations to potential customers.

This is a field based role. The territory includes: Boston area and parts of CT. Relocation benefits are not provided for this role. Candidates must reside within 50 miles of territory border.

Job Facts:

• Must demonstrate in-depth knowledge of the full portfolio of products offered by Roche Diagnostics, Tissue Division.

• Proven ability to juggle multiple account management projects at a time, while maintaining sharp attention to detail

• Meet with customers to discuss their evolving needs and to assess the quality of our company’s relationship with them

• Coordinates the involvement of company personnel, including support, service, and management resources (specialists), in order to meet account performance objectives and customers’ expectations.

• Proactively leads a joint company-strategic account planning process that develops mutual performance objectives, financial targets, and critical milestones for a one and three-year period.

• Clearly communicate the progress of monthly/quarterly initiatives to internal and external stakeholders

• Proactively assesses, clarifies, and validates customer needs on an ongoing basis.

• Achieves assigned sales quota in designated strategic accounts.

• Closely coordinates company executive involvement and Customer Service Representatives to ensure customer satisfaction and problem resolution.

• Customer focused selling skills is a must to drive consistent results & partnerships.
​

Who you are (minimum qualifications):

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

• You hold 5+ years relevant sales or equivalent experience

Preferred Qualifications:

• Capital sales experience

• Pathology/Digital Pathology sales experience

• Strategic planning and organizational skills

• Experience working with multiple call points (lab managers, directors, clinicians, c-suite)

• Proven leadership abilities

• Understanding of performance metrics

• Ability to work in a regulated environment

• Excellent oral and written communication skills including making impactful presentations

• Hands on experience with CRM software and MS Office (particularly MS Excel)

• Strong negotiation skills with a problem-solving attitude

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of MA is $110,400 - $205,000. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. This position is eligible to earn incentive compensation that is calculated and paid in accordance with the applicable Incentive Compensation Plan for the role. This position also quali
descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Esecutivo del Conto Strategico - Laboratorio di Patologia

L'opportunità:
Questo ruolo supporta il franchising Tissue Diagnostics e sarà responsabile per soddisfare e superare gli obiettivi di vendita in conti mirati in territori specificati.

Responsabile dell'incontro e del superamento degli obiettivi di vendita (strumenti di capitale e reagenti) in laboratori di patologia anatomica mirati all'interno della Regione Mid Atlantic. La geografia si concentra sui clienti più grandi della regione, grandi scenari strategici, massicci consolidamenti e/o maggiori opportunità competitive. Deve mantenere e crescere i conti esistenti & sviluppare nuovi conti nella geografia assegnata. Sviluppare partenariati con tutti i livelli di Influenza di acquisto per includere: C-Suite, Direttori di laboratorio, Direttori di laboratorio, Histotechnologist, Agenti di sicurezza, Gestione dei materiali, ecc. Inoltre, la posizione richiede presentazioni di quantificazione del valore ai potenziali clienti.

Questo è un ruolo basato sul campo. Il territorio comprende: zona di Boston e parti di CT. Le prestazioni di trasferimento non sono previste per questo ruolo. I candidati devono risiedere entro 50 miglia di confine del territorio.

Fatti di lavoro:

• Deve dimostrare una conoscenza approfondita del portafoglio completo di prodotti offerti da Roche Diagnostics, divisione Tissue.

• Prova capacità di affrontare più progetti di gestione account alla volta, mantenendo la massima attenzione ai dettagli

• Incontro con i clienti per discutere le loro esigenze in evoluzione e per valutare la qualità del rapporto della nostra azienda con loro

• Coordina il coinvolgimento del personale aziendale, compreso il supporto, il servizio e le risorse di gestione (specialisti), al fine di soddisfare gli obiettivi di performance del cliente e le aspettative dei clienti.

• Proattivamente conduce un processo di pianificazione del conto aziendale-strategico congiunto che sviluppa obiettivi di performance reciproche, obiettivi finanziari e pietre miliari critici per un periodo di uno e tre anni.

• Comunicare chiaramente il progresso delle iniziative mensili / trimestrali a stakeholder interni ed esterni

• Proattivamente valuta, chiarisce e convalida le esigenze del cliente su base continuativa.

• Ottieni quota di vendita assegnata in conti strategici designati.

• Coordina strettamente il coinvolgimento esecutivo dell'azienda e i rappresentanti del Servizio Clienti per garantire la soddisfazione del cliente e la risoluzione dei problemi.

• Le competenze di vendita focalizzate sul cliente sono un must per guidare risultati e partnership coerenti.

Chi sei (titoli minimi):

• Hai una laurea o un'esperienza equivalente

• Ha 5 anni di vendite rilevanti o esperienza equivalente

Preferiti:

• Esperienza di vendita di capitale

• Esperienza di patologia / patologia digitale

• Pianificazione strategica e competenze organizzative

• Esperienza di lavoro con più punti di chiamata (direttori, amministratori, medici, c-suite)

• Prove capacità di leadership

• Comprensione delle metriche di prestazione

• Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente regolamentato

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione orale e scritta, tra cui fare presentazioni d'impatto

• Mani sull'esperienza con il software CRM e MS Office (in particolare MS Excel)

• Forte capacità di negoziazione con un atteggiamento problem solving

L'intervallo di stipendio previsto per questa posizione in base alla posizione primaria di MA è $110.400 - $205,000. La retribuzione effettiva sarà determinata in base all'esperienza, alle qualifiche, alla posizione geografica e ad altri fattori legati al lavoro consentiti dalla legge. Questa posizione è ammissibile per ottenere un risarcimento degli incentivi che viene calcolato e pagato in conformità al piano di compensazione incentivo applicabile per il ruolo. descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position
Strategic Account Executive - Pathology Lab

Die Gelegenheit:
Diese Rolle unterstützt unseren Franchise-Franchise für Tissue Diagnostics und wird für die Erfüllung und Überschreitung von Verkaufszielen in gezielten Konten in bestimmten Gebieten verantwortlich sein.

Verantwortlich für die Erfüllung und Überschreitung von Verkaufszielen (Kapitalinstrumente & Reagenzien) in gezielten anatomischen Pathologielabors in der Region Mittelatlantik. Geographie konzentriert sich auf die größten Kunden der Region, große strategische Szenarien, massive Konsolidierungen und/oder größte Wettbewerbschancen. Muss bestehende Konten pflegen und wachsen und neue Konten in der zugeordneten Geographie entwickeln. Entwickeln Sie Partnerschaften mit allen Ebenen der Kaufkraft: C-Suite, Lab Directors, Lab Manager, Histotechist, Sicherheitsbeauftragte, Materialmanagement, etc. Darüber hinaus erfordert Position Wert Quantifizierung Präsentationen an potenzielle Kunden.

Dies ist eine feldbasierte Rolle. Das Gebiet umfasst: Boston Bereich und Teile von CT. Verlagerungsleistungen sind nicht für diese Rolle vorgesehen. Die Kandidaten müssen innerhalb von 50 Meilen von der Grenze des Territoriums wohnen.

Job Facts:

• Muss eingehende Kenntnisse über das gesamte Produktportfolio von Roche Diagnostics, Tissue Division, demonstrieren.

• Bewiesene Fähigkeit, mehrere Account-Management-Projekte zu einer Zeit zu joggen, unter Beibehaltung scharfer Liebe zum Detail

• Treffen Sie sich mit Kunden, um ihre sich entwickelnden Bedürfnisse zu diskutieren und die Qualität der Beziehung unseres Unternehmens mit ihnen zu bewerten

• Koordiniert die Einbeziehung von Unternehmenspersonal, einschließlich Unterstützungs-, Service- und Managementressourcen (Spezialisten), um die Leistungsziele und Erwartungen der Kunden zu erfüllen.

• Proaktiv führt ein gemeinsamer unternehmensstrategischer Account-Planungsprozess, der für einen und dreijährigen Zeitraum gemeinsame Leistungsziele, Finanzziele und kritische Meilensteine entwickelt.

• Die Fortschritte der monatlichen und vierteljährlichen Initiativen für interne und externe Interessengruppen klar

• Begutachten, klären und validieren Sie die Kundenbedürfnisse kontinuierlich.

• Achieves hat Verkaufsquote in bestimmten strategischen Konten zugewiesen.

• Koordiniert die Unternehmensleitung und Kundendienstmitarbeiter, um Kundenzufriedenheit und Problemlösung zu gewährleisten.

• Kunden konzentrierte Vertriebsfähigkeiten ist ein Muss, um konsequente Ergebnisse und Partnerschaften zu fördern.

Wer Sie sind (Mindestqualifikationen):

• Sie halten einen Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige Erfahrung

• Sie halten 5+ Jahre relevante Verkaufs- oder gleichwertige Erfahrung

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• Investitionserfahrung

• Pathologie/Digitale Pathologie Vertriebserfahrung

• Strategische Planung und organisatorische Fähigkeiten

• Erleben Sie die Zusammenarbeit mit mehreren Call Points (Lab Manager, Direktoren, Kliniker, c-suite)

• Bewährte Führungsfähigkeiten

• Verständnis der Leistungsmetriken

• Fähigkeit, in einer geregelten Umgebung zu arbeiten

• Ausgezeichnete mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, einschließlich der wirkungsvollen Präsentationen

• Erfahrungen mit CRM-Software und MS Office (insbesondere MS Excel)

• Starke Verhandlungskompetenzen mit einer Problemlösungseinstellung

Der erwartete Gehaltsbereich für diese Position auf Basis des primären Standorts von MA beträgt $110.400 - $205.000. Die tatsächliche Bezahlung wird anhand von Erfahrungen, Qualifikationen, geographischer Lage und anderen gesetzlich zulässigen arbeitsbezogenen Faktoren bestimmt. descriptionByLocale.fr: Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste de directeur du compte stratégique - Laboratoire de pathologie La possibilité : Ce rôle soutient notre franchise de diagnostic tissulaire et sera chargé d'atteindre et de dépasser les objectifs de vente dans des comptes ciblés dans des territoires déterminés. Responsable de l'atteinte et du dépassement des objectifs de vente (instruments de capital et réactifs) dans les laboratoires de pathologie anatomique ciblés de la région du milieu de l'Atlantique. La géographie est axée sur les plus grands clients de la région, les grands scénarios stratégiques, les regroupements massifs et/ou les plus grandes opportunités concurrentielles. Doit maintenir et développer les comptes existants et développer de nouveaux comptes dans la géographie assignée. Établir des partenariats avec tous les niveaux d'influences d'achat, notamment : C-Suite, directeurs de laboratoire, gestionnaires de laboratoire, histotechnologue, agents de sécurité, gestion des matériaux, etc. En outre, la position nécessite des présentations de quantification de valeur aux clients potentiels. C'est un rôle sur le terrain. Le territoire comprend: la région de Boston et des parties de CT. Les indemnités de réinstallation ne sont pas prévues pour ce rôle. Les candidats doivent résider à moins de 50 milles de la frontière territoriale. Faits sur l'emploi : • Doit démontrer une connaissance approfondie du portefeuille complet de produits offerts par Roche Diagnostics, Division des tissus. • Capacité éprouvée de jongler avec plusieurs projets de gestion de comptes à la fois, tout en maintenant une attention particulière aux détails • Rencontrer les clients pour discuter de l'évolution de leurs besoins et évaluer la qualité de la relation de notre entreprise avec eux • Coordonner l'implication du personnel de l'entreprise, y compris le soutien, le service et les ressources de gestion (spécialistes), afin de répondre aux objectifs de performance du compte et aux attentes des clients. • Dirige de manière proactive un processus de planification des comptes stratégiques de l'entreprise qui développe des objectifs de performance mutuels, des objectifs financiers et des jalons critiques pour une période de un et trois ans. • Communiquer clairement les progrès des initiatives mensuelles/trimestriels aux intervenants internes et externes • Évaluer, clarifier et valider les besoins des clients de façon continue. • Atteint le quota de vente attribué dans les comptes stratégiques désignés. • Coordonner étroitement la participation des dirigeants de l'entreprise et les représentants du service à la clientèle pour assurer la satisfaction de la clientèle et la résolution des problèmes. • Les compétences de vente axées sur le client sont indispensables pour obtenir des résultats et des partenariats cohérents. Qui vous êtes (qualifications minimales): • Vous possédez un baccalauréat ou une expérience équivalente • Vous possédez 5 ans ou plus d'expérience en ventes pertinentes Qualifications préférées : • Expérience en ventes de capitaux • Expérience en pathologie/pathologie numérique en ventes • Expérience en planification stratégique et en compétences organisationnelles • Expérience de travail avec plusieurs points d'appel (gestionnaires de laboratoires, directeurs, cliniciens, c-suite) • Compétences éprouvées en leadership • Compréhension des paramètres de performance • Capacité de travailler dans un environnement réglementé • Excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite, y compris la présentation d'effets • Mains sur l'expérience avec le logiciel CRM et le MS Office (en particulier MS Excel) • Fortes compétences en négociation avec une attitude de résolution de problèmes L'échelle salariale prévue pour ce poste en fonction de l'emplacement principal de l'AG est de 110 400 $ - 205 000 $. La rémunération réelle sera déterminée en fonction de l'expérience, des qualifications, de l'emplacement géographique et d'autres facteurs liés à l'emploi permis par la loi. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you a strategic safety and facilities leader ready to make an impact in a fast-paced biotech environment? We're seeking an experienced Director/Associate Director to join our SBX Technology team as the cornerstone of our site's operational resilience and compliance excellence. In this high-visibility role, you'll lead proactive risk management, oversee critical infrastructure, and drive continuous improvement across safety, facilities, and security—all while maintaining inspection readiness around the clock. If you have 8+ years in large-scale industrial environments, proven management expertise, and the drive to anticipate facility demands, we'd like to hear from you.

The Opportunity

• Manages the SHE, Security, and Facilities maintenance to comply with applicable regulatory and company policies, utilizing industry best practices, and identifying and managing risk.

• Works with building management to maintain critical power systems and emergency generators. Serves as the primary internal lead for building power restoration and temporary generators, ensuring building management and external vendors to maintain 100% operational readiness during extended building outage.

• Works cross-functionally to develop and support facilities projects and implementing new technology processes including remodels, new equipment, and reagents, etc . Manages all moves, construction, upgrades, and maintenance for the site.

• Leads hazard identification - determining and implementing necessary risk assessment programs/processes – as well as related facilities changes.

• Responds to and investigates all SHE, Security and Facility issues. Supports post-incident analysis to determine mitigation strategies to reduce future incident frequency and impact.

• Leads, manages, and continuously improves all relevant safety processes in a large generator environment, including hazardous waste management, dangerous goods shipments, chemical safety assessments, spill safety, exposure monitoring, biosafety programs, etc. Identifies and manages risk and ensures compliance.

• Ensures the site complies with applicable regulatory and company policies and is always “inspection ready”. May lead government and company interactions related to SHE, Security, and Facilities requirements including reporting, notification, facilitating inspections, and ensuring closure of corrective actions.

• Establishes monitoring solutions for critical facilities and lab equipment to enable after-hours monitoring and meaningful alerts.

• Prepares clear response plan documents for safety and facilities scenarios that can be executed by on-site personnel outside of standard business hours. Provides transparent documentation of site fail point areas.

Who you are
Education

• Bachelor or Master’s degree in chemistry, safety, industrial hygiene, or other relevant field.

Experience

• 8 years of progressive experience within a large scale industry such as technical manufacturing, diagnostics, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, oil and gas industry, or other relevant industries.

• 5+ years of management experience.

Core Competencies

• Emergency Response & On-Call Availability: Demonstrated capability to respond effectively to critical safety, facilities, or security incidents (chemical spills, power outages, facility emergencies) with flexibility for after-hours and weekend availability as needed; track record of minimizing business disruption during safety events

• Self-Direction & Organization: Highly sel

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Functional Consultant – SAP EWM/TM & Custom Solutions

We are seeking an SAP EWM/ TM Functional Consultant to join our team supporting a highly complex, customized SAP solution. This role is ideal for a consultant who thrives in technically challenging environments and is passionate about deep-dive problem-solving and continuous learning. We are looking for a consultant who is not intimidated by complexity but energized by it. This role requires someone who views a non-standard solution as an intellectual challenge rather than an obstacle, and who sees continuous learning as a core part of the job.

The Opportunity

• Provide functional consulting and support for our bespoke SAP solution with extensive custom developments

• Analyze, troubleshoot, and optimize complex business processes in the supply chain and logistics space

• Collaborate with development and technical teams to understand non-standard functionality and custom implementations

• Drive system enhancements, testing, and deployment activities in a GxP context

• Deal with uncertainty and make decisions at the product level with guidance from a more senior member. Provides solutions to a broad range of difficult problems.

• Primarily interact within product teams, squads, and across the Product Line as applicable. Interacts directly with stakeholders on small to medium engagements. Communicates information, issues, and potential solutions within product teams and clearly communicates the impact of their own work in the context of business needs.

• Travel to Switzerland as needed for on-site support, workshops, and client engagement

Who you are:

• Hands-on experience with SAP EWM (Extended Warehouse Management)

• General understanding of SAP Transportation Management (TM) concepts and integration points

• Working knowledge of BOPF (Business Object Processing Framework) and its application in custom developments

• Familiarity with BGRFC (Background Remote Function Call) functionality

• Experience supporting complex, non-standard SAP solutions with custom code

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity

• Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively across technical and functional teams

• Excellent communication skills in English and ability to work effectively across technical and functional teams

• Willingness and demonstrated ability to learn new concepts and technologies quickly

Nice to have:

• German language skills (written and spoken)

• Experience with SAP ABAP or custom object development

• Experience in the Pharmaceutical environment following GxP guidelines

• Familiarity with change management and process improvement methodologies

• Familiarity with agile methodologies like SAFe

• Basic to intermediate level of business process domain knowledge in supply chain

What you get:

• Salary range 10,000 - 18,000 PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance (target 12%).

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Vacation subsidy available.

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time).

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice).

• Private heal
descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Consulente funzionale – SAP EWM/TM & Custom Solutions

Stiamo cercando un consulente funzionale SAP EWM/TM per unire il nostro team supportando una soluzione SAP altamente complessa e personalizzata. Questo ruolo è ideale per un consulente che prospera in ambienti tecnicamente impegnativi ed è appassionato di deep-dive problem-solving e apprendimento continuo. Siamo alla ricerca di un consulente che non è intimidito dalla complessità ma stimolato da esso. Questo ruolo richiede qualcuno che vede una soluzione non standard come una sfida intellettuale piuttosto che un ostacolo, e che vede l'apprendimento continuo come una parte fondamentale del lavoro.

L'opportunità

• Fornire consulenza e supporto funzionali per la nostra soluzione SAP su misura con ampi sviluppi personalizzati

• Analizzare, risolvere i problemi e ottimizzare i processi aziendali complessi nella supply chain e nello spazio logistico

• Collaborare con team di sviluppo e tecnici per comprendere funzionalità non standard e implementazioni personalizzate

• Miglioramento del sistema di trasmissione, test e attività di distribuzione in un contesto GxP

• Affrontare l'incertezza e prendere decisioni a livello del prodotto con la guida di un membro più anziano. Fornisce soluzioni a una vasta gamma di problemi difficili.

• Interagire principalmente all'interno di team di prodotti, squadre e attraverso la linea di prodotto come applicabile. Interagisce direttamente con le parti interessate su piccoli o medi impegni. Comunica informazioni, problemi e potenziali soluzioni all'interno dei team di prodotti e comunica chiaramente l'impatto del proprio lavoro nel contesto delle esigenze aziendali.

• Viaggiare in Svizzera come necessario per il supporto in loco, workshop e impegno dei clienti

Chi sei:

• Esperienza pratica con SAP EWM (Extended Warehouse Management)

• Comprensione generale dei concetti e dei punti di integrazione SAP Transportation Management (TM)

• Conoscenze di lavoro di BOPF (Business Object Processing Framework) e la sua applicazione negli sviluppi personalizzati

• Familiarità con funzionalità BGRFC (Background Remote Function Call)

• Esperienza di soluzioni SAP complesse e non standard con codice personalizzato

• Forte capacità analitiche e problem solving con la capacità di navigare ambiguità

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e capacità di lavorare efficacemente in team tecnici e funzionali

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione in inglese e capacità di lavorare efficacemente in team tecnici e funzionali

• Volontà e capacità dimostrata di apprendere rapidamente nuovi concetti e tecnologie

Bello da avere:

• competenze linguistiche tedesche (scritte e parlate)

• Esperienza con SAP ABAP o sviluppo di oggetti personalizzati

• Esperienza nell'ambiente farmaceutico seguendo le linee guida GxP

• Familiarità con la gestione dei cambiamenti e metodologie di miglioramento dei processi

• Familiarità con metodologie agili come SAFe

• Livello base a livello intermedio di conoscenza del dominio del processo aziendale nella catena di fornitura

Che cosa si ottiene:

• Salario range 10.000 - 18.000 PLN lordo basato sul contratto di lavoro.

• Pagamento bonus annuale in base alle tue prestazioni (target 12%).

• Bilancio di formazione dedicato (formazione, certificazioni, conferenze, percorsi di carriera diversificati ecc.).

• Ricarica venerdì (2 venerdì per trimestre disponibile).

• Prendere il programma di tempo (fino a 3 mesi di congedo da utilizzare per qualsiasi scopo).

• Sovvenzione per le vacanze disponibile.

• Flex Location (possibilità di eseguire il nostro lavoro da diversi luoghi del mondo per un certo periodo di tempo).

• Prendere il tempo per la carità ( congedo a pagamento aggiuntivo di massimo 2 settimane per impegnarsi nell'azione di carità di vostra scelta).

• Cura privata
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position

Functional Consultant – SAP EWM/TM & Custom Solutions

Wir suchen einen SAP EWM/ TM Functional Consultant, um mit unserem Team eine hochkomplexe, maßgeschneiderte SAP-Lösung zu unterstützen. Diese Rolle ist ideal für einen Berater, der in technisch anspruchsvollen Umgebungen lebt und leidenschaftlich über tiefgehende Problemlösung und kontinuierliches Lernen ist. Wir suchen einen Berater, der nicht durch Komplexität eingeschüchtert, sondern von ihm eingeschüchtert wird. Diese Rolle erfordert jemanden, der eine nicht standardisierte Lösung als intellektuelle Herausforderung betrachtet, anstatt als Hindernis, und der ständiges Lernen als Kernteil der Arbeit sieht.

Die Chance

• Bereitstellung von funktioneller Beratung und Unterstützung unserer maßgeschneiderten SAP-Lösung mit umfangreichen kundenspezifischen Entwicklungen

• Analyse, Fehlersuche und Optimierung komplexer Geschäftsprozesse in der Lieferkette und Logistik

• Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklungs- und technischen Teams, um nicht-Standard-Funktionalität und kundenspezifische Implementierungen zu verstehen

• Antriebssystemerweiterungen, Tests und Bereitstellungsaktivitäten in einem GxP-Kontext

• Umgang mit Unsicherheit und Entscheidungen auf der Produktebene mit Anleitung von einem höheren Mitglied. Bietet Lösungen für eine breite Palette von schwierigen Problemen.

• Grundsätzlich interagieren innerhalb von Produktteams, Teams und über die Produktlinie. Interagiert direkt mit Interessenvertretern über kleine bis mittlere Engagements. Kommuniziert Informationen, Probleme und potenzielle Lösungen innerhalb von Produktteams und kommuniziert eindeutig die Auswirkungen ihrer eigenen Arbeit im Kontext der geschäftlichen Bedürfnisse.

• Reisen in die Schweiz nach Bedarf für Unterstützung vor Ort, Workshops und Kundenbindung

Wer du bist:

• Hand-on-Erfahrung mit SAP EWM (Extended Warehouse Management)

• Allgemeines Verständnis von SAP Transportation Management (TM) Konzepten und Integrationspunkten

• Arbeitswissen von BOPF (Business Object Processing Framework) und dessen Anwendung in kundenspezifischen Entwicklungen

• Vertrautheit mit BGRFC (Background Remote Function Call) Funktionalität

• Erleben Sie komplexe, nicht standardisierte SAP-Lösungen mit benutzerdefiniertem Code

• Starke analytische und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Mehrdeutigkeit zu navigieren

• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und effektives Arbeiten in technischen und funktionalen Teams

• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Englisch und die Fähigkeit, effektiv über technische und funktionale Teams zu arbeiten

• Bereitschaft und demonstrierte Fähigkeit, neue Konzepte und Technologien schnell zu lernen

Schön zu haben:

• Deutschkenntnisse (schriftlich und gesprochen)

• Erfahrung mit SAP ABAP oder benutzerdefinierter Objektentwicklung

• Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Umgebung nach GxP-Richtlinien

• Vertrautheit mit Change Management und Prozessverbesserung Methoden

• Vertrautheit mit agilen Methoden wie SAFe

• Grundlegende bis mittleres Niveau des Business-Process-Domain-Wissens in der Lieferkette

Was Sie bekommen:

• Salary Bereich 10.000 - 18.000 PLN brutto auf der Grundlage des Arbeitsvertrags.

• Jährliche Bonuszahlung auf Basis Ihrer Leistung (Ziel 12%).

• Dediziertes Ausbildungsbudget (Ausbildung, Zertifizierungen, Konferenzen, diversifizierte Karrierewege usw.).

• Freitagserneuerung (2 Freitage pro Quartal verfügbar).

• Nehmen Sie Zeit Programm (bis zu 3 Monate Urlaub zu jedem Zweck zu verwenden).

• Urlaubszuschüsse verfügbar.

• Flex Location (Möglichkeit, unsere Arbeit von verschiedenen Orten der Welt für einen bestimmten Zeitraum durchzuführen).

• Nehmen Sie Zeit für Charity (zusätzliche bezahlte Urlaub von maximal 2 Wochen, um sich in die Wohltätigkeitsaktion Ihrer Wahl zu engagieren).

• Private Heilung

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un consultant qui ne soit pas intimidé par la complexité mais stimulé par elle. Ce rôle exige une personne qui considère une solution non standard comme un défi intellectuel plutôt qu'un obstacle, et qui considère l'apprentissage continu comme une partie essentielle du travail.

L'opportunité

• Analyser, dépanner et optimiser les processus complexes de la chaîne logistique

Interagit directement avec les intervenants sur les engagements de petite à moyenne taille. • Expérience pratique avec SAP EWM (Extended Warehouse Management)

• Compréhension générale des concepts et des points d'intégration SAP Transportation Management (TM)

• Connaissance pratique du BOPF (Business Object Processing Framework) et de son application dans les développements personnalisés

• Familiarité avec la fonctionnalité BGRFC (Background Remote Function Call)

• Expérience supportant des solutions SAP complexes et non standard avec code personnalisé

• Fortes compétences en analyse et résolution de problèmes avec la capacité de naviguer l'ambiguïté

• Excellentes compétences en communication et aptitude à travailler efficacement entre les équipes techniques et fonctionnelles

• Excellentes compétences en communication en anglais et capacité de travailler efficacement entre les équipes techniques et fonctionnelles

• Volonté et aptitude démontrée à apprendre rapidement de nouveaux concepts et technologies

Sympa d'avoir:

• Compétences linguistiques en allemand (écrit et parlé)

• Expérience avec SAP ABAP ou développement d'objets personnalisés

• Expérience dans l'environnement pharmaceutique suivant les directives GxP

• Connaissance des méthodes de gestion du changement et d'amélioration des processus

• Familiarité avec les méthodologies agiles comme SAFe

• Niveau de base à intermédiaire des connaissances du domaine des processus opérationnels dans la chaîne d'approvisionnement

Ce que vous obtenez:

• Salaires compris entre 10 000 et 18 000 PLN brut sur la base du contrat de travail.

• Paiement de bonus annuel en fonction de votre performance (objectif 12%).

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are working to make next-generation sequencing simple and accessible enough for routine use. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. Our Systems Technology Group, a part of Roche Sequencing Solutions, is focused on creating and advancing technologies to significantly enhance DNA sequencing workflows.

We are seeking a hands-on Chemistry & Fluidic Systems Integration Scientist/Engineer to serve as a Subject Matter Expert in chemistry and biology . Joining our current team of talented scientists and engineers, you will bridge the gap between complex molecular biology, physical chemistry and cutting-edge microfluidic instrumentation and consumables.

The ideal candidate will thrive at this intersection, actively porting and translating complex workflows onto novel systems during the earliest stages of research and development. You will be responsible for rigorously testing new concepts, developing and executing complex assays, troubleshooting integrated subsystems, and optimizing overall performance based on first principles.

Your Role and Responsibilities:

• You will tackle efforts to translate, test, and optimize complex, multi-step chemical and molecular biology workflows (e.g., purification, synthesis, library prep, target enrichment, amplification, and sequencing) on early-stage microfluidic systems. You will successfully navigate the transition of assays from solution-phase to solid-phase environments and quantify reactions on surfaces.

• You will perform the selection, formulation, and optimization of buffers, surfactants, coatings and critical additives. You will leverage your understanding of the distinct purpose of each reagent to maintain efficiency and optimize chemical and enzymatic reactions within microfluidic or closed-system environments.

• You will design and execute rigorous experiments using statistical methods to characterize system performance and troubleshoot issues. You will apply your functional grasp of chemistry to navigate challenges related to chemical compatibility, surface tension, surface passivation, ionic strength, shear forces, and the influence of pH on surface interactions.

• You will conduct early-stage, deep-dive troubleshooting for complex performance issues on novel systems. You will seamlessly connect systemic failures such as leaks, null results, or surface fouling back to first-principles root causes, whether molecular, chemical, material, or physical.

• You will serve as a subject matter expert in molecular biology, sample and library preparation, and sequencing chemistry. You will be a go-to person for explaining complex biological and chemical concepts to a team of talented engineers.

• You will analyze complex, multi-modal data sets and serve as a key technical partner to both assay development scientists and hardware design engineers. You will provide critical, data-driven feedback to guide the co-development of reagents, consumables, and instrument hardware, ensuring chemistry, molecular biology, and engineering are harmonized through iterative feedback cycles.

A cover letter is required for this application. Please outline your relevant experience and explain why you are interested in this role and our company.

This is an on-site position based in Santa Clara, CA.
Relocation benefits are not being offered for this role.

Who You Are (Required):

• You have a PhD in Chemist
